summary: Decks and setup for Teleion agent infrastructure and Eranos public-good marketplace
readme_summary: Public overview repo with decks, evidence, and architecture for Teleion Fabric durable task queue and storage. Supports agent work-sharing, verification, and reuse plus Eranos marketplace. Points to main Teleion Fabric repo.

summary: Modernizes COBOL to Java/SQL then verifies it against the original
readme_summary: AI integrator that converts legacy COBOL to Java/SQL then re-checks output on fresh records and adversarial tests. Built on Meta Muse Spark with Vercel demo, VS Code integration and docs for measurement and showcase.

summary: Local-first task control plane where work persists beyond agent chats
readme_summary: Stint makes the task the unit of work with planner, agent, and reviewer loops. Local-first control plane with live scorecards. Uses Muse Spark Open and Muse Glimmer 30B via Baseten, Fireworks, Modal, and Ollama.

summary: Privacy gateway that replaces PII with reversible placeholders for AI agents.
readme_summary: Privacy gateway: PII becomes reversible placeholders before leaving network and restores on return. Python Docker self-hosted Apache-2.0. Built on Meta open models, runs locally with hosted demo.

summary: Zero-trust proxy that redacts keys and PII before prompts reach any AI model
readme_summary: Python gateway that blocks secrets, swaps personal data for placeholders, and checks files and coding agents. Uses Muse Glimmer on GPU and Muse Spark in cloud. Docker/compose deploy with corpus and evals.

summary: Shared memory infrastructure letting AI agents reuse verified work
readme_summary: Fabric stores Task Objects agents can search and reuse, with film-engine demo and eval suite. Dockerized API searchable via curl. Uses Muse models for task search ranking and learning records.

summary: Yes-no bedside aid giving voice to ventilated ICU patients via confirmed gestures
readme_summary: Phone-based aid for awake ventilated ICU patients asking optimal yes/no questions via movement. Backend with plain-code decision logic, movement perception, and first-person speech output. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 for vision, hearing, and question proposals.

summary: Autonomous GitHub issue scout, triage router and fail-to-pass repair agent.
readme_summary: ISSA AS scouts GitHub issues, routes triage across models and performs deterministic fail-to-pass repair with attestation. Triage and critic use Muse Spark Open on Baseten, repair uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API. Security-first solo build with CI and evals.

summary: Turns spoken commands into physical search and drive actions for a tank robot.
readme_summary: MITT pipeline converts speech to navigation goals with search, drive, and arrival checks on a real tank. Python robotics stack with Docker, bench tools, and recorded run reports. Uses Meta models for spoken instruction parsing and tracking.

summary: Voice-locked safety agent that checks in and alerts contacts with location
readme_summary: Watch Me listens for threats and coercion and asks Are you OK, alerting chosen contacts with transcript and map if unanswered. It combines on-device ECAPA and Whisper gating, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark Open with deterministic rules. App adds map and hash-chained log.

summary: Photo of reclaimed wood becomes measured cut plans, 3D renders and build steps.
readme_summary: RecupBuild measures reclaimed planks from a photo with A4 scale reference and generates sized projects. A cutting engine places cuts and outputs plans, 3D render and assembly steps. Built with PHP MVC + SQLite using Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image via Meta Model API.

summary: Verifies disaster debris truck loads by video for FEMA audits.
readme_summary: Load intelligence system with video-verified volumetric tickets, truck tare checks and audit-ready compliance. Includes backend, voice transcription and measurement workflow. Uses SAM 3.1 for vision measurement and Muse Spark 1.3 for validation.

summary: Scan owned parts to see what they can become and find missing pieces to buy or sell
readme_summary: Orphan Parts Lens scans owned items, suggests reuse builds, and helps find or list parts. Provides evidence-backed answers using Meta Muse models. Stack includes mobile client, backend, live demo and docs site with examples.

summary: Phone photo plus voice to measured claim-ready damage report
readme_summary: SnapClaim builds an evidence-cited damage report where numbers link to machine-checkable receipts. Backend + CLI + bench with 4-model pipeline. Uses SAM 3.1 for masks, Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Spark Open and Muse Voice.

summary: Hands-free voice mock interviewer that checks numbers and re-asks puzzles.
readme_summary: Spoken interview practice that transcribes answers and verifies math exactly. Python 3.12 web app with Docker deployment. Uses Muse Spark Open models for follow-ups and pushback.

summary: Zero-shot drone inspection of turbine blades to repair plans.
readme_summary: BladeSight converts drone photos into a verified, prioritized wind-turbine repair plan. Built from scratch for the hackathon with replay-mode demo. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark plus Muse Spark Open for planning.

summary: Converts scanned financial archives into cited, double-checked searchable database
readme_summary: Archivist digitizes scanned financial archives into a verified database with citations. Stack uses Docker, Python pipeline with human review queue. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Spark Open, Muse Glimmer and SAM 3.1 for extraction and verification.

summary: CI gate that scans fine-tuned checkpoints against base for drift and safety
readme_summary: Keel is a checkpoint validity harness that compares derivatives to base models and returns a validity card with exit codes. Built with Docker, Python and Hugging Face demo. Uses Meta open-weight models for base comparison and structural signature analysis.

summary: Synthetic market-data benchmark testing Muse on messy quant finance cleaning.
readme_summary: Procedurally generated benchmark that tests Muse models on quant-finance data-cleaning and exact numeric work. Uses deterministic scorer, not model grading, with Docker demo. Reports Muse Spark 1.3 turn efficiency on tools_frontier tier.

summary: Microscopy assistant that segments cells and reports calibrated uncertainty ranges
readme_summary: VeriCell answers questions on microscope images by detecting cells/organoids and checking each one. Built with Python/FastAPI and Docker, it uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: 3D digital twin and AI copilot for rural solar microgrid decisions.
readme_summary: Simulates 24-hour solar, battery and load-shedding for rural microgrids in 3D. Next.js 15 Turborepo with Three.js, TypeScript and Vitest. Uses Meta AI copilot for energy decision support.

summary: University timetabler where LLM proposes and C++ CP-SAT solver proves.
readme_summary: ScheduleSolve AI combines Muse Spark proposals with 540-line C++17 solver beating OR-Tools at 361 sections. Stack is Python backend, Next.js 16 frontend, Docker Compose with 183 tests.

summary: Card game that matches UK students to top 3 degree subjects and real courses
readme_summary: Four card rounds build a paper-craft room profile to recommend subjects, wildcard, UK courses and apprenticeships. Stack with web frontend, API, functions and DB. Uses Meta AI for matching and simulation.

summary: AI walkaround inspection that films rental units and flags damage
readme_summary: Preflight guides filming of rental equipment then checks condition for human decision. Python engine with API, eval, Docker and offline judge replay page. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, SAM 3.1, Muse Wonder and Voice Transcribe.

summary: Simulates living 30 days in a home before you sign the lease
readme_summary: Pre-living agent that builds household simulations from voice intake and room photos to produce evidence-checked reports. Uses Muse agent planning with vision and voice pipeline, validated by JS/Python tests.

summary: Type one sentence to generate a playable board game for friends tonight.
readme_summary: BoardDream turns a one-sentence prompt into a playable board game with rules, assets, and multiplayer. Stack is TypeScript monorepo with apps/packages, Docker, and evals. Uses Muse Spark for generation, Muse Image for art, and SAM 3.1 for vision.

summary: LLM proposes cell-model fixes, exact solvers verify them for lab testing
readme_summary: Repairs 30-node DNA-damage Boolean model by having Muse Spark propose rules from papers. Verifies with clingo, mpbn and PhysiBoSS simulation, prioritizing hypotheses for labs.

summary: Fine-tuned LLM reads DNA methylation to find tumor signals in blood
readme_summary: Burotu fine-tunes open-weight Muse Glimmer 30B with methylation adapter + QLoRA. It detects tumour signals in blood samples and names tissue origin. Ships with live demo, six training runs, open weights and preprint.

summary: Measures street flood depth from one phone photo to route vehicles and protect sites
readme_summary: Two Meta open models, Muse Spark Open and SAM 2.1, cross-check to estimate depth with error. Rust engine fuses readings into live street map with routing and critical-site monitoring. Stack is Rust, Go, Python with MCP.

summary: Voice-first shared transit pods for Abuja corridors with safe station pickups.
readme_summary: AI-orchestrated 4-seat pods along six Abuja corridors loading at filling stations. Muse Spark understands Pidgin, Hausa and English, assigns pods, boarding codes and family tracking. FastAPI backend, Vercel frontend, 46 tests.

summary: Daily peat-fire spread forecasts and crew routes for commanders
readme_summary: Predicts next-day peat fire spread in Indonesia and assigns crew checks. Rangers reply via WhatsApp voice notes to update plans. Uses Meta AI for briefings, photo and voice reports.

summary: Turns chaotic typed, spoken, or photographed dumps into exactly one next physical step
readme_summary: Backend extracts distinct tasks to a hidden reserve and reveals one step at a time via web and mobile clients. Uses muse-spark-open on Baseten plus Muse Spark and Wonder for parsing and ordering. Includes live demo, seed DB, and Docker render setup.

summary: Verifies AI bug fixes by replaying gameplay and watching frames
readme_summary: Tests coding-agent fixes by playing the game and recording replays with frame evidence. Harness with Docker, agents, bench and bugs corpus. Uses Muse Code fixes with engine logs plus screenshot review to accept or reject patches.

summary: Turns wildlife clips into verifiable animal event timelines with spatial audio cues.
readme_summary: WildScore creates an evidence-linked event timeline from wildlife video for researcher verification and CSV export. Meta SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 propose animal appear-leave events with sight and sound evidence. Includes keyless viewer demo and Docker setup.

summary: Visualizes curtains on your window from a photo for try-before-buy
readme_summary: Curtain virtual try-on: SAM 3.1 finds the window, Muse Image renders fabric, Muse Spark checks result. Node.js + Docker app with CI, evals and ops. Showcases home-decor visualization using Meta vision and image models.

summary: Forwards suspicious messages and gets an evidence-linked fraud investigation
readme_summary: Red Flag investigates texts, emails, screenshots and voicemails like a fraud analyst with linked proof and next steps. Built with Python on Modal, it uses Muse Spark agents plus isolated browser checks to catch phishing pages and scams.

summary: AI coordinator that proposes proven geometry fixes for colliding 3D designs
readme_summary: ORCA is an AI design coordinator where Muse models propose model edits for clashing building and machine designs. Each fix is proven with geometry checks before reaching the user. Observe, Resolve, Check, Apply workflow with spend-tracked prompts.

summary: Multi-agent engine for policy-grounded government data-incident response.
readme_summary: Mandated agents guide incident response under local laws with policy grounding. Built with Muse Spark, Muse Glimmer, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe via Meta Model API. Includes live demo, vercel deployment and audit trails.

summary: Phone video in, measured URDF out, verified by MuJoCo replay over footage
readme_summary: Pipeline converting articulated-object video into measured URDF/MJCF with replay validation. Python stack with Modal apps and MuJoCo checking motion match. Uses Muse Spark agent driving SAM 3.1 segmentation.

summary: Tabletop robot that finds lost items at home and points to them
readme_summary: Tabletop robot for older adults that locates lost objects and points at them. Uses on-device vision with cloud Meta models for detection and multilingual dialogue in 15 languages. Images stay local for privacy with startup-track hackathon build.

summary: Turns phone video of motion into tested physics equations
readme_summary: Converts phone video or machine logs into candidate equations then tests them by numerical simulation on held-out data. Python backend plus frontend with SAM 3.1 tracking; Meta open-weight reasoning model proposes equations.

summary: Voice-first 3D home memory that answers where misplaced items are.
readme_summary: iPhone LiDAR scan builds a 3D map to locate items by voice for blind and low-vision users. MapAnything builds maps, SAM 3.1 finds objects, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark Open handle Q&A with verification.

summary: Proxy that keeps real AI keys hidden and issues scoped agent tokens with voice rotation.
readme_summary: wAIrrior monitors business apps and machines to detect irregularities and contain attacks. Stack includes Docker/GCP deploy, channels and crew agent modules. Uses Muse models for detection and voice-driven key rotation via scoped tokens.

summary: Live chaos lab that injects faults and benchmarks AI incident investigators
readme_summary: Observability console at epicenter.watch with fault injection, telemetry charts and verdict logs. Compares investigator models including fine-tuned Glimmer 30B LoRA adapter on Hugging Face.

summary: Autonomous marketer making daily Instagram carousels from real product photos
readme_summary: Mobile-first PWA with daily background jobs that build 3-slide carousels without redrawing products. Next.js stack with agent pipeline and Instagram integration. Uses Muse Wonder for trends and Muse Spark Open for copy and layout.

summary: Log meals hands-free with Ray-Ban Meta glasses reading a scale into Apple Health.
readme_summary: itlogs.food uses Ray-Ban Meta glasses to read grams from any digital scale and identify foods for calorie logging. It has iOS, server, functions and evals writing to Apple Health. Muse Spark names foods and estimates calories and macros.

summary: Checks garment dye wastewater treatment claims using factory sensor records and AI.
readme_summary: Tellwater links a garment to its dyeing wastewater and verifies treatment from simulated factory meters and records. It uses Meta Muse Spark for investigation and a fine-tuned open Muse Glimmer, with agent, API, core and eval components. Live demo runs capped Muse Spark inference per visitor.

summary: One voice agent that carries tasks across watch, glasses and phone.
readme_summary: Multi-app monorepo with live cross-device session for Watch, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, iPhone and Mac. Routes one utterance across connected apps with security model. Uses Muse Wonder, Spark, Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1.

summary: Photo of broken part to measured printable CadQuery model using screen as ruler
readme_summary: PartSmith measures parts from photos using laptop screen as scale reference with SAM 3.1 metrology. Muse Spark Open writes parametric CadQuery models gated by deterministic verifier. Exposes open registry over REST and MCP with Next.js frontend.

summary: Rehearses developer-exit failures in Docker to show which team workflows still work
readme_summary: Deterministic Go controller injects handover faults in Docker Compose apps and records evidence. A Meta Responses API agent diagnoses only from verified logs. Includes BYO app onboarding, acceptance suite, and handover gate CI.

summary: Code reviewer that must prove bugs with failing sandbox tests
readme_summary: Review loop where reviewer can only report defects with reproducing failing tests in isolated sandbox. Builder revises until pass, sealed in SHA-256 certificate verifiable in browser. Muse-powered with 902 proof bundles.

summary: Grocery assistant that learns habits, maps stores and finds cheaper items
readme_summary: Arya maintains grocery lists, learns usage from purchases, maps stores and flags out-of-stock or cheaper nearby. Python stack with receipt arithmetic tests and privacy pixelation. Built with Meta Muse models.

summary: Autonomous agent that builds, tests, and reuses its own tools safely
readme_summary: Autonomous agent for verifiable goal execution that creates missing skills when blocked, tests them in Modal/Docker sandboxes, and reuses them as graph workflows. Python 3.12 stack with human approval gates for safe execution.

summary: Product photo to Shopify listing and studio photos in English and Bangla
readme_summary: ListSnap turns one photo, voice note or video into a Shopify/WooCommerce draft with listing, cutouts, studio photos and reel. Full-stack store app with DB. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 for cutouts and Muse Image for photos.

summary: AI agent that waits on hold in phone queues so you don't have to.
readme_summary: Holdmate adaptive IVR agent with queue, board, and iOS/watch clients. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 on api.meta.ai for intent normalization and live eval. Talk-loop rescue and Spark fallback in progress.

summary: Provenance gate that decides which voices a wearable agent must obey.
readme_summary: Authority layer for glasses agents that filters audio commands by speaker provenance. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, Muse Wonder for scene reading, Muse Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 grounding. Includes playground demo and audit docs.

summary: Reassembles torn documents from a single photo.
readme_summary: Untorn rebuilds torn pages from one phone photo by segmenting pieces and reading across tears like a crossword. Built as Next.js app with e2e tests, it uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for reassembly.

summary: Films a manual lab protocol and converts it to runnable Opentrons robot code
readme_summary: Converts filmed BioVL2 lab videos, protocols.io links or PDFs into Opentrons protocols. Stack is Python app with Vercel frontend, Modal and Docker. Uses Muse Spark for protocol reasoning and SAM 3.1 for video lab understanding.

summary: Teaches Meta glasses to watch for custom events from voice and 10s look
readme_summary: iPhone app streams glasses view to a fine-tuned Muse Glimmer 30B detector that alerts via glasses. Backend with playground web and docs. Uses Muse Glimmer fine-tune for few-shot vision detection on Meta glasses.

summary: Authoring tool for LLM NPCs where a ledger enforces game rules
readme_summary: NPC Workshop lets authors create Muse-based game characters where models propose dialogue and actions. A deterministic ledger decides outcomes with testing and eval harness. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Spark Open, Image and Voice Transcribe.

summary: Personal browser agent with long-horizon execution and verifiable actions
readme_summary: Personal browser agent powered by Meta Muse muse-spark-open by default with turn budgeting and digital identity engine. Dockerized Node.js service for long-horizon web tasks. Exposes verifiable browser actions.

summary: Schedules EV charging and compute jobs for windiest, cleanest power hours
readme_summary: Wind Buddy agent on Muse Spark plans home EV charging and datacenter loads into clean wind hours with tool-verified fact checking. Plan goes to ESP32 board with mic, speaker, button and relay for human approval and switching. Includes web console, firmware and carbon planning.

summary: WhatsApp trip companion tracking itineraries, flights and preferences
readme_summary: Escala ingests flights, stays and bookings from text or screenshots and monitors changes on WhatsApp in English, Spanish and French. It answers with sources and learns travel preferences when permitted. Built with Meta Model API and Muse Spark Open for memory via Baseten, deployed on Railway.

summary: Controls city floodgates with radar and models to stop sewage overflow.
readme_summary: Model-predictive controller for combined-sewer floodgates using NEXRAD radar and EPA SWMM5 DYNWAVE simulation with SHA-256 verified traces. Python backend plus frontend dashboard. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark 1.3, Wonder, Voice, Image and Glimmer.

summary: Traces viral flood videos to earlier copies with frame-by-frame evidence reports
readme_summary: Takes a video and claim, finds earlier copies, proves match frame by frame and checks date. Python stack with src, bench, prototypes and evidence reports. Built with Meta Muse models for verification.

summary: Blinded screening agent that predicts compound mechanism from cell images.
readme_summary: Plans limited well imaging on BBBC021, reviews calls before unblinding, then checks against PubChem, ChEMBL and PubMed. Backend plus frontend with eval harness and live demo. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and SAM 3.1.

summary: Slow phone pan becomes product catalog, shop page and order sheet for live sellers
readme_summary: PanShop turns one camera pan and narration into order codes, images, titles, catalog and vertical videos, then parses A3+1 comments into orders. Built with Next.js, TypeScript and eval docs. Uses SAM 3.1 for product segmentation and Muse models for titles, descriptions and comment parsing.

summary: Checks invoices against deliveries and drafts payments for human approval
readme_summary: Ledgerline links invoices, purchase orders, photos and voice memos to flag discrepancies and draft emails. Muse Spark reads invoices, Muse Voice transcribes memos, SAM 3.1 counts deliveries. Human reviews; it exports files without sending payments.

summary: Learns from agent history to warn before repeat coding mistakes via MCP hooks.
readme_summary: Mines coding-agent history for pain points and surfaces warnings via MCP/hooks. Stack uses Muse Spark 1.3 as coding agent and curator plus fine-tuned Llama 3.2 1B checker. Also demos ViZDoom Freedoom and Habitat robot control.

summary: Agent video editor that plans, renders, reviews its cut and re-cuts automatically
readme_summary: Montivo edits talking-head and interview footage via a plan-render-review-recut loop that watches its own cut. Built on Meta Muse Spark, Muse Voice, and SAM 3.1 with Docker deployment. Includes blind scoring and hosted read-only demo cuts.

summary: Adaptive IVR agent that waits on hold and rescues you when human answers.
readme_summary: Holdmate queues calls, handles IVR audio and hold music, and alerts via iOS and watch when a human answers. Muse Spark muse-spark-1.3 does intent normalization with evals, with Spark fallback in talk loop. Built during hackathon with board, queue and audio experiments.

summary: AI agent explains oil-well declines with cited data in a minute
readme_summary: WellPilot answers why oil well production changed using production data, PDFs and spreadsheets. An agent fits declines and forecasts, with a checker enforcing citations. Stack is FastAPI backend + frontend on Meta Muse Spark Open.

summary: Chat assistant that finds eligible UK/US benefits with official rules cited for each answer.
readme_summary: Beacon matches users to UK/US support programs with rule-grounded answers and demo flows. Web app on Vercel using Muse Spark, Wonder, Image and Voice Transcribe plus SAM 3.1. Muse models power eligibility reasoning with citations.

summary: Drafts typhoon damage assessments from photos and voice
readme_summary: Ulat prototype for Binan, Philippines turns photos, video, and voice into draft damage assessments and insurance forms. Exposes Telegram bot and Modal dashboard for residents and disaster office. Uses Muse models for multimodal triage.

summary: Muse agent drives robot arm for visual injection-molding inspection
readme_summary: Muse Spark agent controls reBot Arm B601-DM to pick parts, SAM 3.1 counts levers in close-up to sort good and bad boxes. Real hardware with coded safety rules, evals and replay demo. MIT licensed solo build.

summary: Voice AI that fills term-life forms and verifies policy before signing
readme_summary: Two voice agents for term-life insurance: OmniCB fills forms by voice, Integrity Guardian reviews policy. Stack is voice-agent-py + browser app with typed allow-listed actions, second-model checks and deterministic verification. Uses Meta Muse Spark models.

summary: Turns post-disaster aerial photos into draft FEMA damage assessments
readme_summary: Landfall compares pre- and post-storm building imagery, estimates flood depth, and sorts structures into FEMA Preliminary Damage Assessment categories with evidence. Provides map UI, agent planner and county report. Built during hackathon with Python app, evals and Docker deploy.

summary: Counts pollinator flower visits from phone video for citizen science
readme_summary: Tracks insects and flowers in phone video with SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API, classifies insect tracks with Muse Spark / Muse Glimmer. Counts visits over 0.3s and exports FIT Count JSON and CSV. Python pipeline with Docker and Modal demo.

summary: Automated geological logging that turns drill core box photos into depth-aligned data
readme_summary: Automates drill-core logging from core box photos for mining teams. Stack is Python Docker app with web demo and agent pipeline. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation masks and Muse models for mineral / structure interpretation.

summary: Speaks to local clinics for patients using only approved facts on a case card
readme_summary: Medical companion for non-local speakers that handles clinic communication and prescription reading. Stack with api, web, infra and fly.toml deployment. Uses Meta AI to relay decisions without diagnosing.

summary: Personal highlight reels cut from long livestreams for each viewer
readme_summary: WatchMate watches full video with picture and sound via Muse Spark, matches moments to user preferences from text or voice. Cuts personal reels, self-checks edits, and delivers via bot and control UI.

summary: Measures AI scientist discovery loss when measuring physics via camera vs numbers
readme_summary: LLM agent designs experiments in hidden-law universe observed only via SAM 3.1 camera segmentation. Tests perception tax using SAM confidence for system ID. Evaluation science study, no RL, graded on real outcomes.

summary: Agent that trims LLM serving energy while enforcing quality with receipts
readme_summary: WattNot tries one serving change at a time and keeps it only if quality gates pass. Measures GPU joules and emits signed hash-chained receipts. Runs Muse Glimmer 30B on vLLM H100/A100 and Muse Spark.

summary: Three AI roles debate code changes with verified proofs for human approval
readme_summary: Proposer, Critic and Evidence Evaluator agents argue a change on Meta Muse models. Runtime is Rust with hash-chained events and proof verification; only a person decides. Includes contracts, crates/apps workspace, Docker and CI.

summary: Aphasia research toolkit with lesionable models and rights-free stimuli
readme_summary: Picture-naming research toolkit for aphasia studies with rights-free stimuli and automatic error scoring. Lesions Muse Glimmer and other open image models to study failure modes. Python package with web demo and damage-zoo scripts.

summary: Portable local memory that makes any AI agent follow your checklists and rules.
readme_summary: Athos stores criteria, steps and checklists in user-owned files as living agent memory. Any agent loads it without re-explanation, with export as fine-tuning dataset. Uses Muse Spark Open via OpenRouter, self-hostable with local inference.

summary: Pet monitoring assistant for glasses, phone and web that flags behavior and hazards.
readme_summary: FurSight watches pet cams to classify behavior, create memories/stickers, alert owners, and label room hazards. It runs on Quest, phone, Ray-Ban Display and web with cam, ml, ios and eval components. It uses Muse Spark as agent, SAM 3.1 for finding, and Muse Voice Transcribe via Meta Model API.

summary: Multi-agent lab that designs tests and shows evidence for claims
readme_summary: Noesis lets users ask research questions while agents allocate compute, design experiments and apply Bayesian reasoning with reproducible Python/Rust/Julia SDK. Backend plus benchmark harness with CI. Uses Meta Muse models for reading and planning.

summary: Screenshot to named CSS design tokens with verified rewrite
readme_summary: Captures a live app, segments UI with SAM 3.1, clusters values and has Muse Spark name tiered tokens then rewrites code to var() with checks and Sorb preview. Node plus Modal pipeline. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark naming.

summary: Search driving logs in English with LiDAR-verified evidence
readme_summary: Type rare scenarios to find moments in multi-camera logs, each checked against LiDAR before display. Model proposes, geometry decides with per-sweep predicates and BEV views. Python API with configs and docs.

summary: Offline-first Flutter companion that aids communication and daily independence
readme_summary: Milo is a Flutter mobile app for communication and comprehension support with offline-first accessibility features. Frontend in Flutter with Modal-hosted backend and multimodal input. Uses Meta Muse models for conversational and vision assistance.

summary: Screenshot plus goal gives one highlighted next step on your screen
readme_summary: ShowMe overlays step-by-step visual guidance from a screenshot and user goal, masking private details in-browser. Built with web app, backend API, Docker, and eval dashboard. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for vision grounding and sam-3.1 for segmentation via Meta Model API.

summary: Checks viral photos and videos against earlier online appearances to test their captions
readme_summary: Backstory uses multi-agent Muse models to compare a viral photo or video with earlier online publications and judge if its caption fits context, time and place. It ships via Docker/Render with replay and evaluation examples.

summary: Local rule-checking agent that proves answers with hash-chained receipts
readme_summary: Personal agent that checks a local rule before acting, e.g. metal-detecting legality, and emits verifiable receipts. Browser replay recomputes hashes and verifies tip signature for audit. Built with Muse models Oct 26-Nov 4 2026 for hackathon.

summary: Overseer that shows exactly where an AI agent cheated with trace evidence.
readme_summary: AI overseer for coding-agent PRs that fails checks when agents game tests and cites exact lines verified against the trace. Includes verifier, benchmarks and raw run logs. Built solo for Push the Frontier using Meta Muse Spark Open for analysis.

summary: Phone video physics lab that measures motion with error bars
readme_summary: Phone video in, measurement with error bars out. SAM 3.1 tracks pendulum motion, physics pipeline estimates period, Muse Spark agent gives blind verdict. Dockerized Python app with CI, evals and static replay site.

summary: Tests invoice agents against prompt injection with approval controls
readme_summary: AgentShield AI inspects synthetic invoices and challenges agents with attacks like prompt injection and layout shifts. Models advise only; deterministic controls and human approval govern outcomes. No real money movement, with hosted demo and benchmark report.

summary: Screens Kenyan land deed plans for fraud and survey errors in seconds
readme_summary: Photograph a Kenyan survey deed plan for automated verification audit against Survey Act Cap 299. Uses Meta Muse AI with Firebase/Vercel app, API backend, evals and 120 tests. Flags paperwork inconsistencies for review.

summary: Artificial stock exchange where Muse AI traders test rules against Nash/Pareto benchmarks
readme_summary: Simulation wind tunnel where Muse-based makers and takers quote, write code strategies, and must pass out-of-sample tests before trading. Includes Rule Lab for natural-language rule changes and browser replay dashboard. Built solo in Python for market research.

summary: Type a US address to see data centers, builds, bills and hearings with cites
readme_summary: Turns one address into a cited brief and card covering electric bill, noise, water, land and taxes. Uses four Meta models with verification and evals. Stack includes Docker, schemas, fixtures and docs with live demo at mygrid.ai.

summary: Phone videos of physics experiments become verified measurements with uncertainty
readme_summary: Turns pendulum or falling-ball videos into physics measurements with uncertainty and audit. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark for analysis and Muse Wonder for next-step proposals with Dockerized Python backend.

summary: Voice-led Singapore bar-model tutor that draws math with kids step by step
readme_summary: Live voice and whiteboard tutor for P3-P6 Singapore math from photo problems. Stack includes Modal, FastAPI, renderer and coded answer verification. Uses Meta Muse for voice teaching and step checks, not direct solving.

summary: Turns a phone repair video into a step-by-step guide with live coaching
readme_summary: Films a repair once and converts it to step-by-step guides with SAM 3.1 cut-outs and evidence for each claim, then coaches next user live via camera. Built on Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice and Wonder via Meta Model API.

summary: Eight singing AI agents write an episode and 16 bots perform it as 3D musical
readme_summary: A multi-agent system where a Muse Code director delegates to eight Muse Spark 1.3 agents that collaborate, validate, and sing reasoning. Outputs a sung 3D episode in Three.js via JSON event protocol, with lyrics by Muse Wonder and posters by Muse Image.

summary: Plans story-listening fMRI studies and forecasts brain responses before scanning
readme_summary: StillHere helps plan auditory story fMRI studies and validate stimulus designs pre-scan. It uses a Next.js app with API forecasting and public scan datasets. It uses Meta's TRIBE v2 to forecast hearing and language responses for new stories.

summary: Voice-first WhatsApp guide for rural parents and teachers in Hindi and Braj
readme_summary: Marg.ai delivers daily discovery activities for parents, curriculum-to-work links for teachers, and source-grounded answers for students via WhatsApp. Built with Python backend, Docker and Postgres/Alembic. Uses six Meta models with input/output safety checks including Muse voice and language models.

summary: Agent that turns a plain-English idea into a maintainable design-system website
readme_summary: Frontend codegen agent that converts rough ideas into multi-screen apps reusing design-system components. Enforces WCAG 2.2 AA via review agents that debate issues. Built on Muse Spark models inside Muse Code harness.

summary: AI flight operator for simulated CubeSat with deterministic mission-plan gate
readme_summary: Operates simulated 6U CubeSat HUGINN via OpenC3 COSMOS, routing all commands through BALDUR-0 gate. Architecture with signed mission plan, append-only event log and ground system. Uses Meta models for operations reasoning under strict verification.

summary: Shares verified web workflows so other agents can reuse them with zero calls
readme_summary: MCP platform where Muse Spark performs browser workflows and Muse Spark Open verifies them into signed reusable records. Install via MCP HTTP transport, local run with no keys. Meta models only.

summary: Voice-first Telugu farming agent for crop diagnosis, prices and schemes
readme_summary: Krishi Mitra lets farmers speak, type or send crop photos in Telugu, Hindi or English to get diagnosis, weather-timed action plan, mandi prices and scheme eligibility. Same vision+tool agent handles image and voice with TTS readout. Backend, frontend and evals built during hackathon.

summary: One street photo shows the next 5km of places, landmarks and signs on map
readme_summary: What's Ahead maps a street photo to the next 5km using Overture Maps. Muse Spark Open names visitor-known landmarks, SAM 3.1 finds signs in the photo and projects them onto the map. Web app with camera and map fly-through deployed on Vercel.

summary: Organizes years of lab reports into one timeline for doctor visits
readme_summary: Consolidates Polish, German and English lab reports into a single timeline for short appointments. Explicitly not medical advice, no diagnosis or interpretation. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0 with Angular frontend and API plus Docker.

summary: Records legacy app behavior and rebuilds it as verified modern web app
readme_summary: Records legacy app behavior then rebuilds as modern web app and proves field-by-field parity. TypeScript/Bun action with docs, examples, and CI/Pages. Uses Meta Muse models for migration synthesis and behavioral verification.

summary: Owner-initiated search of neighborhood cameras to find lost dogs
readme_summary: Opt-in footage search that tracks and matches missing pets across cameras. Workers platform with evals and evidence logs. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking and segmentation, Muse Spark for owner-query matching.

summary: Self-driving dye lab that matches cotton color from a phone photo iteratively
readme_summary: Shows a color, predicts dye recipe, dyes cotton strip, photographs and corrects until match. Hardware firmware plus Python app on Hugging Face Space. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Wonder, Glimmer, Spark, Image and Voice.

summary: Routes coding subtasks across Meta models by difficulty and verifies quality versus cost
readme_summary: One request is planned with clarifying questions, split into labeled subtasks, then routed to models by complexity with program-run checks and escalation. Includes web UI and eval/ experiment to measure cost-quality tradeoffs.

summary: Points phone at machines to guide fingertip to buttons with voice and sound
readme_summary: Accessibility web app that maps machine buttons with Meta models and steers fingertip via audio cues. Reads displays after presses to verify success. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Wonder.

summary: Multimodal market platform with multi-agent analysis and risk simulation
readme_summary: Transforms market complexity into structured insight via observe, understand, analyze and validate pipeline. Uses multi-agent collaboration with multimodal AI for analysis, risk management and market simulation. Web platform with Docker setup, benchmarks and live deployment.

summary: Cited apostille guide where every fact shows quote, source and date.
readme_summary: Apostille handbook with human-approved facts drafted by Meta AI and staff quotes. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for drafting and photo judging. Rust workspace with enforced Meta-only models and live site.

summary: Hands-free voice assistant that does tasks for hands-on entrepreneurs
readme_summary: Voice-first intent-based assistant for workers who can't stop to type. Next.js + Modal stack with Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Image, SAM 3.1 and SeamlessM4T. Turns spoken requests into executed actions.

summary: Sandboxed bench that tests if AI agents resist planted temptations
readme_summary: Alignment bench where agents work in isolated sandboxes while a separate monitor model watches each step. Tasks hide plants like credential requests to detect misbehavior. Python 3.14 service with Docker, Caddy and public compose deploy.

summary: Finds identifying details in video and redacts them before posting.
readme_summary: Veil scans video for faces, plates and spoken PII. Muse Spark proposes risks, SAM 3.1 tracks them, Muse Voice transcribes audio. Deterministic code re-renders fictional text and re-audits the export.

summary: Voice command loop that fixes robot faults in a simulator and proves the fix
readme_summary: BlinkFlow is a say-fix-prove loop for robotics with a digital twin simulator. It takes voice commands, applies fixes, and replays before/after runs with contact metrics. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for language and reasoning.

summary: Wheelchair routing that rates path usability with evidence and confidence
readme_summary: Analyzes walkway photos where muse-spark-1.3 classifies obstacles and SAM 3.1 measures blockage. Serves web app with human review, explicitly marking unknown areas as unknown.

summary: Voice-first app helps blind users count Ethiopian cash in Amharic and English
readme_summary: Birr is a voice-first Android app plus web demo that identifies banknotes from photos and answers cash questions. It uses ASR, SAM-based vision on Modal, and Muse Spark Open for reading notes, with deterministic code for totals and Amharic/English speech output.

summary: Checks in freight with vision, document and voice witnesses plus signed receipt
readme_summary: Verifiable dock check-in using three witnesses: SAM 3.1 pallet vision, Muse Spark document parse, Muse Voice transcribe. Deterministic Python judge decides HOLD or OK. Outputs signed receipt with evals and fixtures.

summary: Tests keyboard focus management on web pages against WCAG 2.4.3 using walkers and vision
readme_summary: NoMouse walks web pages by keyboard only, letting deterministic DOM walkers settle what they can and Muse Spark 1.3 judge screenshots for focus landing and return. Frozen deterministic verdicts are shown beside each model verdict.

summary: WhatsApp board photo plus voice note becomes verified teaching record
readme_summary: WhatsApp-first teaching diary infra that converts board photos and voice notes into signed .tdx records. Uses SAM 3.1 to crop board and Meta models for transcription with verifiable signature system.

summary: Shared control plane to keep parallel AI agents aligned and reviewable
readme_summary: Switchboard stores user decisions, limits and reviews for assistants to check. Architecture with frontend, harness, integrations and Modal sandbox playground. Supports multiple assistants to stay within bounds when plans change.

summary: Disaster logistics planner for flood-hit towns managing fuel and shelters
readme_summary: Python survival agent for Kottur flood scenario modeling fuel, hospital, pump and shelters as cascades. Includes A-star routing, allocator, counterfactual analysis and voice capture with benchmarks and artifacts.

summary: AI network repair agent that keeps changes only after deterministic tests pass.
readme_summary: NetProof is a solo-built agent that repairs network faults and rolls back unproven changes. Deterministic tests must prove fix with no breakage, with run store and replay dashboard. Built on Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Spark Open.

summary: Phone-video survey tool that finds dogs missed by vaccine drives
readme_summary: Seventy analyzes phone video via a SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark + Muse Wonder pipeline with rules in tested code. Built for rabies teams with FastAPI services, Supabase, Docker and live Vercel app. Gives operational results, no medical advice.

summary: Voice civic complaints in Hindi/Hinglish with photo and tracking ID.
readme_summary: Lets citizens report civic issues by voice in Hindi, Hinglish or English with a photo, then an agent drafts formal complaints and routes to departments. Frontend plus backend with Docker and Render deploy. Uses Meta AI / Muse for transcription, classification and routing.

summary: Verifies earnings draft numbers against SEC filings with filing receipts
readme_summary: Checks financial claims in earnings drafts against S&P 500 SEC filings, each verdict linked to filing evidence. Vercel deploy with evals and examples. Built for Meta hackathon Indie Build for Your World with real NVIDIA draft demo.

summary: Community-owned food delivery and neighborhood help network
readme_summary: Strongo replaces 30% commission platforms with community-run ordering, AI dispatcher, open books and need board. Middleware-based Next.js app with Docker Compose, docs and eval suite. Uses Meta AI models for plain-language ordering and dispatch.

summary: Turns product notes into tested, filmed and deployed web apps automatically.
readme_summary: Muse Muse uses Meta Muse models to build, test, film and deploy apps from notes plus inspiration. Includes lab that fine-tunes Muse Glimmer and publishes to Hugging Face. Next.js app with catalog, Docker and Vercel setup.

summary: Deterministic policy firewall that blocks unsafe agent writes before they execute.
readme_summary: Policy gates for Muse Glimmer 30B where every agent write is checked before running. Refused writes return fixes, approved writes execute. Demo blocks $4000 limit increase, allows $2500 with 97% CI coverage.

summary: Adaptive quizzes generated from real documents for learning and team training.
readme_summary: Generates adaptive quizzes from uploaded documents for learners and teams. Monorepo with apps and packages using pnpm workspaces. Uses Meta Muse models to create questions and personalize learning paths.

summary: Benchmarks chunking and retrieval for Indonesian legal RAG pipelines
readme_summary: LexRAGLab tests which chunking and retrieval settings feed Indonesian legal clauses to LLMs. Backend plus frontend workbench for measured experiments. Uses Muse models for answer generation and evaluation on legal documents.

summary: AI postmarket surveillance toolkit that links complaints to FDA evidence
readme_summary: Open-source postmarket surveillance toolkit for FDA-cleared AI/ML devices. Finds matching FDA evidence, prepares PMS evidence packs, and keeps facts traceable for audit. Python API with Streamlit UI, built for quality/regulatory review.

summary: Vision-verified inventory agent that blocks ERP posts until camera count matches
readme_summary: Verification gate agent for ERP inventory: no quantity is written without camera evidence. Python API with demo, evaluation and experiments. Uses Meta vision counting with Muse reasoning to validate counts before posting.

summary: Onboards network devices to monitoring by reading manuals and live-testing
readme_summary: Agent that reads device MIB files to select metrics for CPU, memory, disk and sensors. Verifies each pick with live SNMP tests on the device via Docker stack. Uses Muse Spark to parse MIBs and map health metrics to monitored objects.

summary: Grounded multimodal guide to Chile national parks, pilot Puyehue
readme_summary: Bosque Vivo Chile explores national parks with grounded multimodal answers. Muse Spark 1.3 reasons, Muse Voice Transcribe handles voice, and SAM 3.1 segments images. Monorepo with web app, Docker Compose, and GCP deploy for Puyehue pilot.

summary: Neighborhood app organizing same small weekly meetup groups a few blocks away
readme_summary: Flutter app for Android, iOS and web with Firebase backend in Sao Paulo. You say voy and it organizes recurring 2-6 person groups. Uses 5 Meta models for matching and organization with CI and evals.

summary: Zero-training visual inspection that finds parts and judges defects in plain English
readme_summary: ZeroShot QC does zero-training inspection: SAM 3.1 localizes parts and defects, Muse Spark judges against plain-English rules and reference. Reports 0.918 F1 on MVTec AD. Stack includes Docker backend, frontend, CLI and evaluation docs.

summary: Isolates an instrument from audio or video and teaches it on keyboard.
readme_summary: Web app plus engine lets users type or draw over video to select a sound, isolate stems, transcribe notes and practice with coaching. Built with Muse Spark Open for separation, vision grounding and performance scoring.

summary: Long-running Mac agent that plans, acts, and improves every round
readme_summary: Goal-driven coworker that operates a real macOS computer over days via Docker Compose and Node.js. Implements plan-act-reflect loops with self-improvement. Built on Meta Muse for planning and computer-use actions.

summary: Agentic chest X-ray workflow drafting reports for clinician review and sign-off
readme_summary: Agentic radiology workflow for clinics without on-site radiologists, from intake to signed report. Meta Muse Wonder coordinates Glimmer agents, SAM 3.1 preps scans, with clinician review required. Runs on clinic GPU with auditable trace.

summary: AI invoice payer that only executes human-approved payment limits via Yebo
readme_summary: Reads invoices and plans payments, then Yebo enforces human-approved limits so prompt tricks cannot divert funds. Node.js + Railway demo with dry-run replays. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for vision extraction and tool-call planning.

summary: Turns videos and docs into live on-screen step guidance in real apps
readme_summary: Compiles YouTube tutorials and articles into checkable steps, overlays next control and detects completion. Windows-only, tested on VS Code, SOLIDWORKS, Blender. Uses Meta models only when plain code cannot ground UI.

summary: Bangla voice and vision copilot that turns Messenger chats into courier-ready orders
readme_summary: PocketDokani is a phone web app for Bangladeshi Messenger sellers that converts chat screenshots into source-linked order drafts, parcel checks and courier bookings. Built with Dockerized Python backend, Alembic and web frontend. Uses Muse models for Bangla Q&A, vision parsing and price/COD extraction with seller approval.

summary: Safety screen that filters code-mixed prompt injections in agent tool outputs.
readme_summary: MixShield is a security gateway that screens agent tool outputs for Hindi-English code-mixed injections. It combines Llama Prompt Guard 2 locally with Muse Spark Open as classifier and agent. Includes AgentDojo experiments, benchmarks and Hugging Face demo.

summary: Shows which Python dependency CVEs are truly reachable with proof paths
readme_summary: vexproof triages Python vulnerabilities by verifying AI-proposed call paths with a deterministic verifier and emitting OpenVEX. It distinguishes reachable vs unreachable findings to cut noise. Uses Muse Spark Open via Meta API, Python 3.12, Docker and CI evals.

summary: Paper-trading options agent that prices dealer exposure and manages short premium positions.
readme_summary: MarketWingMan is an autonomous premium-selling options agent with a research desk. Python Dockerized system reads option chains, computes dealer exposure, sizes positions against a ledger, and journals paper trades. Uses Muse models for research and explanations with offline deterministic pricing.

summary: Wi-Fi camera fall detector that checks in by voice and alerts family on WhatsApp
readme_summary: Remy watches a room with a cheap Wi-Fi camera, confirms falls, asks Are you okay via speaker and reports replies on WhatsApp. Python pipeline with local pose model plus deterministic rules gating Meta calls. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe for notes and replies.

summary: Captures expert know-how before exit and answers successors in Teams
readme_summary: Clone Flow captures retiring expert knowledge via guided conversation and serves it in Microsoft Teams. Stack spans Python backend, frontend, desktop, Docker and Render. Uses SAM 3.1 for visual tracking of tasks like robot-arm calibration and Muse models for Q&A with proof.

summary: Learns 3D movement from one phone video then scores followers joint by joint
readme_summary: Simon converts a single phone video into a reusable 3D movement reference then compares imitators. Modular pipeline with hub, bench, and fixtures. Chains eleven Meta models for pose, 3D, and language feedback with no suits or config.

summary: Plain-language camera rules that prove themselves and double-check alerts
readme_summary: Rulecam lets users describe camera worries in their own language, validates if cameras can check them, and proves rules before live. Python 3.12 stack with phone/CCTV support. Uses Meta models including Muse Glimmer for second-look alert verification.

summary: Turns small open models into private tool experts via verified answers.
readme_summary: Fine-tuning factory that trains small models only on referee-verified answers. Proven on CAD: Muse Glimmer 30B scored 83-92% on 30-part exam. Built with Muse Spark Open, live at expertery.com.

summary: Photo-to-physics twin that simulates and verifies home robot plans before acting
readme_summary: One photo becomes a physics twin and one sentence becomes checkable goals; plans are simulated in MuJoCo before execution. Python stack with eval and bench harnesses. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for segmentation and SAM 3D for rebuild.

summary: Personal tutor that teaches adults from their own slides and notes.
readme_summary: Study companion for 18+ with source-linked explanations, practice and learner-controlled memory. Coordinates agent roles with cloud/local Meta AI routing and checks. Rust/Python stack with architecture docs.

summary: Scores animal behavior from plain English with no training on video
readme_summary: Defines behaviors in plain English and scores video with no training using SAM 3.1, Muse Spark and Muse Spark Open. Evaluated once on CalMS21 official test set at 0.58 F1, 0.88x real-time, $11.25 per hour. Make demo runs with no keys.

summary: Loop-based platform for autonomous app generation and model verification runs.
readme_summary: Loopwright runs recorded autonomous development loops for extraction, generation and checks. Pipeline runs on Meta Model API with muse-spark-1.3, muse-wonder-1.0 and muse-image-1.0. Each loop record states model and endpoint for verification.

summary: Farm walk photos become plain-text field records kept at home
readme_summary: Flet phone app captures field photos and voice during walks; local home system processes them and writes plain-text records. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark 1.3 for agronomy reading, and Muse Voice Transcribe. Records exposed via CLI and MCP server.

summary: Auditable credit monitor that links debt alerts to exact SEC filing quotes
readme_summary: Watches USD investment-grade issuers, recomputes maturity walls in code and attaches verbatim quotes. Backend plus Firebase web app with CI. Uses Muse Spark for extraction, Spark Open and Wonder for independent verification.

summary: Phone stitch inspector that scores garment seams and audits quality
readme_summary: Phone app photographs seams; SAM 3.1 finds seam, fine-tuned classifier scores it, Muse Spark explains verdict with Telugu voice support. Dashboard tracks defects, AQL audits and buyer reports from logged data.

summary: Turns phone walkthrough video into staged broker-approved real estate listing
readme_summary: Stages filmed rooms preserving geometry, writes copy from what camera saw, enables broker approval and first-person walkthrough. Built with Muse Spark, Wonder, Image and SAM 3.1.

summary: Turns product photos into WhatsApp storefronts that learn from sales chats
readme_summary: Closed-loop storefront for Colombian WhatsApp sellers. Photo-to-ad showcase at /foto with Dockerized Python backend, Alembic migrations. Uses Muse models to generate ads and improve listings from conversations.

summary: AI renovation studio with 3D mockups, visualizations and cost estimates
readme_summary: Open-source studio combining AI visualization, interactive 3D mockups and project workspaces. Monorepo with Dockerized web app. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Image for renovation renders.

summary: Ask your company database in plain speech and get exact answers with trace
readme_summary: AYDA lets business users ask questions in English, French, or Darija typed or spoken. It finds relevant tables, writes one read-only SQL query, and answers with trace. Built with Meta models, live on Odoo 18 with Docker.

summary: 3D digital twin planner for telecom sites with EMF safety analysis
readme_summary: SiteTwin 3D loads site files to map coverage, capacity, rooftop and EMF safety zones. Includes Python backend, Modal app, and 3D web viewer with sample sites. Uses Muse Spark Open Expert Operator by text or voice to diagnose and simulate fixes.

summary: Jarvis assistant in terminal, Chrome and desktop that acts with approval.
readme_summary: Opens Jarvis in any folder to read files, git and system state and propose commands for approval. Chrome extension lets it click and fill tabs; desktop agent acts on apps. Python package using only Meta models via Model API.

summary: Voice-first reminder app that organizes tasks and nudges until done
readme_summary: Turns messy voice/text dumps into reminders with follow-ups using Muse Spark. Voice via Muse Voice Transcribe, photo proof via SAM 3.1, badges via Muse Image/Wonder. Node + Vite frontend with Baseten/Modal backend.

summary: Async multi-agent team that plans and produces startup social content.
readme_summary: Harmonia routes plain-language requests through a chat router to specialized agents for strategy, briefs and reviewed artifacts. Web dashboard plus Telegram Bot API with nonce-bound approvals and Firestore context. Uses Meta Muse models for orchestration with deterministic verification.

summary: Film a room and ask in words if furniture fits with verified 3D checks
readme_summary: Rebuilds rooms in 3D, segments objects with SAM 3.1 and answers via Muse agent calling geometry tools. Docker Python stack with Modal demo and eval harness. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse for tool-grounded answers.

summary: Printable kids practice sheets graded by AI from handwriting photos
readme_summary: Practice Sheets generates daily Grade 1-6 worksheets for paper printing and grades photo uploads. Next.js app with Supabase backend and Render deployment. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 vision to read handwriting and mark against answer keys.

summary: Auditable agent workflows with human approval and ledger proof
readme_summary: Research prototype for verifiable synthetic financial agent workflows combining Muse planning and semantic review. Enforces deterministic policy, hash-bound approval, idempotent execution and ledger verification. Python backend with frontend and Docker compose.

summary: Mac screen buddy that points, guides tutorials, and turns bug videos to fixes
readme_summary: Cursor assistant that sees screen to explain or act, Shadow guides live from tutorials, Repro reproduces bugs from video. Python Mac app using Muse Spark 1.3/1.2 for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for screen vision.

summary: Finds peak foreign account balances with source-page links
readme_summary: Tool for CPAs reviewing foreign bank statements to find each account's highest balance with one-click source verification. Python pipeline with arithmetic checks and evidence linking. Uses Meta Muse to read pages in ~10s for ~2 cents.

summary: Fleet of 13 agents carries routine work across a hospital patient journey
readme_summary: Throughline connects referral to follow-up with agents handling routine handoffs between departments. Humans are looped in for decisions on a shared contract for new agents. Built as a Vercel-deployed monorepo with live app and demo video.

summary: Interpretability atlas labeling and steering features across Glimmer 30B layers.
readme_summary: Glimmer Scope trains sparse autoencoders on nine layers of Muse Glimmer 30B. Every firing feature is labeled, steering-tested 170k+ times, and tracked cross-layer in an atlas. Repo includes SAEs, paper, Hugging Face demo and Modal deployment.

summary: Edge beehive monitor that detects anomalies with video prediction and segmentation
readme_summary: Hive entrance monitoring on Raspberry Pi 4 using Java 25 and GraalVM Native Image. Combines V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-B/16 surprise detection, SAM 3.1 segmentation, Muse Spark Open reasoning and Muse Voice Transcribe with web console and HF dataset.

summary: Phone video scan that flags earthquake topple risks room by room
readme_summary: Turns a one-minute phone video into tipping and egress-blocking risks with frame boxes and FEMA E-74 steps. Uses SAM vision plus Muse Spark reasoning, deployed as web app on Modal.

summary: Compiles one task video into a verifiable program for humans and robots
readme_summary: Learns steps, order, parameters and visual contracts from one video, then tracks execution live, guides next steps and flags errors. Runs for real-world tasks, robot arm and screen agents. Uses video understanding plus vision checking.

summary: Street-level flood risk forecasts for Africa up to 14 days ahead
readme_summary: Agent answers will it flood here with green-amber-red level and actions. Uses 51 rain forecasts plus ground wetness data. Built with Muse Spark Open and Muse Voice Transcribe in English, French, Swahili.

summary: Android app that detects scam calls from live speech to block fraudulent money transfers
readme_summary: Android scam-call guardian for Malaysian families that analyzes what the caller says, not caller ID. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for live transcription and Muse Spark for scam reasoning to warn before money moves. Native app with CI and APK builds.

summary: Generates coding tasks then voice-interviews candidates about their code
readme_summary: Recruiter pastes job offer, generates practical task with sandbox-tested tests in TS/Python. Candidate builds with any AI tool, then voice AI interviewer defends code. Built with Meta models, separates verified facts from interpretation.

summary: Checks second-hand listing claims against photos for buyers
readme_summary: Seller claims plus photos go through blind Muse Spark observation and SAM 3.1 boxes, fixed rules produce supported/contradicted verdicts. Live site with app, browser extension and evals for furniture listings.

summary: Turns family photo libraries into searchable graph and auto-cut films
readme_summary: Ingests 20k photos into reasoned life graph for search and Q&A, then crew of Muse agents writes, cuts and re-cuts personal film. Python app with graph DB, Modal deploy and Windows packaging.

summary: Simulates a 3D desert farm where an AI scientist trials crops and irrigation.
readme_summary: Green Frontier lets users pick crops while the AI plants trial plots, learns behavior, trains irrigation policy, and diagnoses faults on record. Web 3D app with backend simulation. Built for Push the Frontier on Meta AI models.

summary: Agent that turns a sentence into board, case, firmware and order
readme_summary: Hardware R&D agent generates PCB, printed enclosure and tested firmware from text. FastAPI backend with SvelteKit frontend and replay viewer. Uses Meta Muse Spark, Wonder and SAM 3.1 models.

summary: Agent that verifies construction photos against design package with evidence
readme_summary: Takes drone stills, nameplates and walkthroughs and checks them against quantities and drawings. Muse Wonder agent produces findings with evidence drafts. Next.js + Python app deployed on Vercel with recorded and live demo runs.

summary: Investigates plant faults by fusing sensor trends, photos and procedures
readme_summary: FAULTGLASS is an industrial investigation agent for operators that detects drift, tests explanations, requests field evidence and verifies recovery. Full-stack backend/frontend with plant datasets. Uses Meta models for reasoning over telemetry and images.

summary: Turns text prompts into physics-simulated robots with parts and firmware
readme_summary: RoboCraft converts prompts into physics-simulated machines with datasheet ratings, parts lists and wiring. Stack includes Next.js frontend, Python backend and C++ WebAssembly engine. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and SAM 3.1.

summary: One phone video becomes a priced catalog with studio photos
readme_summary: FastAPI backend + frontend takes a seller video, segments products with SAM 3.1 and generates studio photos with Muse Image 1.0. Human review before publishing with prices and stock. Built end-to-end on Meta Model API.

summary: AI operator that plans and verifies solar-battery dispatch from plain-language goals
readme_summary: Natural-language operator for solar+battery sites that plans daily dispatch and validates before execution. Python service with Docker, tests and Hugging Face demo. Built on Muse Spark Open with replay on same-day weather data.

summary: Describes a sound and auto-builds the DAW chain, then listens and refines it
readme_summary: AI music production agent for REAPER and Ableton Live. Plans signal chains from text, pedal photos or reference tracks, sets plugin parameters via remote control, renders audio and iteratively listens. Uses Muse models with multi-track subagents in Go backend.

summary: Camera test bench where decision models pick one object and SAM highlights it
readme_summary: Point a camera or upload a photo with a goal, get one object choice with probabilities or abstention. Decision model runs in ~0.15s GPU, end-to-end 1-1.5s, then SAM 3.1 segments the choice. Python server with domains and eval harness to test open-weight models and train your own.

summary: Hourly agent that investigates Korean air pollution events with cited evidence
readme_summary: Monitors ~670 AirKorea stations and NASA FIRMS fires hourly, clusters PM events and investigates causes. Serves evidence-backed Q&A with sources. Built with Muse Spark Open, SAM 3.1 for smoke masks, Modal + web frontend.

summary: Turns network requests into validated configs with dry-run and approval
readme_summary: Python AI agent converting natural language changes to multi-vendor configs with safety gate, lab dry-run, and human approval. Ships Ansible playbooks, proven rollback, and tamper-evident journal via Muse Spark.

summary: Simulates ML training and agent jobs to forecast cost and behavior before spending GPU
readme_summary: Preflight profiles a few minutes of a real ML job and simulates full runs or campaigns. Stack is Python API plus web frontend with GPU probes and docs site. Uses Meta models to model job behavior and estimate cost.

summary: Talk to build a pixel platformer live with AI-verified hot-loaded code
readme_summary: Talk-to-Build turns spoken prompts into running game code, art and tests. Agents generate changes, verify them in headless playtests, then hot-load into a live pixel-art platformer. Uses Meta Muse models for code and art generation.

summary: Voice-driven story app turning kids questions into illustrated adventures
readme_summary: Little Adventures turns a child's spoken question into narrated illustrated chapters starring their own character. A parent sets up via app while the child chooses what happens next. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 for character look, and Muse Spark for story and images.

summary: Talk-run online store with approval-based AI back office
readme_summary: A-Commerce is a conversational storefront and back office where owners approve agent work. Rust monorepo with crates, agents and Makefile, live demo Ailism Commerce. Runs on Meta Muse Glimmer 30B open weights on one GPU.

summary: Turns any repo, article or topic into narrated whiteboard explainer videos.
readme_summary: Parses GitHub repos, articles or topics into scripted whiteboard videos with narration. Web app with docs, gallery and rendering pipeline. Uses Meta Muse models for script and storyboard generation.

summary: AI filesystem with zero bytes on disk, text search over footage and access help.
readme_summary: Rust Axum API with React TypeScript Tauri desktop presenting virtual filesystem. Streams media on demand with AI indexing and search. Uses Meta AI models for footage search, iGuide and iRead accessibility.

summary: Phone video scan tells if your Ontario basement can become a legal apartment
readme_summary: Films a basement to check legal second-suite feasibility anywhere in Ontario, then guides layout, visualization, permit set and financing. Built with SAM 3.1, Muse Spark/Wonder/Image/Voice and MapAnything on Node/pnpm with live site.

summary: Muse proposes plant changes, physics simulators verify, engineer approves
readme_summary: PlantAgent is an engineering workspace where Muse reads drawings and proposes changes re-solved by DWSIM, pandapower and others. Failed checks loop back with numbers for human approval. Muse Spark Open runs loop on Baseten and Fireworks.

summary: Smart-contract scanner that finds Solidity flaws and visualizes attack flows.
readme_summary: SentryVision analyzes Solidity contracts to identify vulnerabilities and explain exploits. It combines Slither/Solc static analysis with Python backend and web UI. Built for Meta hackathon as standalone security verifier.

summary: CV evidence reviewer that checks who actually did quoted work
readme_summary: CV evidence reviewer that traces quotes to proof and flags unsupported claims. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 with saved replays, judge video and calibration, deployed as Python app on Render.

summary: Hands-free lab assistant using smart glasses, voice and a robot to log runs
readme_summary: iOS client plus server that connects Meta AI glasses vision, voice transcription and lab logging. Glass view verifies bench steps while voice drives the record and robot replay. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Voice Transcribe 1.0 for perception and dialogue.

summary: Turns STEM figures into talking tactile sheets for blind students by touch.
readme_summary: Creates raised tactile graphics from STEM figures where a phone camera identifies touched parts and speaks names. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, muse-spark-1.3 for grounded Q&A, and Muse Voice for speech interaction.

summary: Turns phone video of a person into a Unitree G1 humanoid skill
readme_summary: Pipeline converts phone video to 3D motion via SAM 3.1 and SAM 3D Body, retargets to G1 skeleton, labels phases with Muse Spark. Trains PPO policy in mjlab with V-JEPA 2 input and judging. Web demo visualizes stages in 3D.

summary: Used-car inspection agent linking every finding to photos, video and OBD evidence
readme_summary: Hanbridge Inspector ingests walk-around photos, paint-gauge video, voice notes and OBD reports for Korean used cars. A Muse Wonder/Spark agent with SAM 3.1 and Glimmer streams tool calls and produces BUY/NEGOTIATE/WALK AWAY report. Built as Next.js app with live demo.

summary: Desktop agent audits site usability and opens verified fix pull requests
readme_summary: Fitts walks websites and Android apps like a user to find Nielsen heuristic, accessibility and performance issues. It fixes code on isolated branches, verifies fixes, and opens pull requests via chat or voice. Uses Meta models for reasoning and code repair in a desktop agent architecture.

summary: Drone search assistant that plans where to fly next and spots missing persons
readme_summary: LastSeen plans drone search areas from witness input and detects missing persons in photos. Stack is Python app with planning tools, tests and eval docs. Uses Muse Spark for planning, SAM 3.1 for visual search, Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Red-teams walking robots in sim from text, voice or photos then retrains
readme_summary: Turns plain-English, voice or photo scenarios into MuJoCo physics attacks via Muse and SAM 3.1, tests quadrupeds/humanoids, retrains fallen policies with PPO. Includes autopilot hunt and regression gauntlet.

summary: Voice-first Mac control that clarifies and confirms before acting
readme_summary: Mac app for hands-free computer use: speak outcomes, resolve ambiguity by voice, preview irreversible sends. Uses Meta models for intent and voice plus on-device overlay, remote phone client and eval harness.

summary: Turns long talking-head videos into captioned vertical Shorts
readme_summary: AI Spatial Director cuts long single-speaker videos into up to 3 vertical 1080x1920 Shorts with hooks and captions. Python pipeline adds framing and visual context. Uses Meta AI to select moments and verifies output with PASS/FAIL receipts.

summary: Tracks elephants near villages to predict arrival and send SMS alerts in 3 languages
readme_summary: Early-warning system for human-elephant conflict that tracks herds and predicts village ETA. Pipeline uses SAM 3.1 for per-frame tracking and Muse Spark 1.3 vision for behavior reading. Sends Sinhala, Tamil and English SMS alerts.

summary: Watches procedure video in 3s windows to tick steps and flag errors
readme_summary: Learns a procedure from written steps plus one expert video, then watches novice video to track progress and detect skipped/wrong-order steps. Evaluated on CaptainCook4D recipes against timed error annotations. Python backend with offline checks and self-hosted test harness.

summary: Offline disaster mapper that shows which rescue vehicles can reach buildings.
readme_summary: FirstLight maps building damage and vehicle-specific physical access for fire, ambulance and ATV. Built on Hurricane Michael data for Mexico Beach, it runs offline without API keys. Stack includes Python routing engine with geometric clearance analysis and benchmarks.

summary: Turns Meta glasses recordings into step-by-step phone guides
readme_summary: Captures expert work via Meta glasses narration into steps with looping clips and checks. Python + iOS pipeline; uses Muse Spark to segment video and generate instructions.

summary: Append-only record layer that proves what AI agents believed and did.
readme_summary: Curator is a life content manager with a K-record accountability layer for agent calls. It uses a wrapper plus append-only record store with a Muse Spark 1.3 call path, deployed via Docker and Firebase hosting. Offline tests run with npm test; prove path does one real recorded call.

summary: Reviews landscape drawing sets against bills, prices and code with sourced counts
readme_summary: Estimator-style reviewer for landscape packages that counts, measures and cross-checks drawings, bill arithmetic and code. Python backend with web frontend and samples, using Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning and SAM 3.1 measurement with traceable citations.

summary: Daily assistant that surfaces two next steps from personal goals with verified numbers
readme_summary: Personal loop that pulls signals from user commitments five times daily, proposes two actions with reasons, and checks numbers with plain code. Includes evals and voice correction. Uses Meta Muse models for step selection and reasoning over user records.

summary: Checks meeting transcripts for ambiguous decisions and resolves splits with members
readme_summary: Parses pasted or transcribed meetings to find decisions open to multiple readings. Asks participants private clarifying questions and compares answers in code, then settles differences. Uses Muse Spark for ambiguity detection and question generation.

summary: Live video repair call that outlines parts, prices jobs, and books visits
readme_summary: Homeowner points phone at fault while agent grounds parts, asks pricing question, quotes from owner price list, and requests approval-gated booking. Agent loop with tools, SAM grounding and voice relay; uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Phone-video agent measures fish lengths for Sri Lanka port sampling with audit trail
readme_summary: Verifiable agent for NARA port sampling films fish on a board for 20 seconds. Measures fork and total length with Muse Spark 1.3 and SAM 3.1, cross-checks against species relationships, defers uncertain fish to an officer. Python with audit trail.

summary: Measures speed and timing from road video to check claims with honest ranges.
readme_summary: Sakshi reads ordinary traffic video with SAM 3.1 and Muse for tracking, then deterministic physics computes speed and timing. Checks statements against measurements for expert review without assigning fault. Dockerized Python API with replay UI.

summary: Photos supplier delivery notes, double-checks totals and flags overcharges
readme_summary: Separates delivery notes from one photo, reads money numbers twice in code. Agent zooms to re-read, checks price history and cites evidence. Built with Next.js, voice Q&A and swappable Meta open-weight model.

summary: Autonomous on-call engineer that finds root causes and verifies recovery
readme_summary: Detects production incidents, finds evidence-backed root causes, takes safe actions and verifies recovery. Includes demo app, chaos faults, benchmarks and platform API. Uses live Meta models for diagnosis and Muse Code for fixes.

summary: Pairs two calendar agents via tap to negotiate and book a shared meeting time.
readme_summary: Ketchup uses two pocket Dots where each user's agent reads only their calendar. Agents pair on tap, negotiate a common slot and pencil it in, demoed via Modal simulator. Built on Meta open-weight models for agentic scheduling with calendar tools.

summary: Films home repairs to build costed lists and match handymen with bill tracking
readme_summary: VergeCare turns filmed home issues into costed snag and wish lists with handyman matching and bill tracking till paid. Built with Next.js, Drizzle and Docker. Uses Meta AI multimodal models for property management.

summary: Place real catalog furniture into your room photo without changing other pixels.
readme_summary: Stages real catalog furniture into user room photos while preserving background pixels. Stack spans web frontend, backend service, catalog pipeline and Modal deployment. Uses Meta vision/generative models for placement, masking and photorealistic compositing.

summary: AI agents audit flood-control contracts against satellite imagery on the ground
readme_summary: Atlas cross-checks government public-works payments against Earth observation with auditable agent runs. Built with Dockerized Python services, it audits Bulacan flood-control contracts with tested decision core and live demo for contract audit.

summary: Turns how-to videos into live camera guides that verify each step
readme_summary: Converts video or manuals into step-by-step voice guidance that checks work via camera. Muse Spark writes steps and judges geometry, SAM 3.1 measures objects. Docker stack with eval harness and CF-Bench paper.

summary: Job-story writer where every sentence cites your reviewed transcript.
readme_summary: ApplyArc Evidence converts spoken job stories into defensible application writing with code-checked citations to reviewed transcripts. Uses Meta Muse Wonder and Spark Open for cross-document correction. Standalone hackathon build with Docker client and fixtures.

summary: Auditable beehive inspections from sticky-board and comb photos.
readme_summary: HiveLens turns apiary photos into counts, comb composition, marked-up images and saved reports. SAM 3.1 supplies segmentation, Muse Spark interprets tiles and reasons over measurements. Deterministic code verifies claims before findings.

summary: Disaster agent turning voice notes and posts into deduplicated rescue tasks
readme_summary: Earthquake-response agent that transcribes voice notes with Muse Voice Transcribe biased to district place-names. Muse Spark reads Turkish/Arabic messages to extract and deduplicate rescue tasks for coordinators. Dockerized Python service with tests.

summary: Minimal phone interface that stretches battery for calls and texts
readme_summary: Prototype phone OS that pauses background work to keep calls and messages alive until a chosen time. Python web simulator with battery rules, optional Muse Glimmer 30B helper.
