summary: Turns a 10s phone video into a verified MuJoCo physics digital twin
readme_summary: TwinProof converts phone video with fiducial marker into a MuJoCo twin via SAM 3.1 perception and Muse Spark agents. Includes identifier, verifier, and self-test catching seeded bugs. Stack spans computer vision, physics simulation, and agent reasoning.

summary: Consent-gated AI ads where only the licensed creator can appear in renders.
readme_summary: Assent licenses creator likeness to one brand with agent-planned images checked against licence terms. Next.js on Cloud Run with Firestore, Storage, KMS. Uses Muse Spark for planning, Muse Image for generation, SAM 3.1 for consent gate.

summary: Camera-first repair copilot that identifies parts and verifies each fix step.
readme_summary: Next.js app where users photograph a fixture to get model ID, overlaid next steps and safety checks. Uses Muse Spark Open via Baseten for visual identification on /lab, Modal backend, narrated Playwright demo.

summary: Human-reviewed order intake that flags overlaps before updating seller orders
readme_summary: Prototype for sewing-materials sellers that keeps source beside AI proposal and flags repeat vs addition vs replacement overlaps. Requires separate confirmations to save review and apply changes. Python app with demo and verification docs.

summary: Converts narrated phone walkthrough videos into structured work plans
readme_summary: SightWork generates work plans from walkthrough video. Built with Next.js, Playwright and CI. Every model used is a Meta model, processing narrated walkthroughs into viewable plans with example sanctuary project.

summary: Hausa voice-first WhatsApp agent answering Sokoto budget questions with sources
readme_summary: Kasafi answers Sokoto State budget and policy questions by Hausa voice note or text on WhatsApp. Checks answers against source pages. FastAPI backend with Docker, Alembic DB and live smoke tests.

summary: Surveys street assets from public street photos into evidence-linked review lists
readme_summary: Automates first-pass street surveys from Mapillary photos to produce a Record Update List for human review. Stack includes Docker deploy, pipeline/server with eval; Ballard pilot reports 10.3 min and $5.63 Meta API cost. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation with Muse Spark and Muse Glimmer for records.

summary: Turns one sentence into a checked Hex Cluster planter build in live configurator
readme_summary: Hex-agent converts briefs like strawberry tower for balcony into valid Hex Cluster builds. Muse models plan the configuration and drive the existing web configurator with constraint checking. Includes paper, share links and 5/5 demo suite evaluation.

summary: Counts unique source videos behind news clips to expose reused footage.
readme_summary: IndexReel fetches clips or X posts, fingerprints frames to link re-uploads, crops and compilations, and shows side-by-side evidence. Stack is Python with evals, scripts and a static site plus X bot @askIndexReel for replies.

summary: Turns one demo video into checked picture step cards with live camera coaching
readme_summary: Films a task once to generate picture step cards with done-checks, then guides learners via camera. Built for Ray-Ban Meta glasses and Display with web app, using first-person video and vision checks for step verification.

summary: Public tracker of AI insurance denials with open appeal drafting tools
readme_summary: Documents AI-driven claim denials and defines the LITMUS standard for medical AI evaluation. Provides open-weight appeal letter drafting measured in public. Built as docs site with datasets, demo replay, and Meta AI for drafting.

summary: Durable task queue and versioned store for agent swarms with maker-checker
readme_summary: Pull-based durable task queue and atomic Task Object store for agents over HTTP/MCP. Implements leased tasks with fencing tokens, versioned content-addressed storage, and maker-checker separation for auditability.

summary: Turns verified syllabus outcomes into checked printable lessons for teachers
readme_summary: AI Workbook Studio for Uganda and Zambia teachers generating editable workbooks and answer keys. Uses Muse to draft items and review wording, with deterministic code checks for math and content rules plus teacher review.

summary: Watches Kilauea webcams to measure plumes, alert fountaining and write bulletins
readme_summary: Volcano Vigil segments plume and lava fountains in public webcam frames with SAM 3.1 and measures height and drift via camera geometry. A Muse Spark agent triages inspections and writes grounded bulletins. Live dashboard, Telegram alerts and replay mode included.

summary: AI tutor that turns kids interests into lessons and updates parents
readme_summary: myKx provides Kix sidekicks that tutor children in worlds they love and report progress to parents. Built with Next.js app/components stack during the hackathon. Uses Meta Muse models for tutoring, personalization, and parent summaries.

summary: Gate that trials agent lessons before admitting them to shared memory
readme_summary: Pyx requires every candidate agent lesson to pass hidden-rubric grading by two judges, causal replay, poison screening, and human approval. Survivors enter an evidence-linked lesson bank served over MCP. Built solo on Meta models only with Docker API and eval harness.

summary: Stress-tests traffic-camera rules by replaying law against real car tracks
readme_summary: Compiles statutes/rules into thresholds and replays them on drone trajectories and video. Backend + frontend studio with ticket court and traffic lab. Uses Muse Spark to compile rules and SAM 3.1 to track vehicles for ticket analysis.

summary: Muse Code plugin and CLI that finds and verifies app vulnerabilities
readme_summary: Continuous security tester for Muse Code and standalone CLI on macOS/Linux/Windows. Investigates source and live apps, enforces scope, records evidence, and converts proofs to repeatable tests. Uses active Muse session or Meta Model API with Muse Spark Open / Glimmer.

summary: Agent for plant walkdowns that reviews facility footage for safety and defects
readme_summary: Analyzes refinery and plant walkthrough footage to flag anomalies and summarize condition. Frontend on Vercel with Python backend, Modal apps and benchmark suite. Uses Meta Muse vision models for inspection reasoning.

summary: Shopping agent that finds real clothing items with verified price and stock
readme_summary: FullAura is a web app where users describe clothing needs and an agent searches Tom Tailor, Tchibo and Giesswein. Code verifies price and stock on shop pages; agent judges warmth and style. Built with Muse Spark and Muse Image, Dockerized backend + frontend.

summary: Agentic laser M2 measurement to ISO 11146 that rejects bad data honestly
readme_summary: Agent drives simulated camera and stage, judges exposure quality, fits caustics until ISO 11146 coverage is met. Python stack with tests and scripts. Uses Muse Spark for agency and SAM 3.1 for vision checks.

summary: Agents that learn unwritten business rules from records to plan safer
readme_summary: Extracts verified experience from business records with code checks and human approval before planning. Streamlit app with configs and benchmarks. Uses Meta Muse for agents with 24 pre-registered verification experiments.

summary: Turns biomedical questions into cited hypotheses and human-gated plans
readme_summary: Multi-agent system that turns research questions into falsifiable hypotheses and reviewable plans. Every claim must cite and quote sources with human approval gates. Built with Muse models and Streamlit app deployed to Hugging Face Spaces.

summary: Voice-first bookkeeping in English and Pidgin for Nigerian market traders.
readme_summary: Voice assistant records sales, payments and debts only after spoken confirmation. Per-shop hash-chained ledger prevents silent edits. Uses speech-to-text for money talk like 15k with Node backend and mobile client.

summary: Local PII scrubber that extracts structured data from medical reports via MCP
readme_summary: MCP server that de-identifies medical reports locally then extracts structured data without patient data leaving device. Includes deid/extract modules, evals and demos for high-volume clinical report processing.

summary: Live AI news studio with real-time anchor, fact-check and matting
readme_summary: Live interview studio where AI anchor talks to guests, Meta models transcribe, fact-check and cut out background. Built on Meta API keys with Python stack, lipsync module and broadcast-ready segment pipeline.

summary: iOS keyboard that rewrites messages and emails in your personal writing style
readme_summary: SaySo learns a user's messaging and formal voice per contact using personal LoRA training. It runs in an iOS keyboard with rewrite key, Back Tap screenshot replies, and in-app chat. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer for on-device inference and a server pipeline for training.

summary: Turns a GitHub issue into a tested pull request verified in an isolated sandbox
readme_summary: ThePolisher is a TypeScript + React 19 app on Cloudflare Pages that takes a GitHub issue, generates a fix, and validates it with pytest in a Modal sandbox. It uses Muse Spark to write/polish code and Muse Wonder as an adversarial reviewer to break it.

summary: Turns properties into 3D eco-district twins with physics-based insights
readme_summary: Verdara builds an interactive 3D eco-district from site vision, computes metrics with deterministic engineering equations, and explains results via agents. TypeScript full-stack with Docker. Uses SAM 3.1 for vision and Muse Spark for explanation.

summary: Mobile app comparing notice photos to official sources with evidence
readme_summary: Next.js mobile-first web app with country-aware, multilingual comparison flow. Combines OCR and retrieval of official-source material. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for explanations and SAM 3.1 for image regions.

summary: Compresses photos by sending a sketch and fetching only needed close-ups
readme_summary: MuZip keeps photos on-device, sends a tiny sketch, and lets AI request needed regions. Muse Spark decides what to view and SAM 3.1 segments requested areas. Transmits under 1% of data as text messages.

summary: Screens Sydney station precincts in plain English using NSW open data
readme_summary: Answers feasibility questions for 185 Sydney train/metro precincts with computed, checked figures shown on a map. Next.js frontend queries NSW open-data sources with traceable citations. Uses Meta AI models for natural-language query and explanation generation.

summary: Turns video into verifiable physical-world safety intelligence
readme_summary: Converts video into measured physical-world events with verifiable evidence instead of vague captions. Python pipeline with edge Docker, coverage and evaluation. Uses Meta vision models including SAM-style segmentation for forklift safety.

summary: Span-level guard that strips prompt injections from agent tool output, keeps data
readme_summary: Security gateway for agent tool traffic that outputs clean data with stripped markers. Fine-tuned open-weights span model with committed benchmarks vs Llama Prompt Guard 2, Dockerized with evals and 39 tests.

summary: Converts photos and text prompts into game-ready PBR materials for engines
readme_summary: Text-to-material workflow with photo and voice input that outputs PBR maps for Godot and Blender. Built Nov 1-4 with FastAPI backend, WebGPU ReSTIR path tracer in browser, using Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Voice Transcribe.

summary: Turns receipts, SMS and voice notes into a confirmed ledger and credit file
readme_summary: Tool for small traders that ingests receipts, notebook pages, mobile-money SMS and voice notes into a confirmable ledger. Python stack with eval/tests, using Muse Spark 1.3 extraction and Muse Voice Transcribe for lender-ready files.

summary: Camera system that watches motion, tests physical laws and predicts future motion
readme_summary: System that observes moving objects, proposes rival laws, validates on held-out data and suggests next experiments. FastAPI backend with Next.js frontend. Uses Meta Model API Muse models for reasoning.

summary: Human-governed synthesis where AI claims need quotes and approval
readme_summary: FEN x Meta enforces AI proposes, human decides with provenance. A Vercel Python function calls Meta Model API to propose quoted claims, deterministic checks verify quotes, humans verdict in review UI, stored in Supabase with public registry.

summary: Relationship AI that remembers people details to help you follow up
readme_summary: Noa assistant for small business owners captures one-sentence memories and recalls them later. Web plus API stack with seeded demo. Uses Meta Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open on Baseten, and Muse Code.

summary: Turns field photos and crew notes into auditable infrastructure maintenance reports.
readme_summary: Five-stage fail-closed pipeline that segments defects, fuses image and notes, reasons with citations, and drafts next steps with human review. FastAPI service with Docker deploy and 50-case eval. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark 1.3 Vision and Muse Wonder 1.0.

summary: Self-learning daily planner that blocks doomscrolling and adapts nightly
readme_summary: Flutter Android app with Lify agent for planning, alarms, limits and scroll intervention. Backend on Supabase Edge with nightly learning. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, Muse Image and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Local-first VS Code coding agent with governed memory and missions.
readme_summary: RAME Code runs inside VS Code with local-first inference via Muse Glimmer, llama-server, Ollama, LM Studio and Meta Model API. Implements scoped permissions, user-governed memory and autonomous Missions checked by host. Built from scratch for Indie Push the Frontier track.

summary: AI video-editing workstation turning footage into stronger cuts via chat
readme_summary: LolixCopilot understands footage, finds moments and turns instructions into timeline operations. Built with Next.js 16 frontend and FastAPI Python backend. Uses Meta Model API Muse Spark with Supabase.

summary: Disaster triage queue from drone imagery and radio calls with evidence
readme_summary: Turns drone images, video and multilingual radio calls into mission priority queue and draft team plan. Every perception, reasoning and speech step runs on Meta AI via Meta API. Includes private custom-data mode and live demo.

summary: Generates 3D port digital twins from text or photos for stress testing
readme_summary: Converts plain-English descriptions or photos into programmable 3D terminal twins, then agents test conflicting signals. Built with Next.js. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for vision, and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Links each incident-report claim to body-cam timecodes for lawyer review
readme_summary: Checks written incident claims against body-worn video, labeling On recording, Not found, or Check this claim with clickable timecodes. Tested on 5 public Volusia videos with 39 claims. Python codebase with eval, pytest, docs and Meta models for vision transcription.

summary: Friends pin cut-out objects on shared board and remix into new scenes
readme_summary: Pinneds lets friends share photos on a board, cuts out objects, and remixes pins into credited scenes. Firebase App Hosting web app. Uses Meta Model API: Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Image, Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Zero-trust guardrail that enforces policies on AI agent actions with vision checks
readme_summary: Satyahd is a policy enforcement layer for AI agents powered by muse-spark-1.3 and SAM 3.1 vision. It validates actions with Python 3.12, Docker, and pytest coverage, blocking untrusted behavior before execution.

summary: Phone-based child breathing counter with WHO-style triage and follow-up plan.
readme_summary: Child pneumonia triage companion that estimates breathing rate from phone video and outputs triage and plan. FastAPI backend with Docker and Fly.io deploy, plus evals and tests. Uses SAM 3.1 for chest motion, Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Turns any outfit photo or video into a shoppable breakdown of similar items.
readme_summary: Segments outfit photos into garment pieces and retrieves similar shoppable products. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark 1.3 for descriptions, Muse Image for previews. Includes web app and Shop this look Chrome extension.

summary: Return verification that holds refunds until box contents are confirmed
readme_summary: E-commerce returns gate where box contents are counted and refunds held pending human approval. Next.js demo/play app with gate logic and evals. Uses SAM 3.1 for visual counting, Muse Spark for reasoning, Muse Wonder for narrative.

summary: Phone camera repair guide that overlays parts and reads manuals aloud
readme_summary: Fix-It Lens reads appliance type plates, retrieves manuals, and creates page-cited repair cards with upkeep reminders. Overlays parts on live camera, gives spoken steps, and enforces code-based safety zones. Meta models propose actions while deterministic code decides.

summary: Text a benefits letter photo to get renewal help that files only after approval
readme_summary: SMS-style assistant for public benefits renewals that reads letter photos and drafts filings. Uses Engine and Guardian agents with sandbox agency portal and synthetic data. Built on Meta Muse models with nightly tests.

summary: iOS agent that turns finds in one app into plans in another app
readme_summary: iOS planning agent between phone apps that connects partner apps via field cards and shared action log. Built with Swift app plus Worker proxy, using Muse Spark reasoning, Spark Open vision and Voice Transcribe.

summary: Safety control plane for LLM-coordinated warehouse robot fleets with 3D viewer.
readme_summary: Combines seeded simulator, motion control layer, Postgres coordination and MCP tool boundary. Deterministic code retains motion and permission control with model review. Built with Muse Spark Open and 3D viewer.

summary: Voice-first macOS center to review PRs, triage Linear and run coding jobs.
readme_summary: Voice-first command center for engineers to talk through PR reviews and tickets. Runs background coding jobs and integrates with Linear and GitHub. macOS app with website, docs and Meta Muse models.

summary: Sketch or sentence to game-ready Roblox R15 3D hero
readme_summary: HeroGen converts a sketch or prompt into a textured, rigged Roblox hero with high/low LODs and rig gates. Python pipeline on Modal with tests and tools. Uses Muse Image, SAM 3.1, Muse Spark, SAM 3D Objects/Body and Sapiens 2.

summary: Words or photo to validated robot digital twin driving in simulation
readme_summary: RobotForge converts text, photo or parts list into an engineering spec, checks it, and simulates the twin in Gazebo against ground truth. Next.js garage app with catalog. Uses Muse Spark for spec generation and diagnosis.

summary: Event planning app that normalizes vendor quotes for easy comparison
readme_summary: PlusOne Events centralizes event planning and puts vendor quotes on the same lines with missing-charge flags. Compares local price ranges and briefs vendors. Built with Meta Muse Spark at its core.

summary: Turns one brief into a full course with lectures and exercises
readme_summary: Agent chain on Meta models turns a brief into plan, modules, lectures, images and typed exercises. Deterministic code checks formatting and grading, corrector model fixes flags. FastAPI tutor refuses to answer outside materials.

summary: Evidence-first ops platform to investigate failures and verify fixes
readme_summary: Investigates operational exceptions from authorized evidence with allowlisted tools and approval-gated corrections in SQLite sandbox. FastAPI backend on Render with docs. Uses Baseten-hosted Muse Spark for analysis.

summary: Tracks agent memory dependencies and flags stale beliefs on change
readme_summary: Records what each agent memory rests on and flags dependent memories when evidence changes. Rust service with docs site; Meta model proposes corrections held behind human approval and guard until accepted.

summary: Smart racket sensor with AI coach for swing analysis and drills
readme_summary: Sensor insert in racket handle measures swing speed, spin, face angle and impact point, sent to iPhone, Watch and Ray-Ban Display. Muse Spark agent runs physics simulation and plans drills. Includes iOS app with simulated racket mode.

summary: Monitors older adult homes for heat readiness and overnight faults
readme_summary: Checks if home will be warm by morning and flags overnight anomalies to get right responder moving. Synthetic data demo, no control or medical function. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for explanations at story times.

summary: Glasses read warehouse papers and block mismatched form entries
readme_summary: Second Look pairs Ray-Ban Meta glasses via Android app to a receiving form. Device frames and typed values go to a server where Muse Spark reads the paper and blocks submit on mismatch with a fix. Monorepo with apps, packages, and eval.

summary: Turns a glasses walkthrough video into a verified construction punch list
readme_summary: Converts Ray-Ban Meta or phone walk video with voice notes into trade-ready punch items with photos, severity and room. Uses fingertip tracking to pin defects, verified SAM-style outlines, and Muse models for summary and dispatch with before-after re-walk.

summary: MCP server that turns messy product photos into listing-ready images
readme_summary: Rust MCP server for seller agents that stages product photos and issues fidelity receipts. Single static binary port of Python reference with conformance and evidence. Designed for agent tool calls over MCP for commerce listings.

summary: Shared live coding agent session for teams on macOS, Android and web
readme_summary: Hosts a single AI coding agent that multiple teammates join via invite link with catch-up brief. Monorepo with apps, packages, Docker compose and mobile clients. Uses cloud AI coding agent backend for collaborative code generation.

summary: Always-on AI teammates working across 100+ business apps
readme_summary: Wayfind provides isolated cloud computers that run AI teammates inside business tools, pausing when idle. Combines cost-efficient Meta open-weight models with Firecracker microVMs on AWS. Next.js frontend with serverless backend.

summary: Bilingual flood anticipation assistant for Metro Manila with guidance and alerts
readme_summary: Flood-Gentic provides flood anticipation and safety guidance for Metro Manila in English and Filipino. It combines backend risk data, RAG corpus and FAISS retrieval with a web frontend designed for VR and Meta glasses. Built with Meta models for conversational assistance.

summary: Converts one photo of a flat part into measured editable CAD for laser and CNC.
readme_summary: ReverseCAD generates editable CAD programs with millimeter dimensions from a single photo of brackets, covers or gaskets. Candidate CAD writing runs on Muse Spark Open via Baseten, with assembly-fit checks. Built for manufacturing repair during the hackathon.

summary: Photo document checker that pre-validates paperwork before office visits
readme_summary: Suri reads document photos, cross-checks names and requirements against office rules, and asks for fixes. Next.js app on Vercel uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API, human always decides.

summary: Step-free transit planner that checks live lift status for wheelchair routes
readme_summary: Door-to-door public-transport planner avoiding stairs and high kerbs with live Deutsche Bahn lift status. Covers Darmstadt and Frankfurt with Python backend, published demo site and video.

summary: Role-based company assistants governed by rules and human approvals
readme_summary: Role Assistant Foundry generates an org chart with a scoped assistant and handoff form per role using Meta Muse. Code checks drafts against company rules and issues HMAC receipts per human approval. Deployed on Cloud Run with 24-hour demo sandboxes.

summary: Errand agent with provenance firewall that blocks payment detail scams
readme_summary: Browser errand agent that checks where every payment value came from before money moves, blocking IBAN swaps and payee drift. Includes attacker suite, evals, ledger and replay UI. Uses Meta AI vision models for screenshots and actions.

summary: Community disaster photo reporting with AI triage and human verification
readme_summary: Next.js prototype for submitting disaster photos, generating AI observations with priority scores for human review. Includes evidence display and sharing flow. Uses Meta AI vision models for photo intelligence with human-in-loop.

summary: Multilingual weather alerts plus photo-based disaster damage reporting
readme_summary: Free weather and air-quality alerts in user language plus post-disaster paperwork help. Frontend + backend polling NWS/AirNow every 15 mins. Uses Muse Spark for alerts and SAM 3.1 to outline damage in photos.

summary: Reconstructs prior events from one photo with visual evidence outlines.
readme_summary: Retrodict proposes what happened before a photo, proves each step against outlined image evidence, and validates against real video. It uses Muse Spark Open for reasoning with SAM 3.1 and V-JEPA 2 for vision. Python app with docs, eval and tests.

summary: Voice-first care companion turning medical papers and visits into one sourced care plan
readme_summary: Voice-first companion for families of elderly patients. It ingests prescriptions and visit audio into a single care plan with source citations and flags conflicts as doctor questions. Built as website with frontend/backend stack, uses Muse models for multilingual summarization without giving advice.

summary: Multi-phone Android agent that picks devices, retries safely and replays runs
readme_summary: Agent orchestrates real Android devices, selecting capable phones and falling back on failure with safety guardrails. Python agent with Docker setup, prompts, docs and 872 tests plus replay tooling. Uses Meta models for planning and device action grounding.

summary: Turns existing devices from Arduino to robot arms into cohabiting home robots.
readme_summary: Platform that unifies heterogeneous devices into embodied agents with shared hub, firmware, and bodies. Docker and Compose deployment for amd64/arm64 with CI. Uses Muse Spark and Meta models for perception, planning and interaction.

summary: Zero-coordinate GUI agent for desktop and mobile grounded in SAM 3.1 vision
readme_summary: MusePilot automates desktop, ADB mobile fleets and legacy canvas apps without coordinates, with visual state verification. Architecture uses Invariant verifier and planners. Grounded in SAM 3.1, Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Auto-builds nurse rosters and handles sick calls in Hindi or English
readme_summary: ShiftSense generates fortnight rosters in seconds with OR-Tools CP-SAT solver. Muse Spark parses Hindi/English typed or spoken messages, runs replacement workflow, and explains decisions. Human approves every change.

summary: Verifiable audit trail proving what autonomous agents actually did
readme_summary: Agent accountability layer with demo agent, clearinghouse verifier, console and demo-site. Records agent actions in a provable log with live playground. Built from scratch for Push the Frontier Startup track during hackathon window.

summary: Independent PyBullet verification for AI-generated robotics policy fixes
readme_summary: RoboWitness requires every AI-proposed robot fix to pass a hidden deterministic PyBullet exam. Meta AI proposes the fix, simulator executes, oracle decides with SHA-256 sealed evidence. Backend plus web with Docker compose.

summary: WhatsApp receptionist for clinics that books and fills slots, no advice
readme_summary: DPM Agent is a WhatsApp front desk for Dominican clinics handling booking, rescheduling and waitlist in Spanish, English and Haitian Creole. Built with Docker, Python and WhatsApp integration with privacy guardrails. Uses Meta Muse models for dialogue and strictly avoids medical advice.

summary: Agent-to-agent meetup planner that finds mutual time, place and invites
readme_summary: Mifgash exposes an API where personal agents negotiate availability, location and booking. Random-order private asking with expiry and calendar links. Uses Muse Spark Open on Baseten for parsing and place picking.

summary: Rover arm that fetches named objects via vision language
readme_summary: Hasami links a Thenar Walker rover and Pi controller with Muse Spark intent parsing and SAM 3.1 wrist-camera segmentation. Local SAM 2.1 fallback, taught grasps and wheel nudges, verified on physical hardware. MuJoCo sim for future tasks.

summary: Live AI-verified Himalayan road and trek conditions with crew updates
readme_summary: Platform unifying travellers, road department and crews on one map for Himachal Pradesh roads and treks. Built with Next.js using Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1 for image analysis and Muse Voice for transcription.

summary: Reviews event change requests with evidence before approving revisions
readme_summary: Keeps schedule, rooms and volunteer assignments consistent when plans change. User describes change, reviews evidence and approves exact revision. Local app with Meta workflow and Cloudflare overview.

summary: Gatekeeper that blocks risky npm installs and investigates packages in a baited cloud sandbox.
readme_summary: Intercepts AI agent installs, statically checks packages and detonates suspicious ones with fake secrets. Service + CLI + locked sandbox architecture. Uses Muse Spark as security engineer to decode and report evidence.

summary: Runtime oversight plugin that keeps secrets from coding agents browsing the web
readme_summary: Plugin for Meta Muse Code that enforces the Agents Rule of Two at runtime. It detects untrusted content plus sensitive data in one session and delegates the step to a verified subagent on a Meta model without the secret.

summary: Benchmarks AI code judges against an adaptive cheater with hidden tests
readme_summary: Pits an AI judge against a cheater agent that hardcodes tests and adapts to feedback. Uses real-library seeds, patches, and hidden tests as ground truth with a dashboard. Python/pytest harness built during hackathon to probe judge blind spots.

summary: Stores your checklists as portable memory any AI agent can follow
readme_summary: Turns personal criteria and checklists into local files agents reuse without re-prompting. Developed during hackathon from pre-existing prototype. Focus on portable local memory and agent plugins.

summary: Photo-to-pattern garment workflow for small tailoring workshops
readme_summary: SeamProof converts photos and text prompts into garment designs, verified patterns, toile corrections and cut plans. Python pipeline with deterministic verifier and tailor-language explanations. Uses Meta Muse models end-to-end for design, pattern and cut.

summary: Automated drill-core logging from a photo of the core box.
readme_summary: CoreSight photographs core boxes to produce geological logs via agents and geometry code. Stack is Python with Docker deploy and install script applying hackathon patches. Uses Meta models live for vision agents with cached demo replay.

summary: AI presales tool that turns dense RFPs into cited, compliance-scored proposals
readme_summary: Turns RFPs into evidence-backed proposals where every claim cites its source. Stack is Dockerized backend + frontend deployed on Render with sample RFPs. Uses Meta AI models for extraction, drafting and code-scored compliance.

summary: Films physics experiments and replays them as editable 3D simulations
readme_summary: Real2Simulation turns phone video of a room or experiment into an editable 3D lab with tracked motion and fitted models. Web 3D physics stack. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for measurement plus agent prompts.

summary: Turns text or sketches into tested React Native apps with auto screenshots.
readme_summary: Agent plans a mobile app, builds it in React Native, screenshots screens and self-fixes mismatches. Runs cloud preview with Expo Go plus local iOS Simulator and Android emulator. Uses Meta Muse models for planning and codegen.

summary: Turns scores into editable DAW chords and accompaniment with AI harmony.
readme_summary: Extracts chords from scores and explores harmony to build accompaniment parts. Combines Muse Spark 1.3 with Music Transformer plus Muse Spark Open on Baseten. Full DAW backend with live demo and YouTube walkthrough.

summary: Checks claims against document packets and opens deciding clause on page
readme_summary: Verifies a claim against every document in a packet and highlights supporting or opposing clauses on the source page. Streamlit plus Docker app with clause-level retrieval; uses Meta AI models for claim decomposition and evidence linking.

summary: Checks finance post numbers against SEC EDGAR and drafts corrections
readme_summary: Agent that extracts numbers from a finance post, fetches SEC EDGAR filings, and returns verdict with corrected draft and citations. Web app with program verification; uses Meta Muse Spark instead of model memory for numbers.

summary: Turns one photo of an old place into a sourced 30-second history film
readme_summary: Takes a photo of a landmark, researches its history on the web and verifies claims against sources. Built in Python with Modal, it generates a vertical first-person film with sourced captions. Uses Meta models for research, narration and video generation.

summary: Autonomous visual QA agent that finds pixel UI regressions and auto-fixes them
readme_summary: Closed-loop QA agent detecting pixel-level UI regressions missed by DOM tests, diagnosing root cause, and committing verified CSS/React fixes to PRs. Stack is backend + frontend with Docker and E2B micro-VMs using Muse models for reasoning.

summary: Studio that converts bank credit policy PDFs into tested, auditable approval apps
readme_summary: Parses credit policy documents and drafts approval workflows where AI drafts and tests, humans approve. Go backend with Docker Compose and versioned releases. Uses Meta AI models to draft rules and generate test cases.

summary: AI operations assistant for cafes forecasting demand, stock and staffing
readme_summary: Plans demand, inventory packs and staffing via a DAG plan graph with validator and owner approvals. Backend in Python with Docker Compose. Uses Meta Muse models for forecasting and Q&A plus Meta glasses for delivery checks.

summary: Wearable field assistant that answers only from your manuals and refuses otherwise
readme_summary: Ambient Field Lens captures technician questions and grounds answers in operator manuals with distance gating. Refusals become draft passages requiring human approval to improve docs. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B grounding checks with iOS, web and backend services.

summary: Converts textbook photos into narrated video lessons in local languages
readme_summary: Takes textbook PDF or photo and generates illustrated narrated video in French, English, Pidgin, Hausa and others. Built with Next.js, Remotion and Modal. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Image, SAM 3.1 and MMS voices.

summary: Cheap honest browser agent costing under 1 cent per task
readme_summary: Python browser agent on Muse Spark scoring 70% reachable on Online-Mind2Web 300 at under 1c per task with zero hallucinations on blocked sites. Emphasizes honest reporting, evaluation reports and low-cost inference.

summary: Builds a personal Arabic course from openly licensed sources
readme_summary: Agent builds personalized Arabic course from English, Russian, Chinese and French open materials with lessons, quizzes and comeback coaching. Runs on Meta Muse models; replay demo uses recorded answers.

summary: Muse connector giving Muse a private on-device workspace with tag redaction
readme_summary: Muse connector that runs document work on user-owned hardware with tag placeholders. Python relay architecture with separate reader model and leak check. Uses Muse for planning while private parsing stays local, only summaries return.

summary: Autonomous agent that proposes and simulates new battery materials
readme_summary: Agent takes plain-language goals, proposes crystal substitutions via Meta LLM, builds structures and simulates with Meta FAIR UMA. Scientific filters score results and failures loop back for correction on solid electrolytes and cathodes.

summary: Lets solopreneurs describe chores and builds approved automations step by step.
readme_summary: OneSaaS is a Tauri desktop app that turns natural-language requests into Gmail-based business automations with human approval. Monorepo with apps, packages and visual design board. Powered by Meta Muse models for planning and building workflows locally.

summary: Always-on AI ad team that audits Meta ads and builds weekly creatives
readme_summary: Agent Beans runs six AI specialists plus a code-only Operator to check ad accounts daily and plan weekly ads. All metrics trace to source data with read-only recordings on synthetic accounts. Built on Muse models with web dashboard.

summary: CI for AI agents that proves behavior by reading app databases
readme_summary: Runs agents on copies of real apps with fictional data, deciding outcomes from DB state not LLM grades. Provides PyPI/npm kits, GitHub Action PR checks, agent generator and auto-fix rounds.

summary: Natural-language firewall changes turned into validated patches that an admin must approve.
readme_summary: FR_OS AI-Perimeter adds a natural-language AI layer to the FR_OS router OS running on real router hardware. It turns requests into validated config patches requiring admin approval and explains anomalies, using local Muse Glimmer by default with cloud opt-in.

summary: LLM superoptimizer that beats clang -O3 on hot x86-64 functions
readme_summary: Finds hot C/C++ functions, asks Muse for faster assembly, verifies correctness and keeps wins via CC=oqed-cc. Harness with benchmarks, sweeps and web UI. Uses Meta Muse models for assembly generation.

summary: Turns a shelf video with spoken prices into an order-taking shop page
readme_summary: Converts short shelf video and spoken prices into shop page, WhatsApp ordering, Meta catalog CSV, and product photos. Seller verifies prices and answers clarifications before publish. Built for small kirana shops with phone-first workflow.

summary: Listens to ATC radio to flag pilot readback errors with audio and track
readme_summary: Parses ATC clearances from live audio or recordings, checks pilot readback and ADS-B track against clearance, raises alerts with clips. Live monitor plus review console with report drafting. Docker, Python, Muse models.

summary: Auto quality platform linking owner complaints to engineering defects
readme_summary: Frontline intelligence for auto quality turning multilingual reports into cited investigations and repair evidence. Dockerized service; uses Muse Spark for extraction, evidence lookup and drafted investigations.

summary: Measures frequency bias in Glimmer-30B and steers it with a one-knob adapter
readme_summary: Dialed In injects controlled waves into Muse Glimmer-30B to measure spectral response and trains a one-knob adapter reducing slope by 24%. Traces half the effect to a single matrix. Muse Spark and Wonder proposed and reviewed experiments.

summary: Turns one product photo into a real-size 3D shop with WhatsApp ordering
readme_summary: Sellers upload a photo to generate a mobile shop with true-scale 3D, AR table placement, AI Q&A and WhatsApp checkout. Solves repetitive sizing questions for Instagram/WhatsApp sellers with no signup creation flow.

summary: Phone app helping Indonesian eel farmers keep glass eels alive in nursery stage
readme_summary: Synteel guides 0-12 week glass-eel to elver care with water checks and mortality alerts. Stack is mobile web preview plus Android APK with Node server. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Spark Open, Muse Voice Transcribe, and SAM 3.1.

summary: Browser tool that designs peptides and compiles them to DNA for biotherapeutics
readme_summary: Next.js web app for AI peptide design with safety verification and DNA compilation. Frontend plus docs and demos for engineered live biotherapeutics. Uses Muse Spark to invent peptide candidates.

summary: Reviews bike and dashcam footage to map potholes into human-approved council reports.
readme_summary: RoadLens is a post-ride workflow that turns bike and dashcam footage into reviewed hazard evidence. Python pipeline uses SAM 3.1 to segment candidates and Muse Glimmer to triage before human confirm. Exports GeoJSON and draft council reports with GPS mapping.

summary: Tests mobile popups on 8 phones and auto-verifies CSS fixes with video
readme_summary: Opens pages on 8 Indian phone viewports, records 12s and measures overlay coverage. SAM 3.1 tracks overlays frame-by-frame, Muse Spark classifies and writes CSS fix, then re-records to verify.

summary: Autonomous Unreal playtester that checks gameplay against design docs
readme_summary: Muse Spark turns plain-English design docs into checks, then plays UE 5.8 levels from screenshots and state. A no-LLM deterministic verifier replays bugs 3x with repro steps and video. Agent plus Unreal and scripts setup.

summary: Finds, proves, fixes and regression-tests BOLA authorization bugs in FastAPI apps
readme_summary: Agent with read-only code tools that plans tests, patches BOLA flaws and retries failed fixes. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Spark Open, with deterministic code deciding Confirmed and Verified.

summary: One dashboard to draft, approve, publish and answer social media for clients
readme_summary: SocialPilot AI is multi-tenant SaaS for agencies to create brand-voiced posts, schedule publishing, and triage comments into leads. Muse Spark drafts content grounded in business facts with human approval. Docker Compose apps with CI.

summary: Explains and stress-tests game referee results without ever deciding outcomes
readme_summary: Verifiable referee produces signed receipts for matches while Meta models only explain, attack and visualize results. Uses Muse Spark for explanation, Muse Wonder for adversarial test and SAM 3.1 for vision. Python pipeline plus web verifier.

summary: Measures when self-hosting Muse Glimmer on one GPU beats API costs
readme_summary: Serves Meta Muse Glimmer 30B on one NVIDIA L4 with vLLM INT4 and runs a triage agent. Compares cost-quality against Muse Spark 1.3 baseline across reasoning levels with cost model and dashboard.

summary: Multilingual AI call-taker that triages flood helpline overflow into rescue queue
readme_summary: Overflow agent for disaster helplines that listens in caller language, confirms numbers/places, dedupes against live case board. Server + dashboard with map-ranked rescue queue and photo analysis. Uses SAM 3.1 for people counting and Muse Spark for water-level reading.

summary: Autonomous agents audit APIs against GDPR, HIPAA, OWASP and SOC 2
readme_summary: Enterprise API Security Auditor ingests security policies once then autonomously audits API and AI gateways against compliance standards. Architecture has Dockerized backend, frontend, Postman collection and docs. Uses Meta AI models for policy reasoning and audit report generation.

summary: Ninja-warrior physics game turning real parks and streets into courses
readme_summary: ConquerCourse is a browser physics game where real parks and objects become ninja-warrior courses. Static web + shareable course JSON and ghost challenges. Uses Meta AI for course generation assistance.

summary: MCP server giving AI agents control of real Android apps
readme_summary: Envoy is an MCP server that lets any MCP client operate real Android apps alongside desktop/web. It compiles verified runs into shareable routines with a sourced memory graph. It integrates with Meta Muse, Muse Spark agent and Claude Code.

summary: Script tag and protocol giving sites audited control over agents on forms
readme_summary: Usher lets sites expose forms as governed assistant apps via one script tag and plain-English rules. Owner publishes map, controls fields and submit. Supports MCP, Claude and ChatGPT with session visibility.

summary: Live time-aware map of your sources so AI answers what is true now
readme_summary: Grove ingests user sources into a live time-aware world model with provenance. Stack is server + runner + web with evals and Docker deploy. Uses Meta models for extraction and grounding to answer with what is true now.

summary: Measures school-gate near-misses from one phone video for road action.
readme_summary: Crossing Watch estimates distances and near-miss events from a single phone video using SAM 3.1 for measurement and tape-checked calibration. Muse Spark drafts the authority letter and a fine-tuned open-weights Muse Glimmer judges validity. Includes live Explorer, app, and certified college-gate demo.

summary: Turns a photo of any machine into a working buildable LEGO model
readme_summary: SAMgo converts a photo of a machine into a functional LEGO model with moving parts. It uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, SAM 3D for geometry, and Python BrickGPT pipeline. It uses Muse Spark and fine-tuned Muse Glimmer for LEGO assembly reasoning.

summary: Muse Spark runs forecast-first fault diagnosis on real Arduino circuits with verified logs
readme_summary: BenchMate lets Muse Spark read schematics and choose multimeter experiments on real boards. Forecasts are frozen before measurement and checked by code, with sealed faults and offline-verifiable records. Python firmware plus web demo site document five planted-fault cases.

summary: Glasses clip that sees, listens and helps in a second language
readme_summary: Clip for glasses plus Android app and phone backend using Meta models. Reads text aloud, supplies meeting lines and recalls sourced memories. Monorepo with firmware, hardware, evals and Modal deployment.

summary: Local workbench to inspect, steer, and verify behaviors inside open models.
readme_summary: lobot is a local neuron-steering workbench for open models like Llama 3.2 3B. It shows token-level neurons, applies steering doses with before/after forks, and creates behavior directions from text. A Muse Spark agent can run the read-steer-verify loop via the Meta API.

summary: Recovers game moves from binaries or clips and ports them to new games.
readme_summary: Harness to recover a dash move from compiled WASM or gameplay clip and port it to unseen games. Uses Muse Wonder for recovery, Muse Spark for porting, SAM 3.1 for clip tracking. Docker compose with coordinator.

summary: Virtual fitting room that shows catalogue outfits on mannequin and you.
readme_summary: Fashion e-commerce app where shoppers style mannequins and preview outfits on own photo. Uses Muse Image for try-on, Muse Spark for logic and SAM 3.1 for segmentation.

summary: Crop-season planning agent for Argentine farmers with LP optimizer and verifier
readme_summary: DORA plans Argentine grain seasons from text, voice, invoice photos and map sketches. Gradio app combines LP engine with shadow prices and a Meta-model agent plus verifier. Includes eval suite, observatory and Spanish-English Modal demo.

summary: Read-only safety check comparing isolation plans against live plant data and camera
readme_summary: Verifies a plant isolation plan against live sensor data and camera before maintenance. Python backend with eval harness and simulated reactor. Uses Muse Spark to find the plan and compare claims, outputting STOP on mismatch.

summary: Agents that handle texts, quotes and scheduling for landscaping crews
readme_summary: Next.js field-service app with two agents that turn crew texts into office work like quotes and scheduling. Runs Muse Wonder and SAM 3.1 with tools, calculator and Postgres. Fake switches stub iMessage, email and Stripe locally.

summary: Phone and desktop gate that blocks agents until they prove UI control.
readme_summary: Haptura is an owner gate for phone and desktop agents that requires proof of UI control via experiments before acting. Implementation is in phone/windows.py and rules.py with a measured arena and 72 scored runs. It uses Muse Spark and Muse Wonder behind the gate and evaluates SAM vs color tracker.

summary: Governance harness for long-running agents with judge grading and receipts
readme_summary: Provides durable task graphs, independent judge-model grading, and human gates on spend and publishing. Emits hash-chained receipts per decision with measured drift and calibration evidence on Meta Model API.

summary: Drone weed maps plus label rules to spray only where both agree.
readme_summary: ClearSwath combines weed detection maps with pesticide label constraints for spot-spray decisions. Click map spots to see quoted label sentences and application record. Replays saved real runs with FastAPI backend and synthetic voice narration.

summary: Turns one phone video demo into verified executable robot program
readme_summary: Intent2Action reads a phone clip and sentence to generate a verified robot program that runs in new scenes. Uses Muse Glimmer for task parsing and fine-tuned open models with Isaac Sim validation. Includes human correction and failure recovery.

summary: Turns user-journey discoveries into reusable release checks
readme_summary: Python package semaudit converts validated UX findings into reusable checks with journey, rule, and evidence. Built during hackathon on Muse Spark and tested on an open-source store. Runs locally with Python 3.12, no key for demo.

summary: Rust gate letting AI agents act only via approval, privacy router and audit log
readme_summary: Small Rust core enforces fail-closed approvals, privacy routing and hash-chained decision log for agent actions. Uses Meta Model API Muse Spark/Wonder on sanitized text, local Llama for sensitive data, Spark Open on Baseten for images.

summary: Turns typed or spoken specs into web datasets with a receipt for every value
readme_summary: Dapi lets non-scraper users request columns via text, upload or voice and returns counted datasets. Each value links to source evidence for compliance and research use. Live at dapi.fly.dev with runner, specs and verification pipeline.

summary: Goal-driven research agent with verifier, contradictor and evidence folder
readme_summary: Autonomous research agent forming hypotheses, reading full PDFs, self-evaluating and citing only read sources. Verifier, contradictor and judge pipeline scores answers with quotes. Includes repair mode generating tested website patches.

summary: Turns grade photos and voice notes into evidence-cited study orientation reports
readme_summary: Agent takes a grade-sheet photo and voice note, picks tools stepwise, and builds an orientation report where each sentence cites grades, transcripts, or guide rows. Stack is Python CLI plus SSE web demo with journaled evals in evals/results. Uses Muse models for reasoning with ask_student fallback instead of guessing.

summary: AI SRE that finds outage causes with evidence and drafts verified fixes.
readme_summary: Triage watches services, diagnoses outages with cited evidence, applies reversible mitigations on approval, and validates fixes in sandbox before draft PR. Monorepo with apps and infra using pnpm workspaces. Built on Meta Muse models for diagnosis and remediation.

summary: Audits proposals vs specs to flag commercial commitment gaps before signing
readme_summary: PromiseGap compares proposals against specs to surface SLA and commitment mismatches. Built with Symfony 8.1, PHP 8.4, PostgreSQL pgvector for retrieval. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 to extract clauses and explain gaps.

summary: Pocket travel agency that understands Moroccan darija voice notes
readme_summary: BonSafar lets users send voice notes in darija, French or Arabic to plan travel. It handles visas, payments and baggage rules for Moroccan travelers. Built with Next.js on Meta Muse models for multilingual voice understanding.

summary: Converts foreign hospital bill photos into checked English insurance claim packs
readme_summary: Reads bill photos and produces checked claim with deductible, eligibility and codes in seconds. Python backend with static frontend, samples and traceable calculations. Uses Muse Spark for reading and reasoning while code counts and people decide.

summary: Detects N+1, missing indexes and slow DB queries with AI fixes
readme_summary: AI-powered database analyzer that finds N+1 queries, missing indexes, overfetching and slow queries across backend languages. Returns fixed code. Built with Meta AI, Node.js backend and web UI.

summary: Safety checker that vets LLM-planned robot arm actions before they move near people.
readme_summary: Sentinel sits between an LLM planner and a physical robot arm, checking proposed trajectories against safety rules before execution. Its Modal-hosted dashboard compares naive versus checked actions, including slowing and reorienting a knife hand-over near a person.

summary: Turns a phone video into a scaled 3D model you can edit and print.
readme_summary: Pipeline from phone video to scaled editable 3D via VGGT, SAM 3.1 parts and 3D objects with AI edit traces. Web viewer plus Vercel and Supabase stack. Uses Muse Spark verification and Muse Wonder tool calls.

summary: Turns coverage denials into verified verdicts and cited appeal letters.
readme_summary: Ingests denial letters/EOBs as photo, PDF or text, maps program and policy, argues payer side first, then issues cited verdict. Drafts appeal with sentence-level citations and checklist for inconsistent denials. Built on Muse Spark with policy QA corpus.

summary: Mobile memory gym teaching champion techniques like loci and peg systems
readme_summary: Flutter memory-training app that teaches loci, pegs and spaced recall through interactive gyms and progress tracking. Uses Firebase and Muse models for personalized coaching, works offline without keys in local mode.

summary: Group planning app that resolves conflicts and negotiates shared decisions.
readme_summary: Setvia understands group concerns, finds hidden conflicts and negotiates options for shared plans. It is a TypeScript full-stack app with client, server and shared packages using Meta Muse Spark 1.3 API. CI runs on GitHub Actions with live web deployment.

summary: Attention-aware maths tutor that watches focus signals to intervene at the right moment
readme_summary: Browser-based AI maths tutor that tracks gaze, dwell and edit signals to detect confusion. Uses webcam/demo simulation for attention, Muse Spark for tutoring text and Muse Spark Open for decisions, with spend caps and rules fallback.

summary: Runtime guardrail that verifies agent perception before action
readme_summary: SafeLabs Guard checks multimodal agent perception against a deterministic ledger to block spoofed vision/audio. Next.js 15 + TypeScript app with bench and docs. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Crowdsourced voices woven into a book, audiobook and video book
readme_summary: Book by the People aggregates thousands of submissions into a unified book with audiobook and video editions. Next.js TypeScript app with Docker and e2e tests. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for writing, Muse Image 1.0 for art and MMS-TTS for narration.

summary: Walking mystery game that turns street photos into solvable cases
readme_summary: Questory is a phone-first walk-to-play game where AI agent Wren builds cases from player photos. Built on Meta Model API with Muse and SAM 3.1 for story and vision. Stack is Next.js 16 with mobile play and Meta Glasses support planned.

summary: Evaluation workspace to find vision-model misses with exportable evidence
readme_summary: Agent-enabled QA harness for vision engineers to test human-labeled images, inspect misses and false alarms, and export reports. Muse Spark proposes next tests, SAM 3.1 predicts, Python scores, human decides release.

summary: Simulates 90-day app launch with thousands of virtual users to compare strategies
readme_summary: Rehearsal simulates ad views, installs, usage and payments over 90 days for two launch plans. Shows funnel and reasons for churn to pick a winner before spending. Built with Muse Wonder, Spark, Glimmer and Voice Transcribe.

summary: Generates marketplace-ready product photos from one phone picture
readme_summary: Product-photo studio for Philippine small sellers taking English, Filipino or Taglish input. Muse Spark agent plans shoot, Muse Image renders listings and promos, SAM 3.1 cleans cutouts. Outputs Shopee/Lazada/TikTok sized packs with captions.

summary: Runs synthetic cardiovascular experiments from plain-language hypotheses
readme_summary: Ontology-grounded lab generates synthetic physiology experiments and verified reports with research CI checks. Python project with agent_eval, experiments, and results. Experiment agent runs by default on muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API.

summary: Code-repair agent that generates patches then proves if they are safe to merge.
readme_summary: Keel generates candidate fixes with Muse models then has Muse Spark write adversarial tests where candidates disagree. Python agent plus platform and GitHub Action, focused on calibrated trust for auto-merge decisions.

summary: Genome interpreter that explains ancestry, variants and folds affected proteins.
readme_summary: App takes a genome, reports origin and standout variants with biology from published data. Uses Meta Muse Spark for stories, Muse Image for visuals, and Meta ESMFold to show wildtype vs mutant structure.

summary: Approval and audit layer for coordinating mixed robot fleet missions.
readme_summary: Coordinates mobile and humanoid robot missions with authorized execution and evidence preservation. Stack is Next.js 14 frontend with Python backend, Docker deploy and simulation. Uses Meta Muse models to propose actions that only proceed after human approval.

summary: Checks if a molecule can be made and proposes sourced synthesis routes
readme_summary: Retrosynthesis system with literature mining into a knowledge graph and dual debating agents with rule-based verdict. Backend plus Docker Compose and frontend. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and extraction.

summary: Agent clicks ad funnels like a shopper to verify discounts and trials with proof
readme_summary: Tests Meta ads before spend by clicking the funnel like a customer up to payment. Checks discounts, prices, shipping and trials with quotes and screenshots. Built on Muse Wonder computer-use, Muse Spark Open, and SAM 3.1 segmentation.

summary: Telegram agent that sends reminders, follows up on skipped tasks and keeps goals
readme_summary: Proactive Telegram accountability agent that messages first with reminders and follow-ups via text, voice, photo, video or PDF. Node.js/TypeScript service with proactive scheduling and approval-gated actions. Uses Meta Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: AI operator fits more EV chargers on existing building grid connection
readme_summary: Headroom optimizes EV charging against building load to avoid peak demand charges and overload. Streamlit operator with simulation, tariff logic and live demo. Built for energy control of a physical system.

summary: Release gate that blocks Argo canaries when behavior differs from PR intent
readme_summary: Release gate for Argo Rollouts that checks if a canary did what its PR said and nothing else. Uses Muse Spark Open for explanation only, never approval, with replayable decisions and behavior-vs-intent verification.

summary: Turns a dance rehearsal video into per-dancer sync scores and a shareable reel.
readme_summary: Uploads a phone video, tracks every dancer with SAM 3.1, scores timing against crew beat and checks formation top-down. Python 3.11 backend plus frontend in Docker with pytest and evals. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation/tracking and Muse Spark 1.3 for coaching notes and reel.

summary: Turns sheet offcut photos into hole-aware CNC cutting plans
readme_summary: Desktop prototype for reviewing photographed sheet remnants and planning parts across inventory with hole-aware nesting. React TypeScript frontend with FastAPI backend. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and software-verified CNC output.

summary: Tracks one object in fixed video and answers with frame-linked evidence
readme_summary: Reconstructs an object's observed history in short fixed-camera video, answers questions and links claims to source frames, refusing when unseen. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation/tracking, Muse Spark 1.3 for investigation and Muse Wonder 1.0 for review via Meta Model API.

summary: Turns everyday photos into tappable talking boards for non-speaking people
readme_summary: Momentalk lets caregivers photograph a real moment to generate outlined objects and large word buttons for communication. Frontend plus backend with Docker/Render deploy uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe, Wonder and Image for language, voice and visuals.

summary: Splits group restaurant bills item-by-item from photo and voice
readme_summary: Dex reads receipt photos for items, tax, tip and totals and checks math. Users state who had what by voice or text for exact to-the-cent splits saved to an expense log. Built in Python on Meta models with receipt OCR and agentic splitting.

summary: Agent that bisects vLLM regressions and proves fixes with GPU benchmarks
readme_summary: PerfPilot automates GPU performance debugging with PerfBisect, TuneSmith flag search, and a bench harness with 17 failure scenarios. Open-weight agents on muse-spark-open propose commits, deterministic referee and benchmarks decide.

summary: Turns one-line worksheets into interactive lessons with handwritten mistake review
readme_summary: AI classroom platform where teachers generate worksheets and learners circle confusion and check handwriting. Co-pilot analyzes class mistakes to generate targeted practice with hints. Built with Next.js and Meta AI models for worksheet and vision tasks.

summary: Locks SAM-segmented objects to test 0.5-1 second visual position forecasts
readme_summary: Live observation interface requires real Meta SAM 3.1 masks before tracking and forecasting from images only. Local tracker follows objects between SAM calls, motion model predicts ahead. No simulator state, outcomes measured openly.

summary: Hands-free glasses scribe turning consultations into verified SOAP notes
readme_summary: Ray-Ban Meta glasses capture consult, Muse Voice Transcribe produces transcript, Muse Glimmer drafts SOAP and verifier checks lines. Doctor reviews and signs. iOS plus Python stack for public-sector doctors in Mexico, documentation only.

summary: Reads energy meter displays with phone and verifies values with physics.
readme_summary: Points phone at inverters and meters, SAM 3.1 reads digits then physics checks and re-looks on failure. Muse Spark explains findings with evidence. Backend plus web frontend deployed on Azure Container Apps.

summary: Films items for sale to auto-generate listings verified against video proof
readme_summary: Seller points camera and narrates while AI director guides shots and drafts listing. Claims contradicted by video are struck through before publishing. Buyers can ask questions answered by video search. Reflex/Python app with replay page and YouTube demo.

summary: WhatsApp court agent explaining summons and tracking hearing dates
readme_summary: Indonesian court litigant assistant on WhatsApp that reads letters, verifies facts and sends hearing reminders. PHP CodeIgniter app with Docker using Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe, 186 tests passing.

summary: Meal photo tracker that outlines foods and logs portions and nutrition.
readme_summary: Private meal history app that outlines foods, estimates portions, and matches USDA references without advice. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark 1.3 for naming and portions, and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0.

summary: Trust layer for solo-founder launch content with approval receipts
readme_summary: LaunchCrew turns one idea into a fact-checked launch pack via Scout, Maker and Checker agents. Nothing publishes without owner approval and Ready-gate checks, with receipts for every call. Powered by Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API.

summary: Screens UK health ads against claims register, CAP Code and ASA rulings.
readme_summary: PreFlight ingests video, image, product pages or scripts, extracts explicit and visual claims, and checks each against the GB register, CAP Code and ASA rulings with source locations. It suggests exact authorized replacement wording with register IDs. It uses Meta vision and Muse models for claim extraction and matching, packaged via Docker for review.

summary: Hands-free delivery check-in using glasses camera to count and read labels.
readme_summary: Hands-free check-in desk using Ray-Ban Meta glasses or Android camera for deliveries. SAM 3.1 detects items, Muse Spark reads labels, rules verify counts before ERP posting. Human voice confirm required.

summary: Accessibility gaming buddy that plays hard parts from English or Arabic voice commands
readme_summary: PlayFellow-Coop lets players with limited mobility delegate game segments by voice then reclaim control. Built on the PlayFellow engine with LM Studio adapter, memory, proxy hardening and redaction. Uses Meta models for bilingual command understanding and game actions.

summary: Open-source Markdown editor and knowledge base with AI assistant and workflow templates.
readme_summary: Papeliz is a cross-platform Markdown editor for personal knowledge with AI assistance and agent workflow templates. Built with app/site pnpm workspace from scratch Oct-Nov 2026. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Voice Transcribe and Image for notes and creative features.

summary: Superoptimizer where Meta models propose LLVM rewrites and Alive2 formally proves them.
readme_summary: qed-superopt optimizes hot LLVM IR functions beyond clang -O3 via LLM proposals verified by Alive2 refinement proofs. Python pipeline with bench, results and repair loop on counterexamples. Uses Meta models for rewrite generation and repair.

summary: STEM lab where students predict first, then test ideas in simulator
readme_summary: Interactive STEM lab that requires prediction before simulation and removes coaching for recall. React+Vite frontend with Flask backend and guided experiments. Uses Muse models to coach reasoning and assess understanding.

summary: Async AI project manager that replaces status meetings
readme_summary: Pam checks in via Slack, challenges vague updates, syncs boards, and chases blockers. Needs Meta Model API key plus Slack and board backend like built-in Pam board or Azure DevOps. Ships with Docker Compose and console UI.

summary: Generates checked solar-plus-battery pre-feasibility studies for diesel islands
readme_summary: AutoSolar Researcher simulates hourly PV, battery and diesel across designs to compute LCOE, fuel and CO2 savings. It fuses four weather sources, cited costs and a published-study check with second-model review. It uses Muse Spark, Glimmer, Wonder, SAM 3.1 and Muse Code.

summary: Forecasts flash drought risk in 1-2 weeks and advises irrigation actions
readme_summary: FlashWatch forecasts soil drought probability for Corn Belt farms and recommends irrigation, chemical and feed actions. AI agents deliver text advice, find pivots from aerial photos and control pivots on approval. It uses Meta models with live feed site and saved agent runs.

summary: Multi-agent runtime keeps long documents consistent from one canon
readme_summary: Writes operations manuals and agreements from shared company facts and propagates fact changes to every page. Prevents contradictions like approval roles or zone changes. Runtime plus web UI built on Muse Spark.

summary: Phone slow-motion video that measures machine vibration and diagnoses faults
readme_summary: Python app that analyzes slow-motion phone video to segment parts and measure vibration per part. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for tracking and Muse Spark 1.3 for fault diagnosis with magnified visualization. Ships with Hugging Face demo and test samples.

summary: Turns product photos into editable 3D shoppable rooms with AI stylist
readme_summary: Next.js commerce app converting product photos into interactive 3D showrooms. Shoppers inspect products, try finishes, and query a budget-aware stylist grounded in catalog. Uses Meta models for vision, 3D generation and styling.

summary: Grocery list AI finds price-match proof from current flyers
readme_summary: MooseCart takes list by voice, text or photo and hunts flyers for exact price-match candidates with proof. Prices come only from flyer data, no model invention. Demo covers Milton stores; engine is store-driven for Canada.

summary: Creates a living painted world for every guided meditation session
readme_summary: Generates calm animated paintings tailored to each guided meditation, with rippling water and drifting clouds. Uses Meta models to design, paint, check and animate 1,101 library worlds plus live personal ones. Stack includes Python, Flutter and web frontend.

summary: Ask plain-English questions about camera footage and get clips with proof.
readme_summary: AskFootage indexes recorded camera footage and answers questions with matching clips on a timeline. It outlines objects with SAM 3.1 and shows measurements for each match. Muse Spark parses questions via the Meta Model API, with offline demo replays.

summary: Deterministic runtime that blocks prompt-injection tool calls by enforcing pre-signed plans
readme_summary: Gate-enforced runtime in Rust where agents act only through code-checked tool calls. Includes crates, demo, docs and evals with 48-run attack tests. Built on Muse Spark with support for Muse Wonder as agent model.

summary: CI regression tests that verify code changes preserve users' ability to opt out.
readme_summary: AgencyDiff uses computer-use agents to explore baseline vs candidate UIs and converts verified behavior into repeatable opt-out checks. It runs as a GitHub Action with scripted replay gate and screenshot reviewer, evaluated on agent PRs and Circle benchmark. Built with Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Code.

summary: Quantum lab where AI plans circuits and exact physics verifies every number
readme_summary: Inkubit turns sketches, photos and speech into quantum experiment plans and circuits with 3D Earth visualization. Backend uses exact simulation and physics invariants to verify AI outputs. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Voice.

summary: Show a bug or dictate and it pastes the prompt with edited screenshots.
readme_summary: iVibe is a desktop helper to fix, prompt and dictate bug reports wherever you type. Captures and edits screenshots to attach the right words. Cross-platform releases with TypeScript codebase and AGPL-3.0 license.

summary: Turns workplace video into explainable safety observations and evidence reports.
readme_summary: Analyzes short workplace video with SAM 3.1 tracking and Muse Spark rule drafting to match natural-language safety rules. Generates human-reviewable evidence with replay mode. Backend plus frontend MVP with synthetic scenarios.

summary: Phone repair guide that verifies bike chain fixes by measuring each step.
readme_summary: Session-based voice guide validates framing, chain seating and spin test from video before advancing. Python probe with replay, eval benchmark and procedures. Uses SAM 3.1 masks for measurement and Muse Spark for explanations.

summary: Finds the screenshot part you describe and marks it with boxes
readme_summary: Pyosi grounds natural language to screenshot regions with numbered boxes and distance highlights. Says not-found or ambiguous instead of guessing. Next.js app with eval harness, uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API.

summary: Audits AI support agents by checking promised refunds against Stripe/Shopify records
readme_summary: Execution auditor that reconciles agent-promised actions against Stripe/Shopify ledger state. Backend plus sample inbox frontend with 235 backend and 93 frontend tests. Uses Muse models to parse promises and verify money movement.

summary: Spatial ERP that turns dock camera and voice into warehouse ledger transactions
readme_summary: Autonomous Spatial ERP for receiving docks executing a transactional DAG from camera plus voice. Monorepo with Fastify SSE orchestrator and React/Vite spatial HUD. Uses Muse Spark Open for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for box refinement.

summary: WhatsApp scam-checking agent that verifies links and gives safety verdicts
readme_summary: Second Look bot on WhatsApp Cloud API and website that investigates forwarded chats and links with self-chosen tools. Built on Muse Spark with preregistered validation on 945 cases and verify_results.py reproducibility.

summary: AI writing studio that keeps serialized fiction consistent episode to episode
readme_summary: StorySpine is an AI-assisted studio for designing novels and writing episodes with author-approved story memory. It architectures top-down and verifies chapters bottom-up with quote-proven findings. Frontend plus server with evals and samples.

summary: Phone walkaround video turned into measured wildfire defensible-space report
readme_summary: Films a home/HOA walkaround to track hazards with SAM 3.1, measure wall distance in feet, and check California rules via deterministic engine with citations. Muse Spark Open agent builds prioritized fix plan with cost and tracked rescan verification.

summary: Live broadcast checklist that flags risks and proposes human-approved fixes.
readme_summary: Static web app on Cloudflare Pages with Show Caller risk engine and incident learning flow. Agent proposes fixes with receipts; human approves before action. Uses Meta Muse models for fix proposals and risk reasoning.

summary: Sports club scheduler from text, voice, or league schedule photos
readme_summary: Club ops agent drafts conflict-free schedules, proves checks, explains results, and drafts multilingual family notices for human approval. Python/FastAPI + Docker with evals. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta API with live eval proof.

summary: Voice assistant that answers hands-busy questions using recent camera frames.
readme_summary: Lets users ask by voice or text with selected camera frames as context for cooking and assembly. Frontend with backend and audio pipeline plus tests. Uses Meta API models for vision-language guidance and speech handling.

summary: Verifies flood reports against satellite and photo evidence to prioritize relief zones.
readme_summary: Centinela turns community flood reports into verified decisions for responders. Backend plus frontend with evaluation harness fuses voice notes, photos, satellite and bulletins via deterministic code verdicts. Uses Meta AI for voice transcription, extraction, vision and segmentation explanations only.

summary: On-screen personal assistant that handles refunds, forms, letters and reminders.
readme_summary: Rust-based Windows assistant that works on the user's screen and asks before sending anything. Uses Muse Spark for planning, SAM 3.1 for grounding, plus Muse Voice, Muse Image and Muse Glimmer. Repo includes crates, fixtures, evals and design specs.

summary: Watches cockpit displays and radio to catch set-vs-cleared altitude errors
readme_summary: Crosscheck listens to ATC/intercom and reads flight displays via camera, speaking up when said, set and doing disagree. Flown and scored in X-Plane 12 Boeing 737-800 against hidden sim data. Built on Meta models for vision reading and audio monitoring.

summary: Turns textbook chapters into animated lesson videos students finish.
readme_summary: Upload a chapter or topic to get planned, reviewed animated lessons rendered with Manim and Remotion. pnpm monorepo with apps, engine and packages. Uses Muse Spark to plan/review, Muse Image to draw, SAM 3.1 for parts and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Watches cooks to capture unspoken techniques and teaches them back later.
readme_summary: Compinche watches cooking via phone or Ray-Ban Meta glasses, asks about unexplained decisions, and saves answers as video-linked cards. Later replays teaching in another kitchen. Built with LangGraph, Meta models, and local SAM 3.1.

summary: Spanish-speaking bench assistant that finds faults on real circuit boards
readme_summary: Lunes looks through a USB microscope, guides probing, reads instruments, and compares measurements to simulation to isolate faulty components. Built with Python, firmware and cheap bench hardware, it runs offline on Muse Glimmer for low-resource labs.

summary: Anonymous whistleblowing that turns redacted evidence into cited timelines
readme_summary: Twelve-stage pipeline on Muse Spark Open converts scattered redacted evidence into cited timelines with uncertainty shown. Showcase demo runs crypto steps in-browser with nothing sent remotely.

summary: Claim ledger that verifies agent memory against code with CI blocking
readme_summary: Saphene extracts workspace claims and verifies them with deterministic grep file:line receipts and reviewer personas. Runs as GitHub Actions and MCP plugin for Copilot/Cursor, using model APIs with offline fallback.

summary: Illustrated Singaporean biography books with layered animated pages and sources
readme_summary: Interactive cloth-cover books with pen frontispiece, decade-style plates, short films per spread and footnoted captions. Next.js app with generation pipeline using Muse Spark, Muse Image, SAM 3.1, Muse Wonder, Voice Transcribe.

summary: Voice-set spending limits for shopping agents with automatic refund evidence
readme_summary: Compiles spoken limits into enforced buying policy, shops autonomously and builds vision evidence for refunds on wrong delivery. Built entirely on Meta open-weights Muse Spark Open models on Solana devnet. Node plus Modal architecture.

summary: Compresses decks, PDFs and JSON to Markdown with token savings proof.
readme_summary: Squeeze converts token-heavy slides, PDFs, pages and tool output into compact LLM-ready Markdown and reports tokens saved. Muse Spark describes images over 64px, drops logos, tables charts, plus fact-check Q&A. All code written Oct 26-Nov 4 2026.

summary: Converts scanned seismogram films to miniSEED with human review
readme_summary: SeismoRescue digitizes WWSSN seismogram film scans to miniSEED for archival rescue. Muse Spark reads printed borders while fine-tuned SAM 3 traces lines from both ends. Agreed spans export, disagreements go to human review.

summary: Turns one demo video plus one rule into a robot program tested on 20 simulations
readme_summary: Test-driven robot programming from phone video plus sentence into checks and code. Python + MuJoCo simulation with bench and web replay demo. Uses Muse Wonder for code/diagnosis and SAM 3.1 for vision.

summary: Webcam gaze board lets users speak by looking and blinking to select cells.
readme_summary: Gaze communication board on ordinary webcam: look at cell, close eyes ~0.4s to speak. Pairs 30fps local gaze with Muse Spark semantic anchors and SAM 3.1 pinpointing plus online corrector to fix drift without headset.
