summary: Audits purchase ledgers against invoices with cropped evidence working papers
readme_summary: Vouch matches ledger samples to invoices, POs and GRNs, linking findings to source crops. Uses stateless Muse Spark calls for extraction and separate verification. Runs offline synthetic demo; live mode needs Meta API key.

summary: Finds PCB assembly defects from a phone photo versus a golden reference board.
readme_summary: Compares a phone photo to a golden board via alignment, part localization, and classical vision comparison. Muse Glimmer only confirms or rejects vision-raised candidates with netlist grounding. Includes Gradio app, prompts, and severity rules.

summary: AI agents execute your digital will after trusted liveness confirmation.
readme_summary: Ereditas is a liveness-gated estate companion that carries signals and tasks after death confirmation. Multi-app architecture with Caddy, Docker and Fly deployment. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark 1.3 live.

summary: Turns bug screen recordings into failing tests and fixed PRs
readme_summary: Takes mp4 screen recording, understands steps with SAM 3.1 plus Muse Spark, reproduces live via computer use, writes failing Playwright test, fixes code and prepares PR. TypeScript pipeline with verification gates.

summary: Voice-to-board relay that structures responder casualty notes for red-first dispatch.
readme_summary: Offline-first static PWA with no backend or account; records are encrypted on-device and relayed to a dispatch board sorted red-first. Responders dictate care already given and confirm entries; it gives no medical advice. Stack is vanilla HTML/JS.

summary: Hands-free voice AI for earbuds and glasses that answers commute questions while walking
readme_summary: Earshot is a voice-first mobile assistant for walking commutes using Bluetooth glasses or earbuds. Stack is iOS app plus server and web client with low-latency speech pipeline. It uses Meta AI / Muse models for conversational Q&A and proactive suggestions.

summary: Converts planner sentences into checked cargo load plans for synthetic ships
readme_summary: StowLM wraps a ship-planning engine in an app pipeline: Muse Spark parses cargo docs, fine-tuned Muse Glimmer 30B maps text to rules, engine plans, checker verifies. Built with Python app plus experiments and synthetic ship data for research pilot.

summary: Local-first personal memory that answers files with cited proof
readme_summary: Indexes PDFs, text, images and audio into persistent memory of decisions and deadlines. CLI/API/web UI with conflict detection and honest abstention. Built scratch for hackathon with evidence-backed answers.

summary: Autonomous agent fleet that finds and simulates rare anomalies in SDSS and DESI sky surveys
readme_summary: Multi-layer discovery engine over SDSS/DESI imaging for rare cosmic anomalies. Stack is Next.js 14 with Three.js frontend, FastAPI backend, Docker Compose and notebooks. Integrates 6 Meta Model APIs plus Spark open-weight models.

summary: WhatsApp and web control room for municipal pothole and leak reports
readme_summary: Municipal ops control room for South African cities: residents report via WhatsApp/web, Muse Spark does triage and multilingual work orders, SAM 3.1 masks hazards. Human dispatcher approves; .NET with sandboxed demo.

summary: Agent-to-agent platform where personal agents negotiate and settle group plans
readme_summary: Serve removes group-chat coordination by letting personal AI agents negotiate times, prices, and venues with each other. Sport scheduling is the first use case with live demo and technical report. Built solo on Meta open models with self-evolving agents.

summary: Full-stack RL platform to train, verify, diagnose, and heal agents
readme_summary: Self-Healing RL Studio for training agents, verifying intent alignment, diagnosing faults, and planning recovery. FastAPI backend with React Vite frontend using PPO, TD3, and SB3. Includes warehouse training environment.

summary: Turns a room photo into a playable escape room hosted by AI wizards
readme_summary: Keyframe generates an escape room from your own objects in about three minutes. Four wizard agents narrate and run puzzles via web app. Uses Meta models for vision, story, and game hosting on Modal.

summary: Auditable agent researching biotech catalysts with source verification
readme_summary: Proof Reader researches 6-month biotech catalysts like trial readouts and FDA decisions. Muse Spark acts as research agent with Brave Search, then claims are checked against cited sources with captures. Includes Python server, accuracy checks, and PTGX run evidence with human control.

summary: Design board that segments references part-by-part for targeted edits
readme_summary: FastAPI + React 19 board where Muse Spark reads designs, SAM 3.1 segments parts, and Muse Image redraws selected parts. MCP server, corpus and 1,913 tests. Lets users change one element while preserving rest.

summary: Property permitting answers verified against official jurisdiction sources
readme_summary: Resolves an address to jurisdiction and authority, then answers build-permit questions only when backed by retrieved official sources. Full-stack app with backend, frontend and infra; uses Meta models with snapshotted verification for HR-001 to HR-012 modules.

summary: Voice-note diary that turns daily stories into comics with your own cast
readme_summary: Comimo turns voice or text in Arabic and English into comic diary panels with consistent characters. Stack is Next.js 16 and React. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Image 1.0 and SAM 3.1 for story and art.

summary: Simulated range where AI defenders practice containment with replayable logs
readme_summary: Crucible runs attacker vs defender exercises on simulated company networks with full logging and scoring. Python server with static replay site. Uses Meta models for log-watching and containment decisions.

summary: Turns licensed pages into checked interactive lessons for teachers
readme_summary: Turns a licensed page into a short interactive lesson with quotes, numbers and formulas verified by code. Stack includes apps/packages with deterministic checks. Uses Muse Spark to write lessons and SAM 3.1 to confirm diagram regions.

summary: Voice desktop companion that guides PC tasks and highlights buttons to click.
readme_summary: Windows 10/11 desktop assistant with a light-bulb companion for step-by-step PC guidance. Built with Rust/Cargo plus web assets. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark 1.3/Wonder 1.0, MMS-TTS, Glimmer 30B and SAM 3.1.

summary: Voice-first shopping aid that locates shelf items and verifies labels aloud
readme_summary: Ittro is a voice-first Android app that finds a requested product, guides the hand to it and checks the label. Native Android with modular app and relay components. Uses on-device vision and speech with Meta AI models for guidance.

summary: Prompt-to-playable 3D gothic horror games and PBR assets in browser
readme_summary: Autonomous studio that turns one prompt or voice input into playable 3D worlds and procedural assets. Browser studio on serverless GPUs with sandbox; uses Meta Muse models and SAM 3.1 for generation and scene understanding.

summary: iPhone coach app that logs workouts by voice and auto-fills weekly check-ins
readme_summary: Setecho removes coaching paperwork for athletes and human coaches. The iOS + watchOS app counts reps, syncs scale and food data, and fills check-ins by voice. It uses Meta AI models for speech logging, rep counting, and progress summaries.

summary: Code reviewer where every finding carries machine-checked proof or failing test.
readme_summary: CodeProof verifies code findings with citations, adversarial confirmation or failing tests. Zero-runtime-dependency tool with Docker demo and 268 deterministic tests. Built from scratch for Push the Frontier Indie track.

summary: Agent that searches TESS light curves for small planets and publishes predictions.
readme_summary: Tessa searches public NASA TESS data on nearby K/M dwarfs, explains dips, and outputs testable planet predictions with case files and 3D map. Pipeline includes agent, pipeline, finetune and serve components plus hosted site. It uses Muse Spark for Q&A and a fine-tuned Glimmer vetter v10 model.

summary: Private voice-first cycle companion that turns fuzzy recall into structured logs
readme_summary: Voice-first menstrual companion that logs entries and estimates event overlaps on-device. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech input and Muse Spark tool-calling to resolve landmarks like holidays to dates.

summary: Turns failed exam questions into mastery plans where learners do thinking
readme_summary: Teacher photographs finished exams; Muse Spark 1.3 marks answers and diagnoses reasoning from handwriting. Each unmastered question becomes a level ending in a real task, play-tested by Muse Wonder. Built in LoWisa platform with phone, desk, and host apps.

summary: On-phone guardian that nudges kids to stay safe and guides parents
readme_summary: On-child-phone companion detects risky chat patterns and gives friendly nudges, parents get pattern insights not text, schools get anonymous trends. Stack is FastAPI, Postgres, Muse Spark 1.3 with Llama 3.2 1B on-device.

summary: Self-hosted fact-checker that splits posts into claims with quoted sources
readme_summary: Clear Context is a self-hosted fact-checking agent using LangGraph that separates claims, researches details, and links findings to source passages. Includes backend, Chrome extension and evals. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0.

summary: Evidence-led MEP takeoff that grounds estimates in construction drawing geometry.
readme_summary: Parses local PDF vector linework deterministically, then applies Meta foundation models to read systems and quantities with estimator review. Human-in-the-loop takeoff store with frontend and docs. Uses Meta AI vision-language models for drawing intelligence.

summary: Multi-agent team that turns Dominican tenders into GO/NO-GO bids with evidence
readme_summary: Postor reads DGCP tenders, amendments and scanned pages to give an evidence-backed bid verdict plus draft proposal. It uses Muse Spark for reading and drafting, Muse Wonder for audit, SAM 3.1 for localization, Voice and Prompt Guard 2.

summary: Replays tasks on old vs new Muse models to give GO, NO-GO upgrade verdicts.
readme_summary: Cost-aware statistical gate that replays user tasks on old and new Muse Spark versions with repeats and blocks PRs on regression. Runs as Docker app and GitHub Action with evidence store. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.2 vs 1.3 comparison harness.

summary: Finds fall hazards in elderly homes from a photo with a low-cost fix plan.
readme_summary: Analyzes a home photo to detect, outline, and prioritize fall hazards with explanations in EN/ES/PT. TypeScript client plus API, photos never stored. Uses Muse Spark for hazard reasoning and SAM 3.1 for segmentation and walkway measurement.

summary: Volcanic hazard twin that simulates lava flows and drafts emergency alerts
readme_summary: Operations agent answers eruption questions by calling lava, impact, seismic and CAP 1.2 alert tools to write cited briefings. Python stack deployed on Modal. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B open-weights served on own GPU as the brain.

summary: Agent turns Strava outings, GPX and photos into finished adventure book drafts
readme_summary: Agent web app takes spoken or typed book ideas in English/French, connects Strava or GPX plus photos, and drafts an AdvenBook. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 chat and vision, SAM 3.1 for subject-safe crops, Muse Voice Transcribe, and AdvenBook MCP server. Next.js with Vercel Blob.

summary: Phone slow-motion video measures machine vibration to diagnose faults
readme_summary: Pocket vibration analyzer that films machines at 240fps, measures frequency from pixels and magnifies motion. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark for diagnosis, and Muse Image for localization with FastAPI backend and frontend.

summary: Bangla voice and photo crop advisor with treatment plan and follow-up
readme_summary: KrishiBondhu diagnoses sick-leaf photos in Bangla by voice or image and provides treatment plans with follow-up. Uses Muse, SAM 3.1 and Meta ASR with LangGraph agent, Next.js 16 and Postgres.

summary: Daily companion that updates your 5 closest people and suggests easy ways to meet.
readme_summary: Iris is a Muse concept that shares brief daily status with five chosen contacts plus one low-effort hangout idea. It runs as a static web app with engine, prompts and test data. Uses Muse for mood-aware message generation and suggestion ranking.

summary: Turns photos and Swahili voice notes into verified Kenyan SHA claims
readme_summary: Reads photographed claim documents, cites each field to source, checks SHA rules and repairs returns. Multimodal agent built on Meta Muse models with human confirmation gate. Backend plus frontend demo with synthetic data.

summary: Turns a room walk-around video into 3D measurements and furniture that fits
readme_summary: Homie converts ~60 phone video stills into a 3D room with sizes using Muse Spark for floor-plan inference. A shopping agent proposes real Shopee Taiwan products, checks fit in code, and visualizes them in 3D and photorealistic views. Web app supports zh-TW and English.

summary: Tests declared workflow policy against what execution actually enforces
readme_summary: Turns workflow evidence into a reviewable model, evaluates declared policy, tests counterfactuals and verifies safeguards with a deterministic simulator as authority. Node.js app with live judge UI, CI and evaluation suites.

summary: Triages vulnerability reports into evidence-linked cases for human review
readme_summary: Mizan reads vulnerability reports and code to flag injection attempts and verify claims without execution. Self-hosted Python workbench with audit trail and API. Uses Meta models for reasoning-only security triage.

summary: Checks floor plans for wheelchair accessibility and lists failing doors, rooms and fixes
readme_summary: ConformScope analyzes uploaded building plans to measure rooms and doors in metres and check accessibility rules. It uses FastAPI backend with Next.js 16 frontend and Meta AI SAM 3.1 for vision plus Muse Spark for reasoning. Live demo runs sample apartment checks in minutes.

summary: Voice-first night dispatcher that guides stranded cyclists and walkers to safety
readme_summary: Offline-capable PWA with Node server and playbook logic for night breakdowns and safety. Uses Meta AI voice interaction to give one spoken next step with cited sources and test receipts.

summary: Evidence workstation that tests if satellite changes survive other explanations
readme_summary: GeoAlibi is a local Python research prototype for satellite change verification with exported evidence. It exercises live Muse Spark interpretation and SAM decoding. Submitted as offline walkthrough November 2026.

summary: Verifies procedures from video with tracked visual evidence
readme_summary: Turns procedures into Proof Plans then reviews videos with timestamped findings. Web app with frame inspector. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for events and SAM 3.1 for tracked object geometry.

summary: Packing photo checker that flags weak evidence for Indonesian sellers
readme_summary: ProofMuse gives Indonesian sellers instant feedback on packing photos before shipping. Muse Spark 1.3 observes and SAM 3.1 segments labels, Go rules engine decides. Advisory only, with live demo and eval set.

summary: Plain-English camera rules and alerts using existing business cameras.
readme_summary: Streamatic turns existing cameras into natural-language rules like gate open after 10pm, running live in Lagos. Hackathon work adds self-setup, SAM 3.1 outlines, and a verification guide. New Telegram chat and demo web client call the existing product API.

summary: Converts drill-core tray photos and voice notes into checkable lithology logs.
readme_summary: CoreLog photographs core trays to propose structured lithology logs with label and depth reading. Plain-code cross-checks, abstention on weak evidence and human validation before export. Bilingual French/English PWA with Python server.

summary: Local-first cozy day planner with visual room and voice interaction
readme_summary: Cozy local-first day planner combining visual pocket room, voice interface and time-aware planning. Vite + TypeScript frontend with local storage, nothing saves without consent. Built with Meta AI models for planning assistance.

summary: Plans verifiable ECU calibrations with deterministic physics checks
readme_summary: MetaECU Copilot reads Bosch EDC16C39 flash and plans calibrations from a 774-symbol catalogue. Python backend with desktop and web apps plus deterministic safety gate where physics rejects unsafe edits. Uses Meta Muse for planning with verifiable execution.

summary: Paste a URL to research, design, launch and guard Meta ads with human approval.
readme_summary: Keel automates SMB Meta advertising from brand research to creative generation, launch, and live monitoring. Full-stack app with Meta integrations. Runs every step on Meta models with human-in-the-loop approval and Advantage+ drift guarding.

summary: Reproducible GRPO loop that improves Muse Glimmer tool-calling from 0.63 to 0.725.
readme_summary: MARKOV is a GRPO training loop that fine-tunes Muse Glimmer 30B for better tool calling. Evaluated on BFCL v4 with McNemar significance and Hugging Face demo. Starter and eval scripts with Modal RTX PRO 6000 FP4 training.

summary: Overhead camera turns assembly lines into QA with SOP tracking
readme_summary: Turns an overhead camera into a QA station for assembly lines. Deterministic OpenCV/NumPy measures tool-part contacts per frame with FastAPI backend and web frontend. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark 1.3 for root-cause audit, Muse Image for fix diagrams.

summary: WhatsApp sales advisor that diagnoses crop issues and sells farm inputs.
readme_summary: Open Market lets farmers send text, voice or photos to get catalog-grounded product recommendations, datasheets and order calculation with human escalation. Chat and WhatsApp interface. Built with Meta Model API and Muse Wonder for retrieval and dialogue.

summary: Listens to phone calls live to warn of scam scripts before money is asked
readme_summary: Real-time on-call scam detector that tracks scammer script turn-by-turn for OTP and UPI fraud. FastAPI Python backend with streaming audio pipeline and family alerts. Reports measured results, architecture docs, and YouTube demo.

summary: Physics predictor that tracks throws with SAM 3.1 and forecasts landing from 0.25s of flight.
readme_summary: Python backend with web frontend. Uses SAM 3.1 to track ball and surface, freezes at 0.25s to predict arc and error in cm, then uses Muse Spark/Open and Muse Voice for spoken what-if physics replays like Moon gravity.

summary: Forwards suspicious emails to get phishing and invoice-fraud verdicts with evidence
readme_summary: Email fraud checker for small businesses that returns a verdict with evidence for phishing and impersonation. Web app with live demo workspace using synthetic files. Built on Meta models for email classification and explanation.

summary: Personal AI companion that sees your screen and follows you iPhone to Mac
readme_summary: Genita is an iPhone to Mac AI companion that sees what you see and personalizes from first hello. Stack spans iOS app plus server with deploy and docs. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Verifies financial code against locked Lean 4 specs with counterexamples and proofs
readme_summary: ProofForge states guarantees as Lean 4 requirements and checks fixes with six kernels. Muse Spark writes fixes via ProofForge MCP server with Muse Code harness. Every verdict is recorded in a reproducible Passport.

summary: Replays coding-agent sessions to explain diffs and quiz you before approval.
readme_summary: Reviews agent-written diffs to summarize what shipped, deviations, and risks. Requires comprehension check before approval to build trust. Built for hackathon Indie Build for Your World track.

summary: Local-first studio for building apps with inspectable, correctable project memory
readme_summary: Local-first studio for building small browser apps with persistent correctable memory. Records decisions, imports images, generates with Muse and stages changes for review. Includes Muse Forge game-studio workspace demo.

summary: MCP infrastructure layer to size, cap, secure and deploy agent-built apps
readme_summary: Infrastructure layer for apps built in coding agents via MCP server. Provides load estimation, spend/rate caps, GCP Cloud Run/GKE deploys, access control and typed semantic data layer. Includes AI gateway for model access in apps.

summary: Maps a research field and explains papers with linked symbols and live math.
readme_summary: Research Microscope maps related papers for a question, then deep-dives into the target paper with defined symbols, cited margin notes and live figures. Muse Wonder generates interactive explanations while pipelines handle paper retrieval and parsing. Includes evals, pipelines and 3-minute demo video.

summary: Voice-first browser that uses real websites in Nigerian languages.
readme_summary: Desktop agentic browser speaking Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, Pidgin and English. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 frontend and backend that searches, reads, fills forms and pauses for approval.

summary: Daily AI office-comedy comic where audience comments decide the next episode
readme_summary: Pipeline that produces daily comic episodes and two 9:16 clips for Facebook, Instagram, Threads and TikTok. Audience comments drive the next storyline for recurring characters. Uses Muse models for writing, image generation and quality checks.

summary: Local privacy gateway that masks entities before prompts reach Muse models.
readme_summary: Privacy entity engine that sits between user and Muse Spark to mask people, IDs, money and contacts. Fine-tuned Muse Glimmer 30B builds entity graph with coreference, Muse reasons over placeholders, restored locally.

summary: Parcel-hub tracker that follows lost parcels on CCTV and shows proof frames
readme_summary: Spoor fuses hub CCTV video with scan logs to trace a parcel scanner-to-scanner and pinpoint loss. Frontend plus backend plus ML pipeline uses SAM 3.1 for tracking with Muse Wonder, Spark and Glimmer for reasoning. Outputs evidence frame and tracking narrative.

summary: AI back office for trucking carriers handling advances, invoices, and payouts
readme_summary: AI operator for a trucking money desk that processes advances, invoices, settlements and payouts. Built with Next.js, Postgres and QuickBooks Online sandbox integration. Uses Meta models to check requests, explain exceptions and propose actions for human approval.

summary: Self-hosted assistant to optimize, translate, and caption YouTube channels
readme_summary: Self-hosted Python assistant that audits titles, descriptions, chapters, and translations for small channels. Uses 8 Meta models for optimization and captioning with local runs and human approval before publishing.

summary: Finds which ad elements drive purchases and sizes a controlled test to prove it.
readme_summary: Adsect decomposes Meta ads into visual, audio, text, and delivery elements linked to Shopify purchases. It generates single-element variants, verifies changes, and sizes controlled tests. Built on real spend data of $1.52M, 17,890 orders and 1,067 ads.

summary: Plans mood-based NYC walks and fair meeting points for two friends
readme_summary: Web app that turns wishes like quiet 25-minute walks into guided turn-by-turn routes in NYC. Finds fair meeting points by walking time and shared preferences. Uses Muse Glimmer, Spark and Image plus Voice with custom walking graph.

summary: AI ad agency that generates, simulates and evolves small-business ads for Meta.
readme_summary: Multi-agent system researches, writes and tests ads in a simulated feed beside competitors, then publishes within budget caps. Uses Muse Spark, Wonder, Image and SAM 3.1. Stack is Python 3.12, Next.js and Remotion video-as-code.

summary: Turns one product photo and sentence into a directed 3D ad video in minutes
readme_summary: MuseReels plans board, camera, light and set then pre-renders sheets for Muse to check against the photo. Supports CSV catalog batches with MP4 export or video-model finishing. Custom 3D engine with Next.js frontend built for Startups track.

summary: AI proposes engineering experiments while independent checkers verify results with replayable evidence.
readme_summary: VerifForge runs AI-guided engineering experiments with separate proposer and verifier stages and stored evidence for replay. It uses Docker Compose services with Alembic migrations and a planner workflow. It uses Meta muse-spark-1.3 for experiment guidance and verdicts.

summary: Verifies AI pull requests by reproducing bugs and sealing proof-of-fix receipts
readme_summary: Attest reproduces a reported bug, verifies the fix in the running app, and checks it rejects a wrong fix. It seals results into verifiable receipts re-checked on CI across OSes. Uses SAM 3.1 for UI grounding and Muse models in the verifier workflow.

summary: AI study companion that plans weeks, tutors without doing homework, checks learning
readme_summary: MuseLearn for secondary school plans study weeks, tutors with guardrails, and verifies understanding. Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Supabase Postgres with RLS. Uses Muse Spark for tutoring and Muse Voice for speech.

summary: AI back office for brokerages where every action links to client words
readme_summary: AI back office for real-estate brokerages with role-based rooms for owner, brokers and compliance. Built with Python backend and web UI deployed via Docker on Render. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Image for assistant and corrections.

summary: Organizes personal loan evidence and drafts Korean court filing text
readme_summary: ClaimBack-AI is a self-help tool that organizes user-provided evidence for unpaid personal loans and fills standard Korean court document text with user-confirmed facts. Backend and frontend with bilingual UI, built with Muse Spark 1.3 implementation and review workflow.

summary: Visual motorcycle customizer that turns photo edits into parts build sheets
readme_summary: DreamBike lets a custom shop preview modifications on the customer's own bike photo. Every accepted change updates a parts, labor and paperwork build sheet. It exports an English EUR estimate with before/after images and 19% VAT using Meta AI image editing.

summary: Inspects Python projects for security and business-logic flaws with evidence
readme_summary: ForgeGuard builds a read-only SourceGraph from Python code and investigates rules via agent. Backend validates findings locations and gates fixes behind human approval. Uses Meta Muse-powered agent with apply and rollback support.

summary: iPhone AR app that labels appliance controls and checks each step visually
readme_summary: Kokobubu points iPhone camera at appliances, reads labels, overlays AR markers and guides step-by-step with voice. Verifies completion via camera where visible. iOS app plus web prototype and scripts, using Meta AI vision and language models.

summary: Marketplace of video templates written for agents to execute
readme_summary: Template store where each pack holds timing, framing, storyboard and fill recipe. Web frontend with agent skill for rendering. Built with Muse Code; agents use image and video models to produce spots.

summary: Mixed-reality guide that verifies each physical assembly step
readme_summary: Step-by-step assembly assistant that checks camera images with Meta-hosted models in desktop browser and HoloLens 2 WebXR. Python 3.12 backend with Node 24 frontend. Built for local execution with CI, docs and demo assets.

summary: Indexes Spanish video with quote-grounded claims for archivist review
readme_summary: Indexes Spanish-language video into metadata claims linked to transcript quotes and time ranges. Runs independent automatic checks, defers unconfirmed claims for human review, and reports accuracy. Python app with review UI and tests.

summary: Utility outage agent locating grid faults and guiding safe crew restoration
readme_summary: Autonomous outage triage agent fusing complaints, crew reports and photos to locate faults and dispatch crews. Python + web stack; uses Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 for language and vision.

summary: Turns witness fireball videos into trajectory, speed and verdict
readme_summary: Agent orients phone/dashcam video against map landmarks then triangulates fireball trajectory with error bars and meteor vs reentry verdict. Python + web 3D viewer, validated on Chelyabinsk. Uses Muse Spark reasoning and SAM 3.1 vision.

summary: Turns souk stall photos into grounded listings tied to numbered boxes.
readme_summary: Souk Lens analyzes market stall photos into item listings bound to SAM 3.1 boxes drawn on the photo. Built with Next.js and Vercel with one-click demo pipeline. Uses SAM 3.1 for grounding and Muse Spark 1.3 for box-referenced descriptions.

summary: AI front desk that answers, quotes, and drafts bookings for service shops.
readme_summary: AIBOSSPRO builds a structured business brain from owner voice or text using Muse Spark. Customers chat via panel or WhatsApp with verified replies, code-computed prices, and owner-approved bookings. SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Wonder support marketing content creation.

summary: Fall-event verifier that confirms, escalates, or clears possible falls
readme_summary: Jaga is a research prototype fall verifier for home safety built for elderly parents. It reviews selected moments and routes them through a confirm-escalate-clear alert ladder. Performance is reported on public benchmark datasets only.

summary: Generates tested CIM-compliant Splunk add-ons from raw sample logs.
readme_summary: Agentic pipeline from raw logs to line-breaking, timestamping and CIM-mapped Splunk add-on verified by Splunk itself. Python engine with Docker Splunk lab and CI. Uses Meta Muse Spark agents to propose parsers and tests.

summary: Teacher debrief must pass Nine Gates before entering digital twin
readme_summary: Synthetic-only ENS slice turns post-class debriefs into quoted observations and contestable learner claims. Firebase hosting with fixtures, code checks and teacher approval. Uses Meta AI models under Gate 9 policy for extraction.

summary: Policy gateway that screens AI actions and packages at the edge
readme_summary: EdgeGate enforces policies and evaluates package/action risk before execution, with reproducible results and tests. Python 3.12 codebase with policies, scripts and CI. Uses Meta AI models with hardening for secure agent ops.

summary: Inline security gateway that enforces policy on MCP agent tool calls
readme_summary: Veylith is a TypeScript control plane and inline gateway for Model Context Protocol agents. It intercepts tool calls for policy enforcement and sandboxing, powered by Meta Muse muse-spark-1.3 for risk analysis.

summary: Converts old 2D machine drawings into editable 3D CAD and holograms
readme_summary: Workbench reconstructs interactive 3D CAD assemblies from patent figures and sketches. Uses Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe, Image and SAM 3.1 with wave-optics simulation for holographic displays.

summary: Phone camera diagnoses PCs when monitoring agent goes offline
readme_summary: Helpdesk tool where phone films PC lights and screens for offline diagnosis. Interprets blink codes like memory failure for technicians. Integrates with existing helpdesk workflows and migrations.

summary: Phone-scan home inventory that tracks items, votes and chores for Muse context.
readme_summary: Spaces turns 8 phone photos into a room inventory with keep/sell voting and chore tracking. Web + server app shares Spaces as context for Muse in Meta AI app. Uses muse-spark-1.3 and sam-3.1 for detection and listing drafts.

summary: Self-healing infrastructure agent that investigates and fixes incidents
readme_summary: Autonomous infrastructure guardian detects, investigates and remediates failures. Docker Compose Python service with tests and docs. Built for hackathon using Meta models with self-heal demo endpoint.

summary: Simulator studying unsafe instruction spread between agents and defenses
readme_summary: Pre-sprint preparation for Apart swarm alignment hackathon Nov 6-8. Small simulator and test plan for bad-instruction propagation. Status states no event-period results yet, cloned from sellerpilot-ai.

summary: Local AI video studio that isolates subjects and renders cinematic edits from text
readme_summary: AI video and animation studio that runs locally. Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript + FFmpeg pipeline finds and tracks subjects frame-by-frame. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Image and SAM 3.1 for edit planning, generation and segmentation to output verified MP4.

summary: Glasses app tells you if you will like a wine before you buy it
readme_summary: YourWine is an Android companion for smart glasses plus web demo that predicts personal wine taste. API backend with taste profile matching and voice output. Built with Muse Code, Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Shows how each garment size fits your body shape on a proportional mannequin with reasons.
readme_summary: Compares brand size charts against Meta MHR body presets or user measurements region by region. Next.js app renders faceless proportional mannequin and Nisha sizing assistant explains fit in plain words.

summary: Multimodal disaster triage with verified emergency dispatch workflow.
readme_summary: Autonomous triage agent combining spatial segmentation, radio transcription and multimodal assessment with deterministic Python verifier. FastAPI backend plus Next.js frontend for infrastructure damage and dispatch. Integrates sam-3.1, Muse voice, Spark, Wonder and Image.

summary: Generates 12 tailoring measurements and cutting sheets from two phone photos
readme_summary: TailorFit lets customers submit front and side photos plus height to produce a 12-measurement sheet with confidence, sizes, yardage and cutting sheet. Built as monorepo apps and services, it uses SAM 3.1 for body segmentation, Muse Spark and Muse Image.

summary: Turns phone acting clips into game-ready animated Unity characters.
readme_summary: ActSprite converts a phone performance clip into 8-12 frame sprites and a ZIP via Unity importer in 4-6 minutes. Pipeline uses Meta APIs for tracking and generation with web app and evaluation harness.

summary: Self-healing LLM serving agent that detects and fixes GPU incidents
readme_summary: ServeDoctor watches vLLM every 30s with local Muse Glimmer, escalating to Spark/Wonder to diagnose and apply whitelisted fixes. Includes ServeIncidents benchmark with sealed answers and replay site. Built Oct 29-Nov 3 2026 for Push the Frontier.

summary: Turns a website URL into creator briefs, fit scores, and verified draft video checks
readme_summary: Plugs into live OOCM creator-marketing platform. Builder generates campaigns from website paste, Muse scores creator fit and verifies draft reels against brief with proof. Stack uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Image with production web app.

summary: Offline Android app giving hazard-aware evacuation directions in under a second
readme_summary: SafeRoute provides offline hazard-aware evacuation guidance for Android with no network. Routes depend on hazard type, e.g. earthquake to open space, flood away from underground. Built for Meta hackathon Build for Your World.

summary: Memory agent that preserves dealership customer relationships across staff
readme_summary: Relationship-memory agent for car dealerships keeps customer history when salespeople leave. Built on Muse Spark 1.3 with Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image. Includes 172 tests, ruff, gitleaks and CI with live demo.

summary: Privacy-preserving camera check-in detecting falls at home
readme_summary: Elder-care fall detection using ordinary camera without continuous cloud video or wearables. SAM converts clips to 32x18 silhouette grids for Muse Spark to classify motion as text, with edge plus backend pipeline, demo, and evals to explain every alert.

summary: Turns bank CSVs and Gmail into 3-bucket household plan with shock tests
readme_summary: Bucketwise parses transactions into Emergency, College and Life Event buckets with crisis testing. Built with Next.js app router and CSV/Gmail ingestion. Uses Meta AI models to find leaks and recommend actions.

summary: Verifiable AI video editor that proposes story cuts with receipts for each render
readme_summary: Watches clips to propose edit plans, tracks subjects, transcribes captions and renders via local FFmpeg. Uses Muse Spark for story, SAM 3.1 for subject tracking, Meta Voice Transcribe for captions, Muse Image and Muse Wonder for review. Studio UI with correctable plan and delivery probes.

summary: Group-chat assistant that tracks decisions, debts and next steps multilingually.
readme_summary: Sorted joins group chats in Hindi, Telugu and English to extract decisions, balances and tasks with code-computed numbers. Vite + Node server on Render with example groups. Powered by Meta AI for multilingual chat understanding.

summary: Turns shop product videos into playable 20-second mini-game ads
readme_summary: Reel2Play converts Reels into tested playable ads with win codes, gameplay Reel, and posters. Muse Spark Open directs game generation, Muse Glimmer play-tests, and SAM 3.1 segments products. Stack is Python API, game engine, and eval harness.

summary: Turns multilingual disaster reports into structured responder intelligence.
readme_summary: MIDUSAFE Sentinel structures fragmented text and voice reports in English, Swahili, and Sheng into traceable incidents. Muse Spark extracts validated Pydantic schemas for severity, duplicates, and follow-ups. Includes real-time dashboard for human responders.

summary: Voice-first crop-care agent helping farmers diagnose leaf problems over time
readme_summary: Helps smallholder farmers photograph symptoms, answer follow-ups by voice, and track changes. Uses Meta Muse for agronomy reasoning and SAM for visual crop analysis with React 19 client and Node server plus MongoDB Atlas. Supports multilingual voice guidance for Bangladesh context.

summary: Turns real dish clips into listing photos only if faithful to the plate
readme_summary: Films the actual served plate then generates listing-quality image with faithfulness report and audit rounds. Rejects non-matching outputs, stores source hash for trust. Built for indie restaurants for Swiggy, WhatsApp and Instagram.

summary: Simulates industrial motor failures to predict, diagnose and prevent breakdowns.
readme_summary: Foresight AI is simulation-only Python platform with Observe to Monitor loop for motor digital twin. Uses ODE twin, Isolation Forest and XGBoost with bounded agent tools. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 or Muse Spark Open, else deterministic planner.

summary: Deterministic gate that scores agent actions and enforces release, wrap, hold, or escalate.
readme_summary: Declares each action as Type, Trace, Amount, Reversibility and scores it with fixed arithmetic. A separate Python sidecar enforces decisions with one-use permits and a reconciled ledger. Built as deterministic guardrail for AI tool execution.

summary: Paired-world simulator for testing macro and micro policy decisions.
readme_summary: WhatIf runs reproducible simulations with synthetic households, modular models and calibration evidence. Monorepo apps + datasets with CI. Uses Muse Spark Open via Baseten for runtime reasoning and scenario explanation.

summary: Overnight store ops agent that finds broken orders, fixes them, and flags payments.
readme_summary: Small-store operations agent classifying orders, tracking scans, and messages as broken or normal. Tool loop holds, corrects addresses, moves stock, or cancels via Muse Spark 1.3, Glimmer 30B optional. Built with FastAPI and web UI deployed on Cloud Run.

summary: Agent OS with Rust kernel and always-on monitoring platform
readme_summary: Three-part system: Rust kernel booting in QEMU, agent platform with model calls and budget guardrails, and Xubuntu remaster carrier. Built by person plus agent crew with committed boot logs and demo video.

summary: AI bookkeeping and MTD VAT for UK small firms from OneDrive files
readme_summary: Accnomos does receipt-to-VAT bookkeeping where books stay as files in user OneDrive. Python services + web app with code-calculated VAT and HMRC sandbox. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 with Glimmer 30B fallback to read receipts.

summary: Software advisor that installs and tests tools in sandbox before recommending
readme_summary: Tests software in sandbox and returns verified install steps via web app and MCP for agents. Built with Muse Spark models for evaluation and recommendation. Python stack with pickfit.app, evals and replayable results.

summary: Desktop app where a team of agents plans tasks and an auditor verifies results
readme_summary: Desktop app that takes plain-language tasks and returns checked results with evidence from model agent team. Includes planner, checkers, and fresh auditor with local run records. Connect your own model in Settings.

summary: Workbench turning plain-language intent into checks for robot runs
readme_summary: Mollet is a browser workbench for recorded robot runs that converts intent into reviewable behavior conditions joined with traces and video. It preserves evidence for verdicts with replay and export. Uses Muse Spark and SAM adapters on top of RL Triage Agent, with saved-response replay.

summary: Camera-assisted field repair guidance with verifiable FieldProof receipts.
readme_summary: Guides technicians with step plans, voice questions and cited references via browser and Android clients. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 for assistance; deterministic policy makes verification decisions.

summary: Checks intersection safety proposals against city crash records before funding
readme_summary: NearMissLens evaluates one street-safety proposal against crash history in about minutes. Python backend with web copilot produces tasks, evidence and saved results for planners. Uses Meta models for analysis with deterministic code checks and full evidence log.

summary: Verifies image authenticity with gated pipeline, receipts, and try-on demo
readme_summary: ProofShot is a verification pipeline with upload, gate checks, receipt chain, and verify page. It includes judge, shop, and virtual try-on pages deployed on Hugging Face Spaces. It uses Meta AI models to detect synthetic images and audit claims.

summary: Prompt-driven Windows video editor that plans edits and renders locally with timeline
readme_summary: Windows AI video editor that turns prompts into an editable timeline. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 to plan and critique edits from transcript and footage, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, plus local Whisper and FFmpeg for transcription and rendering.

summary: Local-first shield against scams and impersonation on-device.
readme_summary: SOVIR is local-first protection with consented sensors and council of voters for explainable decisions. Raw text and pixels never leave device. Rust backend with apps and website, auditable revocable actions.

summary: Scans Ethereum token bytecode to surface owner risks before swapping.
readme_summary: Brandklipparen is a deterministic ERC-20 risk scanner that lists owner powers like mint, pause and blacklist from bytecode. It includes its own EVM decompiler, proof traces, web app, REST API and MCP server. It uses Meta Muse models to explain findings in plain language.

summary: Builds and backtests trading strategies on market data with simulation.
readme_summary: BacktestAI is a quantitative strategy engineering platform with backtesting, market simulation, and live trading support via MT5. Architecture is Python backend with Alembic, JS frontend in apps/packages, and benchmarks. It is powered by Meta Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder via Meta Model API and FastMCP.

summary: Multi-tier IT service desk agents acting over WhatsApp and email
readme_summary: Four L1-L4 agents fix IT issues via tool calls to Microsoft 365, Azure VM and VPN plus proactive monitoring. Uses Meta Model API with FastAPI app, agent framework and tests for approvals and identity checks.

summary: Agent that diagnoses and patches faulty RISC-V RTL until simulations pass
readme_summary: Afterglow is a Muse Spark agent for RISC-V debug: red sim in, green sim out with no hand RTL edits. Pipeline runs collect, diagnose, explain, patch, resim and verify with waveform + text. Locked 3/3 and full 8/8 evals plus 72-fault board.

summary: Webcam blister-strip inspector driven by spoken QA rules and vision models.
readme_summary: Blistrue inspects tablet blister pockets via webcam, using SAM 3.1 for segmentation and frozen DINOv2 for scoring. Muse Voice and Spark 1.3 convert spoken rules to versioned checklists. Flask app signals machine and logs batch.

summary: Turns plain-language prompts into simulated physics worlds with live browser playback.
readme_summary: Agent team picks simulator, builds world, validates physics against references and runs live in browser. For students and non-experts to test robotics ideas without simulator expertise. Dockerized Python server with MuJoCo.

summary: Judges video against rule packs to rule who violated what with evidence
readme_summary: Rules-compliance judge for forklift OSHA and sim-racing footage. Python 3.12 pipeline with 8 rules packs and 37 experiments. Uses Muse models to perceive and describe, scripts to measure and decide.

summary: Film a broken part on a mat to get a measured printable STL
readme_summary: SnapPart turns video of a part on a printed mat into measured STL and honest report. Pipeline does photogrammetry, measurement, and print validation with Python backend and frontend. Uses Meta models for vision and reporting.

summary: Shared verified memory that gives web agents task-specific hints via MCP
readme_summary: Centralized hint store for web workflows retrieved via MCP remote/stdio or CLI. Agents use existing browser tools with curated hints. Rust service with gatekeeper curation by Muse Spark 1.3.

summary: Generates Mac desktop automation scripts from voice requests and repairs them on UI change.
readme_summary: Builds Python programs that drive Mac apps via screenshots and auto-repairs code when UI changes. Stack is Python engine with browser extension and app frontend. Uses Muse Wonder for code generation, Muse Spark for verification, SAM 3.1 for grounding and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Photo-based city issue reporter with AI verification of repairs
readme_summary: PWA where citizens report potholes and hazards by photo, verified by SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark with neighbor confirmation. Built on Supabase Postgres PostGIS, Storage and Auth, piloted in Ambato.

summary: Converts failure videos to code fixes with live browser verification and signing
readme_summary: Rust zero-shot video-to-code repair harness with two-gate Playwright CDP verification. Enforces isolated repo changes and Ed25519 Merkle proofs. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder 1.0 and SAM 3.1.

summary: Phone camera assistant that watches assembly steps and catches wrong placements
readme_summary: StepSight uses live camera to highlight correct parts and flag misplaced bricks during manual assembly. Combines SAM 3.1 vision, Muse Spark reasoning, Muse Image and Voice Transcribe. Web app with EN/ES support and live demo.

summary: On-device benchmark system recommending optimal local LLM configs per phone
readme_summary: Hardware-aware Android system that recommends local LLM configs, validates against real on-device benchmarks, and improves via verified results DB. Uses Meta Muse Spark for recommendations. Includes APK, cloud sync, and eval tooling.

summary: Marketplace where AI agents hire field workers to collect verified evidence
readme_summary: Clients or their AI agents post field jobs and field pros complete guided mobile checklists with location and maps. Muse Spark reads labels from submitted evidence while human review makes final decisions. Produces checkable evidence reports.

summary: Personal save-and-resurface memory that brings links and notes back on time
readme_summary: Homing stores links, flyers, voice notes and videos, verifies them against the source and resurfaces them when relevant. It uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and Muse Voice Transcribe via server/app/llm/gateway.py. Stack is server plus web app with Docker Compose deployment.

summary: Camera-based home rehab companion for PT, OT and SLP with therapist approval.
readme_summary: Aruga is a clinician-directed home-program companion turning prescriptions into tracked performance. Built with Next.js 16, React 19 and TypeScript, five agents handle activity, biomechanics, goals and guidance. Camera motion tracking provides feedback with therapist always approving.

summary: Evaluates robot code patches in simulation and certifies fixes without regressions
readme_summary: Deterministic MuJoCo referee tests controllers on hidden cases, then Muse Spark rewrites failures and re-tests. Issues Verified and Certified verdicts. Python harness with controllers, experiments and recorded runs.

summary: Reconstructs evidence-backed recipe drafts from bakery production videos
readme_summary: Analyzes real production video with scale readings, speech, and timestamps to draft structured recipes for human review. Python backend with frontend and specs/tests pipeline. Uses multimodal Meta AI to fuse visual observations and spoken instructions into inspectable documentation.

summary: Autonomous agent that repairs breaking API changes and proves fixes in sandbox.
readme_summary: DriftZero diffs OpenAPI v1 to v2, repairs code in isolated git worktree with Muse Code, and validates in Modal sandbox on hold-out tests. Opens PR with evidence, rejecting test-editing cheats.

summary: Voice-first Android assistant for bills, documents, and daily routines
readme_summary: Native Kotlin + Jetpack Compose app with Python FastAPI backend reads bills, summarizes documents, and speaks daily briefing. All AI via backend to Meta Model API only. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and Muse Voice Transcribe for listening, with platform TTS.

summary: Photos of your room restyled in place with real shoppable furniture and decor
readme_summary: Snap 1-3 room photos, SAM 3.1 segments 24 object types into layout masks, and Meta models restyle the photo while preserving layout. Every rendered item links to a real product with price. Stack is Meta Model API with Fly.io API and Vercel web app.

summary: x402 API letting AI agents pay for inventory with Solana devnet USDC
readme_summary: API implements x402 HTTP 402 payment flow for one inventory request. Verified one 0.01 test USDC payment on Solana devnet via explorer, with client-side budget cap and signer callback. Node.js service with sample data, not production payments.

summary: Muse Spark pushes objects after imagining moves in V-JEPA 2 world model
readme_summary: Agent pushes objects in PushT, 3D tabletop and billiards using one frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder plus predictor and translator. Calls simulate tool to imagine push sequences in latent space before acting. Entry Oct 27-Nov 4 2026 with live episodes site.

summary: Turns messy seller photos into ready-to-sell Meta Commerce catalog
readme_summary: Katalog Kilat converts multi-product chat photos into catalog feed CSV, studio photos, captions and product pages. Mobile web app with Docker stack. Uses muse-spark-1.3, SAM 3.1 and muse-image-1.0.

summary: Converts Indian pharmacogenomic PDFs and photos into de-identified research data
readme_summary: Reads lab PDFs, WhatsApp photos and dictation into verified de-identified records and cohort frequencies. Uses Meta Muse models for extraction, aggregation pipeline, research-only tool.

summary: Builds cited adaptive courses from your lectures, slides and papers
readme_summary: Turns student materials into a course where every sentence links to source page or lecture timestamp. Supports editing via natural language prompts. Uses Meta AI models for generation with source highlighting.

summary: Forecasts medicine stock-outs at health centres and suggests nearby redistribution moves.
readme_summary: PHC Pulse lets Punjab PHC staff report stock via register photo, voice note, or shelf photo. System forecasts shortages and proposes officer-approved transfers. Uses Meta AI for OCR counting, demand forecasting, and multilingual input.

summary: Turns plain-word family meal plans into sized grocery lists sent to Instacart
readme_summary: Plans weekly meals for actual household members with approval by email. Built with Next.js, Docker and Instacart integration. Uses Muse Spark to interpret meals while tested code calculates quantities.

summary: Local malware-analysis agent isolated from prompt injection in samples
readme_summary: Analyzes binaries in an isolated sandbox where decider never ingests raw text. Python agent with tool airlock. Uses Meta open-weight models for steering analysis while resisting fake prompts and tool output.

summary: Meeting copilot that checks live talk against your notes and flags contradictions.
readme_summary: Desktop overlay plus panel that collects PDFs, Drive and Notion notes per project, then listens to meeting audio and screen. Built with Python and desktop overlay UI. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and Muse Voice Transcription for live speech.

summary: Group chats performed by personal clay figures in their own voices.
readme_summary: Scene turns group chat into a 3D table stage with user-created figures and voice clones. Next.js app with figure pipeline and Spark director. Uses Muse Image, SAM 3.1, SAM 3D, Voice Transcribe.

summary: Converts paper labs and voice notes into verified FHIR bundles privately.
readme_summary: MedEdge AI ingests lab reports, prescriptions and dictated notes into HL7 FHIR R4 with anonymization and human approval. Full-stack Docker app. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark and Muse Voice.

summary: Pre-filter that blacks out names, IDs and faces in images before AI upload
readme_summary: Detects names, addresses, account numbers, ID numbers and faces in pictures and blacks them out, failing closed to full blackout. Pipeline uses CPU Tesseract OCR plus classifiers. Startup track demo on Modal with docs and samples.

summary: WhatsApp buyer agent that verifies used cars on video before haggling
readme_summary: Lives in WhatsApp: seller films proof video, Muse Spark checks car identity and dashboard, VIN checked via NHTSA, then negotiates with buyer approval. Built for Meta hackathon Indie Build for Your World track.

summary: Compresses fine-tune weight diffs to tiny swappable patch files for live use.
readme_summary: Stores fine-tune deltas as 1-bit signs with scales to shrink patches from 1GB to ~19MB. Python tooling with examples, fixtures, and tests. Demonstrates live hot-swap of behavior patches on Qwen2.5-0.5B without compressing the base model.

summary: Version-aware legal verification engine tracing conclusions to changed law provisions.
readme_summary: ClauseTrace maps findings to source versions of India's DPDP Act and Rules on a fictional agreement. Dependency graph re-checks only affected conclusions when law changes. Demo with backend, vercel frontend and video, not legal advice.

summary: Turns vague bug reports into reviewed test-backed fixes via CLI
readme_summary: Reprofy is a Python CLI that classifies bug reports, writes regression tests, and proposes diffs. Pytest validates in disposable copies with explicit approval. Uses models for triage and fix generation.

summary: Tests if board minutes prove physical-presence substance from meeting evidence.
readme_summary: Checks jurisdiction physical-presence rules against minutes, tickets, bills and recordings. Muse models read evidence, deterministic code applies published rule, each finding cites page/second. Synthetic SPECIMEN demo data only.

summary: Fine-tunes Muse Glimmer with RL to plan for home robots
readme_summary: Makes Muse Glimmer 30B the planner for Spot robot and human in PARTNR Habitat 3.0 tasks. Improves via RL in simulation on task success only. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B open weights with LoRA adapter.

summary: On-device session layer that summarizes Instagram visits by intent and outcome
readme_summary: IntentLoop adds intent setting and visit summaries to a faithful mock Instagram feed with daily limits. Next.js app with local activity storage and drift tracking. Uses Meta AI models to classify intent completion without lecturing on launch.

summary: University carpooling features for students in Chia, Colombia
readme_summary: Hackathon-only extract that plugs into the ConVia carpooling app for university staff and students. Documents daily log and PR-tested changes. Uses Meta models for matching, safety, and evaluation harnesses with Supabase backend.

summary: WhatsApp guest concierge and expense agent for small Moroccan riads
readme_summary: Runs WhatsApp front desk in any language plus expense back-office with manager inbox for 5-10 room riads. Node.js src with importer, docs and evals integrating with closed-source DarFlow. Uses Muse models plus SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe for receipts.

summary: AI co-engineer that investigates mobile network incidents
readme_summary: AI co-engineer for mobile networks that fuses KPI, alarm and config evidence into incident records. Python backend with frontend and verified investigation docs. Built on Meta Muse models operating on simulated network data.

summary: Voice-first lab companion that identifies kit vials and walks through protocols with timers.
readme_summary: Finds vendor manual, structures protocol, recognizes bottles from photo/video and guides run with volumes and timers. TypeScript Vite frontend with Node server. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice and Muse Image.

summary: Compares new site photos against a baseline photo to flag differences
readme_summary: TrueScene stores one reference photo per place then compares new photos or video frames to generate reviewable findings. Node 22 + TypeScript server and web client deployed on Fly.io. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark and Muse Wonder for analysis.

summary: Video calls that translate family speech in each speaker's own voice
readme_summary: Real-time bilingual video calls where Telugu and English are translated while preserving speaker voice. Web app with Modal deployment for mobile Safari and Chrome, built for family calls.

summary: Sourced searchable catalog of machine-vision cameras, lenses and software
readme_summary: Machine Vision Radar unifies 950 products from 433 vendors into a typed, sourced catalog with search, compare, news and task solving. Includes CLI, app and MCP server with human-approved research agents. Uses Meta Muse models for research and Ask.

summary: Local proxy that prunes agent context to cut tokens and VRAM use
readme_summary: ContextGC is a local-first FastAPI middleware proxy for CrewAI/AutoGen/LangChain that deduplicates and prunes shared context while preserving prefix cache. Includes telemetry dashboard and 117 tests. Works with local Llama runtime to keep long runs in fixed window.

summary: Autonomous crop-health monitor for Mars greenhouses that detects wilt and alerts offline
readme_summary: CERES is mission control for off-Earth farming that measures plants, raises evidence-backed alerts, and works without Earth link. Built for the Meta hackathon, it uses Meta models for detection and explanation with human-verified decisions and offline-first architecture.

summary: Clip-on wearable that sees, remembers, and notifies only when it matters
readme_summary: Clip-on camera and mic feed local YOLO11n vision and Whisper transcription into a Context Engine. Stores events in per-user FalkorDB graph with nightly Dreamer consolidation for beliefs. Backend monorepo with Active Agent, Ask API, and frontend for memory aid.

summary: Collaborative editor that bisects regressions and verifies Muse-proposed fixes.
readme_summary: PeerCodeAI is a real-time Yjs collaborative editor with checkpoint time-travel debugging. It bisects failing tests to find regressions. Uses Meta Muse Spark to explain root cause and propose patches verified on a copy before apply.

summary: Learns unwritten work rules and distills them into a local Muse Glimmer model.
readme_summary: workalike observes how users work, asks only ambiguous cases, then trains the patterns into an open Muse Glimmer model for local GPU inference. Includes testbed, baselines and experiments. Uses fine-tuned Muse Glimmer for private on-device execution.

summary: French-language AI assistant that takes real restaurant orders via link or QR.
readme_summary: Oren lets small businesses in Togo launch an assistant from a menu photo and voice note into a verified catalog. Next.js + Supabase app with owner dashboard and customer chat ordering with explicit confirmation. Uses Meta AI for French chat, multimodal catalog extraction and order composition.

summary: Rebuilds photographed objects in 3D at real size placed on real map
readme_summary: Takes phone photos with GPS/compass/lens metadata and infers object type, size, floors and roof, then checks against geometry before placing 3D model on map. Python src/adapters with Open-Planet integration. Uses Meta vision models for measurement Q&A.

summary: Turns GitHub repos into live EDM sets with voice control and gig search.
readme_summary: Maps repo stats to live EDM mix with light show, repo-vs-repo or code-vs-song battles. Voice commands via Muse Voice Transcribe, tempo/key listening. Uses Muse Spark with search grounding for gig discovery.

summary: Turns Polish parcel ID into NDVI maps, SAM masks, and field walk advice
readme_summary: Local-first demo turning parcel boundary into dated cloud-masked Sentinel-2 NDVI/NDRE, orthophoto with SAM 3.1 masks, and fact-checked field note. Uses local Muse Glimmer 30B or Muse Spark 1.3 API.

summary: Five AI agents that close books, prove numbers and catch fraud
readme_summary: AI finance team for fictional UAE SME Falcon Trading LLC. Five agents handle month-close, reconciliation, fraud detection and cash findings. Powered by muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API with replayable demo run.

summary: Compares two AI answers about long videos and picks the one backed by footage.
readme_summary: Portia runs three Muse Glimmer agents to search ~100 hours of video via transcripts and frame zoom. Muse Spark 1.3 verifies evidence and returns the better answer with timestamps and confidence. Static gallery in product/site, live app at portia.shayekh.tech.

summary: Verifies suspicious texts, screenshots and voice notes for fraud in Mexico
readme_summary: Nelli takes text, image, voice note or link and returns Spanish verdict card with 5-point evidence and safety actions. Designed for older adults, independent frontend. Built with Meta Model API with rules-based decisions.

summary: Turns citizen flood photos in Manila into a live depth map with MMDA levels
readme_summary: Turns photos into flood-depth pins on a Metro Manila map with evidence overlaid or honest can't-tell. Ask Lusot answers English/Taglish voice or text via Muse Spark tool calls. Web app on Amplify plus Android app, evaluated on sealed MMDA-labelled set.

summary: Local device fabric turning TVs, phones and sensors into one permission-aware AI system.
readme_summary: Multi-transport discovery fabric using mDNS, SSDP, ADB and BLE relays with transactional undo. Permission-aware orchestration across disconnected hardware. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B locally and Meta MMS-TTS for narration.

summary: Small-business copilot for Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp replies, posts and ads.
readme_summary: Creator/business inbox unifying Messenger, Instagram DMs/comments and WhatsApp with live updates. Drafts replies, lead finder, Reel director and ad watcher with human approval. Uses Muse Spark Open and Muse Wonder plus Meta APIs.

summary: Local desktop studio that cuts long recordings into captioned clips offline
readme_summary: Local Clip Studio edits recordings into short clips on one PC. Stack is Python, FFmpeg with libass, onnxruntime hearing model and llama.cpp. Uses local models via API for transcription and editing, no cloud GPU needed.

summary: Turns a yearly goal into a Muse-coached plan with quests and community.
readme_summary: Misogi takes one hard goal like holding Mandarin conversation and uses Muse Spark to draft metrics, milestones and weekly quests. Your Muse acts as coach while Muse Wonder builds personal pages, with shared climbs and templates. Built as Next.js web app with live demo at getmisogi.com.

summary: Turns one room video into editable 3D Gaussian Splatting scene
readme_summary: Pipeline converts walkthrough video into object-separated 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes editable via browser drag or agent. Runs end-to-end on eight Meta models, demonstrated on two Blender rooms with open code and benchmarks.

summary: Arabic-first localizer turning images into editable translated RTL layers
readme_summary: Uploads comics, posters or menus, segments text, translates to Arabic, inpaints originals and re-typesets RTL in matching style. Includes layer editor with SVG/PNG export and replay mode. Uses vision segmentation plus translation models.

summary: Hebrew reading station that grades child speech letter by letter for teachers
readme_summary: Kriah Listener listens to a child read Hebrew with nekudos and marks each letter. Phone station for kids and teacher dashboard groups students and prints packets. Uses speech recognition with rulebook grader and Muse coaching.

summary: $50 robot car that detects body changes and learns new dynamics by self-experiment
readme_summary: AIRO is an adaptive controller for a low-cost robot car that detects body changes and runs experiments to learn a new model. Stack is Python 3.13 with a MuJoCo digital twin, onboard learning loop, and web docs site. Fleet sharing distributes validated body models across cars.

summary: Disguised notebook app linking extortion evidence across cases in Peru
readme_summary: Collects WhatsApp audio, photos and messages in a disguised business notebook. Transcribes and links cases by voice, account, image and script for human review. Uses Meta AI models for transcription and matching with district-level maps.

summary: Disguised notebook app that links extortion evidence across cases without exposing victims.
readme_summary: Blindaje lets users store WhatsApp voice notes, photos and messages in an app disguised as a business notebook. It transcribes evidence into comparable signals to link cases from the same network for human review. District-level maps are public while victim identity stays private.

summary: Drone payload builds GPS-anchored 3D semantic map for rescue teams
readme_summary: SurMap is a civilian disaster-response payload carried over affected areas. It builds GPS-anchored 3D semantic maps from stereo video for search-and-rescue teams. Python 3.11 stack with strict typing, Ruff, pytest CI, and deployment tooling.

summary: Verifies creator videos delivered promised brand screen time per contract
readme_summary: Screen-Time tracks products frame-by-frame, rejects look-alikes and checks audio and terms. Next.js on Vercel built with Claude Code during hackathon. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe via Meta Model API.

summary: Detects if a photo is real, AI-generated or AI-edited with evidence maps
readme_summary: Checks one photo with calibrated thresholds, face boxes, contribution maps and face-swap detection. Uses DINOv3 and Perception Encoder, SAM 3.1 for outlining edits, and Muse Spark to describe likely changes.

summary: Diary notebook where Scout, Wren and Atlas agents read, write and organize
readme_summary: Agent notebook on Meta Muse Wonder where three agents research, draft and organize pages. Live map UI shows footprints and wet-ink edits, plus rearrangement for queries with widgets and pen selection.

summary: Describe a CFD case in words and an agent builds, runs, and explains it
readme_summary: Agentic frontend for computational fluid dynamics where a Physics Agent builds OpenFOAM-like cases live. Web app with interactive pressure/velocity fields and explanations for airfoils and wakes. Uses Meta Muse models to plan simulations and narrate physics results.

summary: Out-of-process recorder verifying what coding agents actually did
readme_summary: Captures file writes, network and processes outside agent sandbox to compare against self-reports. Includes Python recorder, static console, Muse plugin and recorded bundles. Built during hackathon for agent verification.

summary: Autonomous agent rebuilding legacy PH government sites into accessible experiences.
readme_summary: Paste a legacy URL; it crawls pages, understands content and rebuilds on BetterGov Kapwa design system with migration report. Cloudflare plus open-source design system stack. Uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API and Muse Image.

summary: Shows what an AI understands about your repo before it edits code
readme_summary: Read-only repo verification tool for public repos with no account required. Analyzes codebase to surface AI understanding before agentic edits. Built with Astro frontend, runs on Modal using Muse Spark Open.

summary: Cuts basketball games to vertical clips with phone approval to post
readme_summary: Picks highlights and tracks ball to cut vertical clips with ffmpeg for Instagram/Facebook, posting only after phone approval. Python service with meta-relay and tests. Uses Muse Voice, Muse Spark and SAM 3.1.

summary: Verifies Nigerian seller receipts against bank evidence in Yoruba and Pidgin
readme_summary: Payment safety layer for Instagram/WhatsApp sellers that checks transfer screenshots. Uses deterministic rules for verdicts, Muse models for chat, with 20-case benchmark and sandbox demo.

summary: Browser voice companion that speaks answers and checks sources before responding
readme_summary: PWA companion with no account that answers out loud and cites sources to avoid guessing. Calls Muse Wonder and five other Meta models directly via Meta API with user key.

summary: Platform that turns ideas into shipped products using teams of AI agents
readme_summary: WeStride.org uses Muse advisors for cited research, planning, and Muse Code sandboxes to open PRs and maintain products. Turborepo with apps and packages runs on Meta Model API using member or supporter keys.

summary: Pet AI twin built only from photo Memory Prints that cites sources
readme_summary: Cocoverse builds a pet AI twin from user photo Memory Print cards that answers in pet voice with citations. Stack is Next.js, Supabase, and Modal backend at cocoverse.app. Uses Muse models for chat and Muse Image for demo pet photos.

summary: Accounts-payable agent that matches bills to delivered goods before paying.
readme_summary: Relayloom reads bills, checks delivery photos, investigates gaps, and pays only verified amounts. It runs on Meta open-weight models inside company network with demo storefront. Demo reports 17 of 17 bad bills caught with goods verification.

summary: Walkthrough video auditor that links each finding to frames and masks.
readme_summary: AuditLens takes phone walkthrough videos or photos and a safety checklist to produce an evidence report. Backend uses Meta models with bounding boxes, measurements and confidence scores. Mock mode runs without keys; live mode uses Meta API with human review.

summary: Verifies hand-drawn circuit answers with simulation and independent review
readme_summary: Photograph a hand circuit and ask by text or voice. Muse Spark grounds claims in ngspice simulation, Muse Wonder blind re-reads drawing to review every claim, looping for correction instead of guessing.

summary: Pauses coding agents at hard decisions so you choose and record the why
readme_summary: Decision guard for AI-built projects that surfaces reversible choices before code. Built on Bento MADR canvas, works with Muse Code agent and optional Muse Spark critic. Static demo site with browser-run samples.

summary: Stress-tests tool-using agents to find cases where they hit metrics but break policy rules
readme_summary: GoalFault puts a Muse Spark 1.3 support agent in a simulated support system and runs difficult requests against it. It checks executed tool calls against written policies to prove rule-breaking metric gaming and test guards.

summary: WebXR Japanese tutor with a red panda in Quest passthrough.
readme_summary: WebXR app for Meta Quest with no install, featuring passthrough companion and cardboard objects. AI game master adapts lessons, scenes and progress tracking. Uses Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe and Video gen at runtime.

summary: Helps merchants verify AI-agent orders match shopper intent to cut disputes.
readme_summary: Demo store reads products from Supabase, shopper agent chats, and merchant tools screen agent orders. Next.js storefront with verification flow and dispute playbook. Uses Muse models for agent shopping and intent-vs-action checks.

summary: Multi-agent engine that scores reroutes across sea, air, road and rail.
readme_summary: Evaluates logistics disruptions with four specialist agents and an orchestrator ranking cost and on-time odds. Built in Python with deterministic scoring plus UIs for briefings. Uses Muse Spark, Wonder, SAM 3.1 and Voice Transcribe via Meta Model API.

summary: Visual referee that verifies AI coding agent UI work with calibrated checks
readme_summary: Spectra verifies front-end agent output by comparing before/after screenshots. It combines Meta SAM 3.1 segmentation with pixel NCC matching, calibrated to a 3-sigma noise floor. Exposes a CLI, MCP server, and web workbench with 164 offline tests.

summary: AI operations manager that drafts work for agencies pending human approval.
readme_summary: Orbyte reads agency work, drafts plans and requests approval for risky actions. Stack is Astro React with PostgreSQL Drizzle and documented workflows. Uses Meta Muse Spark, Muse Image and Muse Voice Transcribe for planning and content.

summary: Voice-first accessible companion for blind, deaf and disabled users
readme_summary: Voice-first companion that talks, listens, signs, captions, and uses camera to describe scenes and warn of obstacles. Built around disability access with adaptive UI. Next.js stack with video demo, focused on assistive multimodal interaction.

summary: Ask questions over CCTV and get timestamped evidence timelines
readme_summary: Uploads multi-camera CCTV, asks natural language questions, returns chronological timeline with before/during/after frames. Python + Node + ffmpeg stack with evals and Guardian alerts. Uses Meta AI vision models via MODEL_API_KEY for scene analysis.

summary: Reads bond prospectus with Muse to configure and test bond tokens.
readme_summary: Parses final terms plus base prospectus to resolve day-count, business-day and rounding rules. Fills ICMA-aligned schema with quotes and page cites. Deploys configured bond token and simulates full lifecycle on local chain using Muse models.

summary: AI investigator diagnoses machine vibration with evidence-based experiments
readme_summary: FailureLab AI runs vibration experiments for imbalance, misalignment, bearing faults, stating expectations before results. Explains diagnosis and answers from evidence. Python backend with Docker, local serve, captioned demo video.

summary: Photos parts cars to price parts and runs repair bench from symptom to tests
readme_summary: One-page copilot for a BMW performance shop for parts valuation and repair diagnostics. Python app with demo cache and eval result files. Uses Meta models with sourced claims for pricing and next actions.

summary: Insurance Q&A that cites IRDAI rules or refuses when proof is missing.
readme_summary: Aketud Verify answers Indian insurance questions in Hindi, Hinglish and English. Muse Spark proposes answers and Muse Spark Open verifies them against 2024 IRDAI rule corpora. It refuses or flags fraud patterns when citations fail.

summary: Learns design routines in Figma and Adobe apps into rerunnable no-AI workflows
readme_summary: Desktop Electron app that observes design tasks and converts them into reusable routines and cross-app flows. Includes Figma plugin and Cloudflare Worker for AI access. Uses Meta models to generate routines that rerun without AI calls.

summary: Campus marketplace for students to buy and sell pre-loved items with chat
readme_summary: Re-Love is a student marketplace with feed, search, filters, listings, and per-listing messaging. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind and Supabase Auth/Postgres/Storage with RLS and realtime chat.

summary: Auto-scheduling for cafes and shops with nearby part-timer network
readme_summary: Scheduling for small businesses: owner writes rules in plain language, builds cheapest compliant week. AI agent fills open shifts from own team then nearby part-timers. Built with Streamlit, phone accept/decline flow.

summary: Chat in English or Pidgin to order food and essentials locally
readme_summary: Tool-calling agent on Meta models turns chat or voice into product search, cart and order with nearby shops via web and WhatsApp. Monorepo with agent service, apps and packages. Uses Meta models for dialogue, transcription and WhatsApp handling.

summary: Artifact registry storing AI-built projects as milestones with safety scans and reviews.
readme_summary: VibeForge stores zips with scans and surveys instead of git history. Rust Axum backend with scanner and OSV checks, React TypeScript frontend, and SKILL.md for any AI tool. Uses Meta Muse AI review and MCP for pushes.

summary: Answers security questionnaires only with cryptographically proven evidence
readme_summary: Generates customer proof packs where browser re-verifies every cited record, signature and approval. Refuses or flags tampering when evidence is missing, built on Muse Spark and Muse Spark Open. Python vea package with evals, samples and docs.

summary: Phone HUD that segments trail hazards and speaks warnings
readme_summary: Real-time optical HUD scanning camera frames for hazards, tracking and ranking by severity. Browser-based, no app install. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark/Wonder/Glimmer.

summary: Learns a task from one video demo then checks later attempts for errors
readme_summary: OneShot records one tabletop demonstration as procedure then evaluates attempt videos for what went wrong and fixes. Modal-hosted web app built Oct-Nov 2026. Uses Meta Muse vision models for video checking.

summary: Scores rodent behavior videos into audited, ARRIVE-compliant results
readme_summary: Open-source pipeline that turns rodent test video into tracked metrics, stats and a report. Uses SAM 3.1 for vision, Python for measurement, Muse Spark for judging with number-audit enforcement. Research-only behavioral pharmacology lab tool.

summary: Self-hosted agent that finds, triages and fixes code vulnerabilities.
