readme_summary: Scurita is a repo-agnostic self-hosted security agent for GitHub, GitLab or local git using LangGraph + LangChain harness. Muse Spark acts as hosted brain for CVE triage, secret detection and fixes. Runs locally or in Docker with docs and sandbox.

summary: Voice-first AI that explains Nigerian legal rights aloud in English or Pidgin
readme_summary: Honest Orb is a voice-first companion that answers spoken legal questions with clear audio grounded in Nigerian law. Built with Meta models, FastAPI backend on Modal, it auto-listens for phone-call style follow-ups with cited sections.

summary: Finds first-user channels and runs measurable growth experiments that learn
readme_summary: Agent analyzes a product, proposes traction channels, runs small Threads and web experiments, and banks outcomes. TypeScript + web frontend with serverless backend and live read-only demo. Uses Meta AI to plan experiments and judge needs-more-data.

summary: Orchestration gateway that routes app-builder requests to the right Meta model
readme_summary: Sits between browser app builder and Meta models to select model, trim context and track impact. Three engines plus gateway for lower tokens and faster edits. Includes benchmarks, MCP servers and browser tests.

summary: Tap Korean signs to hear what they mean and what to do next
readme_summary: Mobile PWA where users photograph signs and tap text regions to get translation plus cultural context. Pipeline uses SAM 3.1 point-prompted segmentation with fallback rules. Backend and frontend on Vercel with Muse Spark reasoning.

summary: LoRA slider controls for ParticleGAN generation via Muse Glimmer integration.
readme_summary: Integrates upstream ParticleGAN with ridge LoRA distillation for slider controls. Modern glimmer_modern API reuses immutable upstream source for 0.9.4 training. Legacy glimmer_slider PG82 artifacts require separate legacy install.

summary: Diagnoses Docker outages with evidence and verifies the fix restores use
readme_summary: IncidentLab reproduces volume-full, permission, and database failures in a file-upload app with Postgres. Muse Spark on Meta Model API investigates via tools, proposes repairs, and verifies user flow. Includes Docker lab, evals, and web UI.

summary: AI shopping agent that reads real checkout pages with spending guardrails.
readme_summary: PactPay is a shopping agent where Muse models perceive checkout pages and propose actions while fixed code authorizes payments. Built as a pnpm monorepo with apps, packages, Docker Compose and PayPal Sandbox test login for checkout.

summary: $7 ESP32-CAM camera that understands scenes with on-device vision and AI
readme_summary: X-Lens pairs ESP32-CAM firmware with Rust server and vanilla JS dashboard for low-cost visual understanding. It uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning, and Muse Voice Transcribe for audio.

summary: Personalized park guide with camera animal ID and adaptive day plans
readme_summary: Multimodal guide for Kolmarden park with kid-aware day planning and live camera identification. Uses SAM 3.1 for animal segmentation, Muse Spark for stories, plus Voice and Image models. FastAPI backend with web client.

summary: Autonomous director that switches multicam streams and cuts vertical reels
readme_summary: Automates live multicam directing: camera switching, lower-thirds, audio fades and long-form to 9:16 reel slicing. Python/FastAPI pipeline with Docker Compose and showcase tooling. Uses Muse Spark for directing, SAM 3.1 for spatial tracking and Voice Transcribe.

summary: Live workshop watcher that circles hazards detected in camera stream
readme_summary: Local V-JEPA 2.1 encoder streams camera frames with concept-bottleneck head predicting 11 hazards and risk score with per-patch circles. SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor called only on flag. Backend, Streamlit, Docker and Android app with RTSP simulator end-to-end.

summary: Browser 3D room that simulates how sound reflects off described surfaces
readme_summary: Browser 3D room with real-time acoustic reflection physics. Users describe a room in text, Muse builds a preview for Apply, and surfaces change the sound. For sound designers and architects as an early approximation tool.

summary: Closed-loop agent that synthesizes and benchmarks Triton GPU kernels
readme_summary: Autonomous compiler agent analyzing PyTorch ops against memory roofline to generate fused Triton kernels. Python + Modal on NVIDIA A10G with sandbox verification. Uses Muse Spark Open weights.

summary: Browser agent that acts in your own Chrome via text, voice, or images.
readme_summary: Works in existing Chrome with tabs and logins, sends only latest page snapshot to cut cost. Uses Muse Spark Open on Baseten for actions and Muse Voice Transcribe for input. Node.js server plus TypeScript/Tailwind web live view.

summary: Webcam AR layer that answers questions about real objects using hand gestures
readme_summary: GODMODE overlays AI answers on live camera feed controlled by hand twists and moves. Web frontend with server backend runs on laptop or phone webcam. Uses Muse models for reasoning with vision grounding, prototype for glasses use.

summary: Architecture workbench that turns system sketches into reproducible traffic experiments.
readme_summary: Founders and backend teams convert diagrams into traffic experiments to find bottlenecks and compare repairs. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for analysis and Muse Image 1.0 for visuals with docs and GitHub Pages deploy. Includes CI, demo video and two-minute local run.

summary: Mac desktop assistant with 3D mascot that answers and automates apps
readme_summary: Native Swift Mac assistant with streaming answers, web search, screen-aware planning and in-folder code building. Uses Meta models via API for planning and Muse Code actions without taking over mouse.

summary: Drop-in proxy blocking indirect prompt injection in English and Turkish
readme_summary: Kalkan sits before tool-using agents with fast screen plus intent-judge pass to block injections before tool calls. Includes self red-teaming sandbox and dashboard with detection rates. Dockerized proxy with evals and fixtures built for Meta hackathon.

summary: Prompt-driven cyber range where AI red and blue agents battle with verifiable scoring.
readme_summary: Platform to design, deploy, exercise and score prompt-driven cyber ranges for red/blue agents. Node backend with frontend and Docker-based deployment, built on Muse Spark for agent reasoning with evidence-logged attacks.

summary: What-if classic chapters rewritten in author voice as comic pages
readme_summary: NovelSpell Remix generates alternate chapters from public-domain classics and renders them as comic pages with covers. Muse Wonder writes text and Muse Image draws art via Meta Model API. Cloudflare Workers app with FastAPI-style server and static site.

summary: Scope approval gate and live map for fleets of coding agents
readme_summary: Acan is a scope-first gate where developers approve agent change-scopes before code. It runs old and merged apps side-by-side to catch out-of-scope diffs with reproducers. Built in Rust with plant view UI, using Muse Spark for planning and Muse Spark Open workers.

summary: Checks if motion in a video follows real-world physics laws
readme_summary: Upload a 2-5s clip and get consistent, inconsistent, or cannot judge with reasons. Muse Spark reasons, SAM 3.1 tracks the object, code computes physics. Frontend and backend hosted on Render with fixed bench in data/bench and no per-clip tuning.

summary: Rebuilds oilfield wells and history from raw files with cited sources
readme_summary: FieldLens sorts unlabeled surveys, logs, and spreadsheets to reconstruct wells and history with cell-level citations. Backend plus 3D viewer, charts, and Q&A. Powered by Meta Muse Spark agent for sorting, entity resolution, and QA.

summary: Quest 3 companion that walks your room, sees objects and talks you through
readme_summary: Nubi is an open-source mixed-reality companion for Quest 3 built with Unity 6.6 and OpenXR. It navigates room space, outlines held objects and converses. Uses Muse Spark for dialogue, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Voice and Wit.ai.

summary: Runs small shops in WhatsApp with catalog, orders and fraud-proof receipts
readme_summary: Commerce agent for WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook handling catalog, payments, delivery and books. Web plus API with wallet-transfer verification via SMS matching. Built with Muse Spark reading photos and voice notes.

summary: Turns hand-drawn home sketches into AR designs and staged material lists
readme_summary: Self-build housing assistant that measures homes and designs next rooms with families. Web and server with AR visualization and takeoff tools. Uses Muse Spark to transcribe measurements and detect doors and windows.

summary: Collaborative AI workspace turning scattered docs into citable answers
readme_summary: Agentic Knowledge Workspace centralizes admin/enterprise documents for natural-language query with citations and refusals. PHP stack. Uses Muse Spark Open for retrieval, verification, and access control.

summary: Counts fish in underwater video with evidence frame for every MaxN.
readme_summary: Counts survey video with MaxN and first-arrival times plus evidence frames and review queue. Muse Spark points at motion and SAM 3.1 tracks via Meta Model API. Web demo with finished runs.

summary: Turns one phone photo into a dialect-localized Instagram ad in a minute.
readme_summary: AdMorph AI cuts out products with SAM 3.1, writes Arabic/English copy with Muse Spark and paints final creative with Muse Image. It is a Vercel web studio with fixed model roles and layout verification.

summary: Distributed Storybook visual testing gate for coding agents.
readme_summary: Selfie is a distributed visual review gate for Storybook that runs locally, in CI, and on GitHub. Designed to handle 100x render volume from agents in the loop. Uses Muse Spark to explain visual changes.

summary: Converts URLs or cookbook photos into guided cook-along recipes.
readme_summary: TextSous Open converts recipe URLs, text, or up to 3 photos into canonical JSON, timeline, and variants. Web app with Cook Along view with lanes, timers, and SOUS voice. Uses Meta model API for parsing and conversion.

summary: Turns questions or sketches into bilingual interactive lessons.
readme_summary: ExplainBack creates reviewable bilingual lessons where learners predict, experiment, explain, and try new cases. App validates lesson contracts and computes outputs. Uses Muse models to draft and revise lessons.

summary: Interactive 3D classroom where Muse teaches machine repair on phone or Quest
readme_summary: Web and WebXR classroom to repair, X-ray and disassemble 8 machines in 3D. Muse Spark acts as teacher moving real model parts while answering why. Stack uses SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe, Three.js and Meta Quest support.

summary: Teach by recording once, then replays portal work with self-repair on change
readme_summary: Converts one computer-use run into a replayable program triggered via WhatsApp approval. Monorepo with replay engine, dry-runs and repair evals. Uses Muse computer-use for teaching and zero-model replay until UI change triggers repair.

summary: AI receptionist that answers unknown calls in Thailand to screen scams before you pick up.
readme_summary: KRAI-A beta answers unknown calls, discloses AI handling and screens scammers for at-risk users. App with corpus, eval arena and measured proof results, MIT licensed. Uses Muse Spark, Wonder and Voice for call screening pipeline.

summary: Tool-driven agent that turns molecule hypotheses into auditable lab notebooks
readme_summary: MolChat orchestrates molecular docking and chemistry workflows from prompt to evidence notebook. Includes benchmarks, conformance tests, docs, and Docker setup. Uses Muse Spark Open for planning with auditable stops and reviewable runs.

summary: Ten-dollar glasses wearable lets you talk, point and write to control your computer.
readme_summary: atem is a sunglasses-mounted ESP32S3 camera and mic plus a harness that routes speech and vision to web and app actions. It previews planned actions then shows proof after execution. Every model call uses Meta Muse models for intent and execution.

summary: Voice-controlled electronics bench assistant that drives an SO-101 robot arm
readme_summary: Hands-free bench partner where Muse Spark routes requests to Muse Wonder for firmware, SAM 3.1 for vision, and Voice Transcribe. Local Llama 3.2 fast-path handles arm commands and HUD visualizes routing to SO-101 arm.

summary: AI clerk that prepares warehouse work inside existing 3PL software
readme_summary: Reads emails, WhatsApp and portal requests to prepare work in existing warehouse software for one-click approval. Counts boxes from delivery-note photos and supports English/Spanish. Built with Next.js, Prisma, Vercel and Modal with Meta Muse models.

summary: AI astronomer that predicts supernova outcomes and logs public scored forecasts
readme_summary: SIRA investigates ZTF transients via ALeRCE, proposes rival hypotheses and registers predictions before observations. Keeps timestamped public ledger. Built with Meta Muse models and Muse Spark Open.

summary: Autonomous agent that plays Unity games to find and reproduce bugs with evidence
readme_summary: Reads a Unity project's code to learn controls and state, then plays in real time, investigates anomalies and exports bug reports. Stack includes Unity bridge and agent harness. Uses decision and stronger escalation models for playtesting.

summary: Collects human and AI answers separately, reviews and publishes them as consented labeled data.
readme_summary: Open core of tbwim.adisaan.com asking one human question at a time. Laravel PHP app keeps human and agent answers apart for review, synthesis and publishing. Uses Meta Model API under a hard spending cap.

summary: Voice-controlled SO-101 arm with vision safety gate and watchdog
readme_summary: Pathfinder is a natural-language safety layer for a table SO-101 arm where Meta models see and decide but local checks drive motors. Uses dual-camera MediaPipe hand gate with 150ms watchdog. Logged build with calibration and replay tooling.

summary: Auto-syncs multicam talking videos into horizontal and vertical edited cuts
readme_summary: GhostCut Director syncs camera cards, picks takes, color-matches, and selects angles per line. Mac app plus Python CLI with ffmpeg pipeline and editable timelines. Uses Muse models for edit decisions and SAM 3.1 for visual analysis.

summary: WhatsApp voice agent guiding non-English parents through international flights
readme_summary: WhatsApp agent that escorts an elderly parent through a flight by voice in her language with family in loop. Built in Java 21 with local H2, ffmpeg, and tape-mode replay for demo. Uses Meta Muse models for multilingual voice dialogue and travel orchestration.

summary: Reads freight shipping docs into one schema and learns each sender layout
readme_summary: Reads Shipping Orders and Packing Lists in Chinese and English into a fixed schema with code checks and dual verification. Learns sender layouts via Muse Wonder from corrections to reduce review. TypeScript stack with Drizzle and live demo.

summary: Reviewer agent that cross-checks ID documents and links evidence for humans
readme_summary: DocTrust cross-examines NID, birth certificate and bank forms for inconsistencies in Bangla, English and Hindi. Pipeline uses planner plus deterministic comparator with perturbation re-reads. Runs on hosted Muse Spark or Muse Spark Open with SAM views.

summary: Bilingual map of Nagasaki local shops with owner-approved stories, no ratings
readme_summary: Noren is a Japanese/English map of 3,612 Nagasaki places from OpenStreetMap, Overture Maps and creators. Stories are quoted public posts with attribution plus owner-approved interview sentences. Uses Next.js/Vercel stack with Muse models for translation and story drafting.

summary: Voice-first iPhone plus glasses companion supporting daily life with Parkinson's
readme_summary: Cadence offers guided routines, walking cues and caregiver dashboard via voice. Pairs iPhone with Meta glasses for camera/audio/motion. Protected backend with iOS app and web walkthrough.

summary: Simulated humanoid rehearses furniture moves from room photo in 3D.
readme_summary: Builds an editable 3D room from an image and door size, then a Unitree G1 rehearses the move in Isaac Sim. Python stack with VLM guidance. Uses Muse Spark to explain results in English or Korean.

summary: Turns phone singing takes into vertical AI-world music videos
readme_summary: Real One segments the artist with SAM 3.1 and keeps them real while Muse Image builds per-section worlds. Muse Wonder directs takes, lyric sync and beat-aligned cuts.

summary: Calculus notebook that checks ink steps and writes hints in handwriting
readme_summary: Pen-first notebook app where assistant reads page ink, verifies steps with computer algebra, and writes leveled red-pencil hints and ghost next-steps on page. Dockerized API plus client; uses Meta AI for page understanding and tutoring dialogue via voice and tap.

summary: Phone camera guide that outlines the spoken-about part and explains it aloud
readme_summary: Talking camera guide that segments the asked-about part and answers by voice in seconds. Server plus static client with contracts and simulations. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 for grounding, and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Camera-based lab trainer that segments circuits and guides repairs by voice
readme_summary: Points laptop camera at real circuits, SAM 3.1 segments parts, Muse Spark 1.3 identifies them and writes level-adapted procedures. Tracking keeps masks anchored while guide updates from answers and voice. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Verified multi-agent trip planner for nomads using only reviewed destination data
readme_summary: Multi-agent workflow for long-stay travel planning. Planner drafts day-by-day plans from Outgrid records with source refs, Verifier checks claims. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API and Muse Spark Open on Baseten.

summary: Phone-line and web checker that blocks impersonation scams for families
readme_summary: Anti-scam system with phone Line Lock, clone-site checker, scam memory, and family explainer cards. Backend + agent + analyst services with Docker deploy. Uses Meta tools for detection and explanation.

summary: Runs a multi-channel YouTube pipeline from idea to script, video, QA and metadata.
readme_summary: Documentary-grade film factory driven by channel profiles through ideation, research, script, visuals, QA and distribution. Python pipeline with adapters, validators gating each stage, and human approvals. Uses Meta Muse models plus LTX-2.5 for image-to-video.

summary: Rust office where agent claims are checked against signed ledger
readme_summary: Agora intercepts agent actions and answers, verifying each claim against a signed append-only ledger before delivery. Built in Rust 2024 with Muse models, includes benchmarks and Cloud Run deployment.

summary: Garment photo with A4 sheet becomes sewing pattern and size advice
readme_summary: Turns flat garment photo calibrated by A4 sheet into printable graded patterns, cutting layouts and tailor orders. Built for Build for Your World with Next.js, TypeScript and Meta vision models for measurement.

summary: Tests bank systems read-only to audit DORA controls and write reports.
readme_summary: AI agent that generates work programme, runs read-only tests, seals evidence and routes fixes for approval and re-test. Python controls library with sealed replayable reports. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for planning and review, SAM 3.1 for masking.

summary: Factory copilot that guides workers step-by-step and verifies work on camera
readme_summary: Captures an expert job once then guides new workers with step instructions and camera verification. Python backend with web frontend, deployed on Modal, using vision models to box parts and check completion.

summary: Phone video scan that rates furniture tip-over risk and suggests fixes
readme_summary: Fall-Zero turns room video into tip-over verdicts for child, elderly, and earthquake risk. Python pipeline uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, SAM 3D for reconstruction, and Muse Spark 1.3 for description and chat.

summary: Crowdsourced flood mapping from photos, clips and Telegram bot
readme_summary: Collects resident photos and clips to estimate flood depth and plan routes via coordinator console. Cloud Run app with Telegram bot that calls models live. Uses Meta vision models for overlays and verdicts per vehicle.

summary: Telegram checker giving Indonesian parents scam verdicts in Bahasa
readme_summary: Forwards suspicious messages, screenshots, QRIS, voice and video for plain Bahasa Indonesia verdict and next steps. Telegram bot with WhatsApp adapter built, Python app backend. Uses Meta models to classify scams and alert family.

summary: Offline-first voice copilot diagnosing crop pests for smallholder farmers.
readme_summary: Expo field client queues photos offline then diagnoses pests and diseases with multilingual voice guidance. Backend plus WhatsApp Business integration with edge-profile fallback and ExecuTorch harness. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Image/Wonder and SAM via Meta Model API.

summary: Signed evidence packaging and offline verifier for agent behavior assurance
readme_summary: Integrity harness runs documented pressure scenarios under deterministic contract and packages results as Ed25519-signed archives with offline verifier. Python harness with demo app, docs and evidence store. Evaluates Meta target-agent runs and verifies tamper-evident behavioral assurance.

summary: Constraint-driven agent designing planar four-bar linkages with checks
readme_summary: Mechanism AI proposes linkage candidates while an independent deterministic evaluator owns pass/fail. Built with FastAPI, Pydantic and SSE streaming, it runs reference kinematics and optional MuJoCo MJCF simulation for collision and path checks.

summary: Bench camera that tracks parts across teardown and verifies repair completion
readme_summary: Cairn adds object permanence to repair work, tracking parts across frames to flag missing or out-of-order items. Stack is Python + Docker + Vercel replay with bench vision pipeline. Targets SAM 3.1 for segmentation with Muse Wonder/Glimmer/Voice for reasoning.

summary: A scrollable feed of background agent work from inbox, calendar and sales.
readme_summary: Feedforward turns background agent output into approvable cards from inbox, calendar and sales. Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, Vitest and Playwright. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for agents, Muse Image 1.0 for visuals and SAM 3.1 for physical-world cards.

summary: Investigates bug reports, proposes patches, and verifies fixes in a sandbox.
readme_summary: Tracera indexes repos into a versioned code graph, investigates with cited hypotheses, and reproduces and verifies patches in Docker. Inference uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder, and SAM 3.1 for screenshots. Web app with evidence-backed review UI.

summary: Finds surplus steel lots across consenting trade networks
readme_summary: Evidence-backed steel sourcing app with map search, quoting, and doc checks. Built with Next.js + Docker/Postgres. Uses Muse Spark with quoted evidence and prompt-injection filtering.

summary: Private LAN agent network letting your own computers work as a team
readme_summary: Multi-Auto-Setup creates a private LAN network of agents across macOS, Windows and Linux. Connects Claude Desktop, Open WebUI, Muse and coding agents locally. Python 3.11+ with local-first data.

summary: Cyber-physical SOC agent correlating cameras with logs to contain threats at the edge.
readme_summary: Fuses physical presence from cameras with cyber telemetry for live quarantine and self-healing. Dockerized backend plus frontend with edge processing to avoid cloud video. Uses Meta open and multimodal models for detection.

summary: VS Code extension that flags risky DB changes and proves leaks in a sandbox
readme_summary: Lucid is a VS Code extension that reviews commits for database and security risks. It shows warning cards with fixes and lesson cards, then reproduces RLS leaks in a disposable sandbox with fake users. It uses Muse models via Meta API for analysis and explanations.

summary: Voice companion for lonely seniors with check-ins, pill reminders and family alerts.
readme_summary: Voice-first companion for older adults living alone with daily check-ins, medication reminders and symptom notes. Built on Muse models with no medical advice, family dashboard and safety escalation.

summary: Turns Sentinel-1 radar motion into ranked bridge inspection lists for cities
readme_summary: RadarTwin binds EGMS scatterers to bridge footprints, splits decks into spans, deseasons series and fuses passes into vertical motion. Validated on Dresden, it ranked Carola Bridge before collapse with web story and tests.

summary: Explains football goals by tracking players with geometry, not guesses
readme_summary: Upload a football clip to get grounded tactical explanation of space, marking, and passes. Uses SAM 3.1 to track players and ball and map pixels to pitch metres, then Muse Spark reads only where geometry directs. No training, Meta Model API only with verifiable claims.

summary: Turns street flood photos into 3D flood maps and rescue routes
readme_summary: Converts street-level flood photos into DEM-based flood-extent shapefiles with depth profiles and rescue corridors for Rodriguez, Rizal. Uses Docker backend/frontend stack with DEM processing pipeline.

summary: Tests if one AI can hide a word in art that another AI decodes from pixels only.
readme_summary: Spark sender writes SVG hiding English word; separate Spark decoder sees only PNG and writes Python tools to crack it. Frozen prompts, exact-match scoring, 60% decoded with 0 false alarms. Python eval plus dashboard.

summary: Voice-first companion that watches over elders living alone daily.
readme_summary: Saavren is a voice-first guardian for elders living alone, handling check-ins, fall detection, and health trend alerts to family. It offers browser demo, Android APK, and Docker setup. Built as full-stack with backend, frontend, and mobile clients.

summary: Tags where each agent action value came from for phone approval
readme_summary: Deterministic provenance tracker with no model that labels each value in Muse-proposed tool calls. Mobile approve/deny UI surfaces when values come from untrusted reads. Tested with Muse Spark 1.3.

summary: Transcribes fireground radio into must-acknowledge alerts for commanders
readme_summary: Earshot turns multi-channel crew radio into triaged queue and earpiece briefs. Python server with realtime ASR and routing agent plus replay mode and eval suite. Uses muse-voice-transcribe-1.0 for ASR and muse-spark-1.3 for JSON triage.

summary: Multi-agent pipeline turns raw interviews into editable mini-documentaries
readme_summary: ChronoCut orchestrates archivist, screenwriter, director and editor agents to produce versioned Edit Decision Lists with browser timeline editing and re-render. Full-stack with auditable model telemetry. Uses Muse/media models for transcription, scripting and cutting.

summary: Phone alerts that explain community Wi-Fi outages in English, Telugu or Hindi
readme_summary: Analyzes public Freifunk Munchen router data to cluster real outages, cutting 79 offline events to 6 alerts. Sends phone-friendly cause and fix steps multilingually. Python backend with detection heuristics + LLM explanations.

summary: Camera explainer that grounds every fact in what it sees and cites
readme_summary: I SEE points a camera at objects to explain identity, workings, interiors, and care with cited sources. Uses Muse Spark for vision and search, SAM 3.1 for outlines, Muse Wonder for disambiguation, Muse Image and Voice Transcribe. Includes verifier and calculator.

summary: Finds companies showing buying need with quoted evidence from your site.
readme_summary: Enter your website to profile your offer, find competitors, and surface companies with timely needs from jobs and news. Web app with Playwright verification and Modal deployment. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for extraction and reasoning with web search.

summary: Phone photo of crop plot gives plant count, weed share, and watering advice.
readme_summary: Turns one phone photo into plant count, canopy cover, weed ratio and daily water need with week-by-week tracking. FastAPI on Modal + web/Android clients; SAM 3.1 segments plants, Muse Spark Open directs vision and explains results, deterministic code computes metrics.

summary: Research coach challenges startup ideas and pushes founders toward field checks.
readme_summary: Adaptive epistemic loop that counters AI certainty and guides startup validation with provenance tracking. Python backend + web frontend, inference on Baseten and Fireworks with Meta open-weights Muse Spark Open and Llama 3.3 70B.

summary: Tests robot plans against adversarial scenarios before acting
readme_summary: Whatiff evaluates robot reliability via adversary scenario planning, scene editing and deterministic scoring. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Image 1.0, SAM 3.1 grounding and Muse Spark Open on Baseten for action selection. Built from scratch for agentic evaluation.

summary: Generates OpenSCAD parts and blocks done until measured geometry passes
readme_summary: Turns plain language into printable OpenSCAD parts and assemblies with declared intent. Verifies mesh with deterministic harness for fit, strain, stability and slicer checks. Uses Muse Wonder and Muse Spark for design generation.

summary: On-device agent that restores broken network connections without cloud.
readme_summary: Uplink runs locally to diagnose and fix offline computers when cloud assistants fail. Built with an agent loop, typed tools, safety gates, and replay harness. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer 30B base open weights on-device via llama-server.

summary: macOS analyst companion that drafts sourced notes, triages mail and dictates
readme_summary: Native macOS Swift app with local web UI for analysts to draft BLUF notes, review work, triage mail and agenda. Uses only Meta models at runtime for drafting, review, image generation and voice, with no other provider.

summary: Traces Herculaneum scroll surfaces in CT with SAM 3.1 without sheet jumps
readme_summary: Scholar-guided tracing for Herculaneum Scroll 1 CT. Measures SAM 3.1 traces against hand-traced sheets and fixes first-slice jumps to stay on sheet. Includes viewer and eval on real CT slices for Vesuvius Challenge research.

summary: One-key recap of last 30-120 seconds of audio into a multilingual card
readme_summary: Catch Up buffers 2 minutes of on-device audio, then converts the last 30/60/120s into a card with questions, summary, facts and quotes. Next.js desktop + web with evals. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark on Meta Model API.

summary: Builds community-trained text and speech translation for Shawi languages.
readme_summary: Open toolkit turns community translations and recordings into Indigenous to official-language models for text and speech. First pair Shawi-Spanish/English on Muse Glimmer 30B QLoRA plus NLLB-200 1.3B. Includes methodology, labeled builds and Hugging Face models.

summary: Predicts turbofan remaining life and abstains when uncertain for review
readme_summary: Calibrated RUL predictions on NASA C-MAPSS with 90% bands turned into INSPECT, NO_INSPECTION, or ABSTAIN by code. Streamlit app with sensor history and prompts configs. Uses Muse Spark agents to explain each call and highlight sensors.

summary: Web IDE to supervise coding agents with approvals, diffs, and impact analysis
readme_summary: Web IDE for supervising coding agents on Python repos with chat-first planning and approval gates. Agents work in git worktrees with impact cones, diffs, and test evidence. Nothing merges to main without human approval.

summary: Browser rehearsal tool that links scripts to sound cues with operator-controlled GO
readme_summary: RUNQ is a browser-based rehearsal and sound-cue tool for theater. It connects scripts to cue suggestions, human review, and deterministic local audio. Uses Meta Muse Spark optionally for cue prep while operator retains control.

summary: Live 3 months on Costa Rica minimum wage in a finance simulator
readme_summary: ColonQuest is a personal-finance simulator set in Costa Rica with a deterministic engine tracking every colon. It runs locally with downloadable Windows builds and bilingual docs. It uses Meta Muse models as an AI director to generate contextual financial events.

summary: Fictional city permit demo where Muse drafts and people approve decisions.
readme_summary: Fictional municipal permitting app following one permit from form to decision. Muse proposes actions, humans decide, with public record. Track Indie Build for Your World, demo on Render.

summary: Fictional city permit app tracing applications from form to decision
readme_summary: ACME City Permits follows one fictional permit from applicant form to recorded decision and issuance. Muse proposes next actions and checks while people make decisions. Built during the event with a requirements prototype then full app on Render, using Muse for agent assistance.

summary: Seller console linking Facebook Live comments to products and orders
readme_summary: A control room for solo Facebook Live sellers that maps comments to products, quantities and price negotiation with approval queue and memory. Built by KeviqLabs with Meta AI. Includes hosted demo, replay judge mode, architecture and measured results docs.

summary: Senior-first scam checker that judges messages against your real life data
readme_summary: Prudence checks emails against real orders, bank, carrier, breaches and contacts to block scams. Monorepo with 880 tests, 97% coverage, 41 seed cases. Built for Meta hackathon as privacy security gateway.

summary: MCP gateway turning an SME owner's AI assistant into a business back-office helper
readme_summary: AI Launchpad connects ChatGPT, Claude and Meta models to Estonian SME tools via an owner-only HTTPS MCP gateway. Focuses on next-best-action, time saved and reliable back-office automation. Pilot tested with Meta/Baseten path and synthetic data.

summary: Turn plain English into tested 3D mechanical assemblies
readme_summary: ProtoLab turns natural-language mechanism briefs into connected 3D assemblies and runs physics tests. Muse revises designs using measured results with gallery and replay compare. Built for Meta hackathon with Meta Muse and Cloudflare Workers app.

summary: Visualizes what AI-written code does before you trust it, explained by AI
readme_summary: Atlas draws AI-written code as a per-function machine diagram with plain-English explanation from Muse Wonder. Web demo on Fly.io with judge-code budgets and sample files. Helps review untrusted generated code quickly.

summary: Platform to recruit and manage autonomous AI workers with verifiable identity.
readme_summary: Infrastructure for creator-published AI employees with locked DNA and sandboxed tools. Employer assigns missions and receives verifiable reports with persistent emp identity. Uses Meta models for planning and execution.

summary: Approval-gated agent team that runs a business page weekly content operation
readme_summary: PaCo runs brief, trend research, content plan, drafts, approval, scheduling and reporting for FYF AI demo brand. Uses deterministic rules plus judge pass architecture. Uses Muse Wonder for plan, drafts and verdicts, Muse Spark for utilities.

summary: Usability testing that sends Muse browser agents to test websites.
readme_summary: Sends Meta Muse Spark browser agents to perform customer tasks on sites. Checks answers against site records, shows friction points and re-measures fixes. Live app with paired eval reports.

summary: AI pathology pre-reads and outbreak alerts for Kenyan pathologists.
readme_summary: Flutter app for patients, doctors and pathologists with human approval workflow. Firebase backend with Baseten, Modal and Fireworks inference. Uses Meta models for pre-read drafts and alerts.

summary: Agentic flood twin where storms and city edits reshape flood and routes live
readme_summary: Urban-flood digital twin with 2D simulation, impacted buildings and evacuation routing. FastAPI on Cloud Run with React CesiumJS frontend and simulator engine. Uses Muse Spark planner verified against simulator output.

summary: Turns why questions into explorable living worlds grounded in real science
readme_summary: Builds interactive simulated worlds from why questions for self-discovery. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and judging, Muse Image + SAM 3.1 for visuals, Next.js with 40 citizen agents.

summary: Heat-aware walking app showing shady routes in 3D city view
readme_summary: React, TypeScript, Three.js, Express and Capacitor app for heat-aware campus and city walking. Renders 3D streets with perceived heat per hour and shade-optimal routing. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API to plan walks.

summary: Shared permission-aware graph connects a child's caregivers with proposals
readme_summary: FridgeGraph gives a child's village one connected, permissioned graph for care coordination. Rosina turns plan changes into proposals for parents to decide, with live demo, schema docs, and Muse provenance.

summary: AI agent ports real CUDA projects to open SYCL with proven verification
readme_summary: Meta Muse plans and ports CUDA codebases like llama2 and llm.c to SYCL 2020 with CI proof. Python stack with patches, scripts, and evidence using muse-spark-1.3, running on CPU, NVIDIA, and AMD.

summary: Guides blind users fingertip to the right spot on touchscreens by voice
readme_summary: Point Android phone at kiosk, say want, and get tones, speech and vibration steering to button. Sends camera frame via gateway where Meta models read screen and locate target, confirms presses and walks through multi-step orders.

summary: Warm voice-first companion for seniors living alone.
readme_summary: Maya is a voice-first companion for elderly users with conversation, check-ins, and care flows. Built as mobile APK plus web app with voice guard fixes. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for warm dialogue and speech interaction.

summary: Policy enforcement gateway that blocks non-compliant ERP agent actions
readme_summary: ComplianceGate turns public regulations and company KB into enforceable controls at ERP control points. Built in C# .NET with Gate agent, compliance and eval services. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Image with auditable memos and owner sign-off.

summary: Converts stall video or voice prices into shop page, bills and WhatsApp
readme_summary: MarketMate turns Tamil, Hindi or English stall video or voice into checked price list, shop page, WhatsApp messages and day close. Prices come only from seller voice. Built with Python, Modal hosting and Meta AI for transcription and extraction.

summary: Npm malware detection that never runs package code
readme_summary: Open-source npm scanner with investigator agent, lockfile audit, and install guard for npm/npx. Muse agent analyzes files and diffs with code-verified claims. Served via Modal API with CLI and GitHub Action.

summary: Webcam tabletop tower defense turning desk objects into pixel heroes
readme_summary: A Windows party game where a top-down webcam turns mugs and keys into 16-bit units battling Filipino folklore creatures for 8 turns. Uses four Meta models together for vision, sprites, and Taglish voice orders. Built solo with app, backend, evals and docs.

summary: Verification-first guard that checks agent actions with deterministic tests.
readme_summary: Sentinel X reviews proposed agent actions and scans authorized lab sites for vulnerabilities. Deterministic code and independent tests decide, with evidence logs and temporary proxy rules. Local lab prototype with CI and demo video.

summary: Turns home camera motion alerts into cited visit stories and timeline
readme_summary: Vigil correlates multi-camera events into one cited visit story with spatial view and gaps. Applies user rules to flag attention. Built with Python/Docker stack and local dashboard; Meta vision models perceive while code decides outcomes.

summary: Archive copy of exam-to-mastery tutor that builds thinking-first plans
readme_summary: Private archive mirror of From Exam to Mastery: photographs exams, Muse Spark 1.3 marks and diagnoses, Muse Wonder validates levels. Learner does thinking, ending in real tasks. Same LoWisa structure with docs, evidence and scripts.

summary: Virtual city help desk that finds codes and prepares permits for staff review
readme_summary: Virtual city help desk where residents describe needs and the agent pulls parcels, city code, and prepares paperwork. Staff review in a workspace with code citations; agent prepares, staff decide. Web app with live planner dialogue.

summary: Turns molecular dynamics questions into executable, verifiable analyses.
readme_summary: Research copilot studies E. coli AdK trajectories, plans analyses and runs MDAnalysis NumPy SciPy code for inspection. Uses Muse Spark for planning and Muse Wonder verifier to check reports and figures.

summary: Verifiable procurement evidence engine with every claim footnoted to source.
readme_summary: Expediente builds investigation dossiers where every finding links to exact document and page, deleting untraceable claims. Provides graph portal and chat over procurement documents. Python package with zero dependencies, MIT licensed.

summary: Digital seal tracking shipping container damage with photos at handover
readme_summary: Tracks containers across handovers with SAM 3.1 masking and Muse Spark damage coding. Drafts claims as agent, blurs people, and takes spoken notes via Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Scans repos and sites for hijackable domains, buckets and accounts with fixes
readme_summary: Detects dangling CDN, S3 and repojacking risks from polyfill.io-style takeovers. Labels Proven/Likely with fix plan, issue and patch, runs on PRs. Live Render app with API, eval and docs.

summary: Agentic storefront builder that turns price lists into shoppable sites with chat
readme_summary: Owner uploads spreadsheets and PDFs to draft business model, reviews it, then launches storefront at /s/:slug with assistant chat and MCP ordering. Next.js with Drizzle and Docker. Uses LLM business agent with rule-based fallback importer.

summary: Verifies rental cleanings photo-by-photo with dual vision checks and SAM 3.1
readme_summary: Hosts define room rules and reference photos; Muse Spark drafts checklists while dual vision checks plus SAM 3.1 verify cleaner photos. Spanish-first cleaner app sends voice re-photo requests for gaps.

summary: Creates illustrated children's books natively in mother-tongue languages
readme_summary: Parent/teacher prompt or folk tale becomes illustrated picture book written first in Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Swahili and others. Multi-agent pipeline writes, checks reading level, illustrates. Frontend + backend + Supabase.

summary: WhatsApp back-office that tracks open deals and drafts follow-ups for owners
readme_summary: Followthrough watches leads, samples, quotes, orders and invoices for WhatsApp-run small businesses. It flags going-cold deals and drafts next moves in owner voice for approval. Built with Muse Spark Open, Muse Voice Transcribe and WhatsApp Cloud API.

summary: Removes the painter from footage so the artwork's creation remains visible.
readme_summary: Piece of Mind films painting sessions and outputs clean artwork video using only aligned camera pixels. SAM 3.1 segments the painter and Muse Spark handles language interaction, with no generative image edits. Scripts verify every output pixel came from camera frames.

summary: Agent-assisted tender review workspace with human award controls
readme_summary: Quorum manages procurement from intake to award with evidence-linked findings and redlines. LangGraph agent stops at named-human gates with quorum checks. Built with Next.js, Bun, LangGraph.js and MCP.

summary: Evidence-gated AI investigator for gas-turbine faults and anomalies
readme_summary: ThermoMind turns turbine sensor windows into investigation cases with deterministic evidence and baseline comparison. Muse Spark 1.3 generates reports citing only tool-returned evidence IDs, gated by a server validator. Uses UCI Gas Turbine data and Docker Compose stack.

summary: Daily FDA MAUDE dashboard flagging spikes and severity for device types.
readme_summary: B2B postmarket-surveillance tool for regulatory teams using public openFDA MAUDE data. Streamlit + Docker app matches claims to FDA records with human-in-the-loop decisions. Uses Meta AI models for signal summarization over device adverse events.

summary: Verifiable repair agent that tests database fixes on disposable copies.
readme_summary: Python runtime investigates failed imports, proposes guarded repair script and validates on disposable copy with independent checks. Includes local workbench and replayable demo. Uses Meta Muse Spark agent for evidence analysis.

summary: Self-evolving Muse agent with measurable, testable and reversible self-improvements
readme_summary: Agentztein is an experimental self-evolving agent that proposes, tests and reversibly applies its own capability improvements. It uses deterministic evaluation, regression detection and versioned rollbacks. Built on Meta Muse models with a monorepo of API, apps and datasets.

summary: Workshop assistant that watches your bench and remembers tools and tasks.
readme_summary: Workshop assistant with bench camera and phone camera plus hands-free voice that teaches objects, finds them, and resumes unfinished work. Built with Python agent and persistent cross-day memory. Uses Meta Muse models for the conversational agent and look/highlight/read actions.

summary: 3D city simulator that compares hazard impact before and after events.
readme_summary: Procedurally generates synthetic cities in Three.js and runs deterministic floods, quakes and wind. Stack is Next.js React with Three.js and OpenStreetMap importer. Uses Meta AI features for city generation and intervention suggestions.

summary: Agent that turns damaged parcel photos into carrier claims
readme_summary: Customer reports damage with photo, agent finds order and decides reship or refund. Builds carrier claim PDF and email plus customer draft. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Vernacular multimodal citizen assistant for civic, farm, health, and education tasks
readme_summary: SIA / Namma Ooru SuperApp is a WhatsApp and web assistant for rural India covering civic, agriculture, education, and health. Flask app uses Muse Spark/Wonder, SAM 3.1, and Muse Voice for multilingual text, vision, and speech.

summary: Multi-agent planetary intelligence with 3D Earth digital twin viewer
readme_summary: SATA Sentinel combines multi-agent queries with 3D Earth visualization for planetary data. Built with React, Three.js and TypeScript on Next.js. Uses Llama 4, Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and Muse Code.

summary: Calendar agent that computes real departure times and nudges you to leave on time
readme_summary: .NET system with Tempo.Api, Core, Agent, Jobs and Web plus Google, Maps, Meta and Push integrations. Learns recurring stops and adjusts plans from chat or invite photos. Uses Meta AI for conversational planning.

summary: Agent crew that builds branded carousels from real business photos.
readme_summary: Reads business website and brand, then edits real photos layer by layer in GIMP into Instagram carousels. Agent crew with planner, designer and critic. Uses Muse Spark, Wonder, Image and SAM 3.1 for segmentation.

summary: Measures construction progress from drawings and phone photos per BOQ
readme_summary: SiteSight imports architect drawings to propose BOQ items, then SAM 3.1 segments phone photos to quantify built progress. Agent trace shows accepted and rejected detections for engineer review. Built on Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 with web review UI.

summary: Scam checker that rates risky messages, images, voice notes and QR codes
readme_summary: Accepts text, screenshots, voice, QR and links and returns risk verdict with explanation and next steps. Backend plus frontend and mobile clients in Docker. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for image checks.

summary: Record a browser task once and replay it over CSV rows with self-healing
readme_summary: Teach-Once records a narrated browser demo and compiles it to a deterministic parameterized workflow. Run executes rows with no model calls and triggers healing only on site change. Uses Meta models for compilation and repair with Python playback engine.

summary: Research tool checking if red blood cell changes are real or noise
readme_summary: HelpChoreAI does flow-corrected longitudinal RBC tracking for VPS13A disease research. Python/Modal app validates measurement quality before trusting change, built to accelerate scientific experiments.

summary: Verifies mechanical reassembly in 2 stages and regenerates missing CAD links.
readme_summary: Plane-aware 2.5D teardown system with fast local check plus Meta model confirmation. Backend plus frontend with STEP/STL regeneration from millimeter estimates. Uses muse-spark-open-1026 on Baseten for stage-2 vision gate and parametric CAD.

summary: Autonomous manga studio that keeps character identity and lettering consistent.
readme_summary: Autonomous comic production engine that parses scripts, plans panels, locks character identity, and places lettering deterministically. Python backend with frontend studio and visual judge. Uses Meta AI models for generation with reference-sheet continuity.

summary: Desktop workbench that reviews engineering drawing sets and exports QA reports
readme_summary: Moke imports drawing PDFs, runs whole-set or discipline reviews, and tracks findings with coverage and offline HTML reports. Built as a desktop plus backend workbench, it uses Meta Muse models for reasoning and SAM for image reading with auto model routing.

summary: Turns unmeasured cooking videos into written recipe cards with estimated amounts
readme_summary: Expo app plus FastAPI server with plate, measure and client pipeline for video analysis. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark 1.3 for recipes and Muse Voice Transcribe for narration.

summary: AI troubleshooting for environmental stations with evidence-first repair approval
readme_summary: AI-assisted troubleshooting for technicians maintaining environmental monitoring stations. Finds where data delivery stops, proposes one exact change for approval, then proves recovery. FastAPI backend, React TypeScript frontend, Meta Muse.

summary: Turns tennis training video into player movement data and coaching insights
readme_summary: CourtSense extracts player trajectories and movement metrics from a coach's training video. Built with Next.js, TypeScript and validation scripts using SAM 3.1 for tracking. It uses SAM 3.1 for player segmentation, Muse Spark 1.3 for analysis plus Muse Voice and Image.

summary: Turns store map photo and shopping list into shortest walking route
readme_summary: Snap a store map, input list by text/photo/voice, get optimal walking route. AI drafts map and matches terms for human review, exact solver routes. Web app on Cloudflare Pages works offline with on-device matching.

summary: Turns hard questions into visual analogies with self-checked drawings
readme_summary: Lets users ask a concept, pick a familiar world, and get 3 analogies with generated explanation and image. Built with Python backend and web frontend. Uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark for analogies and image checking.

summary: NestJS service reconciling farm dispatches to plant using multimodal AI OCR
readme_summary: Automates field-to-plant reconciliation with Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning and ERP RAG, Muse Glimmer OCR for handwritten guias, and Muse Spark Open failover via Modal and Fireworks. NestJS microservice built for Startup Build for Your World.

summary: Security and forensic prover for paid x402 API endpoints on Base Mainnet
readme_summary: Verifies 16 x402 v2 USDC resources with OpenAPI discovery, Bazaar manifest and referral receipts. Provides formal security checks for DeFi agents. Docker backend with frontend and x402scan verified servers.

summary: Sorts songwriting voice memos into takes filed by your spoken cues.
readme_summary: Keeper uploads long songwriting memos, cuts sung/played takes and files them by nearby speech like verse or scrap. Rejected takes preserved, canvas arranges demo and exports WAV. Solo Indie build with live Modal web app.

summary: Browser-local tree motion analysis producing arborist evidence briefs.
readme_summary: Combines local video motion measurement with planning and review workflows for tree inspection. Full local app with Node frontend and backend, Docker/Cloudflare setup. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 to plan measurements and interpret evidence for qualified arborists.

summary: Muse agents that attack Pi energy controller via hardware-in-loop to prove bugs
readme_summary: Hardware-in-loop rig where $20 STM32 simulates battery/inverter/grid to attack Raspberry Pi controller over Modbus RTU. Muse Spark agents find, prove with timers, fix and re-attack. Found 4 bugs, 31/31 checks.

summary: 3D jeepney twin for seat-aware trip planning with Taglish voice guidance
readme_summary: SakaySightAI simulates Metro Manila jeepney routes in 3D on OpenStreetMap for drivers and commuters. Web app with Firebase and Vercel API reroutes, waits and prices choices in pesos. Uses Meta Muse Wonder as voice/photo agent.

summary: Audits kirana shop WhatsApp bills, voice notes and schemes to find lost money
readme_summary: Khata analyzes weeks of distributor WhatsApp chats, bill photos, rate lists and voice-note schemes for kirana shops. Reconciles bills and payments to produce owner report of leakages. Python pipeline with docs, evals, tests and Meta hackathon Build for Your World entry.

summary: Voice note and photo turned into website, reel and caption for shops
readme_summary: SMB launch tool that turns voice note and product photo into website, reel and caption with code-checked prices. Uses Muse Spark, Wonder, Image, SAM 3.1 and Voice via Meta Model API. Node plus Python stack with 232 tests.

summary: Measures coffee leaf rust and cherry ripeness from phone photos
readme_summary: Turns phone leaf photos into rust measurement, ripeness counts and farm dashboard. Powered by Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for analysis. Full-stack app with backend, frontend and live deployment.

summary: Inspects robot demos with synced video, SAM masks and cited checks
readme_summary: Investigates robot demonstrations with synchronized video, SAM 3.1 observations and source-backed checks. Provides cited Muse Spark explanations with missing evidence flagged. Stack is React plus FastAPI.

summary: AI director turning live music, lyrics and crowd into reactive concert visuals
readme_summary: Director agent fuses flyer, live audio, and crowd camera into real-time audio-reactive visualizer with custom shaders. Built with Next.js and WebGL shaders system. Uses Muse Spark, Wonder, Voice, SAM 3.1 and Glimmer.

summary: Checks Korean ad posters and copy for cultural issues with cited evidence
readme_summary: NARAK reviews posters, copy and dates against public sources and a case registry with evidence trails. Built with Next.js on Vercel, it uses Muse Spark 1.3 for research, SAM 3.1 for region outlines and Muse Image 1.0 for labeled variants.

summary: Finds hospital billing errors and missed aid from bill photos
readme_summary: BillRadar reads hospital bills and EOBs from photos or video to flag errors and financial assistance. Python Docker stack with docs, eval and samples, built on Meta models for document vision and reasoning.

summary: WhatsApp agent that turns notas and voice notes into sales records
readme_summary: CatatAI receives photos of handwritten notas, voice notes or Bahasa text on WhatsApp and extracts structured sales records. Reads results back for confirmation before saving to support warung bookkeeping. Python agent using Meta AI models with correction and DB layers.

summary: Multi-agent crypto risk scorer showing measured risk stats and counter-arguments
readme_summary: Multi-agent crypto risk intelligence Streamlit app with transparent score, backtesting and Devil's Advocate review. Built with Python, Streamlit and matrix_engine agents. Uses Muse Spark for risk reasoning in English and Turkish for education only.

summary: Ewe voice assistant for chat, translation, and learning.
readme_summary: Voice app with Talk, Translate, and Learn modes for Ewe speakers. Pipeline combines fine-tuned Meta MMS for STT, Muse Spark via Meta Model API for dialogue, and EchoVoiice/MMS-TTS for speech.

summary: Autonomous multimodal agent for hardware and signal diagnostics
readme_summary: Hardware diagnostics agent combining DSP batch replay, telemetry verification and structured tool calling. Python plus web stack with CI verification. Uses Muse Spark Open, Llama, Baseten, Fireworks and Modal.

summary: County-level corn yield nowcasts from satellite and weather before USDA.
readme_summary: Estimates Iowa corn and soybean yields county by county from public satellite and weather with classical ML. Shows SAM 3.1 field outlines on 3D globe with reproducible benchmark vs USDA. Docker Compose harness with docs and benchmarks.

summary: CI harness that tests V-JEPA world models and auto-fixes robot failures
readme_summary: CI for JEPA world models that runs V-JEPA 2-AC raw to create regression tests, probes perception vs control failure, then edits weights and guardrails. Muse Spark Open subagents diagnose and fix, gated promotion with JSONL logs.

summary: Turns traffic camera video into road measurements and closure forecasts
readme_summary: FlowCast reads town traffic camera recordings to measure vehicles, flow and speed, builds network state and KPIs, and forecasts closures or jams with a graph model. Dashboard plus Traffic Assistant uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API, with Muse Glimmer local option, and SAM 3.1 for vision.

summary: Pixel factory game over GitHub where issues become shipped pull requests
readme_summary: Shiptorio gamifies GitHub workflow as a pixel conveyor: issues move through Planner, Builder, Checks and Gate. Powered by Meta Muse Spark for planning and building. Human approves Ship it to merge real PRs.

summary: Voice-controlled AI co-op partner for blind and low-vision gamers
readme_summary: Player Two reads the game window, answers questions aloud and sends controller/keyboard input via voice. It uses a local fast path plus Muse Spark tool loop with pathfinding. Built on Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1.

summary: Voice note plus pill-pack photos in, one-page linked brief for clinicians out
readme_summary: Anamnesis ingests patient voice notes and medicine-pack photos to generate a one-page clinician brief with audio-turn and image-region citations. Built with Muse Code and Meta open-weight models. Staged tests only, no medical advice or clinical use.

summary: WhatsApp agents that receipt FMCG deliveries and track shop payments
readme_summary: Mimi serves Nigerian FMCG distributors with WhatsApp receipts, multilingual confirmation and dispute flags. Reads payment screenshots and promise-to-pay with code verification. Stack is Docker, Postgres with Alembic, bridges to WhatsApp.

summary: Local-first vault giving agents scoped access without seeing secrets
readme_summary: Local-first wallet where coding agents request capabilities, not keys. Local Meta marshal model vets requests, policy enforces scope and expiry, vaultd injects secrets per execution. Desktop app for approval and audit.

summary: Wishlist app that finds real prices and plans when you can afford each goal
readme_summary: Dandelist turns wishlists into costed plans by finding live seller prices and monthly upkeep. Monorepo with apps, packages and infra running on iPhone, Android and web from one codebase. Uses an AI shopping agent for price lookup and affordability timing.

summary: Converts prompts and documents into narrated, sourced explainer videos.
readme_summary: Agentic pipeline on Meta models that plans, scripts, directs and renders videos with review loops. Keeps plan, script, sources, credits and costs; supports PDFs, Office and images.

summary: Agent that drafts building controls and verifies them before live building run.
readme_summary: Agent that turns written sequences into block-graph building control logic. Muse Spark drafts logic, deterministic control engine replays test vectors, only verified drafts run on BOPTEST emulation. Rust workspace with Docker.

summary: Agentic food network balancing cost, health and convenience for daily meals.
readme_summary: Spinach Kitchenless orchestrates food agents over channels with guardrails, MCP layer and data stores. Stack is Docker Compose, Python 3.12, Postgres with mock mode, evals and smoke tests.

summary: WhatsApp agents for contractors and suppliers that agree on signed bills
readme_summary: Each business gets a WhatsApp ledger agent that records bookings, deliveries and payments. Uses Muse models to read/explain documents with deterministic code checks, A2A sync and dual-signed records.

summary: Turns personal photos into traced design rules and product screens
readme_summary: Tearsheet extracts colors, light and layout measurements from user photos into reusable design rules. It then generates product screens where every choice traces to a photo spot. Built with Muse Spark on Meta Model API as a web app with live demo.

summary: Visual React Flow studio for designing stateful AI agent workflows and logic
readme_summary: Provides a canvas-based StateCraft editor for modeling agent states and transitions. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, React Flow and Bun. Powered by Meta Muse Spark via Baseten inference for agent reasoning.

summary: Verified real-estate listing packs where every claim links to photo or audio proof.
readme_summary: Evidomo turns agent photos and voice walkthroughs into publication-ready packs with code-enforced sourcing. Monorepo with web app, Docker Compose and human review gates. Uses Muse Spark for transcription, claim extraction and multilingual packs.

summary: Agentic category manager that vets vendors and proves every number
readme_summary: Screens new vendors for documents and injection, decides SKU bets and terms, then monitors category. Deterministic verifiers prove numbers on synthetic data. Backend plus frontend stack recorded live against Muse Spark, Muse Image and SAM 3.1.

summary: 3D cartonization assistant that measures items and plans optimal box packing
readme_summary: Detects items at packing bench, fits 3D cuboids with uncertainty, extracts handling semantics, and optimizes placement with OR-Tools. Frontend is React + Three.js with manual override. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for semantics plus deterministic validator.

summary: Self-curating agent memory that organizes itself at write time over MCP
readme_summary: Universal MCP server with 9 tools for persistent agent memory with write-time curation, linking and consolidation. Avoids brute-force search via structured recall. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Code, evaluated on 22 scenarios.

summary: Turns your daily life context into personalized English lessons and printable book
readme_summary: Language-learning app that generates daily lessons from learner-shared context. Practices expressions then files pages into printable book. Built for hackathon with Muse models, Cloudflare Pages and Functions stack.

summary: Converts Python functions to verified Dafny code or returns a failing test case.
readme_summary: Pipeline infers intent, writes executable spec, transpiles Python to Dafny and proves it. Success yields verifiable proof certificate, failure yields concrete counterexample test. Uses escalating prover stages.

summary: Turns a phone walk video into a wheelchair accessibility report with tracked barriers
readme_summary: Film bus-stop to entrance, AccessWalk detects barriers tied to SAM 3.1 tracked objects and frames. Full-stack with backend, frontend, eval and deploy scripts for route accessibility reporting.

summary: Splits AI-written PRs into must-review regions and safe-to-skip code
readme_summary: Python service that chunks PRs into ~25-line regions with risk scores, P0-P2 priority and inline comments. Proves safe skips via syntax-tree checks. Uses Muse Spark API and Muse Code for analysis and calibration.

summary: Turns one shelf video with spoken prices into product catalog, ads, and WhatsApp sales
readme_summary: Live on airi.chat, it converts a single shop video into cleaned product photos, verified prices, video ads, and Instagram / Click-to-WhatsApp ads. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for extraction, SAM 3.1 for cutouts, and Muse Image 1.0 for studio images inside WhatsApp inbox.

summary: Farm planning PWA with field maps, crop ranking, weather alerts and voice assistant
readme_summary: Progressive web app for Indian farmers to map fields, compare crops, and track daily tasks and journal. Combines satellite maps, weather, Sentinel-2 indices and profit estimates. Evara assistant answers from farm records with voice input via Muse models.

summary: Converts refund policies into sealed tests and verified prompt fixes
readme_summary: Support Bot Rescue compiles written policies into code-checkable rules and sealed holdout conversations. It detects violations, rewrites prompts and verifies fixes with Meta models as target and attacker.

summary: AI agent recovers dead Linux servers using only console pixels and keyboard
readme_summary: Agent reads server console screenshots via Muse Spark native computer tool, types fixes and cycles power. Independent external prober verifies recovery via SSH login, nonce and data hash.

summary: Hands-free car-care companion that guides maintenance and recalls history
readme_summary: Carmori guides maintenance tasks with voice interaction, vehicle-specific history, and rule-based workflow control. Web backend with voice-service and render deployment. Combines Meta multimodal models for Q&A and guidance with persistent maintenance memory.

summary: Turns mid-roll breaks into custom motion-design bridges per video
readme_summary: Analyzes video to select break points and writes a scene-specific bridge into the ad. Generates per-video transitions so one ad adapts to thousands of videos. Built with Meta models, render and voice pipeline.

summary: Research partner for engineering and science with anti-hallucination answers
readme_summary: Tribos is a research assistant that grounds answers in retrieved sources to reduce hallucination. It provides demo, docs and quick-start for technical Q&A. Built with FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend and Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning.

summary: Auto-discovers custom compression algorithms and ships them as plugins.
readme_summary: Algomini automates discovery of novel compression algorithms as reusable plugins. Built with Rust crates, Python lab, and GitHub Actions cloud. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for research and code generation.

summary: Goal agent that detects stalled goals and proposes the smallest approved next step
readme_summary: IrysQuest monitors a local-first quest log via MCP to detect stalled goals and propose minimal next moves for approval. Python CLI uses Muse-powered breakdowns with voice and notebook-photo capture; demo runs with no keys.

summary: Checks tender bid packages against tender documents with code-verified quotes
readme_summary: TenderCheck extracts requirements from tender docs and matches bidder files using Muse Spark. Deterministic code verifies every quoted requirement against source text and scanned seal/date fields. Human makes final eligibility decision; no auto-compliance claim.

summary: Turns office videos into bilingual listings, restaged photos and chat booking
readme_summary: Office listing agent where owners upload video to get structured specs, Arabic/English listing and restyled photos. Next.js 16 + TypeScript + Tailwind 4 with WhatsApp-gated publishing. Uses Meta AI vision and chat models for extraction, staging and Egyptian Arabic booking.

summary: Turns international student advising meetings into SEVIS-ready compliance records
readme_summary: Sits in on DSO advising appointments and builds the compliance record live from audio. Stack is web frontend with relay backend and Netlify hosting. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech and Muse Spark agent for regulation-grounded notes.

summary: AI layer that reads and routes health-payer debits while keeping humans approving
readme_summary: Independent AI layer over debit-management for Argentine health payers to read, reconcile and route deductions. Standalone Python demo with 100% fictitious data. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for document understanding with human approval.

summary: Phone video cable tension measurement with physics validation and engineer-signed reports.
readme_summary: Resonance estimates cable tension and vibration from slow-motion phone video and refuses on physics failure. SAM 3.1 finds cables via MLX or Meta API, physics validates, Muse Spark writes report. Screening tool requiring engineer signature.

summary: Turns lab check-ins and interviews into living research project memory
readme_summary: Next.js + Supabase app that ingests weekly check-ins, interview recordings and plans to preserve knowledge across student turnover. Built solo for Build for Your World Indie track with Vercel demo and judge login.

summary: WhatsApp AI that converts palm farm daily reports into owner dashboard data
readme_summary: Palm plantation ops system where foremen send daily reports via WhatsApp Cloud API webhook to an agent router. AI extracts structured JSON to PostgreSQL via Prisma for owner dashboard in SAP Fiori style. Monorepo with apps, packages, Docker and Supabase.

summary: Turns checkout criteria into human-approved browser tests with evidence.
readme_summary: ProofPath proposes semantic checks with muse-spark-1.3 for human review and snapshot approval. Playwright runs paired release comparisons with deterministic PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE verdicts. V2 adds evidence downloads, regression reuse, and bug packets.

summary: Places contextual in-scene ads in video while keeping story and actors identical
readme_summary: AdVision system for intent-based in-scene ad placement with identical timing and cast. Uses a unified Meta client for Muse Spark reasoning, Muse Wonder video understanding, Muse Image backdrops, and SAM 3.1 segmentation. Built with Next.js frontend and backend adapter plus Baseten fallback.

summary: Zero-trust engine that requires AI fixes to prove red-to-green test passage
readme_summary: Forces coding agents to prove fixes via immutability guard, baseline failure reproduction, and Muse Spark to Wonder debate for minimal patch. Emits TGRES SHA-256 receipt. Ships as pip package and GitHub Action with evidence dossier.

summary: Snaps fridge photo to map freshness and plan meals first
readme_summary: Turns one fridge photo into ingredient freshness map and prioritizes recipes for food about to spoil. Live Next.js + Convex app built on Meta models for Build for Your World, with English/French UI.

summary: Physics-based embodied AI playground tuning control policies with MuJoCo simulation
readme_summary: Kintsugi Sensei is a robotics research app with MuJoCo physics, Optuna tuning, Python server and web UI. It experiments with control policies in simulation. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for vision and Muse Image for generation.

summary: Chrome extension to operate web pages by voice and expose controls to AI agents.
readme_summary: Turns page controls into labeled callable tools used via side-panel voice or typed requests. Local MCP server gives external agents the same tools through one executor with human approval for submit, pay or delete. Docker, Chrome extension and MCP docs.

summary: Self-hosted gateway sharing team codebase context across AI tools to cut repeat work.
readme_summary: OpenAI-compatible gateway ingests code and docs once with Postgres row-level security scoping. Open models via vLLM or Ollama build memory and answer locally, with Docker, dashboard and evals. Uses Muse models for shared context.

summary: Investigative tool where models propose timelines and code checks evidence
readme_summary: CaseWeave helps investigators test conflicting accounts against evidence with propose-check-replay-review flow. Built with FastAPI backend, worker and frontend plus Docker, a Meta model drafts hypotheses while deterministic code validates possibility for human review.

summary: Live 3D digital twin that monitors bridges and defects from sensors and video
readme_summary: InfraTwin-Live maps bridges, tunnels and dams in 3D with sensor health and AI video inspection. Stack is Dockerized backend/frontend with Modal workers, using SAM 3.1, Muse Spark/Wonder, Image and Voice.

summary: Multi-agent coding system that requires you to prove understanding to proceed
readme_summary: Orchestrator plans tasks, Code/Test/Research workers implement in workspace with verification. Learning Gates quiz understanding before unlock, with local memory adapting future gates.

summary: Flight recorder that verifies screen-based AI agents with evidence packs
readme_summary: BlackboxAI ingests screen recordings or sandbox events plus task/policy to produce step-level verdicts. Monorepo with apps/packages, Docker compose and docs/demo evidence packs. Uses SAM 3.1 for cursor/UI tracking and Muse models for verification.

summary: Turns bug recordings with narration into failing Playwright tests.
readme_summary: Converts screen recording plus narration and keyframes into steps, bug claim and generated Playwright test. Python backend with Modal web and practice store. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark for extraction and test writing.

summary: Cephalometric hair analysis that prescribes barber cuts without swapping identity
readme_summary: Zero-identity-swapping hairstyle engine using MediaPipe 468 landmarks for face measurement. Web app with Vercel frontend and Python API backend. Uses Meta AI models for prescription reasoning while preserving user identity.

summary: Verifies second-hand items by visible flaws for trusted remote trade
readme_summary: Investigator agent maps wear fingerprints with SAM segmentation, challenge codes and guided photo checks. Stack is Streamlit app with business API. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Voice Transcribe for verification.

summary: Compares AI coding plans, API prices, and benchmarks in USD.
readme_summary: Static site cataloging coding subscriptions and pay-as-you-go API prices with official links and model benchmarks. Built with Node/pnpm and Cloudflare Pages from versioned data and scripts.

summary: Turns survey photos into zebra counts, IDs, and population estimates
readme_summary: WildWitness processes wildlife photos into counts, individual IDs and capture-recapture estimates using SAM 3.1, Muse Spark Open and Muse Wonder. A research agent answers questions grounded to tool results. Deployed on Modal with dashboard and evals.

summary: AI travel agent that plans trips and books real flights via Norba API.
readme_summary: Next.js travel assistant built on Meta models for pre-trip, in-trip and post-trip help. Integrates Norba API over HTTPS for real flight booking plus vision, voice and MCP tools. Includes agency desk and checkout links.

summary: Photo-puzzle game where SAM cutouts solve pencil-drawn museum levels
readme_summary: Browser puzzle game where players photograph objects and tap to segment them. SAM 3.1 provides point-prompt masks used as physics colliders. Muse Spark acts as Curator level designer and hint voice with engine-verified claims.

summary: Property tool combining records, zoning and editable plans for small builders
readme_summary: Combines parcel records, zoning sources and editable massing plans to compare small development options. Includes research and modeling apps with underwriting estimates and interactive walkthroughs. Built as full monorepo with infra and docs for Astoria case study.

summary: Personal AI workbook that teaches any skill, helps when stuck, and badges mastery.
readme_summary: Learner profile generates custom workbook for 309+ skills, plus hints, grading and gap fix-ups. Web + API + Docker stack for all ages. Every AI call uses Meta Model API: Muse Spark, Muse Image, SAM 3.1, Voice Transcribe.

summary: AI supervisor watching browser SOPs to stop compliance errors
readme_summary: Real-time supervisor agent that watches shared browser tab, tracks SOP execution, and intervenes on skipped or invalid steps. Frontend replay demo plus Python backend, with docs, evals, and live Vercel replay for enterprise web procedures.

summary: Turns a screen recording of a web bug into a replayed Playwright test and fix PR.
readme_summary: Gecko ingests screen recordings into contact sheets, transcribes narration, replays actions in a real browser, and generates a failing Playwright test. Muse Code then fixes the bug against that test, only merging when green. Stack includes browser replay, Playwright, Docker, and web backend.

summary: On-device focus copilot using biometrics to sustain deep work states
readme_summary: Edge-first cognitive ergonomics agent for developer productivity. MediaPipe + TensorFlow.js extracts posture and PERCLOS on-device at 60 FPS. Uses Muse Spark for streaming interventions via SSE and Muse Wonder for task decomposition, plus SAM 3.1.

summary: AI sales desk for social vendors with grounded replies and checkout links.
readme_summary: SellAI gives small vendors an AI desk across Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp. Next.js app handles multilingual intents, catalog-grounded replies, and checkout to dashboard. Uses Meta Muse models for intent and sales dialogue.

summary: Turns talking-head clips into videos with timed diagrams behind the speaker
readme_summary: ExplainCut transcribes an uploaded webcam clip, plans a timed diagram, renders it in code and composites it behind the cut-out speaker. Next.js app uses ffmpeg-static with no system FFmpeg needed. Runs on Meta Model API with SAM 3.1 segmentation.

summary: Reviews dubbed video like code review with timestamped fix threads
readme_summary: Uploads original and dubbed video with a brief to return timestamped review threads. Combines Muse Spark 1.3 audio-video judge on short clips with deterministic signal checks. Serves results via REST, MCP, webhook plus side-by-side UI.

summary: Flood dispatch planner that finds cut-off buildings from satellite and road maps
readme_summary: Lifeline compares before/after satellite photos with road networks to detect cut roads, isolated buildings, and ranked entry points. It writes cited dispatch briefs and provides an Ask-the-map assistant for typed or spoken questions over results.

summary: Turns screen recordings into cited playbooks an agent can replay and verify
