readme_summary: Shadow converts expert recording and narration into a reviewable playbook with source links. An agent then replays the task, asking where the recording is unclear. Backend and frontend on Modal, supports Meta Model API and Muse Spark Open.

summary: Turns trader voice notes into structured ledgers, debts, and invoices
readme_summary: Voizgger converts informal market voice notes into ledgers, debt SMS, shelf audits and invoices. Built with Python Flask and Docker, it uses Muse Voice Transcribe for STT and Muse Spark for extraction.

summary: Desktop AI coding workspace with verified builds, Git, terminal and browser.
readme_summary: Trebell Code is a desktop workspace for building software, running commands, reviewing diffs, and browser verification. Uses Electron-style desktop plus Node tooling. Uses Trebell Native model loop with optional Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode integrations.

summary: Fits physics equations from phone video and overlays predictions as ghosts
readme_summary: Upload pendulum or fall video to track objects, calibrate time series and fit competing physics models on first 60% only. Overlays predictions and designs deciding experiment. Built for Push the Frontier with vision tracking.

summary: Signed prepaid credits and verification for autonomous agent payments over HTTP
readme_summary: Mudrika provides signed prepaid credits with budget limits for agents paying over HTTP 402, plus SAM 3.1 credential verification. Uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark via Meta Model API and Muse Spark Open via Baseten.

summary: Browser workspace to design robot cells, simulate motion, and export programs
readme_summary: Enginuity turns plain English into robot-cell layouts, simulated motion tests, and controller-native program exports in the browser. Next.js + TypeScript frontend with Rust/Python crates and Docker. Uses Muse models for agentic cell building and motion planning.

summary: Oil terminal linking prices with satellite tank measurements
readme_summary: TERRATERM pairs crude prices and news with satellite detection of Cushing tanks and EIA inventory. Keyboard-driven terminal with agent Q&A and sources. Uses Muse Wonder for models, SAM 3.1 for tank spotting, Muse Spark for checks.

summary: Photos of balconies or gardens mapped to monthly sun paths and direct-sun hours.

summary: One-shot factory visual inspection from a single good part photo.
readme_summary: Shows one good part photo then checks bottles, bolts, PCBs and garments via phone camera for defects. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for segmentation via Meta Model API. Python backend with web frontend and benchmark suite.

summary: Robot plus phone inspector mapping street hazards with photos and city case records.
readme_summary: Neighborhood inspection prototype pairing rugged robot and Android phone with Next.js admin portal. Leaflet/OpenStreetMap UI with photos, SAM highlights and city reports on SQLite. Uses SAM for hazard segmentation and Muse models for case descriptions.

summary: Verifies industrial maintenance evidence before engineers trust and apply RAG.
readme_summary: Multimodal verification for maintenance queries with cited evidence and trust scores. FastAPI backend, Cloudflare frontend, pytest benchmark. Uses Muse Spark Open for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for image grounding.

summary: Version control for self-improving agents with jury-tested commits and revertible edits
readme_summary: Issue-triage agent that learns project conventions from corrections. Uses git-style commits, jury evaluation on held-out data, and traceable reviews. Built with Python harness, dashboard, and Meta Muse models for reasoning and judging.

summary: Gamified focus app where a cat blocks distractions and rewards real-life perks.
readme_summary: Tracks blocked apps and sites, focus sessions, points, streaks, and redeemable local rewards. Every AI feature runs on Meta Muse models including Spark chat. Stack spans backend, web, Android, desktop, and browser extension with Google sign-in.

summary: Cognitive world-model mind where SAM vision and LLM proposals face checks
readme_summary: Embodied cognitive model with internal world model for a simulated robot. Uses SAM 3.1 as vision eye, Muse and Llama for proposals that pass gates and rehearsal. Built during hackathon with proof register and demo video.

summary: Proactive coding agent that proves fixes in sandbox and proposes PRs
readme_summary: Unbidden is a proactive engineering agent that detects improvements, validates in sandbox and opens pull requests with evidence. Python 3.12 architecture with install, evidence and bench docs. Uses Meta models for analysis.

summary: AI caseworker for newcomers in Poland tracking letters and deadlines.
readme_summary: Mobile-first Next.js app that reads letters/emails, builds one case file with law-derived deadlines and live interprets. Built on Meta Muse models; guides only, never files or gives legal advice.

summary: Active-investigation agent that organizes DFIR evidence and next verifiable steps.
readme_summary: KRAKADYL keeps forensic cases organized, flags missing recoverable evidence and coordinates next steps within a fixed mandate. AI proposes, deterministic engine checks, human verifies. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 with research map and demo frontend.

summary: Mobile chat assistant that prepares radiology studies over DICOMweb
readme_summary: On-call radiology resident as mobile chat app connected via DICOMweb for study preparation and discussion. Uses Muse Glimmer on Modal with RAD-QC v5 LoRA check and Muse Spark fallback. Workflow tool only; radiologist signs.

summary: AI support agent that sees your screen and guides fixes live on call
readme_summary: Charie joins support calls, sees customer screen, guides troubleshooting step-by-step, then creates tickets and verified fixes with human approval. Autonomous loops for support, QA and security monitoring. Monorepo with apps/services and deploy config.

summary: Operator-guided workbench to diagnose and fix Entra ID, Intune and Azure issues
readme_summary: Routes MSP tickets and builds remediation views with typed actions and human approval. Uses Glimmer 30B for hover explanations, Spark 1.3 for routing, Wonder 1.0 for scoping and fixes, Voice Transcribe for commands. MCP + web app stack.

summary: Bilingual Arabic-English auto-reply app handling business texts, voice notes and images.
readme_summary: Autonomous multimodal B2B smart-reply Android app for text, voice notes and images in Arabic and English. Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose Material 3 on Android 14. Runs 100% on Meta Model API with 640+ unit tests.

summary: Glasses witness that answers what it saw and keeps photo proof
readme_summary: Truss watches via Meta Wearables Toolkit, speaks answer when it sees it, e.g. pill already taken, with photo proof. Android app plus Python-stdlib-only server. Uses Meta-only models for always-on visual memory.

summary: Measures size and speed in video with 90% intervals or explicit refusal
readme_summary: Video measurement tool turning plain questions into measurement plans via Muse Spark. SAM 3.1 tracks objects and Python computes size/speed with 90% intervals. Validated on tape-measured clips and GPS scooter passes.

summary: Snaps WAEC physics questions to auto-build interactive 3D lab benches
readme_summary: Converts WAEC physics practical photos into 3D experiments with Watch, Practise and Exam modes and WAEC-style marking. Built for Nigerian WASSCE prep with Firebase hosting, demo video and solo hackathon build.

summary: Agentic auditor testing if kidney spatial signals survive segmentation errors
readme_summary: Co-scientist for kidney research that delegates investigation planning, controls, and literature review to Meta models. Deterministic Python code computes all numbers from artifacts. Checks RNA-to-cell assignment robustness.

summary: Playground for building community apps where member agents act together
readme_summary: Agora is a platform for creating community apps for trade, learning, and organizing. It provides primitives for communication, geo, matching, and workflows via agents. Users describe needs in Muse which generates the app on Agora.

summary: Creates 10-60s social commercials from a website with your own API key.
readme_summary: Next.js BYOK studio turns URL into script then Meta.ai prompts and stitched video in under 10 minutes. Key stays in browser, pay provider directly. Supports Standard and Contributor modes for platforms and vibes.

summary: Answers place questions from satellite imagery and map layers
readme_summary: Geospatial auditing engine pulls satellite imagery vs OSM/Google Maps to return metrics, verdict and memo with GeoJSON/CSV export. Backend plus web/mobile clients in English/Swahili. Uses Muse Spark memo with live web search grounding.

summary: Voice helper on a senior's phone that reads mail aloud quoting only what it sees.
readme_summary: Biscuit watches the mailbox, chimes on arrival, reads letters aloud and asks follow-ups. Quote-grounded answers, family page and 911 escalation. Built as Kindred AI product for Build for Your World.

summary: Recovery loop for coding agents that bisects, fixes and remembers failures
readme_summary: Doc records AI coding agent turns to bisect breaking changes, then plans fixes with Muse Wonder and parallel Muse Code agents. It stores approved lessons for future sessions, driving the pre-existing dmc rollback tool via six Meta models.

summary: Personal memory system that tracks videos, files and commands you already saw.
readme_summary: Enheduanna logs screen, video, file and shell activity into searchable memory. Helps recall what video, author or file was seen weeks ago. Includes visualizer, config and scripts with Muse models.

summary: Durable long-horizon agent workspace for building and testing software
readme_summary: OpenHarness pairs a durable run engine and tenant-scoped APIs with a Vite SPA and sandboxed runtimes. Hackathon work added browser-check loop, Modal live-browser takeover and MCP skill gating. Orchestrates Muse Spark 1.3, Wonder, Glimmer 30B, Image, Voice and SAM 3.1.

summary: Simulated search-rescue drone piloted by fly hemibrain spiking model
readme_summary: ROS 2 and Gazebo simulation with X3 multirotor, coverage planner and Drosophila hemibrain spiking pilot. MCP server exposes start, monitor and stop controls. Designed for Muse-powered agents via MCP.

summary: AI front-of-house for resorts with live booking, pricing and staff handoff
readme_summary: Multilingual concierge checks live availability, quotes exact price, holds rooms and links to resort pay page. Unverifiable requests route to staff with transcript. Built with Next.js, Muse Spark, Prisma and voice support.

summary: Turns sung or played sketches into editable orchestral scores for your DAW
readme_summary: Takes MIDI, MusicXML or sung/hummed audio and transcribes it into readable scores with Arrange, Expand and Recompose modes. Web app with MIDI/MusicXML export for DAW editing. Uses Muse Spark for transcription and orchestration reasoning.

summary: Adaptive tutor that teaches lessons, quizzes you, and plans what to learn next
readme_summary: Adaptive learning companion with Learn-Practice-Evaluate-Adapt loop from courses or PDFs. Combines course context, practice results and feedback. Uses Meta Muse Spark for teaching and Muse Image for visuals.

summary: Reflects conversation patterns back to help you see yourself more clearly
readme_summary: Journaling reflection app that observes everyday conversations and surfaces patterns. Built on Meta Muse Spark with Next.js 16 in EN/VI. No account or database, privacy-first client design with live Vercel app.

summary: Vietnamese voice tutor that shows every screen click step-by-step
readme_summary: Windows Python tutor that guides users through on-screen tasks with visual click overlays while user retains control. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and Muse Voice Transcribe. Includes grounding, STT, TTS and tutor evals.

summary: Checks if new security advisories actually affect your code, with evidence
readme_summary: SaveBell ingests advisories, vuln DBs and security news, fact-checks reports and maps them to connected GitHub repos. It inspects file and line level code to decide applicability and proposes fixes. Built as Next.js app with Muse models for analysis.

summary: Bio-responsive Android companion linking health, calendar and finance data
readme_summary: LifeSOS Android app connects Health Connect, calendar, outflows and social ties into an empathetic companion. Jetpack Compose UI powered by Meta Muse Spark 1.3 with prompt-level safety guidance.

summary: Voice-first AI companion that speaks and acts in Tajik, Uzbek, and Russian.
readme_summary: Mobile plus server voice assistant that hears, remembers, and completes tasks in under-served languages. Adds custom speech pipeline around Muse models. Uses Muse models for dialogue with Voice Transcribe extensions for Tajik/Uzbek/Russian.

summary: Turns disassembly videos into step-by-step visual repair guides
readme_summary: Ingests video with ffmpeg, transcribes audio in 30s windows via Muse Voice, plans steps with Muse Spark anchored to quotes. Verifies timestamps mechanically and outlines parts per keyframe. Dockerized Python + web UI.

summary: Turns 1-3 photos plus Vietnamese voice into a full market listing.
readme_summary: Seller assistant for Cho Z marketplace in Zalo that converts photos and speech to title, category and pricing. Parallel pipeline generates studio image and attributes in seconds. Uses four Meta models for image, voice and text.

summary: On-device camera reader that calls cloud only when uncertain
readme_summary: Edge-to-cloud router reading IDs/codes: Perception LM 1B on Jetson Orin Nano reads locally in ~1.2s, scores token confidence, escalates to Muse Spark when unsure. Offline mode marks unverified and queues recheck. No training.

summary: WhatsApp reverse marketplace that brings budget-matched shops to you
readme_summary: MoranBuy is an AI reverse marketplace on WhatsApp for text, photo and voice requests with budget-first offer ranking and held payments. Uses only Meta models via Meta Model API for matching and chat.

summary: AI accessibility audits that create reviewable GitHub fix pull requests
readme_summary: TypeScript monorepo with React+Vite frontend and Azure Functions API backed by Cosmos DB and Key Vault. Audits sites for accessibility issues and opens reviewable GitHub Issues/PRs. Uses Meta-compatible Model API for remediation suggestions.

summary: Private 3D spatial memory for glasses and robots with on-device face and plate blurring.
readme_summary: Loci captures eye-level walks, blurs faces/plates/screens, detects objects and states, and maps them in metric 3D. Answers cite observations with time, position and frames, verified before display. Uses Muse models for QA plus vision models for detection and 3D localization.

summary: Turns WhatsApp voice notes and photos into ERP orders with self-learning rules
readme_summary: Converts mixed Darja, French and Arabic chat orders into distributor ERP lines. Go service with ERP adapters and rule engine. Uses Muse Spark to write matching rules, adversarial-test them, and pick products from code-built shortlists.

summary: Finds browser accessibility bugs and verifies fixes by deterministic replay
readme_summary: Monorepo with apps/packages that observes failures in a real browser and uses Meta models for bounded repairs. Rejects fixes until deterministic replay proves them. Key-less public deployment smoke-tested Nov 2026.

summary: Phone photo of warehouse aisle becomes damage tickets and inventory counts
readme_summary: AIsleEye segments boxes and floor markings from one photo, inspects damage, flags blocked walkways and files tickets after supervisor approval. Stack is Python backend, frontend app and infra scripts. Uses sam-3.1 for segmentation and muse-spark-1.3 for schema-constrained damage inspection.

summary: Single-file browser app to view, create and revise 3D and 2D educational models offline
readme_summary: Static single-page app shipped as one 430KB HTML file with no backend, using Three.js, Vue 3 and Tailwind via CDN. Runs generation and revision in-browser, likely calling Meta AI/Muse models for model creation for classroom 3D/2D visualization.

summary: Fuzzy photo search that finds the image you describe even with wrong details
readme_summary: Recall searches a 5,000-photo library from free-text descriptions with mistaken details. It doubts each clue, searches alternate interpretations, grounds objects visually, and asks up to three one-tap questions. It uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and Meta vision models for grounding, deployed on Modal.

summary: Turns rack photos into CMDB and compresses alerts into verified incidents.
readme_summary: Scans a server rack photo into a CMDB then triages 512 alerts into 3 verified incidents with tickets. Makefile-driven Python service. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, SAM 3.1, and Voice Transcribe.

summary: Singing game that adapts vocal exercises to your range and tracks pitch
readme_summary: Web app where users sing to guide a character collecting stars, with adaptive exercises, pitch detection, piano guide and drums. AI composes exercises from text, voice, sheet-music photo or drawing and generates art using Meta models.

summary: Turns river and typhoon data into cited flood alerts in 5 languages

summary: Diagnoses underperforming ad campaigns and verifies fixes in auction simulator
readme_summary: Verifiable agent that ingests delivery logs and bid requests to find root cause with evidence. FastAPI backend with contract-validated data tools and deterministic auction simulator for before/after proof. Uses Muse Spark tool-calling for diagnosis and fix proposal.

summary: Generates PIC firmware C code verified by emulation, solving, and real compilation

summary: Autonomous orbital analyst that tasks satellites to answer Earth queries
readme_summary: ARGUS is an autonomous analyst that plans, acquires satellite imagery, analyzes, verifies and alerts. Stack is FastAPI, React 19, Python 3.12, Docker. Uses Muse Spark for planning and reasoning plus SAM 3.1 for Earth observation analysis.

summary: Push-to-talk gadget giving older adults simple voice access to AI help
readme_summary: Confio is an ESP32 push-to-talk device plus web backend letting older adults ask questions, call family, take photos and SMS in their language. Includes prompts, deploy scripts and hardware docs. Uses Meta AI models for conversational assistance.

summary: Video tool that masks subjects and syncs effects to music beats
readme_summary: Python + web app that ingests clip and track, builds beat map and renders vertical video. Uses SAM 3.1 segmentation client to isolate subject, keeps background static. Three beat-locked effects with tests.

summary: Turns any arXiv paper into an interactive course with shared build and live progress

summary: Local-first AI video editor that builds grounded first cuts and highlight reels

summary: Adaptive learning app that locates knowledge gaps and teaches from there

summary: Verifies UI bug fixes with a trusted browser oracle and evidence

summary: 3D-print shop workflow from customer request to quote and printer reservation
readme_summary: Manufacturing assistant for Print3DStore with Muse Spark intake, STL validation, mesh preview and Bambu Studio estimates. FastAPI backend plus frontend with approval-gated job creation and printer failover.

summary: Observes work patterns and auto-builds small helpful desktop apps
readme_summary: Tailor monitors desktop activity to detect friction and proposes and builds tiny apps from counted behavior using four Meta Muse agents. Desktop app for Windows/Mac with backend, browser extension and website for distribution.

summary: WhatsApp bookkeeping assistant for traders using voice notes and photos.
readme_summary: WhatsApp-native intelligence for Nigerian shops that keeps books from voice, receipts and chats. Python FastAPI + Postgres app where Muse Spark proposes business events and Python commits journal lines and COGS.

summary: Turns screen recordings into process maps with timings and bottlenecks
readme_summary: Converts screen recordings of ERP, mail and spreadsheet work into process maps with durations and fix recommendations. Monorepo with Python worker and apps/services packages. Uses Meta vision models to understand on-screen actions.

summary: Neuron atlas mapping Muse Glimmer identity neurons into tunable persona dials
readme_summary: Exploratory project that probes Muse Glimmer 30B open weights to find persona-related neurons. Python with PyTorch MPS/CUDA, uv, and scripted evals. Uses Muse Spark agent for analysis and a mixer UI instead of prompting.

summary: Construction audit thread linking drawings, decisions and site photo evidence
readme_summary: Keeps drawing marks, RFI decisions, and site photos as one auditable thread for MEP verification. Muse Spark models walls, doors and devices with geometry checks. Flags legend conflicts and cross-sheet mismatches.

summary: Uganda civic reporting tool turning photos and voice notes into verified incidents
readme_summary: Community infrastructure reporting with photo, text/voice and map pin processed into structured records. Backend uses Muse Spark 1.3 strict JSON, SAM 3.1 segmentation and PostGIS duplicate detection with reviewer workspace.

summary: Adds dock video as fourth match to hold payments when footage contradicts paperwork
readme_summary: Procurement verification that adds receiving-dock video to PO, GRN and invoice three-way match. Full-stack backend plus frontend with policy engine citing receiving policy clauses. Uses Meta AI agent vision reasoning over synthetic delivery videos.

summary: Turns one road photo into measured distress map, PCI score, quantities and repair plan.
readme_summary: PaveLens uses Meta SAM 3 to segment pavement distresses, converts geometry to metres, computes ASTM D6433 PCI and budgets. Meta Muse Wonder diagnoses and plans detours and crew routes. Stack is Python backend plus frontend with bilingual docs.

summary: Transfers files to air-gapped machines via screen-camera light channel
readme_summary: Verifiable optical bridge that encodes files and agent context into light patterns for isolated systems. Uses Muse Spark for semantic packing and Muse Glimmer for red-teaming, plus LT fountain codes. No network, RF, or USB required.

summary: Always-on camera agent that watches for events you describe in words
readme_summary: Pulse turns plain sentences into yes/no visual questions and scores live frames every second, saving matches as cards. Single Python app with eval scripts and docs. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer open-weights locally via token log-probs.

summary: Evidence-linked coordinator agent prototype for Bangladesh community help tasks
readme_summary: Startup-track coordinator agent proof of meUus Human OS vision with evidence linking. Uses muse-voice-transcribe-1.0 and muse-spark-1.3 for multilingual coordination. Spec-driven docs cover architecture, API contracts, privacy and i18n.

summary: Chat, voice or photo booking agent for local cleaning services
readme_summary: Parses cleaning jobs, finds local businesses, verifies exact pricing and books slots with transparent tool-call trace. Vercel app with api/lib/fixtures and tests. Powered by Muse via Meta AI for understanding and orchestration.

summary: Parses catalog prerequisites and audits degrees for defects.
readme_summary: Converts prerequisite text to AND/OR logic in CNF and audits catalogs for missing courses, loops, and long paths. Python pipeline with Mendeley/UIUC loaders, frozen eval split, and Vercel site.

summary: Natural-language control for multi-vendor robot workcells with spatial vision.
readme_summary: FOROS Action Engine adds spatial reasoning and workcell perception for robot control. Bridges Meta Model API to URSim and multi-vendor controllers with feedback loop. Includes Python bridge, web cockpit and simulators.

summary: Private family hub with real-time rooms and a proactive household assistant
readme_summary: Each family channel runs on Cloudflare Durable Objects with real-time sync and @famuse assistant. Edge-native TypeScript stack with auth and e2e tests. Uses Meta Model API Muse Spark for butler answers and household help.

summary: Synthetic inpatient shift handover board linking pending tasks, owners and source evidence.
readme_summary: Synthetic U.S. inpatient shift-change replay showing unfinished work, owners and next steps. Built with Next.js, Drizzle and Vercel with persistent handovers and department tasks. Uses Meta Muse models to draft human-reviewed operational proposals with source links.

summary: Simulates two alternate life futures from one decision to explore and fact-check
readme_summary: Next.js + FastAPI monorepo that branches one decision into two talkable simulated futures. Uses Muse Wonder, Spark, Voice and Image with stress-test and verification.

summary: Turns legacy panel photos into live typed queryable sensor streams
readme_summary: Retrofit points a camera at industrial panels to extract live typed instrument streams. FastAPI backend plus frontend uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark, Spark Open on Baseten, Wonder and Voice Transcribe. Push the Frontier manufacturing submission.

summary: Screen-black voice thinking tool that returns summary, map and sketch
readme_summary: Blackout lets users state a goal and think aloud with screen black. Python app listens, builds mind map, parks tangents, and returns cited summary, todos and image. Uses Meta Muse models via custom muse_client with speech I/O.

summary: Turns three t-shirt photos into a 1:1 printable sewing pattern ready to cut
readme_summary: Sewtrace converts phone photos of a garment into measured pattern panels with seam checks. Python stack with Docker, tests, and demo assets. Uses only Meta models via Meta Model API for vision measurement and pattern generation.

summary: Balloons engineering drawings and auto-fills AS9102 inspection forms
readme_summary: Automates aerospace AS9102 first article inspection by ballooning dimensions, tolerances, and notes on drawings and filling Form 3. Built with Meta Muse models, live Cloud Run app with sample drawings. Includes FastAPI backend, eval harness, and Docker deploy.

summary: Digital twin where SAM 3.1 must clear work zone before crane energizes.
readme_summary: Sentinel AI is a 3D factory-bay digital twin where pressing ENERGIZE captures CAM-01 and Meta SAM 3.1 segments people in rendered pixels. A deterministic rule plus virtual PLC blocks power unless zone is clear, fresh and human-authorized. TypeScript monorepo simulation, not a safety system.

summary: Turns familiar places into memory palaces for speeches and study recall.
readme_summary: Place-based recall coach that converts a photo of a familiar space into an ordered memory-palace route. SAM 3.1 segments objects into loci and Muse Spark creates multisensory associations, with mobile app and cloud backend.

summary: AI meeting twin that attends, masks sensitive details, and drafts follow-ups
readme_summary: Second Seat is a scripted meeting room where an AI twin participates with live guidance and takeover. It masks sensitive data, keeps evidence records and drafts follow-ups for review. Solo-founder privacy safety layer.

summary: Splits a book basket across Romanian shops for lowest total with shipping
readme_summary: Optimizes which books to buy at which Romanian bookshop including shipping and fees, e.g. 43.57 lei saved on 7 books. Live bilingual web app with no sign-in. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 on Meta Model API and Muse Spark Open on Baseten for matching.

summary: AI ad auditor that checks claims, repairs creatives, and exports verified images
readme_summary: Audit-repair-verify engine for ad creatives with source inspection and claim lineage. Node.js API with consistency server and OCR localization. Uses Meta AI for claim verification and image repair with checked export.

summary: FHIR follow-up engine that flags patients lost after doctor orders via WhatsApp
readme_summary: Reads HL7 FHIR R4 orders, results and notes, turns each order into a dated expectation, and drives WhatsApp outreach until resolved. Deterministic verification engine with Muse Spark reading the care plan; doctor retains decisions.

summary: Turns spoken working states into auto-checks that catch AI regressions mid-turn.
readme_summary: Hooks for Muse Code where Muse Spark generates checks from user words or audio. Torpor engine runs checks at turn end and notifies AI to fix failures immediately.

summary: Voice-directed $34 toy drone that follows the person or car you describe
readme_summary: Toy Loiley X69 drone with laptop autonomy stack and safety governor plus digital twin UI. Python mission pipeline with classical controller. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe, fine-tuned Muse Glimmer for missions, and SAM 3.1 for tracking.

summary: Sandbox-verified auto-repair and browser pre-flight gate for web apps
readme_summary: Automated repair tool that fixes web app faults and verifies them in a sandbox with browser pre-flight checks. Python 3.13 CLI with Node.js harness, Makefile and deployment gate. Uses Muse Spark to generate patches and validate test evidence.

summary: Dubbing workbench that verifies timing, meaning and on-screen signs before release
readme_summary: Standalone dubbing verification workbench built Oct 26-Nov 4 2026. Adds timing, semantic, scene and sign-localisation gates between pipeline stages with verdicts, provenance and token cost. Uses Meta Model API for checks.

summary: Spatial memory for smart glasses to save objects and find them by voice
readme_summary: Android app plus Docker backend with Postgres, Redis, API and worker for saving photos and records and AI search. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for visual grounding with voice queries.

summary: Self-hosted business OS with invoicing, CRM and gated AI tasks.
readme_summary: MuZe is a single-process Node OS for founders with SQLite invoicing, inventory and CRM. It uses approval-gated AI tasks, WebLLM in-browser inference and hash-chained audit ledger. Meta dispatch is DRY_RUN by default.

summary: Reconstructs crumpling forces from sheet shape and photos via inverse simulation
readme_summary: Simulates cloth deformation, learns inverse shape-to-force mapping, and verifies by re-simulation. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation, VGGT for 3D geometry, Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning, plus SAM 3 and DINOv2 ablations.

summary: Creates personalized illustrated picture books where your child is the hero
readme_summary: Fabulka turns parent voice notes and photos into illustrated picture books or comics in five languages. Monorepo TypeScript apps with generation pipeline. Uses Meta Muse models for story, voice and illustration generation.

summary: Rebuilds lost places in 3D from old photos and spoken memories
readme_summary: Turns old photographs into partial 3D scenes where unseen areas stay empty. Owner-approved single memory proposal creates versioned scenes with photo vs memory vs guess labeling. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse models for evidence checks.

summary: Snaps shop signs into multilingual orderable books pinned on a live map
readme_summary: Prox Now turns shop sign and menu photos into structured shop books with items and prices. Next.js app with map ordering, translated order screen and coupon wallet. Uses muse-spark-1.3 to parse photos into categorized catalogs and power shopper queries.

summary: Inline steganalysis gate that screens agent-shared images for hidden data channels
readme_summary: CovertLens intercepts inter-agent images at the artifact store and scores original bytes across LSB, JPEG DCT, metadata and geometric channels. A verdict ladder (log, flag, quarantine, fail-run) gates delivery and appends findings to the run trace. Built with Python service, Docker and evaluation harness integration.

summary: Operator workspace linking robot goals, execution feedback and visual review
readme_summary: PushPilot is a Meta Muse Spark 1.3 workspace for robot demos uniting goal, plan, feedback and visual result. Shows motion to MUSE review flow with recorded decisions. Frontend and backend with contracts, prompts and deploy configs.

summary: WhatsApp AI that turns palm farm daily chats into structured dashboard data.
readme_summary: Foremen send daily reports via Meta WhatsApp Cloud API webhook to an agent router for mandor, agronomi, and manajer roles. AI extracts JSON to PostgreSQL via Prisma/Supabase for SAP Fiori-style owner dashboard. Monorepo with apps, packages, Docker Compose.

summary: Training plan that replans around travel, equipment and injury constraints
readme_summary: Adaptive Workout replans fitness weeks when travel or injury changes constraints. A deterministic engine writes all sets, reps, and loads while Meta models only call tools and explain swaps. Stack is web app with offline and replay mode.

summary: Turns chemistry questions into predictive experiments with replayable records
readme_summary: VIBloom builds assumption trees, forces Muse Spark to pre-predict outcomes, and tests via deterministic Oregonator solver. Contradictions trigger competing explanations and decisive tests. Web app with replayable sessions via Meta Model API.

summary: Checks viral videos against real physics to flag fakes on web and WhatsApp
readme_summary: Forwards suspicious clips via WhatsApp or web, tracks objects and compares motion to gravity. Returns verdict, annotated video with ghost overlay, and plain numbers. Multilingual web app with physics-based verification pipeline.

summary: Assists biologists with blood smear cell counts and review triage
readme_summary: Finds every cell on smear images, proposes differential counts, and flags slides needing human review. Python + web stack with tiled inference experiments. Uses SAM 3 for cell proposals and Meta open-weights vision embeddings for typing.

summary: Security agency dashboard that watches cameras and alerts on WhatsApp
readme_summary: One dashboard for malls, schools, homes and ICUs that learns per-site normal behavior. SAM 3.1 sees, Muse Spark fuses image/sensor/SOP text, Muse Wonder reasons over Neo4j habit graph, WhatsApp Business API acts.

summary: Hands-free voice app to found a fictional company and build an orbital colony
readme_summary: Next.js hands-free demo where speech drives company naming, equity split, structure building and lawyer summary. Uses Meta Model API key with unified Next + ASR WebSocket server on Node 22, built for headset and accessibility use.

summary: Watches one desktop task then compiles it into a reusable verified recipe
readme_summary: Edith records screen and audio for a manual Word/Excel/desktop task, compiles it with Muse Spark to a minimal program, verifies on copies and replays after confirmation. Local-first Python app. Uses Muse Spark for program synthesis while screen data stays on device.

summary: Second brain for what you saw to dispute damage bills with video proof
readme_summary: Maanas records pickup and return walkarounds via glasses, phone or dashcam to create comparable visual memory. SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark detect pre-existing scuffs and generate dispute packets. Mobile client with Node server and vector recall.

summary: High-throughput flight recorder that audits autonomous agent actions.
readme_summary: C++20 zero-dependency core with bridge layer ingests over 1M events/sec with O(log n) seek. Uses SHA-256 Merkle chain for tamper-evident forensic verification. Calls Muse Spark 1.3 API for causal instruction and analysis.

summary: Local-first time tracker that finds lost time and suggests ranked fixes
readme_summary: Stretto measures detours, waiting and repeated routes locally on-device and turns them into ranked time-saving changes. Humanflow provides its voice and agent backend. Uses Meta Muse models for analysis while keeping all data on the user's computer.

summary: Phone scan that checks if a backyard cottage fits zoning rules
readme_summary: LotFit answers whether an ADU fits a lot and where, tracing numbers to zoning clauses. Muse Spark Open acts as agent, Muse Spark reviews, Muse Code assists, with Neo4j Aura rulebook, web UI and 1,120 passing tests.

summary: Phone app where agent codes, simulates and trains robot tasks
readme_summary: Describe task in plain words; Meta-powered agent writes firmware, runs it in MuJoCo physics sim, trains on cloud GPUs and iterates. Monorepo with packages, scripts and demo, using Modal, Baseten and Fireworks.

summary: Autonomous Unity warehouse with packing cells, robots, and truck loading
readme_summary: Unity simulation of packing inspection, carton transport, order planning, label creation, and voice-order handling. Unity Assets with robot controllers and camera feeds; uses Muse Spark, Muse Image, Muse Wonder, Muse Voice and SAM 3.1 for vision checks.

summary: Mini-DAW that turns hummed voice notes into editable sessions via Muse tool calls.
readme_summary: Lattice is a mini-DAW where Muse acts as session engineer via visible tool calls for EQ, arrangement and mixing. Users can edit the session by hand with changes fed back to the model. It uses Muse via Meta models for audio reasoning and control.

summary: AI-planned ESP32 builds verified by camera against the plan
readme_summary: SparkBench takes a task description, gets Muse Spark plan approval, builds ESP32 firmware and records LEDs/OLED with iPhone camera. Compares measured behavior to plan with mapping repair. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice.

summary: Phone physics lab that measures motion and tests physical laws
readme_summary: Films motion, segments objects with SAM 3.1, converts pixels to meters and fits competing models in Modal Sandbox. Python backend + web frontend with evals. Uses Muse Wonder for measurement and Muse Spark for claim review.

summary: Used-car export business run by eight AI employees from chat to delivery
readme_summary: AutoFTE is a white-label platform with website, CRM, auction, chat and app for exporter Hikari Motors. Eight Muse Spark Open agents handle chat, auction sheets, pricing and invoices. Dockerized monorepo with evals, demo data only.

summary: Gives locked-down PCs AI help via USB KVM without installing software
readme_summary: Locked Computer Assist pairs a locked computer with an AI computer via USB KVM. The KVM acts as monitor and keyboard to view screen and type fixes. Uses Muse Glimmer for vision debugging and Muse Spark for code fixes.

summary: Mongolian Messenger sales agent taking orders and QPay payments
readme_summary: Multi-tenant Messenger agent for Mongolian shops handling Cyrillic/Latin text, voice, and product photos. Muse Spark tool-calling agent loop with grounding, stock policy, handoff, order drafts. Signed webhook, Send API, demo checkout.

summary: Produces evidence-cited cyber risk digests for private equity deals in minutes.
readme_summary: Cross-checks management claims against evidence, analyzes SOC 2 and passive outside-in signals, then scores via deterministic NIST CSF rules. Python CLI with YAML scoring and eval fixtures. Built on Meta Muse with quoted locators.

summary: Educational auto-loan refinance comparator with source-verified numbers
readme_summary: Streamlit app compares keep, refinance now, or wait scenarios for auto loans with explicit rate assumptions. Model extracts terms with exact source quotes verified by code before computation. Uses LLM extraction plus deterministic engine, no data stored.

summary: Privacy firewall that veils screens so cloud agents never see real sensitive values
readme_summary: Veil is a privacy firewall for computer-use agents that sends only veiled screens to cloud models with policy enforcement. Python stack with policy, bench and infra. Uses Muse Wonder in cloud, Muse Glimmer and SAM 3.1 locally on raw pixels.

summary: Voice-first planner that rebuilds your week around sleep, health and people.
readme_summary: Describe what broke and Mesocycle replans sleep, people and health priorities via chat and voice. Cloudflare Workers app with docs and evals for architecture. Uses Meta AI voice and LLM via Call AI for conversational week setup and recovery planning.

summary: Agent that translates clinical SAS programs to R and verifies numbers match SAS
readme_summary: sas2r-agent translates clinical SAS programs to R, runs the R in a Docker sandbox, checks every number against SAS output, and self-repairs. It scores 94/100 on a real-SAS benchmark with hash-chained provenance. It uses Muse Spark as provider with a leaderboard dashboard.

summary: Delivery planner that builds verified routes from satellite photos
readme_summary: Takes satellite photo plus sentence, reads roads from OpenStreetMap and aerial evidence, then plans, validates and repairs delivery routes. Solo hackathon build with demo of 20 deliveries, verification and repair loop.

summary: Turns shelf photos into sell, donate or recycle listings with prices
readme_summary: Converts photos or video of unused items into per-item listings with condition, price, multilingual title and product shot. Goal-driven agent batches lots and drafts buyer replies for approval. Installable Android PWA via Hugging Face.

summary: Holds risky WhatsApp agent actions until owners approve via signed link
readme_summary: Shift Lead monitors business WhatsApp agents and holds refunds, cancellations, and account changes for owner approval. Family mode explains forwarded messages and voice notes and alerts trusted contacts. Built on Meta Model API with dashboard, receipts, and evaluation results.

summary: DTF print shop studio that turns stories into 3D shirt previews
readme_summary: SablonAI is a web store and design studio for an Indonesian DTF shop with ready designs and custom creation. Next.js storefront with rotatable 3D shirt and photo mockup. Uses Meta Model API live for design generation and preview.

summary: Earnings assistant with voice Q&A and tamper-proof pre-report predictions ledger
readme_summary: Everyday investor desk answering typed or voice questions from live market data with sources. Frozen-calls ledger sha256-chains predictions before reports then auto-grades after. Uses Muse Spark Open for tool-calling and chart reading.

summary: In-scene ad placement that keeps story identical per viewer
readme_summary: Meta Model API adapter orchestrates Muse Spark for reasoning, Muse Wonder for atmosphere, Muse Image for backdrops and SAM 3.1 for surfaces. Next.js plus Python backend with Audience Network logic. MIT licensed.

summary: Mobile junk-journal planner to arrange scraps digitally before gluing physically
readme_summary: Flutter mobile app for designing junk-journal compositions on the go. Uses proxy backend for Meta AI calls. Uses SAM 3.1 for cutouts, Muse Spark for planning, Muse Wonder and Muse Image for layout and assets.

summary: Pluggable memory layer that stores confirmed cards and retrieves only relevant context
readme_summary: Deja Vu is an agentic memory layer that infers short cards from chats, verifies against user words, and injects ~150 tokens per request. Built on Meta Muse models, it plugs into Muse, Claude or ChatGPT without changing chat flow.

summary: Builds LEGO models only from your photographed parts with instructions
readme_summary: Skill plus MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT that inventories owned LEGO parts, designs buildable models, and renders booklet-style instructions. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for description with MCP server architecture.

summary: Decision support that turns case notes into compatibility-checked leg artery plans.
readme_summary: Streamlit app that parses typed, pasted or dictated cases into structured femoropopliteal plans. Applies clinician rules to output strategy, access, kit and rationale. Uses Meta Muse models for parsing and reasoning.

summary: Indoor-air agent that senses, plans and controls purifiers with approval.
readme_summary: Agent that fuses OpenAQ/CAMS data, forecast and room photos to size CADR and schedule ventilation. Requires user approval before controlling via Home Assistant, webhook or Bluetooth. Uses Muse Spark scene analysis plus SAM 3.1 for haze and vent outlines.

summary: Real-to-sim archive replays building puzzle runs as ghosts on a map
readme_summary: Maps one building floor to a floor plan with one puzzle and replays runs with ghost agents. Python realtosim package with data/logs/reports and GitHub Pages demo. Uses AI agents to test real-to-sim behavior before real execution.

summary: Checks sky-camera clips to find meteors and explain why
readme_summary: Measures night-sky clips in Python then classifies meteor vs planes/satellites. Frontend + Python backend hosted on Vercel. Uses Meta Muse Spark for detective-like reasoning and explanations.

summary: Turns old phones into family cameras programmed by text or voice note.
readme_summary: Lets families define watch tasks in English, Hindi or Kannada with photo-grounded confirmation and shared alerts. Stack with backend, web, phone client and fixtures. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Camera-first storefront builder for micro-vendors with auto pricing
readme_summary: Decoupled Next.js 14 App Router frontend and FastAPI engine for micro-commerce. Pipeline is SAM 3.1 for product vision, Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning, Muse Code for actions. Targets kiosk vendors.

summary: Verifiable AI triage for semiconductor SEM defects with selective abstention.
readme_summary: Evaluates SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 on Carinthia-S SEM benchmark for rare defect classification. Framework measures IoU, calibration and abstention for manufacturing ADC. Python stack with reproducible results and tests.

summary: Researches autonomous game QA agents completing unseen ViZDoom levels
readme_summary: Research on autonomous playtesting agents using ViZDoom to test navigation and progression with richer inputs. Evaluates Meta AI models on unfamiliar levels for gameplay issues. Python stack with configs, prompts and scenarios.

summary: Local-first visual assistant grounding electronics questions on a grid
readme_summary: Points camera at board, asks by text or voice, returns short answer plus normalized overlay position. Has Electron desktop and phone PWA builds with Meta-published models prioritized. Grid up to 128x128, keys kept out of page.

summary: Voice role-play training with research-backed scenarios and scoring
readme_summary: Training platform where leads describe failure modes and upload materials to generate leveled voice scenarios. Stack is monorepo apps/packages with Docker deploy. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Image.

summary: Turns school camera events into accountable staff incident response
readme_summary: EduSphere Safety combines school video pipeline, scheduled rules, tenant incident management and evidence review. Uses SAM 3.1 for detection and local Llama for briefings. .NET + Docker prototype with simulation bounds.

summary: Interactive knowledge map for Wikipedia with AI summaries, paths and quizzes
readme_summary: Web app turning topics into clickable knowledge maps with read nodes, expansion, AI summaries and quizzes. Node/Express API plus frontend with Remotion video pipeline for demo capture, narration and rendering.

summary: Generates labeled synthetic defects to test what visual inspectors still catch.
readme_summary: Reads QA spec and good-part photos to forge pixel-labeled defects for about $0.02 each. Python backend plus frontend measures smallest detectable defect without real failures. Uses Muse Image, SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark with eval harness.

summary: Medicinal chemistry copilot that extracts structures and plans optimizations.
readme_summary: Evidence-grounded copilot for early drug discovery with Next.js frontend and RDKit backend. SAM 3.1 segments structures in paper figures and Muse Wonder reads SMILES twice, while RDKit applies and verifies edits.

summary: Turns phone slow-motion video into physics measurements with error bars.
readme_summary: Upload a motion clip, ask in plain language, get tracked trajectories and fitted physics quantities. Python CV pipeline with SAM 3.1 tracking plus web viewer. Uses SAM 3.1 for masks, Muse Spark and Muse Wonder for Q&A and uncertainty.

summary: Local-first review cockpit that verifies AI coding diffs by running behavior ripple analysis, not summaries
readme_summary: Point at a repo and two refs; it builds both, runs tests and traces behavioral ripples beyond edited lines. Local-first cockpit with Docker, json-server demo, e2e and CI action for agent-diff verification.

summary: Films a market stall and builds a shop page with WhatsApp ordering from video.
readme_summary: Stall to Store ingests stall video, tracks products with SAM 3.1, transcribes prices and matches them with Muse Spark. Python htmx app with eval and tests. Generates shop page with photos, prices and click-to-chat WhatsApp orders.

summary: Turns plain-language rules into live camera violation alerts with overlays.
readme_summary: Compiles natural language rules to executable DSL with Muse Spark 1.3, segments frames with SAM 3.1 to scene graph. Deterministic engine checks violations and renders overlays.

summary: Runs unmodified Win 3.1 Minesweeper on 8088 PCs via DOS TSR shim.
readme_summary: 86TO88 runs original WINMINE.EXE under Windows 3.0 real-mode via a DOS TSR and 361-byte DLL shim. No game code is reimplemented; verified on Tandy 1000 EX hardware. Bridge built by Muse Wonder with browser emulator demo.

summary: Verifies what shopping agents saw on screen before approving payment
readme_summary: Safety layer for shopping agents that enforces signed spending rules, then checks agent screenshots for price and quantity mismatches. Stack is Next.js + API with Drizzle. Uses Muse Spark for rules parsing and SAM 3.1 for screen checks.

summary: Compares NYC buildings using official records and imagery for retrofit planning
readme_summary: Workspace to explore NYC buildings, compare two candidates, and plan climate-resilient retrofits. Built on Cloudflare Worker with official lot records, aerial imagery and 3D display. Uses seven Meta model roles across hosted workflow and local inspection mode.

summary: Synthetic disabled personas test iOS apps and auto-fix accessibility code
readme_summary: Allyfix runs six synthetic users with different disabilities in iOS Simulator to complete tasks. Muse Wonder edits code on a git branch to fix blockers, then saves passing runs as deterministic replay tests. Built with Xcode, Swift, and Meta Muse models.

summary: Photos of storefronts scored for trademark confusion with hashed evidence
readme_summary: Investigator photographs markets and Meta vision finds logos and assesses likelihood-of-confusion. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for assessment, plus local Muse Glimmer option. Produces hashed evidence record.

summary: Turns forgotten saved links into a short daily personalized lesson.
readme_summary: Yaadsi ingests saved links into a corpus and generates daily 15-minute lessons. Built with Python app.py + agent pipeline and Vercel frontend. Uses Muse Spark Open via Meta Model API for tutoring, lesson generation and Q&A.

summary: Audits Arabic websites for accessibility, writes Arabic labels and fixes DOM and source.
readme_summary: Mada Fixer audits Arabic sites with axe-core plus visual review, generates missing Arabic labels with Meta models, then patches DOM and source and proves gains with measurements. TypeScript Node CLI with scripts, docs and offline eval checks. Uses Meta AI for Arabic label generation and fix proposals.

summary: Session-aware gateway that predicts cost, caches tools, and resumes agents.
readme_summary: Sits between agent frameworks and LLM/MCP servers to optimize whole sessions, not single calls. Rust gateway with daemon, engine-core, and MCP gateway for budgets, loop redirect, and resumable state. Model-agnostic infra.

summary: AI digital wallet for sending and receiving money in Angola
readme_summary: Smart digital wallet designed for Angola with send, receive and balance flows. Combines FastAPI backend and web frontend with conversational banking assistant. Uses Muse Spark Open for financial assistance.

summary: Turns scanned P&ID drawings into verified graphs, BOMs and rule violations.
readme_summary: Reads scanned P&ID images into a machine-readable graph, BOM CSV, and annotated overlay with design-rule checks. Stack is Python with Docker and evals. Uses SAM 3.1 for symbol detection and Muse via Meta Model API for reading and verification.

summary: Animated chalk tutor that narrates lessons and answers speech
readme_summary: Interactive tutor that generates chalk-style visuals per lesson scene with synced narration. Built on Meta Model API with SAM 3.1 for textbook photo tracing, Muse Spark for lessons, voice Q&A and tap-to-find quizzes.

summary: Three-layer guardrail firewall that filters prompts, tools and model outputs.
readme_summary: Aegis enforces policy rules, a safety classifier and a tighten-only LLM judge on every agent prompt, tool call and output. Python service with Vercel dashboard, policy.yaml and hash-chained audit log. Built on Muse Spark muse-spark-1.3 with Llama-Guard style prompts.

summary: Turns plain missions into validated multi-robot source-search simulations
readme_summary: Compiles operator missions to specs then runs seeded 2D robot-swarm source localization with safety filter. Frontend + backend with FastAPI docs, Render deploy. Uses Baseten meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026 via OpenAI-compatible API.

summary: Turns factory nonconformities into cited, auditable quality records
readme_summary: Four agents for Knowledge, Quality, CAPA and Audit share Muse Spark 1.3 on Meta Model API with structured outputs. Grounds answers in procedures, proposes corrective actions and writes tamper-evident logs.

summary: Modifiable personal assistant framework where users change behavior by talking
readme_summary: Inspiratio is a framework for building personal assistants that users modify by conversation with approval before changes apply. Muse bot is the interface and muse-spark-1.3 on Meta Model API is the brain with web search. Supports Muse Spark Open and fallback models behind one interface.

summary: Agent review board that debates robot failures and tests fixes in simulation
readme_summary: Pointer runs three Muse Spark investigators plus skeptic to form failure hypotheses, then validates fixes in MuJoCo. Server with web UI, sim and SAM tracking views. Uses SAM 3.1 grounding and voice explanation.

summary: Local-first app that analyzes private files locally before ever calling cloud AI
readme_summary: Handoff is a local-first Windows app where local Llama analyzes files behind Llama Guard 3, Prompt Guard 2 and PII masking. Only masked text can reach Muse Spark, blocking prompt injections hidden in business files. Includes pre-registered Meta vs Google local-cloud evaluation.

summary: Model-free referee that verifies browser agent claims with evidence bundles
readme_summary: Chimera lets Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API plan and act in a real browser, then verifies with deterministic snapshot re-reading and allowlist checks. Produces sealed trace, snapshot, and action logs and counts false successes. Python harness with adapters and benchmarks.

summary: Stamps work photos tamper-evident and turns them into reports and proof links.
readme_summary: AI work camera for field crews that keeps original tamper-evident, adds owner watermark and reads order numbers, plates and damage. Web app plus Android app with server backend. Uses Meta Muse Spark vision extraction for daily reports.

summary: Converts leftover material photos into measured cutting plans and SVG patterns
readme_summary: Upload flat material, OpenCV detects outline, calibrate with known measure, generate layouts. Backend Python 3.12 plus Node 20 frontend, works without AI key. Optional Muse Spark via Baseten adds image understanding and suggestions.

summary: Turns one expert repair video into live voice coaching with work checks
readme_summary: Veteran's Eyes converts narrated expert video into step guides with highlighted parts. Phone app speaks steps, answers questions from expert tips and verifies critical steps using four Meta vision and voice models.

summary: Finds mosquito-breeding standing water from phone video or photos
readme_summary: StillWater validates phone video or photo, blurs people via hosted SAM 3.1, detects water-holding containers and risk with auditable rules, then writes Bangla/English cleanup orders. Runs on Modal with ffmpeg pipeline.

summary: Body-agnostic humanoid controller using spiking neural networks in pure Rust
readme_summary: AnyBody is a body and task-agnostic humanoid control stack built in Pure Rust with 25M synapses and 1kHz biomechanics and zero PID. It uses Meta Muse Spark for task planning and SAM-3.1 for vision grounding. Crates, Python scripts and tests support simulation and control.

summary: Whiteboard tutor that speaks and sketches lessons stroke by stroke
readme_summary: AI teacher that narrates lessons while a hand draws doodles live on a board. Go backend plus Flutter board app. Uses Meta models to write lessons, generate doodle art and locate objects for synced speech.

summary: Mac screen recorder where you edit video by chatting and approving cuts
readme_summary: Klipolo is a macOS video editor for screen recordings and clips edited via chat with Meta models. Built with Rust crates and cross-platform apps, cuts stay pending in red until Apply. Uses Meta chat models for edit instructions.

summary: Offline-first SOS messaging over Bluetooth LE mesh with encrypted relays to server.
readme_summary: Emergency network that sends encrypted SOS via nearby phones over Bluetooth LE mesh. Internet-connected device forwards to central server and operator panel. Prototype with mobile, Node server and Turkish/English support.

summary: Agent orchestrator combining CI, kanban, and harness controls in one view
readme_summary: AI orchestrator built around CI and agile project management rather than chat. Orchestrates many agents transparently with kanban workflows. Built for Meta hackathon with promo site, install wizard, and video demos.

summary: Engine that builds connectors from docs, monitors drift and auto-repairs with verification.
readme_summary: Compiles declarative connectors from vendor docs and runs scheduled syncs with Complete/Degraded/Blocked status. Repairs drift via L0-L4 ladder from rules to frontier model behind trust boundary. Uses small and frontier models for repair with Decimal money handling.

summary: Cross-discipline research partner that finds hidden science connections
readme_summary: Agent that spans literature across fields to spot shared problems, test connections and help draft answers and papers. Solo-built with literature engine, evidence checks, memory and budget control. Uses Muse Spark today, configurable to stronger Meta models.

summary: Hands-free voice layer to dictate prompts to coding agents
readme_summary: Thalvi is a hands-free voice assistant with Hey Thalvi wake-word to dictate, correct and paste prompts. It has Hyprland/Windows desktop apps for cooking, road and messaging use. Built with Muse Spark Open and tested with Muse Code.

summary: AI growth studio helping indie apps get discovered and marketed
readme_summary: MuseLaunch turns an app into listings, studio assets, and growth experiments for indie developers. Monorepo with web, API, and e2e infra on Cloud Run. Uses Muse models, SAM 3.1, and HyperFrames.

summary: One app to run Muse, Claude Code and Codex sessions across machines
readme_summary: Native multi-system orchestrator for simultaneous Muse, Claude Code and Codex sessions with overseeing agents. Swift-based UI with Parking Lot and scoreboard. Uses Meta Muse plus Muse Spark API for agents and voice.

summary: AI business twin that researches opportunities and runs approved actions
readme_summary: SentinelX builds a Visual Business Twin from owner brief and website, then runs Opportunity Hunter and Creative Studio. Stack is backend + frontend with docker-compose and supervised agents. Uses Meta text, vision, image and Voice-to-Action with approval-gated self-hosted delivery.

summary: AI back office where agents do books and owner approves every change
readme_summary: Munshi provides seven agents for small-shop accounting with named-person approval tray. Next.js 16.4, React 19, PostgreSQL 17 monorepo. Uses Meta AI models for bookkeeping automation with audit trail.

summary: Predicts robot eval regressions to select costly simulations under risk policy
readme_summary: Brier predicts post-policy-change regressions and selects simulations under calibrated risk. Rust + Python with 60k episodes, 5k Parquet keys, single-epoch Glimmer fine-tune for $2.18. Uses Muse Glimmer fine-tune with ECE calibration, deployment on hold.

summary: Voice-steered picture book that redraws pages from kids ideas
readme_summary: StoryShaper is a voice-driven interactive picture book where kids answer aloud to shape the story. It uses Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark for narration, and Muse Image to redraw pages in consistent style.

summary: Local persistent memory and voice assistant that tracks context and intent.
readme_summary: Persistent personal intelligence environment with provenance memory, context graph, and approval-gated actions. Zero-dependency Node.js app with local JSON storage, offline tests, and live Muse models for phrasing.

summary: Trains quoting AI on past jobs to draft customer quotes from video walkthroughs
readme_summary: Service-business quoting product with customer chat, past-job learning and owner pricing. Full-stack API + app monorepo. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for chat and quote drafting and SAM 3.1 plus Muse 1.2 for video walk-around measurement.

summary: Turns Markdown into richer docs via scored model improvement loop
readme_summary: Enriches Markdown with callouts, tables, and sources using Muse models, human templates, and deterministic checks. Core is knap-mcp, a Zig binary exposing tools via MCP stdio server and CLI with scored slot-filling loop.

summary: Repairs Python breakage after upgrades only if visible and hidden gates pass
readme_summary: PatchPilot finds Python functions that silently change results after pandas and NumPy upgrades and proposes repairs. A local browser app runs visible, hidden and differential gates before writing patches. It runs Meta Muse models including Glimmer locally and Spark Open via hosts.

summary: Duplicate-aware intake and historical checks for loan case reviews
readme_summary: Handles uploads and API submissions with duplicate-aware intake and version-bound JSON rules for bank movements and loan principal. Includes review panel and regression fixtures. Python worker with Docker and Vercel app.

summary: Agent audits sites for screen-reader gaps missed by standard checkers
readme_summary: Parity walks key site flows comparing sighted view vs accessibility tree to find barriers axe-core misses. Proves each issue, proposes fix, re-checks and leaves decision to human. Built on Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe with Playwright + axe-core.

summary: Turns a photo of an evacuation plan into a step-by-step exit route
readme_summary: Photograph a posted evacuation plan, tap your location, get routed to nearest exit in your language. Muse Spark extracts floor box and exits as points, code computes paths; demo site has 203 real plans.

summary: Photographs paper clinic charts for dual-AI reading and human verification
readme_summary: Basa converts photographed paper clinic charts into human-verified digital records with offline capture and review UI. Next.js + Supabase stack with evals and synthetic data only. Uses Meta Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 for segmentation and two independent readings.

summary: Converts experiment videos into motion measurements and testable predictions
readme_summary: Research prototype that tracks motion in experiment videos and compares recordings. Stack spans .NET solution with Lean toolchain and formal specs. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for visual tracking.

summary: Voice-driven Unity village where NPCs talk, remember and give quests
readme_summary: Unity Quest project with voice interaction for NPCs using authored personalities and memory. Server with PostgreSQL memory and Unity Behavior Graphs control actions. Uses Meta models for speech interpretation and dialogue generation.

summary: Rehearse big business bets with three 36-month cash futures
readme_summary: Parallax parses a founder decision, builds three futures and simulates 36 months of cash in code with stress tests and board debate. Node API plus Vercel frontend with evals. Uses Meta Muse models for reading, reasoning and planning.

summary: Maps code change requests to blast radius with indexed dependencies and evidence.
readme_summary: ScopeGraph indexes codebases to analyze impact before edits and exposes MCP tools for AI assistants. It uses a Python FastAPI service with React frontend and Docker deployment. It uses Meta Muse models for change mapping and risk explanation.

summary: Tracks Milwaukee City Hall meetings and explains decisions in minutes
readme_summary: Civic tracker for Milwaukee Common Council, committees and commissions. Built with Next.js and Convex, it links agendas, votes, and video into followable files. Uses Meta AI Muse models to summarize meetings and surface hearing dates.

summary: Ask plain-English questions about business data and get answers with shown queries and stated limits.
readme_summary: Charie answers plain-English business questions by investigating a connected database like an analyst, showing every query behind its numbers and flagging what it could not establish. It uses only Meta models for its analysis.

summary: Deterministic code scanner with AI fixes, re-scan proof and signed reports
readme_summary: Paste code or scan a public repo with 12 deterministic security rules, then get multilingual AI explanations and one-click patches. Re-scan proves CLEAN with signed verification artifact plus DevOps auto-healer. Uses Meta models for explanations with served-request counters.

summary: Security audit that proves AI-code risks and patches them
readme_summary: Vibe Audit 2.0 scans GitHub repos with 104 rules then reasons exploitability and outputs proof-of-risk with fixes. Second command patches on sandbox branch and re-scans. Uses Muse Spark reasoning over routes and auth boundaries.

summary: Counts lab plate colonies from photo and phrase with auditable measurements
readme_summary: LabVision Copilot counts colonies/cells from plate photo plus noun phrase using SAM 3.1. Counts and diameters are computed in Python, never by the model. Uses Muse to decide prompts and stream agent work.

summary: Checks photographed English business rates bills against 2026/27 rules for errors in £/year
readme_summary: RatesCheck uses Muse Spark 1.3 to extract photographed bill fields into strict-schema JSON, flagging unreadable fields as null. A deterministic TypeScript integer-arithmetic engine then recomputes the charge, using Deno and Supabase.

summary: On-prem AI SOC that turns Wazuh alerts into explained attack chains
readme_summary: Corvus plugs into Wazuh, normalizes alerts to OCSF and correlates to MITRE ATT&CK. Muse Glimmer triages on-prem, pseudonymized incidents go to Muse Spark reasoning. Raw logs never leave network, outputs Sigma rules.

summary: Trustless bug bounties that pay for proven exploits on committed invariants
readme_summary: Rust verifier + NEAR contracts that pay only for executed break of committed snapshot, verified 5/5 real and 0/21 fakes on testnet. Offline replay via make replay and on-chain verify. Live demo and pitch site included.

summary: Default-deny checkpoint that authorizes AI tool calls before execution
readme_summary: Qyrix Sentinel sits between agents and tools to decide ALLOW/BLOCK before execution. It tracks trust provenance, issues short-lived single-use grants and records evidence. Meta Llama only explains; enforcement is deterministic policy with backend and frontend.

summary: Live ship map where you can ask Muse about nearby vessels
readme_summary: One-page live tracker for US waters centered on user location. Uses aisstream.io AIS feed with MapLibre GL and OpenFreeMap. Muse models answer typed or dictated questions about visible ships.

summary: Student success platform that gives hints, tracks mastery, and aligns teacher and parent
readme_summary: Guardian Book connects learner, parent, and teacher with teacher-approved marking and AI hints that never reveal answers. Monorepo web app uses Muse Spark for step-level diagnosis, guidance plans, and multilingual notes home.

summary: Turns plain-language theses into researched, guard-railed stock portfolios.
readme_summary: Hunch researches a thesis and builds a US-equity portfolio where weights and orders are decided by code. Muse Wonder 1.0 does research; Muse Spark 1.3 runs agent, daily check and critique. FastAPI backend on Main Sequence with simulated venue.

summary: Voice-first memory aid for people with Alzheimer’s and cognitive impairment
readme_summary: Android mobile app acting as voice-first memory prosthetic for dementia care. Built with Expo/React Native. Uses Meta Model API on Android for conversational memory support.

summary: AI dashboard that segments street damage from photos and builds repair cases for cities
readme_summary: InfraSight turns citizen photos of broken streets into triage-ready maintenance cases. FastAPI backend with web dashboard uses SAM 3.1 for pixel segmentation, Muse Spark for diagnosis and pricing, and Muse Image for visual reconstruction.

summary: Turns manga pages into animated sequences in the browser with no GPU
readme_summary: Browser anime studio that scans pages, detects panels, cleans frames, interpolates and animates for export. Full-stack JS app with CI and docs; uses Muse Spark chat/vision, Muse Image, Muse Voice, SAM 3.1 plus open-weight Muse models.

summary: Turns object photos into interactive 3D exploded views that explain how it works
readme_summary: Magneye builds a verified anatomy from photos to render an interactive 3D exploded view with fault diagnosis. Python plus web frontend with streamed agent trace. Uses Muse Wonder agents, SAM 3.1 segmentation and SAM 3D.

summary: Turns raw talking-head clips into framed vertical shorts with captions
readme_summary: Drop a 20s take and get a 9:16 edit with cuts, captions and sound. Code-rendered engine preserves face and voice. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark for edit planning.

summary: AI career coach that surfaces hidden strengths from past work stories
readme_summary: YourMove Realize guides conversational reflection to uncover strengths with evidence. Go backend with benchmarks and tests, live demo accepts experience text or sample resume. Built with Meta Muse Spark for hackathon.

summary: Converts process specs into ladder logic, P&ID and live plant simulation
readme_summary: Uploads PDF specs for Muse Spark to extract requirements with citations, then generates ladder rungs and P&ID. Validator with 2-step repair loop, browser EPANET simulation. Uses live Meta Model API and voice dictation.

summary: Chat hub where personal agents collaborate with owners and friends on tasks
readme_summary: Chat system where user-owned agents work across friends via invite links and MCP. Supports one-click Hub agents on Muse model API plus Dot, Muse and Duet natives. Includes demo replay, tests and docs.

summary: Desktop coding workspace linking research, planning, review and verified edits.
readme_summary: Electron desktop environment for research-grounded coding with cited sources, plans, diff review and approval. Meta-first integration runs chat, planning and synthesis on Muse models. Fixed audited provider with verified execution tracing changes to research.

summary: WhatsApp bookkeeper for Kenyan dukas reading SMS, receipts and voice notes
readme_summary: Owner forwards M-Pesa SMS, receipts and voice notes to WhatsApp; bot proposes Swahili entries for approval then posts to journal. Answers profit questions and generates P&L PDFs. Built on Meta models with Convex backend.

summary: Disaster response coordinator turning damage video into aid requests
readme_summary: From phone video to prioritized evidence-backed help request with human approval. Next.js TypeScript on Vercel. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for damage segmentation and Muse Voice Transcribe for notes.

summary: Secure agent runtime with atomic capabilities, policy gate and audit chain
readme_summary: ROF12 is a default-deny runtime for limited, revocable agents with atomic capabilities, taint tracking, policy engine and audit chain. Python/FastAPI with PostgreSQL, Alembic RLS and JWT auth. Uses Muse models in mock and live modes for gated refund and operational workflows.

summary: Pinned opencode harness that constrains agents to safe, verifiable design work.
readme_summary: Agent harness, not a loop: pinned opencode provides loop and tools, Fuel adds config, permissions and plugin to enforce no fake results and folder-scoped edits. Includes evals, harness runner, MCP stub and scripts.

summary: AI crew handles calls, forms and appeals for patients
readme_summary: PJ Health puts a crew of AI agents on Muse Spark to do patient work like calling offices, finding benefits, contesting bills and booking rides. Patient only decides and signs. Built on Meta Model API for the hackathon startup track.

summary: Camera-local anomaly detector that learns normal scenes and flags outliers
readme_summary: VEGA samples timestamped footage to model per-camera normality with flow, color and memory witnesses plus YOLO. Muse Spark judges candidate events while SAM 3.1 segments them for evidence-grounded review. Python pipeline built solo during hackathon.

summary: News reader that groups articles, papers and videos into single evolving stories
readme_summary: OSMS groups articles, papers, newsletters, podcasts and videos about the same event, showing what's new, disagreements and timelines. Built with Widgetbook UI, backend pipelines and arXiv semantic search. Meta AI usage not detailed in excerpt.

summary: Auto diagnostic copilot fusing OBD2, camera and voice into ranked next tests
readme_summary: Android CameraX/mic plus ELM OBD2 feed FastAPI backend with event store and deterministic Bayesian engine. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for reasoning/vision/PDF and SAM for segmentation. Produces hash-chained replayable report.

summary: Maps legacy repos to architecture graphs and answers with cited proof
readme_summary: CodeArchaeologist AI scans repos into structural architecture graphs and provides evidence-grounded answers with Docker-isolated GitHub scanning. Next.js plus isolated workers on AWS with Nginx. Uses Baseten-hosted Muse models for reasoning validated against cited evidence.

summary: Marketplace that re-homes event booth equipment before teardown
readme_summary: Givers photograph booth gear, Muse Spark detects and counts items with SAM 3.1 verification for reservations. Mobile-first English UI in KST with org-scoped auth. Docker backend plus contract and spec docs.

summary: Scans elder homes from phone video to flag hazards and draft subsidy forms
readme_summary: SafePath AI uses SAM 3.1 masks and video tracking with A4-scale measurement and rule engine. Muse Spark assesses risks and writes Taiwan long-term-care subsidy drafts. PHP backend with before-after evidence verification.

summary: Multi-agent studio that redraws images stroke-by-stroke into named-layer SVG
readme_summary: Drawlab converts raster inputs into clean editable SVG with semantic layer names via five cooperating agents. Frontend plus Python backend for live stroke rendering and text edits. Uses Muse Spark for planning/edits and Muse Image for visual refinement.

summary: Tests if LLM judges can detect coding-agent lucky passes missed by visible tests
readme_summary: Preregistered study on 16 coding tasks comparing process vs outcome judges for detecting lucky passes. Uses Python analysis pipeline with LLM judges over agent traces and final code. Finds code-only judge reaches AUROC 0.93 vs 0.51 for process.

summary: Talk-to-edit video director that builds editable timelines from raw footage
readme_summary: Auteur Labs lets users direct edits in natural language and receive an editable timeline with verified renders. Stack is web frontend, API, motion renderer and deploy configs. Built on Meta models for video understanding and Muse Wonder codegen.

summary: Phone AR assistant that highlights objects and guides physical tasks hands-free.
readme_summary: Lumen points a phone camera at physical tasks and gives step-by-step voice guidance. It uses Android app with pluggable Skill Packs for any domain. It uses Muse Spark for reasoning, SAM 3 for grounding, and Muse Voice.

summary: Synthetic auditor showing why risk checks block trades with evidence comparison
readme_summary: Streamlit demo that reconstructs fictional trade timelines and audits quote-gate decisions. Local code validates actions while Muse Spark Open proposes claims for evidence comparison. Includes synthetic cases, tests and provenance docs.

summary: Airline crew recovery that finds rested, rated replacements in seconds
readme_summary: Regional airline crew control that parses sick notes and finds rested, rated, current cover via deterministic rules engine. Python src, web UI, infra and TV display. Uses Muse models to read, plan and explain with verifier against engine results.

summary: Agent that writes power controllers to smooth AI cluster grid load
readme_summary: Agent that synthesizes a controller to keep training power inside grid limits, addressing 0.1-20Hz oscillations. Python stack with specs, evals and NREL H100 measurements. Built on Muse models for the Push the Frontier energy challenge.

summary: Voice-updated cash-flow forecast for Portuguese real-estate agents
readme_summary: Agentimo forecasts net commission for independent agents after IVA, IRS and expenses. Agents update deals by talking instead of spreadsheets. Built by PropWare with Meta Muse models for voice and forecasting with web app deployment.

summary: Pauses video to extract objects as physics bodies you can throw and command
readme_summary: Pauses any clip, segments clicked objects into physical bodies with mass and inpainted background. Converts voice commands like moon gravity into tested simulation programs. Built on Meta Model API with backend/frontend and evals.

summary: Dispatches physical-world tasks from AI agents to vetted nearby humans
readme_summary: When agents need physical action, routes task to nearby person who completes it with photo evidence. Live demo site and video, built for Meta hackathon. Cloudflare, Next.js, Drizzle stack with human-in-loop workflow.

summary: Mobile app that interprets dog behavior from photo, video and audio
