readme_summary: PerritoTalk analyzes uploads or live camera/mic clips for posture and sound cues with care guidance. Mobile-first Cloudflare Workers app uses Muse Spark multimodal with bilingual EN/ES UI.

summary: Turns plain-English factory constraints into verified energy-aware schedules
readme_summary: Factory energy optimization system where operators input text constraints or bill images. Muse Spark parses requests, a CP-SAT constraint engine generates schedules, and a verifier checks them. Python app with engine, LLM, and test layers.

summary: Non-autoregressive guard predicting failed tool calls with probabilities
readme_summary: Single forward-pass encoder that maps failure text to calibrated probabilities over typed recovery actions. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B with QLoRA adapter distilled via RLCD; evaluated on R-Judge.

summary: Verifies aircraft turnaround milestones from video for delay disputes
readme_summary: TurnProof verifies loading equipment docked to loading complete from stand-camera clips against claims. Produces signed hash-verified evidence packets re-verifiable offline. Uses SAM 3.1 for detection and Muse Spark 1.3 for structured keyframe facts.

summary: Sports photo ingest that picks decisive shots and drafts captions
readme_summary: SnapPipe backs up camera photos in seconds, compares bursts, reads jersey numbers and writes IPTC captions. One LXC server per shoot with web review and ingest/worker pipeline. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for vision and JSON.

summary: Phone camera assistant that reads manuals and guides assembly step by step.
readme_summary: ShowMe guides product assembly and machine operation using manual parsing, 3D steps, and live phone-camera checks. Stack includes backend + Docker with manuals and eval. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and Muse Wonder for live visual guidance.

summary: Phone-call AI that connects offline users to healthcare and emergency services.
readme_summary: Talk turns any basic phone call into access to care coordination without app or internet. Python stack with Docker, mocks and sofa modules plus tests. Uses Meta AI agents for speech understanding and orchestration to essential services in Nigeria.

summary: Turns a 10-second shelf video into a WhatsApp shop with voice and photo ordering.
readme_summary: SpatialShelf converts a phone video of a shop shelf into a catalog orderable via WhatsApp text, handwritten photo or Bangla/English voice note. Includes stock decrement and picking route. Merchant web app plus worker pipeline.

summary: Investigates risky npm dependencies and visualizes how they entered your app
readme_summary: TRACII combines deterministic npm analysis, static code review, and dependency impact graphs to explain supply-chain risks. Meta Muse models assist investigation and fixes. Stack includes Python backend, frontend dashboard, and GitHub Action.

summary: Multilingual visual copilot that guides home repairs step by step
readme_summary: FixCV lets users describe broken items by voice in Tamil, Hindi or English, then guides fixes with camera verification of each step. Uses Meta SAM parsing for visual checks and Muse models for dialogue. Node.js stack with multilingual UI.

summary: Photographs schedules and syllabi to build verified plans that auto-rebuild.
readme_summary: Parses photos of schedules, syllabi and whiteboards into a dated study plan. Muse Spark reasons with tool calls to reschedule missed sessions with explanations. Built with Next.js frontend, evals and verifiable date checks.

summary: Hands-free glasses coworker for technicians that sees parts and drafts reports
readme_summary: Second Hand streams Ray-Ban Meta camera via Wearables Device Access Toolkit to Android plus server backend. Answers hands-free, segments parts, and enforces safety. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for part segmentation.

summary: Crowdfunded game ideas that AI agent crews build live for players
readme_summary: Siwi lets users post game ideas, upvote, price by token counts, buy in and have AI agents build and test the game. Next.js app with prompts, examples and multi-agent pipeline. Uses Meta Muse Spark models for design, pricing, code generation and QA.

summary: Scores earnings-call guidance history to predict if management will deliver
readme_summary: Concall tracks management guidance from Indian listed company earnings calls and predicts future delivery accuracy. Built as a Streamlit app with evaluation scripts and data pipelines. Uses LLMs to extract guidance, score track record, and forecast reliability for analysts.

summary: Records tutorials once then verifies AI replays with PASS/FAIL evidence
readme_summary: ReplayLab 3.0 captures tutorial playback and generates verifiable workflows with review, screen-share validation, and FAIL/PASS/UNCERTAIN scoring. Dockerized apps/packages with docs and demo video. Uses local Meta Llama 3.2 1B via Vulkan for workflow generation.

summary: Converts how-to videos into human manuals and robot-ready JSON procedures.
readme_summary: Upload-first tool that extracts keyframes and builds step manuals plus JSON with traceable frames. Evaluated with 3-run majority vote on held-out sets, up to 3 min / 100MB video. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Code for all demo AI, 100% local run.

summary: Checks video claims against web evidence with verdicts and cited sources
readme_summary: Video Integrity Intelligence ingests files or URLs, transcribes speech, extracts claims and searches live web for evidence. Outputs supported/contradicted verdicts with citations plus AI-frame and spam checks.

summary: Voice-first museum guide that answers questions about art in front of you
readme_summary: Mira is an Android app that uses BLE beacons to detect nearby artifacts and answers spoken questions. Grounded in curator records, it remembers tour context and speaks back in English and Hindi. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for grounded Q&A and voice.

summary: Research prototype analyzing ovarian ultrasound stills with evidence maps
readme_summary: Full-stack prototype for ovarian ultrasound stills on MMOTU OTU_2d dataset. Compares frozen features vs DINOv2 plus SAM 2.1 lesion localization with separate masks and scores. Research only, runs NO_MODEL without bundle.

summary: Clinical intake and drug verification assistant with Pidgin and English support
readme_summary: Docarion provides bilingual symptom intake, consultation rooms and counterfeit/antibiotic checks for Nigeria. Stack spans backend, frontend and mobile with clinical vision workflows. Uses SAM 3.1 clinical vision and Meta AI co-pilot.

summary: Landlord tool triages repair requests and reviews quotes with AI assistance.
readme_summary: Handles tenant report to completed repair: triage, vendor coordination, itemized quote analysis and policy updates. Muse Spark Iris assistant converts requests to actions; backend validates, landlord confirms; Dockerized frontend/backend.

summary: Autonomous video pipeline detecting environmental hazards for Abidjan pilot
readme_summary: Monitors video streams for environmental events using SAM 3.1 vision and Wonder router with Spark agents. Stack is FastAPI, Docker, real-time dashboard with audio alerts. Uses Meta API for vision detection and agent orchestration.

summary: Change-safe system linking spec changes to medical device labels
readme_summary: Connects specification changes to affected labels, artwork and deterministic findings with fault-injection tests. Dockerized backend with Alembic migrations. AI-optional, rules-decide human-approve workflow.

summary: Benchmarks and optimizes vision models for edge hardware deployment.
readme_summary: EdgeForge benchmarks models like YOLO across edge silicon for latency and optimization guidance. FastAPI backend with ONNX Runtime and Next.js frontend, Docker Compose, using Muse Spark and Llama 3 for analysis.

summary: Turns scanned P&ID drawings into verified, simulatable connectivity graphs.
readme_summary: Agent pipeline that finds symbols with Meta SAM 3.1 over overlapping tiles, builds connectivity and runs deterministic verifier with re-inspection loop. Flags uncertain parts for human review and enables valve isolation simulation.

summary: Playable React bug challenges with replays and regression tests
readme_summary: BugArcade turns real UI bugs into three-move debugging games with action timeline and failure analysis. Includes live demo, browser replays and proof artifacts. Frontend plus backend with Playwright verification.

summary: Natural-language mission control for autonomous drone search and rescue
readme_summary: Operators describe objectives; Muse Wonder plans checked flights for 1-4 simulated aircraft. Combines deterministic planning, autopilot software, SAM 3.1 detection and Muse Glimmer evidence review.

summary: Agent team turns reels and links into parent-friendly updates, tracks wellbeing
readme_summary: Family elder-care app where shared reels/links are converted by Meta-model agents into followable content, safety-checked before viewing, with wellbeing reports. Python 3.11 stack with Docker, Modal, scam-checker, and 175 tests.

summary: Inspects Mexican credit offers via camera and voice with catalog verification
readme_summary: Captures financial offers via camera and voice to compare disclosed terms against a curated catalog and user profile. Built with Next.js, Modal, and Baseten plus an Android client. Uses Meta Model API and Muse Spark for document reading and transcription, with deterministic code for calculations.

summary: Bilingual Arabic-English AI career coach for Gulf graduates with CV matching.
readme_summary: Matches CVs to job descriptions, identifies skill gaps and provides interview practice. Built with Python backend and web UI, localized for Saudization and Emiratization context. Powered by Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API.

summary: Evidence atlas tracing US data center permits, grid and disclosures to sources
readme_summary: WattDocket aggregates permits, grid context and operator disclosures with line-level citations. Architecture with API/core/schemas and open-source data provenance. Uses Meta AI for extraction and explanation with gap labeling.

summary: Decentralized satellite swarm mesh for space awareness and collision avoidance demo
readme_summary: FastAPI backend with React 18 and Three.js visualization for orbital swarm coordination. Models edge guidance and inter-satellite links for decentralized collision avoidance with live demo deployment.

summary: Safety-critical OS pairing 1000Hz Rust kernel with AI for surgical robotics
readme_summary: Tri-plane surgical robotics safety OS with Rust no_std 1000Hz actuator kernel, Kalman observer, and shared-memory bus. Targets IEC 62304 and DO-178C with web console demo. Uses Meta foundation models and SAM 3.1 for tissue segmentation and procedural guidance.

summary: Migrates legacy C billing code to Python with evidence of equivalence.
readme_summary: Autonomous agent migrates legacy C pricing/billing to Python using Muse Spark Open. Records legacy behavior, replays edge cases, diagnoses mismatches, repairs and verifies on held-out inputs with hosted FastAPI + frontend demo.

summary: Personal dining concierge that matches your taste profile to real restaurant menus.
readme_summary: DineTuned builds a persistent taste profile with Taste Detective and Taste DNA, then recommends specific dishes from real menus. Stack is web + api with Supabase and Render deployment. Public demo uses local data; real path used Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and Muse Image 1.0 for visuals.

summary: Smart-glasses memory that finds where you left objects at home from video
readme_summary: First-person home memory from glasses video to answer where did I leave my passport. Pipeline names movables with Muse Spark, cuts masks with SAM 3.1, re-IDs with DINOv2, tracks state. Python pipeline with precomputed demo.

summary: Talking digital twin that books and drafts, awaiting your approval
readme_summary: i-persons is a consent-gated digital twin that books meetings, sends email, and handles travel hand-offs. Built with Muse Spark, Muse Image, Muse Voice Transcribe, and SAM 3.1 across web, WhatsApp, and Ray-Ban Display glasses.

summary: Distributed fabric that turns a sentence into a trailer using local and cloud models
readme_summary: CinemaFabric routes each production task to local GPU, Mac, CPU or Meta Model API by quality, latency and cost with failover and caching. The demo studio builds script, storyboard, poster, voice-over and score. Integrates Glimmer, Llama, SAM and cloud models.

summary: Turns expert demo video into a checklist that verifies later job recordings.
readme_summary: Python tool converts how-to video into step checklist, then checks new recordings frame-by-frame, abstaining when not visible. Includes offline bench that grades Muse Spark on open how-to videos and exposes result-bias failure.

summary: Battery coating inspection that holds decisions when AI evidence is insufficient
readme_summary: SecureCoating combines Meta SAM 3.1 with pre-existing YOLO stack for electrode inspection. Adds dual-empty reconciliation and auditable HOLD decisions with demo provenance. Uses SAM 3.1 for evidence-grounded segmentation, Streamlit and Docker GPU build.

summary: Turns plain-language safety rules into live camera compliance checks
readme_summary: Camera-based workplace safety monitor. Muse Spark compiles natural-language rules to strict JSON with objects, zone, and hold time. SAM 3.1 segments and tracks objects per frame for alerts. Stack includes Python safety_mode, API, web demo, and Jetson bench.

summary: Adversarially retests coding-agent fixes to verify claimed bug repairs
readme_summary: Finds blockers by running repro tests 5x on PR vs base, then attack-loops proposed fixes for regressions. Demoed on pandas #64677 with 9 blockers and a caught perf regression. Python CLI with eval harness, demo and runbook docs.

summary: Career planner comparing roles, costs and time for moves in England.
readme_summary: Career path optimiser that combines experience, goals, budget and time to compare routes. Six-chapter flow covers profile, roles, skills, costs and trade-offs. Local-first stack with Docker, synthetic demo and England data.

summary: Agent-owned persistent homes forming a Muse-powered community
readme_summary: MuseCondo gives AI agents persistent identity and ownable homes in a shared Muse Tower community. Agent-native architecture with no resident dashboard. Uses Meta Muse models for identity, home maintenance and community interaction.

summary: Pinch a device in Quest 3 and get Muse-built connectors plus AR controls
readme_summary: WebXR system where SAM 3.1 segments devices in passthrough, then a Muse Spark agent with terminal and device tools writes, tests and deploys connectors. Generates live AR knobs and hand controls, demoed on MIDI, Bluetooth and Chrome.

summary: Turns vague goals into small timed steps to help you start now.
readme_summary: Next.js app where Muse Spark clarifies goals, searches real events and plans backward from due dates. Timer, streaks and Why-this-plan UI keep execution. Live on Vercel with web search.

summary: Infinite whiteboard tutor that explains textbooks with diagrams and citations
readme_summary: Upload books and chat with AI tutor on shared infinite canvas with text, LaTeX, diagrams and page citations. Supports drawing, selection Q&A and navigation. Monorepo with apps, Docker Compose and e2e tests.

summary: Voice-first shared window keeping distant families connected without monitoring
readme_summary: Nearer is a voice-first mobile app connecting parents and children across homes with lamps, doors, and memories. It uses Capacitor iOS/Android with Cloudflare Worker backend. It uses Muse for Hindi voice transcription, recipes, and family book search.

summary: AI interviewer that watches live coding and scores how you engineer
readme_summary: Crucible offers Live Coding Interview and Project Defense modes with a live AI interviewer that tracks edits and voice. It provides replay with synced code, audio and nudges plus scored feedback and merge-gate verdicts. It uses Meta Muse models for interview dialogue, code audit and evaluation.

summary: Building cooling that follows people using CCTV and BACnet controls.
readme_summary: Agent sees occupancy via Meta SAM 3.1 on CCTV, eases off empty zones and aims louvers at people via BACnet BMS. Text/voice complaints adjust units. Python monorepo with measured release numbers.

summary: Meeting listener that speaks only when it truly matters
readme_summary: Sotto is a local web app that listens to brainstorms and interjects rarely at pauses for errors or dropped threads. Node Fastify server uses Meta APIs with wake-phrase, React Vite UI and scripted fixtures.

summary: Local proxy giving OpenAI-compatible API for CLI model accounts
readme_summary: CLIProxyAPI is a Go proxy server exposing OpenAI, Gemini and Claude-compatible endpoints for CLI providers. It multiplexes multiple CLI accounts locally for use from any SDK or client. Ships with Docker and desktop client support.

summary: Point phone at broken appliance, describe issue by voice, get guided fix steps
readme_summary: Handyman identifies appliances from phone photos, diagnoses faults and walks through safe fixes with camera checks. Frontend mobile web plus backend live inference. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for diagnosis, SAM 3.1 for part segmentation, Muse Image for overlays.

summary: Checks recorded SOP procedures against video to flag missed or wrong steps
readme_summary: ProcessWatcher aligns recorded physical work against written SOPs with timestamps and frame evidence. Deterministic DP aligner decides compliance over model perception. Uses SAM 3.1 for hand-tool tracking, Muse Wonder for scoring, Muse Image for diagrams.

summary: Chat stylist builds persistent wardrobe from photos and validates looks
readme_summary: Instagram-DM-style agent catalogs garments from user photos then assembles full looks. SAM 3.1 segments garments, Muse Spark 1.3 classifies and reasons, Muse Image 1.0 renders previews. A fit-rule engine validates proposals via local proxy and wardrobe service.

summary: Personal library that saves posts and PDFs into searchable knowledge
readme_summary: Rembr collects saved Instagram, X and other posts, links, images and PDFs into one library with original source and notes. Provides search and knowledge tools to rediscover content. Monorepo with web app, worker, Docker and Render deploy.

summary: Analyzes playtest video and event logs into mapped friction report
readme_summary: Playtest Lens feeds 2-minute video+audio windows to Muse Spark 1.2 with no frame sampling, then verifies moments against clips and Godot event logs. Outputs confusion and bug map with clips and quotes. 21-min test costs about $0.18.

summary: Proxy server exposing OpenAI/Gemini/Claude APIs for CLI model accounts
readme_summary: Proxy server providing OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex/Grok compatible endpoints for CLI accounts. Go-based service with Docker, multi-account routing, and desktop client, forked from CLIProxyAPI with Devin fixes.

summary: Farsi learning app for diaspora children aged 3-7 with a daily spoken-word quest game
readme_summary: ZAAL is a React Native/Expo Persian learning app for children aged 3-7 in diaspora families. Its Daily Quest lets children pick words, say them aloud with on-device playback, and collect them through mini-games on a quest map.

summary: Generates an approved after-photo of a tidy table and executes it with robots
readme_summary: AYNA takes a spoken tidy request and current table photo, generates a verified after photo with Muse Image checked by SAM 3.1, converts it to centimetre goals, and executes in a physics twin. Returns a receipt of final object positions.

summary: iPhone assistant that outlines exactly which button or part to touch
readme_summary: Pip is a talk-while-you-work iPhone app that sees via camera, grounds instructions in 3D and tracks objects. Built with Muse Wonder, Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Voice Transcribe on-device EdgeTAM and DINOv2.

summary: Five-agent AI team that finds and qualifies federal contracts to bid
readme_summary: Rauros Systems describes your company then five agents search real US federal procurement records. Muse Spark 1.3 qualifies matches against capabilities and red-teams recommendations. Every result links to source with APPROVED, REVIEW_REQUIRED or HOLD status.

summary: Local-first Windows PC investigator that builds evidence-backed forensic timelines
readme_summary: Local-first Windows forensics app with PySide6 UI that collects artifacts into verifiable evidence. Uses strict Python 3.11+, mypy and 600+ tests for reliable offline investigation workflow.

summary: Lets AI operate button-only machines via camera, servos and approved MCP tools
readme_summary: Physical MCP watches machine panels with webcam, plans button presses with Muse Spark, checks plans in code against LCD readings, and requires human approval for risky actions. Servo fingers press buttons; demo uses 4-channel timer.

summary: Reviews coding-agent changes as analyst, architect, QA and compliance officer
readme_summary: Lifecycle Copilot runs non-coding duties for each code change without writing code or touching repos. Produces signed acceptance record. Built on Meta Muse Spark, pnpm monorepo.

summary: One phone records matches and maps every player in real meters
readme_summary: PP-Coach-Tracker tracks players and ball with SAM 3.1, solves pitch homography to output metric positions and writes tactical reports. Architecture is API plus worker and viewer with Android native. Uses SAM 3.1 tracking and Muse Spark reporting.

summary: Dependency scanner that proves if a CVE is reachable from public entry points
readme_summary: VScan builds call graphs with tree-sitter for Python/JS/PHP/Go, traces reachability from entry points and runs taint analysis. Correlates with OSV, CISA KEV and EPSS to verdict exploitable/reachable/not reached. Includes dashboard and action.

summary: Turns one product photo and brief into a finished 3D video ad
readme_summary: Multi-agent pipeline reads brand, finds/builds 3D model, plans shots and renders MP4 in C++ PBR renderer via JSON-RPC. Outputs 16:9/9:16 video with titles and music. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Voice.

summary: Whiteboard tutor that teaches visually and adapts to how you think
readme_summary: Shared whiteboard tutor that explains concepts, checks understanding and remembers learner models for next lessons. Web + API stack. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Image.

summary: WhatsApp voice agent that turns merchant messages into approved retail actions.
readme_summary: Cirak Agent converts merchant voice notes and product photos into planned business actions executed in KEDD CRM. A merchant approves with one word before deterministic code runs reads and writes. Built with agent layer, WhatsApp-style demo on Modal, and KEDD integration.

summary: Voice-directed film studio for blind creators with pixel-checked continuity
readme_summary: Voice co-director turns spoken ideas into storyboards and video with audio readback. Enforces continuity rules by segmenting props with SAM 3.1 and speaking measured changes.

summary: Real-time 1889 Nellie Bly world race game using historic newspaper scans
readme_summary: Then & There replays Nellie Bly's 1889 trip day-by-day from Nov 14 2026 to Jan 2027 using Library of Congress clippings. Players read original scans and predict if she makes it. Built with Next.js, Convex and Vercel with an AI Editor for verification.

summary: MCP server turns messy product photos into listing-ready images sellers can trust.
readme_summary: Agenthand is a Python reference MCP server for seller agents with draw, stage and proof tools for listings. It uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image with pixel-level proof the product never changed. Rust repo is the shipped product.

summary: Real-time voice roleplay for rehearsing tough conversations in English and Polish
readme_summary: Full-duplex voice pipeline with specialized agents, hidden state and screen sharing. Web client plus server pipeline with evaluation harness. Uses Meta Muse models for dialogue, interruption and post-call review.

summary: Private chief-of-staff linking personal learnings to work decisions
readme_summary: Ingests glasses captures, highlights and notes into personal Postgres separate from firm data. Drafts answers with per-sentence citations plus follow-up chat. Uses Muse models for ingestion and grounded drafting.

summary: Turns novel chapters into narrated vertical reels with drawn characters
readme_summary: Muse Spark writes hook, beats, poll and CTA; user narrates via teleprompter. Adds word captions, consistent Muse Image characters, badges and end cards. Chat editor revises reels; runs on Meta Model API via Docker and Modal.

summary: Voice call assistant that sees your iPhone screen and guides you where to tap
readme_summary: OjO is a phone call with screen-share. It narrates apps by voice, zooms tap targets, and writes localized text to clipboard. iOS frontend with backend, site and docs for live call experience.

summary: Personalized dashboard finds hackathons, jobs and tracks deadlines
readme_summary: Next.js React TypeScript app on Vercel with MongoDB Atlas for accounts and saved items. Uses Meta Model API for conversational search, web research, and artwork, plus in-app calendar for deadlines.

summary: Autonomous ops system that runs short-term rental guest, cleaner and issue work
readme_summary: Coordinates hosting operations end-to-end on a staged Hospitable-model fixture world with reservations and cleanings. Uses Meta AI models with graduated autonomy gating where low-risk acts auto-run and guest messaging or charges require earned rights.

summary: Curiosity-led learning companion that maps and tests what you explored
readme_summary: Trailhead follows user curiosity, builds a map afterward from actual exploration and checks recall. It fills only missing prerequisites. Built with Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 using app, components and lib with Docker deployment.

summary: Verifies Indian bills and payment requests to catch scams before paying.
readme_summary: BillSaathi checks bills against biller records, flags scams and explains verdicts in user language. Web plus API stack with eval harness and synthetic sandbox data, no real money moves. Built Oct 26-Nov 4 2026 for Startup track Build for Your World.

summary: Turns saved Reels into actionable to-do lists so plans happen
readme_summary: Someday converts useful Instagram Reels like recipes and travel plans into to-do lists via a bot and web app. Built with Next.js, Supabase, and video understanding. Live on Vercel with a 3-minute demo for the Meta hackathon.

summary: Converts a short work recording into guided visual instructions teams can follow
readme_summary: Captures expertise by turning task video and narration into editable steps, approved versions and offline follow-mode with field feedback. Frontend plus backend architecture. Uses Meta AI models to transcribe, segment steps and generate visual guidance.

summary: Agent that keeps product docs synced with code changes after review.
readme_summary: Next.js + Docker platform traces source changes through grounded analysis, Playwright screenshots and Meta vision. Human review gates publication to reader, SDK and read-only MCP interface. Uses Muse Spark Open via Baseten for reasoning.

summary: Spec clash detector with independent verification of AI code fixes
readme_summary: Resolves conflicting requirements by exhaustively finding disagreements, letting user decide winner, then having Meta coding agent implement. Independent checker verifies fix with measured 160-run study. Live Modal web demo.

summary: Turns phone stockroom video into an audit-ready count reconciled to books.
readme_summary: React Vite PWA + FastAPI/Postgres backend that turns phone video into tracked counts, reconciled to ledger with evidence packs on S3. Uses SAM 3.1 for detection/tracking, Muse Spark 1.3 for labels and damage checks, and Muse Voice Transcribe for narration.

summary: Multi-agent supply chain platform with disruption detection
readme_summary: Enterprise supply chain orchestrator with LangGraph agents, SQLite and Celery workers. Detects disruptions, negotiates stockouts, supports voice warehouse commands with HITL guardrails. Powered by Muse and SAM models.

summary: Turns floor plans and photos into explorable 3D homes for WebXR
readme_summary: WalkIn converts floor plans, photos and video into labelled 3D homes viewable in browser and Quest WebXR. It uses Muse Spark for layout, SAM 3.1 segmentation and Three.js with Immersive Web SDK.

summary: Turns expert demos into procedures then checks learners step-by-step on video
readme_summary: StepLint transcribes expert demos, tracks objects in video and drafts ordered procedures for review. During practice it verifies each step against visual evidence and coaches. Built for workbench assembly and hands-on tasks with Next.js.

summary: Maps external trust in repos and sites to flag takeover risks
readme_summary: Scans GitHub repos or websites for domains, scripts, buckets and Actions, classifies with Muse Spark and investigates via DNS, RDAP and GitHub lookups. Ranks expired domains and abandoned accounts. Detection only, live event-stream UI.

summary: Checks renovation bills by measuring tiled walls from phone photos
readme_summary: Reads contractor work statements and measures tiled areas from ordinary photos using tile grid as scale. SAM 3.1 finds tiles to recover wall plane, returning findings with uncertainty.

summary: Reconciliation copilot turning SME sales fragments into reviewable books
readme_summary: NaijaLedger ingests notebooks, invoices, PDFs, voice notes, and CSVs into deterministic match proposals for Nigerian retailers. Keeps AI from approving money or tax decisions, requiring human review. Built with Firebase, Cloud Run, and Meta AI models.

summary: AI-assisted chip design IDE where every pass comes from a real EDA tool
readme_summary: Agent IDE for chip design with Dockerized Ubuntu, Python and Node services. Integrates real EDA tools via MCP agent tools. Runs on Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and SAM 3.1 for design assistance.

summary: Checks code, tests and git evidence to show real distance to MVP
readme_summary: Parses MVP description into acceptance items and checks files, tests, git history and Muse Code sessions. Uses deterministic code for verdicts and a Muse model only to propose items. Reports verified to missing status as a range.

summary: Generates Facebook and Instagram campaigns for shops with owner approval
readme_summary: Product-in to campaign-out flow: Muse Spark plans copy, Muse Image creates product visuals, SAM 3.1 verifies. Owner approves then publish/export and measure. Python pipeline with synthetic demo business case.

summary: Turns whiteboard lectures into accessible linked pages for blind students
readme_summary: Processes recorded lectures into ordered board steps with plain readings, MathML and LaTeX. Links spoken deictics like this to referenced steps and marks unresolved cases. Python pipeline with evals and docs.

summary: Governed SecOps pipeline that only remediates with deterministic evidence
readme_summary: Scan-to-remediation workflow with 16-node LangGraph, guardrails, z3 checks, PoC witness and sandbox re-scan. Muse Spark proposes fixes, deterministic verifiers must confirm. Deployed on Cloud Run with Render fallback.

summary: Audits car ADAS claims against listing photos and docs for human review
readme_summary: Compares advertised ADAS features against listing photos and vehicle docs to produce reviewable evidence packets. Uses Muse visual observations with SAM localization, manufacturer-aware rules and deterministic reconciliation via durable worker with spend caps.

summary: Films a room to get renovation estimate, visualization and contractors
readme_summary: Phone-first app that analyzes room video in Uzbek, Russian and English to produce smeta estimate and finished look. Web stack with samples, lib and deploy, live site with sample room. Uses Meta models for video analysis, pricing and Foreman voice assistant.

summary: Films motion with a phone camera and answers measurement questions with proof.
readme_summary: Video measurement tool: upload motion video, ask in text or speech, get calibrated measurements with uncertainty overlays. Docker + backend/frontend on Modal; Muse models parse intent and plan tracking. Code computes via CV tracking.

summary: Tests if AI-taught 2048 lessons actually improve play on new boards
readme_summary: Three Muse-powered AI students play 2048 while teacher and peer agents propose lessons tied to past moves. Lessons are kept only if they improve scores on new boards versus untaught controls. Web classroom visualizes notebooks, provenance, exams, and comparisons.

summary: Photographs agar plates to count colonies and estimate CFU/mL with verification.
readme_summary: Photographs agar plates to segment colonies, count them, and estimate CFU/mL. Built with FastAPI and mobile web UI, tiling and CFU math pipeline. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and a Muse Spark agent with verifier that rejects unsupported counts.

summary: Webcam heart-rate estimator with live coaching and Muse-explained quality reports.
readme_summary: PulsePilot estimates heart rate from webcam video using FacePhys with guidance on lighting and movement. LangGraph workflows provide coaching, session analysis and insights. Muse Spark runs assistance while sensing and numeric reports run independently.

summary: Dual-sided trust layer scoring human reviews and AI agent reliability for commerce APIs
readme_summary: Reputation protocol for human + agent commerce combining verified reviews, 1-click scores, and machine telemetry like latency and schema drift. Next.js platform with AI sentiment analysis provides machine-readable consensus to prevent bots buying from fraudulent APIs.

summary: Live stand-up streaming with comedy-aware moderation on 12s delay
readme_summary: Live platform for stand-up shows where each show runs under comedian-approved rulebooks. Uses only Meta models for live comedy-aware moderation to avoid false takedowns. Built with Next.js, Tailwind and custom server.ts.

summary: Adaptive traffic signals with safety kernel and AI copilot
readme_summary: Adaptive traffic-signal intelligence with formal safety kernel and emergency-vehicle preemption. TypeScript Node monorepo with MongoDB time-series, pipeline and evals. Uses advisory-only Meta AI copilot for operator assistance, not direct control.

summary: Text-based go-to-market coach for founders via WhatsApp, SMS and email
readme_summary: Pitchside is a messaging-based GTM coach with 30-day challenges, check-ins and outreach help. Built with Node.js server and messaging integrations, it uses Meta Muse models for coaching dialogue and drafting posts.

summary: Live stage engine turning voice moods into synchronized lights and visuals
readme_summary: Afterglow is a FastAPI live-performance engine where push-to-talk cues drive light and motion scenes. Includes mock mode, tests and Render deploy. Uses Meta Model API for transcript refinement and keyword-to-scene mapping with silhouette overlay.

summary: Catalogs wardrobe from flat-lay photos and picks daily weather-aware outfits
readme_summary: One photo batch in, SAM 3.1 segments garments and Muse Spark catalogs them for a morning outfit agent. Python server plus scripts considers weather, calendar and unworn items. Built during hackathon with closet-first reuse focus.

summary: Local sysadmin agent that watches logs, explains issues and fixes them with permission.
readme_summary: On-machine agent for patrols, diagnosis and permissioned remediation across Linux, macOS and Windows. Muse Spark 1.3 drives patrols and Muse Wonder handles deep diagnosis, with Ollama local mode plus OpenAI and Anthropic. Python package with evals and tests.

summary: Android copilot that maps PCB photos and guides one-step multimeter fault isolation.
readme_summary: Native Android app with no backend; technician photographs board and describes symptoms. Uses SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API for part mapping, Muse Spark for ranked faults and gated measurements, Muse Image for repair view.

summary: Checks written crochet patterns stitch-by-stitch to find breaks and suggest fixes.
readme_summary: Paste a pattern to validate stitch counts, detect where it breaks and preview what it makes. Python web app with stitch-by-stitch checker, fix suggestions and demo video, built to avoid frogging yarn.

summary: Autonomous farm manager agent that controls a simulator via HTTP API
readme_summary: AgroGenesis agent adds autonomous observation, planning and tool-calling over a pre-existing farm simulator. Built in TypeScript with Meta Model API (Muse), persistence, and benchmarks via HTTP-only integration.

summary: Maps building facades from one photo to plan projection shows
readme_summary: Reads architecture from a single photo to produce element masks and timed show plans that align visuals to fins, glass and crowns. Uses SAM 3.1 for mapping, Muse Spark for planning and Muse Image for visuals with FastAPI backend.

summary: Phone photo to ledger CSV pipeline for Thai tax invoices and receipts
readme_summary: Ingest, PII scrub, segment, extract, validate and export Thai invoices to CSV/XLSX. Uses SAM 3.1 segmentation, Muse Spark extraction, satang/VAT math, R1-R14 rules, review queue, CLI. Python package with eval harness and gold labels.

summary: Scam-story checker that judges messages, screenshots and calls before you pay.
readme_summary: Bank-integration-free web app analyzing SMS, WhatsApp, email and QR context for red flags. Returns verdict card with next steps without seeing accounts or payments. Vite + Tailwind frontend with Vercel demo.

summary: Turns phone video into measured physics experiments with editable gravity replays
readme_summary: Agent watches short clips, tracks motion with Meta SAM 3.1, estimates laws and parameters with error bars. Verifies measurements against footage, then re-renders same shot with Moon gravity or no air. Node server with MCP tools and web demo.

summary: Chennai flood early-warning map built from crowdsourced photos and Tamil voice
readme_summary: Flood reporting and mapping system for Chennai with photo verify, depth measure, live map and Tamil voice Q&A. Python backend plus frontend. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark and Muse Voice.

summary: AI forensics agent that correlates logs and builds incident timelines
readme_summary: AI-powered digital forensics agent that analyzes security logs, correlates evidence, and reconstructs timelines. Backend in Python with frontend UI, using Meta Muse Spark via Model API for reasoning and report generation. Supports replay demo and local live investigation.

summary: Turns an AI-visibility scan into a personalized video report for businesses
readme_summary: Scans a business for AI search visibility then generates a presenter-led video report from real scan numbers with one-click written report. Built with Next.js, app/components/lib structure and e2e tests. Uses Meta AI models for report narration and video generation pipeline.

summary: Turns AI security opinions into deterministic evidence-gated fix decisions with receipts.
readme_summary: Extracts bounds checks via AST and validates invariants with math receipt checker. Python CLI with fixtures and evidence packs. Uses Meta Muse-Glimmer-30B for agentic code review workflows.

summary: Delegates agent spending caps with guardrails and PayPal sandbox settlement
readme_summary: AgentPay lets Muse Spark deliberate quota purchases under code guardrails, settles via PayPal Vault Sandbox, and issues visual receipts via Muse Image. Cloudflare Workers with spend ledger and replay.

summary: Maps micro-features like doors, sheds and indoor objects from images and video with GNSS and AI
readme_summary: Upload image, image set or video to detect small-scale map features missing from conventional maps. Uses EXIF GNSS when available, else Meta Spark 1.3 for localization; built in 10-day hackathon with Docker backend.

summary: Generates evidence-linked used-car condition reports from guided video clips
readme_summary: Captures eight guided car areas or one 3-min video, then runs local AI pipeline to produce private condition report with evidence links. Static landing plus sample report hosted on Cloudflare Pages, inspection app runs locally. Uses Meta vision and Muse models for damage screening.

summary: Chrome agent that finds UI defects and proves fixes across screen sizes
readme_summary: Chrome side-panel agent powered by Muse Spark via Meta Model API. Investigates live page, previews fix, edits source and verifies at mobile/tablet/desktop. Includes browser extension, bridge, demo-app and Vite plugin.

summary: Film a task once and test which robots can do it in simulation
readme_summary: Converts short task video into portable skill card checked against each robot morphology and tested in MuJoCo simulation. Static web demo with cards, robots and scripts. Uses SAM 3.1 tracking and Muse Spark Open via Meta AI for card generation.

summary: Investigates RTL chip bugs with contract skills and measured evidence.
readme_summary: SiliconShield investigates RTL design and security bugs for chip development. It provides contract skills for Muse Glimmer with reproducible checks and docs. Python 3.11+ stack with configs, deploy scripts, and examples.

summary: Phone-assisted malaria parasite counter for microscope field images
readme_summary: Turns lab microscope into counting copilot via phone or camera on eyepiece. SAM 3.1 segments cells, Muse Spark runs and audits counts, Muse Voice Transcribe enables hands-free operation. Supports Kiswahili/English reporting with Python stack.

summary: Edge biometric focus coach that sustains deep work and prevents burnout
readme_summary: NeuroSynk is edge-first cognitive ergonomics agent pairing on-device MediaPipe/TensorFlow.js telemetry at 60FPS with Meta models. Uses Muse Spark streaming for interventions and Muse Wonder for task decomposition. No raw video leaves device.

summary: Agentic investigator that diagnoses server failures with photos and logs
readme_summary: InfraSight correlates technician photos, SMART telemetry, kernel logs and manuals in multi-step investigations. Backend deterministic engine plus frontend with eval and tests. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for vision and sam-3.1 for perception with audit trails.

summary: Redesigns rooms from photo plus prompt with before/after comparison slider
readme_summary: NookShift lets renters explore room redesigns from photo and text prompt. Next.js client calls /api/plan which uses Meta Spark, SAM 3.1 and image model with per-view filtering. Returns plan, SAM boxes/masks and proposal image URL.

summary: Scans medicine packs to detect counterfeits in English, Pidgin, Yoruba
readme_summary: TrueMed photographs medicine packs, extracts evidence and checks facts against NAFDAC data and custody ledger. Backend API plus web and admin control room. Uses Meta AI vision-language for pack reading and multilingual explanations.

summary: Turns an ancestry upload into a cited 2-minute 16:9 history documentary
readme_summary: Takes ancestry results and writes, directs, illustrates and audits a short documentary end-to-end. Uses Meta Muse models for script, visuals and fact audit with Node static app plus API and replay mode. No GPU or DB needed, serves at localhost:8000.

summary: Hands-free repair and safety agent for industrial field crews with glasses HUD
readme_summary: Industrial field assistant running perceive-reason-confirm-enforce for repair and safety. Uses SAM 3.1 for part segmentation in camera/glasses view, with Next.js frontend, status API, and Vercel demo.

summary: Turns mountaintop cameras into wildfire detectors and locators
readme_summary: FireFinder detects wildfire smoke, calibrates camera pose from terrain and triangulates fire location with verification agent. Python pipeline with browser replay UI for six included fires. Uses Meta models for smoke detection and alert generation.

summary: Local-first agent platform with persistent memory, 132 tools and subagents
readme_summary: Local-first agent platform with Universe, Studio and Bots surfaces sharing memory and permissions. Spawns subagents and calls 132 tools with disk-persisted plans and artifacts. Uses Meta Muse Wonder and Muse Spark via Meta Model API.

summary: Gives Muse an iPad body that sees the screen and taps apps via ESP32.
readme_summary: Ode runs on a spare iPad with companion UI, sees the screen, talks with user and actuates real apps through $5 ESP32 with no jailbreak or APIs. Repo includes app-skills, devices and deploy configs with offline CI. Uses Meta Muse Spark for vision, dialogue and action planning.

summary: Photo a kiosk to get step-by-step help in your own language
readme_summary: AccessPoint helps elderly, blind, low-vision, migrant and tourist users operate ticket and checkout machines via photo guidance. Telegram bot plus mobile app provide multilingual next-step instructions. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice and Muse Image.

summary: macOS voice assistant that acts in the window you point at without clicking
readme_summary: Point at a window or Figma layer, hold Option and speak to run tasks in place via Muse. Native Swift app plus brain service, Figma plugin and custom protocol. Uses Meta Muse models for speech intent routing and in-window actions.

summary: WhatsApp investing assistant for Ghana stocks with risk profiling and live pricing.
readme_summary: WhatsApp investing assistant for the Ghana Stock Exchange that profiles risk, builds plans, and suggests priced trades. Runs on Cloudflare Workers with WhatsApp integration. Uses Meta Muse models for profiling, planning, and trade explanations.

summary: Three full apps generated from prompts by Weave with Muse
readme_summary: Three example apps generated by Weave from short prompts into flows, design, data contract and code. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Spark Open on Baseten, coded via Muse Code and OpenCode.

summary: Zero-config VS Code extension that records prompts and profiles LLM context.
readme_summary: TypeScript VS Code/Cursor extension that auto-records prompts, profiles context usage and acts as prompt co-pilot. Architecture is client extension + Meta Model API backend for analysis and suggestions. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0 via Meta Model API.

summary: Browser agent that sees screen, plans clicks, and verifies work
readme_summary: VisionPilot takes plain-English tasks, perceives the browser screen, plans actions and verifies completion with user approval. Python CLI agent built with Muse Spark via Meta Model API and Muse Code.

summary: Turns hand-drawn architecture sketches into live 60 FPS interactive simulations
readme_summary: Bi-directional physical-to-digital simulator replacing static slides with live failure testing. Dockerized backend + frontend architecture. Uses 6 Meta AI models for sketch parsing, diagramming, and simulation.

summary: Turns a repair video into an illustrated step-by-step guide with safety stops.
readme_summary: Upload filmed repair video and get illustrated beginner guide with outlined parts and danger hard-stops. Stack is Python app with Dockerfile and Modal deploy, web frontend and demo guides. Uses vision-language models for frame analysis and step generation.

summary: Turns syllabi and course files into verifiable, editable study plans
readme_summary: Muse Spark extracts assignments, deadlines and requirements from PDFs and images for student review. Features weekly workload view, calendar, Focus Mode and browser storage with quote and page validation.

summary: Repo history explorer that maps eras, architecture, and bug causes with citations
readme_summary: Archaeo ingests full Git history to build timelines, interactive architecture maps, and why-explanations. Stack uses Docker Compose with frontend and backend apps. Uses Muse models via Meta API for cited code reasoning with commit links.

summary: Manufacturing investigation platform combining rules detection with AI evidence reports
readme_summary: Deterministic Go detection triggers a Meta agent that selects cross-department evidence via eight tools. Stack is Go, PostgreSQL, React/TypeScript with SSE and audit. Uses Meta models for investigation and shift handover reports.

summary: Wildfire spread simulator that prioritizes firefighting resources with what-if reasoning
readme_summary: FireShift AI simulates wind- and terrain-aware wildfire spread from satellite perimeters, validated on the 2018 Camp Fire. It maps buildings and roads in the burn path and uses a reasoning model to compare scenarios. Stack is React map frontend plus Python pipeline and Streamlit app.

summary: Room planner that checks door clearances, utilities and ergonomics before construction
readme_summary: TypeScript frontend with Node server pairing Meta AI multimodal layout parsing with a local deterministic geometry verifier. Adds clearance, egress and joinery cut-sheet optimization for procurement planning.

summary: Records app tasks into guides that auto-repair when the UI changes
readme_summary: Muse Spark 1.3 performs tasks in live apps via computer use, Studio converts runs to video, article, demo and in-app walkthroughs. Re-runs and regenerates guides on UI change pending human approval. Node.js + render pipeline.

summary: Verifies Nigerian polling-unit result sheets with AI vision and publishes checks
readme_summary: Reads Nigerian polling-unit result sheets and cross-checks totals for Osun 2026 election. Stack is React 19 + Hono API in TypeScript. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for OCR-reasoning and SAM 3.1 for sheet segmentation via Meta Model API.

summary: Turns pre/post flood images into ranked, uncertainty-aware dispatch plan
readme_summary: Takes pre/post disaster image pair to map newly flooded areas, estimate impacted people, area and blocked roads, and rank zones with flood-aware routes. Stack includes Docker/Python with printable HTML and Bangla brief. Uses Meta AI vision and Muse models for mapping and audit agent.

summary: AI-assisted campus marketplace helping students sell products, skills and work
readme_summary: University marketplace for listings, discovery and permission-controlled AI commerce. Modern web app with live deployment, CI, docs and launch film. Uses Meta AI / Muse for listing assistance and buyer-seller workflows.

summary: On-device Android coach that labels study sessions and plans days
readme_summary: Android app reads UsageStatsManager sessions during timetable study blocks and labels them focused/distracted/neutral on-device. Backend assists ambiguous cases and next-day planning. Built for privacy with raw usage staying on owned devices.

summary: Glasses-based visual memory that answers where enrolled objects were last seen
readme_summary: Ray-Ban Meta glasses relay via Android to Python backend dashboard with photo timestamps. Uses SAM 3.1 to locate objects and hands, Muse Spark to describe placement. Enroll once flow with automatic observation relay.

summary: AI-native notebook editor where agent writes and runs cells end-to-end
readme_summary: Standalone Bun frontend notebook editor with real Python kernel where agent plans, codes, executes and fixes. Same-notebook supervision via MCP tools. Supports Muse Spark and Muse Spark Open only.

summary: Turns force-response descriptions into simulator-verified origami metamaterial folds.
readme_summary: Pipeline that designs origami-inspired force-displacement cells from natural language. Combines generators, world models and simulator verification with Python stack. Hackathon work extends prior simulator and proposer models.

summary: Learning platform that turns topic requests into fact-checked mini-lessons
readme_summary: Users request topics, an external skill-driven teacher agent calls the public API to create droplets via the Python studio pipeline that writes and fact-checks lessons. Stack is Next.js with Prisma and Docker. No direct Muse integration; teacher is Claude routine or CLI.

summary: Turns NZ addresses into 3D backyard housing concepts checked against housing rules
readme_summary: Generates evidence-backed 3D housing concepts from real NZ property data using national open data, LiDAR, and aerial imagery. Meta models design dwellings in Blender with independent NZ granny-flat rule checks. Live at button.nz.

summary: Turns one sentence into a playable painted point-and-click adventure game
readme_summary: Diorama turns story ideas into small point-and-click games with painted scenes, walking characters, inventory and reachable endings. Local CLI + Studio writing plain files. Uses Muse Spark for planning, Muse Image for art, SAM 3.1 for segmentation.

summary: Android launcher that rebuilds home screen and generates missing apps
readme_summary: Masala is a Kotlin Jetpack Compose Android launcher that reshapes home around intent and writes pinned apps. Native app with core modules, Gradle build, and 1315 tests. Uses seven Meta models for understanding, planning, and codegen.

summary: Agent that reconciles clinic messages, calendar, and drafts replies with Undo
readme_summary: Kept reads appointment emails/texts, resolves true booked time, checks calendar conflicts, and drafts replies for approval. Never auto-sends, full Undo. Uses Meta key-hosted model with Gmail and calendar integrations.

summary: Trip flood risk advice from PAGASA data, photos and road closures
readme_summary: Answers Go, detour, Wait or Unknown for Philippines trips using PAGASA advisories, closure sweep and crowd photos. Next.js map app with depth reader that maps street photos to MMDA gauge and Telegram watcher for voice and photo reports.

summary: Interactive world map showing who funds and lends to large corporations.
readme_summary: Who Funds It visualizes corporate financing flows, equity, debt and donations with scaled map markers for entities like BlackRock. Open-weights Muse Glimmer geocodes business addresses and validates data quality via sampling. Stack is Dockerized frontend plus backend with live Vercel demo.

summary: AR game where kids drawings become characters and tables become playable levels
readme_summary: Rudeus is an Android AR game in Kazakh and Russian for kids. It photographs drawings into characters and scans tables into obstacles and platforms via ARCore. Uses SAM for masking and Muse models for character generation in Kotlin Multiplatform.

summary: Plans a layover walking tour that guarantees on-time arrival
readme_summary: WowSpot plans time-boxed city walking routes with on-time arrival. It uses Muse models for intent, voice and photos plus ORTools OPTW solver, self-hosted OSRM foot routing, and a strict schedule validator.

summary: Ableton co-producer that hears mix issues, fixes them and proves the result
readme_summary: Ableton Live device plus engine and ML backend that analyzes Main track for clashes. Muse Spark explains issues and applies fixes, then re-measures to confirm. Includes browser demo and install tooling for Live integration.

summary: Self-hosted AI teammate that codes tickets to approved pull requests
readme_summary: agnts takes Jira, Plane and chat tickets and codes them with Muse Code in isolated containers with human approval. Go module agnts-muse enforces budgets over Muse session protocol. Handles reviews, security scans and meeting notes.

summary: Point phone at broken appliance to get 3D guided repair steps
readme_summary: Identifies exact machine model from sticker photo, researches repair and shows steps on 3D model with voice and photo verification. Built solo during hackathon. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

summary: Edits photos from a sentence with plannable, checkable, undoable layers
readme_summary: Plans photo edits from text or voice, segments targets with SAM 3.1, redraws with Muse Image, then self-reviews and revises. Swift app with library-scale planning via Muse Spark and Muse Wonder plus Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Runs Claude, Codex, Gemini and Copilot coding agents side-by-side in one window
readme_summary: Local chief-of-staff router that orchestrates parallel coding agents via screen reading and auto-typing. Runs on-device across macOS, Windows, Linux and Android with Spaces for project organization.

summary: Trains a personal agent from before-after examples to draft in your style
readme_summary: Learns user writing style from corrections to turn raw meeting notes into finished minutes. Web app with Better Auth, desktop apps for Mac and Windows with auto-update, plus profile memory and coaching.

summary: Drone wildfire mapping with live flame detection and spread forecasting.
readme_summary: Sentinel Ember processes drone video in-browser to outline flames and map them on 3D terrain. A forecaster predicts the one-hour fire front and dispatches agents to monitor it. Built for faster wildfire suppression decisions.

summary: Safe email client that holds incoming mail until AI checks and a helper approves it.
readme_summary: Blazor Server email client for elderly and users with learning disabilities. Every message passes Rules, Meta AI, link and policy checks; unclear mail goes to a helper. Built with .NET 10 Blazor Server and plain CSS.

summary: Single story-world hub that keeps series, game and shorts in sync
readme_summary: Storyverse holds one master story world and generates sheets, art, scripts, voices and coder packages via Next.js app. Stack is Next.js, React components and lib pipelines. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Image, SAM 3.1 and Muse Code per README.

summary: Chat agent that researches docs and verifies steps in a sandbox to build tutorials
readme_summary: Cueframe is a chat-first agent platform where browser actions are REST/WebSocket calls and jobs stream progress. It researches official docs, executes in sandbox, and returns cited tutorials. Built on Muse Spark, Wonder, SAM 3.1, Image and Voice.

summary: Semantic firewall that allows, denies or asks before coding agents act
readme_summary: AgentWarden sits between coding agent and machine with deterministic rules, local Llama 3.1 8B judge and Muse Spark escalation. Scans tool calls and file reads for prompt injection, fails closed, with evals and hooks.

summary: Text-to-3D office designer that plans rooms and builds walkable models
readme_summary: Icarus plans rooms and circulation from text and builds a walkable 3D model with furniture and lighting. Monorepo with apps/packages and validator layout engine. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for program inference and edit operations.

summary: Cryptographic permits that verify every agent money action
readme_summary: Mandate issues certificates for agent actions touching money or production, enforcing exact-payment approval at a bank teller demo. Stack is console frontend, bank service and bench harness. Uses Meta models for policy checks per docs.

summary: AI OS helping small suppliers triage bids and track government orders
readme_summary: KounOS reads federal solicitations, compares supplier quotes, recommends bid price and monitors awarded orders to delivery and payment. Built on Meta Muse models via Meta Model API with API backend and web frontend. Prototype built Oct 26-Nov 4 2026 for hackathon.

summary: Turns one robot demo into executable tests with PASS/FAIL and failure onset frame
readme_summary: Shows a task once, generates readable executable test via Meta models, grades attempts frame-by-frame. Returns PASS/FAIL/CAN'T TELL with physical cause and code blame. Built for Push the Frontier robotics testing.

summary: AI SRE team that cuts Kubernetes waste and ships fixes as git commits
readme_summary: Finds unused capacity, diagnoses incidents, does KEDA scaling and node SKU optimization. Multi-agent system with dashboard and GitOps behind cost-aware LLM router. Supports OpenAI-compatible APIs.

summary: Android nutrition tracker that logs meals and activity with Meta AI
readme_summary: NutriMind AI is a Kotlin Jetpack Compose Android app for nutrition and activity tracking. Uses Firestore and on-device features with photo and activity inputs. Powered by Meta Model API for multimodal nutrition analysis.

summary: Styling assistant that restyles owned clothes and tracks confirms
readme_summary: Seoul-first closet app in Korean and English that suggests minimal edits using owned clothes and counts only confirmed wears. Calls muse-spark-1.3 and sam-3.1 via Meta Model API from adapters. Node runtime with SAM parser dependency.

summary: Model-agnostic harness that builds verified Flutter apps to TestFlight
readme_summary: Rocket turns one prompt into store-ready Flutter app from locked design kit with auth, paywall, metadata and signing plumbing. Gate validates builds before TestFlight upload under user account. Harness is model-agnostic, demonstrated with Muse Spark generation.

summary: Floating Android guide that narrates phone tasks for older adults
readme_summary: Android accessibility companion with floating Help bubble that gives spoken step-by-step UI guidance with visual rings. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe with backend observer loop.

summary: Deterministic security gate that blocks prompt injection in tool-using agents
readme_summary: Gate treats all tool and image outputs as untrusted data, allowing only user-directed actions. Deterministic code with no model, evaluated on AgentDojo workspace suite against scripted worst-case attacker with Muse Spark Open agent.

summary: AI film studio turning one idea into screenplay, storyboard, voice track and MP4
readme_summary: Next.js app with accounts and admin console that generates screenplay, cast bible, chained storyboard frames and continuity checks. Builds voice track and final MP4 for Shorts, TikTok, Reels and YouTube. Uses Meta Muse Wonder, Spark and Image models.

summary: Browser studio that generates explorable 3D worlds from text prompts
readme_summary: Meta models plan worlds and write constrained GPU functions, verified before rendering via NullGraph on client GPU. Frontend studio for camera, controls and video export. Uses Meta models for world planning and code generation.

summary: Turns paper sketches or text prompts into playable phone games
readme_summary: PlayLab generates playable games from hand-drawn levels or descriptions in seconds, with phone as controller via QR. Muse Spark builds and repairs code, Muse Image creates sprites, SAM 3.1 cuts out drawings. Plain HTML/JS frontend, no build step.

summary: Checker that catches GD&T and dimensioning errors before parts reach shop floor
readme_summary: Upload PDF/image drawing or sample; Muse Spark extracts dimensions, tolerances, feature-control frames and datums to structured data. Flags missing datums, untoleranced dimensions and manufacturability risks before release.

summary: Teacher-led music lessons with AI mediator and bilingual instruction
readme_summary: Souls of Muse supports teacher-led instrumental and singing lessons with a Muse AI mediator. The repo hosts soulsofmuse.app plus a model test bench for the hackathon. Includes rehearsal room, video studio and Ray-Ban Meta services prototypes.

summary: Opt-in video ad system that tracks surfaces and composites brands per viewer
readme_summary: Uploads short video once, detects stable posters and objects in longest shot, tracks them in 3D, then composites auction-winning brands in browser. Pipeline with auction, perspective and occlusion handling. Prototype for disclosed Reels-style placements.

summary: Benchmarks LLMs as drone navigators in 3D disaster simulations
readme_summary: Eval harness for ReAct single and 2-drone missions in Gazebo worlds from real assets and NASA FIRMS data. Uses inspect-ai, Baseten and Modal inference. Uses SAM 3.1 for edge perception and Muse frontier models.

summary: AI agents plant realistic bugs to find gaps in tests then write verified fixes.
readme_summary: BugBait is a multi-agent mutation-testing system where a Saboteur plants bugs and runners execute the suite. It uses Meta Muse Spark for bug generation and verified test synthesis, packaged as Python app, Docker, and GitHub Action.

summary: Policy gate and tamper-evident ledger for finance agent actions
readme_summary: Gate checks every agent action against Cedar rules before tool execution and records to tamper-evident ledger. Modular Python/Docker architecture with docs per module. Targets regulated finance auditability on Meta hackathon stack.

summary: Verifies AI bug fixes by testing tests with decoy patches and dual-model review
readme_summary: Reproduces bugs, plants plausible wrong fixes and requires independent probes like DB reads. Muse Wonder writes fixes, Muse Spark reviews gaps. GitHub Action and JS package with Vercel deployment.

summary: Learns Windows and Chrome chores once, then replays them with zero AI calls
readme_summary: Windows + Chrome automation that learns a task from one demonstration then replays deterministically. Python app with overlay and code verification. Uses Muse Spark for initial step inference, replay uses no AI calls.

summary: Tablet camera over factory QC table flags garment defects for inspector review
readme_summary: Phone/tablet mounted over final-inspection table captures photos when garment is still, runs SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark pipeline to circle defects like holes and bad seams. Built with Cloudflare Workers, D1/SQL storage. Inspector confirms verdicts.

summary: Photo of a paper shop notebook becomes a searchable mini-CRM with one-tap WhatsApp
readme_summary: Converts ledger photos into customers, balances and follow-up lists. Stack is vanilla HTML/CSS/JS ES modules with Supabase and Netlify Functions, zero npm dependencies. Uses Muse Spark Open for reading and Q&A and Muse Voice Transcribe via netlify/functions/_lib/ai.js.

summary: Simulates feedforward road-traffic noise cancellation across an open roadside zone
readme_summary: Browser Vite sim of two-tower fiber-linked active noise control for 60-160Hz traffic rumble. Implements seeded propagation, delay model, and guarded FXLMS adaptive controller with honest wavelength-capped quiet zones. No Meta model dependency.

summary: Token-efficient unambiguous language for AI agent messaging
readme_summary: AICL defines a common S-expression language for agent-to-agent requests with spec and zero-dependency reference implementation. Replaces ambiguous natural language with verifiable typed messages. Draft v0.1.0 with SKILL and SPEC.

summary: Crowd of synthetic shoppers tests real websites for usability issues
readme_summary: Footfall sends eight persona agents in real Chrome browsers to shop a site and narrate friction. Store database verifies success, then fixes are re-tested. Includes scenarios, tutorials and tests for repeatable UX evaluation.

summary: Local workstation that reveals what a tech video edit cut out
readme_summary: Local video evidence workstation aligning published edits to source with dual-player view. Deterministic 4Hz spatial-color aligner plus timestamped Meta AI interpretation. Dockerized backend traces omissions in tutorials and demos.

summary: Image-first crop health assistant for smallholder farmers with voice input
readme_summary: Mydrak AI v3 is a crop health assistant that diagnoses plant disease from images and Hindi voice. Python stack with bot, audio, vision, SAM, decider and KB disease cards. Planned use of Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Glimmer, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Resolves PayPal disputes in-chat inside merchant limits with receipts
readme_summary: Buyer and merchant agents negotiate refunds within owner limits, verify via PayPal records and signed receipts. Python network-isolated system with web console and static verifier. Uses Muse models for negotiation and dispute triage.

summary: Browser extension that explains pages, guides form fills and flags errors
readme_summary: AI browser companion extension plus web app and form simulator that explains pages and assists form completion. Extension, web and Supabase backend. Uses Meta Muse Spark Open on Baseten as private inference for page understanding.

summary: Drone shark detection that sends confirmed alerts to lifeguards in seconds
readme_summary: SharkWatch analyzes aerial water video to detect sharks amid glare and kelp. It packages evidence and routes confirmed alerts to authorities. Next.js app with live and demo routes built for Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon 2026.

summary: Infers LEGO robot kinematics to drive EV3 bricks and train pointing policy
readme_summary: Just Bricks infers kinematic chain from LEGO part poses, generates FK/IK and EV3 programs, and drives the robot via web console. MuJoCo auto-generates demos to fine-tune SmolVLA for webcam pointing. Uses Meta AI for kinematics reasoning and VLA policy.

summary: 15-agent store assistant drafts ads and ops tasks staged for owner approval.
readme_summary: Breaks solo-seller requests into subtasks across 15 specialists for ads and store ops. Python FastAPI with approval-gated drafts, mission receipts, and risk gate. Uses Muse Spark dynamic planning and Muse Image for ad creatives.

summary: Homeschool quest app where parents assign goals and AI checks proof
readme_summary: GameSchooling compiles parent goals into kid quests with verifiable grading. Built on TanStack Start on Cloudflare Workers with D1+R2, it uses Muse models and SAM 3.1 to verify submitted work.

summary: Simulator for modeling remote-memory CXL and RDMA fabrics for AI workloads
readme_summary: Discrete-event simulator with scenario schemas, Python engine and dashboard for placement and prefetch policy. Helps test latency cliffs and failures without hardware. Built as Muse AI Hackathon infra copilot.

summary: Compiles desktop app workflows into checked tools for small local models
readme_summary: Autoharness has a frontier Meta model learn a GUI task once then exports it as an MCP tool. A small open model executes locally with code checks validating each step. Zero cloud cost after learning phase.

summary: Workbench that turns questions about simulated fly brains into measured experiments.
readme_summary: CausalFly is an AI-assisted workbench for simulated nervous systems with 3D visualization. Next.js frontend plus deterministic measurement engine compares control versus intervention trials. Uses Meta AI to convert language and visual observations into controlled experiments.

summary: Classifies screen time semantically to show what your hours actually were.
readme_summary: Always-on activity agent that classifies screen content instead of app names, with loopback-only sync for privacy. Stack includes local agent, server and web viewer. Uses open-weights Meta models for semantic classification.

summary: Ask BLAST questions in plain English and get verified E-value verdicts locally.
readme_summary: Local-first genomics assistant: paste sequence or accession, Muse interprets intent and explains verdict. Real BLAST engine runs search, code validates hits, E-values, identity and coverage. Docker Compose with backend + frontend.

summary: Grounded IT triage workbench that drafts safe runbooks from tickets and screenshots
readme_summary: Workbench for Windows MSPs that matches tickets and error screenshots to Markdown runbooks via BM25L. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for grounded diagnosis, classifies PowerShell risk, and supports re-triage and PSA writeback. Never executes commands.

summary: Maps Meta ad portfolios to reveal missing motivation and format ideas.
readme_summary: Web app for advertisers that maps coverage of creative ideas across a portfolio. Runs cached demo with no key, optional passcode-gated live mode. References Meta Andromeda retrieval for context on ad encoding.

summary: Photo-to-creature pixel sandbox where objects hatch into companions you raise
readme_summary: Oddlings turns photos of real objects into pixel companions with abilities, habitats and fusion. Players care for, talk to and build worlds for creatures. It uses Meta Muse Spark for character logic and Muse Image for pixel art generation.

summary: Hands-free voice assistant that narrates important surroundings for blind users
readme_summary: TheThirdEye watches camera input and speaks only when something matters like currency, faces, or labels. Built with TypeScript full-stack and Caddy deployment. It uses Muse models for proactive vision understanding.

summary: Windows desktop agent that runs commands, files and messages
readme_summary: Open-source AI OS for Windows 10/11 that controls PC, runs terminal commands, manages files, and sends WhatsApp/Email. Python architecture with tools and memory powered by Muse Spark Open via Baseten inference.

summary: Turns PDFs into quoted guided tours linked to source pages
readme_summary: Generates verifiable reading guides where every quote must match source. TypeScript React + Mastra + Effect on Modal. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 exclusively with reviewer agents for validation.

summary: Accessible Helsinki journey planner that checks step-free routes with evidence
readme_summary: Digital Twin Watch answers wheelchair routing queries using Helsinki open data and Digitransit HSL routing. Node server.mjs app with map and citizen evidence. It uses Meta AI for natural-language explanations.

summary: Isolates disputed invoice amounts and drafts collection notices for MSMEs
readme_summary: AR dispute-resolution platform for Indian MSME distributors. Isolates disputed vs undisputed balances, verifies claims against evidence, drafts notices, and requires human approval. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for verification and drafting with FastAPI backend and web frontend.

summary: Turns expert videos into SOPs and verifies learner attempts with visual proof.
readme_summary: StepProof generates structured SOPs with steps and visual end-states from expert video, then checks learner video for skipped or out-of-order steps. Runs offline with OpenCV mocks, swappable to SAM 3.1 and Muse models. Includes Streamlit app and eval report.

summary: Firewall between agents and world that screens inputs and blocks risky tool calls.
readme_summary: Ingress screens emails, web, files and images with heuristics, guard model, Muse Spark vision and SAM 3.1. Egress enforces DLP and tool policies with Muse judge; red-team agent self-hardens rules.

summary: Chrome side-panel agent that reads pages and clicks, types and summarizes
readme_summary: Autonomous browser agent living in Chrome side panel, working with user tabs and logins. Powered by Muse Spark Open or any OpenAI-compatible model. Includes chat, browser tools, memory and playbooks.

summary: Search 77,750 MoMA catalogue pages by what appears in the pictures
readme_summary: Visual index over 757 MoMA catalogues with 93,527 figures detected and 45,493 records catalogued. SAM 3.1 finds figures, Muse Spark reads pages and identifies books. Web app links each result to MoMA PDF page.

summary: Two-way browser bridge between sign language and spoken speech
readme_summary: Browser live-call app with captions plus avatar fingerspelling one way and sign-to-text the other for NSL and ASL. No special hardware required. Uses speech-to-text, letter/word sign classifiers, and Meta models for translation.

summary: Voice and photo bookkeeper that closes monthly books for gig drivers
readme_summary: Ryde Off reconciles payout reports, bank feeds, receipt photos and voice notes into ledger, P&L and Schedule C draft. Agentic Python plus app stack. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Investigates Python bug reports with checked citations from pinned repos
readme_summary: Investigates Python issues using independent Muse Glimmer agents that cite pinned repo sources. Stack is Python app with local rechecking and cached demo. Uses Muse Glimmer for investigation with verifiable citations.

summary: WhatsApp fact-checker where agents debate forwards and judge returns verdict card
readme_summary: Forward Court forwards suspicious text, photo or video to true-vs-false agents that cite only retrieved sources. A judge returns True/False/Misleading/Unverified or Dangerous verdict cards in user language for resharing.

summary: Turns best YouTube moments into lessons with checks until it sticks
readme_summary: Next.js app that curates YouTube clips per topic and quizzes for retention. Deployed with Baseten and Modal hosting. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for tutoring and Muse Voice Transcribe for video speech.

summary: Voice dictation aid that structures vertigo cases for ER physicians
readme_summary: Voice-first prototype where physician dictates and Meta models structure findings and ask follow-ups. Deterministic rules engine makes safety call for stroke risk. Replay mode with scripted cases only.

summary: 3D maze game where you guide a robot with natural-language missions via AI agent.
readme_summary: RoboRally is a 3D factory maze game with no manual controls. The player types a mission, Muse Spark plans moves in bounded segments, backend validates against walls and hazards, and the engine executes. Frontend and backend game loop.

summary: Designs replacement parts from a phone photo with scale reference and verifies fit.
readme_summary: Takes photo with ruler/coin, measures with SAM 3.1, generates CAD via Muse Spark and verifies with deterministic checker. Rust mesher plus Cloudflare Workers studio. Uses SAM 3.1 for measurement and Muse Spark for CAD.

summary: Field notebook that verifies camera-clip counts with human confirmation
readme_summary: Field notebook for camera clips combining zones, rules-engine counts and human-confirmed notes. Python API plus Next.js web app with Docker Compose and output schema docs. Uses vision detection with deterministic counting logic.

summary: Film products and speak to auto-build a multilingual storefront PWA.
readme_summary: PWA for small merchants that turns product video and Darija/French/Arabic/English voice into a store. Cuts products from video, sets prices by voice, and publishes a shareable shop. Built with Next.js and Cloudflare, using Meta AI for transcription and vision.

summary: Open-source monitoring that captures agent runs and groups failures into fixes
readme_summary: Observability for AI agents capturing prompts, tool calls, tokens and cost via OpenTelemetry. Groups failures and drafts fixes. Monorepo with apps and packages. Uses Meta Muse Spark by default for explanations.

summary: Converts street photos into geolocated inspection reports for city teams
readme_summary: Turns phone photos of roads and construction sites into severity-scored civic reports. TypeScript pnpm monorepo with apps and packages. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark via Meta Model API for analysis.

summary: Visual-bug agent watches UI failures and ships verified fixes from one sentence
readme_summary: Agent that watches visual bugs, proves them with failing tests, and ships verified fixes. Uses Muse Code plus SAM 3.1 perception, Muse Spark reasoning and Muse Wonder with 146 offline tests.

summary: Tests if resource-bounded AI cells adapt when memories become untrusted
