readme_summary: Python assistant preserving objectives and snapshots with syntax checks and muse-spark-1.3 reassessment of evidence. Includes deterministic multi-generation experiment where evaluator outcomes persist as versioned memories.

summary: Turns screen recordings of office work into automation-ready workflow maps.
readme_summary: FlowSME converts work recordings into workflow maps, app usage, and automation scores. Python service analyzes screenshots and emits schema-checked JSON reports. Uses Muse Spark vision for step description and structured workflow reasoning.

summary: Photograph a broken appliance to get a safe step-by-step troubleshooting plan.
readme_summary: FixLens identifies appliances and faults from photos or video, asks targeted questions, then generates prioritized fixes with safety stop rules. Built as mobile app plus backend API. Uses muse-spark-open-1026 via Baseten OpenAI-compatible API for vision and reasoning.

summary: Autonomous agent that finds bugs and opens verified fixes via sandboxed patches
readme_summary: AutoPatch-Kernel localizes faults via Tree-sitter AST call graphs and syscall tracing, then tests patches in parallel Git worktrees in Modal sandboxes. MCP server, Python engine and dashboard stream progress with Z3 verification. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning.

summary: Checks pharma packaging lines for leftovers and logs QA-signed clearance
readme_summary: Fixed cameras watch pharma lines, SAM 3.1 segments leftover objects and Muse Spark judges against checklists. Operators remove and re-check, QA signs timestamped record. Vite + Node stack with virtual plant demo. Uses live Meta SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark models.

summary: Energy-aware agent turns plain English policy into safe solar network actions
readme_summary: Compiles plain-English policy into network actions against real solar state with self-refusal for critical loads. Supports local Llama via Ollama by default and hosted muse-spark-1.3 via Meta API.

summary: Simulates factory failures to test persist-or-replan recovery decisions
readme_summary: Simulation-grounded digital twin for manufacturing recovery. Meta model inspects shop state, proposes bounded experiments, and chooses PERSIST or REPLAN. Built in Python with configs, scripts, and hosted Modal web replay.

summary: Automated review that flags dubbing errors with timestamps and fixes
readme_summary: Uploads video plus brief to get timestamped threads with evidence and fix instructions via REST/MCP/webhook. Muse Spark watches and listens while deterministic signal processing verifies sync and quality. Side-by-side review UI with FastAPI backend.

summary: Reliability lab that finds and proves vision-model counting failures
readme_summary: CounterForge searches controlled image edits that preserve count but break VLM counting, then packages verified failures as regression tests. Full-stack app with FastAPI, Postgres, and review workflow.

summary: Voice and text errand agent in Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, Pidgin and English
readme_summary: ASAP lets users send voice notes or text in Nigerian languages to complete errands like buying and booking. Built with Node 22 and zero dependencies, it uses Meta Muse Spark for multilingual understanding and agentic task execution.

summary: Self-evaluating video generation orchestrator that predicts failure and guides retraining
readme_summary: Orchestrator agent that classifies, plans, runs, verifies and reports video generations with per-item measurement and evals. Built on Latent Raw format with LTX-2.5 LoRAs and Meterless H-MEM memory. Adds failure prediction and training guidance during hackathon, with SAM 3 planned.

summary: Measures physics videos with frame tracking, fits and honest error bars
readme_summary: Turns phone video of pendulum or collisions into measurements with error bars. Uses Next.js frontend, custom physics fits and SAM 3.1 frame tracking. Muse Spark agent selects targets, recovers tracking and guides next experiment.

summary: Personalized AI campus tour planner for prospective students
readme_summary: Campus Compass builds personalized itineraries from major, interests, time and location across 5,877 institutions. Node web app with mapped guides, landmarks and experimental Android/Meta glasses support. Uses Ollama llama3.1:8b locally with Meta integration path.

summary: Turns photos of market sales books and voice notes into verified ledgers
readme_summary: Telegram/WhatsApp bookkeeping agent reads handwritten pages and voice notes in English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo. Models propose entries, code verifies numbers into hash-chained double-entry ledger. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image with one-tap confirm.

summary: Voice-first leaving-home check that verifies stove knobs before saying all clear
readme_summary: Hold Point walks users to the stove and checks knobs with two independent Meta models, giving movement guidance and last-seen item locations. Built for blind, low-vision and older adults. Python agent with evals and proofs.

summary: Night-shift AI that researches suppliers and drafts shop listings for approval
readme_summary: Second Me researches live CJ Dropshipping products, cleans supplier data and drafts listings overnight for solo sellers. Built with Vite and Node server.mjs, it uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API with human approve/reject gating.

summary: Simulates factory operations with digital twin and six investigating AI agents.
readme_summary: Industrial digital-twin MVP models factory topology, ingests simulated telemetry, and runs six specialist agents for incident analysis. Twin Copilot on Muse Spark Responses API uses function calling with deterministic tools. Human approval required before applying plans.

summary: Turns phone product photos into marketplace-ready cards with compliance checks.
readme_summary: Next.js TypeScript app validates photos against marketplace rules like white background and proportions. Pipeline generates card text, checklist scores and ZIP export with mock mode and evals. Uses Muse models for visual inspection and copy.

summary: Headless dynamic pricing and replenishment for grocery electronic shelf labels.
readme_summary: Provides RL-based pricing decisions streamed to grocery ESLs via headless API. Uses Muse Spark for decision reasoning and PyTorch DQN for pricing policy. Backend is FastAPI with WebSockets and demo storefront.

summary: Mobile wardrobe app that sorts outfit photos into pieces and saved looks
readme_summary: Mobile-first app with Pile, Wardrobe and Hanger for outfit photos. Server-side Cloudflare Worker calls Meta Muse Spark 1.3 via api.meta.ai to detect wearable pieces and regions, then crops and validates them for mixing.

summary: Verification layer that proves AI code fixes in sandbox before any PR
readme_summary: Sits between model and main branch: Muse Spark proposes explanations and fixes, isolated sandbox tests them, independent verifier re-runs suite. Built and benchmarked on Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Spark Open with zero false fix claims.

summary: Distributed orchestrator routing AI workloads across edge PCs and cloud endpoints
readme_summary: Turns room of PCs into one addressable compute surface with hybrid routing for cost and latency. Python-based orchestrator with launcher, benchmarks and Windows app. Routes Meta open-weights and Muse models between edge networks and cloud.

summary: 3D flight simulator driven by fruit-fly neural circuits and spiking neurons.
readme_summary: Neural Simulation Playground 3D links camera vision to Drosophila connectome SNN to control flight. Three.js frontend with Python experiments backend. Uses Meta Muse Spark for analysis alongside Ax framework.

summary: Breaks prod-like stacks to test if AI agents can safely fix incidents
readme_summary: FaultLine injects reproducible faults, lets an agent attempt repair, blocks destructive actions via live-state guardrails, and verdicts fix reality. Includes Python harness, Docker Compose, and bench configs.

summary: Drafts ad creatives, copy and audiences from a single product photo.
readme_summary: Turns product photographs into reviewable social campaigns with creative directions, image assets, copy and audience ideas. Built on Meta Model API with Next.js, MIT licensed. Includes visual auditing, feed-story artwork and catalog export.

summary: WhatsApp AI that watches customer videos to triage trade jobs and draft quotes
readme_summary: WhatsApp front desk for UK tradespeople analyzing problem videos, asking follow-ups, and flagging danger. Python stack with ffmpeg pipeline and SAM parser. Uses SAM for vision plus Muse for dialogue.

summary: Local workbench tracing GPU kernel sync edits from proposal to evidence.
readme_summary: Warp Relay follows GPU synchronization edits through 12 curated cases, CPU archives, and recorded B200 trials with offline evidence bundles. Python 3.10+ workbench with docs and manifests for traceable kernel investigation.

summary: Detects dark fishing fleets from SAR with verifiable evidence chain
readme_summary: Fuses Sentinel-1 C-band VV+VH SAR with Meta SAM 3.1 segmentation and Muse Wonder 1.0 vs Spark 1.3 reasoning. ResNet-18 ONNX inference with WebCrypto Ed25519 chain of custody for maritime surveillance. Includes benchmark harness, verify script and tactical web console.

summary: Finds and verifies fixes for concurrency bugs in payment code
readme_summary: AI agent diagnoses six PostgreSQL fintech concurrency bugs like deadlock, lost update and double-spend. Independent verifier proves each fix before acceptance rather than trusting test reruns. Python benchmark with Muse Spark via Meta Model API and reproducible seeds.

summary: Privacy tool that finds location leaks across photo feeds and suggests fixes.
readme_summary: Attacker agent scans multi-photo feeds to find where user becomes findable, defender suggests minimal fixes. Built with Streamlit using Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 from Meta Model API. Includes browser extension and demo app.

summary: Phone-photo workplace toppling risk assessment with measured fall energy
readme_summary: Measures toppling distance and fall energy from one phone photo using gravity sensor and SAM 3.1 segmentation. Muse Spark Open drafts likelihood, severity and controls from tool-call numbers only. Supervisor confirms all grades; checker blocks model-typed numbers.

summary: Turkish voice wayfinding aid that finds doors and reads signs for blind users
readme_summary: Gozum is a Turkish find-and-guide phone web app for blind and low-vision users. It loops camera frames through plan-act steps like locate and read_text. Uses Muse Spark for action planning with server vision tools, built as Python server plus mobile web client.

summary: Glasses-based grocery assistant that sees shelves and guides by voice
readme_summary: SwiftUI + FastAPI assistant using Meta Wearables DAT Live Stream for POV understanding, product ID, and navigation. Adds selective Meta inference and TTS with optional Kroger ordering backend.

summary: Food delivery where runners and bikers earn money while working out.
readme_summary: Trackfud connects customers, merchants, couriers, and admins for workout-based delivery. Stack is Go backend, gateway, and multiple frontends for customer, courier, merchant, and admin. Uses Muse Image for marketing hero and AI rails in ordering flow.

summary: Five-gate evidence control between AI output and human legal decisions
readme_summary: Evidence-control infrastructure enforcing bounded execution, artifact capture, deterministic contract validation, evidence review, and human authorization. Demoed on frozen synthetic fixture; human authority stays human.

summary: Local Modbus water-station decoy to practice attacks and record interactions safely.
readme_summary: Simulates a small water booster station with equipment display, Modbus commands and readback reports. Runs locally in Python with no real hardware. Built for decoy research and DecoyBench evaluation, no Meta model inference in core decoy.

summary: AI web QA agent that inspects live sites to explain and verify issues
readme_summary: Client-server QA agent combining deterministic HTTP/HTML checks with browser inspection. Uses Meta Muse Spark to explain SEO, security, and render issues with evidence-backed fix guidance.

summary: Agent turning product catalogs into reviewed, human-approved ad creatives
readme_summary: Creative Director Agent checks catalog photos, cuts out products, writes headlines, lays out and reviews ads for approval. Web app with API, MCP server and layout engine. Uses Meta models for vision and copy.

summary: Tests messages against 24 AI readers to find misreadings and fix wording
readme_summary: Live Modal app where 16 Muse Glimmer and 8 Muse Spark readers interpret your message and show misreads. Python package with Colab, deploy, tests and docs. Finds shortest wording both model families understand.

summary: Deterministic safety gate between AI proposals and actuators for uncertain perception
readme_summary: BEBOP checks vision-language plans under fog, dust and occlusion and fails closed on uncertainty. Deterministic gate with 2-sigma verdict logic, pytest suite and benchmarks. Sits between AI planners and physical actuators to prevent false approvals.

summary: Binds human approval to hashed agent actions with verifiable evidence
readme_summary: ActionProof hashes exact agent actions for approval to block tampering and stores execution evidence. Docker Compose stack with backend, policy engine and Meta model calls for verified runs.

summary: Verifiable camera-based navigation proposals checked by physics before ROS 2 execution
readme_summary: Java 21 Spring Boot backend with React TypeScript frontend and Nav2-compatible export. Proposes navigation candidates then verifies them through deterministic physics checks. Uses Meta AI for proposal generation in a research prototype pipeline.

summary: Phone vision system that sorts a whole table of parcels in one look
readme_summary: Parcel locker sorting aid where overhead phone sees color and depth on a mat. Detects barcodes and assigns green/yellow answers for locker fit and sharing. Built solo with mobile, web and Python backend.

summary: Local-first Notion-style workspace where humans and MCP agents co-edit the same pages.
readme_summary: Block editor with page tree, databases, comments and real-time sync plus MCP server for agents. Tasks, permissions and history live in workspace with visible attribution. Built-in Trama agent runs on Meta Muse Wonder.

summary: Agentic dock workspace where AI arranges and creates tool panels
readme_summary: PolyDocks is an operable workspace where agent Poly opens, arranges and generates tool panels via Ctrl+K. Dockerized web workspace with agent-home and architecture docs. Uses Meta AI agent models to create tools on demand.

summary: Rebuilds black-box behavior as evidence-tested substitute implementation
readme_summary: Second Source observes a site behavior then separately re-implements it with comparative evidence reports and experiments. Vercel app + workspace with browser-slice harness. Uses Muse models for analysis and verification contrast.

summary: Agents that expand a kids nature game with real-world places
readme_summary: Animundo Builder grows the Animundo nature game ahead of players on a real-Earth grid. Agents fill missing areas from reviewed content. Every model call uses Meta models via Muse Code-built pipeline.

summary: Bilingual Arabic-English live copilot for Google Meet meetings
readme_summary: Chrome MV3 extension plus Python 3.12 backend for live Arabic, English and mixed speech understanding. Shows key points on speaker tiles during Google Meet calls. Runs exclusively on Meta models for transcription and summarization.

summary: Local-first document intelligence that redlines conflicts across files privately
readme_summary: VAULT is private multimodal document intelligence that runs locally and finds contradictions. Backend plus CLI with Docker, CI and local inference setup. Uses Meta Llama 3 locally for reading, keeping documents on-machine.

summary: Game that scores cleaning photos before and after with multilingual voice hosting.
readme_summary: Gamified cleaning-quality verifier where cleaners submit before/after photos for an AI quality score and leaderboard. Static JS app with Muse vision scoring and multilingual game-show voice that celebrates without coaching.

summary: Private AI reflection space with moderated peer support communities
readme_summary: Provides private conversations, reflection tools and story discovery plus Supabase-backed communities with moderation. Uses Meta AI via server-side routes for guidance, with Next.js frontend and human review flows.

summary: Multi-agent inspection for construction defects and progress tracking
readme_summary: Coordinates specialized agents to compare drawings, photos and scans for defects and progress. Services for geometry, localization and 4D progress with iOS and Supabase. Uses Muse Spark for evidence analysis and reporting.

summary: Self-hosted search engine over your own crawl with pluggable ranking
readme_summary: Postgres-backed custom index as source of truth with swappable AI backends and plugin interfaces for filtering and enrichment. Architecture uses FastAPI, Postgres, Redis, Kafka and ClickHouse. AI backends configurable via config.

summary: Turns scattered school newsletters into verified per-family actions
readme_summary: ParentLoop hubs per school/class where School, Parent and Group agents extract and verify facts from newsletters and chats. Private per-family actions without portal credentials. Docker + Node stack with live demo.

summary: Shelf-monitoring app that spots empty shelves and refills via suppliers
readme_summary: Dukon makes empty shelves visible and refills them via WhatsApp suppliers. Uses SAM 3.1 for shelf vision, Muse Spark for reasoning and Muse Voice Transcribe for input. Live web app with demo video, built for Build for Your World indie track.

summary: AI-native 3D game engine where agents build and test games on canvas
readme_summary: Autonomous 3D engine and simulation on React Three Fiber, WebGL and Electron with mobile studio. Includes MCP server and store. Uses Meta Llama and Muse hub for agentic coding, physics and transpilation.

summary: Lets buyer agents jointly unlock cafe off-peak offers within limits
readme_summary: Next.js buyer/merchant flow where cafes publish quiet-hour offers and agents propose constraints. Requires separate owner approval before synthetic checkout. Uses Muse Spark for extraction, Muse Wonder for terms and Glimmer for constraints.

summary: Ternary compression toolkit shrinking Qwen models for efficient inference
readme_summary: OpenBonsai implements ScaleQ-style ternary compression for Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3-8B with calibration scripts and openbonsai run CLI. No Meta Muse dependency; evaluated on GSM8K and HumanEval with results below official Bonsai.

summary: Voice-first assistant that decides when to nudge and acts via confirm-gated tools
readme_summary: NudgeAI is a voice-first personal workflow agent with habits, tasks, nudge engine, chat with confirm-gated tool calls, voice and photo-to-tasks. Backend plus mobile app wired end-to-end. Uses Meta AI for chat, voice and decision-gated actions.

summary: Type a theme to repaint a 3D model's textures and export a new GLB
readme_summary: Browser tool that reads glTF/GLB texture atlas and UV layout, then asks Meta Muse to repaint it in-theme while preserving UV islands. Rebuilds normal and roughness maps for export. Supports Meta Model API and offline backend.

summary: Family agent turns parents voice notes and bill photos into shared task board
readme_summary: Saath converts voice notes and document photos into a verified shared family task board. Stack is backend + frontend + Telegram bot + WhatsApp Cloud API with Docker. Uses Meta AI models to transcribe, extract tasks, and verify bills for coordinated care.

summary: WhatsApp climate action earns tradable ECOIN after Meta AI verification
readme_summary: ECO mints ECOIN for verified climate action via WhatsApp in any language. Meta AI checks evidence, deterministic rules decide, public ledger enables audit. Web atlas, ledger, Ghost Audit evals, Supabase backend.

summary: Reconciles grower messages against weekly orders with human approval
readme_summary: Food-hub prototype that reads grower messages, checks them against weekly orders, and proposes reconciliations requiring coordinator approval. Built with Next.js and documented evidence in docs/EVIDENCE.md. Uses Muse Spark recorded responses for message parsing in synthetic demo workspaces.

summary: Finds Ottawa family activities with quote-verified details and reminders
readme_summary: Household age-band matcher for Ottawa free and paid activities with verbatim price, age and date quotes linked to listings. Email reminders before registration via scheduled jobs. Monorepo with apps/packages and Supabase, built for Build for Your World.

summary: Offline Android helper turning ASHA visits and voice into accountable follow-ups.
readme_summary: Offline-first Android app for India ASHA workers with SOP Q&A showing exact source page and voice-to-record workflows. On-device Llama 3.2 with cloud fallback. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Voice and SAM 3.1 plus Llama 3.2 on device.

summary: Grounded Bangladesh law assistant answering with cited statutes and documents
readme_summary: Legal research copilot for Bangladeshi law in Bangla/English with section-level citations and document analysis. Docker/Cloudflare stack; uses Muse models for grounded Q&A, deadline tracking and lawyer handoff.

summary: Verifiable Indonesia fire and smoke intelligence with public data checks
readme_summary: Public-interest disaster tool correlating haze reports with BMKG/BNPB data and smoke forecasts. Vercel + API + admin UI; uses Meta AI for verification, summarization and handoff notes.

summary: Bounded AI gate that reviews outgoing business documents before approval
readme_summary: ForgeVigil places a bounded Muse Spark agent in front of outgoing documents. It runs its own investigation using read-only tools for approvals and facts, while deterministic code makes the allow decision. Built with standard-library-only Python 3.11-3.13 and offline qualification workflows.

summary: Talk to and drive an ESP32 robot via WhatsApp, PC agent and Quest
readme_summary: Embodied AI system linking ESP32-CAM robot car to Muse brain with Windows agent, WhatsApp voice, browser and Quest 3S avatar. Uses Meta Model API, Muse Code, Ollama, plus open robot protocol and SSH.

summary: Turns a one-line idea into a four-panel comic with a collectible hidden gem object
readme_summary: Tales is a Next.js app that generates a four-panel comic, cast, dialogue, cover and reel from a one-line prompt. A story object is hidden as a collectible gem whose inscription changes how the comic is read.

summary: Marketplace connecting vacation-rental hosts with cleaners
readme_summary: Sparkl is a two-sided marketplace with host/cleaner roles, job lifecycle, ranked matching and realtime chat. Built with Expo React Native, Fastify, tRPC and PostgreSQL. Uses Meta AI assistant for job posting from checklists.

summary: Photograph a crop to get practical growing advice in English and Kiswahili
readme_summary: Photo-based crop advisor for farmers and extension officers; identifies plants and gives care advice with optional notes. Built with Next.js and English/Kiswahili UI. Uses Meta SAM for vision and Muse for diagnosis and advice.

summary: Operations agent watches orders, inventory and spend for retailers
readme_summary: Blueprint agent computes operating picture in code from orders, refunds, inventory and ad spend. Built on Meta Muse Spark with guardian screens and named approvals. Includes evals, migrations and Docker compose.

summary: Turns room photos into automatable smart-home controls and routines
readme_summary: Spatial studio converts a room photo into masked devices via SAM and authors automations with Muse Spark for Home Assistant execution. Dockerized FastAPI backend, frontend, Caddy and HA setup.

summary: Family trip-planning chat agent that researches real flights and hotels with prices
readme_summary: Chat agent collects family size, dates and budget, then searches live flights and hotels for grounded links. Runs end-to-end from terminal in Python. All reasoning, tool choice and PDF extraction runs on Muse Spark via Meta Model API.

summary: Dashcam plus GPS inspector that finds road hazards and prefills DOT reports
readme_summary: RoadScout preprocesses dashcam video with ffmpeg, detects hazards with SAM 3.1, verifies with Muse Spark, then geotags, dedups and blurs faces. Stack is Python FastAPI, React Vite, SQLite with pytest and Playwright.

summary: Mobile shop app that links finger-pointing and speech to catalogue items for basket review
readme_summary: Mobile web app for Tanzanian shops that resolves pointed-at products and Kiswahili/English quantities into a review card. Built with Next.js and local catalogue matching. Uses Meta AI for multimodal grounding with explicit user confirmation.

summary: Turns plain-language needs into working apps or hardware order packs.
readme_summary: Bottega uses Muse Spark to design Zod-validated JSON app specs rendered by a safe runtime, no arbitrary code. Supports iterative teach-and-grow edits and generates RFQ packs with CAD for hardware builds.

summary: Photo of a math worksheet becomes a 5-problem practice sheet targeting one habit
readme_summary: Agent grades a worksheet photo, identifies the single error habit, and generates a short practice set with self-checked answer key. For adult learners and tutors only with saved replayable sample runs. Uses Meta AI vision and reasoning models.

summary: Open-source AI reviewer that catches KiCad board errors before manufacturing
readme_summary: TrustPCB reviews KiCad boards with real electrical checks and simulations, showing evidence for every claim. It provides a web UI, CLI and CI integration for automated review. Built on Meta Muse Spark for reasoning over schematics and layout.

summary: Agent harness that answers genetics questions with verified literature evidence
readme_summary: Retrieves genetics literature, extracts atomic findings, and checks claims against verbatim source text with experimental context. Progressively renders traceable answers and scientific visualizations. Includes architecture docs and evals, not medical advice.

summary: Checks Philippine resort bookings against records to spot scams
readme_summary: Paste Facebook link or chat screenshots; Muse Spark 1.3 extracts details and compares to government source. Reports matches, limits of screenshot proof, and next check. Next.js app with evals and scripts.

summary: Local harness measuring Muse Code time, cost and version regressions
readme_summary: Runs prompts against Muse Code to record timing breakdown, plan-limit cost, model comparisons and replay with context growth. Fixed radar prompts track Muse versions. Local results page with frontend and golden prompts.

summary: Screens all SEC EDGAR filings for accounting manipulation and tariff risk
readme_summary: Autonomous XBRL screener using DuckDB and Z3 proofs to flag manipulation. Python warehouse with demo cockpit. Uses Muse models for forensic reasoning, dossier drafting, and RAG triad reflection over filings.

summary: Pharmacy decision support and student simulation with synthetic cases
readme_summary: Full-stack app with backend and frontend deployed on Render for hospital pharmacy workflows and training simulation. Uses meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026 via Baseten for interaction checks. Demo-only with synthetic data, not clinically validated.

summary: Checks truck trailer loads against federal cargo securement rules
readme_summary: Python rules system using SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API to segment load, trailer bed, axles and tie-downs into measurements. Deterministic engine applies 49 CFR Part 393 Subpart I rules for PASS/CHECK verdicts. Includes Modal app and tests.

summary: Visual inspection workflow turning photos into human-approved maintenance work orders.
readme_summary: FixFrame follows Observe-Understand-Verify-Act from image plus note to structured work order. SAM 3.1 segments regions, Muse Spark extracts issues, human reviews and approves. Includes demo scenarios, safety policy and Meta API notes.

summary: Builds approved career memory from resume and chats for interview cues
readme_summary: Creates cumulative Career Memory from resume PDF and conversations linked to job descriptions. Next.js plus backend with desktop HUD. Uses Meta models to extract facts, ground reminders, and keep job data separate.

summary: Drought adaptation advice from satellite data and cited science reports
readme_summary: Computes drought indicators from satellite archives, retrieves evidence, ranks options by rules. Docker stack with frontend. Uses Muse Spark to draft reports that deterministic code validates statement by statement.

summary: Witnessed research runner with tamper-evident log of every analysis step
readme_summary: Saksi executes protocol-specified analyses during research, assisting drafting and review while logging human and agent actions. Provides tamper-evident provenance instead of post-hoc checks. Uses Meta AI agents with Python workflow engine on Modal.

summary: Daily checker for small restaurants that flags price, delivery and invoice issues
readme_summary: Stockpot helps independent restaurants track price changes, short deliveries and invoice mismatches with a daily attention list. Web app with Node API, server and shared frontend code deployed on Vercel. Uses Meta Muse models to check documents and explain numbers behind alerts.

summary: AI growth copilot for Etsy/Shopify sellers for listings, images, and marketing.
readme_summary: Muse Growth Studio helps small sellers with copy, product imagery, and growth ops using Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Image 1.0, Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and ComfyUI. FastAPI backend with Vercel frontend. Validated with 100 offline tests.

summary: Searches long lecture videos and answers with verified quote timestamps
readme_summary: Glosa converts sermons, lectures and talks into searchable citable text with exact timestamps. It uses transcription plus vision-language checks to verify answers against what was said. Built with Meta models to prevent hallucinations in study notes.

summary: Raspberry Pi home hub for scam protection and text-first PC help
readme_summary: Always-on Raspberry Pi 5 appliance linking phones, cameras and smart devices via auditable Switch workflows. Built with Muse AI coding. Uses Muse Spark and Meta models for Guardian monitoring and assistance.

summary: Turns expert video into step guides then watches beginners via camera
readme_summary: Apprentice converts expert video, PDF or docs into verified steps with checks and warnings. Muse Spark parses video with audio into ordered steps. SAM 3.1 watches live phone camera to catch mistakes. Monorepo with apps, docs and e2e tests.

summary: Hands-free copilot that verifies home wiring before walls are plastered
readme_summary: WireProof assists electricians with cable checks, copper verification, and in-wall cable mapping. Web app with panel reader at /panel, probe and relay services, Railway deploy. Uses Meta models for vision inspection and voice copilot guidance.

summary: Merge gate that finds secrets surviving deletion in diffs and git history
readme_summary: PR Diff Sentinel scans working tree, PR diff and commit history for leaked secrets. Muse Spark labels masked hits, Muse Wonder writes rotation steps and chat. Rules enforce Pass/Fail; AI cannot clear Fail. Ships as web app and Chrome extension.

summary: Turns a rental video into a measurable 3D room that flags listing scams
readme_summary: SightSeen converts a landlord video into a real-scale walkable 3D room with measurements, furniture staging, and scam checks. Built with Java Spring backend plus frontend and worker, it uses SAM 3.1, SAM 3D Objects, MapAnything, Muse Spark and Muse Image.

summary: Converts video of mechanisms into verified Three.js and Blender physics rigs
readme_summary: Autonomous video-to-physics engine that segments with SAM 3.1, reasons with Muse Spark 1.3 and Open 1026, and self-verifies Three.js/Rapier and Blender rigs. Monorepo with apps, packages and infra, built for Push the Frontier.

summary: Lightweight native app engine without Chromium using Wasmtime and Skia
readme_summary: A native runtime combining Wasmtime, Skia, Filament with Meta Yoga 3.1.0 layout as a Chromium alternative. Built with Meta Muse Wonder and Muse Spark 1.3, ships demo apps, desktop and store.

summary: Point camera at engine to get AR part outlines and grounded repair steps.
readme_summary: Mobile web app where camera, voice or circle-to-search triggers part segmentation and repair cards. Stack is Vite, Tailwind and web UI with iFixit guide linking. Uses SAM 3.1 for AR outlines and Muse Spark 1.3 for steps.

summary: AI-run digital courtroom that litigates cases and inspects evidence
readme_summary: Autonomous multimodal courtroom presiding over disputes with adversarial agents. Built with Next.js + Modal backend. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for evidence inspection under BSA/CPC statutes.

summary: Guided helper for older adults for appointments, groups, and scam checks
readme_summary: Next.js TypeScript app with three fixed guided flows ending in user-chosen actions. No open chat mode, uses plain-spoken persona with formal Spanish support. Uses Muse Spark for extraction and confirmation via Meta API.

summary: Persistent multi-agent simulator planning a robotic outpost in Arcadia Planitia
readme_summary: Multi-agent planning and execution simulator for Mars outpost preparation with validator-owned resources. CLI, dashboard, and docs with isolated acceptance testing. Uses Meta-model agents with 159 matched responses.

summary: Phone-camera walking companion giving spoken hazard guidance
readme_summary: Drishti uses chest-strap phone camera with on-device COCO-SSD lite Tier 1 detection and cloud reasoning for hazards and navigation. Speaks Hindi or English, guides to destinations and alerts family. Complements cane, never replaces it.

summary: Directs plain-language cinematic color grades for your video
readme_summary: AI colorist that asks adaptive questions, writes validated grade plan, masks with SAM 3.1 and renders full-resolution video. Muse Spark 1.3 plans and reviews renders with bounded revisions and compare view.

summary: Lunar robot that predicts material ESD risk from a phone photo before handling
readme_summary: ESD-Guard AI photographs an object, estimates material and ESD risk for lunar vacuum vs Earth humidity, then plans Franka arm handling with grounding. Includes MuJoCo digital twin and incident analysis. Uses PE-Core and Meta Vision AI with Python and MuJoCo Menagerie.

summary: Converts tabletop video to MuJoCo twin to auto-tune robot grasping policies
readme_summary: Pipeline from phone video via SAM 3.1 tracking and Muse Wonder semantics to metric 3D twin in MuJoCo with auto-tuned grasp planner. Python/Streamlit dashboard with config.yaml, scripts and randomized physics evaluation.

summary: Privacy filter that redacts secrets in screen recordings and spoken audio
readme_summary: Finds private info on screen and in speech, redacts values, bleeps audio and verifies output. Built solo in Python with OCR, speech processing and a verify agent that writes a receipt.

summary: Vietnamese tax assistant that cites the provision in force on the date asked.
readme_summary: Answers Vietnamese tax questions with date-aware citations, amendment chains and new-regulation alerts. Web frontend plus Python backend with legal corpus retrieval. Uses Muse Spark via API to draft grounded Vietnamese answers with citations.

summary: Bilingual clinical training with simulated patients and safe intake summaries for Nigeria.
readme_summary: Combines AI simulated patient, structured clerking feedback and safety-first intake in English and Pidgin. Full-stack prototype with frontend, backend and API docs. Uses Meta AI models for simulation, feedback and clinician-review summaries.

summary: Snap a market stall and voice prices to get a WhatsApp catalogue
readme_summary: StallSnap segments stall photos with SAM 3.1 to cut out products and transcribes Pidgin voice notes with Muse Voice to price items. Generates shareable catalogue for WhatsApp traders. Node/bun + src stack with test materials and build log.

summary: Human-approved debugging pipeline turning bug reports into verified patches with evidence
readme_summary: Meridian AI runs a reproduce-evidence-hypotheses-tests-patch-verify workflow with human approval at each step. Stack is Next.js web app plus Python API with Alembic migrations and Docker Compose. Uses Meta Model API / Muse models to investigate bugs and propose patches without auto-applying.

summary: Flashcard feed with SM-2 repetition built for ADHD studying
readme_summary: Munki opens to an infinite due-weighted flashcard feed with flip, Knew/Again, XP and combos to cut setup friction. Implements a real SM-2 scheduler over Purdue course content. Hackathon indie submission with client, frontend, Drizzle backend.

summary: Dashboard that prices used electronics and times resale for cash
readme_summary: Liquid 2.0 catalogs idle electronics, segments condition, checks market comps, and drafts listings to surface sell windows. Spatial asset terminal deployed on Vercel with zero login. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for visual valuation.

summary: AI devil's advocate that stress-tests market beliefs on history
readme_summary: Turns plain-language beliefs into sealed testable rules, replays on historical candles with deterministic engine and attack battery. Verdict FALSIFIED/FRAGILE/SURVIVED with hash-chained ledger. Explained by Muse Glimmer 30B in source language.

summary: Multimodal memory agent that captures screenshots, docs and voice notes into actions
readme_summary: Captures scattered inputs, connects related memories and turns them into follow-throughs. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Image; Next.js + Supabase with demo mode and evals.

summary: Detects PPE violations from live video and verifies fixes with photos.
readme_summary: SiteSentinel monitors construction and factory safety from Ray-Ban glasses or phone video. It uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark for hazard detection, voice alerts, task assignment, and photo verification. Architecture uses AWS Lambda API with web HUD and dashboard.

summary: Turns photos of materials into animated IKEA-style instructions
readme_summary: Manual for Anything generates plain step-by-step animated manuals from a photo of materials. Node.js 24 browser app with saved examples like paper snowflake and colour bridge. Uses Meta Model API vision and reasoning for step and diagram generation.

summary: Turn-based simulator to test market entry, ads, and pricing before real decisions
readme_summary: Hypothesis builds custom turn-based market simulations from a user-defined turn description. Python/Docker stack with prompts and experiment requests curated by Muse Code. Powered by Muse Spark 1.3 agents to simulate buyers, competitors, and market dynamics.

summary: Verified audio quest and on-site missions about Lithuania's Plokstine Cold War missile base
readme_summary: Youth audio quest with 3 remote episodes, 7 on-site missions and 10 legend-or-fact cards about Plokstine base. Pipeline verifies every sentence against official sources and witness testimonies before publishing. Supports 11 languages with content, docs and pipeline folders.

summary: Ranks bombed land for clearance using records, satellite and human geography
readme_summary: ClearField fuses declassified bombing records with satellite imagery and OSM exposure to rank survey zones. Provides plain-language explanations and offline field reporting. Tested with Laos/Cambodia profiles, Sentinel pipeline and local DB APIs.

summary: AI review tool that flags impersonation with explainable decisions
readme_summary: AI-assisted impersonation review with explained moderator decisions, audit history and appeals. Uses SQLite, isolated sandboxes and benchmarked text/image copy detection. Attempted Meta cloud ML/OCR integration via Model API but hit model_not_found.

summary: Turns questions into narrated vertical explainer reels rendered from code
readme_summary: Generates captioned 1080x1920 reels where every frame is rendered from AI-written code for editable diagrams. Uses Manim, Remotion, Three.js and Canvas engines with Python pipeline. AI plans scenes, code and narration.

summary: Turns ideas and papers into verified citable prototypes with agent loop
readme_summary: Muse-only plan/act/observe agent that builds verified prototypes from ideas, papers or hardware photos. Features HITL sign-off, replay fence and Studio handoff. Uses Muse Spark with optional SAM 3 on Baseten.

summary: Runs AI-planned tasks in locked-down containers with verifiable records
readme_summary: Agent Rush plans tasks with a hosted model then executes steps in fresh networkless read-only non-root Docker containers. FastAPI control layer with hardened sandbox and pytest suite. Uses hosted LLM for planning with containment flags returned alongside exit codes.

summary: Private family care, inheritance and giving plans with evidence gates
readme_summary: Hearth provides persistent household workspaces for care, inheritance and giving with scoped access. Firebase auth and hosting with evaluation page. Uses source-grounded Meta AI with evidence gates.

summary: Negotiates prices in structured rounds with human approval control
readme_summary: Buyer-side negotiation agent with multi-round workflow, history and budget validation. Built with Meta Muse Spark for strategy generation plus deterministic checks. Requires explicit human confirmation before finalizing agreements.

summary: Generates illustrated personalized social stories for autistic children
readme_summary: Turns a caregiver paragraph into a draft illustrated social story book with the child in images. Built with web research grounding and image generation pipeline. Uses Meta Muse models for story and illustration.

summary: Explains what changed in your stocks with links to source passages
readme_summary: Fynex Copilot ingests portfolio CSV then fetches SEC EDGAR, AMF and earnings call transcripts. Built with Next.js and Meta Model API integration. Uses Muse Spark to summarize changes and Muse Voice Transcribe for calls.

summary: Personal tribal-knowledge system that captures notes without filing and reuses them
readme_summary: Tribe captures personal knowledge without filing, tracks age and past failures, and surfaces it across tools. Built as Indie Build for Your World app with docs, MCP server, and web client for reusable context.

summary: Upload a lesson to get a voice-guided interactive electric-circuits lab
readme_summary: Lesson-in, living physics lab-out for electric circuits on any device. Muse Spark designs labs while a deterministic engine runs physics, with voice guidance, teacher view, and full Docker/CI tests.

summary: Somali-first JavaScript SDK to call twelve AI providers via one API.
readme_summary: Abuur AI provides Somali-named config and task methods for text generation across twelve providers. It runs on Node 22+ with browser and Node entries for Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic and others. It standardizes requests without hiding provider billing and limits.

summary: Multilingual voice, text and vision farming assistant for Central Africa.
readme_summary: NongLink Agent helps small farmers and cooperatives in Angola, DRC and Congo with crop advice, prices, weight estimates and irrigation. Multimodal and trilingual PT/FR/EN with Docker demo. Uses Meta AI models for text, voice and vision assistance.

summary: Local incident lab that reproduces Java e-commerce failures and tests Maven ZIPs in Docker.
readme_summary: TRACEBACK is a local Java 17 Spring Boot plus React Vite app for deterministic e-commerce failure simulations with JPA/Flyway and Postgres/H2. Uploaded Maven ZIPs run isolated in Docker runner with real test counts. Uses backend investigation pipeline and simulation lab examples.

summary: Phone-first live vision and audio guidance to help blind users navigate surroundings
readme_summary: Captures continuous rear-camera frames for spatial vision analysis and audio navigation cues. Phone-first web app with Node.js server and Netlify serverless deployment. Built for assistive navigation with test-covered codebase.

summary: Shared couples app with chat, live map, memories and playful Couple Court
readme_summary: Flutter mobile app for Android/iOS with paired shared space, chat, OpenStreetMap live location, and photo memories. Implements Couple Court with timed turns, evidence, and AI-guided remedies. Uses Meta AI for mediation flow and verdicts.

summary: Phone video turned into textured game-ready GLB 3D assets
readme_summary: Upload walk-around video and CodeMesh segments with SAM 3.1, recovers pose with MapAnything, then meshes and textures to GLB. Self-checks by re-rendering against footage. Frontend plus Modal backend with live demo.

summary: Agent that proves if a metric jump is real with SQL evidence
readme_summary: DataTrace investigates business metric changes with executed SQL evidence down to individual claims. A Meta-powered agent separates real movement from reporting errors and an independent checker verifies fixes. Built with Streamlit, Docker, and Muse Spark 1.3 plus Wonder 1.0.

summary: Hausa/English agent that clusters outage reports into faults and dispatches technicians
readme_summary: GridSense takes customer text and voice reports in Hausa and English, then uses Muse Spark to classify fault type, map to feeders, and merge or open faults. Stack includes backend, frontend, scripts and pytest suite for intake, triage and dispatch workflow.

summary: Multi-agent scholarship finder with verification across 50 languages
readme_summary: Hoc Bong Hunter v4.0 is a 12-node multi-agent web app that matches, verifies and tracks scholarships with triple-verification engine. Static HTML/CSS/JS front end with Node server, i18n, and CI/CD on GitHub Pages. Uses Muse Wonder 1.0 and Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API.

summary: Webcam Kenyan Sign Language helper for mobile-money transactions
readme_summary: Assists Deaf customers at mobile-money agents by recognizing small KSL vocabulary via webcam with customer confirmation before speech output. Next.js/Vercel app with English/Kiswahili and simulated payments. Uses Meta AI vision models for sign recognition.

summary: Auditor that verifies computer-use agent claims against screen recordings with evidence
readme_summary: Reads agent screen recordings, finds proving frame and returns TRUE_DONE, FALSE_DONE or UNSURE verdicts. Uses Muse Wonder computer use, Muse Spark 1.3 screenshot judge and SAM 3.1 boxes via Meta Model API. Stores artifacts in append-only SQLite with deterministic DOM checks.

summary: Compares approved updates to suggest priorities and draft school work.
readme_summary: Sidekick compares saved source revisions and task progress to select preparation actions and create drafts. Python backend with frontend and verification workflow. Uses Muse Spark to select actions, verify inputs, and remember progress.

summary: Voice-controlled dashcam crash investigation with 3D replay and reports
readme_summary: Turns dashcam clips into location, plate evidence, 3D replay and statements controlled by voice. Users hold Space to speak for zoom, tracking and paperwork, with video analysis and playback in one interface.

summary: First-person paramedic training sim from dispatch to handoff
readme_summary: Vite client plus Node server proxy that holds the API key on localhost. Single-patient femoral-bleed scenario guides MARCH assessment, treatment, transport and radio handoff with debrief. Uses Muse models for patient dialogue and FTO evaluation for training only.

summary: Sorts Semgrep Java alerts into calibrated lanes and proposes audited fixes.
readme_summary: Triages Semgrep SARIF findings on Java into calibrated lanes using Muse Glimmer 30B with r2_s7 LoRA adapter. Muse Spark audits alerts and drafts fixes, with Modal and Semgrep pipeline. Preserves all alerts with neverSuppressed flag for human review.

summary: Visual support agent that triages damage photos and enforces refund policies.
readme_summary: Autonomous triage agent reads customer damage photos and applies policy rules. Combines SAM 3.1 vision, Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning and Muse Voice with deterministic guardrails. Full-stack with Supabase, Next.js and policy engine.

summary: Turns community ideas into planned events with people and resource coordination.
readme_summary: AI-assisted platform to plan events, recruit contributors, track execution and recover from blockers with human approval. Covers education, health, environment and neighborhood use cases. Frontend on Vercel with backend execution workflows.

summary: Ambient virtual cat room where gifted real-object photos become in-room sprites to watch.
readme_summary: Quiet Cloudflare Workers site/app where fictional cat Nori lives on server timeline. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for strict JSON photo understanding and Muse Image 1.0 to redraw gifts in room palette as 512px sprites.

summary: Hands-free glasses copilot guiding laptop motherboard repair step by multimeter step.
readme_summary: Wearables repair copilot for Meta AI glasses with Android client and Python server. Guides technicians with verified diagnoses one measurement at a time. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for board vision and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Adds GPU optimization layer to speed up Meta AI reasoning and image tasks.
readme_summary: Combines Meta AI models with Simulated Bifurcation on NVIDIA GPUs via Modal for faster, higher-quality outputs. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 to clarify prompts before Muse Image generation. Private research prototype with Render + Modal stack.

summary: Time-aware verified memory layer that keeps assistant facts current with provenance.
readme_summary: ChronoFact converts conversation streams into timestamped verified facts with history and fixed-context answers. Built entirely on Meta models in Python, it beats RAG on LongMemEval with local GPU inference.

summary: Diagnoses dead PCBs from a photo plus a few multimeter readings.
readme_summary: BoardBreaker segments board photos with SAM 3.1, reads silkscreen to build a component map, then plans minimal probe measurements. It ranks likely faulty parts once evidence converges. Built as TypeScript API/server + client with boards data, scripts, and tests.

summary: Debugs embedded boards on hardware and proves fixes with tests
readme_summary: Agent for Raspberry Pi 5 + Honeywell ABP2 sensor that runs allowlisted inspections, searches datasheet, then flashes fix and re-tests. Requires measured output plus datasheet evidence; code in bringup_agent/, pi_app/ and verification/.

summary: Ray-Ban Meta task verifier that signs off hands-on steps via Muse Spark vision
readme_summary: Signoff turns tasks into verifiable steps and checks each via Ray-Ban Meta glasses photos. An Android Kotlin app captures steps and a Python backend uses Muse Spark 1.3 to judge correctness. Reports 29/30 correct with ~4s verification.

summary: Payment layer letting AI agents buy single facts from any website
readme_summary: Doubloon monetizes web for agentic traffic with per-fact payments, gateway, buyer agent and MCP. Stack includes Python ingestion, payments service and frontend demo for agent-to-site transactions.

summary: Builds a physics twin from phone video to diagnose rotating-machine faults
readme_summary: Shadowtwin tracks coast-down video with SAM 3.1, fits a differential equation, and compares twin vs reality to classify imbalance, rubbing, drag, bearing, or drive faults. Python physics pipeline with web viewer. Built with Meta models during hackathon.

summary: Go-based compiler and runtime for typed multimodal AI workloads
readme_summary: Lowers YAML/JSON workloads into typed MIR, validates and optimizes via graph compiler, executes with concurrent runtime. Go core with local, mock, and Meta backends plus performance profiling.

summary: Verifies AI-generated code fixes with inspectable execution evidence
readme_summary: TraceMend links task, model response, diff, constrained execution and test verdict in one investigation to verify patches. Powered by Muse Spark, with pinned Python benchmark repair workflow and live execution report.

summary: Turns vague project briefs into prioritized tasks, risks and next actions
readme_summary: AI workflow planner that converts ambiguous briefs into tasks with estimates, risks, assumptions and next actions. Python package with CLI, docs, examples and tests. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 as the planning and reasoning model via API.

summary: Learns SOPs from one narrated demo and verifies task execution on video
readme_summary: FlowForge converts a narrated physical demonstration into an evidence-backed SOP and checks later attempts for missing or out-of-order steps. Dockerized backend plus web frontend with eval report on 12 videos. Uses Meta models for multimodal step grounding.

summary: Chat app that explains scam messages with Messenger-style demos
readme_summary: MetaThreatly is a Laravel PHP app for fraud-safety chat and explainable message checks. Provides fictional Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp demos with limited guest replies. Uses MySQL, Blade frontend, and server-scoped conversation history.

summary: Factory that runs coding agents on idle company hardware via work graph
readme_summary: Coordinator turns goals into dependency graphs, dispatches to idle machines, audits with different model and merges on rules. Uses Muse Spark audit verdicts, MCP server, Rust crates and self-hosted loop.

summary: No-code studio that sorts medical files and prelabels them for human approval.
readme_summary: Labelling studio for X-rays, CT, ECG, pathology and video with auto Studio setup. AI assistant prelabels via SAM 3.1 and Muse models through Meta Model API. Monorepo with apps/agent and human accept/reject workflow.

summary: Persistent workspace where Muse Spark keeps project memory across sessions
readme_summary: ALIVE stores approved sources, conversations, workflow runs and feedback for long-term projects. Backend in Python with Docker and Alembic, frontend workspace UI persists across restarts. Uses Meta Muse Spark as the acting model with research mode boundaries.

summary: Task board where coding agents review PRs and propose human-approved patches
readme_summary: MergeMate gives each repo a task board where agents review PRs, screenshots, and voice notes then open draft PRs. Web app for desktop and mobile. Uses Muse Spark 1.2 for review and patches, SAM 3.1 for screenshot segmentation, Muse Voice.

summary: Automated belt turning 51 driver handbooks into 51 full exam-prep courses
readme_summary: PassLearnersPermit generated 255k files, 4987 videos and quizzes for all 50 states + DC in 8 days. Assembly-line lanes with validator receipts and ledger tracing to handbook pages. Built with Meta models on production belt.

summary: Closes engineer to shop-floor loop with geometry review and shop memory.
readme_summary: Anville reviews synthetic STEP parts geometry-only and learns designer and shop feedback to shorten next loops. Judge quickstart runs pytest without CAD or Onshape, with optional Meta reasoning and Onshape UI for live path. Python codebase with connectors, agents and geometry tests.

summary: Project-centric task manager with inherited calendars and an acting chat per project
readme_summary: Task manager organized by client/project tree with tasks, notes, decisions and cross-project overview. Next.js + Supabase with Google calendars attached per node via inheritance. Uses Meta chat model to act on tasks and exposes an MCP server per project.

summary: Fail-closed privacy guard that blocks direct and mosaic leaks in agent searches.
readme_summary: MOAT Guard sits between deep-research agents and web search to pass, rewrite or block queries. It uses tiered checks for exact values, prior context and model rewrite, with FastAPI demo on recorded runs.

summary: Keyboard and screen-reader accessibility regression testing with evidence
readme_summary: Tests saved keyboard journeys in forms and dialogs with focus and screen-reader observations. Provides diagnosis, source patch and separate verification with local editor. Uses Muse models for diagnosis and repair review.

summary: Video meetings with live captions, memory, and agents that complete tasks
readme_summary: Monorepo with web, backend, connector, and FastAPI AI service plus Postgres pgvector memory. Spots decisions and answers @ai from history. Uses LLM keys and Deepgram for captions and project memory QA.

summary: Webcam lab partner that measures experiments and judges hypotheses
readme_summary: Argus watches bench experiments via webcam or USB microscope through a Plan-Watch-Measure-Judge loop. It uses SAM for segmentation, extracts real-unit readings, fits curves, and suggests the next run. Web app with public read-only replay.

summary: Investigates vehicle crashes with Meta AI plus a deterministic checker for auditability.
readme_summary: Meta AI crash investigator with deterministic re-checker and agent bench suites for robustness. Uses SAM 3.1 vision over crash media with Python 3.12 pipeline. Live replay on Hugging Face Spaces with no API key.

summary: WhatsApp-native group gift registry with secret claims and pooled gifts
readme_summary: Gift Circles app where owner shares link and friends coordinate claims and pooled contributions. Owner sees wishlist only, no money held. Verified with 393 Vitest tests and Chromium flows, built for hackathon.

summary: Trains and certifies patching agents for smart-contract flaws on-chain
readme_summary: Agent patches vulnerability sandbox rewrites, deterministic grader checks patch and PoC. Docker Compose backend with contracts and challenges. Uses Meta AI agents with validator signatures for skill records.

summary: Voice-controlled Windows app freezer that suspends distractions to save RAM
readme_summary: Windows 10/11 utility where user states task by voice, agent freezes unneeded apps and thaws on completion. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for planning and Muse Voice Transcribe, with threat model and evals.

summary: Coastal earthquake prep app with maps and evacuation guidance
readme_summary: Prepares households for coastal earthquakes with risk maps, routes to high ground, and go-bag checks. Python backend with Modal and web frontend. Uses Muse Spark vision models to analyze photos and personalize safety plans.

summary: Merges bracketed property photos into HDR listings with descriptions for approval.
readme_summary: Takes folders of bracketed RAW photos per room, merges to HDR, straightens and color-balances, then ranks, labels, and declutters. Python CLI plus approval web page pulls unit facts from AppFolio and uses Muse models to write listing copy and captions.

summary: Verifies builder payment claims by counting windows and doors in site videos
readme_summary: SiteProof parses demand letters and bills of quantities, then detects and counts installed windows and doors in WhatsApp progress clips. Each claim is marked Verified, Short or Not seen yet with frames and outlines. Stack is Python backend, Next.js web frontend with vision models.

summary: Turns a parent's own book pages into checked slides, video and practice for kids
readme_summary: LessonBloom generates Grades 1-5 Maths and English lessons only from uploaded book pages, with slides, narrated video, practice and flashcards. A code verifier checks every question before a child sees it. Built on Meta models with a TypeScript server and web client.

summary: Local-first desktop studio where an AI agent edits fiction files you own.
readme_summary: AI Book Studio is a local-first fiction writing app where the book is a folder of Markdown and JSON. A writing agent reads the Story Bible and chapters and performs checked, undoable saves. Uses Meta Muse models for long-form drafting and editing with spec-driven workflow.

summary: Turns Reels and Shorts into shoppable timeline-tagged Shopify products plus MCP.
readme_summary: Reel2AICart is a Shopify Remix app that analyzes Reels, Shorts and product videos once, caches timeline product tags for PDP and Instagram. Backend on Modal GPU with Neon Postgres plus pgvector and MCP tools for agent shopping. Built with Muse Spark Open.

summary: Local studio finds story moments, edits multilingual subtitles and exports clips.
readme_summary: Context Desk is a local video production workspace with Discover, Moment Map, Studio timeline and Library. Muse Spark assesses sampled frames and transcripts while Muse Voice transcribes audio, keeping evidence and uncertainty visible.

summary: Team chat with Atlas agent that creates and updates tickets from conversation
readme_summary: Team chat with channels, DMs, threads and tickets workspace. Atlas agent performs CRUD on tickets with user permissions via domain layer in src/lib. Built with Next.js 16, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Supabase, Meta Model API, with evals in evals/.

summary: Agent manages a crop cycle from soil and satellite data with farmer approvals.
readme_summary: FieldPilot reads soil sensors and satellite imagery to make bounded farm operations autonomously and asks before economic changes. It explains decisions in plain language with LIVE Muse Spark or labeled REPLAY modes. Stack has backend, frontend and planner.

summary: Transcribes shop visits in Hindi/English and routes findings to action teams
readme_summary: Records FMCG shop visits, transcribes Hindi/English/Hinglish/Marathi with speaker diarization, and extracts quote-grounded findings. Backend + web app deployed via Docker/Railway routes each finding to finance/distribution inboxes. Uses Meta-only models for transcription, extraction and verification.

summary: Growth autopilot turning business context into approved video campaigns.
readme_summary: Pipeline from business input to reasoning, image and 9:16 reel plus voiceover with human approval. TS apps with API and Modal jobs, 225 tests. Uses Meta models for reasoning and creative synthesis.

summary: Privacy gate that masks image PII then red-teams it to prove no leak
readme_summary: Pipeline: locate PII, mask images, attack with second model, score leaks to release or refuse. Product code isolated from answer key with evidence commands. Uses vision locate, masking, and Baseten attack model.

summary: Self-hosted team memory that turns GitLab project activity into an updated corporate wiki.
readme_summary: Mnemosyne is a self-hosted, git-backed graph of team memory nodes that MCP-capable AI can read and write across GitLab projects. Meta Muse models turn it into Wikipedia-style articles, workflow diagrams, and PDF handbooks refreshed on a schedule under spend limits.

summary: OS-level Spanish-English interpreter for any video call app on Windows
readme_summary: Runs beside Meet, Teams, and Zoom via virtual microphone for realtime ES-EN dubbing and subtitles. Stack uses Muse Voice Transcribe for ASR, Muse Spark for translation, and MMS-TTS for voice output in Python.

summary: Rust harness verifies AI performance patches with data
readme_summary: AIOps Experiment Engineer lets Muse Spark 1.3 propose perf patches from operational evidence. Isolated Rust harness builds, checks correctness, measures p95 latency. Verdicts VERIFIED, REJECTED or INCONCLUSIVE on Cloudflare Workers.

summary: Agent that writes Triton GPU kernels checked by an anti-cheat harness on H100s
readme_summary: Muse Wonder writes Triton kernels for 43 KernelBench tasks, verified on Modal H100s in strict fp32. Hardened harness blocks cached outputs and PyTorch fallback, comparing Wonder, Spark, and Wonder+Spark fix loops.

summary: Calculates Bay Area new-home true price after builder incentives
readme_summary: Collects move-in-ready listings and incentive fine print from builders across 8 Bay Area counties, converts credits and buydowns to dollars, and compares to county assessor sales. Web map plus Muse Spark agent for queries.

summary: Investigation workbench that proposes and verifies failures in event-driven systems
readme_summary: ChaosPilot reads source code and behavioral contracts to propose chaos experiments. It executes them against fresh deterministic Node.js instances for trading and inventory targets. Uses Meta Model API for investigation reasoning with a mock mode for offline dev.

summary: Telegram bot that turns Singlish chats and photos into a calm task list.
readme_summary: Settle forwards Telegram chats, slides and math photos into one prioritized student task list and starts the first step. Stack is Next.js 15 TypeScript, Bun, Supabase Postgres and Telegram Bot API. Uses Meta AI models to parse deadlines and generate plans.

summary: Rebuilds legacy software into modern web apps from screen-recorded video
readme_summary: Records use of old software without source, then multi-agent pipeline extracts screens, reconstructs flows, and generates a modern web app. Verifies step-by-step parity. Built from scratch for hackathon with Python agent team and modern web output.

summary: Turns notebook photos or spoken questions into hands-on science experiments for kids
readme_summary: Turns a photo, typed or spoken lesson into prediction, drag-and-drop experiment and spoken tutoring. Web app with api/server/src/shared stack deployed on Vercel. Uses Meta Muse models for lesson understanding and voice explanation.

summary: Prompt-to-furnished 3D room builder that inspects and fixes Unity scenes
readme_summary: AI agent builds, inspects and corrects furnished rooms inside a real Unity HDRP project from one prompt. Python/Go orchestration with Unity 6000.3. Uses Muse Spark for layout reasoning and SAM 3.1 for visual inspection.

summary: Voice-first online store for local kirana grocery shopping.
readme_summary: Next.js 16 + Supabase Postgres with RLS and multilingual voice ordering UI. Includes mobile, e2e and Playwright testing setup. Uses Meta Muse models for speech-driven product search and checkout assistance.

summary: DM agent that quotes prices, checks stock and holds bookings
readme_summary: Skapter automates customer DMs for small service businesses like detailing. Muse Spark Open reads text, photos in English or Spanish and calls tools for pricing, supplies and calendar holds, escalating to the owner when human judgment is needed.

summary: Turns photos of workshop offcuts into verified cutting plans to reuse scrap material
readme_summary: Photographs irregular leather, felt or foam scraps, segments shape, and nests parts around defects. Independent geometric verifier checks overlaps and spacing before display. Web app with AI segmentation plus nesting engine, leftover material tracked for reuse.

summary: Vertical space shooter with AI briefings, live difficulty tuning, and spoken coach
readme_summary: Godot 4.7 5-sector shooter with bosses. Muse Spark via Meta Model API generates briefings, taunts, adaptive AI Director tuning, post-run coach, and Muse Image emblems. Stdlib Python server with same-origin Vercel API, offline fallback.

summary: Turns GitHub issues into tested draft pull requests after human approval.
readme_summary: Analyzes repo architecture deterministically, plans tasks and executes in isolated worktrees with test verification. Monorepo with deterministic intelligence engine. Uses Muse Wonder for planning and Muse Spark for coding agents.

summary: Event clothing-swap app linking exchange requests into two-way swaps and cycles.
readme_summary: Vintage Relay lets organizers share QR codes for flea-market events where users list garments with photos. Backend links requests into swaps and three-person cycles requiring consent. Uses Meta AI for garment search, matching, and descriptions.

summary: Turns lecture audio and video into transcripts, notes and whiteboard visuals
readme_summary: Lecture Studio records or uploads lectures to transcribe audio and extract whiteboard moments. It pairs board drawings with guided notes and generates teacher materials. Next.js app with browser persistence and sample lecture mode.

summary: Maritime supervision cockpit for vessel inspections, emergency alerts and bulletins with human review.
readme_summary: NaviGarde IA is a maritime operations cockpit for Benin authorities for boat inspections, sailor alerts and bulletins. AI photo inspection, voice triage and explainability feed human-required validation. Built as Dockerized web app with review workflow and public alert page.

summary: Voice and vision AI companion with versioned memory anchored on Solana
readme_summary: Talk and show webcam to a persistent character that stores memory in a versioned graph. Dockerized agent and app stack. Uses Muse Spark for dialogue and memory, Voice Transcribe for speech, SAM 3.1 for vision.

summary: Assistive voice app that clarifies dysarthric speech after user confirms text
readme_summary: Assistive communication platform for dysarthria that transcribes speech and proposes clearer sentences in Hindi/English/Hinglish. Stack spans backend, frontend, inference and Docker with workspace at /communicate. Uses Meta Muse Voice Transcribe as primary with opt-in local Whisper for comparison.

summary: Phone-camera pendulum tracker with audited physics measurements
readme_summary: Points phone camera at a pendulum where SAM 3.1 handles segmentation and stdlib-only Python does measurement. Ships every result with full audit trail. Includes fixtures, tests and CI for reproducible metrology.

summary: Turns narrated inspection videos into visual findings and signed reports
readme_summary: Converts narrated home-inspection videos into findings with visual evidence. Uses Muse Spark for narration, Muse Wonder for independent review, SAM 3.1 for localization. Human-in-loop approval before report.

summary: Lets plants define SCADA camera alerts in plain English with no training
readme_summary: Connects USB/RTSP cameras to SCADA via plain-language rules approved by user. Playground with Docker, Ignition and Python streaming. Uses Muse Spark for rules and SAM 3.1 for watching.

summary: In-game voice sidekick that watches screen, coaches, and clips plays
readme_summary: Coach watches gameplay, joins voice chat, gives live strategy, and acts via game tool calls. Studios add playbooks to onboard players without tutorials. Uses Meta Model API for reasoning and tool-calling with desktop capture and TTS stack.

summary: Pre-publish vision check that tells blind creators if a photo or video is post-ready
readme_summary: Simulated Instagram composer running six checks: framing, crop safety, sharpness, text, impression and privacy. Reports pass/fix/uncertain in screen-reader and braille-readable text. Client-server app with Docker, tests and documented model choices.

summary: Extracts P&C insurance guideline PDFs into traceable Excel rating requirements
readme_summary: RateCraft extracts rating tables and routines from P&C PDFs with Muse Spark 1.3, normalizes them via deterministic validation engine, and exports Excel with evidence. Node.js 20+ only, zero runtime dependencies, one PDF per run.

summary: Rust CUDA runtime that runs SAM 3 segmentation live on NVIDIA GPUs
readme_summary: sam3rs is a native Rust/CUDA runtime loading official SAM 3 checkpoints with no PyTorch. Single CUDA stream engine does image segmentation and click-to-track video far faster than PyTorch.

summary: Measures animal behavior from video with frame-linked verification
readme_summary: Kappa takes experiment video and plain-English measures, tracks animals with SAM 3.1, and returns Verified, Locked or Refused values with uncertainty and frame links. Researcher confirms assay; integrity checks block identity swaps and impossible motion.

summary: Turns photos of public spaces into accessibility barrier reports by need
readme_summary: Maps curb ramps, footpaths, entrances and signage issues filtered by mobility, vision and hearing needs. Next.js app scoped to IIT Dhanbad OSM boundary with community reports. Uses Meta vision AI for evidence-backed detection.

summary: Permissioned camera layer letting AI agents query existing business cameras
readme_summary: Rikuy Connect is a safe gateway for agents to see through business cameras with permission and audited calls. Monorepo with apps, skills and demo. Uses Meta Muse models and vision APIs for camera understanding.

summary: Verification engine that generates with Meta models and blocks unverified outputs
readme_summary: Veritas is a declarative policy engine that generates then adversarially cross-checks artifacts in a closed loop. Python CLI/app with tiered critics and cryptographic receipts. Uses Muse Spark for critics, Muse Image for generation/edits, SAM 3.1 for grounding.

summary: AI DJ that builds playlists and performs transitions in Mixxx with gesture control.
readme_summary: Meta Muse Spark selects songs and plans cues, tempo changes and crossfades from validated options. Local controller executes in Mixxx with MIDI feedback and webcam gestures for requests. Includes dashboard, analysis scripts and Mixxx config.

summary: Voice concierge dispatches hotel delivery robots and replans failures
readme_summary: Hotel room-service demo with voice ordering, fleet brain dispatch, battery-failure replanning, and door camera checks. Next.js + Supabase with browser MuJoCo robot sim. Uses Muse Spark agent, Muse Wonder fleet brain, and SAM 3.1 vision.

summary: iOS app turning federal court filings into plain-English sourced briefings.
readme_summary: CASER tracks US federal court filings and generates plain-English case briefings. Built with SwiftUI iOS + widgets and Next.js backend. Powered end-to-end by Meta Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API.

summary: Phone tutor that watches paper math and asks Socratic voice hints aloud.
readme_summary: Muna Lens tracks handwriting via phone/webcam, reads steps, and outlines errors with Socratic audio prompts. Uses SAM 3.1 for live hand tracking and SAM 3 for still-frame grounding on Modal GPUs, with Meta open models for reasoning.

summary: Consent-first reconnection bridge for families separated by war and displacement
readme_summary: Privacy-first blind-matching service to reconnect families without searchable directories. Backend parses memories, resolves matches, and redacts documents. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, and SAM 3.1 with consent-gated contact.

summary: Mobile-first ops app for SMEs with voice transactions and analytics.
readme_summary: AI COO combines dashboards, voice-based transaction entry, and decision support for small businesses. Built with Next.js frontend and deterministic analytics plus Meta AI models for reasoning.

summary: Turns text ideas into playable 2D physics simulations in the browser
readme_summary: Takes natural-language prompts via Meta Muse and SAM 3.1 to configure deterministic Python physics backend. FastAPI plus Pydantic serves scenes to Next.js 16 with 60 FPS PixiJS WebGL visualization. Docker Compose full-stack with design docs.

summary: Benchmark testing if Muse can tell rule bots from LLMs pretending to be scripts
readme_summary: Runs interrogation games where Muse Spark interrogator scores suspicion against real scripts versus AI impersonators. Dashboard replays games with logs and analysis scripts. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 for evaluation research.

summary: Git-like version control, branching and region merge for digital paintings
readme_summary: Saves painting versions, branches ideas, diffs regions in plain words, and merges or restores regions pixel-for-pixel. Built with Muse Code with browser frontend, backend, CLI and Modal. Never generates pixels, only copies artist pixels.

summary: Turns ordinary video into measured 3D physics with verified events.
readme_summary: Extracts 3D points from video or photo, tracks rigid bodies, and detects contact, crush and rebound with measured numbers. Web plus Python backend with GPU worker, MapAnything and MoGe-3 for 3D. Uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark plus Muse Voice for explanation.

summary: Deterministic firewall that blocks indirect prompt injection in AI agents
readme_summary: Quarantine plus action-gating firewall stops hijacking from untrusted data without hurting clean work. Python package with benchmarks, demo agent and CI tests. Evaluated against Muse Spark, dropping attack success from 60% to 0%.

summary: Software wind tunnel proving app fixes with real failure experiments
readme_summary: Open-source tool runs double-clicks, lost responses, webhook duplicates and races against real backend and DB. Traces breakage and re-runs to prove fixes. CLI installs to Claude Code, Codex, Muse Code for Next.js Postgres apps.

summary: AI-assisted booking enquiry, room allocation and quotation helper for guest houses
readme_summary: AI-assisted operations for independent guest houses: reads enquiries, checks capacity and pricing deterministically, owner approves. Next.js + TypeScript stack with docs and tests. Uses Meta Muse Spark for enquiry understanding plus Smart Maps concierge.

summary: Shared family thread turning elder-care agreements into tracked tasks.
readme_summary: One thread per loved one with board tracking pharmacy, appointments, and forms to prevent dropped commitments. Built with React/Vite, Supabase, and Lovable demo hosting. Uses Meta AI workflows to parse chat into tasks and follow-through reminders.

summary: Badge audio plus CCTV review that coaches Indian store staff
readme_summary: SaySo joins salesperson badge audio with store CCTV by timestamp to explain walkouts and suggest fixes. Web app plus firmware/hardware for recording with Modal deployment. Uses Muse Spark to generate short coaching notes from the combined events.

summary: Home emergency helper with first-aid voice guidance and family alerts.
readme_summary: AuraHealth helps families in home emergencies with neighbor alerts, spoken first-aid steps, and timed records. It also manages health cards, medication reminders, and voice/text chat. Research prototype built with Muse Glimmer, designed for offline use.

summary: Continuous vision inspection for one-off industrial builds against CAD.
readme_summary: Argus inspects engineer-to-order manufacturing using video, photos, and 3D scans checked against CAD and order rules. It monitors every build stage and produces a traceable dossier for human sign-off. Built on Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, and SAM 3.1 with Docker API.

summary: Tamper-evident procurement approvals with hash-chained audit and risk AI
readme_summary: Governance core extracted from Vertical Reality OS. Records who, where, when and approver in append-only hash chain with Meta-powered risk intelligence. Next.js + Tailwind + Supabase dashboard with live Vercel demo.

summary: Personal memory agent that stores preferences in a time-aware graph for other AIs
