readme_summary: Mirror learns user decisions into a time-aware Kuzu knowledge graph and visualizes it as a body map. Python + Docker Compose stack exposes relevant memory to external AIs via MCP. Uses Muse models to extract, update, and retrieve personal context.

summary: Predicts a code change's production latency before deploy with signed gate
readme_summary: Deploy gate for coding agents and CI that A/B measures changed services off production and predicts mean latency. Built in Go with MCP server, Muse Code plugin, signed pass/block verdicts and AWS test bed. Extends rhobound-cli with batch queue models and variance tests.

summary: Multimodal platform to verify suspicious content for deepfakes and missing context
readme_summary: VeritasShield AI investigates images, audio, screenshots and links for manipulation and miscontext. Frontend on Vercel with Python backend API uses SAM segmentation overlays and evidence search. Uses Meta Muse models for multimodal reasoning and verification via Meta Model API.

summary: Voice-first sales copilot turning debriefs into plans and win forecasts
readme_summary: Private copilot for infrastructure deals that turns voice/text debriefs into minutes, ranked actions, and follow-up emails plus HMM win probability. Built with Meta Muse models in Streamlit with eval harness and sample deals.

summary: Turns one spoken sentence into checked plans for drone and arm robots
readme_summary: Natural-language control for a home/warehouse robot team. Meta models plan tasks, verify visually before moves, and check results. Includes drone skills, landing experiments, benchmarks, and command center scripts.

summary: Reruns classifier code under checked controls to expose inflated evaluation metrics.
readme_summary: NullLab is a local Research Workdesk where users attach CSV plus train.py, confirm target and splits, then Muse Spark proposes typed interventions. It reruns fold-local fitting and leakage checks to report metric deltas. Includes agent, app, baselines, and docs.

summary: Builds auditable 3D exploded views from repair docs and device photos
readme_summary: Local-first Next.js studio that researches iFixit and web, intakes 3-16 photos, then generates evidence-backed 3D exploded view. Local server proxies provider calls. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 over up to 48 visual inputs for reconstruction proposals.

summary: Orbital station simulator where AI diagnoses and repairs failed modules
readme_summary: LATTICE simulates a modular orbital data center where a Muse agent diagnoses telemetry, inspects rendered camera frames, and commands REPAIR/SWAP/DEORBIT. Next.js + 3D scene with robot servicer. Uses Muse Spark vision, SAM 3.1 segmentation, and web search.

summary: Invoice ingestion engine that validates duplicates and gates ERP payment approval
readme_summary: SIRE extracts invoices via Muse Spark ReAct pipeline, runs deterministic validation and duplicate blocking, then human approval with audit. Stack is React Vite Tailwind with Oracle DB and ERP handoff.

summary: One photo of papers shows which scheme documents you have or miss
readme_summary: Sarkari Saathi photographs papers on a table to tick off Indian scheme document lists. SAM 3.1 segments papers, Muse Spark names them, code matches schemes. Vite + Node server, Hindi/Marathi/English voice readout.

summary: Multimodal evals and observability for agents that see, hear and act.
readme_summary: EvalVerse records multimodal agent traces and checks answers against evidence media. Python 3.11 package with server, examples and 155 tests. Evaluates vision/audio/video agents, localizes failure stage and audits judge trustworthiness.

summary: Photo plant identifier that checks pet toxicity against veterinary database
readme_summary: PetSafe Plants identifies all plants in a photo and matches them to a curated toxicity reference. Muse Spark proposes identities with uncertainty, SAM 3.1 segments overlapping regions for re-check. Python backend with Docker, web UI, tests and notebooks.

summary: Turns appliance symptoms into technician-ready repair requests via chat
readme_summary: Tenant-aware intake platform with embeddable chat, hosted intake page, tech workspace and REST API. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for fact extraction and draft assessments with optional image-label transcription.

summary: Quest 3 grow HUD that scans microgreen trays and tracks health.
readme_summary: Crop Scout is a Meta Quest 3 passthrough HUD assistant for microgreens growers. It scans trays with headset cameras using SAM 3.1 segmentation and Muse Spark via Meta Model API. Room and DataStore provide shared tray storage and history.

summary: Infinite canvas notebook with inking, live math, PDF studio and AI research copilot.
readme_summary: Spatial infinite-canvas notebook with pen smoothing, zoom and minimap, living calculations, and multilingual PDF reading with voice. Built with React Vite Tailwind and powered by Meta multimodal models for research assistance.

summary: Verifies robot code policies against reward hacking and physical failures
readme_summary: Adversarial verification harness for code-as-policy embodied agents. Four-node LangGraph loop with domain-randomized sandbox telemetry, HMAC signing and SAM 3.1 counterfactual 3D checks.

summary: Turns a whiteboard photo into a running, tested repo with services and tests.
readme_summary: Parses system diagrams from board photos into services, database, queue and compose files. Generates boilerplate code and tests automatically. Uses SAM 3.1 for diagram region detection and Muse models for architecture extraction and codegen.

summary: Converts demo video into reusable object program with parts and interactions.
readme_summary: Takes a video in and outputs source-linked object program capturing geometry and interactions like hinges. Produces connected 3D drafts for reusable agent context. Demo site with trailer and walkthrough.

summary: Turns one item photo into edited listings for Marketplace, Shopee and Carousell.
readme_summary: Identifies brand and model from logos and labels, cleans product photo and drafts platform-specific descriptions. Suggests price from comparable listings. Uses Muse Spark for understanding, SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Image for cleanup.

summary: LLM-driven irrigation platform where Muse Spark reasons over sensor streams
readme_summary: Sensor nodes stream over MQTT to an orchestrator that prompts Muse Spark 1.3 with live readings, history and reflection. Safety engine validates decisions before firing actuators. Docker and YAML-configured IoT stack.

summary: Turns creator ideas into reviewed scripts, scene prompts, thumbnails and metadata
readme_summary: Short-form video studio that turns a brief into researched story, reviewed script, character direction, scene video prompts and platform metadata. Has backend, frontend and Supabase. Uses Meta AI models for generation workflow.

summary: Persistent 3D memory of home objects from glasses and phone views
readme_summary: Reality Diff turns looks at a space into a persistent 3D map of objects with identity, location and history. Built with SAM 3.1 for segmentation plus Muse Spark reasoning, with Streamlit app, YAML config and eval harness.

summary: Builds a user-owned health passport from messy PDFs and wearables
readme_summary: Ingests lab PDFs, portal exports and wearable data into one structured passport where every fact cites source, page and line. Built with Next.js, Supabase and fixtures/scripts for parsing. Does not diagnose; it transcribes and aligns records with provenance.

summary: Turns cooking videos of loved ones into living recipes linked to video moments
readme_summary: Records family cooking video and generates steps linked to timestamps, preserving literal measures. Stack uses Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark 1.3 for schema-validated JSON, and SAM 3.1 to locate hands and containers.

summary: Local app for learning European Portuguese via translate and talk.
readme_summary: Local FastAPI app with one HTML page for Translate, Explore and Talk in PT-PT. Uses httpx to call Meta API and edge-tts for speech. Proof of concept with pytest, no auth or persistence.

summary: Malagasy voice notes converted to verified shop ledger and credit history
readme_summary: PWA where shopkeepers speak Malagasy/French notes to build a verified sales and debt ledger. Backend transcribes, extracts entries and compiles credit history for microcredit. Built with Python backend, frontend PWA and eval tests.

summary: Verifies AI draft reviews against exact sources with quote checks and stale control.
readme_summary: Reviews a saved draft against a source, validates quotations locally, and marks older revisions STALE. Uses Meta Muse Wonder via Model API for judgments with human approval separation. Python stdlib app with web UI and live demo.

summary: Builds walkable 3D places from spoken or typed descriptions
readme_summary: Type, upload audio or talk live; server transcribes, generates block-style 3D scene to explore with keyboard and mouse. Node server plus web client with quality scaling; demo includes 15 places like Taj Mahal and Punjab home.

summary: Tests if revoked AI agent work still reaches business systems
readme_summary: Standalone open-source app for evidence-driven investigation of AI-agent controls with observed-effect checks. Includes Jurator compiler turning written policies into verifiable controls. No account, backend or database required, model proposes code decides.

summary: AI phone agent that answers home-service calls and books jobs
readme_summary: SecondCall AI rebuilds Debbie, a live AI receptionist for HVAC, plumbing and roofing, on Meta Muse models. Includes telephony, agent-core, post-call QA and eval-harness rematch of 565 failed calls. Bookings and proof are sent after each call.

summary: Multi-camera weapon detection with tracking and auto 911 call
readme_summary: Campus safety system watching cameras for weapons, tracking person across cameras, and placing automated 911 call with observed facts. Muse Spark Open on Baseten for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, SignalWire+ElevenLabs voice.

summary: Evidence-gated COBIT self-assessment where Spark proposes and Wonder challenges
readme_summary: Self-assessment co-pilot for COBIT 2019 where Muse Spark proposes claims and Muse Wonder challenges them, with deterministic code scoring capability per ISO/IEC 33020. Built as Next.js app with claim contracts in lib/claims.js. Uses Spark and Wonder with code-enforced output roles.

summary: Any video in, physics measurement out with every step drawn on the footage.
readme_summary: General video forensics system where Muse Spark proposes what to prove, measures motion and overlays steps. Static web player hosts results like Moon vs Earth g estimates at $0.36 per clip. Python pipeline with prompts, skills, fixtures and tests.

summary: Personal research radar that tracks questions and briefs what changed with quotes
readme_summary: Gleaner monitors arXiv, Hacker News, GitHub releases and blogs for user questions, filters noise and verifies quotes answer the question. It produces cited daily briefs and next steps. Uses Meta models for filtering and Muse Spark for suggestions via Python pipeline.

summary: Guided voice helper that prepares Medicaid and SNAP applications for review.
readme_summary: Tenet conducts spoken or typed interview, asks each question once, and fills NC DHB-5200 and DSS-8207 drafts. Answers stay on device, numbers use deterministic rules, output is review-only. Built for Meta hackathon Oct 26-Nov 4.

summary: Helps disabled artists edit artwork and turn it into stickers, totes with NFC stories
readme_summary: Artists frame drawings for SAM 3.1 segmentation, edit via voice or text with Muse Image 1.0, and hear descriptions via Muse Spark 1.3. Stack is web plus iOS with VoiceOver support. NFC tags link products to captioned artist videos.

summary: Self-hosted AI party host on TV with phones as controllers, no install
readme_summary: Funhouse is a party-game platform with TV screen, landing site, and phone controllers. Includes cartridges like quiz, werewolf, and drawing games with Docker compose deploy. Uses Meta AI models as the live host and game master.

summary: Kit for multi-vendor agents to cooperate with human-signed decisions
readme_summary: CoalitionKit composes group tasks from one sentence, joins via QR, agents query owners privately and make offers. Python 3.12 open kit, pre-release. Supports any-vendor agents with person-signed decisions.

summary: Evidence-first science agent that proposes studies and verifies claims with code
readme_summary: Human-supervised research prototype on environmental data using Meta open-weight models. Models propose methods, tools acquire data, independent code evaluates evidence. Python package and CLI with evals and replay examples.

summary: Turns PR review decisions into unbreakable rules for coding agents
readme_summary: Knack extracts decisions from merged PR threads into enforceable agent rules with provenance quotes. Python + ast-grep CLI enforcement. Prevents agents re-shipping rejected alternatives.

summary: Keeps story worlds consistent with sourced facts and contradiction checks.
readme_summary: Imports lore and scripts, proposes facts with verbatim source quotes for human approval. Checks accepted canon for contradictions and change impact. Nuxt app built on Muse models for Startup track demo.

summary: WhatsApp agent for plumbers that triages leaks and drafts job tickets.
readme_summary: Takes urgent WhatsApp requests, gives damage-control help and builds quote from owner rules. Human confirms every job with owner app review. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 to read leak video frames.

summary: Cozy work app that finds jobs for you and handles the boring management parts.
readme_summary: Hygge is a native iOS app that finds work and automates admin while user keeps decisions. Includes TestFlight beta, Swift client with backend and CI. Uses Meta AI features for job matching and workflow automation.

summary: Mac app to run Muse Code teams and answer from the Muse app
readme_summary: PenguPool brings coding-agent teams and waiting questions into one workspace via macOS app with Go host. Runs Muse Code locally, follow from Muse app. Built for Muse in-the-loop approvals.

summary: One care engine for surgical counts, pill reading and discharge notes
readme_summary: Lightday links doctor dictation and nurse photo proofs for wristband, vitals, tray counts and discharge. Built with Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice. Count-guard blocks surgery close until camera count matches.

summary: Voice-guided wiring assistant that checks each terminal-block wire via overhead camera
readme_summary: Assemvio turns an expert wiring demo plus narration into a validated step plan for trainees. Deterministic vision code using SAM 3.1 masks and color checks issues PASS/FAIL/UNSURE. Muse Spark only compiles plans and answers questions, never sets verdicts.

summary: Local-first intelligence platform with API, mobile app and agent features
readme_summary: Monorepo with API, mobile app, packages and evals using Postgres, Redis and Prisma. Local setup guide for API credentials, simulator and on-device validation. Agent features with Turbo/pnpm TypeScript workspace.

summary: Simulated user swarm that predicts eye-tracking heatmaps to pre-test website designs.
readme_summary: PersonaVision tests websites with AI personas on phone and desktop, showing gaze, confusion and fix suggestions. TypeScript pnpm monorepo with apps, session-runner and Docker. Uses Meta models for persona simulation and UX analysis.

summary: Cozy clinic game where persistent patients remember you and teach clinical reasoning
readme_summary: Browser portrait game where encounters change persistent patients across clinicians. Built with web frontend plus Supabase backend on Vercel. Uses Meta AI / Muse models to drive patient dialogue, memory, and clinical teaching.

summary: Kid-safe creative studio that turns voice and drawings into pictures and stories
readme_summary: Creative space for kids 5-12 to generate images from voice/text, animate drawings, and create illustrated stories. Stack with backend/frontend and evals, using Meta models for generation and safety checking of everything a child sees.

summary: Worldbuilding workbench weaves alternate histories on a dated timeline
readme_summary: Writers ask what-if questions and weave fitting events by date with cause links, forking conflicts via What-if-instead. Muse Wonder checks timeline fit, Muse Spark 1.3 runs ripple checks, Muse Image and SAM 3.1 supply scenes and cutouts. Chronicle rail plus globe UI.

summary: Evidence-backed life memory graph with verifiable consent forgetting
readme_summary: MemoryAtlas turns consented photos, voice, video and notes into a queryable graph that self-corrects and forgets verifiably. Stores only text, code-enforced retention. Backend plus frontend with Docker, evals and leak checks on deletion receipts.

summary: Mac piano tutor that listens via MIDI or mic and coaches your playing
readme_summary: Native Swift macOS tutor that hears notes via MIDI or microphone, grades pitch, rhythm and tempo against scores. AI tutor on Meta Model API explains mistakes and plans practice. Built with Swift Package Manager, no extra install.

summary: Muse connector that generates touchable talking WebAR characters
readme_summary: Takes a passphrase and theme in Muse to compose a character server-side for HACKAR:S WebAR. Pipeline with engine, player and API layers. Uses Meta Model API via MCP to generate 3D, voice and AR interactions.

summary: Turns opportunity links into verified plans, calendars and application drafts
readme_summary: Personal opportunities agent that finds official sources, extracts dates and requirements with exact quotes. Uses muse-spark model-driven tool loop where code verifies quotes before trusting values. Stack is TypeScript monorepo with Supabase and apps packages.

summary: Executes PRs under kernel tracing to catch supply-chain attacks
readme_summary: Runs pull requests and npm packages under kernel tracing and compares observed behavior to claimed changes. Caught unsafe postinstall exfiltration to bare IP with disabled TLS in 100-package trial.

summary: Multi-agent team turns a paragraph into checked concept, image and build plan
readme_summary: Runs expert agents and chief designer on shared whiteboard with literature search, calculation and simulation. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for team reasoning, Muse Image 1.0 for pictures and SAM 3.1 for part maps.

summary: Agent swarm optimized vLLM on Apple M1 Pro for 21% faster inference with identical output.
readme_summary: WeSolve is a multi-agent swarm that profiles and rewrites vLLM GPU code for Apple Silicon with benchmark verification. It targets Meta MobileMoE-S with bit-identical output checks. It is orchestrated through Muse Spark and Muse Code session logs.

summary: Playful game that teaches prompting AI agents one tap at a time
readme_summary: Web game where players tap pieces and check Pipo's actions to learn prompting. Cloudflare Workers plus JS frontend with missions. Powered by Muse Spark for agent responses and hints.

summary: Field photos to weed maps with EPA-checked herbicide advice
readme_summary: Upload a field walk; a Muse Spark agent drives SAM 3.1 segmentation, code measures intensity and applies threshold rules to list EPA-label herbicide options with citations. Python scout pipeline with Docker and tests. Live demo replays saved runs.

summary: Visual studio where AI plans apps then writes them into editable component tree
readme_summary: Museware lets users describe an app, approve a blueprint, then generates executable React components with verify gates. Stack is React + Vite frontend with Node API server. Uses Muse API for planning and codegen with local offline fallback engine.

summary: Assistant for Pi Hub that proposes store and job actions for approval
readme_summary: Autonomous agent for SMAJ PI HUB to discover products, jobs and entertainment via natural language. Implements Verified Delegation where users approve actions before execution with transparent records. Uses Meta Model API with Next.js frontend and public demo workspace.

summary: Knowledge graph showing House members stances with quotes and sources
readme_summary: Evidence-anchored graph mapping U.S. House members on -1 to +1 spectrum per issue with verbatim quotes and sources. Monorepo with apps, services and ingestion tools plus GitHub Pages UI. Uses Muse Spark for stance extraction, scoring and cited summaries.

summary: Predicts what breaks on dependency upgrades and proves it with test runs
readme_summary: ChainReaction reads migration guides, traces affected imports, and predicts upgrade impact chains. Verifies with real before/after test runs and keeps only passing fixes. Uses Muse Spark with recorded offline replay runs.

summary: Refactors tangled prompts into modules and checks token cost savings
readme_summary: Promptimize.ai extracts workflow modules from promptbases and benchmarks token cost and behavior. JavaScript web app with evaluation UI and cloud benchmark receipts. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for refactoring and Muse Wonder 1.0 for architecture advice.

summary: 3D room that visualizes Muse shopping cart notes on shelves in real time
readme_summary: A 3D showroom web app that polls a cart API every 2s and renders items on shelves with totals. Built with Next.js frontend and Cloudflare Worker plus Durable Object backend. Uses Meta Model API with muse-wonder-1.0 and muse-spark-1.3 as agent brain.

summary: Turns voice, singing, or sheet images into edited music scores
readme_summary: Agentic notation editor with multi-agent Band Mode for parallel instrument parts. Next.js app with audio spectrum analysis. Uses Muse Spark for score agents and Muse Voice Transcribe for talk/sing input.

summary: Agentic securities-lending desk that drafts locates, quotes and bookings for approval
readme_summary: LoanDesk AI is an agentic lending desk where the agent reads chat, works locates and books. Stack is FastAPI + LangGraph + Postgres with React/TypeScript frontend and Terraform infra. Uses Muse models for trader-supervised workflow automation.

summary: Prepaid bill card that sets per-bill limits and explains declines
readme_summary: Consumer fintech demo with sample account, per-bill virtual cards and decline explanations. Next.js app at digna.dev; uses Meta AI for support, risk messaging and onboarding.

summary: Desktop research writer where Muse drafts only from your library with checked cites
readme_summary: Groundwork is a desktop app for writing from papers, notes, scans and web pages in a personal library. Muse Spark drafts strictly from library sources with citation chips verified against quoted pages. Electron frontend with Python backend.

summary: Hotel ops app routing guest voice requests to staff tasks with photo checks
readme_summary: Readybell unifies guests, staff, rooms and reports in one Next.js app. Guest chat/voice becomes routed tasks, staff prove work with AI photo check, owners get daily briefs. Built for hotel live operations.

summary: Curated link collection for the DeepSeek Harness coding super-agent prototype
readme_summary: Awesome-list documenting dsh-superagent prototype: setup, usage, design articles and code diffs for a proactive repo-scoped coding agent. No app code, links only. Not built on Meta Muse; covers DeepSeek Harness ecosystem.

summary: Turns how-to videos into step guides that check a photo of your work
readme_summary: Vercel web app where creators publish narrated guides and learners follow step-by-step with stuck-photo check. Uses Meta vision models to compare user photo to creator frame and outline differences. Demo access via code Meta2026.

summary: City parking map built only from camera pixels and traffic routing
readme_summary: CarMaCar renders simulated car cameras and builds a live parking map purely from pixels using SAM 3.1. Muse Spark writes and tests traffic routing playbooks on real Los Angeles roads.

summary: Bangla/English app that digitizes prescriptions and explains health records plainly
readme_summary: MediSathi digitizes prescriptions and lab reports with on-device Bangla/English OCR for review, timelines, trends and doctor reports. Built with Next.js and check-in tracking. Uses Muse Spark for plain-language explanations and grounded Q&A over user records.

summary: Desktop guide that points at the exact button to click for beginners.
readme_summary: Watches the screen, plans multi-step tasks, and overlays a pointer with one instruction per step. Desktop app demoed in Godot 4 with discovery questions and confirm cards. Uses Meta vision models for screen grounding and step planning.

summary: Native Linux terminal that visualizes coding-agent activity as a project map
readme_summary: Native Linux terminal built for coding-agent workflows with activity indicator and repo content feed. Stack is native desktop app with content-tour mode. Uses Muse Spark for explanations and Muse Image for visuals, grounded in actual code.

summary: KiCad schematic debugger that ranks root-cause fault hypotheses
readme_summary: Haxrok ingests KiCad netlists, ERC, datasheets and symptoms to rank fault causes with evidence labels. It also runs pre-fab reviews, wiring checks and ngspice simulations.

summary: Collaboration workspaces connecting people, universities and funders
readme_summary: Next.js 16, React 19 and Drizzle/Postgres platform for discovery, project workspaces, groups and realtime chat. Tracks requests, agreements, contributions and wallet activity. Uses Muse Spark for AI assistance.

summary: Photo of desk becomes editable 3D twin for device mapping and fixes
readme_summary: React 19 + Three.js app that converts desk photos into editable 3D twins and tracks connections. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark structured output for troubleshooting dialogue.

summary: Turns long videos into readable notes where every point links to its exact second.
readme_summary: Turns 2-hour videos into verified articles with timestamp citations checked against transcripts and keyframes. Web plus API architecture for ingest, transcription, and verification. Uses Meta Muse models for summarization and evidence grounding.

summary: Connects scattered medical records into traceable timeline with sources
readme_summary: Unifies medical files from different institutions into one versioned history with source inspection. Built solo with Meta Muse Spark for extraction and linking, local-first backend with docs and offline checks.

summary: Role-play lessons where you practice by teaching and speaking
readme_summary: Mobile web app for experiential learning where users role-play teacher, coach or Spanish scenarios with grading. Built with Muse Code and Meta Model API on FlashFeed knowledge packs with web frontend.

summary: Self-hosted CI fixer that opens draft PRs only with proof and policy gates
readme_summary: Self-hosted CI repair service turning red builds into human-reviewed draft PRs with deterministic checks and policy gates. Monorepo apps architecture. Powered by Meta Muse models for patch generation and review.

summary: Family agents split errands via negotiation without sharing location
readme_summary: WRU is a negotiation layer over WhereCtx personal location servers. Each family member's Muse agent on Muse Spark reads only coarse status and negotiates tasks via offer-counter-commit. Outputs only assignment, preserving coordinate privacy.

summary: LLM agents propose turbulence closures for k-omega SST with deterministic scoring
readme_summary: LLM research agents write candidate RANS closures in a checkable grammar with least-squares fitting. A deterministic evaluation ladder and OpenFOAM pipeline score proposals, with a live cockpit. Uses Muse models for proposal generation only, never for scoring.

summary: Turns claim photos into an editable inventory and finds evidence for insurers
readme_summary: Converts imported photos into an editable contents inventory for insurance claims, then retrieves supporting evidence. Built with FastAPI, JSON persistence, Pillow, ReportLab and vanilla JS. Uses Muse Spark muse-spark-1.3 for reasoning, SAM sam-3.1 for vision, and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Translates Japanese letters, forms and machines into migrant languages.
readme_summary: Photo-based explainer for Japanese letters, ATMs, and forms in Nepali, English, Vietnamese, or Burmese. Static HTML/JS frontend with Python server and offline chatbot. Uses muse-spark for translation and explanation.

summary: Publishes verified agent-readable pages so AI assistants can serve small firms
readme_summary: Crawls a small business website, identifies missing facts, asks the owner to confirm, and publishes an agent-readable page. Includes Errand consumer agent for benchmark tests and a back-office app. Uses Meta Model API to parse sites and validate facts before publishing.

summary: Mobile fabric catalogue that digitizes swatches and vendor cards
readme_summary: Fashion buyers photograph swatches and cards for searchable catalogue on React + Supabase. Hackathon work migrates extraction from Gemini to Muse Spark with Muse Spark Open option. Supabase Edge Functions pipeline.

summary: Turns WhatsApp product photos into ready-to-publish Reels and shop posts
readme_summary: Merchant sends 1-8 photos or voice note via WhatsApp, agent returns Reel with Publish/Change/Discard to post to Instagram. Portal links Instagram, Facebook Page and Shopify. Built with Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

summary: Turns plain-English rules into camera watchers that alert and act on events
readme_summary: Whenever is IFTTT for cameras: Muse Wonder generates rule code from English and tests it, then Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 watch RTSP/ONVIF feeds. Runs on Mac/Linux with actions, alerts and reports. Built for Meta hackathon with Python camera pipeline.

summary: Real-time AI mock interview simulator with voice and performance diagnostics
readme_summary: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript platform for verbal mock interviews with 3D avatar and diagnostics. Stack includes Tailwind, Three.js, Supabase, Framer Motion. Uses Meta AI for realtime speech interaction and interview scoring.

summary: English listening companion for Arabic learners that explains tapped words in context.
readme_summary: Tap words or ask by voice to get CEFR-tuned Arabic explanations saved for review. Web app with Supabase and 16kHz transcribe API. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for explain and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Skill-first optimizer cuts billed cost per successful agent task
readme_summary: TokenTrim adds caching, compaction and tool modules for coding agents on Meta Model API. Python CLI + dashboard measures dollars per successful task using muse-spark-1.3-contributor on synthetic benchmarks.

summary: Phone video becomes a tested physics twin for motion what-if play.
readme_summary: Tracks moving objects from phone video, fits physics parameters, and validates on unseen footage to certify or refuse the twin. Python backend with web UI and synthetic sample clips. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for motion reasoning and verification.

summary: Multi-agent command center where one executive agent coordinates specialist agents
readme_summary: Warden Automatons is an open-source MIT framework with Node.js control plane, React Vite dashboard, Postgres pgvector memory and sandboxed execution with Playwright QA. A single @warden agent delegates to engineering, product and security agents. Integrates Muse and other LLMs.

summary: Rebuilds small business sites for search, AI agents and branding
readme_summary: Takes a business URL, Instagram and shop to score discoverability then rebuilds an editorial site, studio photos, campaign and brand skill. Python pipeline using five Meta models including Muse Spark and SAM. Demo showroom with deploy scripts.

summary: Agent that proves every action with immutable hash-chained receipts and verification.
readme_summary: Halimi turns requests into tool actions and returns a receipt with understanding, tool used, timing and refusals. Receipts are hash-chained with a verification endpoint. Built with Python server plus tests and docs using Meta Model API.

summary: Turkish coding agent that proves its work with independent acceptance tests.
readme_summary: Takes Turkish text or voice tasks, writes code with tools using Muse Glimmer/Spark. Separate Muse Spark call writes blind acceptance tests. Shows pass rates over iterations with measured results.

summary: Independent agent re-analyzes papers to deliver replicated or not verdicts
readme_summary: QED takes a claim plus replication package, writes fresh analysis code without running authors code, executes in Modal sandboxes. Python FastAPI orchestrator, pluggable codegen. Uses Llama Meta API and Muse Code.

summary: Geotechnical monitoring agent that detects ground collapse risk from sensors.
readme_summary: Monitors subsidence above coal workings from surface sensor arrays to catch collapses early. Multi-tool autonomous agent with deterministic safety guard, eval harness and web demo for hazard alerts.

summary: WhatsApp win-back agent helping Nigerian shops re-engage quiet customers
readme_summary: WhatsApp retention agent for Nigerian retailers to send naira-priced offers. Customers reply by text or voice note in their language. Built with Muse Spark for text, Muse Image for pictures and voice transcription.

summary: Agent that finds surgical supplies for the OR without a phone call
readme_summary: Surgical Item Finder matches varied surgical item names to inventory and routes requests to materials staff. Stack is FastAPI backend, frontend, Docker and Render demo. It uses Meta Muse models to resolve aliases, search inventory and draft handoffs.

summary: Checks fundus photos in a second and tells technicians keep or retake
readme_summary: On-device diabetic eye screening QA that flags blur, aim and coverage issues while patient is present. Python app with coach_core, experiments, notebooks and tests. Reduces ungradable rates and return visits.

summary: Prototype that reviews rental deposit evidence using precomputed vision analysis samples
readme_summary: Offline pipeline segments items with SAM 3.1, suggests classifications with Muse Spark, and generates demo scenes with Muse Image. Next.js site explores a precomputed sample run with mock fallback. Does not analyze uploads or determine liability.

summary: Adversarial caller that stress-tests voice agents with difficult scenarios
readme_summary: AI mystery shopper sends difficult callers at voice agents before launch and grades pass-fail in re-runnable grid. Muse Wonder generates adversarial scenarios from business URL. Text transcripts plus browser-voice playback for review.

summary: Turns kids drawings into playable physics games you edit by chatting
readme_summary: Converts cutout drawings into physics bodies to play as real games in minutes. Studio publishes games with one click, with sandbox agents and headless verification. Built for Meta hackathon indie track.

summary: AI assistant that extracts subscription terms from receipts and warns before trials renew.
readme_summary: Paste receipt to extract service, price and billing dates for review and reminders. Next.js app with localStorage and server extract route. Uses Meta Muse Spark model for receipt parsing.

summary: AI mediation for mobile-money escrow disputes from voice notes and photos
readme_summary: Handles P2P trade disputes in Cameroon from spoken code-switched audio and contested photos. Built for MTN/Orange Money escrow flows over WhatsApp and Marketplace. Uses speech, vision and mediation pipeline with TypeScript stack.

summary: Turns briefs and footage into approved ad ideas, storyboards, and cuts
readme_summary: Studio pipeline that generates three ad ideas, storyboards the pick, then builds finished cuts with human approval and logged decisions. Built on Meta Muse plus SAM 3.1 with Docker deploy and browser preview demo.

summary: Agent content factory for short-video posts with auditable human approval gates
readme_summary: Birds Eye turns AI content production into a disciplined pipeline where agents write and review posts. Posts are files in git with explicit validated transitions. Built for Meta hackathon Theme 1 using Meta models with Docker and Modal app.

summary: Private desktop agent that learns tasks from one narrated screen demo
readme_summary: Rose runs on a private Ubuntu VM, sees XFCE desktop and acts with mouse/keyboard. Learns workflows from narrated screen recordings or via MCP handoff. Keeps video and credentials local, using Muse Spark Open and Glimmer.

summary: Agent-aware firewall that maps edge IoT attack surface and blocks rogue agents
readme_summary: Digests edge/IoT environments, builds attack-surface map and enforces plain-language business rules live. Includes Python sim, policy engine, and quarantine/revoke loop for PLCs and sensors. Designed for intent-level inspection of agent actions beyond packet filtering.

summary: Photo plus voice note turned into infant lesson plan and printable visual card
readme_summary: Takes one classroom photo without children and 15-20s voice note to inventory materials. Generates 3x20-min SEP-aligned lesson plan with safety sections and 3-panel ficha. Built on Meta Model API with Python bridge and Cloud Run demo.

summary: Creative editing agent where Muse plans edits for preview and native export
readme_summary: General-purpose media editing agent with memory and native tools. Uses Muse Glimmer via Ollama to plan edits over native operations for preview and export in Studio. Hosted Muse Spark profile remains unverified.

summary: Video Q&A engine answers with timestamps and abstains without visual proof.
readme_summary: Upload MP4 and ask questions; every claim cites timestamps and stored frames or system abstains. Uses muse-voice-transcribe-1.0, SAM 3.1 tracking with IoU merge, OCR voting, and deterministic event graph with Allen-interval ordering.

summary: Live captions and study notes to help deaf students follow class
readme_summary: Mobile-first React, TypeScript, Vite and IndexedDB app with Node server proxy. Streams mic audio to Meta Muse Voice Transcribe for live captions, then uses Muse Spark 1.3 for catch-up summaries and study notes. Saves transcripts, bookmarks and notes locally in the browser.

summary: Local safety gateway that approves or blocks coding agent file, shell and git actions
readme_summary: Intercepts proposed file edits, commands, HTTP and pushes, resolves impact, applies local rules and escalates to Muse Wonder judge. Python service with live action stream and LeashBench. Uses Muse Spark for proposals and Muse Wonder for safety decisions.

summary: Verifies sellers and listings to block fraud and polish product photos.
readme_summary: An agent for social commerce that scores risk from photo review, EXIF and perceptual-hash duplicates, verifies seller IDs, and creates studio cards. Full-stack app with FastAPI backend and frontend. Uses Muse Spark vision, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

summary: Lets residents report potholes and floods with AI drafts and live map.
readme_summary: Dashboard with Upload & Analyze for AI draft from photo with confidence and evidence. Node server with offline pending sync, map picker, confirmations and WhatsApp sharing. Uses Muse vision models for image assessment.

summary: Live camera narration of nearby objects, distance and direction for blind users.
readme_summary: Web app that samples camera frames about every 2 seconds and speaks guidance. Uses SAM 3.1 for detection and Muse Spark for short navigation prompts plus voice queries. Has mock mode, unit tests and Vercel deployment.

summary: Evidence-review workbench for lunar oxygen reactor ground-test planning.
readme_summary: Researchers log runs and request input-driven review with accounting checks, tools, critique, and next-evidence requests. Python backend with Vite/Three.js frontend. Uses Muse Wonder for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for segmentation.

summary: Autonomous science agent that discovers device behavior via planned safe experiments
readme_summary: StateSmith Discovery proposes hypotheses, preregisters experiments in an append-only ledger, and builds transition graphs from measured evidence only. Stack is Python 3.12 + Next.js app with webcam/mic, ffmpeg, and Modal. Human performs all physical actions on WAIT/GO prompts.

summary: Autonomous CCTV control-room operator that watches feeds and sends alerts
readme_summary: Next.js 14 control room using Muse Spark Open 1026 for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for vision detection. Baseten serverless inference with WhatsApp Cloud API alerts. Transforms cameras into autonomous operator.

summary: Turns video of motors and pumps into vibration digital twins
readme_summary: Argonaut builds live digital twins from video of rotating machines to identify natural frequencies, damping and optimal speed setpoints. SAM 3.1 creates virtual sensors, Muse Spark grounds part names, with sub-pixel motion and audio tachometer. Physics checks plus human sign-off before action.

summary: Converts lecture PDFs to accessible HTML with verified equations only
readme_summary: Turns engineering PDFs into screen-reader HTML, publishing equations only after triple verification. Combines Muse Spark vision transcription, glyph-layer parsing, and render-back diffing. Deterministic role-tagged diff decides publish or refuse.

summary: Gives Muse hands and eyes on phones and watches via MCP with bench tests
readme_summary: Provides physical-device control of Android, Wear OS and iOS simulators via MCP linc-nerve server. Evaluated under pre-registered confinement on mobile-agent-bench. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for agency and SAM 3.1 for screen vision.

summary: Offline oral-lesion photo workflow that routes referrals without diagnosing
readme_summary: OncoLens lets health workers photograph lesions and answer a questionnaire; fixed protocol sets priority. SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark via Meta Model API assist dentist review. Dentist signs every case; prototype only.

summary: Two grounded restaurant assistants for guests ordering and owners analytics
readme_summary: Chef assistant builds validated meals from menu with diet and budget checks; owner assistant answers sales metrics. Node TypeScript server validates all outputs. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API grounded in restaurant data.

summary: Audits trading backtests for overfitting and look-ahead leakage faults
readme_summary: Two Muse Spark agents with opposite jobs audit strategies for selection bias and leakage; all numerics are deterministic code. Built with Streamlit app, Muse Spark via Baseten meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026, and eval harness.

summary: Chat-centered computer with custom Rust OS where one conversation controls files and apps.
readme_summary: AI-native operating system written from scratch in Rust with own kernel, drivers, TLS 1.3 and model engine. Single conversation interface finds files, opens sites, aggregates chats, and lists reversible actions. Centers Meta Muse Spark for intent handling.

summary: Proof-carrying drone emergency landing verified by pixel evidence
readme_summary: Python safety system where Muse Spark proposes zones from vetted hazard vocabulary. SAM 3.1 must back every claim, with SAM-distilled student checking descent. Modal apps and tests for simulation.

summary: Parses job notices, checks eligibility and preps application photos.
readme_summary: Uploads PDF or photo notices to extract key facts, eligibility checks and page-cited Q&A. Resizes selfie and signature to portal specs and autofills forms via extension. Adds Telegram chat and deadline reminders.

summary: Rebuilds freelance payment agreements from chat screenshots for approval
readme_summary: PayAgent ingests chat screenshots and text to reconstruct agreed, changed and paid amounts with message citations. Next.js app with guest workspaces and investigation flow. Uses Muse Spark vision-language parsing.

summary: Desktop watcher that learns repetitive copy-paste work and automates it for you.
readme_summary: Echo observes spreadsheet-to-form copy-paste via browser extension and dashboard. Backend turns demonstrations into repairable recipes with redacted PII. Uses Muse Spark to detect repetition, judge automation and self-heal selectors mid-run.

summary: Shared 3D avatar world that builds props and scenes from photos and text prompts
readme_summary: Web-based multiplayer 3D world with photo-made avatars and prompt-driven scene editing. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for moderation, Muse Image for generation, plus SAM 3.1 and SAM 3D for cutouts.

summary: Stateless simulator that places chip fab machines under heat limits
readme_summary: Places semiconductor machines on 100x100 cleanroom grid under thermal and vibration constraints. In-memory verifier-gated loop converges in 20-80s with Meta Model API corrector and Fireworks AI fallback, no database.

summary: One shared family agent with permissioned memory and approval for actions.
readme_summary: One agent per family with 1:1 chats, private/shared/restricted memory enforced in code. Uses Meta Muse models for memory, planning and reminders with human approval and escalation rules.

summary: Long-term memory for an agent monitoring a 39-pole parking fleet
readme_summary: Forget Fleet gives a Muse Glimmer 30B agent weeks-long memory over daily smart-parking events. Python fleetmem with replay, eval QA and web viewer running locally on DGX Spark. Uses Glimmer for remember/link/forget decisions with event citations.

summary: Disruption desk that shows which cargo shipments are hit and what to do
readme_summary: Tidewatch maps canal closures, strikes and conflicts to impacted shipments and actions. Backend multi-agent system with web frontend on Render. Uses Meta Muse Spark agents with Meta SAM 3.1 for vision.

summary: AI browser tester that finds UI violations and exports Playwright tests
readme_summary: BugArena explores a demo shop with Meta Responses API, reports rule violations, reproduces them in a fresh browser, and exports Playwright regression tests. Stack includes Node.js dashboard, Playwright, Docker with screenshots and run history.

summary: Agentic onboarding tool that maps and validates messy supplier catalogs for import
readme_summary: DataBridge AI turns inconsistent supplier feeds into reviewable import-ready data via semantic mapping and validation. Built with Streamlit app plus Python normalization tools on Modal dedicated endpoint. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer to propose mappings and select diagnostic tools.

summary: Early-warning monitor that predicts video generation failures during sampling
readme_summary: Watches LTX-2.5 sampling and at step 3 of 8 predicts exposure and color failure. Director agent stops failed drafts, picks one correction and regenerates with logged metrics. Runs in custom sampling loop on cloud GPU with SAM tooling.

summary: Tracks motion in video to find physics laws and make lab reports
readme_summary: Galileo turns phone video plus one known length into a physics experiment. SAM 3.1 tracks motion, Muse Wonder fits the law with uncertainty, Muse Spark helps reporting. Python pipeline outputs numbers and PDF lab report.

summary: Personalized explainer that turns any question into lessons and narrated videos
readme_summary: Persona Explainer adapts explanations, lessons, and 30-sec videos to age and interests, then self-scores them. Built with Next.js frontend, lib prompts, and video generation pipeline. Built entirely on Meta models for persona adaptation, video creation, and verification.

summary: Turns a photo of everyday friction into a constrained, visual fix-it plan.
readme_summary: Workflow is observe, plan, visualize, do, check from a resized JPEG with user constraints. Built on Sites Vinext starter with Drizzle DB on Cloudflare. Uses Meta adapters for planning, grounding markers, and follow-up check.

summary: Webcam-based optical assay for injectable medicine with payment clearing flow
readme_summary: Bun and TypeScript Strict app claiming to turn a 30-FPS webcam into a biophysical assay engine with 1.10s pipeline. 14-file architecture with payment clearing logic, built as hackathon healthcare and fintech demo.

summary: AI lifeguard that tracks swimmers and alerts on drowning risk in pools
readme_summary: Pool-camera assistant that finds persons/heads, tracks IDs underwater and escalates WATCH/ALARM/EMERGENCY. Uses SAM 3.1 with zoomed quarters plus Muse Spark/Muse Image in Python with frontend alerts.

summary: Uncertainty-aware waste scene planner producing explainable robot sorting actions
readme_summary: Python system with multimodal perception layer, deterministic policy planner, and 2D simulation. Fixture provider for offline demo and Baseten provider for live inference. Uses Meta Muse Spark Open 1026 for structured scene inventory.

summary: Federated LLM fine-tuning with encrypted aggregation that hides updates
readme_summary: Horizon lets orgs jointly fine-tune without sharing data via threshold-encrypted aggregation where only the sum decrypts. Python framework with Modal app, configs, and docs. Uses open-weight Muse Glimmer for private local fine-tuning.

summary: Agent that turns rough ideas into complete websites using design systems.
readme_summary: WeaveWithAI turns a plain-language idea into a frontend-only website reusing design-system components with zero-cleanup code. Built on Meta Muse models with Muse Spark inside Muse Code harness. Review agents debate issues until fixed, checked for WCAG 2.2 AA.

summary: Turns UI screen recordings into spring-physics React, SwiftUI and CSS code
readme_summary: Video-to-code Studio that measures motion from mp4/mov/webm and fits spring constants to generate runnable clones. Uses Meta API muse-spark-1.3 plus sam-3.1 with Node frontend and Python backend for tracking and codegen.

summary: Adaptive tutor that maps skill mastery across 6 levels and targets knowledge gaps.
readme_summary: Learning tool that tracks proven, failed and unknown skills from attached lectures. Guides study in professor notation with slide links and error revisits. Full-stack app with backend, compute and Docker deploy.

summary: One-minute booking pages for local shops with voice owner assistant
readme_summary: Koblip Book creates booking pages from Google Maps search with shareable pages and day management by typing or talking. Stack is Next.js, Drizzle, Postgres with English/Spanish support. Uses voice-enabled assistant for owners to manage appointments.

summary: Multi-agent orchestrator that routes briefs to agents with approval and evals
readme_summary: A Meta-native agent orchestrator turns a brief into scheduled content via Intake to Postiz drafts. Muse models via Meta Model API route work across agents with human approval gates. Includes live harness reporting routing quality, latency, and cost.

summary: Chat-built agents tested in arena and gated before going live
readme_summary: Unfenced lets users describe an agent in chat, practice it in the Arena against personas, then gate and launch. Engine with channels, reflection, and recorded evals feeds real cases back. Uses Meta Muse models for builder, simulator, and judge.

summary: Personal health record hub with evidence-linked explanations and FHIR sharing.
readme_summary: Keeps personal health data in one place with pattern detection and caregiver alerts. Cloudflare Workers with FHIR R4 subset and deterministic safety checks. Uses Meta AI only to reword facts, no diagnoses.

summary: Simulated audience that watches short video cuts and gives timestamped edit notes
readme_summary: Private screening room where fictional personalities watch cuts scene by scene to produce attention curves and engagement. Web app with contracts, migrations and API. Uses Muse models to simulate reactions and generate Director Notes.

summary: Shows a robot task once, then hardens it via adversarial simulation.
readme_summary: ANTS synthesizes a robot program from one human demo, then an adversary attacks it in simulation. Only rewrites that cause no regression are kept, with no weight training. Architecture has Synthesizer, Adversary, and regression gate.

summary: Distilled Llama 3.2 1B running offline on iPhone with optional Muse escalation
readme_summary: On-device iOS assistant using distilled Llama-Reflex-1B for offline Q&A and structured actions. Swift + Core stack with action contracts, drafts and journal. Uses Muse Glimmer labels for distillation and optional Muse cloud as System 2.

summary: Owner cockpit with chat, searchable library and human-review workflow for records
readme_summary: Python app with responsive shell, server-side conversation persistence, retained-record Library and owner gateway. Chat does deterministic record inspection without new model calls. Includes migrations, fixtures and deployment configs.

summary: Turns PDFs into narrated tours with highlights and interactive visuals
readme_summary: Uploads PDFs to generate narrated explanations with source highlights and side visuals. Ingest + player architecture with Docker Compose. Uses Meta AI / Muse models to explain passages, diagrams and math beside the original.

summary: Turns PDFs into narrated guided tours with highlights and figure zooms
readme_summary: Ingests PDFs to doc.json with IDs and geometry, then plans source-grounded tours, highlights, and visuals. Stack is ingest + player with Docker using Muse Spark for planning and spoken or typed Q&A on the page.

summary: AI-guided Tamil and Hindi placement tests with automated scoring and reports
readme_summary: Spring Boot + Vaadin app deployed for Tamil and Hindi Level 1 assessments with auth, PostgreSQL and Azure Blob. Uses Meta Model API Muse Spark for assessment guidance and Muse Voice Transcribe for speech tasks.

summary: Per-person captions and speech bubbles for group videos, mapped to each face
readme_summary: Takes a group video, tracks tapped faces with SAM 3.1 and binds diarized voices via mouth movement. Renders per-speaker bubbles, threads side conversations with Muse Spark, and answers locally with Muse Glimmer.

summary: Talk to a Raspberry Pi to generate, verify and run apps for connected hardware
readme_summary: Modulate lets users describe device behavior in speech; a Muse Spark agent detects components, writes code, sandboxes and repairs it, then activates locally with rollback. Runs on Raspberry Pi with web UI for browser demo and device connect.

summary: QR-to-chat multilingual restaurant ordering for foreign guests and staff
readme_summary: MejaBahasa is a QR-based guest web chat with cart, checkout, staff, kitchen and owner dashboards on one SQLite backend with Docker support. Built with Python backend plus static web frontend. Uses Meta AI Muse models for multilingual menu explanation and order-taking.

summary: Pre-commit house rules that teach coding agents repo conventions
readme_summary: Organizes pre-commit hooks for progressive disclosure: agents see a rule only when they break it, with why and fix guidance. Rust + Python tool with necro --explain, examples and docs. Alternative to stuffing AGENTS.md.

summary: Photo and ad critic that grounds opinions in brain-model signals before Muse answers.
readme_summary: NeuroMuse places Meta TRIBE v2 cortex encoder with calibrated heads in front of Muse Spark for grounded opinions on photos and copy. It stores taste as readable rules and brain states for memory. Muse Spark handles tool-calling and final responses.

summary: Analyzes kid playtests to build AI persona testers for games
readme_summary: Syncs face, hands, voice, screen and game events from real kid playtests to find key moments and fixes. Builds measured persona testers that play new games within observed limits. Uses Meta models for emotion analysis and Node/Godot harness.

summary: Finds YouTube videos from a half-remembered spoken line via text or voice
readme_summary: Quote Finder turns a fuzzy remembered quote into search queries with Meta Muse models and searches YouTube API titles and descriptions. It ranks verified links with embedded player and lets creators search their own caption archives. Built as a Vite + TypeScript web app.

summary: Scan a room to get a playable 3D racing world with real physics
readme_summary: Room World converts phone .glb scans into labelled world.json via Meta AI models and checks. The web app renders with three.js and Rapier physics for game mode racing or work mode accessibility planning. No sign-in demo on Render.

summary: Engineering workstation that turns part descriptions into solved FEA solids.
readme_summary: Drafty connects scenario planning with parametric CAD and finite-element solving in one loop. A Meta AI assistant collects loads and assumptions, then Studio edits dimensions and runs the solver. Both chat and manual paths share the same part and results.

summary: Local-first Windows workstation for evidence-based field diagnostics and repair
readme_summary: Native Windows diagnostic workstation that guides technicians from symptom to verified evidence. Local-first architecture for real investigations with safety controls. Built open-source by Rookweld for field-kit workflows.

summary: AI agents review timesheets and give owners evidence-backed payroll advice
readme_summary: Multi-agent team audits NAZAR time-and-attendance data and produces recommendations with evidence. Human must approve before changes. Built with Python backend, Docker deploy, and live demo; uses Muse models for analysis and fact-checking.

summary: Turns cricket coach voice notes into reviewed marked-up video lessons for students.
readme_summary: NetSense films net sessions while coach talks, transcribes with Muse Voice Transcribe. Muse Spark planner splits remarks and locates moments and selected player in video. Coach approves marks before sharing private lesson.

summary: Council of AI specialists gives red-yellow-green verdict on money decisions
readme_summary: Money adviser for Indian families built on Meta Muse Spark for insurance, loans, tips and fraud calls. Council outputs plain verdict with questions to ask; all numbers computed by code. Includes demo video and screenshot flows.

summary: Agentic browser workspace with isolated worlds and swappable AI cores
readme_summary: Tauri 2 desktop app providing A/B/X browser workspaces with comfort modes. Architecture supports swappable Pi/Muse/Grok/Hermes cores via BYO key or local models. Built for hackathon Indie track focused on agency and accessibility.

summary: Local browser workspace with isolated worlds and swappable AI cores
readme_summary: YOUR Profile is a Tauri 2 desktop agentic workspace with separate A/B/X worlds and comfort modes. It supports swappable Pi, Muse, Grok and Hermes cores with BYO key or local models. Includes safe sandbox, specs and Linux release build.

summary: Multi-agent team that turns public tenders into bid or no-bid decisions
readme_summary: Reads Dominican DGCP tenders, amendments and scans to output bid, conditional, no-bid, plus draft proposal. Five-agent system with Docker/Modal backend. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1, Voice Transcribe, Llama Prompt Guard 2.

summary: Voice-first PWA that guides a 30s check-in and 90s pause for eating urges
readme_summary: Voice-first local-first PWA with Notice->Pause->Choose flow using personalized spoken dialogue. Built with Next.js PWA stack and Meta Model API for live response generation. Uses Muse Spark/Wonder for conversation and Muse Voice/Image plus SAM 3.1 per modalities doc.

summary: Visualizes contamination chains on staged care videos for infection training
readme_summary: Staff training and audit aid for staged post-acute care video. Segmentation is the sensor feeding a deterministic pathogen-specific propagation engine with Five Moments mapping and counterfactual replay. No diagnosis or clinical advice; client/server plus engine codebase.

summary: Visual timeline app with uploads, live runs, and voice relay
readme_summary: ChronoSight is a production Next.js 16 / React 19 app with normalized BYO uploads and voice relay. Uses TypeScript strict frontend with Python backend, tested with Vitest and Pytest. Deployed live on Render.

summary: AI front desk that turns a damage photo into assessed job, quote and booking
readme_summary: Six trade desks for roofing, med spa, plumbing, AC, salon use chat, assessment and reviews. Frontend with api and demo-sites stack. Uses Muse Spark for chat, Muse Image for pictures and Muse Voice Transcribe for calls.

summary: Browser companion that executes procedures and proves outcomes with code
readme_summary: Learn-Execute-Verify companion: watches user tasks, executes with approval gates, self-heals locators visually with SAM 3.1. Models perceive, code decides. FastAPI/Playwright/Chromium stack powered by Meta Muse Spark, 134 tests.

summary: Local-first harness to run multiple coding agents as one team
readme_summary: Coordinates Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Copilot to split work, message each other, and hand off at limits. Node packaging for macOS, Windows, Linux. Local-first multi-agent orchestration with human review, no Meta AI integration described.

summary: Privacy-first dating protocol where agents vet compatibility before human introductions.
readme_summary: MuseMeet replaces swiping with autonomous dyadic agents, candidate funnel, and vaulted profiles. Node agent_engine with egress guard plus connectors and frontend. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for matching and Muse Image 1.0 with AirGap zero-leakage.

summary: Teach a robot arm a task once from a photo or short text
readme_summary: One-shot robot teaching system plans moves in code, verifies steps and measures with camera. Web plus firmware and calibration tools. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 for perception and planning.

summary: Visual Python code graph where AI agent traces answers with checks
readme_summary: Clones any public Python repo into interactive module graph, then AI agent answers by walking the graph. Every claim is checked against real code with one retry on failure. Python backend with tests, eval and scripts; no stated Muse integration.

summary: Raspberry Pi desk robot that guards focus and filters interruptions
readme_summary: Fritz is a 3D-printed desk companion with eyes, presence detection and voice interaction. Runs on Raspberry Pi 4 using Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Wonder. Holds emails, reminds context, reaches you on WhatsApp.

summary: Real-time camera assistant that speaks street hazards for blind pedestrians.
readme_summary: StreetSense runs fast local YOLO11s + ByteTrack and SegFormer on CPU for per-frame alerts, plus slow Meta model reasoning. Supports phone and webcam, targeting Ray-Ban Meta glasses for navigation aid.

summary: Multilingual voice ordering and kitchen manager for restaurants
readme_summary: Guests order by phone/kiosk in Telugu, Tamil, Spanish-English via Muse Voice Transcribe to cart ops. Deterministic multilingual kitchen display plus recipe inventory forecasting. Governed AI manager, Docker/Fly deployment.

summary: Health insurance assistant that traces every cost to policy and rates
readme_summary: TallyHealth agent for Los Angeles finds in-network doctors and prices care at doctor-specific negotiated rates. Built with Python backend and web UI. Uses configurable Muse models with automatic fallback.

summary: Pre-flight safety checker for risky AI agent capability combos
readme_summary: Chat-first diagnostic with Trafica that analyzes agent descriptions or MCP configs for lethal trifecta risk. Explains why combos are unsafe and how to split capabilities. Multilingual app with live Vercel demo.

summary: Floor-plan tester where simulated AI residents live a day in old vs new design
readme_summary: Upload home, office or street plan and redesign with real items. AI cast simulates a day in old vs new space with scorecard. Built for Build for Your World Indie track, design signals only.

summary: Sports video reuse detector that builds integrity-checked evidence packages
readme_summary: Helps rights holders find potential video reuse via computer vision and vector similarity. Combines Meta Muse models via Model API with cryptographic integrity checks. Full investigation workflow with frontend and backend.

summary: Virtual specialist team supporting GPs with multilingual decision support
readme_summary: Clinician-facing support for low-resource general practice with synthetic data only. Provides multi-agent specialist input in Luganda, Kiswahili and English. Stack spans frontend, backend and model server with review sign-off.

summary: Record a rental once, then run cleaning turnovers from that visual record.
readme_summary: Host and cleaner app for vacation rentals with property records, turnover checklists, and phone web UI. Stack is Docker Compose with backend API and frontend. Uses vision models for room understanding from photos.

summary: Open source personal finance tracker with deterministic ledger and AI explanations
readme_summary: Personal finance web app where balances are calculated deterministically from entries. Uses Meta AI only to explain existing data in plain language. Built with .NET API, web frontend and Docker Compose deployment.

summary: Proactive pixel companion that nudges ADHD users with one next small action
readme_summary: Nudgling is a proactive focus companion where a pixel creature speaks first when you drift, suggesting a sub-two-minute action. It learns from feedback and gamifies work with XP and levels. Words come from Muse Spark in cloud or Llama 3.2 locally via pi agent runtime.

summary: Virtual try-on that shows new clothes on your body styled with your closet
readme_summary: Twin Closet scans body and closet, then shows store screenshots on user from four angles and builds outfits. Web + API + Supabase stack with Vercel/Render demo. Built on SAM 3.1, Muse Spark, Muse Image and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Voice-directed video editor that cuts subjects and writes live shader effects
readme_summary: ShoulderCut is a voice-driven editor where Muse tracks subjects with SAM 3.1 and authors WGSL shaders live. Stack is WebGPU frontend with server backends. Uses SAM 3.1 for masks and Muse for voice intent and shader generation.

summary: Maps London borough supply pipeline against prices with Q&A analyst
readme_summary: London Pipeline unifies Land Registry, MHCLG and boundaries for 33 boroughs on one map. It shows cycle phases, EPC-matched prices and risk scores with verified memos. Uses Muse Spark analyst over source data via Next.js.

summary: Move-out inspector separating wear from damage with photo proof
readme_summary: Upload move-in/out photos and Muse Spark assesses wear vs damage with SAM 3.1 masks and depreciation estimates. Drafts landlord reply with cited sources. Next.js app with live demo and rate limits.

summary: Port-to-door shipment stage tracking for Nigerian importers and clearing agents
readme_summary: Port-2-Door tracks containers from Nigerian ports like Onne to importer address and empty return. Built with Django Python backend in config/tracking modules. Uses Meta AI models for stage updates and importer-agent transparency.

summary: AI agents map hidden power-grid wiring by running experiments on a physics simulator
readme_summary: GridXray reconstructs medium-voltage distribution topology from meter data and switch photos. It uses Muse agents for hypothesis and experiment design with a physics simulator and deterministic checker. Stack includes backend, frontend and docker-compose.

summary: Local console that turns a topic into a narrated faceless video after approval.
readme_summary: ReelDirector is a Flask console with gated flow: script draft, human approval, then video assembly. It uses local rendering with MMS TTS for voice. It uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, Muse Image, and SAM 3.1 checks.

summary: Investigator agent audits live-animal air cargo paperwork and flight deviations
readme_summary: Black-box agent checks IATA paperwork pre-flight, reconstructs flight post-landing, and queries crew on deviations. Deterministic core with evaluation benches, agent loop, and journal handover record. Runs on Muse Spark Open, SAM 3.1 and Voice Transcribe.

summary: Small Llama agents share latent vectors instead of text for faster teamwork
readme_summary: Lets small specialist Llama models collaborate by passing latent vectors, cutting reader latency from 2.7s to 0.06s on consumer GPUs. Stack is Python with bridge.py, dataset builders and chat_app. Uses Muse Spark around local team for orchestration and fallback.

summary: Camera math game where stuffed animals and hand gestures drive play
readme_summary: Toybox Math turns a stuffy photo into a game avatar for gesture-based math like Fruit Ninja. Static frontend with Cloudflare Workers rate limiter and SPEC docs. Uses SAM 3.1 for cutout masks and Muse Spark 1.3 for stories.

summary: Local-first reflex plus cortex system for adaptive autonomous robotics.
readme_summary: Dual-tier robotics kernel combining fast local reflexes with online system identification and cloud cortex. Python backend with dashboard and Foxglove layout. Uses live Meta Model API Cortex for adaptation over local control.

summary: Checkpoint proxy that blocks AI agents from leaking keys to the internet.
readme_summary: Runs agents sealed in Docker with decoy keys, proxying all egress through a checking gateway. Uses mitmproxy, Docker sandboxes and review UI. Built with Muse Spark for policy checks, recording and leak blocking.

summary: Voice-first Windows agent for verified retrieval and controlled computer actions
readme_summary: Privacy-aware Windows AI agent with FastAPI core, Electron Aurora UI and .NET desktop layer for truthful retrieval and verified actions. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning with tests, docs and voice-first workflow.

summary: Personal memory vault organizing bookmarks and gating impulse buys
readme_summary: Personal AI that ingests browser bookmarks, screenshots and social links into semantic memory and daily protocols with impulse-buy gating. Node API with background jobs and Modal. Uses Meta Model API for organization and budgeting.

summary: Checks lab simulators against observations and freezes evidence-cited trust decisions.
readme_summary: Compares observations to executable pendulum models, requests experiments and cites evidence. Python physics engine with five-view replay UI. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for tool reasoning and SAM 3.1 for bob tracking.

summary: Brain-decoding layer that abstains when EEG signals are too noisy
readme_summary: SureEnough wraps brain decoders with sequential stopping and calibrated abstention to control error rates. Web demo uses Meta Perception Encoder with SAM 3.1, Muse Spark and Muse Image.

summary: Tanglish voice and photo ledger that digitizes small-shop udhaar credit
readme_summary: Kadai Khata helps Tamil Nadu kirana stores track credit via Tanglish text, voice and notebook photos. Digitizes shorthand khata entries to a searchable ledger. Django app deployed on Render with live demo.

summary: Voice agent that sets your camera, shoots and checks its own photo
readme_summary: ShutterSense is an agent that translates natural-language intent into camera settings, captures, and visually verifies the result. It uses Muse Wonder for agent and vision plus Muse Image for pose ideas, with CCAPI and simulator.

summary: Turns any GitHub repo into cited answers, docs, and validated presentations.
readme_summary: GitFill is a web app and VS Code extension that answers code questions with file-line citations. It generates handbooks, diagrams, and PPT/PDF with self-checking and auto-repair. Powered by Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, and Muse Image.

summary: 3D space flight sim with free exploration and tactical dogfighting.
readme_summary: METAHORIZON ODYSSEY v7 3D space simulation with 360 exploration and multi-stage action, plus Python GUI and server. Game and 3D export folders with hardware acceleration. Uses Muse Code, SAM 3.1, Llama 3.2 and Llama Guard.

summary: Memory and evidence-based verifier for AI coding tasks
readme_summary: Stores project rationale in a .brain file and only marks tasks done on real verification evidence. TypeScript service with evals. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API for planning, diagnosis and handoffs.

summary: Helps freelancers check purchase bills and deductions before buying
readme_summary: Tax-prep checker on Cloudflare Workers with React/Vite frontend and D1 metadata, homepage plus app and admin dashboard. Manual bill review with consent-gated chat. Uses Meta Model API for optional text chat, invoice extraction paused.

summary: Verifies code fixes by observing real browser behavior, not looks
readme_summary: Local sealed verification for accessibility fixes and game-world cheats using Chromium-observed pointer and focus behavior. Includes dry-run Muse Spark 1.3 adapter and deterministic tests.

summary: Robot agent that writes its own skills and self-verifies from pixels
readme_summary: Embodied agent starting from one primitive, authoring reusable skills and judging success from pixels not simulator state. Python stack with MuJoCo and LIBERO-OBJECT evaluation. Solved 10/10 tasks with 94.1% verifier accuracy and zero false positives.

summary: Verifies Nigerian bank transfer screenshots against actual account credits
readme_summary: AlertCheck checks vendor-submitted receipt photos against incoming payment ledger to output RELEASE, DON'T RELEASE or CHECK MANUALLY. Python agent with vision parsing, ledger matching, and boxed evidence overlay. Uses Muse vision models to extract receipt fields for ledger verification.

summary: Segments and tracks surgical tools in real time to automate counts
readme_summary: ZeroLeft provides real-time segmentation, classification, counting and tracking of surgical instruments for traceability. Python app with SAM 3 client and exemplar matching. Uses Meta SAM 3 foundation vision for instrument segmentation in procedures.

summary: Conversational agent that turns ideas into branded enterprise PowerPoint decks
readme_summary: Agentic assistant that converts natural conversation into enterprise-ready PowerPoint with branded templates. Uses Meta Model API muse-spark-1.3 for content and structuring with backend orchestration and frontend editor. Includes Python service for slide generation and Liquid Glass design system.

summary: AI engineer that designs submarine hulls and rejects unsafe designs via physics.
readme_summary: Hull Forge proposes pressure-hull designs, tests them with a Python fatigue physics model and explains decisions. Includes MCP server, benchmarks and red-team prompts. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 as design agent via Meta Model API and Muse Image for art.

summary: Turns WhatsApp chats into evidence-backed sales follow-ups without a CRM
readme_summary: Organizes webhook messages into customer conversations and flags what needs attention with visible evidence. Uses Meta Model API for classification and Q&A over conversations via text or browser voice. Prototype with Docker compose, fixtures and sandbox WhatsApp integration.

summary: Local-first MCP server turns any UI into permissioned, verified replayable workflows
readme_summary: AnyBridge provides 7 MCP tools to capture interfaces as permissioned workflows with verification and replay. Node.js/TypeScript stack with planner on Meta Muse Spark, focused on security, permissions, and no-model replay.

summary: Closed-loop robot agent that imagines, acts, and replans after failures
readme_summary: Franka Panda in ManiSkill 3 uses SAM 3.1 for detection and Muse Spark for skill planning on YCB objects. Detects disturbances like knocked objects from physics state and replans. Evaluated with 120 runs and Fisher exact tests.

summary: Photograph handwritten math to pinpoint the exact line where reasoning broke.
readme_summary: Checks phone photos of student work from Class 1 to PhD level to locate dropped terms and sign errors. Explains the student's own mistake rather than a generic solution. Web app with public 60-item benchmark page.

summary: Voice-controlled SO-101 arm that picks objects into your hand
readme_summary: Say-and-Grasp provides open-vocabulary pick-and-place on a low-cost SO-101 arm with zero task training. Uses Muse Spark for language-to-grasp planning and SAM 3.1 for segmentation. Records every handover as a Muse-labeled training episode.

summary: 100-second home video becomes priced inventory with hash-sealed claim files.
readme_summary: Phone-browser walkthrough in 30-second clips produces counted, replacement-priced inventory with video, sealed hash, JSON claim file and CSV. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for listing, Muse Wonder/Image and SAM 3.1, with every model call logged to cost_ledger.

summary: Click an object in video to remove it and auto-check the edit for review
readme_summary: VOID Auto-Edit tracks a clicked object with SAM 3.1, adds a second view with Muse, rebuilds background and runs quality checks. Teams review flagged moments instead of full footage. Python pipeline with just checks and evidence bundle.

summary: Agent that turns repeated payment chores into tap-based mini-apps
readme_summary: The agent detects repeating chores from card texts and builds a fixed-renderer mini-app to handle repeats. It writes a checked spec instead of code, keeping repeats to 0 tokens or one short query. Built on Meta Muse models for spec generation and Q&A.

summary: Verifies ATC clearances against pilot readback and FMS trajectory in 4D
readme_summary: Shared 4D ATC clearance verification prototype comparing ATC intent, pilot readback, simulated FMS programming and predicted trajectory. Uses muse-spark-1.3 ATC Intent and Pilot agents, FMS simulator, deterministic comparison matrix and verification coordinator with audit chain.

summary: Estimates flood depth from one street photo using known object heights.
readme_summary: SAM 3.1 segments water and reference objects like tires and jeepneys, Muse Spark reads waterline. Converts to MMDA gauge with passability and nearby shelters on shared live map. Web client with workers backend.

summary: Guardrail that blocks unsafe actions but offers provably in-policy alternatives.
readme_summary: Policy enforcement layer that keeps hard boundaries while letting blocked agents finish tasks via alternatives. TypeScript monorepo with apps and packages, verifiable decision ledger, demos and evals. Built for agent ops on real infrastructure.

summary: Offline-first network engineer IDE with RAG copilot grounded in Cisco docs
readme_summary: VS Code-inspired IDE with offline completions, multi-device terminal and CML simulation management. FastAPI plus React 18 with authoritative AI Copilot via Meta Model API and Cisco documentation RAG.

summary: Text-message bookkeeper that logs receipts, income and mileage to Sheets
readme_summary: SMS/voice-note bookkeeper for solo tradespeople that parses receipts, miles and questions into Google Sheets. Python service with tests and scripts for messaging pipeline. Uses Muse Spark for ledger reasoning, SAM 3.1 for receipt photos and Muse Voice Transcribe.
