summary: Pocket walking guide that narrates sourced stories about everyday street objects.
readme_summary: Chitchat Tour is a mobile web walk around Taipei that triggers short sourced trivia when you pass ordinary street items. Built with Next.js, it personalizes novelty and cross-country comparisons. Uses Meta Muse models for story generation and filtering via prompts.

summary: Finds relevant DC open datasets for plain-English questions and plans analysis.
readme_summary: Turns plain-English DC questions into ranked open-government datasets and analysis plans. Handles discovery across 1600+ datasets before analysis. Uses Meta Muse Spark for ranking, summarization, and planning.

summary: Multi-agent team turns one product idea into a tested local web app
readme_summary: Requirements, planner, coding and test agents build on user's machine via local companion over WebSocket. Contract in docs/contract.md with model I/O trace. Uses Muse Spark for planning and Muse Spark Open for coding via Meta endpoints.

summary: Tabletop studio that turns objects into playable logistics games and tests fixes
readme_summary: LiveWorld converts tabletop objects and design intent into a playable logistics game, simulates outcomes, and measures repairs. Includes Kept checkout experiment for visual contrast checks. Uses Muse Spark for rules reasoning and SAM for object segmentation.

summary: Tells whether to repair, reuse, donate, resell or recycle old electronics.
readme_summary: SecondLife AI accepts photo, voice or text to classify e-waste and guide safe disposal. Client-server app with shared types and docs. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 vision, and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 via Meta API.

summary: Designs robot hardware and firmware from a sketch via simulation and CAD.
readme_summary: Closed-loop Vision-to-Hardware studio using Muse Wonder 1.0, Muse Spark 1.3 and SAM 3.1 to reason over assemblies. Django backend, React Three.js frontend, MuJoCo physics and FreeCAD generation.

summary: Paycheck finance agent that simulates bills and invests the rest
readme_summary: Paycheck Committee answers if bills can be paid via day-by-day cash simulation, then invests leftover via multi-agent committee of researchers and investor personas. Money math is deterministic Python with tests, LLMs only argue and explain. Uses Meta models via Meta Model API.

summary: Photograph official paperwork to get explanations, filled forms and deadline tracking
readme_summary: PaperPilot redacts personal data on-device, then explains bureaucratic documents, plans steps, drafts replies and fills forms. Full-stack with backend/, frontend/, samples and scripts. Uses Meta AI models for document understanding with user review required.

summary: Turns error logs into failing test, verified fix, and privacy receipt
readme_summary: Agent on Muse Spark Open reads only stack-trace code to produce reproducing test, verified fix, and origin commit. Emits Privacy Receipt proving only inference endpoint contacted. Node monorepo with MQTT sample.

summary: Bounded supplier-change demo blocking payment diversion via verified read-back
readme_summary: Enforces Contract to Decision to Bounded Write to Independent Read-back chain for supplier-master changes. Isolates browser execution and blocks direct DB mutations to resist prompt injection. Demo uses fictional data with GitHub Pages preview and Remotion film.

summary: Learns physical tasks from video then executes them with a MuJoCo robot
readme_summary: Video-to-robot system where SAM 3.1 tracks video, Muse models derive physics and procedures. MuJoCo executes tasks with vision self-check and coach mode. Python stack with spend ledger and physics validation.

summary: Agentic bus dispatcher that moves riders across buses mid-route when crowded.
readme_summary: Monitors Chennai corridor buses and proposes cross-bus transfers at shared stops. Uses Meta Muse Spark for dispatch decisions gated by a deterministic verifier. Stack includes Python API, simulator and Next.js dashboard.

summary: Home-safety agent that detects visual hazards and triggers protective actions
readme_summary: OmniMind monitors home camera feeds to detect hazards and act when users cannot. React 19 Vite frontend with Python FastAPI backend. Uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark for vision reasoning.

summary: Hyper-local planting advice for Zambian farmers grounded in live weather
readme_summary: Agriculture advisory engine giving smallholder planting advice grounded in live weather, not guesses. Web app with Node server, live demo and generated images, submitted to Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon.

summary: Records a lab demo once, then coaches and grades the next person with video evidence
readme_summary: Records an overhead phone video of a pH tray experiment and extracts steps from measurements and color changes. Python pipeline with eval, templates and 3D replay plus a live coach that flags deviations. Uses vision analysis in a Muse-compatible coaching and grading workflow.

summary: Samples real object motion from video into interactive JavaScript spring code.
readme_summary: Tracks object with Meta SAM 3.1, measures box-center motion with timestamps, fits damped oscillation to export reusable JS springs. No custom training. Web + JS library prototype for indie developer track.

summary: Embodied AI prototype separating perception from permission with local checks
readme_summary: AIRA is a privacy-aware embodied companion where Meta perception provides evidence, a local validator checks permission, and Unity performs bounded simulation. Source-only Unity project with docs, tools, and tests. Enforces perception is not permission principle.

summary: Turns night event-camera flickers into visible streets using SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.
readme_summary: Applies SAM 3.1 segmentation to ordinary frames and rendered night events from Zurich drives. Uses Muse Image to paint readable streets plus inspection agent for targeted repaint. Python pipeline with static web demo.

summary: Benchmark and runtime guard that tests and blocks prompt-injection in agents
readme_summary: AgentArena runs a Meta Muse tool-using agent in a synthetic sandbox with hidden injections to measure attack success and defense cost. AgentShield is a standalone guard between any agent and its tools. Full-stack with backend agentshield module and frontend.

summary: Local workbench where a Meta model proposes hypotheses and runs fresh eval experiments
readme_summary: AI evaluations researcher that designs experiments, investigates failures, preserves evidence. Vite frontend, server backend, replay and comparison views. Uses Muse Spark for investigation and analysis.

summary: Preserves family keepsakes in a memory graph and retells stories gently
readme_summary: Ingests photos, cards, and voice notes into verified Engram graph and Memory Quilt. Gentle session agent asks, hints, then tells stories with real or stock voices. Python plus web stack; uses Muse Image for illustrations in fictional Rose Ellis demo.

summary: STEM tutor that grounds datasheets and PCB photos into interactive quizzes
readme_summary: Interactive STEM and hardware troubleshooting tutor that converts PDFs and board photos into spatially grounded Q&A. Stack is Next.js TypeScript frontend with SVG overlays plus FastAPI orchestration for ingestion, grading and caching. Uses Meta AI agents for spatial discovery and tutoring via SSE trace.

summary: Turns text and sketches into FEA-verified printable mechanical parts
readme_summary: Converts natural language plus sketch and loads into parametric CAD via narrow tool calls with Muse Glimmer. Runs real FEA with CadQuery, gmsh and CalculiX over 16 turns. Only 11-gate deterministic verifier can certify STL/STEP output.

summary: Care companion that recalls lost objects and relays caregiver messages
readme_summary: Prototype for elders with memory loss that tracks objects, relays caregiver messages and triages health questions. Cloudflare Workers site replays recorded outputs. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Compiles written procedures and verifies them against visual evidence
readme_summary: Compiles procedures into typed requirements and checks timestamped visual evidence with deterministic PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN evaluator. Uses Muse Wonder 1.0 for semantic compilation and SAM 3.1 masks/tracks. FastAPI backend + frontend in Docker.

summary: Block-programming puzzle game teaching coding concepts with AI coaching.
readme_summary: Puzzle game where Bolt the robot runs block programs plus Tracks for data structures, algorithms and full-stack. Uses Meta Muse models for levels, stories, coaching, Manim animations and voice/vision input. Playable in web and as MCP App.

summary: On-device background remover that keeps photos local and uses AI to pick subjects.
readme_summary: Browser WebGPU matting runs fully on-device with no upload, working offline. SAM 3.1 segments the named subject into selectable layers for cloud reasoning. Muse models provide the understanding layer while pixels stay local.

summary: Training simulator for a 12-hour hospital night shift on synthetic patients
readme_summary: Patient Twin lets trainees manage one synthetic admission with history-taking, labs, orders and handoff. Single-screen app with live video-call patient and typing option. Built for the hackathon to practice diagnostic workflow, not for clinical use.

summary: Turns a spare phone into an on-device guardian for baby, pet, and elder care.
readme_summary: Repurposes spare phone for on-device watching with Baby, Pet, and Older-adult modes and watch zones. Sends alerts only when needed with live family view. Built for Startup track using Muse models for on-device detection.

summary: Safety gate that blocks expired APIs and creates auditable repairs for coding agents.
readme_summary: Version-aware safety gate that detects deprecated API usage and produces an auditable repair workflow. Offline Python demo with pytest fixtures, benchmark suite, and audit probes; no live model call in public release.

summary: Reads job notices, checks eligibility and autofills forms and photo requirements
readme_summary: Parses PDF and photo notices to show key facts, fake-check and page-grounded answers. Checks profile eligibility, resizes photos and autofills forms via browser extension and Telegram. Full-stack app with backend and extension.

summary: Neo4j knowledge graph tracking truths, justifications, and provenance
readme_summary: Noesis stores organizational beliefs with premises, attacks, defends, and source lineage in Neo4j. Users query, map-browse, and submit first-class corrections that update canonical truth. Python agent with Docker, benchmarks, and corpus tooling.

summary: Reads multilingual survey comments locally to flag themes and urgent risks
readme_summary: Reads open-text engagement comments in Arabic, Urdu, Hindi and English. Tags theme, sentiment and urgency, routing sensitive reports to human review. Runs locally on Muse Glimmer/Llama via Ollama, or Muse Spark via Meta API.

summary: Address-based editable building twin for hazard response evidence gaps
readme_summary: Starts from address to fetch aerial imagery and building outlines into editable 2D/3D twin. Explores hazard response evidence needs. Stack is Node 24+ SQLite, Python importer, WebGL with 2D fallback, local runtime on port 4173.

summary: Address-based editable building twin for hazard response evidence gaps
readme_summary: Starts from address to fetch aerial imagery and building outlines into editable 2D/3D twin. Explores hazard response evidence needs. Stack is Node 24+ SQLite, Python importer, WebGL with 2D fallback, local runtime on port 4173.

summary: Bilingual story game about Taiwan family policy and photo framing
readme_summary: Baby Bust is a short bilingual browser story game where you run social media for a government office and publish only half a photo yearly 2018-2026. Static HTML/JS with Meta Muse models used in development, mobile-friendly with demo video.

summary: Ask questions of a simulated SMT2020 wafer fab with verifiable answers
readme_summary: Simulated wafer fab Q&A on the SMT2020 testbed with 1043 machines and long routes. Rust workspace with agent, crates, Lean proofs and golden tests. Uses Muse models for fab reasoning and ElevenLabs for voice narration.

summary: Ledger where agent claims count only after database readback confirms them.
readme_summary: Deed is a double-entry pattern for store ordering agents via WhatsApp text, photo lists and voice notes. Meta models parse orders and plan steps, code validates proposals, and every line is read back and confirmed before messaging. All events stored idempotently with auditable temporal memory.

summary: Verifies AI pull requests by reproducing tests in isolated Docker runs
readme_summary: Muse Spark writes tests that must pass on base code, runs them 3x on base and patch in no-network Docker, Muse Wonder cross-checks, then code emits PASS/REVIEW/BLOCK. GitHub Action with replayable evidence.

summary: iPhone hydration tracker that predicts daily water needs from activity.
readme_summary: iOS wellness prototype with offline Core ML DINOv2 Small beverage classifier plus Apple Vision OCR. Backend adds forecasting and adaptive learning. User confirms goals and logs; photos not retained.

summary: Mixed-reality Quest 3 assistant that sees space and places 3D content.
readme_summary: Unity headset app with PC backend holding API keys for agent logic. Uses Meta XR All-in-One SDK, MR Utility Kit and Passthrough Camera for voice-driven scene interaction.

summary: Claude Code hook that blocks prompt injections hidden in repos
readme_summary: Scans repos pre-prompt and files on open, decoding hidden Unicode, then allows, asks or blocks tool calls. Python hook for Claude Code with pytest suite; explains verdicts in plain English using Meta AI models.

summary: Turns YouTube tutorials into hands-on Excel lessons checked by fixed rules.
readme_summary: Mentora generates lessons via Muse Spark from CC tutorials or one trainer demo, then guides in real Excel with deterministic cell checks. Stack is Python app with Excel probes, extensions and pytest.

summary: Scores first-person hand clips for how well robots can copy the grasp
readme_summary: Cuts egocentric video at touch moment and scores 0-100 for robot copyability. SAM 3.1 tracks hands/objects, Muse Spark grades checklist, logistic regression outputs score. Validated on 1426 clips with tactile and mocap ground truth.

summary: Android app for building first AI agents on Muse models with interactive lessons.
readme_summary: AI Open Pocket is an Android Kotlin/Jetpack Compose platform to learn and build Muse-powered agents on-phone. Includes lessons, agent builder and over-the-air screens. Uses Muse Spark, Image and SAM for chat, generation and vision tasks.

summary: Local workspace where Muse reviews PRs and proves fixes with evidence
readme_summary: Connects GitHub to review PRs, suggest repairs and show test evidence with receipts in local workspace. Built with Meta Muse; includes checkout repair demo and issue-to-draft workflow on test repos.

summary: Tap yourself once to get vertical personal highlights from amateur volleyball video
readme_summary: Mobile web app for Baegugu community. One tap tracks player, crops 9:16 follow-cam, blurs faces and adds commentary subtitles. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 for detection, tracking and rally clipping.

summary: Private on-device day memory from watch audio you can question later
readme_summary: Echo captures watch conversations, transcribes and searches on iPhone for weeks. Native SwiftUI iOS and watchOS app with widgets and 571 unit tests. Uses on-device speech first, calling Muse Spark only for rare synthesis questions.

summary: Verifiable comparator that explains Chilean isapre health plan coverage
readme_summary: ALMA Match parses isapre contract PDFs to compare coverage, caps, networks and prices. Backend in Python with frontend and GitHub Actions verification pipeline. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via meta_client.py to extract structured data with page citations.

summary: SAP assistant from functional spec to verified ABAP code and handover docs
readme_summary: Reads FS Word/PDF/Excel, checks design against DDIC, reviews ABAP and web code with verified fixes. Built on Meta Muse Spark with masking and static analysis. Generates TS, UTP and handover docs.

summary: Long-term personal knowledge graph shared across AI tools that recalls for you
readme_summary: Stores files, notes and conversations, consolidates them into a knowledge graph during sleep cycles, and recalls via hybrid vector plus full-text search. Stack includes MCP server with 6 tools, embeddings, and web graph UI. Uses Muse Spark for extraction.

summary: Research agent that tests hypotheses and logs what was actually verified.
readme_summary: Autonomous Discovery Lab investigates questions, proposes testable hypotheses, challenges reasoning and keeps auditable evidence reports. Python runtime with config, scripts and tests supporting live Meta API or offline rehearsal. Uses configured Meta models for live research inference.

summary: Generates small shareable synthetic datasets grounded in real records
readme_summary: Takes real exports like HyLogger logs, validates fit and synthesizes task-specific sets. Python engine with catalogue, profiles and tests. Uses Muse to preserve patterns and flag invented fields.

summary: Review-first desk tracking rule changes with quotes, diffs and checklists
readme_summary: Local evidence desk with immutable snapshots, exact-quote claims, rule diffs and readiness checklists. Stack is Python stdlib only with local server and fixtures. Uses one recorded MuseSpark 1.3 pilot output for synthetic review without live calls.

summary: Visualizes systems built by AI agents and preserves their knowledge
readme_summary: Local-first TypeScript platform that maps what AI agents build and retains their context across sessions. Provides CLI, integrations, docs and examples with 317 tests. Built with Meta Muse for agent observability and knowledge persistence.

summary: Voice-first memoir app that turns spoken stories and photos into keepsake chapters
readme_summary: Accessibility-first storytelling companion: talk, transcribe, then arrange into reviewable keepsake chapters. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for conversation, Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image for photos.

summary: AI engineer that tests a customer's support AI against their policies before launch
readme_summary: Grapim maps customer data, drafts integrations, and builds test sets from past cases with engineer approval at each step. Its risk scan uses Muse Spark 1.3 to extract policy rules and generate breaking customer messages.

summary: Live agent newsroom that transcribes video and verifies claims with proof.
readme_summary: Atlas Live transcribes video, extracts checkable claims, and investigates them with parallel agents and deterministic checks. Python with MCP server, live client, and eval harness. Uses Muse agents for investigation with abstention when evidence is missing.

summary: Turns lecture board writing and speech into study notes with board work
readme_summary: Phone watches lecture-hall board to generate study notes minutes after class for students needing note-taking support. Plugs into hosted Cadenza service; includes app, iOS, Supabase backend and PDF export. Uses board vision and transcripts, not just audio.

summary: Creates personalized illustrated Social Stories for autistic children
readme_summary: Parent app collects child profile and photos to generate Carol Gray-compliant stories; child app offers calm read-along with tap help. Monorepo with apps, docs, Docker compose. Deployed at play and app subdomains.

summary: Configurable multi-agent research team with reviews and evaluation
readme_summary: ResearchSquad defines reusable agents via JSON/Markdown roles, tools and host-managed review. The LeNet branch replays 1988 Bell Labs research via Muse Spark agents and sandboxed training.

summary: Turns plain-English rules into camera checks that answer Yes, No or Can't tell.
readme_summary: SecondShift lets users upload video or go live, with Meta models analyzing against natural-language rules with visual proof. Python backend plus frontend, with offline demo replay and live mode via META_API_KEY.

summary: AI employee team that takes goals by voice and does work in real business tools.
readme_summary: MuseAITeam lets solo founders assign goals to debating AI hires that act in Shopify, HubSpot, Slack, Notion and GitHub. Built as TypeScript monorepo during hackathon by Muse Code, using Meta models for orchestration.

summary: Autonomous micro-bakery ops agent for QRIS, sizing, and food costs
readme_summary: Autonomous commerce agent for Banyumas warung managing QRIS payments, HPP, and kitchen ops. Modal CPU + Python stack runs SAM 2.1 for physical measurement. Uses Meta open-weights and Meta AI tooling for vision and ops.

summary: Voice-first 3D home assistant for timers, search, and smart devices
readme_summary: Screen-based 3D robot listens for wake word, supports barge-in, speaks responses, and executes routines like lights, oven, and Spotify. Node.js app with deploy and docs setup. Built on Meta Muse models for conversation, memory, and tool actions.

summary: Self-defending digital twin that attacks itself to prove resilience
readme_summary: Autonomous cyber defense validation platform that simulates attacks against a digital twin and tests defenses. Moves from alert detection to provable resilience evidence. Powered by Meta Muse Spark with backend and docs architecture.

summary: Pools laptop GPUs into one local runtime for Llama inference
readme_summary: HyperPod discovers laptops on a trusted network, measures free VRAM, and shards Meta Llama models across CUDA and Metal via llama.cpp RPC. Controller rebuilds pipeline on worker dropout with observable placement.

summary: Agent swarm that triages incidents and drafts emergency response plans.
readme_summary: Human-led swarm triages reports and a solver plans crews and routes for city emergencies. Python engine with scenario configs, demo flood in Richmond VA. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and Muse Wonder.

summary: Turns Canvas assignments into start-ready prep cards with reminders and replanning
readme_summary: Converts Canvas assignments into prep cards with first step and risk warnings, plus start-time pings and auto replanning. Stack is FastAPI backend with Canvas sync and web UI. Uses Meta AI models to generate cards and practice sets from graded tests.

summary: Two limited robots team up to play cards guided by AI that sees the table
readme_summary: Embodied card-game demo pairing CoreXY suction crane with wheeled Esper flipper robot under shared perception. Raspberry Pi hub exposes guide, cameras, speaker and API. Uses vision AI to see cards and coordinate complementary pick, place and flip actions.

summary: AI-assisted storyboards, talking-head editing and vertical video exports
readme_summary: Paper Studio is a Next.js App Router app for storyboards and video editing with Remotion exports. It uses FFmpeg, Python faster-whisper transcription and ONNX/Transformers. External model APIs provide AI features via Docker deployment.

summary: AR walking guide that draws arrows only when geometry is verified and speaks doubts
readme_summary: Last-meter visual navigation where a walker records a path and a visitor follows AR arrows with per-frame gates. Monorepo with camera capture, metric localizer, AR runtime and replay playground. Uses Muse Spark for signage reading and SAM 3.1 for door segmentation with logged receipts.

summary: Replays lectures beside a clean board that redraws handwriting in sync with voice
readme_summary: Uploads recorded lectures and shows original video beside a clean board redrawing strokes synced to voice. Stack is Python pipeline with web viewer and tests. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe and MMS.

summary: Hands-free voice agent that controls any Android app with step verification
readme_summary: Voice-controlled Android agent with wake-word listening and floating avatar. Plans with Muse Spark 1.3 computer tool over screenshots, acts via adb, verifies before/after and confirms irreversible actions. Supports Spanish, English, Portuguese.

summary: Shared cross-continent kitchen game where kids feed monsters and build burgers
readme_summary: Browser cooking game for video-call play with monsters and ingredient voice prompts. Built with game, infra and tools directories. Uses Meta AI for characters, art and voice to practice memory.

summary: Mac voice assistant that plans builds and guides welding step by step
readme_summary: Hey Muse is a macOS Electron app where users describe a project and get a guided voice-led build plan. Built with Electron Vite, TypeScript, 3D models and evals. Uses Muse API for planning, voice interaction, instruction highlighting and task checkoff.

summary: Self-tuning loop making Muse Glimmer 30B faster on M5 Max via Metal kernels
readme_summary: Measures Muse Glimmer 30B 4-bit on Mac Studio M5 Max via MLX and adds exact prompt-lookup decoding. Implements H8 sliding-window fix and H9 attention-kernel fix with replicated benchmarks. Reports +17% coding and 1.15x Spec-Bench gains.

summary: Browser horror walk through a generated Taiwanese school that mutates
readme_summary: Last One Out is a 5-minute bilingual 3D horror walk generated entirely by Meta models. Photos, mutations and scares render in browser with no install. Voice input at finale via microphone.

summary: Muse-guided workflow that proposes, benchmarks, and evidences Triton GPU kernels.
readme_summary: Connects Muse proposal and critique to reviewed Triton kernels with human approval and real GPU measurements. Uses paired benchmarking, evidence checks and portable bundles with dashboard replays.

summary: Browser bouldering coach giving move-by-move video analysis like chess.com
readme_summary: Upload boulder attempt for in-browser skeleton detection, hold targeting and annotated playback. React TypeScript Vite frontend with coaching panel and metrics. Uses vision pose models plus Meta AI for coaching feedback.

summary: Evidence-backed code review grounded in team standards and task context
readme_summary: Open-source PR review service with bounded investigation and evidence-backed findings plus human clarification flow. Built with Docker, Uvicorn and durable state, using Meta models via provider interface and ClickUp reads via MCP.

summary: Photo-to-listing commerce studio creating trilingual WhatsApp ads for vendors
readme_summary: For Rwandan micro-merchants, photo and voice input becomes priced Kinyarwanda-English-French WhatsApp listing pinned on map. SAM 3.1 segments product, Muse Wonder extracts title and price, Muse Image enhances photo, Muse Spark writes copy.

summary: Evidence-checked agent team that diagnoses Kubernetes incidents and gates fixes
readme_summary: IncidentLens investigates Spring Boot on Kubernetes by fusing logs, traces, state, code and changes into a verified root cause. Built with Node and Python core, Muse Wonder agents provide reasoning with quote verification, isolated patch testing and governance gates.

summary: Privacy-preserving check if an edited photo shares viewpoint geometry with a registered photo.
readme_summary: Registers background geometry from a photo and compares viewpoint alignment without exposing people in images. Frontend plus Python backend with masking and geometry analysis. Uses SAM 3.1 for person masking and Meta models for assisted mapping.

summary: Walkthrough video becomes a priced room-by-room inventory catalog
readme_summary: Android, web, and CLI share templates to catalog items from a slow walkthrough video with photo, count, and value. Tested on Galaxy S22 with live Meta API. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark for ID/pricing, and Meta speech for narration.

summary: AI customs broker that turns shipping docs into proven SAD declarations
readme_summary: AI customs-broker agent for West Africa that reads invoices, packing lists and bills of lading to produce SAD/IM4 declarations with page-level citations, cross-checks, HS codes and duty estimates. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for stamp checks via Meta Model API.

summary: Live Q&A cue cards for presenters on Ray-Ban Display glasses
readme_summary: Predicts audience questions from slides and papers, then shows checked answer cards on glasses. Stack is Python hub + HUD web app for Ray-Ban simulator. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe for retrieval.

summary: Property maintenance complaints turned into staff actions with approval.
readme_summary: Parses natural-language maintenance complaints, pulls property records, checks history and drafts requests and tenant replies. Next.js + Tailwind app with authorized tools and human approval gate. Uses Meta AI / Muse for classification and structured JSON extraction.

summary: Turns text or diagrams into runnable self-repairing visual workflows
readme_summary: Metaflow generates visual workflows from descriptions or diagrams, fills steps and mappings, runs them on canvas and suggests repairs for failures. Full-stack app with Docker frontend/backend that uses Muse AI for building and healing.

summary: Reads government solicitations to recommend bid, no-bid, or review
readme_summary: FastAPI service ingests RFP text, PDF or SAM.gov ID, tags bid-critical sections and checks past performance. Rule plus Muse Spark agent via Meta Model API streams verdict with token guard. Includes firm profiles and live agent console demo.

summary: Upload document photos to redact signatures, stamps and IDs and extract clean text.
readme_summary: Cleans photos of IDs, forms and slips by segmenting sensitive regions with SAM 3.1. FastAPI backend uses Muse to transcribe, proofread and extract fields with PII detection. Next.js frontend offers one-click share-safe copy.

summary: AI sales crew that finds leads, sends outreach, answers DMs and books meetings
readme_summary: Multi-tenant Next.js app for small businesses with Inbox, Leads, Engage, Bookings and Website Builder. Connects WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram plus Meta CAPI. Uses Meta AI for prospecting, outreach writing, voice calls and DM automation.

summary: Youth basketball league ops with scheduling, scores and standings
readme_summary: League operations platform for team registration, court scheduling, scoresheet extraction review, standings and Elo. Next.js TypeScript Tailwind with Supabase Postgres Auth and Storage. Uses operations agent for evidence-based proposals.

summary: Creator campaign workspace for evidence-backed drafts and version-bound approvals.
readme_summary: Find, Check, and Track stages take creator campaigns from brief to accountable decision. Built with apps/services frontend plus API and Supabase Auth/storage. Uses Muse models for curated discovery and findings review with exact version tied approvals.

summary: Virtual electronics bench for practicing circuit diagnosis on simulated faulty boards
readme_summary: Hardware-free lab with deterministic MNA solver, hidden fault injection and virtual multimeter on three boards. Provides datasheet-grounded AI diagnosis, scoring against withheld ground truth. Includes autonomy benchmark docs and web workbench UI.

summary: Voice-guided phone physics lab that measures motion and writes LaTeX reports.
readme_summary: Records ramp and free-fall experiments, tracks objects with Meta vision models to compute acceleration and error plots. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark as lab partner with Next.js and API backend.

summary: Digital twin platform that debates decisions from parallel perspectives
readme_summary: Takes one versioned identity snapshot and runs parallel agents to compare decisions with evidence scores. Next.js UI + Python API with Twin Council, calendar voice agent, and local talking avatar pipeline. Uses Muse models for reasoning and voice interaction.

summary: Coordinates coding agents to prevent breaking shared TypeScript code
readme_summary: Hive hub checks multiple agents' in-progress changes with TypeScript compiler and rules. Uses versioned Ghost Contracts for shared interfaces verified by real tests. CLI plus dashboard join via invite link.

summary: Voice-and-text shop assistant that records sales and answers from real records
readme_summary: Voice-and-text operations assistant for small businesses that interprets sales, stock and expenses into validated backend tools. Full-stack with real PostgreSQL, audit trail and reports. Uses LLM tool-calling over shop records.

summary: Reproduces Nav2 navigation failures in simulation and verifies AI-proposed fixes.
readme_summary: Replays Nav2 failures in Gazebo, lets an agent propose config fixes, then requires repeated successful runs. ROS 2 Jazzy, Nav2 and TurtleBot 3 experiment harness. Uses Muse Wonder 1.0 for reasoning and Muse Code for experiment code.

summary: Records verifiable product evidence and offline buyer-seller handovers
readme_summary: Next.js monorepo with accounts, backend and verification contracts for product drafts, identifiers and evidence. Provides signed records, DB authorization and offline verification plus TypeScript SDK. Sample products are synthetic; matching records do not prove authenticity.

summary: Audits Python upgrades and behavior-tests AI-proposed fixes before trusting them
readme_summary: CLI that lists code lines broken by dependency upgrades and validates agent fixes against old library behavior. Agent runs on Muse Spark Open via Baseten with code deciding safety. Includes tests, eval results, and no-API-key audit mode.

summary: On-device model learns parent daily rhythm and flags changes calmly
readme_summary: Android Kotlin/Compose apps run small ExecuTorch rhythm model on parent phone for privacy. Family sees calm daily view and change alerts. Includes model/dataset cards, landing site and Muse Spark explanations.

summary: Estimates river discharge with uncertainty bounds from drone video.
readme_summary: RiverEye estimates streamflow in m3/s from nadir drone video with stated range or refusal. Prototype requires surveyed cross-section and GCPs, tested on flooded rivers. Uses SAM 3.1 to find water and track drifters.

summary: Team of bots with Linux computers builds tasks with code-verified results
readme_summary: Open-source AI workspace that turns a sentence into a checked result. Spawns specialized bots with own Linux computers, acquires runtime tools and shapes workspace. Independent code verification required; built on Muse Spark with Docker.

summary: Terminal coding agent that plans, builds and verifies code before marking done
readme_summary: Buzzard Code is a Python terminal agent with plan-build-verify-secure loop and browser tooling. Core CLI, agent runtime and benchmarks enforce code-decided completion with tests and proofs. Runs on Muse Glimmer via Meta Model API.

summary: Live meeting listener that draws an illustrated flow board with gaps and conflicts
readme_summary: Listens to live meeting audio, transcribes speech and builds a visual Flow Map of decisions and flows. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for STT, Muse Spark agent for reasoning and gap detection, plus Muse Image and Muse Wonder for illustrations. Frontend board with backend pipeline for realtime updates.

summary: Six AI agents act as virtual departments for inventory, finance, HR and contracts
readme_summary: Beezy coordinates six specialist agents plus an Executive Assistant for SMB operations. Built with Python backend and Next.js frontend via Docker, it uses Muse Spark 1.3 for tool-calling and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 for voice commands.

summary: Turns build ideas into verified tool plans with paste-ready prompts and live runs
readme_summary: Pathwise AI interviews users to lock a product brief, selects verified tools from a curated catalog, and generates sequenced plans. All LLM calls go through Meta Model API on muse-spark-1.3 with json_schema structured output, with live step execution in-app.

summary: Compares model API behavior to spot stealth models without claiming identity.
readme_summary: model-fingerprint compares capability metadata, prompt-token counts, and tool-choice acceptance across endpoints including Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder. Python 3.11 stdlib-only CLI outputs reproducible JSON evidence. Reports observations only, no auto-attribution.

summary: Arabic-first agent turning answers and certificate photos into university application packs
readme_summary: Turns student answers and certificate photos into a checkable university application pack for counsellor review. Built with Next.js, Meta models for Arabic extraction and eligibility checks. Live product with class mode and fictional demo data.

summary: Compares migrated and legacy app screens to write evidence-linked reports
readme_summary: Captures both legacy and migrated screens on open and save, reads them with Muse Spark and compares field-by-field under fixed rules. Outputs acta reports with screenshot-linked values as static site. No build, HTML viewer.

summary: Translates between Colombian Sign Language and Spanish with 3D avatar and camera
readme_summary: Web prototype with 33 animated expressions and local camera recognition for 11 signs. Spanish-to-sign uses Muse Spark to map intent to catalog, sign-to-Spanish proposes text. Includes backend-meta, web-meta and validation docs.

summary: Turns car photos into 360 spins, 3D walkarounds, commercials and listings
readme_summary: Windows desktop app that runs the full pipeline locally from walk-around photos to publish-ready listing. Generates 360 spin, Gaussian-splat 3D, video commercial and copy. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Spark.

summary: Turns architecture diagrams into reviewed risks and validated AWS Terraform
readme_summary: Upload an architecture image to extract components and connections via Meta Model API. Users correct observations, review risks and approve an AWS ALB/ASG/RDS baseline. It outputs traceable Terraform with isolated validation report.

summary: Quietly verifies family safety during virtual-kidnapping extortion calls
readme_summary: Detects extortion-call stages in Mexican Spanish and confirms loved-one safety while advising when to hang up. Next.js app with live and guided demo modes deployed on Render for hackathon demo.

summary: WhatsApp sales agent that takes orders, quotes delivery, and checks receipts.
readme_summary: WhatsApp agent for Lagos sellers handling text, voice notes, and photos for ordering and receipt verification. Built with C#/.NET, Microsoft Agent Framework, REST API plus SignalR React dashboard. Uses Meta Muse models for conversation and vision.

summary: Sandbox turning science questions into equations, proofs, CAD and C code
readme_summary: Multi-scale differentiable physics sandbox that infers governing equations and control strategies from text or sensor CSV. Python package with docs and tests. Built for Push the Frontier using Meta models for discovery.

summary: WhatsApp back-office agent that updates SME stock, sales and orders
readme_summary: Socio is a WhatsApp-native agent for SMEs that converts audio, photo or text into ERP updates via connectors with human approval. Built with Next.js, TypeScript and Vitest. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, Muse Voice Transcribe for audio, and SAM 3.1 for image parsing.

summary: Agent that traces UI bug screenshots to code causes with test-verified evidence
readme_summary: Upload a broken UI screenshot, logs and repo path to rank code hypotheses with supporting and contradicting evidence. Verifies top hypothesis with real tests and proposes fix plus regression test, abstaining when inconclusive.

summary: Personalized homework that adapts to level with red-pen marking and tracking.
readme_summary: Apni Gati assigns level-fit homework, auto-marks with red-pen feedback and tracks progress. FastAPI backend plus web frontend with eval suite for grading and safety. Uses Meta Model API for generation and grading.

summary: Swift Metal LLM inference engine for Apple silicon with exact caching
readme_summary: Ingot serves MLX safetensors checkpoints via OpenAI-compatible chat API with no MLX/Python at runtime. Hand-written Metal kernels, DFlash2 speculative decoding and exact prefix cache. No Meta Muse dependency; infra for local model serving.

summary: Agent that learns executable skills by testing methods in app copies
readme_summary: Apprentice acquires skills, tests competing methods in copies of real apps, and commits verified work with versioned drafts and evals. Node.js agent with docs and catering demo. Uses Meta models for adaptive compilation and policy-first reviews.

summary: Evidence workspace tracking commitments and impact of scope changes
readme_summary: Accord is evidence-backed workspace distinguishing requests from agreements, tracking conflicts and change impact. Vanilla JS frontend with serverless API, deployed on Vercel. Uses Meta AI for commitment analysis per API setup.

summary: Nonprofit anti-censorship VPN for monitored networks on all platforms
readme_summary: Flutter VPN shipping to Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux and browser extensions with Winn Protocol v3 transport. Full source at 1.0.17+34. Audited and built with Muse Wonder Full for vulnerability fixes.

summary: AI operating system for one-person real estate business with approval gates
readme_summary: Owner-directed AI business OS where Meta Muse Spark proposes plans, uses permitted tools, and pauses for approval. Stack is dashboard frontend, Python backend, Supabase persistence with CRM for leads, properties, appointments and bounded recovery.

summary: Edit Instagram Reels with voice commands into frame-accurate effects
readme_summary: SayCut turns typed or spoken commands into frame-accurate video edits like blur, glow and restyle. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for video understanding and edit plans, SAM 3.1 for segmentation tracking, plus Muse Image and Voice Transcribe. Stack includes FastAPI backend and web frontend with live demo.

summary: Predicts California bills passage odds with transparent legislator scorecards
readme_summary: Rebuilds California Legislature bulk data since 2007 into bill odds and member scorecards. Python pipeline with Supabase and searchable static dashboard. Statistical counting rules with weekly refresh; no explicit Muse use stated.

summary: Tests building facade segmentation and inspection checklist judging
readme_summary: Neev harness validates SAM 3.1 building segmentation and Muse Wonder checklist judging with repeatable evals. Standard-library Python pipeline plus thin local file-based inspection web app.

summary: Calm-rules second brain supporting autistic adults and dementia care
readme_summary: Notices overload, speaks when words shut off, logs events and alerts trusted people using pre-set calm rules. Built with heart-rate watch, Home Assistant wiring and daily-living support with no medical advice.

summary: GLP-1 companion tracking weight, shots and photo meals by injection cycle
readme_summary: Weekly-shot companion for Mounjaro and Wegovy with weight, shots, meal and exercise logging. Plate Lens compares before/after photos around injection cycle. Uses Muse Spark for coaching and SAM 3.1 for meal vision.

summary: Turns phone photos of broken parts into printable editable 3D models.
readme_summary: iOS capture on A4 paper provides scale, SAM 3.1 extracts dimensions and a Muse Spark agent writes parametric OpenSCAD. Output is STL plus editable source. Stack is Python FastAPI service with Docker and tests.

summary: Turn selfies into a personalized Japanese-style manga series with friends
readme_summary: Turns selfies and scenario cards into multi-chapter manga with covers and community feed. Next.js app with table-code multiplayer. Uses Muse Spark for character design, Muse Wonder for storyboard JSON, Muse Image for pages.

summary: Lists live-sale items to WooCommerce and sends pay links on sold comments
readme_summary: Hold item up and speak to list it in WooCommerce, viewer comments sold triggers private pay link in a second. Handles last-unit race, unpaid holds, bundled checkout. Node stack with Meta Live and WooCommerce APIs. Uses Meta AI for listing from live video and speech.

summary: Read-only TypeScript inspector with evidence-linked architecture and security findings
readme_summary: Provides read-only TS/TSX inspection with an architecture graph and conservative, evidence-linked security findings. Built with TypeScript and web UI with tests and docs. Uses Meta Muse to explain selected findings, with synthetic safer-pattern examples clearly labeled.

summary: Persona social network where humans write and owned personas give voice
readme_summary: Retains full Slopbook app with persona editor, Sigils, voice settings and social workflows plus Moltbook feed. Muse edition adds new composer integration and demo walkthrough. Clojure backend with JS frontend, Docker compose and CI verified.

summary: Grounds payment dispute notices into evidence-bound operator recommendations
readme_summary: Synthetic notice image enters LangGraph workflow for extraction, ledger matching, policy check and verification. FastAPI backend plus Node frontend shows evidence-bound reply for approve/reject. No payment executed; offline mock mode supported.

summary: Models infrastructure cascading failures for emergency planners and cities.
readme_summary: SENTRIX is an infrastructure resilience platform for emergency centers and planners. It models how incidents cascade across transport and lifelines. Uses FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, and Muse Spark for multimodal AI-assisted analysis.

summary: Traces AWS Lambda owners from identity, Terraform, Git and trails
readme_summary: GroundTruth is local-first read-only AWS lineage investigator correlating IAM, Terraform, VCS, Git, CloudTrail and CloudWatch. Deterministic engine sets status; Muse Spark only explains evidence. Built with Streamlit, Docker, and auditable coverage gaps.

summary: Turns PDF scans into editable exams with diagnostics and hosted tests
readme_summary: PaperBridge digitizes uploaded PDFs/photos into editable questions, diagram crops, and digital papers plus OMR review. Uses Node 24 and Python 3.12 stack with Meta API for live extraction. Requires MODEL_API_KEY; no offline answer path.

summary: Camera coach that teaches life skills stepwise and logs IEP-ready progress data
readme_summary: Show Me Once breaks life skills into steps, coaches special-education students via camera, and records prompting levels for teachers. Built in Python with live agents for watch, clarify, and marking. Uses Meta models for step-by-step visual guidance and data-sheet generation.

summary: Multimodal workspace that answers questions across docs with citations
readme_summary: Upload PDFs, Word, code, sheets, images, and links, ask across them with cited answers and knowledge graph. FastAPI + LangGraph + PostgreSQL pgvector with hybrid BM25 search. Uses agentic LLM workflows for RAG.

summary: Counterfactual verifier that tests if robot world models hold after edits.
readme_summary: Loads object scenes or SAM 3.1 segmented images, then intervenes by moving or removing objects. Runs deterministic physics and support checks with human approval gate. Replayable proofs for embodied AI verification, Vercel demo.

summary: Offline-first crop advice hub for farmers with leaf photos and cited guides
readme_summary: Village hub serves browser UI over local Wi-Fi using FAO guides with Muse Glimmer locally. Unsure cases are de-identified and queued to Muse Spark cloud; SAM 3.1 segments leaf damage. Reports 82.8% on 87 questions with ~half cloud cost.

summary: Student proof workspace with Lean 4 verification
readme_summary: Proof Atelier is a student proof workspace with dependency-aware Lean 4 verification, Docker setup and benchmarks. Public snapshot includes pinned deps, tests and evidence report. Uses recorded Lean checks with live Meta evaluation pending.

summary: Interactive Earth observatory showing decades of environmental change
readme_summary: Interactive observatory turning satellite imagery into measurable water, greening, forest, ground and coastal histories. Lets users select area and time, compare observations, inspect masks and export evidence. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 and Muse Wonder with real satellite data.

summary: Finds offline local businesses and auto-builds websites, ads and outreach
readme_summary: UpTru 2.0 scans open map data for weak online presence, verifies leads and generates sites, ad mockups and PDF reports. Python core with Reflex dashboard uses Muse Spark, Image and Voice Transcribe.

summary: 3D heritage map of shoe factories with a source-grounded ask agent.
readme_summary: 3D map of Northampton shoe factories carrying sourced facts plus consented community memories. Ask agent on Muse Spark Open answers from sources, flies to building and shows card. Built with web 3D engine, tour and editor tools.

summary: Real-time 3D video-call companion that sees, remembers and coaches
readme_summary: Luvoia is a living real-time 3D companion for video calls with memory and daily coaching. Stack is Next.js 16 TypeScript, LiveKit for realtime, and Supabase RLS. Uses Meta Model API for conversational vision and memory.

summary: Contractor closeout workspace requiring evidence and approval
readme_summary: Local closeout workspace for fictional dealership with persistence, revision guards and import/export. Demo uses explicit offline mock. Verified Muse Spark 1.3 structured responses with documented timeout limitation.

summary: Muse-assisted POS for cafes with photo onboarding and sales reports
readme_summary: Counter-business POS where Muse Spark suggests product names from photos for merchant approval. Adds cash checkout, kitchen tickets, Muse-explained Sense reports grounded in POS records, and manual-grounded Ask help with approved actions.

summary: Voice-first smart-glasses companion describing surroundings for blind users.
readme_summary: DrishtiLink takes Hindi/English/Hinglish voice in and audio out to describe scenes, read text, guide walks and escalate SOS. Stack is React 19, Node TypeScript and Socket.IO with live family dashboard. Uses Meta AI voice and Muse chat models.

summary: Explains crypto market mood in plain language without buy or sell advice.
readme_summary: Public chat where users ask about coins or comparisons and get mood, bull/bear case and watch-points. Includes Simulation Lab and Anomaly Library with public method card. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API, Cloudflare Workers and Firebase.

summary: Construction safety chat with incident recall and work-plan checks
readme_summary: Safety Advisor provides chat answers, incident recall, work-plan extraction, and document canvas for field safety. Hackathon code adds Meta-model features atop pre-existing private app. Stack includes backend, frontend, Supabase, and fixtures.

summary: Fully local browser work agent with on-device vision grounding
readme_summary: Muse Glimmer 30B reads screenshots into grounding notes, local Qwen planner decides, all on Apple silicon via Ollama. Approval gates, call logs, 82/90 vs 80/90 on 45-task bench.

summary: Replayable workspace for gated live discovery of local needs
readme_summary: NeedTrail provides a replay workspace and gated live discovery built story-by-story over 60+ PRs. It uses API, web, worker, and contracts with Docker Compose for acceptance and live releases. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for discovery assistance and replay analysis.

summary: Shareable AI contacts with faces, memory, and group chat presence
readme_summary: Wildcard creates persistent AI contacts with personality and memory for 1:1 help and group chats. Shareable contacts that can text first. Web app on Cloudflare Workers with docs and self-host support.

summary: Robot task studio where plain-language fixes become testable scoped rules.
readme_summary: MIRROR is a MuJoCo-based authoring and testing studio for robot tasks with demonstrate, inspect and correct loop. Corrections become one-rule changes re-judged on old logs and tested on new layouts, refusing with proof if blocked. Shows verified results on blocked cup-tilt layouts.

summary: Edge vision fall-candidate awareness for caregivers with human-supervised review
readme_summary: Hackathon MVP for non-clinical incident awareness: video to edge fall candidate to consented keyframes to advisory. Edge plus dashboard and backend services with traceable incident management. Planned Meta-first evidence assessment, currently mock backend.

summary: Face-recognition gate check finds enrolled attendee without QR scan
readme_summary: Rust service lets gate workers verify attendees via live face match and approve entry. Uses SQLx PostgreSQL persistence, OAuth routes, and outbox with retry, backed by existing Spring Boot ticket backend, not production-ready.

summary: Splits LLM inference with server prefill and client decode for faster serving
readme_summary: Hybrid-inference is a llama.cpp fork prototyping hybrid prefill/decode inference. It adds vLLM bridge tools, native CPU reader, node protocol and bench guides. It optimizes Llama model serving across GPU server and client devices.

summary: Worker-improver loop that tunes harnesses for smaller models.
readme_summary: LX investigates if a smaller fixed-weight model can do a task via prompt, skill, and script edits. Built on harness2-cli portable core with MCP连接 to Claude Code, Muse Code, Codex. Collects evidence per attempt to prove fit.

summary: Browser desktop OS where you and a voice agent share the same apps
readme_summary: Agentic browser OS where user and agent operate shared apps via structured state, not screenshots. Voice or text input produces timed text, speech, widgets and actions. Built with AirLib, AUI, and Meta Muse Spark 1.3 models.

summary: Overnight manager agent that acts on permission and reports evidence by morning
readme_summary: Night Shift is an overnight manager on Muse Spark that works simulated jobs, acts within permissions and wakes owner only on evidence. Recorded replays plus live answers, Docker/Fly deploy.

summary: Local-first agent that learns your voice and drafts a two-week content queue
readme_summary: Local-first agentic content creator with SQLite embedded DB and job queue on Next.js. Ingests work, learns voice, drafts queue for approval. All LLM intelligence runs on Meta Model API with locally encrypted keys.

summary: El Nino early warning for Peru tailings sites with household delivery and check-ins.
readme_summary: Willay watches Peruvian tailings and downstream communities across weeks, days and hours horizons using official ENFEN and SENAMHI data. It has FastAPI backend and web operator console with messaging delivery. It uses Meta Muse models and SAM 3.1 for risk analysis.

summary: Offline-first mentalism performance engine with plugin magic effects and state machine
readme_summary: Consent-based performance engine for digital mentalism with domain-neutral inference and visible state machine. Offline-first platform with plugin effects including The Twelve, Ember Words, and Countdown. Web app with WebGL 3D stage and flat-stage fallback, no cloud AI dependency.

summary: Generates leveled webcomics from one scene idea for A1-B2 English learners
readme_summary: 3E Studio writes level-checked stories, draws consistent-cast art, and publishes reader with TTS, tap dictionary and flashcards. Stack is Capacitor mobile + API + Baseten. Uses Meta AI for writing, level-checking, art and speech scoring.

summary: AI shopping researcher that compares source-backed products and seller offers
readme_summary: AI shopping research app where users describe needs, refine preferences and compare products. Built with React, TypeScript/Express, Zod contracts and PostgreSQL. Uses Meta Model API for chat and research with Brave search optional.

summary: Snap a sketch to get measured cut-ready designs and laser G-code
readme_summary: Katachi is a voice-first workshop buddy that turns phone photos and speech into measured parts, photoreal preview and laser G-code. Built with Supabase and mobile app stack, it uses Meta Muse vision-language and SAM for measuring and tracing.

summary: Edge YOLO tracker for two cats with Muse supervisor for uncertain cases
readme_summary: YOLO runs on Raspberry Pi camera with correctors that escalate uncertain frames. Muse Spark supervisor reviews crops and reference photos with memory. Python stack scored against hand-validated ground truth.

summary: Turns RFQs into priced, cited proposals in your winning voice
readme_summary: AI bid desk that learns win patterns from past proposals and CRM, then drafts priced, page-cited proposals requiring human approval. Monorepo with apps/packages and traced live demo. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Voice.

summary: Teach a robot arm a tabletop task by filming it just once
readme_summary: Python pipeline plus web demo that converts a single demo video into robot actions on a shuffled table. Handles perception, clarification dialogue and execution with tests and samples. Uses Meta AI vision models for video-to-task understanding.

summary: Compares mouse vs keyboard routes and exports replayable regression evidence
readme_summary: Dockerized Chromium testing tool with deterministic outcomes, saved-action replay and CI adapter for customer loopback apps. Uses fictional fixtures, no real payments. Meta connection and acceptance documented in repo.

summary: Security intelligence platform correlating microservice events to detect threats
readme_summary: Ternline combines sub-millisecond deterministic detection with evidence-grounded AI investigation and automated mitigation. It includes declarative detection rules and a web console with docs. Uses AI investigation tracks for microservices threat triage.

summary: Grounded counseling companion giving stress guidance from classical wisdom texts
readme_summary: Persona-driven agent for stress, grief and decisions grounded by RAG in authentic texts to avoid invented quotes. Python krsna_ai package with scripts and data. Uses Meta Muse/Llama open-weights via Baseten inference.

summary: Learns unknown machines, writes controllers, and auto-repairs on change
readme_summary: Runs safe experiments to author Python controllers, verifies them in sealed sandbox against hidden scenarios, then deploys under safety supervisor. Backend/frontend with simulation and TCLab heater board demo. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for experiment design and code repair.

summary: Voice assistant that operates Android apps step-by-step to complete tasks
readme_summary: JARVIS Mobile takes plain speech goals and executes them via phone tools or vision-guided UI automation. Android app with backend uses Meta Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 for verified steps. Speaks back a summary when done.

summary: Turns phone video into interactive Gaussian splat with physics and lessons
readme_summary: Reconstructs tabletop phone video to Gaussian splat via external ThriftSplat, then detects table plane and segments objects with SAM 3.1. Supports physics sim, Q&A, how-to lessons and grasp tests.

summary: Turns any photo into playable spot-the-difference levels with verified masks.
readme_summary: VisualForge forges realistic localized differences from any image with exact boxes and masks. Powers Diferia photo game, QC inspector trainer, and synthetic dataset mode. Uses Meta models for generation with Next.js browser play.

summary: Voice-controlled video editor that turns spoken instructions into verified MP4 renders.
readme_summary: ClipForge is a voice-first video studio where spoken edits are planned then rendered to real MP4. Stack is FFmpeg + OpenCV rendering with ffprobe verification and local app. Uses Meta Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark for planning.

summary: Adapts one approved creative to every placement size with protected pixels
readme_summary: Adapts a finished creative to 6-8 placement sizes in Protected or Fast modes. Uses Muse Spark for layout templates and QA checks, preserving product, logo and Hebrew text as original pixels.

summary: Private on-device archive that organizes documents photos and journals locally
readme_summary: Local-first encrypted life archive for documents, statements, journals and photos with no account or upload. Stack is local web app with parsers and analyzers. Optional deep synthesis runs on-device via Ollama, with Meta models integration.

summary: Snaps chemical labels to build hazmat inventory and fetch SDS PDFs automatically
readme_summary: Manifest0 AI photographs chemical labels room-by-room, extracts inventory, finds Safety Data Sheets on the web and emails PDFs to tech and client. TypeScript web app with live beta. Built on Muse Spark 1.3 for vision reading and inventory structuring.

summary: WhatsApp shop assistant for West African merchants to track sales and credit
readme_summary: WhatsApp-first bookkeeping bot replacing paper notebooks for small shops. FastAPI backend with Alembic and Modal, using Muse models for French multilingual chat, voice and sales ledger.

summary: Verified property registry that lets buyer agents query only proven facts
readme_summary: Aval extracts listing facts from walkthrough video with proof links and serves them via MCP gateway. Seller rules and agent identity gate access to prevent unproven claims. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Local-first firewall that detects credentials and redacts evidence for AI agents
readme_summary: Local-first AI-agent security prototype with deterministic rule-based checks, simulated action handlers, and reproducible benchmarks. Stack is local loopback API with loopback-only labs. No Meta Muse model integration stated; focused on credential detection and redaction.

summary: Rust-native canvas to run and compare 12+ AI prompt pipelines side by side
readme_summary: Native Rust egui/eframe no-code canvas for orchestrating multi-step prompt pipelines concurrently. Invokes Meta muse-spark-1.3 with non-blocking async execution and live progress. Ships as Windows executable with Cargo build.

summary: Model-independent guard that blocks prompt-injection leaks in tool-using agents.
readme_summary: Security layer for tool-using agents that scans ingested text, images and PDFs and gates tool actions. Built in Python with dual gates and tamper-evident logging. Uses Meta Muse Spark as protected agent with model-independent checks.

summary: Mobile arcade that turns photographed objects into three silly microgames
readme_summary: Static Canvas mobile arcade with six environments, offline fixtures and original OST. Server-side Meta Model API integration for object-to-game generation. Deployed as static dist to Cloudflare Pages.

summary: Rechecks coding agent claims against logs to catch false reports and risks.
readme_summary: Verifies Claude Code, Muse Code, and Codex reports against commands, edits, and infra state. Python hooks and bench with post-run cluster checks. Uses Meta Muse Spark to judge claims false on hallucinations, risky actions, and waste.

summary: Read-only app security analysis where every finding traces to code evidence.
readme_summary: Graph-first, read-only security analysis for a controlled FastAPI fixture. Builds deterministic Python code graphs with authorization context and renders them in React/Cytoscape. Uses Meta AI to generate reports constrained to cite only traced evidence IDs.

summary: Embodied VRChat agent that sees, hears, finds objects and brings them to you
readme_summary: muse-body is a VRChat embodied agent controlled via virtual Xbox gamepad and OSC. Muse Spark picks intent from first-person view, SAM 3.1 localizes target. Muse Voice Transcribe handles speech input.

summary: Autonomous agent that finds nearby deals, negotiates and checks out
readme_summary: Proximity shopping engine that finds deals within 50 metres, negotiates price, and checks out with passkey. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Node.js, MongoDB and WebAuthn. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for autonomous shopping negotiation.

summary: Daily tier ranking of frontier models with evidence and audit trail
readme_summary: Model Atlas aggregates Arena, LiveBench, Terminal-Bench and others into source-native rankings. Static dashboard with JSON/CSV outputs and methodology docs. No Meta model dependency; evaluation infra project.

summary: CI tests that fail PRs when agent prompt-injection attack success regresses
readme_summary: GitHub Action injects frozen payloads into mock Gmail/Slack/GitHub tool outputs to test target agent in sandbox. Rule and LLM judges compute ASR per scenario with dashboard badge. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 as target and judge.

summary: Scans pharmacy shelf photos to read packs, flag expiry, and draft restock orders
readme_summary: Pharmacist photographs shelf or delivery carton; SAM 3.1 segments medicine boxes then Muse Spark extracts structured data. Matches catalog, flags expired and near-expiry lots, and proposes approval-gated stock actions. Human-in-loop with audit log for low-confidence reads.

summary: Phone video to true-scale WebAR 3D model via SAM and mesh agent
readme_summary: Pipeline from 360 video to WebAR GLB/USDZ via SAM segmentation, geometry extraction and agentic watertight loop. Modal GPU + FastAPI, Baseten muse-spark-open-1026, Trimesh/Open3D agent, Vite model-viewer. Uses SAM and Muse Spark 1.3.

summary: Turns phone photos of invoices and contracts into filed work per policy
readme_summary: OpenCV finds and straightens documents, then Muse Spark Open / Glimmer extracts schema-constrained JSON fields. Written policy.yml decides what runs autonomously vs needs human approval.

summary: FPGA spiking and ternary LLM engine plus Hopper Triton kernels for AI acceleration
readme_summary: End-to-end hardware-software stack spanning Spartan-7 FPGA BitNet b1.58, INT8 systolic array and LIF SNN to H200 Triton kernels. Verilog/SystemVerilog edge designs verified against NumPy with Python tooling and Colab flow. Targets Meta Muse Spark Open via Open Kernel Challenge benchmarks.

summary: Hindi/English shop assistant that answers only from cited approved policies
readme_summary: Study-library demo assistant with deterministic seat checks, retrieval routing, citations, and human handoff. Python app with fixtures, knowledge base, and mock-to-real adapter. Uses Meta model API for Hindi/English grounded answers verified Nov 2026.

summary: Turns Excel workbooks into analytics and purchase orders
readme_summary: Parses unfamiliar Excel files, proposes mappings, coordinates sales/inventory tools. React + FastAPI + SQLite with Docker. Uses Meta Model API for proposals, Python for deterministic math.

summary: Finds fall hazards in a home walkthrough and visualizes the fixes
readme_summary: App where a 30s home video yields pixel-proven fall hazards, fixed-room previews, and re-film verification. Built with ffmpeg, HTTP/SSE frontend/backend against Meta Model API, tested offline with stubbed models.

summary: Verifies every investment memo number against filings with plugins and approvals
readme_summary: Finguard is a finance harness that checks investment memo numbers against filings. Plugins declare read/act permissions, approvals and verification. Runs on Meta Muse Spark 1.3 with Demo replay and Live modes.

summary: AR interior studio to build scenes from furniture pieces and preview in space
readme_summary: WorldOS is an AR interior studio for building scenes from 36 furniture, lighting and wall pieces. Includes mobile AR preview, workspaces, and reliability improvements. Backend plus Capacitor Android/iOS mobile app.

summary: Local autonomous F1 race strategist that simulates pit stops from timing data
readme_summary: Pulls F1 timing data, fits tyre and fuel pace model and searches one and two-stop plans for undercut threats. Planner runs on Muse Glimmer 30B locally via Ollama while hand-written engine does math. Python with tests and scripts.

summary: Snap a sick crop leaf to get diagnosis, treatment plan and nearby outbreak map.
readme_summary: Vite PWA + Cloudflare Worker + Supabase with scans and realtime outbreak signals. Worker calls Meta Model API so keys stay server-side. Uses SAM 3.1 to segment lesions and Muse Spark for diagnosis.

summary: Deterministic AI engine migrating JSP monoliths to Angular MFEs with proof
readme_summary: Tri-model AI migration engine for JSP to Angular 17.3 micro-frontends with 699/699 parity checks. Handles JSESSIONID to Bearer bridging and Maker/Checker governance. Uses Meta Llama 3/Muse endpoints with Docker demo.

summary: Muse Code plugin that enforces rules, blocks risky calls, undoes edits
readme_summary: Plugin for Muse Code that stores user rules, intercepts tool calls that violate them, cites rule dates, and reverts edits. Includes MCP server, commands, lib and eval harness. Built on muse-spark-1.3 with 27 tests and bypass matrix.

summary: Walks corridors with phone video to generate fire-safety self-inspection report
readme_summary: Upload a corridor walk video to detect fire-door, extinguisher and escape-route issues with timestamps. Pipeline plus rulesets produce manager email and uncertain-item list. Uses Meta AI vision models for inspection.

summary: Ambient desk aquarium where a duck avatar delivers messages from distant friends
readme_summary: A desk aquarium app where friends drop in asynchronously via a duck in a submarine. Uses local SAM 3.1 for face/hand presence and Meta models at runtime. Client-server with web frontend and drawings made during hackathon.

summary: Turns 2D floor-plan images into explorable 3D Three.js scenes
readme_summary: Detects walls, rooms, doors and labels from floor plans into structured scene data. Stack is Python services with Three.js browser workspace. Uses Meta SAM for segmentation and Meta media services.

summary: Go coach pairing KataGo analysis with level-aware Muse explanations
readme_summary: A Go coach that finds best moves with KataGo and HumanSL engines and explains them at the learner's level. Python stack with pre-registered evaluation and calibration runbooks. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for tutoring dialogue.

summary: Closed-loop visual QA swarm that finds UI bugs and proposes fixes
readme_summary: Autonomous visual QA engine that drives live browsers via Playwright MCP, detects UI regressions, and suggests fixes. Python + Streamlit with Pydantic v2 and SARIF gates in GitHub Actions CI. Uses SAM 3.1 for spatial vision and Muse Spark 1.3 for causal fixing.

summary: Gateway routing agent traffic to discounted tier while blocking sensitive data
readme_summary: Taint-aware proxy between coding agents and Muse API to safely use Contributor pricing. Includes gateway, dashboard, and bench analysis. Uses Muse Spark Contributor tier with taint tracking on context.

summary: Local-first security engineer that scans code, explains attack paths and proves fixes.
readme_summary: SentinelOS scans projects with security tools, uses Meta models to plan triage and draft fixes. Re-scans and re-tests to verify. FastAPI Python backend with React Vite frontend and AgentFence policy engine.

summary: Audits spreadsheets for wrong formulas and proves each error by recalculation.
readme_summary: SheetTruth detects quiet spreadsheet errors like short totals and off-by-one refs. It uses a fine-tuned open-weights model for label reading, code-based verification, second-model review, and writes fixes to a corrected workbook. Web app at sheettruth.com with full training and eval in repo.

summary: Citizen photo reports of street damage grouped into public repair tracking.
readme_summary: Civic-repairs lets Bogota citizens report damage with photo, text, and pin on web. Backend groups reports, maps agency responsibility, and requires photo proof of repair. Uses Muse Spark for interpretation and SAM 3.1 for segmentation.

summary: Blocking quality harness turning AI code into senior-level Flutter
readme_summary: Closed-loop agentic harness for Flutter/Dart with spec-driven development. Implements 13 AST rules with grade, check, init and sandbox CLI, pre-commit hooks and heal dispatcher.

summary: Satellite haze maps become plain-language vog vs smoke alerts for Hawaii districts
readme_summary: Takes GOES-18 GeoColor haze detections and explains vog vs wildfire smoke for Hawaii. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark for JSON interpretation, and Muse Image for alert cards.

summary: Two-way Indian Sign Language chat with speech and signer avatar on phone
readme_summary: ISL Bridge translates ISL signs to English/Hindi speech and spoken words back to SAM-cut signer video with captions. Recognizes 202 signs and learns user variants from 5 samples. Uses Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

summary: Local assistant that screens government solicitations and drafts tailored proposals
readme_summary: SmallBiz Rainmaker AI reviews full solicitation packages against company capabilities for bid decisions. Local-first Python system generates proposal drafts and flags items for human review. Powered by Meta Muse Spark for analysis and drafting.

summary: Hosted MCP map of merchant sites so shopping agents navigate with fewer tokens
readme_summary: AgentMap pre-crawls stores into a navigation graph of categories, search and URL templates. Serves ~250-token verified paths via MCP instead of raw browsing. Live prices re-checked; TypeScript monorepo with pnpm and Docker.

summary: Compares before-after room videos to report added, removed or moved objects with proof
readme_summary: Second Look compares two phone walkthroughs and reports added, removed or moved objects. SAM 3.1 provides boxes and confidences; unsupported claims are dropped with reasons. Static GitHub Pages demo plus Python server; uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API.

summary: Phone basketball video turned into tagged plays with citations
readme_summary: Next.js web app proxying to FastAPI backend hoopscliniq-ai. Core loop Record Tag Ask Study with consent-based player hiding. Uses SAM 3.1 for player detection and Muse models for tagging and Q&A.

summary: Independent visual check that passes or fails tool-using agent actions
readme_summary: Proprioception layer renders actions then tracks objects with SAM 3.1 and scores PASS/FAIL via deterministic residual. Muse diagnoses failures blind and repairs. Built with Python, tests, scenarios and web viewer.

summary: Routes tasks across Muse tiers when intent and behavior differ
readme_summary: The Dissonance Router detects intent-behavior gaps and routes to the right Muse model tier with logged reasons. Built on Meta Model API with models.toml tiers and evaluation harness. Measured on 200 live runs to cut cost and latency versus always-Ultra.

summary: Turns meetings, emails and chats into tracked commitments synced to Notion
readme_summary: ProjectPulse extracts commitments, decisions and blockers from team conversations with human approval. Backend LangGraph workflow with frontend syncs to Notion and tracks follow-through. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for diarization and Muse Spark for extraction.

summary: Clinical decision support graph that shows only cited lines for synthetic cases
readme_summary: Walks synthetic cases through a cited clinical knowledge graph for decision support, not diagnosis. Local Python backend with web UI; uses Meta Model API with recorded-provider replay for tests.

summary: Imports projects to inspect code, review patches and verify changes
readme_summary: IRIZA RESCUE is an engineering studio for project import, source inspection, evidence review and patch verification. Standalone Node.js backend with SQLite and editor build. Preserves existing IRIZA identity and separate TASTE store.

summary: Multimodal incident workspace that turns reports, images and audio into verified action plans
readme_summary: Multimodal incident-response workspace that ingests operator text, images and voice notes to build timelines and confidence-scored hypotheses. Uses live Meta Model API for extraction and planning with deterministic verifier and human approval. Stack with backend, frontend, Docker Compose; no auto-execution.

summary: Turns GitHub code into guided learning paths with practice tasks
readme_summary: Connects selected public GitHub source to workflows, concepts and focused practice. Web app with sample learning path, in-app study assistance that pauses during independent attempts. Uses Muse models to explain systems and support authorized human review.

summary: Fills in vague "add this" moments in how-to videos with short audio descriptions
readme_summary: Detects visual references in how-to videos, grounds them with SAM 3.1 on video frames, and drafts timed descriptions. Next.js app with accessible player and volunteer review flow. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech and Muse Spark for description drafting.

summary: Autonomous newsroom writes verified personalized daily broadsheet newspaper
readme_summary: The Muse Newz uses Google ADK multi-agent newsroom to research, write, fact-check and typeset editions. Built with Python API plus app frontend, using Meta AI models and SAM 3 for layout vision.

summary: Learns physical skills from one video and coaches you live via camera.
readme_summary: ShowOnce builds a step-by-step skill graph from expert video then judges webcam frames with spoken corrections. Next.js Electron app with staged standalone server. Uses Muse Spark reasoning, SAM 3.1 video segmentation, Muse Image and Voice.

summary: Triages SAST findings for LLM apps and auto-fixes verified issues.
readme_summary: Consumes canary SAST findings for prompt injection, secrets and unsafe output. Uses Muse Spark to judge true positives, write fixes and re-run the scanner to prove them. Python package with GitHub Action, evals and tests.

summary: Turns CCTV recordings into searchable findings with footage and timestamps
readme_summary: Searches authorized CCTV by description to find people, objects and time intervals without timestamps. Links each finding to source footage and evidence for review. Stack spans dashboard frontend, backend and controlled synthetic demo.

summary: Photo-to-listing tool that publishes and syncs stock across marketplaces
readme_summary: QuickListInventoryAI turns a product photo into titles, descriptions and tax suggestions then publishes to Shopify with multi-channel stock sync. Node/Express with Neon DB, multilingual input and Render hosting. Uses Meta vision and language models for image understanding and listing generation.

summary: Embodied astronaut assistant that sees, talks, and builds CAD models for 3D printing
readme_summary: Physically embodied engineering assistant with vision, British voice, and head-tracking. Python stack integrates Fusion 360, CAD revision, and gated 3D-print control. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for reasoning, vision, and dialogue.

summary: Multi-agent voice interview panel with GitHub bug-fix coding assessment
