readme_summary: Adaptive interview platform with 1-5 personas coordinated by a shared controller for stages and follow-ups. Stack includes voice via ElevenLabs and GitHub repo analysis for isolated coding tasks. Uses Meta AI models for interview dialogue and repository challenge generation.

summary: Simulation-only workspace turning language goals into OT-2 lab protocols
readme_summary: Natural-language goal to validated plan, Opentrons OT-2 protocol and simulator output with synthetic 96-well data. FastAPI backend plus Next.js web app via uv and Node 22. Local simulation only, no Meta model required.

summary: Camera-only silent-speech tool that turns lip movements into captioned speech
readme_summary: Experimental clip-to-caption pipeline with manual recording, SAM face tracking, Muse interpretation, confidence captions, TTS and transcripts. Monorepo with React TypeScript Vite frontend and Node Express TypeScript backend. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for interpretation and SAM 3.1 for segmentation.

summary: Compares two video takes to flag continuity mismatches with frame evidence.
readme_summary: Continuity checker for vertical video producers comparing two takes against a script brief. Ledger plus vision checks flag disagreements with exact frames for human accept/reject. Uses Muse Wonder for reasoning and Meta vision models, with evals and fixtures.

summary: QA harness that tests AI agents and returns SHIP, BLOCK or CONDITIONAL verdict
readme_summary: Agent Gate generates test cases from an agent spec, proves checks can fail, runs them and triages failures. Includes support-ticket and refund-desk samples with seeded defects. LLM refund agent runs live on Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API.

summary: Shows how preprocessing choices change biosignal measurements
readme_summary: Local research workspace that turns a biosignal recording and question into bounded analysis steps with local numerical tools. Produces inspectable reports and animated explanations. First module is PPG analysis. Uses Meta models for orchestration.

summary: Reverse-engineers reference sounds into editable synth recipes
readme_summary: Autonomous sound-design lab where Muse muse-spark-1.3 proposes oscillator and effect structures, numeric optimizer tunes parameters, librosa.pyin tracks pitch and deterministic renderer scores results with experiment logs.

summary: AR corridor on Valencia St showing only verified real-world DayPlay pins
readme_summary: Renders verified DayPlay listings as bearing/distance placards in a walkable AR corridor with zero-hallucination invariant. Architecture is static FOV sim plus FastAPI backend with intent-to-pipeline for constrained listing retrieval. Model plans and parses queries but never invents places.

summary: Converts instructions to verifiable tasks and checks photo and voice proof for completion
readme_summary: ProofLoop AI turns natural language directives into measurable criteria and verifies photo and voice evidence. Stack is React Vite Tailwind Three.js with TypeScript server. Uses Muse Spark for planning and SAM 3.1 segmentation for image evidence reasoning.

summary: Turns phone videos of experiments into measured physics with SAM 3.1 tracking
readme_summary: Students predict, film with any phone, then SAM 3.1 tracks objects frame-by-frame. Python physics code derives gravity via three methods using object size and fps. Flask app with XP, medals and leaderboard deployed on Render.

summary: City time-machine agent that separates proven history from imagined reconstructions.
readme_summary: Sankofa agent gathers scattered archives to visualize streets from 100 years ago with provenance. Frontend plus backend agent with precomputed showcase and live agent run. Uses Meta Muse models to research, cite sources and label proven vs generated content.

summary: AI room redesign from photo with real IKEA products, 3D view and shopping list.
readme_summary: Reads room photo/video to generate layout for style, size and budget with real IKEA Indonesia catalog. Node server plus web client producing 3D room, floor plan and render. Uses Meta Model API with SAM 3.1, Muse Spark/Image/Voice.

summary: Flight recorder that only keeps data insights surviving holdout validation
readme_summary: Flight recorder for AI analysts that logs every test and filters Muse Spark hypotheses via FDR control, holdout validation and confounder checks. Python stack with API, core, benchmarks and Docker. Uses Muse Spark for proposals with statistical verification.

summary: Local lab that tests competing thermal models by choosing experiments to disprove them.
readme_summary: Dependency-free Python lab simulates a thermal system, selects bounded interventions to separate hypotheses and updates Bayesian beliefs, abstaining when all fail. Optional Muse scientist and skeptic propose critiques via live models behind deterministic validation. Exports replayable evidence passports via run.py and Docker.

summary: Turns a prompt and brand URL into editable motion graphics and exports video.
readme_summary: Generates storyboard variants, editable layers, and MP4/PNG exports from prompt + brand URL. Built with Next.js, Neon Postgres/Drizzle, Vercel Blob, Remotion Lambda. Uses Vercel AI SDK with Meta Model API for planning and layer refinement.

summary: Turns family trees into immersive Quest and desktop history journeys
readme_summary: Unity 6000 project for Quest 3/3S and desktop. Fictional demo with 37 people and panoramas works offline; live mode generates scenery and portraits as imaginative interpretation.

summary: Telegram bot that investigates scam messages, QRs and voice notes
readme_summary: Telegram bot investigates Malaysian messages, screenshots, QRs and voice notes using QR decoding, link checks and transcription. Built in TypeScript on Node 24 with Muse models and synthetic eval set.

summary: Evidence-driven copilot that links CV runs and image errors to suggest next test.
readme_summary: Imports training runs, compares metrics and configs, and inspects FP/FN images for object detectors. Uses a Meta Muse agent to investigate failures and propose hypotheses. Targets industrial inspection workflows with local evidence-linked workspace.

summary: SOC copilot turning network evidence into defensible decisions
readme_summary: NetSentinel AI analyzes Suricata, YARA and traffic evidence with Muse Wonder and Spark, mapping to MITRE ATT&CK. Python + Chainlit SOC copilot outputs Suricata rules, YARA hunts and navigator layers with tests and example detections.

summary: n8n community nodes bringing Meta Muse models to workflows
readme_summary: Community n8n package adding Meta Muse to automation workflows. Provides a Chat Model sub-node for Agents/Chains and a full Meta Model API action node for Muse Wonder/Spark via Responses and Chat APIs, usable as agent tool.

summary: Incident workspace turning plant records into timelines and reviewable next steps
readme_summary: PlantPulse is an incident investigation workspace for power-generation and maintenance teams. Next.js 15, React 19 and TypeScript frontend builds evidence-linked timelines, discrepancies and historical context. Uses Meta AI models for summarization with human review.

summary: Turns product demo videos into verified seller-approved carts
readme_summary: Seller Studio with MP4 upload, preserved observations and verified catalog plus seller confirmation. Voice Shopping via transcription and intent extraction. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0.

summary: Converts site change requests into jobs and verifies live pages visually.
readme_summary: Feluda Care Agent turns change requests into atomic jobs, builder steps, and AI-verified done checks across pages and viewports. Python agent uses Meta Muse Spark for planning and SAM 3.1 for visual diff. Includes demo site, Docker, and pytest.

summary: Zero-shot phone inspection that segments casting defects from plain-word prompts.
readme_summary: Dockerized inspection app with API and web UI for small foundries. Uses SAM 3.1 for zero-shot segmentation from text prompts and Muse Spark to apply acceptance rules, measure defects in mm by part diameter.

summary: Generates localized video ads in 35 Asian languages from one master ad.
readme_summary: One-person importer workflow where one master ad is adapted by 30 country-specific agents into localized video ads. Built on Meta Muse models for translation, voice and cultural localization for diaspora customers. Includes training sets, briefs and verification logs.

summary: Zero-trust gateway that enforces policies and red-teams MCP agents.
readme_summary: Action-centric Policy Enforcement Point for LangGraph and MCP agents with 5-layer deterministic shield. Adds protocol integrity pinning, taint tracking and DLP scanning plus multi-vector adversarial eval harness and dashboard.

summary: Vision agents that segment scenes, reason causes and auto-execute fixes
readme_summary: Autonomous multi-agent loop Segment, Reason, Code, Execute, Verify for spatial analysis and defect inspection. Uses SAM 3.1 segmentation with Muse Spark/Wonder reasoning and Muse Code generation in Python.

summary: Meeting copilot that preps answers from your docs and detects directed questions.
readme_summary: Runs beside Zoom/Teams without joining, alerting within 1s when questioned. Shows cue cards prepared from agenda and documents with sources, plus live cards in 3s. Uses Muse Spark for detection, grounded answering and notes.

summary: Maps suppliers to quantify exposure and simulate disruption responses
readme_summary: Tierscope ingests Excel, CSV, PDF supplier/part/factory files to build a multi-tier supply map with exposure and euro impact. Meta Muse models act as supply manager to test plans in a weekly simulator. Human accepts or rejects every action via Python backend and UI.

summary: AI co-owner helping solo therapists find referrals and draft outreach safely
readme_summary: Aeon Practice-OS finds local referral partners, drafts outreach and plans meetings with approval gates. Next.js 16 with built-in Postgres local DB. Built with Meta Muse with human-in-the-loop.

summary: Photo-to-inventory stock-taking app for small merchants to count stock
readme_summary: Photo-to-inventory and stock-taking for Nigerian SMEs. Web portal and Flutter mobile app use Muse Spark for agent scan and SAM 3.1 for shelf crops, synced to shared Supabase with Qore Catalog feedback loop.

summary: Calm local assistant that fuses schedule and context into one Now card
readme_summary: Privacy-first proactive assistant demonstrating calm proactivity from simulated schedule, weather, transit and memory snapshots into a Living Context with at most one NOW card. Zero-diff core, keyless weather, extensive unit and e2e tests.

summary: On-device effort gate where kids earn app time through math and reading practice
readme_summary: Swift/SwiftUI child and admin apps with EarnPlayCore package; deterministic code gates app access on genuine effort. No account, server, or off-device child data. Uses on-device AI proposals for tutoring while code makes safety decisions.

summary: AI profit analyst that proves where e-commerce stores lose money.
readme_summary: Merit unifies orders, Meta Ads spend, and costs to find margin leaks, simulate fixes, and measure earnings. Full-stack with backend, frontend, Docker Compose, and benchmarks. Uses Muse models for analysis with owner approval.

summary: Digital twins meet first to preview compatibility and deals with quoted briefs.
readme_summary: Meety builds opt-in twins from user-approved chat history. Two twins simulate a meeting and each user gets a brief with quoted sources. Built as web app at heymeety.com using Google auth and Muse models for simulation.

summary: Anonymous local invitations that turn shared places into in-person talks
readme_summary: Hoolala! lets people in the same cafe or coworking space post meetup signals, staying anonymous until mutual opt-in. Web app with evals and docs. Uses Muse Spark for profiling, topic suggestions, screening, translation and venue ideas.

summary: Painting co-pilot that turns ideas into concepts, paint recipes in grams and steps.
readme_summary: Impasto Studio Co-pilot guides impasto painters from concept to wall-ready piece with recipes, steps and photo check-ins. FastAPI backend + web frontend with uv and Node. Uses Meta Model API for concepts, recipes and dictation.

summary: macOS learning app that turns your open materials into testable models
readme_summary: Desktop learning companion built with TypeScript, Electron 45.2.2 and React as Glint.app. Users add text, images, PDFs or window captures to tasks, then predict and test outcomes against local rule-based models. Tasks and history stored locally on Mac.

summary: Fuses two animals into hybrid creatures and iterates on visual canvas
readme_summary: Creates hybrid creatures from photos or names in five art styles, naming each and writing field-guide entries. Frontend + backend workspaces with FLORA-style card canvas, using Muse Image with reference blending.

summary: Korean-first GLP-1 journal that drafts editable entries from words and meal photos.
readme_summary: My Dear Step is a personal GLP-1 journal with Momo AI companion that proposes entries from text and photos for user confirmation. It is a web app with Drizzle DB and Lovable frontend. It uses Meta Muse Spark Open for multimodal entry drafting.

summary: Screen-and-camera assistant that points to controls and verifies each task step.
readme_summary: Tandrix sees Mac screen and iPhone camera to guide, automate, and verify tasks with Show-me and Do-it modes. It uses Muse Spark for reasoning, vision and computer use, SAM 3.1 for part segmentation, and Muse Voice Transcribe with Kokoro TTS. Monorepo with Mac, iPhone, and web report apps.

summary: Scores NYC apartment noise from city data tailored to how you sleep.
readme_summary: Combines 311 complaints, permits, liquor licenses, and transit data into a quiet-to-loud verdict with citations. Monorepo with API, apps, and eval services on Vercel. Uses Meta models to parse listings and permits and write grounded explanations.

summary: Autonomous agent that diagnoses failed CI builds and opens fix pull requests
readme_summary: Intercepts failing CI/CD builds, runs Meta AI root-cause analysis, then fixes code on isolated branches and opens GitHub PRs. Built with FastAPI, PyGithub, and Docker Compose. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta LLM layer for analysis and patches.

summary: Asks any photo or video questions by chat or voice with video clip proof
readme_summary: Web, Telegram and WhatsApp bot that answers plain-language questions over user footage. Plans with Muse Spark, tracks with SAM 3.1, transcribes with Muse Voice, verifies with code. Python service with ffmpeg, evals and sim harness.

summary: Multi-agent system that playtests and fixes game onboarding loops
readme_summary: Game Onboarding Optimizer playtests onboarding, finds where players get stuck, proposes fixes and verifies with A/B reruns. Closed-loop multi-agent system with human approval. Uses Muse Spark, Wonder, Image and SAM 3.1.

summary: Streamlit tool that turns delimited datasets into checked statistical analyses and reports.
readme_summary: LabLens AI is a Streamlit prototype for delimited datasets: users choose columns, cleaning, and a model, then it computes statistics, diagnostics, and charts. Optional AI interpretation is grounded in computed-result IDs and exported in a validated report.

summary: Measures cost of completed work and verifies real AI savings
readme_summary: TokenPilot proxies coding-agent traffic via OpenAI-compatible gateway, attributes cost and detects waste with rules. Muse explains evidence, then paired benchmark verifies savings. Backend + frontend with acceptance-test verification.

summary: Finds and replaces identifiers in clinical text for human review
readme_summary: Python tool redacts names, dates, IDs in synthetic clinical notes using Muse Spark, with evidence for each edit and doubtful cases left to reviewers. Includes scripts, tests, and evaluation docs; synthetic data only.

summary: Ephemeral chat room where every text and photo message expires after one hour
readme_summary: Vite + React ephemeral chat with Supabase cloud sync, IndexedDB local store and Realtime DELETE for synchronized dissolves. Ring countdown UI with dissolve animation and settings themes. Explores AI to make social interaction more engaging.

summary: In-person event layer to discover who to meet and why
readme_summary: IntroMesh runs a Discover, Understand, Connect, Learn loop for events with deterministic matching plus explanations. Server calls muse-spark-1.3 via OpenAI SDK with structured Zod outputs for profiles and recommendations.

summary: AI trading platform scanning 1100 US stocks with 22 pattern detectors
readme_summary: TradeUSA is a multi-tenant paper brokerage with momentum scanner, AI trade director and options engine. It scans 1M/5M/15M timeframes across ~1100 symbols with risk controls. Uses Meta Llama/Muse models as the reasoning core of its agentic layer.

summary: Terminal workspace to investigate auth and file logs and export evidence reports
readme_summary: Interactive Python CLI for security investigations. Imports CSV/JSONL, detects signals, manages cases, and exports reports. Uses Meta Model API for evidence search via local MCP subprocess; manual mode works offline.

summary: Referee system that verifies AI-generated trading rules before they go live.
readme_summary: Verification layer for the DAFE Charts terminal. Muse Wonder proposes trading rules, Muse Spark codes and advises, and a hidden referee scores them. Includes voice transcribe push-to-talk and cost tracking.

summary: Voice-controlled Raspberry Pi room speaker and ambient wall display
readme_summary: Voice bridge where Meta Model API muse-spark-1.3 streaming with function calls turns speech into spoken answers and wall scenes. Raspberry Pi bridge with timed logging in experiments/results. Filmed in-room demo Nov 2.

summary: Preserves road-incident media with traceable review of evidence and limits
readme_summary: Blackbox ingests dashcam media, hashes files at intake, and organizes footage for human review. It surfaces what footage supports, uncertainties, and missing evidence without fault findings. Prototype uses Meta AI for analysis assistance with traceability UI.

summary: Messenger prototype that finds nearby friends and suggests real-world meetups.
readme_summary: Messenger-inspired prototype with proximity radar using real PostgreSQL/PostGIS distance math over simulated Manila data. Node.js apps with Docker Compose provide Reconnect Today and meetup advice inferred by Muse Spark 1.3. All identities simulated; routing and AI inference are real.

summary: Real estate marketplace for listings that accept cryptocurrency payments.
readme_summary: Next.js 16 marketplace connecting crypto-friendly sellers with global buyers, with Property model, owner dashboard, and admin review. Built on ShipFast boilerplate with NextAuth, MongoDB, and SEO public pages. No explicit Meta AI model usage described in README.

summary: Deterministic website scanner that turns evidence into verified fix guidance
readme_summary: Scans websites with a deterministic nine-check engine and stores redacted evidence per result. Uses Muse Spark as auditor to explain, prioritize and adversarially re-check findings. Built as Next.js app with seeded demo target and saved reports.

summary: Live voice ordering agent for a real pizza restaurant in Nepal
readme_summary: PizzaGhar is a production voice agent taking orders for a Birtamod restaurant via WhatsApp web. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for dialogue and Whisper for transcription. Reports 124 real customers with owner dashboard.

summary: Phone-based physics lab that tracks pendulums and measures gravity
readme_summary: Students film a pendulum and Galileo tracks motion, overlays physics visuals and guides discovery. Stack is Python backend plus Node frontend with ffmpeg. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark for tutoring and Muse Image.

summary: Projector-camera table helper that guides hands-on tasks with light overlays
readme_summary: Uses a phone projector, overhead webcam, and laptop to see table objects and project instructions onto them. Hold-to-talk mic bubble limits listening; Muse Wonder counts items and guides steps. Python codebase with procedures, recordings, and tests written during hackathon.

summary: Voice and chat copilot to run hotel operations, billing and housekeeping.
readme_summary: Cloom Copilot lets hotel teams operate by voice notes, live calls and chat. Built with Next.js + Prisma and powered by Muse Code. It uses Muse Spark for chat, Muse Voice Transcribe for voice, and Muse Wonder.

summary: Offline-first internet allocation and AI study tools for UNN students
readme_summary: Fair transparent internet-hour allocation with usage logging, offline caching and campus-network publishing for UNN. Built with Python app in run.py plus tests and demo. Uses Meta AI study tools with logged, cached, labeled model calls for scarce connectivity.

summary: Turns missing features into tracked RAISE requests
readme_summary: Muse RAISE app for capturing and tracking feature requests within Commonworld Atlas ecosystem. TypeScript stack with agents, migrations and public assets. Built on Meta Model API using Muse credits for hackathon.

summary: Checks funeral price lists against FTC Funeral Rule disclosures
readme_summary: Uploads funeral home GPLs as PDF or photos and flags missing prices and disclosures with citations. Built for the hackathon and live at itemized.mortuary.ai on Cloudflare Workers. Uses Muse models for document parsing and rule checking.

summary: AI blockchain forensics that traces crypto flows and builds evidence-backed reports
readme_summary: Traces cryptocurrency flows across seven EVM chains with deterministic laundering detectors. Turns on-chain data into briefs and recovery drafts with Muse Spark citing transaction hashes for every claim.

summary: macOS app that moves the cursor with gaze and acts on short voice commands
readme_summary: Glance tracks eye gaze to move the real cursor with wink-click and nod-scroll, then combines gaze plus voice to pick UI elements. Agent runs on Fireworks models for one-step click grounding, with multi-step tasks in progress.

summary: Phone-camera assistant that guides furniture and kit assembly step-by-step with visual checks.
readme_summary: Points phone at parts, identifies them, generates stepwise guide and verifies each step from camera view. Python server with static web client for assembly use case like mic kit. Uses Meta Model API vision plus SAM for part segmentation.

summary: Turns construction drawings into explorable 3D assembly models
readme_summary: Studio that converts a 2D section or detail photo into a named 3D model with step-through assembly. Focused on waterproofing layers and laps, with house cutaway story. Construction detail learning tool.

summary: Comic editor that splits pages into panels and redraws art with AI
readme_summary: Paneller Open vectorizes comic pages into editable panels, bubbles and SFX using SAM 3.1. Next.js app uses Muse Spark for panel planning and Muse Image for clean art without lettering.

summary: Turn-taking layer that stops voice bots interrupting stammering
readme_summary: Adds silence-aware turn-taking to cut bot cut-offs, evaluated on stammered speech. Stack is live server + web voice editor with bench results. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for streaming transcription.

summary: Watches wet-lab bench to catch errors and write lab records
readme_summary: Lab partner for trainees that uses SAM 3.1 masks with deterministic CFU compute and Muse agent trace for protocol deviations. Next.js app with DEMO_MODE, grounded in oncology wet-lab work.

summary: iOS app where animated character guides family speech practice with live feedback
readme_summary: Family iOS app with animated Mibo character modeling mouth shapes, on-device listening and encouraging responses. Adults select lessons or generate custom word sets; built with app/, eval/ and prototypes for speech-practice lessons.

summary: Checks social images for AI-generation traces and harmful private content
readme_summary: Analyzes uploaded images for AI artifacts with outlined evidence regions and for harmful content like PII or gore. Web app plus browser extension with Vercel serverless API. Uses vision-language models to classify and explain findings.

summary: Community flood warning with traffic-light risk and human-approved aid
readme_summary: Chaski Guardian combines weather/ocean data and neighbor reports into green-yellow-red risk with actions for Arequipa ravines. Next.js app with coordinator approval workflow where AI proposes and a person approves. Built with Muse Spark and Muse Code.

summary: Shared persistent-memory MCP server so agents capture facts once and recall compressed payloads.
readme_summary: One memory layer for all clients and sub-bots with provenance verification and temporal index. Python MCP server with Docker, GUI and vault store. Uses ultra-compressed Caveman payloads and OKF trust signals.

summary: Turns messy supplier spreadsheets into checked, source-linked customer quotes.
readme_summary: Preview-first pipeline for xlsx/csv import, mapping, interpretation and validation with human review. Backend plus frontend with Docker compose, credit-gated Muse features. Every value links to source cell with export.

summary: Simulation-first solar-battery twin with AI advisory for school energy resilience
readme_summary: Combines deterministic solar and battery digital twin, previous-day forecast, and bounded load scheduling. Meta Muse Spark provides advisory tool-calling with independent Guardian and human approval. Read-only Next.js control-room dashboard, simulation only.

summary: Turns bills, photos and voice notes into refund-ready consumer complaints
readme_summary: AI agent with Android client and server backend that builds evidence packs from screenshots, SMS and Hindi voice. Checks proof and drafts escalation emails. Uses Muse models for multilingual understanding and drafting.

summary: AI session musicians that arrange and play parts under your song
readme_summary: Takes unfinished recordings, has AI musicians listen and generate in-time, in-key parts you keep or reject with plain words. Parked Oct 28 2026 to pivot to social story creator. Built during hackathon for Build for Your World theme with ledger and web UI.

summary: Analyzes pump.fun tokens for rug risk and backtests copy-trading wallets from on-chain data
readme_summary: Agent-native IDE with Analyze mode for token holder and rug scoring and Copy Trade mode for delayed backtests. Frontend plus backend queries on-chain data with verification before display. Uses Muse models for research summaries, all numbers derived from chain facts.

summary: Merchant terminal for fiat orders and testnet crypto agreements
readme_summary: HybridPay is a Next.js PWA terminal with dashboard, QR checkout, fiat sandbox, EVM Sepolia via viem, and conditional payment agreements. Backend sandbox on Modal with read-only AI assistant. Uses advisory AI with fallback-safe validation.

summary: Audits if Meta models give the same facts in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
readme_summary: Asks same medical, legal and finance questions in two languages, compares answers and flags factual drift. Gradio app with audit, judge and reporting pipeline. Uses Meta AI models as systems under test for cross-lingual evaluation.

summary: Career agent that drafts applications with deterministic guardrails against hallucinations.
readme_summary: Multi-agent system where LLM drafts resumes and cover letters, then stdlib Python verifier enforces truthfulness. Zero-dependency Python with web demo and extension. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for reading and drafting.

summary: Phone coach checks generator placement against CDC/NIST guidance in Hindi and English
readme_summary: Python phone coach measures generator distance from door and checks against CDC and NIST guidance after hurricanes. Bilingual Hindi-English with Spanish safety lines to address CO poisoning risk. Built for Meta hackathon Indie Build for Your World track.

summary: Converts phone video of motion into runnable physics code with what-if simulation
readme_summary: Pipeline segments and tracks ball with SAM 3.1 for sub-pixel geometry, fits 3D physics, emits runnable Python and simulates what-if edits. Web app plus Python backend with live SAM call. Uses SAM 3.1 for vision and Muse Spark for plain-English to parameter edits.

summary: Tries on clothes from any store link live in browser with your webcam
readme_summary: TryAnywhere fits garments to body live in browser from product links. Desktop-first pnpm monorepo with typed provider interface and offline defaults. Meta providers not wired, HF Leffa optional.

summary: Verifies checkout screenshots and returns BUY, TRIAL, WAIT or REJECT verdict
readme_summary: AI's Cart checks a checkout screenshot before paying and explains verdict with observed/inferred evidence. Pipeline extracts fields with Muse Spark 1.3 then checks terms. Vercel demo runs in sample mode, live pipeline on private deployment.

summary: WhatsApp bot finding medicine stock in Ecuador pharmacies nearby
readme_summary: Searches medicine availability across Ecuadorian pharmacies via WhatsApp in Spanish. Uses Gemini to read prescriptions and Google Maps for walking distance with Prisma/Node stack. Built solo for DevFest Quito, no Muse model usage stated.

summary: Shared live AI rooms where teams and agents work with one memory
readme_summary: Solo chat becomes live multi-user room on Share with shared memory, team invites and agents. Includes dissent referee and decision receipts with on-screen pricing. Python backend built for Build for Your World Indie track.

summary: Bug repair agent that patches Python code and verifies with Docker test runs
readme_summary: ProofLoop accepts a bug report or Python repo, generates patches with Meta Model API, and runs tests in isolated Docker with evidence-backed reports. Only marks Verified when execution evidence supports the fix. Stack with Python backend, frontend, fixtures, and demo projects.

summary: AI on-call network engineer that detects, fixes and rolls back router incidents
readme_summary: Detects network incidents, investigates with real router tools and auto-remediates with rollback. Python 3.12 backend with React Spectrum frontend and BIRD lab. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and SAM 3.1 to read rack cabling photos.

summary: Turns a WhatsApp voice note into a live tested WhatsApp storefront in minutes
readme_summary: Genesis converts informal vendor voice notes into business profile, catalog, order form and payments on WhatsApp. Python panel and fixtures with tests for low-device users. FunnelChat entry for informal commerce.

summary: AI WhatsApp operator and booking platform for beauty salons with photo brow analysis
readme_summary: Modular booking and commerce platform piloted at Ari Vivas Beauty in Madrid. Mobile web plus WhatsApp Hermes operator with real agenda, price list and AI brow photo analysis. Owner dashboard with funnel and waitlist.

summary: Shares one keyboard, mouse, and live windows across macOS and Windows.
readme_summary: Cross-OS KVM fabric with bezel cursor handoff, drag-and-drop files, and 60fps live window streaming to phone. Node bridge plus backend, agent, and frontend workspaces. Uses Meta models for multimodal input handling.

summary: Real-time multilingual AI voice messaging with live transcripts
readme_summary: EchoPulse real-time multilingual voice messaging with React 18 + TypeScript frontend and FastAPI Python backend. Deployed on Cloud Run with Swagger docs. Uses Meta AI models for voice understanding and response.

summary: Open-source detector that checks if text, image, voice or video is real
readme_summary: Sniff lets users forward content via WhatsApp or web to get AI-generation verdicts with evidence. Monorepo with apps, Docker quick-start and config for models. Uses Meta Muse models alongside detectors for multimodal analysis.

summary: Phone PWA that scans gravel beds and ranks stones worth picking up.
readme_summary: Bed photo is segmented to rank candidates with boxes, confidence, and reasons, then guides close-up check. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for multimodal ranking. PWA plus Node proxy and Python CLI over Tailscale.

summary: AI agent that inspects Python repos and proposes verified patches
readme_summary: PatchPilot analyzes Python repos, plans repairs with Meta models, requires approval, generates regression tests and runs bounded repair loop. Frontend plus backend with static analysis, reports and CI deployment.

summary: Local-first desktop assistant with computer use and finance reconciliation
readme_summary: Local-first desktop companion Morrow for task execution, computer use, finance reconciliation and self-extension. Cross-platform Linux/macOS/Windows. Powered by muse-spark-1.3, muse-wonder-1.0 and SAM-3.1 inside consent-gated boundary.

summary: Autonomous sysadmin agents monitor servers and propose reversible fixes
readme_summary: Foreman collects server metrics and logs every 30 minutes, with Reviewer writing health reports and Fixer proposing reversible fixes for human approval. Docker Compose Python backend with dashboard and mobile approval. Built on muse-wonder-1.0 and muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API.

summary: Guardrail that allows, approves or denies AI-generated SQL before execution
readme_summary: Parses LLM SQL with sqlglot, enforces single SELECT, allowlist and column policies with LIMIT and audit log. Streamlit demo on DuckDB with red-team corpus. Uses Muse check for query review alongside deterministic rules.

summary: Handwriting-first maths tutor that spots mistakes and gives hints.
readme_summary: Quack is a handwriting-first AI companion for primary and secondary maths homework with mistake feedback and hints. Stack spans apps and services with evals. Uses Meta AI models for handwriting understanding and pedagogical feedback generation.

summary: Demo water-saving token where farmers log meters and trade in a marketplace
readme_summary: AgroToken is a hackathon prototype for Proof of Water Savings with simulated readings, AGT rewards, transfers and marketplace. Uses Python stack with hash-linked history and Docker demo scripts. Not a real cryptocurrency or certified irrigation system.

summary: Quest 3 mixed-reality studio that builds full Instagram campaigns in 3D
readme_summary: Walkable Three.js office where owner creates strategy, copy, images, 9:16 video and Meta Ads draft. WebXR plus small Node.js server.mjs, no Unity build. Uses Meta Muse Spark assistant for guided campaign generation.

summary: Converts a ball-and-ramp clip into a tuned 2D physics simulation
readme_summary: Physics Twin films a tabletop clip and fits a 2D rigid-body simulation tuning friction and bounce to match footage, then predicts future motion with error in cm/px/ms. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for reasoning. Web app with API, server and docs.

summary: Spatial memory that records rooms and answers questions with visual evidence
readme_summary: Records physical environments, tracks observations over time with persistent object identities. Built with React Vite frontend and Fastify Prisma SQLite backend, using live Meta SAM segmentation and evidence-grounded Muse assistant.

summary: Magpie provider plugin driving real Muse Code CLI with MCP tool bridging
readme_summary: Provider for magpie built on official Muse Code SDK using muse serve host with empty preset and per-conversation MCP server for client tools. Handles auth and model calls, verified Nov 2026 with muse-wonder-1.0 on Macmini.

summary: Chat-to-build studio that turns songs into beat-synced 3D music videos
readme_summary: Builder agent listens to full track then writes timeline of three.js scenes with live beat-synced preview. Bun + TypeScript + Python stack deployed on Modal. Uses Meta Model API Muse Spark for directing scenes.

summary: Chat copilot checking freight documents for clearance readiness and mismatches
readme_summary: Slice 1 chat intake of 1-8 photos/PDFs, case summary, cross-document consistency check. Next.js chat UI with optional Supabase in-memory fallback. Uses META_API_KEY for Muse models to parse and compare clearance documents.

summary: 9.12x knapsack compression to run Muse-Glimmer-30B in under 8 GiB RAM
readme_summary: Project LEAN compresses Meta Muse-Glimmer-30B (29.78B) for an 8.00 GiB envelope via asymmetric knapsack quantization. Repo includes audits, campaigns, experiments, preregistration and safetensors release. Built to make Muse-Glimmer-30B deployable on constrained hardware.

summary: Guided crash-photo capture that verifies and seals insurance evidence for adjusters
readme_summary: Guided mobile browser capture flow that checks photos against policy and claim story, then Ed25519-seals them for adjuster review. Stack spans app, server, docs and tools with guardrails, evals and tracing. Uses Muse Spark plus SAM 3.1 with code-decided lanes.

summary: Builds public lighting inventories from street-level photos with AI
readme_summary: AI-assisted inventory of pole spacing, heights and layouts from street imagery for lighting audits. Monorepo with apps, packages and database infra, prototyped with Meta Muse coding agent.

summary: Explores runoff and drainage fixes under same rainfall with field reports.
readme_summary: Executable research prototype to explore surface runoff and compare drainage interventions under same rainfall. Browser simulation with historical map and guided tour plus Node server. Uses Meta extraction for field observations.

summary: 3D simulation for siting AI data centers with research agents and site dossiers.
readme_summary: Playable globe and 3D sites to spec GPU fleets, crews and cooling/electrical fit-out with agent verdicts. Built with Next.js, Prisma and Vercel on Muse by Meta with SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

summary: Tinder-like map marketplace to sell, buy or give away items when moving
readme_summary: MoveAlong is a Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind + Prisma + SQLite PWA for local mover listings by building and distance. It includes Docker support and a Capacitor mobile path, with AI room preview to visualize items before pickup.

summary: AI robotics workspace with 3D digital twins, simulation and build guidance
readme_summary: AI-powered robotics engineering workspace for design, simulation, assembly and monitoring. Combines interactive 3D digital twins, hardware planning and device monitoring. Uses Meta models for intelligent project guidance and build copilots.

summary: Compares two real robot runs and judges which performed task better
readme_summary: Converts paired robot runs into storyboards and asks Muse models to return verdict, confidence and reason. Evaluated on held-out cup_stacking task with 607 pairs and 10 human votes each. Python app with scripts and results.

summary: Predicts brand-creator fit from public sources with storefronts and fan feed.
readme_summary: Next.js app scores category fit, audience overlap, track record and brand safety using only cited public sources, banning personality inference. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via api.meta.ai and open-weights path via Baseten. Includes claimable creator storefronts, marketplace and seeded demo mode.

summary: macOS app that transcribes, translates and dubs English talks into Vietnamese
readme_summary: Mothertongue takes YouTube links, transcribes, diarizes, translates with full-talk context and dubs in southern Vietnamese voices. Native macOS app with EN/VI subtitles timed to speech. Built on Muse models.

summary: Payment safety layer that blocks conflicting invoices where naive agents pay
readme_summary: NYX Guard is a guarded extractor plus reviewer for payment documents on synthetic ledgers. It abstains on conflicting totals and risky recipients while allowing normal invoices. Tested against naive agents using Meta models with paired trials and benchmarks.

summary: Turns disaster photos into evidence-linked incident reports for human reviewers.
readme_summary: Himalayan Sentinel analyzes flood/landslide photos for hazards and infrastructure impact with human-in-the-loop review. Backend combines Muse Spark for scene understanding and SAM 3.1 for segmentation, plus evidence-aware assessment and report generation.

summary: PT-to-5K running coach for Ray-Ban Display glasses with vision layer
readme_summary: Plain-web lens-style app guides PT exercise plans, answers session questions, and adds SAM 3.1 people segmentation for distance estimates and crowd counts. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via server proxy to keep keys server-side.

summary: Budget slider that refines an SDF world from coarse to detailed
readme_summary: Interactive demo where a canonical SDF scene in GFL renders under user-controlled compute budget. Dragging 1-100 refines the image with live budget-error graph, showing anytime rendering. Derived from suitzero/gfl project.

summary: Converts documents into narrated slide videos with selectable audience formats.
readme_summary: Turns uploaded chapters or notes into slides and narrated publish-ready video via agentic pipeline. Frontend plus Python backend packaged with Docker and compose scripts. Uses Meta Muse Wonder for slide scripting and studio voice for narration.

summary: Watches family board-game videos to generate playable rules and browser game.
readme_summary: Pipeline tracks pieces with SAM 3.1, transcribes speech with Muse Voice Transcribe and synthesizes rules with Muse Wonder. Checker replays moves and iterates on contradictions. Outputs browser game with AI opponent and rulebook.

summary: Zero-shot visual inspection finds defects and explains root causes
readme_summary: LineSight is a visual QA platform for manufacturing that detects, verifies and learns defects. FastAPI and React stack uses Muse Spark, Wonder, Image, Voice Transcribe plus SAM 3.1 segmentation.

summary: Diagnoses urban heat causes in Jaipur with causal counterfactual tests
readme_summary: Hotspot Detective fuses Earth observation and telemetry to explain heat islands via permutation testing. FastAPI SSE backend and Next.js frontend use muse-spark-1.3 and muse-wonder-1.0 agents.

summary: Coding agent that marks done only when hidden deterministic checks pass
readme_summary: ProofLoop separates model claims from evidence using allowlisted checks and hidden holdout tests. Rule-based verdict yields verified status, built on Muse Spark during the 2026 hackathon.

summary: Portfolio optimization and index replication studio fusing AI and physics solver
readme_summary: Combines Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder with HexSolid Parametron Ising solver for index replication. Selects optimal portfolios from thousands of stocks with time-series validation. Python studio with charts and market data.

summary: Hands-free voice and camera assistant for cooking and assembly tasks
readme_summary: Lets users ask by voice or text with camera context while hands stay on task. Frontend plus backend guidance pipeline for live scenes. Built for Build for Your World with multimodal assistance focus.

summary: Autonomous wildlife surveillance platform that flags pathogen spillover risk for ecologists.
readme_summary: Monitors wildlife disease signals to anticipate spillover for professionals, not medical use. Stacks agent, API, web app, eval harness and litmine pipeline with live monitor and Hugging Face SFT dataset. Uses Meta AI models for ecological reasoning and alert generation.

summary: Snap a product photo to search marketplace listings and enhance seller images
readme_summary: Visual commerce platform solving buyer vocabulary and seller photography problems. Next.js + Tailwind + Modal stack with vitest. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for multimodal search, matching, and image enhancement.

summary: On-device memory that turns AI glasses conversations into searchable records
readme_summary: On-device System 1 memory for AI glasses that converts daily transcripts into structured searchable records offline. Uses small Meta MobileLLM-R1 360M with non-autoregressive heads, Python pipeline plus iOS export and ontology evals.

summary: Bilingual request-to-task demo with explicit confirmation and auditable receipts.
readme_summary: Standalone Node.js demo using local Muse Glimmer 30B via Ollama for English/Spanish transcript interpretation. Proposal requires explicit confirmation to create synthetic task in append-only audit file. Handles refunds, handoffs, and clarification with live verification script.

summary: Agent that experiments with undocumented machines to learn controls and write manuals.
readme_summary: Agent with camera and four unlabeled controls that proposes rule hypotheses via Muse Spark Open. Deterministic verifier checks explanations against observations and an independent shield gates moves. Monitor detects rewiring and triggers repair with cited experiments.

summary: Turns micro-CT scans into traceable bone measurements for arthritis research
readme_summary: Voluma lets researchers select a workflow, upload a micro-CT scan, and have AI agents segment bones, place landmarks, and measure. It shows each result in 3D beside its evidence for review and conversational correction. Uses Muse models for agentic segmentation and measurement, starting with mouse knee osteoarthritis.

summary: Scans clothing rails by video to create clean catalog cards, looks and boards.
readme_summary: Wardrobe app that converts rail videos and photos into cut-out garment cards. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for detection/tracking and Muse Image for clean product shots. Runs at styld.app in English and Slovenian on Cloudflare.

summary: Script-to-screen 3D film studio inside ComfyUI with open models
readme_summary: Soundstage adds Director Book and ScriptSync to block scenes in 3D clay, use phone as viewfinder, then generate video with sound on local GPU. Cuts takes on realtime timeline with example workflows. Built as ComfyUI extension in Python with open weights.

summary: Controls your desktop coding sessions and apps from WhatsApp or Telegram.
readme_summary: FarFromDesk is a local macOS, Windows and Linux desktop app linking your computer to WhatsApp or Telegram chat. Atlas, built on Meta Model API, reads messages and voice notes to run coding sessions and Mac apps remotely. Ships as installable desktop client with docs and security model.

summary: Agent workspace with web UI to manage RouterOS networks by chat
readme_summary: RouterOS network workspace grounding an agent on real routers and docs. Combines quickchr, centrs and rosetta tooling with browser UI for chat and tool-call inspection. Built on Meta Muse Code for network ops.

summary: Shared baby tracker that logs feeds and sleep by tap, chat or voice.
readme_summary: Android app with backend and Supabase for two-parent baby logging. Uses Muse Spark as tool-calling agent and Muse Voice Transcribe for voice entries with predictions.

summary: Autonomous social media agent that learns voice and drafts cross-platform content
readme_summary: Agentic platform connecting X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook via OAuth and Post for Me. Background feed ingestion with Chroma vector indexing for voice-aware generation. Uses Muse models for niche analysis and content engine.

summary: Experimental radiology dictation with streaming transcription and review.
readme_summary: Spanish radiology pilot capturing audio with Muse streaming and local Whisper OpenVINO. Adds comparative lab, glossary, templates and experimental Meta reviewer for reports.

summary: Turns Spanish tender PDFs into defensible bid prices with citations
readme_summary: Local-first assistant where Muse Spark extracts requirements with page citations for human approval. Deterministic Python engine computes price, points and low-offer rules with accessible Spanish voice UI.

summary: Web UI and CLI to run and track one background coding agent per intent
readme_summary: Orchestrates one background Claude Code process per intent with web UI, agentmgr CLI, and conflict radar. Node/web stack with Jira integration and AI judge for collisions. Uses coding agents for autonomous implementation and review.

summary: Multi-agent team that designs, codes, publishes apps and creates ads
readme_summary: Muse Team uses role agents for CEO, CTO, product, design and QA to build apps from an idea. Stack is Docker backend plus frontend with Railway deploy. Uses Muse Spark and Wonder for reasoning, Muse Code for code, Voice Transcribe and Meta Ads.

summary: Offline-first freight desk for East Africa with landed cost and tracking
readme_summary: CargoLinx provides itemized landed cost, offline quoting and tracking for East African corridors. Deterministic engine with tests plus Cloudflare Workers desk that works without connectivity. Built on Meta Muse models with static frontend.

summary: Replicates arXiv papers on public data to verify reported numbers hold up
readme_summary: Celsus reads arXiv LaTeX, extracts reported numbers, and rebuilds analysis from public data in a sandbox. It compares reproduced results to claims in plain language. Uses Python workflow with isolated execution and receipts.

summary: Turns racing thoughts and burnout into humorous comics plus action plans
readme_summary: MindStrip converts mental overload and caregiving stress into episodic comic strips with 3-step blueprints. The live Next.js flow is landing to single-image episode page to studio dock. It uses Meta frontier models for strip synthesis and empathetic storytelling.

summary: Personal chat agent with editable persona, long-term memory and tool use
readme_summary: kuma-agent is a Japanese conversational agent with SOUL persona files, MEMORY long-term memory, threads and task nudges. Stack is Python + Docker with Web UI. Uses Muse as reasoning brain for dialogue, summarization, memory extraction and tool calls.

summary: Guides housing navigators through unit walkthroughs with AI-assisted documentation.
readme_summary: Walkthrough Kit is a mobile-first prototype for staged housing-unit walkthroughs, organizing video evidence into inspection packets. It assists case managers while leaving decisions to humans. Uses Meta AI companion with video-grounded suggestions.

summary: AI front desk for local services that answers texts, photos and voicemails.
readme_summary: First Answer Sight measures objects from one customer photo using a known-size ruler object. Muse Spark vision reads photo, sizes job and drafts quote from price list in English or Spanish. Node relay plus web upload sends lead to business.

summary: Phone coach that watches your screen and asks one question when you are stuck
readme_summary: Caddie observes work from phone while user stays in usual AI tool and nudges only when stuck. Leaves minimal lessons and practice scenes with session replays. Cloudflare Workers app with demo, practice-preview and sample flows.

summary: AI architecture designer for workload sizing and infra cost optimization.
readme_summary: BuildSense provides AI-assisted software architecture, capacity planning and cost optimization via an agentic loop. Turborepo with web app, packages, Postgres and Docker setup. Runs on Muse Spark via Meta Model API for design and estimation.

summary: Turns PDFs and notes photos into anime lesson with 3D companion Mita
readme_summary: Uploads PDF or ordered note photos to generate dialogue-driven interactive presentations guided by expressive 3D companion. Frontend + backend pipeline structures lessons with contextual visuals. Uses Meta AI/Muse models for lesson shaping and dialogue.

summary: Rust CLI that runs AI-assisted coding interviews in a Docker sandbox
readme_summary: PairProof is a single Rust binary with expert and candidate roles for live LeetCode-style interviews. It uses a disposable Docker sandbox and scores approach, intervention, and token efficiency. It measures directing AI tools rather than memorized coding.

summary: Voice commerce agent in Darija that builds shops and manages ad campaigns
readme_summary: Zero-dependency Node 22 agent that turns product photos into shop, ad creative, launched campaign and customer replies. Voice-first in Algerian Darija with replay mode, bench and web UI, using Meta Muse models for shop and ad reasoning.

summary: Middleware that audits foundation-model agency across 18 models and 36 arms
readme_summary: Python middleware and controllers for auditing model autonomy and interoception. Batch runs tasks locally, on Meta and Baseten with logged reports. Evaluates Meta open-weight models for agentic behavior and failure modes.

summary: Gift-card cabinet to file cards by photo or voice and track spending
readme_summary: Astro SSR on Cloudflare Workers + D1 app where photo, voice, typing or WhatsApp creates a reviewable draft. Sealed drawers, encrypted vault, spend tracking with undo. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for vision extraction and planning.

summary: Local freight assistant that benchmarks carriers with verified cost math
readme_summary: Axle delegates freight evaluation to tested Python modules for cost normalization and carrier benchmarks. Muse Spark provides explainable recommendations over synthetic offline data. Uses consent-gated SQLite profiles with Telegram live integration unbuilt.

summary: Assistive third robotic arm that autocompletes daily tasks
readme_summary: Armed controls an open-hardware SO-101 arm to assist hands-busy users. Uses SAM 3.1 for vision, Muse Voice Transcribe for ears, Muse Spark as judge and Wonder as investigator. Built in 9 days with web and desktop control.

summary: Camera monitor that detects heater clearance hazards and cuts power
readme_summary: AI clearance monitoring for space heaters measures distance and triggers smart-plug shutoff. SAM 3.1 segments objects, Muse Spark assesses hazards, Muse Wonder reads manuals. Python with calibration and rules.

summary: Scans loose LEGO pieces and builds guides using only owned parts.
readme_summary: Scans handfuls of bricks with quality gates, confirms inventory then generates constrained builds. Multi-photo pipeline with placement and inventory checks. Uses SAM 3.1 for masks, Muse Spark for detection and Wonder for ideas.

summary: Tree-based prompt classifier with decider, runner and logger
readme_summary: Implements decide(state, question) interface with YAML question tree, runner, and JSONL/CSV logger. Pure Python with pluggable transport stubs, no direct network calls. Designed to benchmark Jev/Clef/Spark backends via custom transports.

summary: AI-proof coding assessment that grades how candidates direct agents
readme_summary: Next.js + connector platform with staged scenarios and prompt budgets. Captures prompts and file diffs for ranked runs. Built for agentic-hiring evaluation; uses Meta AI models for task staging and review.

summary: Voice-first assistant managing Facebook Page Messenger for businesses.
readme_summary: Mume syncs with Page Messenger, drafts context-aware replies with catalog pricing and requires human confirmation. Built with Expo React Native, Express and Supabase. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Voice, Muse Image.

summary: Cross-app scam explanation layer that adds cited context under existing Meta warnings
readme_summary: Proposed safety layer for Facebook, Messenger and WhatsApp that correlates scam signals across products into one cited warning card. Frontend demo in Vite/TS renders under native alerts without reading chats or storing PII, using Meta AI models on correlation graphs and synthetic data.

summary: Crowdsourced road-hazard reporting with hazard-aware rerouting and voice control.
readme_summary: Lets drivers report potholes, flooding and accidents by photo or sentence, verifies with vision, then updates nearby maps. Backend ranks safe routes and Guardian agent reroutes mid-drive. Uses Meta vision and language models plus Supabase realtime.

summary: German writing and speaking coach with try-first corrections
readme_summary: German coach on Meta Muse models: try-first corrections, red-pen on handwriting, hands-free speaking practice. Dockerized app on port 7860 with docs and evals, MIT licensed.

summary: Turns friends swipe preferences into one shared bookable trip itinerary
readme_summary: Wander collects group preferences by pairwise swipes then an agent reconciles them into a single itinerary. Next.js app with static seed demo. Uses Muse Spark agent for preference reconciliation and trip planning.

summary: After-hours dental clinic agent that reads HMO cards, checks coverage and books.
readme_summary: Answers patient chats from clinic facts, parses HMO card photos and voice notes, then offers only open slots for booking. Python app with staff handoff and medical-query guardrails. Uses SAM 3.1 for card vision and Muse Spark for dialogue.

summary: Research workbench linking scan slices, annotations and 3D anatomy views
readme_summary: Node + web workbench for axial/coronal views, editable annotations and mask comparisons with 3D context. Single-user local prototype. Uses Meta AI for draft region proposals for expert review only.

summary: Turns photos of sari-sari store credit notebooks into verified digital ledgers locally
readme_summary: Notebook-to-ledger agent that keeps handwritten utang habit: photo -> sharp preprocessing -> local Muse Glimmer 30B Vision extract -> Zod validation with centavo math -> human review with gutter UI -> atomic Supabase commit. Stack is Next.js + Supabase.

summary: Photo-to-store PWA that digitizes local shop menus for semantic search
readme_summary: BarrioAI photographs menus/chalkboards to create geolocated store listings with WhatsApp contact. Built with Next.js 16, Tailwind, Supabase PostGIS/pgvector and Leaflet. Uses Meta Model API vision with JSON schema for product extraction.

summary: Browser guide that watches learner screen and points to the right element.
readme_summary: End-to-end lesson for first Muse Spark API call with screen-watching overlay guidance. Next.js 14 web plus Chrome MV3 extension, Python pipeline and Supabase. Uses real Muse Spark runtime prompts and step-anchor mapping.

summary: Turns recipes into priced, source-backed vendor order drafts with eval checks
readme_summary: TypeScript baseline that converts recipes to ingredient needs and priced vendor drafts with offline behavioral checks. Stack is Node 22, Mastra, npm with evals and synthetic demo. Uses Meta recipe-extraction eval; frontend, live matching and exports are planned.

summary: Discord bot that sorts chat into topics with summaries and long-term memory
readme_summary: Coconerd ingests Discord messages via Python API, classifies topics and generates summaries/actions with an AI worker backed by Postgres. Stack is Python backend/worker, Discord bot, and React/TypeScript web with Meta AI for classification.

summary: Describe a watch rule in words; camera monitor speaks when it happens.
readme_summary: Python server plus static web client that checks camera frames every few seconds against a natural-language rule. Converts speech to text, evaluates vision with Meta models, and alerts by voice. Built with Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse models.

summary: Newsletter-to-posts reader app with private email alias to declutter inbox
readme_summary: Gives newsletters a separate home outside main inbox. Creates account with private email alias, ingests subscriptions into readable posts. Stack includes Python backend, Docker/GCP deploy, mobile native client, web frontend.

summary: Muse shopping agent that verifies offers on Solana before one-click USDC buy
readme_summary: Next.js + Drizzle marketplace where Muse Spark shopper agent queries sales agents and verifies seller, ownership, and price on-chain. Single Solana transaction pays USDC, fee, moves Metaplex Core NFT, and records order.

summary: Points phone camera at machines to get spoken steps with live part outlines
readme_summary: Mobile app that transcribes a spoken question, identifies equipment from camera photo and guides repair step-by-step. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech and Muse Spark for visual grounding with camera verification. Node server plus web client.

summary: Verifies AI videos for defects with frame-exact findings and fixes
readme_summary: Provider-agnostic video verification engine that checks AI-generated videos for visual defects and caption mismatches, linking each issue to timestamp with repair plans and regression tests. Web workbench with Docker deploy and demo contracts.

summary: Live classes turn into recaps with a tutor that remembers every session
readme_summary: Flask/FastAPI class server plus Flutter Android app and web client with shared memory. Runs on Muse Spark in cloud or Llama 3.2 on-device via LiteRT-LM. Exposes memory to any AI app through MCP server and tokens.

summary: Runs 30B-100B+ MoE models offline from USB by streaming only active experts
readme_summary: Portable runtime that runs large MoE models on low-RAM laptops fully offline from USB drives. Patches llama.cpp CPU MoE kernel for concurrent expert streaming plus striping and planner. Reports fit and placement before download with measured tuning.

summary: Multi-camera video intelligence system for perimeter alerts and forensics
readme_summary: VI Sentry is a VMS that ingests multi-stream CCTV for live detection, spatial-perimeter alerts and agentic forensic search. Architecture uses SAM 3.1/SAM 2, SigLIP 2, LangGraph, FastAPI, Supabase, Qdrant and MinIO with Telegram bot. Muse Spark powers reasoning.

summary: Agent that diagnoses broken TLS certs, fixes them and proves the repair
readme_summary: Java TLS operator scans HTTPS endpoints, then Muse Spark via Meta Model API decides tool actions. Policy gate controls execution with backup, verify and auto-rollback. Supports on-prem Muse Glimmer via Ollama with full reasoning timeline.

summary: Pre-power PCB safety gate with vision fault detection and live dashboard
readme_summary: FastAPI WebSocket backend with Modal serverless and Baseten inference for PCB inspection to IPC-A-610G Class 3. Uses muse-spark-1.3 and Llama 3.2 Vision for safety gating and predictive fault detection with screenshots.

summary: AI software team that turns descriptions into live apps via agent rooms
readme_summary: Ori runs Direction, Design Studio, build and QA agents to produce clickable prototypes and live apps. All agents run on Meta Muse models, accessed via web or Muse Code connector. Prompts and rules stay on Ori server.

summary: Browser slit-lamp simulator that scores trainee eye examinations
readme_summary: Describe disease, examine rendered eye and fundus, get scored for ophthalmology training. Browser client plus server with eye-model rendering. Live demo site with patient conversation flow and cataract and fundus visuals.

summary: Self-hosted Go gateway unifying providers behind one OpenAI endpoint.
readme_summary: Go backend with web dashboard providing OpenAI-compatible routing, failover combos, keys, quotas, and cost tracking. Translates requests per provider and refreshes OAuth tokens. Aggregates Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini and other OpenAI-compatible APIs.

summary: Small speculative model that predicts agent actions to skip LLM calls
readme_summary: Learns from agent traces to predict next actions, calling Muse Spark only on low confidence, with replayable eval harness. Python package with SAM 3.1 masks for state and published negative-result metrics. Cuts calls from 92 to 49 per episode at 0.96 success.

summary: Converts field repair photos into human-reviewed QuickBooks invoice lines
readme_summary: Pipeline photographs repair scene, runs SAM 3.1 detection with overlay verification, drafts lines via contributor VLM, and posts to QuickBooks sandbox after human review. Every step hashed with receipts; zero production writes.

summary: Voice-first story starter that turns spoken answers into a verified story bible with sky visual
readme_summary: Asks what's the first thing you see, transcribes with Muse Voice Transcribe, then Muse Spark extracts people/places/questions with exact-quote verification. Cloudflare Workers + static fallback client.

summary: Voice-first camera assistant that describes surroundings aloud
readme_summary: Tap once then talk: captures phone camera photo, transcribes speech question and speaks vision answer. Built with Muse Spark for vision and Muse Voice Transcribe, web frontend with sleepy backend.

summary: Turns one clothing photo into multilingual listings and fashion images
readme_summary: For phone resellers: one garment photo becomes English-French-Spanish listing copy plus fashion images. Next.js app built during hackathon, only uses visible or confirmed details.

summary: 1v1 strategy game where natural language orders drive multi-agent 3D battles.
readme_summary: SIGNAL WAR takes commander strategy text through Spark strategist to role-based Glimmer executors with engine adjudication. Results are illustrated with Muse Image and archived in a match archive. Stack is Python FastAPI backend with web 3D frontend.

summary: AR zodiac scanning app that collects real-life meetings as game memories.
readme_summary: Scan zodiac hoodies to spawn AR creatures, save illustrated memories and grow a farm game. Static JS + WebAR frontend on Netlify, voice-first with no signup, using Meta models for daily horoscopes and art.

summary: Flight-route evidence checker that verifies weather and airspace risks.
readme_summary: Answers if verified evidence exists for a route and date across weather, ash, strikes and airspace risk. TypeScript web app with browser voice input where Muse Voice transcribes and Muse models aggregate evidence strength.

summary: Local-first agent that performs reviewed, verifiable actions on your own PC.
readme_summary: INTI AI is a local-first agent platform with reviewed actions and verifiable results. Built with Python 3.12/FastAPI backend and React 19/Vite frontend with Windows agent pairing. Uses Meta Muse models for planning with local security enforcement.

summary: Runs Windows commands with deadline and kills full process tree on timeout
readme_summary: Rust Windows utility with zero third-party crates to run commands under finite deadline. Terminates entire process tree reliably at timeout. Includes CI, measurement docs and policy; Apache 2.0, Rust 1.88+.

summary: Daily visual diary that logs what you consume and repaints it as shareable art
readme_summary: Consumed logs meals, books and music by photo or search into one daily page. Muse Spark extracts structured item JSON and Muse Image repaints entries in gouache style for a social feed and sealed daily capsule.

summary: Simulates wildfire spread from satellite perimeter to prioritize firefighting resources
readme_summary: Wind- and terrain-aware spread simulation starting from early satellite perimeter to predict buildings and roads at risk. Reasoning model compares what-if wind-shift scenarios and explains response priorities. Validated against historical fire, built with Streamlit.

summary: Converts trading claims into testable rules and backtests them on Binance data
readme_summary: Paste a tip, screenshot or clip to get whether it survives real market history. Muse Spark compiles claims into rules and audits results, tested against Binance data. Python backend with live web app and evaluation corpus.

summary: Photo-to-3D reconstruction with reproducible fidelity and placement evaluation metrics
readme_summary: WOM turns a photo into an explorable 3D world via the WOMPar reference pipeline. WOMetrics scores fidelity, placement, asset quality, camera consistency, reliability, cost and time with saved evidence. Supports Muse, OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, and AI3D with one-key demo at wom.quest.

summary: Measures bridge vibration frequencies from smartphone video for review
readme_summary: SETU validates phone video then tracks subpixel displacement to compute PSD and modal peaks for infrastructure screening. Python pipeline uses SAM 3.1 for target segmentation and flags anomalies for engineer inspection.

summary: Guarded trilingual shop assistant with deterministic dummy booking engine
readme_summary: Static browser demo with Node prototype for English, Malay, and Tamil enquiries. Muse Spark Open via Baseten handles phrasing only; local engine owns availability and booking records. Includes replay evidence and tests.

summary: Distills Claude technical interviewer into low-cost open 9B model
readme_summary: CodePraxis runs AI technical interviews with one JSON-move LLM call over structured prompt and rubric. Goal is fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Muse Glimmer 30B on Fireworks to match Claude Opus at lower cost and latency. Includes demo and eval write-up.

summary: AI CFO for African distributors that finds profit leaks and forecasts cash-flow risk.
readme_summary: ProfitPilot AI investigates profit leaks, verifies financial evidence and anticipates cash-flow risk with next actions. Stack is FastAPI backend with Next.js frontend and pytest suite. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for financial reasoning and evidence verification.

summary: Evidence-seeking agent that diagnoses electrical panels or abstains safely
readme_summary: Diagnostic agent for electrical-panel incidents using observe-uncertainty-evidence-diagnose loop. Muse Spark selects tools and only diagnoses when evidence suffices. Python backend with frontend and traceable outputs.

summary: Cuts agent API costs 21-37% while verifying task performance holds
readme_summary: Harness with caching and reasoning policies plus eval suite measuring cost per run vs tasks passed. Python harness/serve CLI, Docker, eval and docs/RESULTS.md. Tested on muse-spark-1.3 with Muse API integration docs.

summary: Turns git history and AI sessions into verifiable candidate evidence reports
readme_summary: Attest links git commits and imported AI session events into a SHA-256 chained report at attest.sh/v/handle. Scores use only Supported to Contradicted with quotes. Vite React frontend served by Cloudflare Worker with API package.

summary: Packing-bench vision that reconciles parcel contents against barcode scans.
readme_summary: BeforeTheTape watches bench clips to verify packed items, writes custody receipts and checks returns. TypeScript pnpm workspace. Uses SAM 3.1 for parcel/item tracking and Muse Spark 1.3 for nested packing reasoning and catalog match.

summary: Vietnamese personal finance coach that tracks GROW commitments and nudges
readme_summary: Valo Agent is a Vietnamese finance coaching agent with persistent profile, GROW framework and deadline commitments. Node/Express server with deterministic calculation engine and adapter for valo-financial-context. Uses Muse Spark only for narration.

summary: Click a bug in Unity play mode to segment it and auto-fix a branched scene copy
readme_summary: StillWrong is a Unity Editor package for click-to-fix gameplay bugs. SAM 3.1 segments the clicked object, Muse Spark via Meta Model API plans the scene fix on a git branch copy. MIT licensed with Unity package, docs, and YouTube demo.

summary: Verified AI shopping with signed offers settled via Solana and NFTs
readme_summary: Shopping agents verify signed merchant offers, seller identity, NFT ownership and listing photos. Settles USDC, fee and Metaplex Core NFT transfer in one Solana transaction, also as Actions/Blinks. Next.js, Drizzle, SIWS auth, Muse Spark vision.

summary: Compares satellite images over time and audits its own change measurements
readme_summary: Time-Fold takes before/after satellite views, uses SAM 3.1 to detect objects and areas, then Muse Spark 1.2 audits detections and writes honest report with stats and annotated images.

summary: Community career agent that matches goals and turns introductions into collaborations
readme_summary: Tulay (bridge) is a Philippines-first career mobility agent built with Next.js, TypeScript and Supabase. AI helps with language while deterministic code handles matching, consent and state. Uses Meta Muse Spark muse-spark-1.3 for structured assistance.

summary: Real-time two-way speech translator where each person hears their language.
readme_summary: Samvaad enables table mode and two-phone rooms for cross-language conversation. It uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech-to-text and Muse Spark for context-aware translation. Built with Next.js 16, Tailwind, monorepo packages and hosted rooms.

summary: Turns a photo of everyday objects into a playable browser fantasy quest
readme_summary: Browser game that captures a photo or short video, detects objects and generates fantasy art and quests. REALMFORGE LIVE uses surroundings as controls and starting point. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 vision and Muse Image generation.

summary: Voice-first migraine diary that builds printable doctor summaries
readme_summary: Quietlog is an agentic diary where voice or text logs are extracted to structured fields and PDF summaries. FastAPI + SQLite backend with Expo React Native app and Open-Meteo snapshots. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0.

summary: Turns notes and docs into taught courses with labs and quizzes
readme_summary: Phone-first learning app where Learn builds subjects, mastery levels, coding labs and practice from user materials. Plans units, teaches lessons and summarizes notes adapted to level. Uses Meta models via server API.

summary: Turns one class session into slides, reference card, podcast, and question bank.
readme_summary: Eight-stage multi-agent pipeline producing deck, one-pager, podcast, and question bank with verifier and instructor review gate. Python Flask app with Canvas and Kahoot exporters. Uses Meta models for generation and verification.

summary: Agentic team that turns operation videos into tested apps via sandbox and audit
readme_summary: FIELD analyzes uploaded operation video visual and audio, asks questions, generates spec and working app. React Vite plus FastAPI and SQLite MVP, runs in E2B sandbox with adversarial Muse Spark audit via Meta Model API.

summary: Marketplace where specialized agents offer skills and hire each other
readme_summary: Internet of Agents where builders teach agents a trade and list them for hire by other agents. Enables discovery, delegation and payment for idle specialized agents. Built with Next.js frontend and agent infra.

summary: Hands-free AR repair guide that labels parts and checks each fix step by voice.
readme_summary: Uses headset camera photos to detect job parts and pin AR labels, with wake-word voice interaction. Walks through diagnosis one test at a time with step verification. Uses Meta AI vision for part detection and voice models for hands-free dialogue.

summary: Natural-language instructions become tested ROS 2 robot behaviors.
readme_summary: Robotics IDE that converts natural language to ROS 2 behaviors, runs them in simulation, and helps debug failures. React + TypeScript web with Python API, Docker and ROS 2 Jazzy workspace. Uses Meta AI / Muse for code generation and failure diagnosis.

summary: Predicts likely switch actions so ALS users need fewer presses
readme_summary: Uses Meta Muse Spark to predict 4 most likely next actions to cut switch-scanning presses, including vision-only screenshot mode. Backend evaluator showed 63% fewer presses over 24 runs vs traditional scanning.

summary: Films physics experiments to track motion and discover predictive laws as code
readme_summary: Kepler tracks moving objects frame-by-frame with SAM 3.1 and converts pixels to meters. Muse Spark generates candidate physics functions as Python code, then tests them on unseen frames. Python pipeline built in 5 days.

summary: Fantasy basketball scout that checks film to validate players before roster moves
readme_summary: Autonomous fantasy basketball scouting desk that shortlists players, inspects permitted film, and stages guarded roster moves. Local-first FastAPI + frontend stack with Sleeper integration and loopback-only security. Uses Meta API clients for live scans with no simulated fallback.

summary: Comparison site for AI coding plans, API prices and model value rankings
readme_summary: Docs site comparing China/global Coding Plans and API per-token pricing with value rankings from benchmarks. Data with source links and verification dates. Built with Node, pnpm and static site generator.

summary: AI stylist that builds outfits from real stock and try-on photos.
readme_summary: Embeddable fashion agent that understands requests with Muse Spark vision, searches catalog, checks fit, and renders shoppable try-on images with self-inspection fixes. TypeScript stack with live Vercel demo.

summary: Livestock triage app that grades cow photos by urgency and tracks disease clusters.
readme_summary: Next.js app where farmer uploads cow photo for Muse Spark 1.3 reading and SAM 3.1 lesion segmentation. Sets monitor/vet_visit/isolate urgency, writes vet note and maps county clusters. Gives no treatment advice; vet must examine animal.

summary: Turns road photos into repair work orders with damage measurement and checks
readme_summary: Upload road photo and pin to detect defects, measure severity, add location context and verify repair. Pipeline uses Muse Spark 1.3 for detection plus SAM 3.1 segmentation and tool calls. Built for Rajkot with human confirmation.

summary: Evidence-backed engineering investigation platform with visual workspaces
readme_summary: FDE Command Center combines source provenance, competing hypotheses, diagnostic predictions and graphical evidence exploration. Python backend server serves local web UI with seven investigation workspaces and synthetic demo data.

summary: Teaches Python via source-linked lessons, live execution and bounded tutoring.
readme_summary: Uses bounded teaching and research agents over RAG sources to guide Python lessons. Learners use editable workspace with real execution and step visualization. Backend rules constrain agent actions; no mastery claims.

summary: Simulates both life choices five years ahead, then gives one action for today.
readme_summary: Futurial learns a user's life decision, generates two detailed 5-year futures, then suggests one real-world action. Built with Next.js/TypeScript, uses Muse Spark for reasoning, Muse Wonder for validation and Muse Image for future visuals.

summary: Causal debugger that replays agent traces with interventions to isolate root causes
readme_summary: Counterfactual Lab debugs AI agents by generating hypotheses, compiling interventions, and replaying traces with and without fixes. Stack is FastAPI backend on 8010 and Next.js workbench on 3010. Uses Muse family via Meta Model API and Baseten open-weights.

summary: Browser debugger that proposes fixes and replays to verify them
readme_summary: SI ORBIT investigates controlled web UI failures by collecting browser logs and source evidence. It asks Meta Muse Spark to propose a repair, applies a scoped patch to a temp copy, then replays the interaction for verification. Stack is Python backend, frontend, fixtures and browser replay tests.

summary: Local lab to design filament coils and compare magnetic field optimizations
