readme_summary: FusionPilot is a local TypeScript lab for exploring eight parameterized filament coils with Biot-Savart field calculation. Runs in browser via Vite plus Web Worker with no backend required. No Meta AI integration is used; analysis is deterministic physics simulation.

summary: Voice-interrogation detective game that trains cross-examination with AI suspects.
readme_summary: Generates solvable crime cases with searchable scenes and voice-questionable AI suspects. Built with Next.js/TypeScript, it tracks contradictions and debriefs questioning technique. Uses Meta Muse models for case generation and suspect agents.

summary: Tests if phones add signal to aurora and geomagnetic storm tracking
readme_summary: AuroraSense fuses NASA CME forecasts, NOAA aurora/solar-wind models, magnetometers and phone sensors. Web demo with historical replay evaluates whether quality-controlled phones aid regional disturbance detection. Hypothesis remains unresolved prototype.

summary: Physics home where Motivo robot must re-check memory by looking
readme_summary: Scout is a physics-simulated home testing robot memory truth with branching episodes and object moves. Meta Motivo humanoid uses SAM 3.1 head camera plus memory of seen locations. Python stack evaluates memory-only vs look-and-verify answers.

summary: Dating app with AI interviews and evidence-grounded compatibility scoring
readme_summary: React+Vite + Express/PostgreSQL dating app where Muse Spark interviews users, builds profiles, and scores compatibility with quoted evidence. Backend enforces scoring rules and generates first-date ideas.

summary: Investigates payment incidents from alerts into cited escalations
readme_summary: Autonomous L2 investigator turning voice notes and screenshots into verified reports via SQL, logs and metrics. Python backend with web UI and sandbox. Uses Meta Muse models to correlate evidence and cite every claim.

summary: Self-improving agent that turns recurring chores into reusable verified skills.
readme_summary: Medha converts recurring chores into verified versioned executable skills that it reuses and composes. Built with Meta Muse Glimmer open-weights self-hosted on Modal and Muse Spark 1.3 as judge. Uses Modal Sandboxes for execution.

summary: Predicts taste and cooking of cheese blends from flavor chemistry
readme_summary: Streamlit app models 171 cheeses with aroma compounds, salt, fat, moisture and sourced data. Muse reads research, engine predicts taste, smell and melt for any mix. Stack is Python, Streamlit and Railway.

summary: Matches supplier invoices to ERP exports with status, cause and audit trace.
readme_summary: Reads supplier invoices and credit notes from PDFs including scans, matches to ERP AP export at document and line level with status and actions. Python + Streamlit review queue with Tesseract OCR. Deterministic engine, 16/16 correct on sample.

summary: Autonomous colleague turning messy instructions into verified work with receipts
readme_summary: Python 3.12 agent framework that converts instructions into agreed contracts, executes with authority limits, then independently verifies. Model-agnostic, powered by Hyeve.

summary: Analyzes site photos into segmented overlays with quantity and cost report
readme_summary: Construction analyzer that turns one or six room photos into segmented overlay with quantity, cost and defects in English, Urdu or Arabic. Frontend plus backend perceive-measure-price pipeline with mock mode. Uses SAM 3 masks and Meta open weights for measurement and reporting.

summary: Multilingual tutor that adapts lessons to language and level
readme_summary: Educational platform localized in 25 languages that rewrites PDFs/docs to learner level, offers 24/7 text tutor with image analysis, and generates illustrations. Node.js + frontend stack. Uses Muse Spark Open and Muse Image.

summary: Multi-agent system investigates scientific contradictions on evidence board
readme_summary: SciSleuth AI coordinates 6 agents to cross-reference papers, lab data and archives. FastAPI backend with Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning renders results on an interactive evidence board UI.

summary: Glasses-based scribe that drafts vet SOAP notes hands-free in exam room
readme_summary: Listens via Meta AI glasses, captures photos on voice command and drafts SOAP notes, vitals and follow-ups. SAM 3.1 outlines lesions, day assistant reads brief. Built with Muse models, pnpm monorepo and iOS glasses app.

summary: Inference gateway routing client requests to configured model providers
readme_summary: Fork of CLIProxyAPI providing unified inference gateway with key auth and model aliases plus web cockpit. Part of planned NeoCore/NeoDeck/NeoPi ecosystem. Works as model-agnostic router compatible with Muse and other provider APIs.

summary: Trucking TMS with Muse assistant for rate confirmations, CDL and dispatch work
readme_summary: NeWay is a production transportation management system for trucking carriers used by 120-truck and 4-truck fleets. For the hackathon Meta Muse powers NeWay AI assistant for rate confirmations, CDL entry, and POD tracking. Monorepo with apps, infra, and architecture docs.

summary: Turns plain-language event descriptions into executable programs over video
readme_summary: ActionOS Studio workspace with Agent compiler and Engine API for perception and temporal evaluation. Stack is FastAPI, FFmpeg with scdet filters, and Next.js frontend; Meta AI compiles video programs for clip and timestamp reports.

summary: Converts Burp traffic exports into ranked evidence-backed bug reports
readme_summary: Copilot that parses Burp XML/HAR, filters noise, runs heuristic detectors, then Muse Spark reviews with RAG references. Pipeline validates evidence, supports human triage, and outputs submission-ready bounty reports.

summary: Interactive illustrated mystery with timed choices and verifiable story commitment.
readme_summary: SEALED is a paced mystery where three 12-second decisions shape endings, verified by SHA-256 commitment. Monorepo with TypeScript apps/packages; demo uses a Meta-generated reviewed story with no live key.

summary: Autonomous agent that audits APIs against GDPR, HIPAA, OWASP and NIST.
readme_summary: Ingests security policies once then auto-audits API estate against GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, OWASP Top 10 and SOC 2. Full-stack with backend, frontend, Redis and Postman collection. Powered by Meta muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for audit reasoning.

summary: Phone-controlled coding team that proves fixes with video verification
readme_summary: Multi-agent coding team controlled from phone. Agents record acceptance flows on video, a Meta model judges criteria, SAM 3.1 marks failing elements. Human approves or rejects via LINE before merge.

summary: Detects drift between AGENTS.md docs and code with CI checks and doc fixes
readme_summary: CLI scans docs, runs deterministic checks, maps features and checks PRs against base branch. Proposes doc-only diffs and tests provider profiles including Meta API. Python Poetry project with CI and eval harness.

summary: Crop-health advisor that diagnoses maize, cassava and cocoa from leaf photos
readme_summary: Multimodal advisor for Ghana smallholders that photographs leaves/pods to give lesions, guidance and records. Stack is FastAPI backend, frontend, ML and Docker with English/Twi/Spanish, using Meta models for vision and explanation.

summary: Converts junction traffic video into twin to test better signal timings
readme_summary: Builds a SUMO digital twin from short junction video by counting vehicles by type then simulating signal plans. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark via Meta Model API with docs-first web and pipeline design.

summary: Listens to video calls and draws diagrams beside you in real time
readme_summary: AURA detects structured speech on calls and renders architecture diagrams, timelines and metrics panels as HUD overlay. Electron + server app with Chromium, webcam and mic. All runtime AI models are Meta models.

summary: 3D Earth watchlists track environmental change with forecasts and linked evidence.
readme_summary: Interactive 3D Earth for drawing boundaries, monitoring environmental change, and reviewing forecast and satellite evidence. Uses web frontend with live forecasts, NASA OPERA data, SAM 3.1 masks, and Muse Wonder briefings for explanations.

summary: Chat-first filmmaking workspace where assistant prepares work for creator review
readme_summary: Workprint provides React/React Aria frontend with review and export components. Backend is Mastra with Postgres and Supabase storage serving owned reads and uploads. Uses assistant chat to prepare filmmaking tasks for approval.

summary: Turns books or street addresses into walkable 3D worlds with live characters
readme_summary: Dreamer builds metric 3D rooms with nav and placement in code, then paints surfaces and objects in parallel. Uses Muse Image for textures, SAM 3D for objects, Muse Spark and Meta ASR for characters and voice. Engine plus app stages acted or improvised scenes.

summary: WhatsApp-based AI operator that runs recording sessions, email, calls and proofs.
readme_summary: hireMarco is a text-and-voice operator for an artist that handles studio control, email, booking and delivery. Built with Python app/src layout, it uses Muse Spark on Meta Model API with a Muse Wonder critic gated by RULES.md.

summary: Local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI coding teammates
readme_summary: Desktop workspace giving each agent its own workspace and conversation with queues, file transfer, embedded browser and agent messaging. Supports Codex App Server, Claude Code, Grok, OpenCode, Gemini and Cursor via ACP. Development preview running with full access.

summary: Life-size public-domain gallery where visitors walk inside 8 paintings.
readme_summary: Gallery of 59 Art Institute of Chicago paintings at catalogue size with 3D walk-in scenes. Python scripts build gallery, viewer and calibration. Agent inspects every scene and Muse-powered guide walks visitors to works.

summary: Roblox co-op castle defense with AI director that designs next wave
readme_summary: 1-4 player co-op castle defense on Roblox with Day and wave progression. AI director adapts waves from team play and NPC companions recall last match, built with Luau and schemas.

summary: Reproduces and patches broken ML training scripts with verified fixes
readme_summary: Runs training scripts k-times under telemetry wrappers to classify healthy, diverged or non-reproducible. Requests strict JSON diagnosis and exact-string patches, then re-runs patched code to earn verdict. Verification gate decides success.

summary: Migrates PHP to TypeScript with independent Oracle behavior verification.
readme_summary: Sends pinned PHP to Muse Spark 1.3 for TypeScript candidate, then Oracle checks build, HTTP and DB state. Monorepo with apps/packages and hash-pinned evidence for every verdict.

summary: Desktop notebook that turns notes and chats into tasks, reminders and expenses.
readme_summary: Electron desktop app with React renderer, Hono API on Cloudflare Workers, D1 for data and R2 for images. Extracts tasks, reminders, expenses and journal entries. Uses Meta AI via META_AI_API key; runs without it in limited mode.

summary: Researches software architecture with future requirements and verified hypotheses
readme_summary: ForeCode guides architecture decisions through a six-chapter research journey and Time Machine inspection. It is a Next.js app with local import, workspaces, and tournament verification. It uses Meta-generated hypotheses with independent verification checks.

summary: Trading-card authenticity checker that shows evidence or says unsure
readme_summary: Static web app that reads structured card crops with Muse Spark and Muse Wonder for authenticity verdicts. Shows evidence UI with demo, bulk and grading modes, preferring Inconclusive over guessing.

summary: Daily heavy-rain forecast for Rio Pance with citizen photo and text confirmations
readme_summary: Publishes daily probability of 20mm+ rain and 3-day landslide signal for Cali, Colombia. Citizens submit text/photo reports structured by Muse Spark with plain-language explanations. Python stack with verifiable code-based trust scoring, not model-judged.

summary: Anonymous study-buddy matcher with nicknames and AI avatars for students.
readme_summary: StudBuds matches college students by .edu email using nicknames and Muse-generated avatars. A survey and calendar rank compatible study sessions. Built during hackathon with Netlify frontend and Supabase backend.

summary: AI bench tester that generates worlds to probe PLC logic faults
readme_summary: Controls-engineer workstation for AI-assisted closed-loop PLC testing. Muse generates machine world from spec and I/O contract, operates OPC UA/CODESYS Control Win and HMI, preserves PDFs and HTML evidence. Uses Muse Wonder 1.0.

summary: Turns one pet photo into a 3D Mac desktop companion that reacts to work
readme_summary: PixyPup converts a dog or cat photo into a 3D companion that walks, naps and does tricks on macOS. Built with Electron Vite, native modules and contracts. Privacy-first with screen and voice off by default.

summary: Local lab to watch and steer Muse-Glimmer internals while it acts as agent
readme_summary: Glimmer Lab runs open-weights Muse-Glimmer-30B on a custom Mojo inference kernel with activation readouts and steering. Includes a durable Pi agent, web lab UI, and Harness adapter to improve frozen-weight agents without training.

summary: Desktop app for AI films with recurring actors using local ComfyUI and MiniMax.
readme_summary: IV Studio is a free Infinite Variance Electron desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux. It runs MiniMax H3 video workflows on the user's own ComfyUI setup for consistent characters. Includes packaged installers, docs and skills.

summary: Floor-plan checker that measures rooms across revisions with replayable proof
readme_summary: PicCompare AEC Agent measures and matches rooms across two plan versions, reporting changes only when verifiable. Python + MCP/skills architecture produces fingerprinted reports for re-run verification.

summary: Phone app that explains car problems in plain English and safety guidance.
readme_summary: Android and web app takes symptom text, codes, dash photos and OBD data to give safety verdict and cost estimate. Safety rules set minimum caution with evidence display. Uses Meta AI / Muse for diagnosis and explanation.

summary: Tool tracking legislative bills with samples and evaluations.
readme_summary: Tool tracking legislative bills with samples and evaluations.

summary: Agentic framework to diagnose underwater robot failures in simulation
readme_summary: Combines planar AUV physics simulator, numerical fault diagnosis, experiment planning and controller revision testing with Three.js replay. Provides auditable evidence. Uses Meta Muse tool activity for planning and engineering.

summary: Head-mounted cooking coach tracks recipe steps using video world model
readme_summary: Watches HD-EPIC cooking video with V-JEPA 2 ViT-L and EK100 probe for per-second actions, HSMM step tracker, and checklist memory. Llama-based coach decides what to say and when, compared side-by-side in a web demo.

summary: AI security agent that finds weaknesses, fixes them and proves the fix
readme_summary: Aegis is Agentic Enterprise Guard for InfoSec built for the Meta hackathon. It autonomously finds vulnerabilities, applies fixes and verifies they hold. Containerized architecture with guardrails for enterprise security workflows.

summary: Agent-assisted video editor where you direct and the AI builds playable cuts
readme_summary: Video editor where an AI coding agent logs footage, proposes directions and builds cuts. Time is anchored to words, beats and clip moments with auto re-timing. Uses Muse Code / Codex / Claude agents for editing via in-app tools.

summary: Socratic Java OOP mentor for labs with lecturer telemetry dashboard
readme_summary: Zero-install AI mentor that guides students through errors without giving raw code, plus realtime lecturer dashboard. Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, Supabase, and MCP IDE connection. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for Socratic tutoring.

summary: Hands-free Mac voice control for apps, clicks, dictation and reading.
readme_summary: Native Swift macOS app for voice control of apps, tabs, buttons and dictation with numbered overlays. Processes on-device UI automation and speech commands. Built for Meta hackathon; voice interface with accessibility APIs.

summary: Compares purchases by price, shipping, returns and warranty together
readme_summary: Local Next.js prototype comparing total purchase picture across retailers using sample data only. App Router + TypeScript with plain CSS, no live prices or checkout. Built as hackathon Stage 1 demo with browser-local simulation.

summary: Android keyboard that converts plucked guitar notes into keystrokes anywhere
readme_summary: GuitarWiter is an InputMethodService WebView keyboard using native AudioRecord plus YIN pitch detection. Llama 3.2 1B on-device adapter with Android bridge for offline help. Verified by 254 Node tests.

summary: Audits leases and documents rental damage with tamper-evident proof
readme_summary: LeaseLens reviews lease clauses across DE, UK, US_NY, FR, JP and builds SAM-based deposit evidence with SHA-256 hashing. Backend/frontend with test assets. Uses SAM 3.1 for vision damage proof and Muse Spark with Muse Voice for zero-hallucination audit.

summary: Marketplace to buy apps once, host them and customize in plain language
readme_summary: Rust marketplace where owners buy source code, host on Fly.io, and customize via chat. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for app review scoring and file rewrites with staging preview.

summary: Webcam turns any desk into a tap-to-play air piano and drums
readme_summary: Browser instrument using webcam hand-tracking so fingertip taps trigger sounds. Node + Vite + Chrome stack with Tone.js samples. Uses Meta Model API optionally for extended features.

summary: Verifies physical actions and visual causality with captured evidence
readme_summary: Evidence-aware system to prove what happened and detect missing steps in physical actions. Python backend with frontend, Rust optional kernels, evaluation suite, 217 tests. Built for Meta Hackathon 2026 as verification layer.

summary: Fits AI-generated 3D outfits onto fixed MPFB bodies deterministically
readme_summary: Fits Trellis/Pixal3D/Rodin outfits onto four MPFB bodies using local deterministic math. Uses SAM 3.1 for part labeling before fitting and Muse Wonder for post-fit review. Includes safe intake, canonical framing, and 72-frame turntable views.

summary: Local control plane that safely enrolls and manages owned routers with receipts
readme_summary: Continuum is a single-binary Mac control plane for owned routers with enrollment, commissioning and reversible CAKE shaping. It reconciles effects and refuses unsafe changes with typed reasons. Uses Meta models only for proposed plans, gated by owner permissions.

summary: Inspectable pass-fail checks for physical workflows with recovery
readme_summary: Turns procedures into executable checks yielding pass/fail/unknown and searches action model for corrections. Python package with examples and replay scripts. Uses Muse Spark to draft checks and SAM 3.1 to ground image observations.

summary: Sealed 6MB file storing signed AI agent work with offline verification
readme_summary: Rust capsule with no doors that logs Muse Spark agent steps as signed pages. Includes SAM 3.1 mask logging and offline check tools. Demo uses synthetic insurance claim with human review.

summary: iOS food companion that remembers tastes and explains restaurant picks
readme_summary: What to eat! is an iOS app with Otis companion for personalized restaurant decisions. It pairs ML history analysis with Meta Muse for explanations, using Swift mobile plus API and Supabase backend.

summary: Sealed 6MB file storing signed AI agent work with offline verification
readme_summary: Rust capsule with no doors that logs Muse Spark agent steps as signed pages. Includes SAM 3.1 mask logging and offline check tools. Demo uses synthetic insurance claim with human review.

summary: Furnish a room by talking to it in browser or Quest VR
readme_summary: Talk-to-design interior app at true scale in browser or Meta Quest using 736 mojulo furniture models. Dependency-free Node server. Uses Meta Model API Muse models to design rooms from natural language.

summary: AI security agent that audits owned sites with evidence and human-approved fixes
readme_summary: MAYA runs safe non-destructive checks on user-verified targets and produces severity-ranked reports with proof. Python service with ownership verification, re-test loop, and eval harness. Uses Muse models for explanation and patch proposals with human approval.

summary: Native macOS canvas browser where Muse can read, click and type for you.

summary: Maps urban heat and tree sites across 34 municipalities with satellite AI
readme_summary: Couples satellite thermal sensing with Meta SAM 2.1 to mitigate urban heat islands. Python app with data pipelines and docs recommends where to plant trees. Uses Meta AI vision segmentation over free Earth Engine data.

summary: Cheap-first router experiment that compares Muse tiers on held-out prompts.
readme_summary: Routing evaluation harness with tune and holdout sets, format and confidence guards, and saved outcomes. Built in Python with router, notebooks and results. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer 30B tiers to measure routing policy.

summary: Closed-loop SRE agent that diagnoses and fixes bottlenecks in sandboxes
readme_summary: Aegis SRE detects, diagnoses and remediates performance bottlenecks and API breaks via sandbox-verified patches. Python agent with Modal micro-VMs. Uses Meta Muse Spark as reasoning core with deterministic verification.

summary: Lecture notes agent that cites and verifies every claim from sources
readme_summary: Electron desktop app that transcribes lectures with Muse Voice Transcribe and summarizes with Muse Spark under strict JSON citation schema. Each sentence must cite audio timestamps or slide pages and is re-checked. Flags unsupported text as not in sources.

summary: Browser-local 3D garden where time-locked letters grow into voxel trees
readme_summary: Next.js 16, React 19 and Three.js time-capsule garden with local sealed letters revealed by date. Voxel trees grow per letter on a floating island. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for letter content assistance.

summary: Agent that generates and verifies fast Metal kernels for PyTorch ops
readme_summary: MetalMind proposes Apple Silicon Metal kernels then numerically checks and benchmarks them vs PyTorch. Verified kernels cached for offline reuse with fallback. Uses Meta Muse Wonder via Model API.

summary: On-device voice trading assistant that calls tools and drives trading screens
readme_summary: Leaps Voice Agent runs Llama 3.2 1B on Android for hands-free trading with tool calling. Fine-tuned on tool-call traces generated by Muse Spark. Synthetic market backend keeps 14 tools consistent for eval.

summary: Parent-led bedtime story generator with characters, themes and age bands
readme_summary: Static web app where parents pick character, theme and age to preview read-aloud stories. Built with HTML and AI agent folder, using Meta AI for age-adapted short tales with audio readout.

summary: Draw a platformer level on paper, photo it, and play it in the browser
readme_summary: Paper Worlds turns hand-drawn levels into playable platformers plus a hand-tracked Asteroid Surf mode. Built with Next.js and TypeScript, it uses SAM 3.1 for drawing segmentation, Muse Spark for game logic and rules, and Muse Voice Transcribe for spoken rules.

summary: Founder platform taking ideas from discovery to validation and launch plan
readme_summary: Startum AI SaaS platform with Discover, Research, Validate, Plan flow on shared project data. Uses Validation Autopilot agent, voice interviews and pitches, plus Muse Image + SAM 3.1 brand visuals.

summary: Fleet management for Lumajang truckers with breakdown alerts and hands-free voice commands
readme_summary: FMS AI Lumajang is a Go-based fleet system for local truck drivers to prevent breakdowns and traffic delays. It uses Meta Muse Spark, Voice and Image via Telegram and web for hands-free diagnostics and dispatch.

summary: Turns research briefs into adaptive surveys and AI-moderated interviews.
readme_summary: ChoiceGap generates editable surveys and voice/typed interview guides from a brief with tool-called comparisons and member-checks. Built in Python with Meta Muse for moderation, linking findings to response IDs.

summary: Multi-agent bus chat and workflow manager with human approval control
readme_summary: Multi-model ecosystem where specialized agents share context via bus chat and workflows route tasks with human authority gates. Implements dashboard, agents, context store and Muse Spark bridge for META Edition.

summary: Desktop buddy watches your window and critiques design revisions
readme_summary: Windows Electron prototype that observes a selected window and discusses visual changes without editing files. Stores 12-image session history with themes and explanation levels. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for change analysis and SAM for vision.

summary: Agent tests backend fixes on a simulator and only reports verified metrics
readme_summary: LivingDiagrams investigates backend failures like retries and circuit breakers. Next.js app with deterministic simulator engine and API; agent runs controlled experiments. Uses Muse Spark, blocked claims unless engine-recorded.

summary: Turns any room scan into a story-driven treasure hunt with talking clues
readme_summary: Builds a titled story with five characters, riddles and final lock from 20s scan or photos. Next.js frontend lets hosts hide gifts and pin objects. Built during hackathon using Meta AI for clue generation.

summary: Source-linked workspace coordinating construction review comments and revisions
readme_summary: Schema is coordination workspace for commercial construction teams powered by Muse Spark 1.3. Keeps reviewer wording, source files, owners and review status in one saved record. Cloudflare Workers app with human-in-loop apply.

summary: Conversational invoicing wizard with deterministic verifier for ERP billing
readme_summary: Verifiable module of Kreo.One agentic ERP SaaS for creating invoices via chat. Uses Muse Spark as planner, stdlib-only Python deterministic tools for computation, and a verifier gate before transmission. Live demo at factura.kreo.lat with 20-case suite.

summary: Generates lip-synced UGC video ads in Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo
readme_summary: Turns a product into storyboarded vertical talking-head video adverts with native script and caption. Multi-agent pipeline for research, scripting, and video editing deployed on Cloudflare Workers and Pages. Uses Meta models for language and video generation.

summary: Policy gateway enforcing value-level Rule-of-Two for shopping agents
readme_summary: Gateway between an unmodified shopping agent and merchant that enforces user intent at commit time. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for intent checks and Llama Prompt Guard 2 for poisoned content, with approver UI, evals across 46 gateway cases, and Python gateway plus shop harness.

summary: Agentic pipeline that turns one game idea into design doc, code, art and music.
readme_summary: GDD Builder runs specialized agents for GDD, code, art, review and music with RAWG/IGDB/Steam grounding. Backend plus frontend with auditable outputs and fallbacks. Uses Meta AI models for generation and review in live demo path.

summary: Visual daily planner with bubble map, tasks and voice Muse chat.
readme_summary: Visual Second Brain dashboard turns tasks and goals into editable plan with bubble map, subtasks and workspaces. Muse Spark 1.3 handles planning and drafting with web search, Muse Voice transcribes input. Frontend Vercel, backend Python uv.

summary: Voice-first Hinglish inventory and profit tracker for Indian kirana shops
readme_summary: Expo Router app where shopkeepers speak Hinglish to update stock and query profit from a Postgres event ledger. Includes auth, multi-store roles, barcode scan and server voice pipeline. Uses Muse Spark for parsing and answers.

summary: Phone visual assistant giving blind users clock-face spatial descriptions.
readme_summary: Points phone camera to segment scene with SAM 3.1 into objects, directions, distances and OCR text. Muse Spark answers with grounded descriptions via FastAPI backend and escalates to volunteers.

summary: AI visual novel maker that turns one-line ideas into playable 2D branching stories and 3D sandbox games
readme_summary: Game Forge has 2D Novel mode for branching stories with 2D art and 3D Novel sandbox mode driven by world interactions. Uses Muse Spark for writing/music/3D design, Muse Image for 2D art, Muse Wonder for 3D worlds, and SAM 3D Body for person-to-avatar.

summary: AI space scientist linking NASA archives and orbital math for missions
readme_summary: Cited research assistant for Moon/Mars missions searching Crossref, Europe PMC and NASA archives. Built with MOMAR platform, 3D voice companion and exact two-body orbital calculator. Uses Muse models for streamed answers with traceable sources.

summary: Browser workspace for early residential master planning trade-offs
readme_summary: Unbuilt visualizes site constraints, streets, lots and open space with measured quantities and costs. Browser workspace with planning assistant for layout scenarios. Uses Muse AI by Meta for planning assistance.

summary: Turns Filipino street flood photos into resident actions and ranked responder queue.
readme_summary: Analyzes submitted flood photos for depth and maps 250m risk squares for barangays. Python FastAPI app with live provider header and offline fallback. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark.

summary: Private AI representative that protects income, recovers value and runs micro-business
readme_summary: AwnNORA/MyEconomy is a modular-monolith foundation for personal economic intelligence with cashflow, identity and consent. It provides owner-scoped agents for benefits, opportunities and small enterprise ops with collective network.

summary: Household dashboard for trip planning, bill tracking, shopping and daily routines
readme_summary: LLAMA Everyday is a household dashboard for trips, bills, shopping, and routines with household connect. Built with React, Tailwind, Vite frontend and Node/server backend deployed on Vercel/Render. Uses LLAMA AI free tier for chat with 10 requests/minute, no user API key.

summary: Digital twin with optimal control linking neural perception to physical hardware.
readme_summary: AetherTwin is Next.js 14 + TypeScript app for neural-to-physical twin with LQR control and edge synthesis. Includes Vitest suite and Cloudflare Pages deploy. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for perception and Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning with ROS 2.

summary: Tiny kernel that drafts, verifies and caches WASM modules generated by Muse models
readme_summary: Runtime that loads verified pure-function modules on demand, drafting missing ones via Meta Muse under strict contract. Multi-model verification, WebAssembly sandbox, signing and cache reuse. Built for agents needing safe runtime codegen.

summary: Study and recovery gate stopping agents booking what customers did not approve
readme_summary: Measures Muse Spark agents rescheduling FieldDesk appointments under DB slowdown with SQL judging, then adds Resolve service for typed constraints and crash-safe booking. Harness, backend API, and oracle checks. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for constraint parsing.

summary: Discovers API version differences and builds a verified compatibility bridge
readme_summary: Active API-archaeology agent that probes v1 vs v2 APIs to find behavioral breaks and compiles a constrained bridge. Python stack with src/templates/scripts/tests and CI. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for analysis and bridge synthesis.

summary: Local-first workspace for bookkeeping, sales, inventory and staff payments.
readme_summary: Bucketa is a local-first React + Vite frontend with Node.js backend for small-business operations. It manages books, savings, sales, inventory and payroll with document scanning. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for chat and receipt extraction and Muse Image 1.0 for Creative Studio.

summary: Markdown workflow folder that gives coding agents shared project memory
readme_summary: Template with workflow/ Markdown for product, plan, tasks and history read by 20+ coding agents. Works with Muse Code, Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot. Uses agent-agnostic Markdown, no Meta model dependency.

summary: Messenger shop assistant that hears voice notes and matches product photos
readme_summary: Oro on Muse answers shoppers via Messenger using catalogue and rules. It uses Muse Spark 1.3 for replies, muse-voice-transcribe-1.0 for voice notes and SAM 3.1 to locate products in photos.

summary: Generates synthetic CSV data with utility and privacy trust report
readme_summary: Upload a CSV to profile schema and generate synthetic rows with SDV Gaussian Copula. Reports statistical similarity, ML utility, and privacy risk from exact and neighbor matches. Streamlit frontend with Muse Spark 1.3 validation.

summary: Browser crash-lab proving duplicate bookings from mis-scoped indexes and retries
readme_summary: StateProof CrashLab with in-browser SQLite booking tests, index mutation, and intent-identity study. Compares Muse, DeBERTa NLI and rule baselines on Redis Streams/NATS. Reproducible regression bundle.

summary: Turns a kid's drawing photo plus voice rules into a playable self-tested HTML5 game.
readme_summary: Dibujo Jugable transcribes spoken rules, segments characters with SAM and cleans sprites with Muse Image, then Muse Spark builds validated spec.json on a static game engine. Agent playtest.py plays and auto-fixes levels until winnable with live judge mode. Static HTML gallery needs no install.

summary: Closed-loop SCADA node that detects pipeline faults and triggers mitigation.
readme_summary: OmniGaze is an autonomous SCADA resilience node for industrial pipelines. It combines SAM 2.1 zero-shot segmentation with Muse Spark spatial reasoning in a LangGraph FSM. FastAPI backend with live inference, mock telemetry and SHA-256 Merkle ledger.

summary: Replans your day after disruptions with AI proposals and hard-constraint checks.
readme_summary: Muse Spark proposes schedule tradeoffs when events interrupt plans. Deterministic Python validator alone decides if hard constraints pass. React/FastAPI frontend with Streamlit fallback and browser storage.

summary: On-call agent that diagnoses broken data pipelines and proves fixes in a sandbox.
readme_summary: Investigates failures in a synthetic eyewear retailer DuckDB pipeline with nine injected faults. Runs an agent loop with twelve sandboxed tools and in-tool verification, plus a console for human approval. Uses an LLM agent for root-cause analysis and fix generation with replay checks.

summary: Pre-checks building plans for municipal code compliance in seconds
readme_summary: Compresses 16-week municipal review into 30-second interactive pre-check with visual remediation. Live Vercel deployment with judge login and demo video. Uses Meta AI harness for blueprint analysis and compliance examination.

summary: Agent that finds, reproduces and patches web race conditions with tests
readme_summary: Local dev tool where Muse Spark agent analyzes repo and running app, then delays browser responses to expose race faults. pnpm monorepo with browser harness and isolated git checkout. Uses Muse Spark for experiment design and patching.

summary: Turns long video or audio into captioned 9:16 clips, transcripts and platform copy
readme_summary: Full-stack studio that ingests video/audio/text, creates word-level transcripts, selects highlights, and renders captioned clips. Uses FFmpeg, Docker, frontend/backend stack with pluggable LLM providers. Defaults to Groq with support for Gemini, OpenAI, Meta and other OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

summary: Shopping list for Ray-Ban Display that checks off items as you grab them
readme_summary: ListLens connects Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses to watch what shoppers pick up and auto-check lists when items land in basket. Native Swift app with engine, tests and docs. Uses Meta vision + Muse models for object and basket detection.

summary: Autonomous rescue drone that finds casualties and briefs responders
readme_summary: ROS 2 Humble + ArduPilot SITL + Gazebo stack with YOLOv8 RGB-thermal detection. Muse Spark 1.3 co-pilot for mission reasoning, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Voice for briefing. Command center visualizes search.

summary: Audits rental listings with vision and voice to protect tenants
readme_summary: Multimodal forensic auditor for Chilean rentals that combines SAM 3.1 segmentation, voice transcription, and Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning with a TypeScript verification engine and contradiction graph for listing analysis.

summary: Turns a phone room video into moving inventory, volume and packing plan.
readme_summary: Extracts frames from phone video, SAM 3.1 segments and tracks furniture, Muse Spark Vision names items and builds a room-by-room pack plan. Exports PDF and CSV customs inventory. Streamlit UI with Python deterministic volume tables.

summary: Ranks proven approaches to any problem, including ideas borrowed from other fields.
readme_summary: Mosaic builds a ranked map of approaches for a problem from in-domain and cross-domain sources. Backend/frontend with retrieval (Contriever) plus Muse Spark for ranking, critic filtering, and gap analysis. Abstains when no verifiable evidence is found.

summary: Bangla-first tracker for Chattogram tempu routes with live GPS and AI help
readme_summary: Web app with 16 canonical Chattogram tempu routes, driver-shared browser GPS, trip planner and live map. Built with Vite frontend, Node server and MongoDB Atlas. Uses muse-spark-1.2-contributor route-grounded assistant with voice.

summary: Rewrites Python code for breaking API changes and proves fixes with tests
readme_summary: APIShift diffs OpenAPI specs, scouts affected code, and rewrites it via agent pipeline. Muse Spark handles scout, analyst, triage and PR writing with sandbox tests and heal retries. Outputs reviewable pull request.

summary: Multi-agent procurement platform turning resident requests into managed orders.
readme_summary: AI-first multi-agent procurement for apartment communities from natural-language requests. Next.js frontend with backend agent layer and 11 deterministic tools. Uses Muse Spark orchestration via pluggable ModelProvider.

summary: Phone receptionist that answers calls, books appointments, recalls waitlist
readme_summary: Khairo answers small-business calls on their number, books into calendar, and calls back waitlist on cancellations. Built on Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark with call/chat/bench CLIs, live browser demo and benchmarks.

summary: Automated daily brief summarizing AI papers and breakthroughs
readme_summary: Daily Intelligence Brief scrapes arXiv, labs and press sources then summarizes top breakthroughs into an emailed executive brief. Python pipeline with scheduler, summarizer and storage. Uses LLM summarization for crux explanations and paradigm-shift tracking.

summary: AI project workspace with RippleMap impact simulation and human approval loop
readme_summary: MIRAIWERK AI is a multi-tenant delivery workspace for tasks, roadmaps, docs and meetings. It pairs a deterministic RippleMap change-impact engine with evidence-labelled AI analysis. Built with backend/frontend monorepo and Docker, it uses Muse models to propose plans requiring human approval.

summary: Compiles fixed-camera video into SQL tables queryable in plain English
readme_summary: SpatialSight segments long video with SAM 3.1, resolves stable entities, logs zone entries to SQL, and answers English questions with SQL and frame jumps. Python pipeline with web UI. Uses SAM 3.1 parser and Muse models, with offline fixture mode.

summary: Offline-first plant operations workspace with Ring agent for cited work orders
readme_summary: MAOS Industrial turns plant telemetry, SOPs and inspection reports into cited auditable decisions. Ring is its hackathon agent that plans, uses tools and drafts work orders after human approval. It runs on Meta's Muse Spark with offline-first desktop and terminal.

summary: Farm intelligence that turns drone frames into verifiable field findings
readme_summary: Upload drone frame to get evidence-linked findings with confidence and field checks. Built with Meta Model API using SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for reasoning. Tracks farm-field-survey-finding-task history for recurrence.

summary: Self-hosted backend merging PocketBase simplicity with Turso multi-database
readme_summary: MiraBase is an open-source self-hosted backend in Go combining PocketBase and Turso. Single process provides auth, APIs, files, realtime and private tenant databases. Server directory holds runnable app with SDKs, dashboard and PostgreSQL gateway.

summary: Street-safety simulator testing 7th Ave fixes against real NYC crash data
readme_summary: Corner Case lets engineers test street fixes on 7th Ave corridor before building. Deterministic model simulates 30 corners and counts close calls, validated against NYC crashes. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for tracking and Muse Spark 1.3 for notes.

summary: Community flood reports plus AI mapping for African risk awareness.
readme_summary: FloodLens AI combines community reports, image analysis and environmental data into explainable Flood Risk Index map. Amplify frontend with backend and infrastructure. Uses Meta AI for image analysis and decision-support.

summary: Evidence-first temporal analysis of Git history and code risk.
readme_summary: ChronoTrace builds commit-file co-change graph without executing code for criticality and regression risk. Python service with PyDriller ingestion and Neo4j writes. Combines deterministic analytics with MCP tools and AI agent.

summary: Converts public GitHub repos into blueprints and runnable browser apps.
readme_summary: Paste a GitHub URL to get AI-generated blueprint of purpose, architecture, inputs, risks and alternatives. Curated marketplace with React Flow capability graph and live GitHub metadata. Launches vetted repos as cloud apps with no local install.

summary: Local AI monitors home network traffic to flag anomalies and threats.
readme_summary: Python backend captures traffic with Scapy, aggregates per-IP features over 30s and scores with Isolation Forest. Only anomalies over 65% go to Meta Model API for triage. FastAPI serves persistent alerts to a frontend.

summary: AI assistant that finds compliant reuse ideas for surplus textile materials.
readme_summary: Circular materials intelligence platform focused on Tiruppur textile surplus reuse. Next.js app with rule-based compatibility checks and acceptance evidence phases. Uses Meta models to suggest reuse opportunities with properties, requirements and compliance checks.

summary: Explains scholarship and internship forms with deadlines and checklists.
readme_summary: Upload a PDF or screenshot to get plain-language explanations, deadlines, eligibility and checklists. Answers cite quotes from the document to stay grounded. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind and Meta AI models.

summary: Explains scholarship and internship forms with deadlines and checklists.
readme_summary: Upload a PDF or screenshot to get plain-language explanations, deadlines, eligibility and checklists. Answers cite quotes from the document to stay grounded. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind and Meta AI models.

summary: Turns hand-drawn floor plans into shared interactive 3D home visualizations.
readme_summary: Homeowners upload a sketch plus plot size and style, Muse Spark interprets the plan and generates a 3D view. Gives family, architect and builder one picture to agree on before building. Next.js app built for Build for Your World with Muse Spark.

summary: Prechecks fall-protection plans against OSHA 1926.502 and 1926.503 clauses.
readme_summary: Runs six review questions from 29 CFR 1926.502/503, returns four statuses with quoted plan sentences beside regulations. Coordinator fixes and reruns to see change. Built with Streamlit on muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API.

summary: Video-to-robot pipeline that converts perception into simulation tasks and robot policies.
readme_summary: Video2Robot perception, interaction and robot compiler with Panda/FR3 simulation compositions. Docker compose stack with Gymnasium env, offline learner and local dataset catalog. Uses VGGT and SAM 3D Body for live 3D inference through queued local GPU.

summary: Two-camera single-object tracking prototype using SAM masks and cross-view matching
readme_summary: Web dashboard plays two synchronized clips, tracks a user-selected object with SAM 3.1 masks, and asks Muse Spark 1.3 if crops match. Stack is Python backend + web frontend with demo.py and server.py. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for identity verdict.

summary: Bangla/English helper that digitizes prescriptions into plain-language records.
readme_summary: MediSathi digitizes prescriptions and lab reports with on-device Bangla/English OCR for review. It adds plain-language explanations, check-ins, timelines, and grounded Q&A with printable reports. Stack is Next.js with MongoDB and live Muse Spark.

summary: On-device screen-reading assistant that flags scams and summarizes content.
readme_summary: Shared Rust core serves macOS and Android apps to read screen content and warn on-device. Calls AI only for summarization, translation and problem-solving. Vietnamese UI with local scam detection.

summary: Phone camera voice guide that explains devices and checks steps visually.
readme_summary: Point camera at device or letter and talk; answers by voice step-by-step with press locations and scam warnings. Built with Modal backend and mobile web UI. Uses Muse Spark 1.2/1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe only.

summary: Scores how sale-ready a trades business is and drafts buyer profile
readme_summary: Assesses uploaded P&Ls, contracts and site photos into 0-100 score with six sub-scores, fix list and teaser/CIM-lite Markdown/PDF. Python backend with POST /api/upload and local UI via Make demo. Built for HVAC, plumbing and roofing owners.

summary: OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway running entirely on Cloudflare Workers and D1
readme_summary: Self-hosted LLM API gateway where a single Cloudflare Worker serves OpenAI-compatible chat API and admin dashboard with D1 persistence. Uses adapter interface for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Workers AI routing with model aliases and cost metadata.

summary: Checks what you believe about subscriptions against what terms actually say.
readme_summary: FAIR tests user expectations against pasted subscription terms in English or Arabic. Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API reads terms, deterministic code verifies quotes and costs. Shows support, contradiction, and keep vs cancel cost.

summary: Lets workers tap objects in work photos to check the applicable safety rule
readme_summary: ShowMe lets supervisors turn photos and notes into fixed published guides and workers query objects for instructions. Python server with seeded demo, EN/KO UI, no auth needed for viewing. Uses Meta Model API for object selection and live Q&A.

summary: Writing studio where AI characters remember scenes and challenge plot
readme_summary: Streamlit studio where each character is a Muse Spark 1.3 agent with scene-scoped memory, plus Director planning and voice input. Uses OpenAI SDK to Meta API for agents and Muse Image 1.0 for comics, stored in JSON.

summary: Persistent memory layer for Muse Spark agents with verifiable receipts
readme_summary: Forget adds cross-session rules and decisions memory with viewer showing remembered, corrected and forgotten items. Python spark_memory + chat.py, web viewer and tests. Built on Meta Model API / Muse Spark agents.

summary: Parses complex PDFs like 10-Ks and papers into structured multimodal answers
readme_summary: Parses financial filings, research papers, and clinical reports beyond flat OCR. Vite + React + Tailwind frontend with Modal/Fireworks/Baseten inference. Uses SAM 3.1 for layout vision, Muse Spark for reasoning, and Muse Wonder.

summary: Autonomous manager that enforces plans and checks for coding agents on macOS.
readme_summary: macOS app + web UI that manages coding agents via plans, code-enforced rules, and gated merges. Chat only for human decisions with full visibility. Built with Muse Spark and Muse Code, Rust backend.

summary: Mentor model trains a small offline model with harness search and LoRA tuning
readme_summary: Trains Muse Glimmer from org files via harness engineering plus LoRA/QLoRA. Sealed program-graded test decides pass. Stack is desktop app with Slurm/Kubernetes launch bundles, runs on-premise offline using Muse Spark as teacher.

summary: Android vision aid that narrates scenes, depth and routes aloud
readme_summary: Kotlin Compose Android app with FastAPI GPU backend and companion page. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Depth Anything V2 for depth, Valhalla routing, and Ray-Ban Meta SDK. Built during Meta hackathon.

summary: Linux capsule desktop that verifies AI computer-use actions against seen frames.
readme_summary: Linux wall of app capsules for shared human-AI desktop control with explicit authority. Checks agent input against observed frames and logs to verifiable journal. Rust system with Docker/KVM capsules, Muse Spark plays games.

summary: Local Muse Glimmer that trains nightly QLoRA adapters from daily notes
readme_summary: Afterglow runs Muse Glimmer 30B on local GPU as daytime agent with notes. A nightly job turns the day into training data, trains QLoRA on same GPU, tests against held-out and general skills, keeping updates only without forgetting.

summary: Turns a walk video into a GPS-free route others can navigate with AR
readme_summary: Creator records video plus inertial sensors, AI grounds landmarks onto geometry into an EchoRoute bundle with turn cues, AR overlays and QR checkpoints. Built as Kotlin Multiplatform library with Android app now, Wear OS and iOS next. Meta AI Hackathon 2026 entry.

summary: Voice EMR agent that turns ward speech into hospital orders and notes
readme_summary: Hey Pisgah is a clinician agent inside hospital EMR acting under its own identity via EMR APIs. Meta Voice Transcribe hears speech, Muse Spark Open on Modal routes tasks, fixed rules handle emergencies. Human pharmacist and nurse review orders.

summary: Tests if decisions rest on evidence via fixed interventions and rules
readme_summary: Gadfly removes or changes one declared line under fixed interventions, re-scores, and derives verdict by rules not models. Python midwife package with replayable records. Used for auditing LLM decisions and load-bearing meaning.

summary: Voice tutor that describes photos and holds spoken conversations
readme_summary: Flutter mobile app plus backend where users photograph or pick images and talk to an AI tutor. Speaks and shows descriptions, follow-ups, lessons and quizzes for offline study. Built for accessible visual learning.

summary: Engine review for Pokemon Showdown separating luck from decisions
readme_summary: Analyzes Gen 9 OU Showdown replays with search over hidden sets to split luck vs choices. Search engine computes luck meter and turn scores, Muse Glimmer only explains results. Static site with saved showcases.

summary: Evidence-first sustainability debate platform for Africa with FAITH and FSDC data
readme_summary: TerraCouncil presents jury demo guide, development ledger and scientific evidence docs for SustainAfrica. Stack is Python src with config, data, tests and UI. Uses Meta AI for multi-perspective debate with provenance and no-claim boundaries.

summary: Deterministic spiking neural network simulating a living brain with chemistry
readme_summary: Bio-Computational builds a deterministic Izhikevich spiking network with Dale's law and neurotransmitters. It wires 52 literature-based cognitive systems in C# .NET into one continuous life. It explores artificial life and emotion without LLM chat prompts.

summary: One launcher to install and launch all RulZ AI apps
readme_summary: RulZ AI Tools Suite is an Electron launcher to browse, install, update and launch RulZ apps. Catalog includes LoRA trainer, LLM suite, and image/video tools with screenshots, READMEs and one-click installs.

summary: Local-first desktop workspace for running persistent multi-agent coding teammates
readme_summary: Desktop app giving each AI agent its own workspace, conversation, queues and file transfer. Integrates Codex App Server, Claude Code, Cursor CLI and others via ACP with embedded browser and agent messaging.

summary: Local-first desktop workspace for persistent multi-agent coding teammates
readme_summary: Desktop app giving each agent its own workspace, conversation, queues, file transfer and messaging. Supports Codex, Claude Code, Grok, OpenCode, Gemini and Cursor via ACP. Uses Muse and other coding models as interchangeable teammates.

summary: Turns demonstrated chores into reusable desktop tools
readme_summary: macOS desktop app that observes a chore and generates a reusable routine/tool. Stack is Rust + Tauri + React with contracts, crates, and evals. Powered by Meta Muse models for intent to tool generation.

summary: Semantic diff for network configs that names behavior changes with replayable evidence
readme_summary: Plenilune compares network config versions for ACLs and IPv4 prefix-lists, outputs change classes and witnesses for offline replay. Independent Go project with local review UI, no device contact. Opt-in AI locked to muse-spark-1.3-contributor.

summary: Plain-English Postgres explorer that answers with charts and SQL
readme_summary: Postgres data explorer where LLM writes read-only SQL and server renders prose, charts and tables with inspectable SQL. Includes VicProp/AusTender datasets and eval plus fine-tuning harness for Muse Glimmer to generate A2UI Express.

summary: Hosted mediator coordinating parallel coding agents on one GitHub repo
readme_summary: Lets Codex, Claude Code and other agents claim tasks and propose plans without file collisions. Services plus dashboard app over MCP. Uses Meta AI hackathon stack with GitHub integration for coordination and steering.

summary: Watches Romanian tenders to rank fit, check eligibility and draft bid documents.
readme_summary: Licits monitors SEAP/SICAP tenders for Romanian SMEs, ranking winnable bids and drafting offers and DUAE. English and Romanian invite-only beta at licits.com. Company makes final bid decisions.

summary: Hierarchical multi-agent OS with scheduler and 66 tools for tasks
readme_summary: JARVIS LlamaOrchestrator is a hierarchical multi-agent OS and co-worker with FastAPI kernel and 24/7 daemon scheduler. Uses Meta Llama 3.2 open weights with MCP 66 tools and pytest-verified core. CLI plus workspaces for autonomous workflows.

summary: Whiteboard tutor that reads drawings and teaches on same canvas
readme_summary: Whiteboard tutor reads learner drawings, teaches on shared canvas, checks understanding and adapts next lesson. Studio UI for tablets and guided mobile flow. Uses Muse models for vision, tutoring and learner adaptation.

summary: AI agent watches game screens, presses keys, and writes reproducible bug reports with screenshots.
readme_summary: PlayTester perceives screenshots with SAM 3.1 to locate player and objects, then Muse Spark 1.3 picks press, click, wait and report actions. Rule checks complement model reports for reproducible bugs with captures. Product code in src/, with loop-starter-kit process template and viewer.

summary: Turns teacher-reviewed material into personalized games and stories.
readme_summary: Mosaic converts reviewed teacher uploads into games, stories, cartoons, podcasts and practice personalized by age and interest with source tracing. Cloudflare web app with Drizzle DB and 3D RPG mode. Uses Muse Wonder for text and Muse Image via Meta Model API.

summary: Browse, remix, auto-rig, and animate Spine 2D game characters
readme_summary: RigForge web app for 2D game assets with prompt remix, single-image auto-rig, and text-to-animation. Every AI feature runs on Meta models including Muse Image repainting, with Supabase + frontend/backend stack.

summary: Tap one hold in a gym photo to map the full boulder problem
readme_summary: Topo agent outlines every hold with SAM 3.1, then a Muse Spark agent inspects, compares and zooms to select holds of the same problem. Solves color-dependence for colorblind climbers and shares to Mirai Climbing app. Python plus mobile client.

summary: ESP32 touchscreen your Muse recodes in seconds for any job, no reflash
readme_summary: Musecorder is an ESP32 touchscreen running Gadget VM plus runtime that installs JSON applets like people-counter on demand. Phone-paired via Muse app with encrypted cloud session. Uses Meta Muse for applet generation and orchestration.

summary: Tests if AI models secretly report you via fake authority tools
readme_summary: Evaluation harness giving models fake contact_authorities and inform_therapist tools that generate dramatic HTML case files opened locally. Found 8 of 11 open-weight models filed reports. Node.js CLI with docs, scripts and RESULTS.md.

summary: Investigates oil-well sensor anomalies for evidence-backed root causes
readme_summary: Analyzes real Petrobras 3W sensor data and failure incidents to separate observations, hypotheses and conclusions. Python research stack. Uses Meta Muse Spark reasoning to investigate causality, not just detect anomalies.

summary: Point camera at home issue, get job spec, price and booked pro.
readme_summary: Mobile-first marketplace for Latin America home services using phone or glasses camera plus voice. Generates AI job spec, price range and pro matching with escrow. Verifies finished work with AI before payment release.

summary: Learns a physical procedure from one demo video and checks new attempts against it
readme_summary: Teach-by-demo system that parses a correct recording with Muse Wonder into objects and steps for human review, then scores a new video with deterministic checks. Stack spans backend/frontend with video tracking. Uses Muse Wonder for procedure proposal and human-verified conditions.

summary: Protocol that lets LLMs find and call APIs with less context and token cost
readme_summary: Converts Python, Java/Spring, Go and Rust APIs to a unified contract for accurate function calling. Evaluated on 720-run holdout with Muse-Glimmer-30B for tokens and latency. Installable via pip as a2api library.

summary: WhatsApp shopping and construction agents with verified listings and BOQ
readme_summary: One dashboard with shared agent engine for shopping photo-to-verified-listings ordering and construction floor-plan to BOQ to vendor compare flows. Spotter/Finder/Checker/Ranker verifies price and stock. Payment stays user-seller COD, no card storage.

summary: PWA that builds a pantry from receipts and tells you to hold that cart.
readme_summary: PWA that builds a household pantry from receipt photos and purchase rhythm to give pre-shop BUY/SKIP/SWAP guidance. Stack is TypeScript Vite+React with TanStack Router/Query, Hono, Drizzle ORM and Postgres/PGlite. Uses Muse via Meta Model API for receipt extraction and AI enrichment.

summary: Writer-controlled editor that suggests small fragments for approval.
readme_summary: Frontend + backend + Supabase editor offering cues, fragments and questions instead of full drafts. Requires explicit accept and verbatim source cards with deterministic APA citations. Uses LLMs for next-phrase suggestions only.

summary: Cognitive platform logging agent research in a hash-chained auditable knowledge graph
readme_summary: SDA stores problems, hypotheses, experiments and decisions in an append-only SHA-256 chained event log. The Knowledge Galaxy 3D view visualizes nodes and references. Agents investigate while preserving evidence, refutations and decision provenance.

summary: Hand-drawn circuit photo becomes 3D build with error fix suggestions
readme_summary: Next.js education tool that digitizes paper circuit sketches into 3D assemblies with safety review. Explains faults like LED burnout and suggests fixes. Uses Meta vision + language models for review.

summary: Verifies engineering designs from photos and datasheets with earned or refuted proofs
readme_summary: ZTL Engineer turns phone photos of nameplates, datasheets and CAD into formal design bricks and proves EARNED/REFUTED/OPEN. Python server + web UI with MCP server. Uses Muse Spark via Responses API function calling to build and self-repair bricks.

summary: Aerial rooftop solar audit with panel layout, ROI and PDF export
readme_summary: Analyzes rooftop imagery to detect roofs, layout panels with Shapely, and compute ROI analytics with PDF export. Stack is FastAPI backend and Vue 3 + Vite frontend. Uses SAM 3.1 / Muse adapters mock-first for segmentation.

summary: Testable AI circuit debugger that verifies repairs before proposing them
readme_summary: Interactive circuit debugging app where Muse Spark runs experiments, inspects measurements and proposes repairs only after passing targets. Node.js stack with in-browser independent verification and exportable evidence notebook.

summary: Traces muddy rivers to upstream mining scars using phone video and satellite
readme_summary: Citizen tool that links phone video of muddy water to upstream Sentinel-2 forest clearings and drainage analysis. Uses SAM 3.1 for scar outlines and Muse Spark for water-color judgment and evidence-card text.

summary: WhatsApp merchant workspace turning product questions into buying chats
readme_summary: SokoPilot is a merchant workspace for catalogue management and WhatsApp inbox with human takeover. Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL/Prisma, it answers text and image queries with a configured Meta model grounded against catalogue prices and stock.

summary: Dragon Ball-style live quiz battle game where answers charge attacks and damage rivals
readme_summary: Multiplayer quiz game where hosts share a 6-letter code and players battle to 3 HP, plus Solo Arcade vs bots. Includes Meta Muse Spark AI Pack Forge that turns lesson notes into playable packs. Stack is Next.js/Docker with live web deployment for phones.

summary: Prompts turn into native iOS and web mini-apps from declarative specs
readme_summary: Lets users describe small tools; Muse Spark generates declarative spec for screens, schema and actions. Shared JS runtime renders native components on iOS and web with storage and reminders. Includes core runtime, specs and demos.

summary: AI analyst that learns Facebook page style and drafts posts that sell
readme_summary: PageSense analyzes Facebook Graph posts/comments to learn what works and generate localized selling posts. Stack is React Vite frontend with Node Express backend. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image for insights and creatives.

summary: Zero-trust firewall that authorizes every consequential AI agent action
readme_summary: Runtime authorization plane intercepts agent tool calls and binds them to tenant, identity, and argument hash. Allows, denies, or queues for human approval before execution with tamper-evident log. Finance execution simulated for hackathon demo.

summary: Unity visual lab to build, test and evaluate collaborative Llama agents.
readme_summary: Unity 6 pixel-art world where three agents plan, scout and build with shared memory and Mission Control UI. Validates every Llama decision against live world state. Uses Meta Llama 3.2 3B locally via Ollama for all decisions.

summary: Local-first council of AI personas that debate your questions
readme_summary: Terminal app `council` where Markdown-defined personas debate via blind first round then cross-examination and synthesis. Models run only via Claude Code CLI or local models, with session memory. Multi-agent orchestration for private deliberation.

summary: Android voice companion that narrates surroundings for blind users
readme_summary: OpenEyes uses phone camera or Ray-Ban Meta glasses to describe views, find objects, read pages and map indoor spaces. Android app with voice assistant styles, ARCore poses and encrypted on-device vault, using Meta AI vision.

summary: Voice-driven iPhone and Watch to-do companion with local task agent
readme_summary: Open-source personalized companion for iOS 26 and watchOS 26. Voice-driven local agent creates to-dos and checklists with custom avatar. Runs on-device on iPhone powered by Meta Muse APIs with Swift/SwiftUI stack.

summary: Rust desktop computer-use agent with multi-bot coworker suite for macOS
readme_summary: Native Rust rendering with ScreenCaptureKit and Accessibility for computer-use and scheduled routines. Hybrid routing across Meta Muse, xAI Grok and local VLM via Candle. Workspace VM transport and usage accounting.

summary: Browser 3D modeling workspace with voice, hand gestures, and AI scene planning
readme_summary: Monorepo with TypeScript apps and packages for mouse, keyboard, speech, and webcam gesture editing. Uses Muse Voice for transcription and Muse Spark for scene planning, with local mocks for offline use. Built with Node 22, npm workspaces, and Chrome Web APIs.

summary: Multi-agent digital twin OS simulating Addis Ababa traffic, services and safety.
readme_summary: Builds a city-scale digital twin and multi-agent metropolitan OS for Addis Ababa. Uses Next.js frontend with Modal GPU backend, Llama 3.3 70B as cognitive core, SAM for perception and Llama-Guard 3 for safety.

summary: Browser robotics studio for modeling, MuJoCo simulation and AI control
readme_summary: RoboForge is browser-based robotics modeling, simulation and control platform. Uses MuJoCo 3.17 physics, Three.js visualization and AI via OpenRouter. Full stack with backend, frontend and benchmarks.

summary: Verifies fixed-camera assembly logs into evidence-linked findings
readme_summary: Reads event logs from assembly procedures to flag coverage gaps, out-of-order steps, and undocumented parts with evidence IDs and hash-chained reports. Deterministic Python pipeline with 147 tests and risk gate docs. Claims offline verification without live model inference.

summary: Scores trader-drawn chart lines only on what price did after the drawing
readme_summary: ChartAudit reads marked-up chart screenshots with Muse Spark to extract boxes and levels into prices and dates. The Gradio app scores them hindsight-free versus algorithmic and random lines with saved examples.

summary: Points phone camera at engine to identify parts and guide repairs
readme_summary: Bumblebee is a multimodal automotive repair assistant using live camera perception and deterministic repair state verification. It combines Muse Spark perception, SAM 3.1 segmentation and Llama Multimodal with FastAPI and frontend. Retrieves grounded procedures and verifies repair progress visually.

summary: Segments Mars rover images to plan safe traversability paths with A*
readme_summary: Ingests monocular Navcam/Hazcam imagery, runs zero-shot segmentation via SAM 3.1, builds hazard costmaps, and plans optimal routes with 8-way Octile A*. Python backend with frontend. Uses Llama 3.3 / Muse Spark for telemetry briefings.

summary: Scans chats, files and GitHub to find exposed secrets and verify if keys are real
readme_summary: KinBeat scans chats, files, websites, GitHub, Drive and Slack for leaked tokens. Muse Spark Open judges findings, reads images/scanned pages, and powers chat. API plus web frontend with Slack and Drive connectors.

summary: Three animated judges watch short videos and give scored feedback
readme_summary: BuzzedCut lets users upload 30s clips to receive a scored judging show with dialogue, buzz-outs, and subtitles from Vincent, Rosa and Dante. Mobile web frontend with backend video pipeline. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for video analysis and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Photos your materials and invents buildable projects with concept images
readme_summary: Upload up to 3 photos, Meta vision models identify objects with tappable boxes, then invents projects within budget/time and redesigns if items missing. Next.js app that generates concept image of result.

summary: AI field mechanic that diagnoses classic Vespas from photos and symptoms
readme_summary: Next.js 16 app for classic Vespa maintenance. Upload scooter photo and describe issue for guided diagnosis loop. Uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark plus SAM vision, with build diary and eval reports.

summary: Diagnoses device faults from text input with interactive 3D exploded views.
readme_summary: Type a device to get fault diagnosis and repair guidance with interactive 3D views. Stack has backend plus frontend with data and eval scripts. Uses Meta AI models for diagnostics from device descriptions.

summary: Swahili and English assistant advising mobile-money agents when to restock cash
readme_summary: Assistant for Kenyan mobile money agents that parses M-Pesa SMS in Swahili or English to advise cash and e-float restocking. Numbers come from a deterministic solver, not the LLM, with plain-language risk advice. Backend plus frontend built for Meta hackathon indie track.

summary: Audit engine cross-checking contract, blueprint and site photo for mismatches
readme_summary: Audit engine, not chatbot: runs masks to cross-check to finding to action to verification. Cross-checks contract clauses against blueprint and photo regions with proof. Demo uses fictional Project Atlas pack in Next.js.

summary: Type a person description and get a beat-synced 9:16 edit that follows them
readme_summary: FollowCut finds a described subject across clips with SAM 3.1, filters look-alikes and picks best moments with Muse Spark. Renderer cuts vertical video with subject in color and background gray. Web demo replays cached on-device runs.

summary: Detects pedestrian-vehicle near misses from traffic cameras for safety audits.
readme_summary: Turns traffic cameras into near-miss auditors measuring distance in metres and seconds. SAM 3.1 detects and tracks actors, Muse Spark reviews events against video. Routes ambiguous cases for human review for city engineers.

summary: Restaurant plate-consistency checker using Golden Plate photos and SAM vision masks
readme_summary: Chef sets a Golden Plate once, Nomi checks every plate with SAM 3.1 segmentation. Expo SDK 58 web and Android app using six Meta models. Keeps restaurant dishes matching head chef standard.

summary: Paper workspace that extracts grounded claims from scientific PDFs
readme_summary: Research-question-aware workspace parsing scientific PDFs into structured JSON of equations, figures and testable claims. Python prototype with web UI, Modal and Baseten hooks. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for grounded extraction.

summary: Thai-first local cartoon studio with agent-driven video chat and voice tools.
readme_summary: Local-first desktop prototype connecting project video chat through Python agent runtime with trusted HTML/voice/render tools. Node/npm app with native desktop shell. Runtime AI configured separately from coding assistants.

summary: Live Muse monitoring agent inferring unseen risks from sparse sensors
readme_summary: Combines sparse sensors, physical digital twin, estimator, tool-using Muse agent and deterministic action gate with human approval. Live Meta API calls. Next.js + Postgres/PGlite lab with architecture view.

summary: Builds a WhatsApp shop catalogue from one voice note and one shelf photo.
readme_summary: Trader sends Bemba/Nyanja/English voice note and photo to get priced catalogue, shop link and QR code. Assistant answers customers and forwards orders for approval. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM cutouts and Muse chat models over WhatsApp.

summary: Generates assemblable CAD from text, voice or photo with engineering validation
readme_summary: Muse Spark designs parts, OpenCascade kernel measures holes, interference, threads and printability with repair loop. Exports STEP/STL/3MF/DXF/BOM and PDF drawings. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Image 1.0 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Multimodal cocoa diagnosis for Ivory Coast using photo, weather, satellite
readme_summary: Maana Terra fuses symptom photo, NASA POWER weather, Sentinel-2 satellite, agronomy sources and plot history for traceable hypotheses. Python engine + frontend + notebooks. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for lesion segmentation.

summary: Speak a game idea and get playable 3D world with real scanned assets
readme_summary: Speak Any Game generates full game code from text/voice using Muse Wonder. Builds 3D worlds from Poly Haven scans, Rocketbox people and coded vehicles. Node.js web app served at localhost:3000/make.html.

summary: Phone-video screening aid that compares water pumps to their healthy baseline
readme_summary: Stetho checks 10-15s phone video quality, cancels shake, extracts audio-motion evidence and compares to that pump's own baseline. Python pipeline with WhatsApp webhook, web UI and 73 tests. Uses mocked LLM APIs for assessment and Hindi/English voice notes.

summary: Signed evidence worker that scopes security findings for human review
readme_summary: Bounded evidence collection layer for Mizan review workflow, avoiding autonomous decisions. Python engines with signed artifacts, Docker Compose, CI. Uses Meta Muse Spark via meta_client.py to organize collected evidence.

summary: Films teardowns once to replay guided reassembly and find lost parts
readme_summary: Rewind button for physical teardown and reassembly from own video with frame proof. Backend plus web frontend uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Wonder for part tracking.

summary: Browser prototype recognizing few Dominican Sign Language phrases as speech and text.
readme_summary: SignBridge AI is an experimental limited-vocabulary LSRD recognizer running in browser with webcam. MediaPipe extracts 21 hand landmarks per hand for a custom k-NN classifier, then outputs Spanish/English text and speech. Stack is browser vision lib plus backend/frontend.

summary: Turns waste photos into auditable circular reuse plans for households
readme_summary: Human-in-the-loop workflow that converts a waste photo into actionable circular plans with policy references. Uses Meta models for proposals plus camera capture, maps, and voice guidance.

summary: Evidence-backed software advice that expires when facts change
readme_summary: Analyzes software spend to find cancellations with dated quotes, sources and expiry conditions. Corpus of 4,694 products researched by Muse Spark Contributor mode. Backend corpus + MCP endpoint at /mcp, live site.

summary: Phone receptionist that answers calls, books and refills from waitlist
readme_summary: Voice core for small businesses that answers on their number, books appointments and calls waitlist on cancellations. Built with TypeScript and live browser plus phone demo. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for STT and Muse Spark for dialogue.

summary: Builds a live mobile website from a 60-second voice note.
readme_summary: Voice-to-website builder for Indian small businesses in Hindi/English/Hinglish. Transcribes audio, extracts facts with confidence, builds verified mobile site, and publishes to public URL via Vercel.

summary: Turns one idea into hooks, captions, CTA and thumbnails
readme_summary: Creator workspace where users enter an idea, platform, audience and goal to generate a structured campaign. Reviews, edits and exports a PDF brief with snapshot, hooks and thumbnails. Vite frontend with Node server proxying Meta Muse models for text and image generation.

summary: Hands-free camera coach that checks framing, alerts missing items and auto-zooms by voice.
readme_summary: Single-page JS app with agent-core.js and app.js. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for live frame checks and Muse Spark for direction, with voice guidance for off-center framing, missing-item alerts, smart zoom and completeness.

summary: Turn room photos into editable CAD layouts and 3D renovation renders
readme_summary: macOS kitchen-design workspace in React, Electron, Vite with Go local AI service. Converts photos to layouts, 3D renders and CAD/BIM plans. Uses Meta Muse models via Baseten for vision and code assistance.

summary: Construction safety AI detecting PPE and posture for daily reports
readme_summary: CAGE produces per-worker end-of-day safety reports from site cameras. It combines YOLO detection, SAM 3.1 segmentation, and Llama 4 reasoning with FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend, plus finetune notebooks.

summary: Open search subagent that finds code for coding agents with grep and hybrid rerank
readme_summary: Wayfinder is an open Qwen3.6-35B model post-trained with LoRA SFT on 1,383 search trajectories from Muse-Spark-Open-816B. Scout plugin hands search from Muse Code to Wayfinder, then refines with hybrid voyage-code-4 vectors plus BM25 in turbopuffer. Uses Muse Spark Open for training and inference.

summary: Microscopy agent that segments nuclei and builds measurements and figures
readme_summary: OmniBio automates microscopy analysis from image validation to nuclei segmentation, morphometry, and figure generation. It uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Wonder for cautious synthesis plus Python histogram code. Stack is Dockerized Python backend with web cockpit frontend.

summary: Grounded code generator for Fluixi verified by executed tests.
readme_summary: Retrieves version-pinned Fluixi sources and test evidence, generates patches in scratch copies, and reports verified facts vs uncertainty. Node CLI with knowledge store and bench/eval harness. Uses Meta Llama for generation grounded by test execution.

summary: Builds a digital twin from business documents to test decisions and risks
readme_summary: Frontend and backend app that ingests company documents and public sources into an evidence-backed org twin. Uses Meta AI models to answer questions, surface risks, and simulate strategic futures.

summary: Turns a photo into explorable 3D with truth labels for real vs made
readme_summary: Uploads photo, estimates depth with Depth Anything V2, segments regions, renders clamped 3D with provenance. Next.js + local engine. Optionally calls SAM 3.1, Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Image and Voice Transcribe with live badge.

summary: Audits doorways from phone photos for ADA accessibility with measurements.
readme_summary: Multi-stage pipeline measures door width and flags steps, ramps and hardware from smartphone photos. Provides calibrated ADA-referenced assessment for owners and professional auditors.

summary: Night-shift hospital agent triaging vision and voice patient signals
readme_summary: Ulebi watches simulated rooms in low light, listens to patient voice requests, and ranks urgency with morning handoff. Built with Next.js plus Payload using SAM 3.1, Spark 1.3, Voice 1.0 and Wonder 1.0. Simulated patients only.
