summary: Auditable food-supply monitor for Senegal rice decisions.
readme_summary: KAIROS reads sources and satellite images with Meta models, while code verifies quotes and computes numbers or refuses. Stack is Next.js 16 TypeScript with strict tests. Uses Meta models for source reading and tool choice, never for displayed numbers.

summary: Snap fridge photos to get ingredient lists and structured recipe plans
readme_summary: ChefSync AI takes up to 4 fridge photos and returns structured recipes for single meal, batch prep or snack. SAM 3.1 detects ingredients, Muse Spark generates recipes, served by Hono TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers with React Vite Tailwind. Uses RPC-typed Zod-validated API.

summary: Two-level system where researcher agents fine-tune models overnight and improve themselves
readme_summary: Inner loop post-trains Muse Glimmer 30B adapters, outer loop revises researchers. Has deterministic controller, original-engine study with Inspect scoring, Docker setup. Uses Meta Muse Spark and Glimmer models.

summary: Agentic debugger that diagnoses broken builds and proposes verified fixes
readme_summary: DevRescue is an agentic developer recovery assistant for broken environments, failed builds, and regressions. Built in TypeScript/Node with Ink React TUI and defense-in-depth execution with human auth gates. Uses Meta Muse reasoning separated from verified observations.

summary: Turns spoken and handwritten shop credit notes into ledger and reminders
readme_summary: Shopkeeper ledger app that transcribes voice and handwriting into reviewable credit records and respectful payment reminders. Built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript and Drizzle. Uses Muse Spark for ledger parsing and Muse Voice Transcribe for speech input.

summary: Mac login combining master password with typing rhythm and device checks
readme_summary: DynamicKey is a Mac vault app plus Safari extension replacing password-only login with password, keystroke dynamics, trusted devices and networks. Includes credential vault, security score, and Gmail risk helper DynamicShield. Meta AI only explains verdicts; auth stays local.

summary: Graph-based financial fraud investigation with evidence validation.
readme_summary: Prototype for compliance analysts to investigate circular transfers and layering on synthetic data. Combines deterministic transaction analysis, directed graph intelligence and AI-assisted explanations with structured case management.

summary: Scans URLs for visual UI bugs, auto-fixes a copy and verifies with measurements.
readme_summary: SiteSurgeon detects low contrast, overflow and mobile layout bugs and verifies fixes with objective metrics. Python app with demo sites and sample runs, using vision models and browser rendering.

summary: Accessible voice-narrated shell making classic Z-machine text adventures playable hands-free.
readme_summary: Plays untouched .z3/.z5/.z8/.zblorb files with bundled Figaro starter; narrates text with highlighting, voice/tap/type input, compass chips and fog map. Built during hackathon across core/server/web/services for eyes-closed completion.

summary: Voice money diary that parses spoken spending into daily savings stories
readme_summary: Next.js + Tailwind app with mic input via Web Speech and localStorage diary. POSTs text to Baseten meta-models/muse-spark-open with forced tool call to extract amount/category. Low-confidence parses ask back instead of guessing.

summary: Voice-first Mac menu-bar dog for accessible, approved-only control
readme_summary: Shep docks to the active window, finds unnamed controls and shows actions for user approval. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B on-device for control naming with on-device speech recognition and Hey Shep wake. Native macOS Swift app with privacy-first design.

summary: AR yard app overlaying sprinkler coverage and grass health to guide watering
readme_summary: Phone AR app that segments lawn vs non-lawn, flags dry zones and overlays sprinkler coverage. Vite + TS frontend with API backend, Meta-models-only constraint. Uses Muse Spark vision and SAM for segmentation and watering advice.

summary: Spanish tool turning cultural events into traceable commerce opportunities
readme_summary: Opportunity Radar maps events to signals, opportunities and campaign proposals in Spanish. Next.js app with server HTTP integration to Meta Model API muse-spark-1.3 using JSON Schema and Zod. Demo mode runs rule-based without credentials.

summary: Turns photos of real objects into animation-ready 2D game assets
readme_summary: React studio for asset inspection plus Python compiler emitting PNG + JSON + ZIP, played by separate Phaser app reading ZIP export. Handles upload validation, EXIF stripping, and sprite processing without API key.

summary: Converts field photos into water infrastructure inspections and repair proof
readme_summary: Multimodal platform structures before/after photos into component-level inspections and visible-change comparisons. Built with Next.js frontend, technical architecture docs, and benchmark guides. Explores frontier vision models for NGO maintenance transparency.

summary: Chrome extension that builds a local profile from history to power timely assists.
readme_summary: Ports the WarmStart pipeline into Chrome: ingest reads history, understand calls Muse Wonder and Muse Spark, with resumable builds. Content scripts add cards on X, muse.ai, product pages, and YouTube side panel. Live moments use Muse Spark Open on Modal per token.

summary: Desktop agent that learns skills by watching human work and self-grades
readme_summary: SkillForge watches human work to extract rules and binds them to new tasks with human-in-loop grading. Implements forge-bind-verify loop with strict JSON schemas and evidence-carrying skills. Reasoning core is muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for all runs.

summary: Public trust record scoring AI agents on identity, delivery, and refusals
readme_summary: Verifies agent skills via corpus gate, gauntlet benchmarks, and escrow invariants I1-I6. Python rig with locked fixtures and demo scorecard proves install safety and burn detection.

summary: Reproduces UI bugs from screenshots and verifies fixes before opening PRs
readme_summary: BugLens AI links screenshots and recordings to source at a pinned commit, proposes patches and verifies in Modal before creating GitHub PRs. Stack is Python FastAPI backend, npm frontend, with bearer-token auth for API endpoints.

summary: Zero-context visual debugger that diagnoses and hot-patches UI from screen
readme_summary: Multimodal runtime debugger that detects frontend anomalies and visual defects directly from interaction. Backend generative super-resolution prior with hot-patch output, live Netlify playground. Claims 5B-token vision telemetry checkpoint.

summary: Photo of broken item becomes mapped repair steps grounded in manuals
readme_summary: FieldFix identifies objects and parts with Muse Spark 1.3, segments them with SAM 3.1 on Meta Model API, and retrieves BM25 manual excerpts. Next.js UI overlays masks and returns structured diagnosis, tools, safety notes and steps.

summary: Turns app screenshots into running SwiftUI apps then iteratively improves them
readme_summary: Engine segments screenshots with SAM 3.1 and understands UI with Muse Spark to write validated specs and SwiftUI code. Next.js and TypeScript agent compiles for macOS and iOS, optionally generating art with Muse Image.

summary: Agent translating legacy Fortran routines into verified JAX code.
readme_summary: Translates scientific Fortran to JAX one routine at a time using Muse Spark on Meta Model API. Verifies each translation by running compiled original Fortran. Enables GPU/TPU, vmap batching and differentiation for climate and aerospace models.

summary: Photographs handwritten score sheets into verified gradebook rows for teachers.
readme_summary: Teacher photo is transcribed to rows, then deterministic checks flag blanks, errors and duplicates. Node app with eval, scripts and tests plus Schoolsoft export. Uses Muse Spark for handwriting transcription, code for decisions.

summary: Converts cloth photos into thread-level jacquard naksha graphs for looms
readme_summary: Photograph brocade cloth, SAM 3.1 finds fabric and Muse Spark reads motif and thread colors. Deterministic engine converts to weaveable graph-paper naksha. Includes FastAPI server, static UI and benchmark suite.

summary: Analyzes uploaded motion clips to measure gravity and bounce and explain predictions
readme_summary: PhysLens Lab stages drop-and-bounce and cup, cans and weighing experiments from uploaded clips. Engine tracks objects, estimates gravity and restitution with error bars, then syncs playback. Runs on laptop CPU; SAM 3.1 and Muse planned for perception and Q&A.

summary: Voice-guided phone app helps blind users locate objects by directional sound.
readme_summary: Web app where users speak a target, then sweep the camera for audio beeps and voice guidance. TypeScript frontend uses SAM 3.1 for detection, Muse Spark 1.3 for intent and Muse Voice Transcribe. Includes VoiceOver support.

summary: Adaptive review desk that tests code speedups with executable evidence
readme_summary: Python 3.12 evidence-challenge server with local cosine adapter and web decision room. Muse Spark selects and adapts experiments, Python judges outcomes. Produces counterexamples or reviewable evidence packets.

summary: Learns when to call SAM 3 to fix ID switches in dense tracking
readme_summary: Risk-aware dispatch for multi-object tracking in dense motorbike traffic. Lightweight ByteTrack runs every frame, learned risk predictor triggers SAM 3 Selective Mask Propagation only at risky moments. Includes MOT utils, TrackEval, and CLEAR-MOT metrics.

summary: Second-device companion that pauses risky calls to inspect requests.
readme_summary: GuardianCall is a Next.js speakerphone companion for rehearsing urgent family requests. It runs offline text checks and enrolled-device verification with an evaluation harness. Uses Meta AI models for request analysis with synthetic audio for demo.

summary: Keeps school plans intact through changes with revision tracking and next steps
readme_summary: School-message plans that preserve completed work through changes and cancellation. Node + static demo with recorded fictional responses, local dev route for PDF/photo analysis. Built for hackathon Startups track.

summary: Plans home device schedules from plain words and verifies them before acting
readme_summary: Household describes routines in text or speech, Muse Spark Open parses to device plans. Plain-code verifier checks constraints with up to 3 retries, then acts and explains. Built with Streamlit, Python agent and live view.

summary: Voice and chat digital twin that answers, qualifies leads and books meetings.
readme_summary: Shareable persona link serves chat and voice from personal knowledge with cloned voice and multilingual support. Stack is Next.js 15 frontend with FastAPI WebSockets, RAG and calendar booking. Uses Gnani STT/TTS with Meta, Groq and NIM LLMs.

summary: Local fantasy basketball scout that checks film evidence before suggesting roster moves.
readme_summary: Local single-user fantasy basketball scouting desk with FastAPI backend and frontend. Runs bounded live scans via Sleeper API plus game logs to shortlist players and build guarded reports. Uses Meta API clients for analysis with no simulated fallback, keeping credentials server-side.

summary: Local idea gardener that turns inspirations into research plans
readme_summary: Collects papers, repos, videos into ranked feed, compost and greenhouse exploration loop to produce flower packs. Outputs OpenResearch and Co-Scientist plans locally. Python backend with web app frontend.

summary: Reviews traffic clips for near-misses with segmentation and expert review
readme_summary: VigiRoute is a local-first Node app for reviewing site/camera-labeled MP4 clips for road quasi-collisions. Muse Spark interprets scenes, SAM 3.1 segments/tracks pedestrians and vehicles, geometry flags proximities. Expert reviews ideas before export. No build deps, runs via server.mjs.

summary: Hazard command center for Malaysia with live maps and AI briefings
readme_summary: Web app with FastAPI backend aggregating hazard feeds on 3D globe and 2D map. Muse Spark agent answers via tools, builds briefings from webcams, FIRMS, YouTube, GDELT. Uses SAM 3.1 on camera images on demand.

summary: Purple-team pipeline that attacks code, patches it, and re-tests the fix
readme_summary: Autonomous purple-team CI/CD pipeline that finds weaknesses, writes patches with Meta Muse, and re-runs attacks. Uses air-gapped Docker for cryptographic proof of fixes. Python FastAPI service for hackathon edition.

summary: Deployed web app with control panel and review worker integration
readme_summary: AIPSTER is a web app deployed at aipster.net with verified production builds and deployment provenance. Architecture includes app.js control panel, review workers and Ubuntu desktop handoff. README focuses on live demo verification and release tracking.

summary: Mac notch agent that listens to calls and files tickets and opens PRs.
readme_summary: Swift/SwiftUI macOS 14+ app that listens to calls in Safari toolbar. Files tickets, writes code and opens pull requests automatically. Uses Muse Spark models and Muse Code.

summary: Desktop study workspace turning course files into tutored practice sessions
readme_summary: ScholarOS unifies LMS courses, assignments, and a context library into focused tutoring with sims and practice. Turborepo TypeScript monorepo with apps and packages plus desktop build. Uses Meta AI models for grounded tutoring over course context.

summary: Agent team that turns textbook chapters into narrated explainer videos
readme_summary: Shoestring Studios converts dense source material into narrated explainer video with claim-to-source report. Uses LightRAG knowledge backend, Node slide rendering, Kokoro voice and ffmpeg. Uses LLM key for agents and narration planning.

summary: Browser and desktop song studio with piano roll, mixer and AI music generation
readme_summary: Next.js song studio plus Electron desktop app with Web Audio synthesis, effects and WAV export. Turborepo with .banger compiler, engine, and agent packages. Uses compiler-validated generation with Muse models for music creation.

summary: Agent protocol for shared road state with propose-confirm-merge commits
readme_summary: Implements AV road-record protocol treating edits as commits and confirmations as review with merge-conflict handling. Rust harness with docs SPEC, examples, and Phase 15a gate scores validating confirm-before-merge.

summary: Interactive procedural help guide with simulated devices and step-by-step tools
readme_summary: Static web app with seven procedural tools and simulated keyboard, laptop, fridge and printer devices with persistent states and media playback. Built from scratch around Meta AI with JS/CSS and regression tests.

summary: Claude Code skills to install, serve and port models on AMD Loom
readme_summary: Plugin of Claude Code skills for AMD Loom hrx-loom compiler, runtime and loom-serve. Covers SDK install, LLM/ASR/TTS serving, GGUF porting, optimization and benchmarking on Ryzen AI Max+ 395 Strix Halo.

summary: Finds regression root causes from test runs and diffs with cited AI hypotheses
readme_summary: RegressionMap runs a failing test at baseline and HEAD in isolated git worktrees, collecting output and diffs as cited evidence IDs. A Meta model proposes ranked root-cause hypotheses that must cite IDs, then a developer approves a verification rerun. Go API plus web UI.

summary: Agent that converts GitHub issues into verified minimal pytest reproductions.
readme_summary: Parses untrusted GitHub issues with guarded deterministic hints then generates minimal pytest tests. Python 3.11 stack with bench, docs and proof artifacts. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for parsing and reproduction reasoning.

summary: Turns one expert glasses recording into hands-free trade guidance
readme_summary: Compiles a narrated Ray-Ban Meta recording into step procedures with visuals, rationale and warnings for hands-free guidance. Backend plus web and Android clients. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Device Access Toolkit.

summary: Tax agent turning M-Pesa and receipts into Kenya eTIMS-ready books
readme_summary: Hazi gathers M-Pesa, bank statements, receipt photos and voice notes, then Muse Spark vision structures them. Deterministic matcher reconciles every shilling and flags unmatched for month-end compliance. Python agent with UI, evals and fixtures.

summary: Converts first-person video into 3D body pose and movement intelligence
readme_summary: LifeLens turns egocentric camera input into 3D body intelligence with human rig reconstruction. Pipeline combines vision models with Meta MHR and Llama 3.2. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for first-person scene understanding.

summary: Hindi-Urdu to English video dubbing with cloned voices and preserved audio
readme_summary: Offline Python pipeline that dubs Hindi/Urdu video to English. Stages for ASR, translation, voice cloning and Demucs audio separation. Runs on Meta open-weight models including Muse Glimmer and Omnilingual ASR.

summary: Desktop IDE that maps code architecture and reviews AI-proposed edits
readme_summary: Ruth IDE parses Angular/NestJS/TypeScript/Rust locally into architecture map of pages, stores and services with evidence edges. Meta Muse proposes changes shown on map for Accept/Discard. Tauri + Vite + TypeScript desktop app.

summary: Two agents that design LoRA fine-tunes and judge results with second review
readme_summary: Job Architect turns a goal into LoRA dataset, base model and hyperparameters with safety screening. Quality Judge evaluates the tuned model with held-out prompts. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API, Muse Wonder and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Civic portal where citizens post ideas, vote, and track weekly public briefings.
readme_summary: The Podium is a dependency-free static civic portal with verified posts and upvote-only ranking. Top-voted plus random post are read verbatim weekly with answers tracked. Runs from file:// with localStorage persistence.

summary: Single screen showing daily cash vs verified takings for restaurant and sports courts.
readme_summary: Srija Business Hub provides guest booking, one-button cashier sale, and owner takings dashboard with day-close status. Built on Docker with synthetic POS data for 10 months. Uses Meta AI for sales summarization and anomaly notes.

summary: Turns plain-word plot briefs into three checked concept floor plans with dimensions
readme_summary: Muse Spark parses client brief into structured room program, sizes and adjacencies. Deterministic Python placer creates three typology layouts with walls, doors, windows and north arrow. Checks livability rules and area budget.

summary: Uploads a photo and returns location with step-by-step visual deduction
readme_summary: ReTracer AI segments photos with SAM 3.1, analyzes spatial cues and reasons to city and coordinates with confidence and deduction trail. Streamlit Python app with backend, face screening and file sanitizer for privacy gates. Uses Muse Wonder for reasoning.

summary: Micro-learning coach that plans study and job hunt in spare minutes
readme_summary: Ropi is a study and career coach for busy learners with 5-minute tasks and replanning. React/Vite frontend with Supabase uses Muse models for planning, coaching chat, and voice input.

summary: Finds Redis concurrency bugs by racing requests through a delay proxy
readme_summary: Tests Redis/Valkey services for lost updates and check-then-act races. Muse Spark 1.3 plans strict-JSON race experiments from source code, a delay-only proxy controls command order, and a code oracle verifies bugs with 20x replay.

summary: Presence-aware Mac agent that briefs you on arrival and watches while away
readme_summary: BLE-Jarvis uses iPhone as BLE beacon; Mac detects arrival, plays music and speaks calendar, Jira and news brief. Native Mac plus mobile apps with tool-calling agent. Uses Muse Spark Open for briefing composition and ElevenLabs for speech with Apple Music playback.

summary: AI SOC copilot where fast triage plus reasoning defends a lab network live
readme_summary: Sentinel V4 is a dual-system SOC copilot with Laya System-1 triage and Muse Spark System-2 reasoning, scripted red-team bots, orchestrator and replay harness. Simulated RFC1918 lab with live dashboard and human approval. Built during hackathon.

summary: Trains robot action policies on frozen Muse features with SAM object tracking
readme_summary: Dataset-first kit trains vision-language-action policies conditioned on quantized Muse features and SAM tracking. Evaluated on LIBERO milk-placement with checkpoints and repro docs. Python configs and LIBERO integration included.

summary: Learns tabletop tasks from one video and runs them on simulated Franka arm
readme_summary: Core Robot converts a demo video into Python using pick/place primitives executed in PyBullet simulation. Pipeline uses SAM 3.1 for object segmentation/tracking and Muse Spark for plan and code generation with pose-based checker.

summary: Identifies video games from gameplay clips using pixels alone
readme_summary: Prysm Lens is a Shazam for games that identifies titles from short gameplay video without captions. Stack spans indexer, service, benchmark and web with upload and link input. Uses SAM 3.1 plus Perception Encoder and Muse Spark for visual matching.

summary: Detects road crashes from dashcam clips to advise stay, reroute or wait
readme_summary: Watches dashcam and traffic-camera clips to detect crashes, emergency vehicles, debris and road work. Cross-checks claims against tracked objects, predicts clearance time range, and scores stay, reroute or wait options.

summary: Review dashboard that triages drone video for rescue candidate signals
readme_summary: Project Triage ingests drone/body-cam batches and samples review units for human verification. Node backend + Vite dashboard uses SAM 3.1 for candidates and Muse Spark 1.3 for prioritization.

summary: Bangladesh legal assistant that answers law questions with cited sources and Bengali PDFs.
readme_summary: Source-grounded legal information and document preparation platform for Bangladesh covering 255 provisions across 31 acts. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind and Cloudflare D1 with Vitest and an offline deterministic workflow plus Bengali PDF engine.

summary: Wearable memory companion for glasses that maps belongings and recalls people.
readme_summary: Wearable-first assistant designed for Meta Smart Glasses with POV snapshots and voice commands. Grounds belongings to visual landmarks for dementia/MCI/ADHD users, with Next.js apps and Meta Muse integration.

summary: Bilingual EN/ES voice companion for older adults with supervised evals
readme_summary: FastAPI backend with Next.js frontend proxying audio to /stt and chat turns. Dockerized stack with offline demo fakes and supervisor-run model evals with spend ledger. Focus on accessible voice interaction.

summary: Turns any tutorial video into a live camera coach that checks your work
readme_summary: Upload an mp4 and follow hands-free as it reads steps, plays clips, and watches via camera to flag mistakes. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 for steps, SAM 3.1 for vision, and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 with Node server and web client.

summary: Video-to-listing P2P marketplace that segments products and photos.
readme_summary: PanDrop uploads seller video, segments products, audits and photographs them into editable listings and marketplace discovery. Uses SAM 3.1 for extraction/inspection with separate frontend and backend.

summary: Postal travel quest in the Philippines to collect stamps, mail postcards, shop local.
readme_summary: PWA with AI guide Isidro, QR stamp collection E to SSS ranks, spoken journal and Nano-Shops via PayMongo. Backend integrates Muse Spark, Muse Image, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe for guide, media and moderation.

summary: Photo-based space memory that reports missing, new and moved items
readme_summary: Mobile-first Next.js app stores spaces and items in IndexedDB, vision via server route to keep keys private. Compares new photo to tracked items to report missing, new, moved. Uses Meta Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 for diffing.

summary: Twelve AI shoppers test real stores for accessibility and checkout bugs
readme_summary: Muse Spark agents with distinct devices and needs walk OpenTelemetry Demo shop in a real browser one action at a time. Records walkout points, writes patches, rebuilds via Docker and re-runs same personas to prove fix. TypeScript harness with evidence logs.

summary: Phone companion that sees screen and camera and talks back in real time
readme_summary: Native Android companion for elderly, blind and non-technical users needing live help. Sees screen/camera, hears and speaks in real time for stuck moments. Built collaboratively by Muse Code with Claude Code as build lead.

summary: Phone bodyguard that detects snatch and pocket theft with on-device vision
readme_summary: SpatialSentry provides continuous phone protection, snatch deterrence and ephemeral spatial memory with 10s RAM purge. FastAPI backend with React Tailwind PWA frontend for phones and Ray-Ban. Uses SAM 3.1 vision plus Muse and Llama 3 for threat reasoning.

summary: Gesture-controlled video overlay turning webcam feed into presentation canvas
readme_summary: Native macOS Swift app that maps hand gestures to interactive cards inside Zoom and Teams video. Zero-dependency Camera Extension architecture. Uses Muse Spark for AI visual education studio features.

summary: AR app that places objects on countertops via vision model coordinates
readme_summary: Unity AR app that screenshots the view and asks muse-spark-1.3 where to place an object. Uses Meta Model API Responses API with file upload, JSON x/y output to drive placement.

summary: Interactive pile of clay people chatting about live news you can tap
readme_summary: Rabble is a web toy where clay people fall, pile, and talk about today's news. It uses Muse Image to generate characters, SAM 3.1 to cut out figures, and Muse Spark to write conversations and rephrase user input.

summary: Physics-verified agent for graphene energy storage design exploration
readme_summary: Agent that proposes graphene designs with Muse Spark, then validates via deterministic physics and independent verifier. Includes benchmarks, provenance tracking, optimization and console UI with 47 tests passing.

summary: Electron desktop office UI to monitor Claude Code and other coding CLI agents together
readme_summary: Agent Office is an Electron desktop app showing main and sub-agents as office characters. Left is persistent office view, right hosts tabs for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Muse Code, and Gemini. Integrates official CLIs for login and execution rather than bundling models.

summary: Warehouse auditor that counts cartons with vision and reconciles ERP records.
readme_summary: SAM 3.1 segments and counts cartons from shelf photo/video, deterministic compare checks against simulated ERP, Muse Spark investigates gaps for human approval. Client/server architecture with spec-driven slices and adversarial QA gates. Uses Meta Model API for vision and reasoning.

summary: Brain-computer interface that steers a Pygame game using 8-channel EEG signals
readme_summary: Streams 250Hz EEG from BrainAccess headset into PSD features plus spatial GNN with few-shot adapter. Python + Pygame live game steered by thought alongside keyboard. Muse models coach the meta-pipeline for calibration.

summary: Helps users pause and verify suspected voice-phishing calls before sending money
readme_summary: Next.js prototype with scripted 20-turn voice-phishing replay, local rules-based risk escalation and mock smart-glasses warnings. Includes optional adapters for Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark behind consent and budget guards. Demo uses synthetic audio, not live inference.

summary: Interactive AR spellbook with animated ice magic for fantasy strategy game
readme_summary: Unity demo of a living grimoire on a wooden table with four ice spells as medallions. Book art and spell animations were generated with Meta Muse models, looping on selection with titles and stats.

summary: Permission and audit layer tracing AI agent actions for approval
readme_summary: Accountability pipeline between agent and tools with tracing, role permissions, second-model review and human approval. Python package with config, dashboard and tamper-evident log. Built to block prompt-injected actions like exfiltration.

summary: C++ kernel that schedules trading agents and risk-checks every order
readme_summary: C++20 kernel for LLM trading agents as runtime behind Dodona GPU-compute options market. Schedules agents, pages context into token budget, gates orders in integer cents and bills per token. Muse Spark via MCP over stdio.

summary: Muse models propose Lean 4 proofs verified by a hardened checker loop
readme_summary: Generate-and-check system where Muse Spark and Wonder propose Lean 4 proofs. Hardened Lean checker verifies them and returns errors for retry. Achieved 15/15 verified theorems plus SAT labs.

summary: Local project memory that answers why-chains and as-of questions with citations.
readme_summary: Blackbox stores decisions, commits, document versions, recordings and agent sessions in SQLite. Node TypeScript CLI answers why and as-of queries with supported labels. Uses retrieval over local project history rather than live model claims.

summary: Research workspace where agent finds papers and maps topics in bubbles
readme_summary: Note workspace with / commands where agent suggests papers with fit, weaknesses, and full-text vs abstract judgement. Folders set Tutor/Analyst roles, Neurolib bubble map visualizes topics. Built for Indie Build for Your World.

summary: Read-only checker verifying network changes against intent before deployment
readme_summary: Declares must_reach/must_not_reach intent for baseline/proposed snapshots and runs deterministic Batfish checks via run_assessment_pipeline. Python CLI and Streamlit UI share one backend; Muse Spark investigates and proposes explanations. Read-only design, Python owns verdicts: REGRESSION_DETECTED or clean.

summary: Physics lab that segments objects with SAM 3.1 and benchmarks neural flow surrogates
readme_summary: Takes object photo, segments with Meta SAM 3.1, simulates flow with exact numerical solver, then trains CNN, FNO and JEPA surrogates to measure error vs horizon and drift. Autonomous assistant uses Muse Spark on Groq with Llama Prompt Guard 2. Runs on laptop CPU.

summary: Local dashboard giving Muse Code permanent project memory to cut costs
readme_summary: Dashboard for Muse Code with Permanent Memory Optimizer storing decisions, files and runs outside chat. Provides approvals, previews, 3D view and skill library. Aims to halve token cost on long sessions.

summary: Mobile farming companion with weather, crop advice and marketplace.
readme_summary: Agri Lanka is an Android farming app with weather forecasting, crop guidance and e-commerce checkout. Built with native Android Gradle stack and in-app navigation. Provides light mode, product pages and farmer-focused workflows for Sri Lanka.

summary: Maps cloud identity attack paths and simulates least-privilege fixes.
readme_summary: BreachGraph AI analyzes AWS IAM exports via deterministic engine to prove attack paths to sensitive data. Meta AI explains risk in plain language and simulator re-runs fixes. Never touches live accounts, uses synthetic demo with frontend plus backend.

summary: Reconstructs failed EV charges to compute auditable refunds for review
readme_summary: Reconstructs failed EV sessions from raw inputs, computes owed refunds with code-only arithmetic, and explains with citations. Model explains without computing money. FastAPI + Next.js with 75 tests.

summary: Property management for HOAs with fund accounting and vision-checked repairs
readme_summary: Multi-firm Blazor web app combining unit registry, fund-separated accounting, work orders, voting and AI assistant. Built on .NET 10, C# 14 and SQL Server. Uses muse-spark, muse-wonder, voice-transcribe, SAM 3.1 and muse-image for ops, verification and minutes.

summary: Real-time interpreter that resolves pointing words like this and there visually
readme_summary: CommonGround grounds ambiguous speech in shared physical context using phone camera input. It combines Muse Voice for speech, Muse Spark for language, and SAM 3.1 for object highlighting to translate when confident and clarify when ambiguous.

summary: Guides kids from business idea to first sale with camera and voice missions.
readme_summary: Kid entrepreneurship tutor where olive guide gives hints, camera and voice verify missions. Numbers computed by code, not model. Built with Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

summary: AI maintainer that triages GitHub issues and drafts onboarding guides
readme_summary: Custodian runs three workflows on GitHub issues: triage and deduplication, bug reproduction as failing tests, and contributor onboarding guides. Python package with docs and tests. Built on Meta Muse models for issue understanding and code analysis.

summary: Autonomous bug-bounty triage pipeline with debate council and proof checks
readme_summary: Pwnbunny triages HackerOne-style reports end-to-end via multi-stage pipeline, adversarial debate council, and proof engine with prompt-injection defense. Python stack with evals and per-company autonomy policy. Uses Meta Model API for triage, debate, and verification.

summary: Learns physical workflow from one video and verifies next execution
readme_summary: Turns one assembly video into structured steps and expected layouts, then checks second execution for missing or misplaced actions. Go backend with SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark pipeline track-structure-compare.

summary: Turns selfies into animal portraits with side-by-side view and exportable image.
readme_summary: Turns selfies or group photos into animal-inspired portraits with side-by-side comparison and PNG export. Frontend in React/Expo, backend in ASP.NET Core 10. Uses Muse Spark for analogy, SAM for segmentation, and Muse Image for generation.

summary: Tri-visor AI cockpit for microelectronics fault diagnosis and board audit
readme_summary: Real-time CAD vector engine plus microscope and multimeter telemetry with SAM 3.1 video segmentation. Stack is Python backend, frontend visor, n8n workflows on Ubuntu. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning, SAM 3.1 vision, Muse Voice and Wonder via Meta Model API.

summary: Payment firewall for AI agents enforcing budgets and approvals
readme_summary: Security and payment control layer between AI agents and money. Owner sets caps, daily budgets and vendor allowlists; policy engine checks signed expiring quotes and approvals before execution.

summary: Mobile parking app to find, book, and pay for spots in Moroccan cities.
readme_summary: ParkSpot AI shows real parking facilities with live availability and MAD pricing, booking, wallet payment, and access codes. It includes AI assistant, live map, GPS near-me, and voice search plus operator and admin consoles. Built with mobile-first frontend, Drizzle, and Alembic backend.

summary: Source-linked literature review workspace for oral cancer researchers.
readme_summary: Oral-lens restricts retrieval to reviewer-selected papers and returns typed assessment with cited passage IDs. Python app with ingestion, embeddings, DB and frontend. Uses Meta models for assessment with Python checks for citations.

summary: Photo agent that culls, critiques and edits photos in your style with audit log
readme_summary: Curato is a photo agent that culls duplicates and blur, critiques images and learns color style. It edits backgrounds, tries generative fixes with face-change guardrails, and outputs drafts with captions. Vision model scoring with SHA-256 audit logs.

summary: Agentic tool scoring vendors for extraction risk at renewal from cited evidence
readme_summary: Left Holding Diagnostic evaluates software vendors into an extraction-risk renewal report. Agentic engine grounds scoring and chat in cited public and private evidence. Requires separate licensed left-holding.md knowledge pack; built for Meta hackathon startup track.

summary: Crowdsourced neighborhood price index turning free-text sightings into map data.
readme_summary: Cloudflare Worker app uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API to parse free-text prices into structured geolocated data. Browsing is free, publishing uses MetaMask as off-chain identity gate. Live at geoprice.dapp.cl.

summary: Multilingual voice oncology intake with nurse review and evidence links
readme_summary: Hybrid patient intake accepts natural-language symptoms, clarifies missing info and shows traceable summaries for nurse review. Python app with synthetic data only, not for clinical use. Built with Muse Code, guideline-grounded.

summary: Team incident workspace with private evidence workers and approval gate
readme_summary: Collaborative checkout-incident workspace with audience-scoped chats and shared agent. Python stdlib server with vanilla web UI. Uses Muse Spark for private extraction and Muse Wonder for repair proposals.

summary: Time-aware memory pipeline that quarantines suspicious updates from retrieval
readme_summary: Experimental RAG memory layer that retrieves time-aware facts while quarantining poisoned claims. Reports pre-registered v1 and v2 synthetic benchmarks vs hybrid RAG with Clopper-Pearson intervals. SQL schema, evals, and audit docs included.

summary: Helps renters check leases, document rooms, and dispute deductions
readme_summary: Four agents for lease checking, move-in report, move-out check, and deduction disputes with quote-backed flags. Built with Muse Spark and SAM 3.1, local Vault, multilingual leases. Flask web app with tests.

summary: Tanker stowage planner that parses orders, checks stability and explains port-by-port plan
readme_summary: Parses free-text voyage orders into cargo parcels and planning rules. A deterministic solver and stability engine checks fill limits, shear, bending and trim. Muse Spark reads orders and explains results without changing numbers.

summary: Bilingual voice+text Windows operator that runs apps, browser, and security audits
readme_summary: Bilingual EN/ID Windows operator assistant with browser HUD and phone control for apps, browser, mouse/keyboard, screen and camera vision. Built with Python server, nodes, and security modules. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning/vision and SAM 3.1 Cloud for segmentation.

summary: Measures appropriate human reliance on AI advice with ground-truthed vignettes
readme_summary: TRL 4 prototype scoring accept-when-right and reject-when-wrong reliance, plus over-reliance and latency. Uses deterministic transparent recommender with Glass-Box/Black-Box ablation and 87/87 verification assertions. React frontend for controlled trust experiments.

summary: Turns patient clothing notes into evidence-checked adaptive fashion ideas.
readme_summary: Four-step agent reads post-mastectomy forum notes, proposes garments with Muse Spark, verifies with Muse Wonder against citations. Code scoring ranks evidence-backed product ideas.

summary: Ray-Ban glasses app that tells thrift resellers to buy or pass in seconds
readme_summary: Reskale captures glasses photo/button input, identifies items and fetches eBay comps to drive a buy/pass rules agent. Expo phone app with /api/vision backend. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for vision, falling back to Muse Wonder 1.0 on low confidence.

summary: Turns one request into evidence-backed code change with host control
readme_summary: Se separates AI research/planning from execution authority, recording intent, findings, changes, and independent checks. Python + Modal deployment with catalog, research, and audit agents plus CI. Uses constrained agent execution for verifiable diffs.

summary: Decides junction priority from a photo checked against Spanish traffic law
readme_summary: Analyzes driver-seat photos in Spain to answer who goes first with verbatim Reglamento General de Circulacion citations. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for structured scene facts and SAM 3.1 for evidence overlays. Marks checked only when rule engine and AI agree.

summary: Turns plain-English scouting briefs into ranked football shortlists with evidence
readme_summary: AI scouting assistant with Python backend and frontend. Plain-English requests are parsed to validated queries, then scored deterministically on percentile stats. Uses Meta Muse Spark Open only for interpretation and explanations, never for player selection.

summary: Auto retopology for Blender that places animation-ready edge loops around eyes and mouth
readme_summary: Blender tool that converts scan triangle soup to quad meshes with proper facial loops. Renders 10 views for Muse Spark vision to plan loops, SAM 3.1 finds features, quad remesher builds topology. Python addon with eval harness.

summary: Turns a game idea into an editable world bible, map, art and quest kit
readme_summary: WorldForge Lite is a Next.js planning tool that generates world lore, 5 locations, NPCs, quests and concept art with interactive SVG map. Uses Meta AI for generation, chat/voice brainstorming, and location remix with full editing.

summary: Mobile AI assistant that describes surroundings and reads text aloud for blind users
readme_summary: SeeAssist is a mobile accessibility assistant combining image understanding, OCR, and voice interaction. Built with a mobile frontend in src plus backend service. Uses Meta AI capabilities for scene description, text recognition, and Q&A about the camera view.

summary: Trust and safety firewall for identity verification and cross-platform fraud detection
readme_summary: FACEmeInsta is an autonomous trust and safety firewall with cross-platform identity mesh and audit logging. Built in Python with Streamlit frontend, core engine, vision hashing, and Meta API client. Uses muse-spark-open-1026 via Baseten for high-throughput inference.

summary: Evidence-first AI that diagnoses Laravel deployment failures from logs and config
readme_summary: Investigation platform correlating Laravel config, Composer deps, app logs and browser errors into findings and fixes. Built with Laravel 13, PHP 8.3, MySQL and Playwright e2e. Uses Meta AI to synthesize observations and verification checklists.

summary: Turns tutorial videos into structured lessons with progress comparison.
readme_summary: Skillow converts practical videos into step lessons, reviews learner progress, and answers questions with visuals. Architecture extracts lesson genes from video and uses multimodal models for guidance. Built with Python app and Meta models for understanding.

summary: Photo of scattered puzzle pieces becomes step-by-step finding and placement help.
readme_summary: Turns one overhead photo into numbered pieces, next-piece suggestions, and placement overlay. Web app on Cloudflare Workers. Uses Meta vision models to detect pieces and guide verification with follow-up photos.

summary: No-code voice agents that call, answer, book appointments and follow up.
readme_summary: Lets businesses create phone agents with voice, prompt personality, knowledge, and tools for outbound campaigns. Runs on Cloudflare with web frontend. Powered by Meta Muse Spark for conversation and SAM 3.1.

summary: Hardware verifier that blocks impossible electronics builds and proves the fix
readme_summary: BenchTruth validates DIY electronics builds with a deterministic solver for pins, power and mechanics. It uses Muse Spark 1.3 for intent parsing to project_spec.json, then renderers emit BOM, wiring and firmware gated by compile and simulation.

summary: Turns one YouTube song into a themed radio show with AI DJ voice between tracks.
readme_summary: Plays On & On then a fixed Muse Spark DJ line spoken via Supertonic 3 before Invincible. Built with Node 20, TypeScript and Cloudflare hosting with YouTube playback and broadcast controls. Falls back to device voice or captions if voice model fails to load.

summary: Turns messy incident photos into evidence-grounded investigation reports
readme_summary: SceneSignal organizes incident photos into court-admissible reports for safety and insurance investigators. It uses SAM 3.1 for visual defect segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for evidence-grounded reporting, with FastAPI backend and frontend.

summary: AI agent troubleshoots a containerized FRR network via typed tools and logs episodes for training
readme_summary: NetOps RL gives an alert to an agent that diagnoses a containerlab FRR network via MCP tools for OSPF, BGP and routes. Independent grading scores each run and stores steps as datasets. Uses Muse Spark for the agent on the Meta Model API with SSH and Docker exec actions.

summary: Demand forecasting and inventory planning copilot for restaurants and retail
readme_summary: Local Node.js app with zero dependencies for dish-to-ingredient and replenishment planning. Hosted version uses Cloudflare D1 workspaces and server-side Meta Model API calls. Forecasts work offline with limited daily Muse questions.

summary: Isolates ensemble sections from one recording to spot out-of-tune passages
readme_summary: Upload a clip and section list to get isolated stems, per-note intonation measurement and fix-first report. Python core with notebook and Hugging Face Space replay demo. Uses Meta SAM Audio for separation and Muse Spark for analysis.

summary: Verifies physical pick-and-place tasks from video with tracked masks
readme_summary: Upload clip, name object, and draw target polygon; SAM 3.1 tracks masks across frames. Deterministic geometry engine returns PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE with visual evidence. Open-source Next.js plus Docker stack with Playwright fixtures and docs.

summary: Academic BTC/USDT analytics with descriptive, predictive and rule-based signals
readme_summary: Streamlit frontend and Python backend provide candle indicators, saved XGBoost V1 predictions, and BUY/SELL/HOLD rules. Includes Docker deploy, tests, and reference SQL without live trading. Academic demo with virtual portfolio replay and no Meta model integration.

summary: AI career studio that tracks skills and builds adaptive roadmaps from labor trends
readme_summary: SkillMirror is an autonomous career studio with skill tracking, labor-market radar, and sandboxed coding challenges. Built in Python with LangGraph dual-graph orchestration and Bayesian roadmaps. Uses Meta Muse frontier models for planning, evaluation, and content generation.

summary: Multi-agent investigation squad that plans, gathers and reports in one trail
readme_summary: Case-file driven multi-agent system with planning, authorized gathering, debate and unified Trail report. Python stdlib server with Docker and role-based access. Powered by Team of META AI models.

summary: Traces how human rules drift across multi-agent AI handoffs for debugging
readme_summary: Research tool that records inter-agent messages to detect rephrasing or omission of human requirements. Implemented in Python with experiment tooling and Streamlit interactive demo. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 to power saved agent responses for analysis.

summary: Workflow-state access control for agentic retrieval over synthetic docs.
readme_summary: StateGate enforces workflow-state permissions on RAG retrieval with YAML workflows and formal language reference. Includes Python engine, 1024 synthetic docs, and eval kit with oracle. Research prototype without stated Muse integration.

summary: Local-first CCTV system with person detection, face ID, and posture alerts
readme_summary: Transforms ONVIF cameras into privacy-first vision with local person detection, 17-keypoint pose, and face recognition on CPU. Node.js + Python + frontend stack. Uses Meta Model API muse-spark-1.3, muse-wonder-1.0, and sam-3.1 for events.

summary: Scores websites 0-100 on readiness for AI agents to find and act
readme_summary: Crawls automotive dealer sites as an agent would, grades findability and actionability, and replays steps. Generates fix drafts like JSON-LD, llms.txt and robots.txt for approval. Built with Muse Spark via Meta Model API; Python/FastAPI app.

summary: In-store retail intelligence platform with offline demo and analytics server
readme_summary: In-store super-intelligence app with reproducible synthetic fixtures, offline demo and local server on port 8001. Python package with contracts, datasets and docs, designed to run without paid model calls.

summary: Multi-agent app that turns research questions into ranked testable hypotheses
readme_summary: Streamlit UI sends questions to planning, literature retrieval, hypothesis generation, prior-art and causal audit, sandboxed simulation and debate. Uses Muse Spark via OpenAI-compatible Meta API and Muse Voice Transcribe. Python src with config and tests.

summary: Communication network connecting coding agents across harnesses and machines
readme_summary: Interactive coding-agent communication network across harnesses, terminals, users and machines with human-in-loop. Glimmer-named switchboard concept with animated branding. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B plus trained LoRA analyst.

summary: Calm car-buying app ranking new cars by 5-year true monthly cost
readme_summary: Low Key ranks new cars by resale from sold-vehicle data and shows 5-year monthly cost with tax, interest and gas. Finds cheapest nearby in-stock unit with out-the-door estimate. Python stack with headless-glimmer and skills; live at lowkey.autos.

summary: Free open-source browser studio for images, video, type, 3D and motion graphics.
readme_summary: Browser-based creative studio for social content with images, video, type, 3D and motion. Monorepo with apps/web, built with TypeScript and Bun. Meta AI usage not detailed in excerpt; projects are local with no account.

summary: Co-writing harness where AI records decisions and humans approve key choices
readme_summary: Go harness for writing defensible documents with an AI agent that logs tradeoffs and sources. Presents key choices as decision cards with a single approval gate. Uses Meta models for drafting, proposing and tracking decisions.

summary: On-device assistant that automates browser tasks and answers messages in your voice.
readme_summary: Lives on user computers to learn browser tasks, practice safely and run them with approval and cost logs. Twin learns writing style; work distributes across PCs and phone. Built on Meta Muse for 2026 hackathon.

summary: Local security rating and vault that scores coding agent runs for risk
readme_summary: Rust CLI + local dashboard that rates coding agent runs with Security Rating and Run Risk Factor. Provides on-machine vault for apps, agent work and keys with Touch ID / polkit auth. Built as privacy-preserving agent security gateway.

summary: Research demo assessing liquidity of illiquid property collateral
readme_summary: Interactive static demo with 30 ATTOM California addresses, illustrative images and 7-stage synthetic assessment. Keeps calculations and lending logic outside the LLM. Uses Muse Spark for open financial-intelligence research and reporting.

summary: Builds editable low-poly 3D scenes to direct camera and action in AI video.
readme_summary: LittleTake lets creators describe a scene or start from reference to generate editable characters, sets, cameras and shots. Users animate a rough performance to guide AI video generation instead of long prompts. Powered by Muse models with web creator UI.

summary: Offline-first AI tutor with WhatsApp lessons and on-device Llama explanations
readme_summary: Ekatra Offline provides WhatsApp courses and an Android app that works without signal. Stack includes backend, hub, and Android with on-device models. Uses Muse Wonder and Muse Image in cloud to author lessons, Llama 3.2 on-device for tutoring.

summary: Chrome companion that tracks focus, detects drift, and nudges you back on task.
readme_summary: Tuck is a Chrome MV3 extension with a service worker, pure attention engine, and memory store. LLM nodes handle relevance, nudges, profiles and tasks, with planned Muse Code session link. It logs events locally to model drift and replay context.

summary: Texts one daily outfit from your closet, calendar and weather
readme_summary: Wardrobe Stylist digitizes a closet from video and recommends one outfit daily using calendar, weather and laundry state. Next.js app with WhatsApp integration and packing lists. Uses Meta Muse models for vision cataloging and outfit reasoning.

summary: Offline bilingual English-Tamil board with exact preview then speech
readme_summary: WorldSpeak turns intent into exact English/Tamil preview and speaks only on explicit action with offline support. Monorepo with apps/packages, Supabase JSONB persistence and pixel-mask renderer. Uses Spark/SAM pipeline for scene generation.

summary: Voice-led ID verification with spoken coaching and deterministic verdicts
readme_summary: Voice-first KYC agent guides blind/low-vision users through consent, document capture, challenge frames and selfie with transcript mirror. Deterministic checks on OCR, MRZ and face-match decide pass/fail. Node.js app uses Meta AI for voice dialogue with synthetic fixtures only.

summary: Edit AI images by circling and speaking; only marked regions change
readme_summary: Web app for localized image refinement via simultaneous sketch plus speech, with a beta 3D sketch-to-model mode. Stack is Vite + TS + server, using Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Voice Transcribe.

summary: Chrome side panel that proposes calmer page layouts only after you approve
readme_summary: Chrome side-panel extension sends user layout preferences as rules with page content to Muse Spark for a proposed redesign. Preview-then-Keep flow reapplies kept layouts per site type with on-device ranking. Proxy + extension stack with Playwright e2e and evaluations.

summary: Run multi-agent LLM workflows locally with shared context on Pi and Apple Silicon
readme_summary: FleetLLM coordinates multiple agents through one local model with shared context reuse and memory-aware scheduling. Supports Metal and CPU inference; FleetPi adds terminal coding agent on Pi SDK. Reports 65.7% GPQA Diamond with Muse Glimmer 30B Q2_K.

summary: Overhead traffic video turned into turning counts and a 3D junction twin
readme_summary: CairoFlow converts a single overhead video into tracked vehicles, turning counts, speeds and a 3D twin. Each figure carries an evidence label and gate status, withheld on failed checks. Built with SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark for the Meta hackathon.

summary: Turns fabric photos into outfit, shoe and bag design concepts to compare
readme_summary: Fashley studio lets users upload fabric, pick category and style, and generate design sets saved to a wardrobe. Uses Muse Image 1.0 via Meta API for generation, with Cloudflare, Drizzle and camera upload flow.

summary: Multilingual AI steward that runs community lab memberships, forms and access.
readme_summary: Hub Steward is a console plus phone app for agencies with permission-checked AI roles, chat, forms and approvals. Demo is a Siaya Kenya computer lab in English/Swahili/German, using OpenAI-compatible models.

summary: Pixel-level witness that verifies computer-use agents before browser actions run.
readme_summary: TESTIGO+ sits between agent and browser, compares intent vs approval vs pixels, and blocks mismatches with signed receipts. Built in Python with gate, bench and simulation stack, using vision models for screen verification.

summary: Searches a name and builds a sourced expert-witness profile for litigation vetting.
readme_summary: ExpertWitness is an AI research agent that searches court filings, publications, licensing and web sources. Backend agent plus frontend results page links every fact to its source. Uses Muse models for research synthesis and cited profile generation.

summary: Terminal coding agent for MSU students with teach-me and plan modes
readme_summary: CLI agent harness built as extension on pi.dev harness for MSU CatChat AI models. Reads, runs and edits code in ask, plan and yolo modes with ta teaching mode. Includes skills, themes and desktop wrapper.

summary: AI research partner that tests AR-glass material ideas in seconds with sources
readme_summary: Lets users test new optical material ideas with instant calculations and provenance. Frontend plus backend science engine. Uses Muse Spark to explain results, draft reports, and cite sources with deterministic validation.

summary: Chef app for correct ordering, receiving and live stock before service
readme_summary: Restaurant stock and ordering app for chefs to reconcile orders and inventory. Built with Expo SDK mobile frontend, FastAPI Python backend and PostgreSQL. Focuses on receive-right and service-ready workflows.

summary: Browser 3D survivors game with voice-talk NPCs and text-to-hero creation.
readme_summary: Meta Space is a Unity WebGL 3D survivors-like set after HELIOS geoengineering freeze. NPCs talk, listen and know the map via Meta APIs, plus text-prompt hero creation. Includes browser build, lore docs and cinematic clips.

summary: Policy gate that reviews AI-worker actions before effects
readme_summary: Scoped gate where defender roles allow or veto managed AI-worker effects before creation. Includes Streamlit dashboard, autonomy and defense council logic. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for checklist and reviewer decisions.

summary: Turns phone video of motion into tested physics equations
readme_summary: SAM 3.1 tracks objects to position curves, classical code fits textbook equations. Muse Spark proposes missing physics from residuals; refit must beat baseline on held-out footage. Python pipeline with pinned results docs.

summary: Tests if decisions hold when uncertain record links change via human review
readme_summary: JoinWitness is a decision-robustness app for authoring plausible record-link alternatives and checking if conclusions survive. Python backend + frontend with solver scripts and fixtures. Uses Meta AI models for human-AI review and verifiable analysis support.

summary: Plain-English data analyst that writes read-only SQL and verifies numbers
readme_summary: Agent plans questions, writes read-only SQL for SQLite/Postgres and cross-checks results before answering. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API with charting, BI publish and WhatsApp. Python agent with scripts and tests.

summary: Hallucination-resistant chatbot that routes, checks, and stops before guessing.
readme_summary: Prism AI assigns risk profile per question, routes to verifiable tier, checks before answering and logs outcomes to learn routing. UI streams live trace and review page quarantines graph writes. Evaluated vs plain model and RAG.

summary: Mac app where handwriting on paper directs Muse to work on your Mac
readme_summary: Mac app using iPhone Continuity Camera: when pen lifts, Muse model reads handwriting via Meta Model API, Muse Code opens apps, edits files, runs commands. Replies in app window, type or speak also.

summary: Raspberry Pi voice companion that handles messages while you focus phone-free
readme_summary: QuietDesk runs on Raspberry Pi 5 with OLED, button, LEDs and voice-first companion Lumi. It manages focus sessions, urgent messages, and summaries. Built during hackathon using on-device scripts and AI voice.

summary: Reads construction signs and previews future buildings and shadows in 3D
readme_summary: Agent reads a photo of a Japanese construction notice, verifies against city open data, and renders the planned building on PLATEAU 3D. Built as static web plus Python pipeline, it shows winter shadows and demolition status with precomputed sample mode.

summary: Family photo archive that links memories to evidence and questions
readme_summary: Next.js + Supabase app for synthetic originals, recorded observations, comparison, and evidence-linked gallery. Includes Playwright tests and docs for audit gates. Uses Meta models for historical inferences and comparison to suggest questions worth asking.

summary: Six-agent aisle copilot that measures forklift clearance and issues verdicts
readme_summary: Measurement-first safety copilot returning walkway, clearance and blockage percent with GO/NO-GO suggestion. Six-agent crew uses SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark with human final approval.

summary: Simulation of floating solar compute nodes that move to avoid clouds
readme_summary: Marine Compute Swarm simulates ocean solar nodes that forecast clouds and reposition for energy. Web app with TypeScript frontend, Node server and tests. Uses Meta AI for sky analysis and planning.

summary: Analyzes wall photos for damage with confidence and next steps
readme_summary: Visual wall inspector reporting only visible observations, confidence, and next best photo. Backend + frontend on Render. Uses Meta AI vision models for cautious non-diagnostic assessment.

summary: Open ASL gloss lexicon and Blender scripts for signing 3D host characters
readme_summary: Provides a 58-gloss ASL lexicon, 23 reviewed clips for the Fiona rig, and Blender authoring scripts. Built on Amazon Sumerian Hosts SDK and Babylon.js with Muse Code subagent workflows for renders and lexicon.

summary: Open-source toolkit that audits websites for AI answer-engine visibility
readme_summary: AEOForge crawls sites with Playwright to audit answer-engine readiness and generate llms.txt. Built in Python with MCP-native tools, it uses Meta Llama 3.2 to score content and suggest fixes.

summary: Reads scanned Arabic UAE case files into bilingual structured summaries.
readme_summary: Case Reader parses scanned Arabic court files with stamps and handwriting into parties, facts, and deadlines in Arabic/English. Built in Python with muse-spark-1.3 and checked against official UAE law texts.

summary: VS Code extension for guarded code proposals with per-hunk review and patch passports
readme_summary: Security-first VS Code extension delivering live edit proposals with per-hunk review, guarded apply/undo and exported Patch Passports. Uses TypeScript extension plus scripts/fixtures with local TrueForge runtime and deterministic inference fixture for verification.

summary: Socratic study companion that questions you instead of giving answers.
readme_summary: Learning app built to coach thinking through prompts and structured feedback. Web app with components and product docs. Uses Meta AI tooling for guided dialogue during the hackathon build.

summary: Pay-per-use Cardano agent extracting facts with on-chain proof
readme_summary: Agent that quotes then extracts facts from PDFs/photos/CSVs with source evidence for user approval, seals fingerprint on Cardano. Uses Meta AI for extraction and x402 pay-per-request with no escrow.

summary: Converts fixed intersection video into calibrated traffic signal simulation
readme_summary: SAM 3.1 detections plus tracking and homography feed a SUMO twin replaying real vehicles. Muse Spark agent proposes and tests signal plans with evidence. Python pipeline with web viewer and verifier.

summary: Budget-safe harness to run coding agents on Meta Muse models without overspend.
readme_summary: Layer over ECC plan-test-implement-review workflow enforcing meta-only/first policies. Uses LiteLLM + Postgres gateway budgets, loop breaker and burst watchdog. Adds fallback chains and AI-usage logs.

summary: Describe video fixes in plain words and it edits talking-head footage
readme_summary: Python app that learns editing style from before/after pairs and applies cuts to new videos. Trims retakes and pauses, preserves room tone, and proposes review spots. Exports finished timeline or finishes in-app for creators.

summary: AI dungeon master constrained by a rule engine with verifiable secret commits
readme_summary: Fantasy adventure narrated by Muse Spark via tool-call proposals enforced by a TypeScript rule engine. Secrets sealed with SHA-256 and verifiable in browser. Supports click, text and English/Tagalog voice input.

summary: Turns one phone video into six Meta-sized ad videos for small businesses
readme_summary: AdLoom media-to-ad pipeline creates six placement-sized videos and paused ads for owner approval. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Voice with fixture-mode mocks. Live Muse Spark 1.3 text verified, full pipeline unverified.

summary: Research workspace that analyzes FASTA sequences and builds phylogenetic trees
readme_summary: PhyloLoom AI is a reproducible genomics workspace for FASTA validation, stats, alignment and tree export to JSON/Newick. Frontend plus backend with Docker/Caddy deployment. Uses Meta open-weights biological models for mutation analysis with an optional AI copilot.

summary: Home digital twin simulating power, water and outage resilience
readme_summary: CasaOS homeowner agent and interactive digital twin for electricity, water pump, and connectivity dependencies. Explores storm scenarios and backup choices with Meta AI agents, built as HTML twin plus agent.py and engine.py prototype for El Salvador home.

summary: Voice AI that calls clinics to compare prices and books care
readme_summary: Voice assistant for out-of-pocket care, starting with braces, that interviews users, calls clinics, negotiates quotes, and calls back with best deal. Full-stack web plus backend with live demo, supporting talk-to-Lana, watch mode, and be-the-clinic modes.

summary: Maps pedestrian crowd flow from camera footage to top-down heatmaps
readme_summary: Detects people with SAM in camera video, projects to top-down map via homography, builds heatmaps and flow arrows for transit planning. Tested on EPFL SCOUT and CityStreet data.

summary: Multimodal RFP and dynamic pricing platform for hospitality
readme_summary: Hospitality RFP Engine automates PDF extraction, layout validation, negotiation and pricing with Django + React. Uses Muse Wonder and Muse Spark for reasoning, omniASR for STT and SeamlessM4T v2 for TTS.

summary: Symptom triage that pages clinicians and escalates until someone responds
readme_summary: Patient describes symptoms typed or spoken, rules plus Meta models set urgency, clinicians paged with escalation and audited handoff. Docker Python + Node stack with frontend/backend. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Meta models for triage and lab PDF explanation.

summary: Mobile editor turning Tamil voice prompts into FFmpeg renders
readme_summary: Footage-aware mobile editing assistant that inspects clips, converts Tamil and English voice into validated plans, and renders trimmed captioned videos. Muse Spark muse-spark-1.3 plans edits, Flutter app with Python backend and FFmpeg export.

summary: Photo becomes a speaking touch communication board for non-speaking people
readme_summary: Take a room photo, AI finds objects and outlines them, each becomes offline touch-to-speak zone in EN/ES/ZH. Static web app with multilingual docs. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Image.

summary: Agentic swarm that rewrites quantum circuits with exact equivalence checks.
readme_summary: Planner-worker-reviewer loop where a planner picks strategies and parallel workers propose circuit rewrites. Keeps only Qiskit Operator.equiv-passing results with live 3D viewer. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 planner via Responses API and Muse Code workers.

summary: 20x110m autonomous batik factory prototype with ESP32 robotic controls
readme_summary: Autonomous batik production factory design with floor plans, ESP32-S3 mesh controls and thermal systems. Static HTML demos plus Python app.py and ESP32 firmware. Uses Muse Spark Open via Modal for factory automation logic.

summary: Metadata-first AI search that turns missions into combinable public datasets and data recipes
readme_summary: Replaces keyword portal search with mission-to-data semantic discovery, relationship explanation and gap detection. AI-assisted app with backend/frontend split for public government data discovery.

summary: Local governed agent runtime that plans goals with human approval and audit trail
readme_summary: Local agent runtime for Ghost Developer Studio that plans goals and executes tools under governance. Read tools run freely, write/exec require human approval with append-only trail. Uses Python CLI + HTTP serve architecture.

summary: Memory and learning app helping neurodivergent thinkers retain and explain ideas
readme_summary: Provides personalized analogies, eight-step explanations, work documentation and interview recall practice. Stack split into backend/ and frontend/ with supporting tools and PRD docs. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for analogy generation, feedback and accomplishment recognition.

summary: 3D tabletop evacuation simulator for stress-testing building disruptions.
readme_summary: ExitLab is a React Three Fiber and Vite app with Express server for evacuation simulation. Renders architectural scenes and runs disruption scenarios. Uses TypeScript, Tailwind and Vitest with AI-assisted stress testing.

summary: Voice-commanded real-time strategy game with LLM captains and enemy.
readme_summary: THE WARDENS is a voice-controlled RTS built in Rust with TypeScript tooling. Local Muse Glimmer converts speech plus fog-of-war context into orders. Enemy broodlord runs as LLM agent with persistent commander history.

summary: Full-duplex face-to-face translator for 17 languages that listens while speaking
readme_summary: Live conversation translator defaulting Chinese-Spanish that keeps listening while displaying translations. Uses Soniox for streaming ASR/TTS and Meta Model API muse-spark and muse-voice-transcribe for summaries. Python server with static UI and demo mode.

summary: Shelf video to product catalog and ad drafts with owner approval and spend caps
readme_summary: Shop owner films shelf; ffmpeg samples frames, Muse Spark reads price tags and merges detections into editable catalog. Planner picks 3 products and generates copy and images from real photos with logging and backend caps. Python app with evals and samples.

summary: Reads your website to profile competitor fans and design Meta, TikTok, Google campaigns
readme_summary: Paste a website to find competitors via Qloo taste graph, profile their fans and generate segmented campaigns. Daily run refreshes audiences with cited Qloo calls. Next.js app with Docker, scripts and tests, built for Qloo hackathon.

summary: Turns supplier PDF datasheets into validated bilingual company sheets
readme_summary: Extracts 16-field product data from supplier PDFs with evidence-linked trust report. Generates stamped A4 company sheets in PT/ES/EN and ERP-ready Excel/JSON via Node backend. Uses Meta AI via Model API with offline fallback for extraction.

summary: Analyzes side-on free-throw video to measure arc and coach form.
readme_summary: Upload a side-on clip to track ball, hoop and shooter with SAM 3.1 video segmentation. Plain Python measures arc peak, entry angle, makes and routine tempo. Muse Spark turns metrics into one strength, one fix and one drill with annotated replay.

summary: Answers missed calls for local businesses and books jobs in 5 stages
readme_summary: Voice agent for HVAC businesses handling inbound calls, address and urgency capture to appointment booking. Built with C# Azure Functions and Twilio voice webhooks plus ConversationFlowEngine state machine. Hands off to human on request and saves lead.

summary: Debugging loop from evidence to verified patch with human approval
readme_summary: Evidence-to-patch assistant running baseline tests, AI diagnosis, minimal patch and real verification. Node/pnpm monorepo with SQLite, server on 4000 and web on 3000. Uses META_API_KEY / Baseten Muse models with e2e Playwright tests.

summary: Audits earnings guidance credibility for 50 US market stocks
readme_summary: RevCall analyzes guidance vs delivery for 50 US titans to score credibility. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API plus HistGBDT with Bayesian model. Streamlit app with dataset builder, evaluation and tests.

summary: Zero-fee UPI gateway that uses AI to verify direct merchant payments per order
readme_summary: Customers pay directly to merchant UPI accounts while Muse Spark 1.3 confirms payment and marks orders paid without holding funds. Built with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.2 and MySQL 8 with Docker Compose deployment.

summary: Suggests cosmetic ingredient swaps and checks emulsion stability and rules
readme_summary: Reformula photographs an INCI label, plans REACH-compliant substitutions via ingredient library, PubChem and rule checker. Python app with web search and lab-trial guidance. Uses Muse Spark vision for label parsing and Muse Spark 1.3 tool-calling for planning.

summary: Fictional vehicle-cabin diagnostics demo with evidence tracing
readme_summary: Offline-first fictional diagnostics demo showing observation selection, evidence graph, contradiction detection and human review. Three-step judge flow with before/after trace. No real diagnosis or Meta calls in demo.

summary: Turns AI chats into learner-owned context for better next lessons
readme_summary: Knovine connects everyday AI chats via private student-scoped MCP into a persistent concept map with evidence. Learners share with class, teachers generate and review Meta-powered lessons. Muse Spark powers in-app learning.

summary: Account-scoped agent OS with verified actions and Solana x402 payments
readme_summary: Gives each account an isolated orchestrator, delegated Solana wallet, and audit trail for device actions. Enforces permission-checked Code Mode and x402 payment handshakes. Uses account-bound LLM credentials for reasoning.

summary: Independently checks AI coding-agent diffs by verifying model claims against evidence.
readme_summary: AI Change Inspector captures Git diffs into immutable snapshots, asks Muse Spark for risk hypotheses, then deterministically verifies each citation exists. Developers record decisions in a React diff explorer with inbox and export. Provides read-only feedback to agents.

summary: Turns denial letters into deadlines, key facts, and a draft appeal letter.
readme_summary: Overturn parses PDF/Word denial letters to extract payer, codes, reasons, and appeal deadline with quotes, plus plain-language explanation and draft appeal. Uses fine-tuned Llama-3.2-1B with evals and never invents missing dates.

summary: Multilingual night-time enrollment agent to fill empty childcare seats.
readme_summary: Agent workflow for Minnesota childcare providers handling after-hours inquiries, tour booking and enrollment forms. Built with Next.js using Muse Code, with Somali and Spanish support and privacy-safe flyer flow.

summary: AI film studio that structures story-to-film with human approval each step
readme_summary: Monofilm is an AI film studio where a human directs and approves every production step. It brings story-to-script, continuity and shot structure to unreliable generative video. Built on Meta Muse models and deployed on Cloudflare Workers.

summary: Turns grandparents spoken stories into bilingual side-by-side storybooks
readme_summary: Next.js App Router React 19 app preserving idioms with explanations, not literal translation. Supports 20 languages defaulting Tamil to English. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for transcription, translation, and storytelling.

summary: El Nino preparedness backend with risk alerts, scraping, and verification
readme_summary: FastAPI backend for El Nino preparedness app with Next.js frontend in sibling repo. Stack is Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis, Alembic, Docker Compose. Uses Meta Muse Spark for LLM risk analysis and verification.

summary: Local web workspace linking photo refs, 3D set and Blender shot planning
readme_summary: Connects photographic references, Three.js set navigation and Blender motion in one local web app. Deterministic Python code handles scene edits and validation while bounded roles assist planning. Uses Meta image generation for references and hosted SAM 3D for geometry.

summary: NEAR escrow where AI verifier attests delivery before funds release
readme_summary: Cross-border payments and bookings settled via NEAR escrow contract with AI deliverable checks. AI holds capped function-call key for attest only, never moves money. Verdict recorded on-chain for payer release.

summary: Links spoken "this/that" in assembly videos to visible parts and tracks them.
readme_summary: Pipeline uses Muse Voice Transcribe for turn windows, Muse Spark 1.3 for gesture and reference grounding, SAM 3.1 for segmentation and tracking. Says cannot distinguish when ambiguous. Python app with latency and baseline eval folders.

summary: Bangla sidewalk copilot that segments hazards and drafts ward council reports
readme_summary: PothChol lets Dhaka pedestrians photo sidewalks for hazard masks and safe-walking guidance in Bangla/English. Built with Next.js calling Meta Responses API for segmentation and planning. Generates formal DNCC/DSCC ward letters.

summary: Manages folkstyle wrestling tournaments from brackets to mat-side scoring
readme_summary: Tournament operations platform with registration, check-in, deterministic brackets and table scoring with rest gate. Zero-dependency Node 20+ app with plain HTML/CSS/JS client built for gym Wi-Fi. Includes trading cards showcase and seeded demo roles.

summary: Gamified 3D simulator teaching building codes via AI extraction and checks
readme_summary: Transforms building regulations into interactive engineering challenges with 3D simulation. Combines Python AI regulation extraction, deterministic calculations, and evidence traceability. Uses Meta API models for parsing regulatory documents into verifiable constraints.

summary: Camera-guided agent that verifies equipment installs and directs next shot.
readme_summary: ProofCam verifies physical equipment installations from photos and decides what to capture next. No web app or DB yet, milestone 0 single-photo proven offline. Exclusively uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark 1.3 for planning and SAM 3.1 for segmentation.

summary: One messy-room photo becomes a guided cleanup quest with a companion
readme_summary: Analyzes one photo to create quest map stops, boss area and step guidance. Built on Meta Model API for vision and generation with rigged companions, app client, app-server and validation pipeline.

summary: Turns customer descriptions and drawings into reviewable fiberglass cost estimates
readme_summary: Browser app follows Upload-Describe, Review, Calculate, Compare workflow for GRP costing. Muse interprets drawings, asks clarifications and narrates results. Deterministic Python code does geometry and money; runs manual without key.

summary: Multi-model decision room with six debate modes in one conversation
readme_summary: Chat app orchestrates Muse Spark, ChatGPT and others through modes from quick answer to full court debate with research. Dockerized backend + frontend deployed on Fly.io. Uses Muse Spark as core reasoning model.

summary: First-responder sweep tool drawing live floor plans with people detection
