readme_summary: iOS sweep app combining RoomPlan LiDAR mapping with SAM 3.1 detections every 1.5s. Places pins via depth and camera pose with AR overlay and voice notes. Built for building search and solo drills.

summary: Turns product photos and a prompt into a captioned vertical video ad
readme_summary: Next.js + Remotion pipeline that writes scripts from photos, voices them, scores music, and renders 720x1280 MP4. Built on Meta SAM 3.1 for vision and Muse Spark for script and direction.

summary: Multi-agent team that debates tickers and issues BUY HOLD SELL calls
readme_summary: Streamlit app runs market, fundamentals, sentiment, bull-bear debate and risk agents to final portfolio decision. Built with Python using Yahoo Finance data. Uses Muse via Meta Model API with mock fallback.

summary: Long-term memory layer for host AI models evaluated on Muse Spark
readme_summary: HIX H5 is a proprietary hosted memory layer for LLMs, evaluated on Muse Spark 1.3 with LoCoMo n=360. This repo publishes results, scoring, docs and a thin demo client that calls the hosted H5 API.

summary: Turns PDFs into structured AI-powered book reader sites you can deploy.
readme_summary: Uploads PDF via OCR endpoint, converts to chapters with stable IDs, and exports a reader website. Uses Meta models for organizing and theming without rewriting text, plus integrity validator. You-control infra with Modal and speech services.

summary: Maintenance intake assistant that drafts evidence-linked work orders for review.
readme_summary: FieldOps AI accepts text, equipment photos and voice for maintenance intake with human-reviewed drafts. Uses Meta Muse Spark for structured analysis and Muse Voice Transcribe. Separates observations from inferences with audit events and approval.

summary: Route accessibility checker that analyzes street photos for wheelchair obstacles with evidence.
readme_summary: Full-stack app with frontend map and backend sampler every ~50m pulling Mapillary street photos. Analyzes each with Muse Spark muse-spark-1.3 to list obstacles, confidence, photo source and age, never declaring routes accessible.

summary: Turns a question, clip and PDF into an evidence-linked visual explainer
readme_summary: Web studio that drafts story with Muse Spark from video and document pages, tracks parts with SAM 3.1, and edits beats into vertical film. Node server plus static frontend, deployed on Vercel.

summary: Electronics salvage workbench for photo ID, parts inventory and builds
readme_summary: Node server plus web UI identifies donor devices from photos and maintains reusable inventory with reservations. Uses Meta Muse models for identification and build planning grounded in datasheets.

summary: Visual operations auditor with multi-role review and human approval
readme_summary: Uploads workstation photos for Muse Spark reasoning grounded by SAM 3.1 segmentation through a three-role council. Node server plus web app records audit history, metrics and downloadable reports.

summary: Generates landing pages, ad creatives and Meta campaigns from products
readme_summary: SaaS workflow from product catalog to landing page, copy and multi-angle creatives to Meta Ads setup. Uses Meta Model API Studio for generation and targets Facebook/Instagram with CAPI tracking. Frontend plus backend guided automation flow.

summary: Edits a broken boat-racing RL policy weights by hand to restore scoring without retraining
readme_summary: Muse Spark reads MAPPO PyQuaticus policy weights, diagnoses flag-carry failure, installs gated steer-home reflex. Edits 2.9% of weights, evaluated on held-out matches. Python, RL checkpoints, results logs.

summary: Eight AI agents generate motion graphics from one brief for blind comparison.
readme_summary: Generates eight 8-second HTML motion loops from the same brief in about 90 seconds for design exploration. Renders side-by-side with validation, metrics and blind scoring. Built as multi-agent system during hackathon.

summary: Natural-language silicon compiler with formal SMT verification on SkyWater 130nm.
readme_summary: ClayFace compiles natural language to SystemVerilog systolic-array accelerators with closed-loop SymbiYosys + Z3 verification. It adds vision-based die inspection with Meta SAM 3.1 and bit-exact INT32 PyTorch parity. Full-stack with backend, frontend, docs, and 47 passing sign-off tests.

summary: Reads 2D mechanical drawings to find DFM flaws, explain failures, and prove fixes.
readme_summary: Extracts structured part specs with Muse Spark vision, checks deterministic DFM rules, then re-verifies crops to drop misreads. Highlights issues with SAM 3.1 plus evidence boxes and explains failures with NHTSA recall index. Fixed drawing is re-rendered and re-checked.

summary: Photo riddle game where AI judges camera answers and checks its own work
readme_summary: Kaptr is a mobile photo game where players answer riddles with camera photos judged in seconds. Backend verifies results and generates fair riddles before release. It uses Muse Spark for judging, SAM 3.1 for segmentation and spoof detection, Muse Image and Wonder.

summary: Residential studio with shared 2D/3D model and AI room planning
readme_summary: Next.js + Cloudflare Worker app with shared 2D/3D project model, autosave, and undoable room edits. Server-only Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Responses API for layout inspection and area calc.

summary: WhatsApp mailbox that digitizes, triages and reads physical mail aloud
readme_summary: MailboxAI gives users a mailing address managed via WhatsApp with ID verification, AI triage and voice notes. Businesses send soft mail directly, cutting paper, postage and delivery delay.

summary: Symbolic-logic NLI lab testing Neutral vs inconclusive universals
readme_summary: This workshop studies equivocation-induced incoherent universals with FOL-extended NLI resolution. Provides six procedures, mapping functions, cases and verification tables. Logs Muse calls for grounding lexical ambiguity proofs.

summary: Decision-tree CLI that records AI agent questions and tests options on branches
readme_summary: pip package opendtree with dtree command. Persists decisions, builds untaken options on git branches with same tests, sandboxed agents with caps, history and cost tracking.

summary: Deterministic safety gate and black box for AI-driven vehicles and robots
readme_summary: Turns Openwist vehicle/robot constitution into enforceable software. Muse models perceive and propose actions while an independent deterministic gate allows or blocks them with tamper-evident logging.

summary: Checks and repairs PDFs for accessibility with human approval
readme_summary: Checks PDFs against PDF/UA-1 and WCAG 2.1 AA, re-validates repairs, and queues judgment calls for review. Java/Docker engine with journals and cost tracking. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for figure descriptions and reading order drafts.

summary: Turns clutter photos into reviewable listings and triages buyer messages for you.
readme_summary: Prototype that separates what photos and seller messages support from unknowns. Generates listings from photos and lets an agent sort messages while owner decides. Built with Next.js on Vercel using Meta Muse models for vision and decisions.

summary: Android prototype that reviews texts and calls for digital-arrest scam signs.
readme_summary: Android app with backend-only AI; no on-device models. Muse Spark 1.3 checks text and screen samples, Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 plus Spark handles speakerphone clips. Targets English/Hindi scam review with explicit prototype limits.

summary: Windows desktop assistant that chats by voice or text and opens apps, searches, and sets timers.
readme_summary: Mochi is an Electron+TypeScript Windows assistant for voice/text chat, app launching, web search, timers, weather and screen reading. Uses src/, extension/ and public/ with ARCHITECTURE.md and FUNCTIONS.md. Uses Muse for dialogue and spoken replies in English and French.

summary: Arabic RTL online store for phones with Telegram order management
readme_summary: RTL Arabic e-commerce for phones and accessories inspired by Apple store design. Products and categories stored in MongoDB, images via Telegram file IDs, admin via Telegram bot with webhook. Stack is Next.js with Vercel config. No Meta AI use stated.

summary: Local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates with agent messaging
readme_summary: HoleBot is a HoleA.I fork of OpenBot providing workspaces, queues and embedded browser. Supports Codex, Claude Code, Grok, OpenCode and others via ACP. Runs locally as a desktop app for agent-to-agent work.

summary: Patient-centered oncology workspace with evidence-linked records and reports.
readme_summary: AI-native oncology intelligence platform organizing fictional patient cases, sources, questions and reports. React/Vite/TypeScript frontend with FastAPI/PostgreSQL backend, using Muse models for source-anchored Q&A and comparisons.

summary: Describe a creature or robot and watch it learn to move in real physics.
readme_summary: Electron desktop with React Three Fiber visualizes MuJoCo physics creatures. Trains locomotion with PPO on CPU and exports to real world. Uses Muse Spark copilot to generate morphology and rewards.

summary: Rust inference core plus Go serving stack to run large models on small GPUs
readme_summary: Rust inference engine with Go serving platform optimized for small hardware like RX 7900 XTX. Benchmarks Muse Glimmer 30B and documents ROCm diagnosis driving design. Focus on model serving, performance tuning, and local infra.

summary: Quest VR voice coach that logs meals, tracks workouts and drafts posts
readme_summary: Quest 3S app where Atlas voice assistant logs meals, tracks squats and drafts social posts on A Better U platform. Uses Muse Spark for voice reasoning, SAM 3.1 for food segmentation and measurement, and Muse Image for post art.

summary: Edit lecture videos by editing words with AI effects and re-voicing
readme_summary: Browser and desktop editor that transcribes video to word-level timing for ripple cuts, plus AI effects, director, masks and subtitles. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Meta models via gateway. Stack is web frontend with gateway service.

summary: Measures shrimp size from a ruler photo via Messenger bot and dashboard
readme_summary: Farmer sends one photo of shrimp by a ruler to a Messenger bot for outlined lengths, average and per-kg size. Uses SAM-style segmentation plus Muse Spark for Vietnamese text, with web dashboard for growth trends. Built solo with Python and Node services.

summary: Generates true-size CAD models and printable grippers from phone photos
readme_summary: Reconstructs NURBS models with editable feature trees from phone photos, tested in MuJoCo before print. Python webapp with Fusion bridge. Uses Meta AI for vision reconstruction for SO-101 robot tooling.

summary: Turns research papers into interactive testable 3D methodology models
readme_summary: Transforms papers from any domain into evidence-linked editable methodology with 3D builds and tensor views. Researchers modify components, run real experiments on isolated compute and compare measured results.

summary: Reusable knowledge and procedures layer to cut repeat AI work across creative, code and agents
readme_summary: SilkWeb provides a reusable intelligence layer with a Git-backed knowledge registry, data contracts, and verified procedures. It demos creative ad generation, coding-agent MCP tools, and deterministic agent execution. Uses Muse models for generation with access-controlled live inference.

summary: Camera + switch monitor that verifies rack cables before you unplug the wrong one
readme_summary: Overwatch for Wiring and Links checks maintenance tickets against live switch state and camera vision. Go service with perception, policy and relay layers uses SAM 3.1 for cable segmentation and hands monitoring to warn before wrong pulls.

summary: Autonomous exploratory web tester that replays and verifies bugs before reporting
readme_summary: Active testing agent for web apps driven by Meta Muse Spark. Runs in isolated secret-free browser with run contracts, tries edge cases, then double-replays violations with controls. Monorepo is TypeScript with pnpm workspaces, docs/spec, and vitest. Uses Muse Spark for exploration and fix briefs.

summary: Agent workspace turning EDC metadata into reviewable SDTM deliverables
readme_summary: SDTM Artifact Workbench maps source metadata to CDISC SDTM with human approval gates. It generates deterministic R/SAS, runs isolated R with XPT checks, and packages evidence. Uses MCP services for CDISC, BioPortal, ClinicalTrials.

summary: Turns app ideas into workspaces with docs, task board and page previews
readme_summary: MuseVibe converts a short idea via setup wizard into planning docs, tasks and generated HTML previews. Stack is Next.js with Neon database and owner-scoped sync. Uses Meta AI models for planning and design generation with local demo fallbacks.

summary: Ray-Ban glasses app that whispers partner's needs to new dads until they learn
readme_summary: Noticer lets a partner list needs in her own words and cues the dad via Ray-Ban Meta glasses with silent then whispered prompts. Built in Swift for iOS, it tracks learning and fades cues, using Muse Spark for need matching and prioritization.

summary: Agentic website platform that answers leads and sells while business sleeps
readme_summary: Agentrix rebuilds brochure sites as Website 4.0 agents for sales, concierge, and support built on ADK-Rust. Uses Meta Muse models for visitor interaction, lead handling, and commerce flows across demo sites.

summary: Answers questions by playing exact moments from curated YouTube library
readme_summary: Splits curated YouTube transcripts into passages and retrieves the answering moment with creator, title, and timestamps. Plays only that segment with short written answer using Meta Model API. FastAPI + SQLite backend, React Vite frontend.

summary: Organizes Safari tabs into focused local workspaces with Meta AI
readme_summary: Safari extension that finds tabs, organizes projects, and saves/restores workspaces locally. Native macOS app plus server and extension components. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for tab organization and search.

summary: Searchable food and travel memory from your photos, run fully on-device
readme_summary: Turns local photos and location history into queryable memory of meals and places. Ask agent uses local Muse Glimmer and DINOv3 for retrieval without uploading to cloud, food-first with trips next.

summary: Connects code, translation context and delivery for multi-language app shipping
readme_summary: Localization integration workspace linking repo source to translation generation and delivery. Provides MCP tools, permission-checked actions and usage normalization. Uses Meta Responses tools with BYOK and encrypted replay.

summary: Vision-only AI that plays Geometry Dash from screen pixels
readme_summary: Geometry Dash Vision AI plays from screen capture alone with one jump input, no game state access. It uses YOLO detection, motion model and route controller with safety shield. Requires NVIDIA GPU with optional TensorRT export for real-time play.

summary: Local-first desktop workspace turning lectures into exam practice.
readme_summary: PySide6 Qt app that records and transcribes lectures and keeps slides and notes together. Local-first Python architecture for university courses. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 API to generate exam practice.

summary: Photo journal that turns daily photos into a song and music video.
readme_summary: Web + server studio analyzes uploaded photos to assign a genre, cast photo subjects as band, and render song plus video. Live demo site documented in PRODUCT and DESIGN docs. Uses Meta vision and music generation models.

summary: Scores Instagram Reels on 10 factors and tells creators exactly what to fix
readme_summary: Prysm analyzes short-form video and scores hook, retention, audio, trends and 6 other factors with fixes. A chat assistant ARIA answers follow-up improvement questions. Stack is React+Vite, FastAPI, Redis workers running on Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1.

summary: AI test engineer that generates tests and separates faulty tests from faulty code
readme_summary: Generates tests with Meta Muse Glimmer then builds an independent docstring-based oracle to triage failures. Built in Python with Streamlit UI and evaluation harness. Prevents self-healing by rewriting assertions to match code.

summary: Screen-free AI messenger that finds contacts and drafts messages by voice
readme_summary: Mobile iPhone app plus backend where Meta-powered agent handles contacts, reads conversations and drafts sends with approval. Built for users who cannot rely on visual navigation. Conversational intent and tool delegation.

summary: Recovers a smooth 3D LUT to match footage to a reference grade
readme_summary: Python differentiable color engine that optimizes a 3D LUT and exports portable .cube. C++ host with FFmpeg pipeline for preview and validation. Built with Meta proprietary and open-weights models for grade matching.

summary: Calm Android launcher with a living companion for the moment
readme_summary: Android home screen companion that surfaces what the moment needs and hides the rest with contextual sheets. Native Kotlin launcher built solo. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Image and Muse Voice Transcribe via Meta Model API.

summary: Agent that probes hidden spring-rope physics from video to predict motion
readme_summary: Scientific agent that selects physical impulses, updates a numerical posterior from camera frames, and predicts unseen motion. Stack is Python backend with frontend and preregistered evaluation. Uses Muse for experiment selection and scoring on held-out episodes.

summary: 3D-printed headset with app for voice-powered visual assistance via USB camera
readme_summary: Meta Muse Vision AI is a Blender-designed 3D-printed headset plus .NET MAUI / Android app using a USB camera. It provides voice-controlled scene understanding built during the hackathon on Muse Spark 1.3 for cross-device wearable intelligence.

summary: Marketing agent turning trade job photos into verified paused Google Ads
readme_summary: Admiry runs inside Muse as a connector for roofers and remodelers to build sites and ads. It uses Muse reasoning with Python tools to verify claims, check Google policy, and create campaigns via Google Ads API.

summary: Queued auto-archiver preserves human-rights video evidence for courts and UN use
readme_summary: Human-rights digital archiving fork adding Postgres queue and distributed workers to Bellingcat auto-archiver. Archives 60k+ URLs from VMs for war-crimes mobile-phone evidence preservation.

summary: 3D memory exploration game with SHA-256 sealed object provenance ledger
readme_summary: Arcadia is a 3D room exploration game where found objects are segmented, transcribed and sealed into an append-only hash chain. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Voice for transcription with Node server and web client.

summary: Benchmark showing trained open model beats frontier model on SEC filing tasks
readme_summary: Benchmarks open vs frontier models on 8-K sorting and Form D extraction from public SEC filings. Fine-tunes Muse Glimmer 30B on Fireworks on few hundred examples. Reports accuracy and cost with significance tests.

summary: Glasses plus wristband that alert deaf users only to what matters to them
readme_summary: ESP32-S3 glasses stream LC3 audio over BLE to iPhone app for live captions. Backend uses Muse Voice Transcribe for STT and Muse Spark Open for relevance filtering and summaries. HUD plus haptic rhythms signal name, orders and warnings.

summary: Local-first memory and web UI that gives Muse Code persistent project context.
readme_summary: Local web frontend that streams Muse Code verbatim with persistent global and project memory. Stores identity, decisions and .continuum.md context with corrections and isolation via Python server.

summary: Adaptive AI courtroom where agents dispute claims with testable evidence
readme_summary: Multi-agent courtroom with propose-approve-execute loop, evidence store and testable disputes leading to verified verdict. Node engine plus CLI packages. Uses frontier models via policy-gated court workflow.

summary: Camera scan of food labels to compare protein per dollar
readme_summary: Mobile-first web app scans, uploads, or manually enters packaged food and price to calculate protein efficiency. Requires explicit opt-in before sending images, with user review and correction flow. Uses Meta vision model for item, price, and nutrition extraction.

summary: AI interviewer that turns personal memories into stories, films and connections.
readme_summary: Guides users to record memories, asks thoughtful follow-ups, and shapes them into shareable stories. Lets users keep items private or find others with similar experiences. Node/server plus Supabase stack with Meta AI interviewer.

summary: Compares baseline vs hardened LLM agents on prompt-injection security benchmarks
readme_summary: Evaluates baseline and hardened agents on 52 cases covering injection, unsafe tools and normal tasks. Python framework logs structured events and emits JSON/Markdown reports on success, blocking and latency. Supports offline mocks and live NVIDIA NIM inference.

summary: Turns dashcam and bike footage into verified geo-tagged municipal hazard work orders
readme_summary: Segments frames with SAM 3.1, filters for persistent detections, tags with camera GPS via exiftool/ffmpeg OCR, then uses Muse Spark to classify and build Open311 payloads. Next.js with ffmpeg chunked pipeline.

summary: Turns one photo into a playable 2.5D layered scene for a skateboarding game.
readme_summary: Agentic pipeline extracts depth-ordered layers, distances and occlusion from a single image. Meta models reason over geometry with image-grounded checks. Unity client plus Python CV services.

summary: Gatekeeper that checks every AI agent action before it can run
readme_summary: Agent Guardian sits between agent and system with no keys given to agent. Intercepts tool calls and validates against hard rules and owner policy using guardian LLM and orchestrator.

summary: Verifies Muse file outputs against requirements with receipts and guarded delivery
readme_summary: Stardive freezes request and checklist, lets Muse create private draft, then runs read-only MCP checks before server receipt and guarded delivery. Blocks release if checks fail. Integrates with Muse via connectors and shows verification card with receipts.

summary: Produce inspection workspace linking tomato photos and sensor data
readme_summary: Registers batches, SAM 3.1 localizes tomatoes and Muse Spark describes concerns with receipts. Keeps persistent history with human confirm/correct review. Adds AWS sensor pipeline for temperature, humidity and VOC/NOx trends.

summary: AI partner that understands your codebase, explains architecture and docs
readme_summary: Neura is an AI software engineering agent powered by Meta Muse Spark 1.3. FastAPI backend with SQLAlchemy and JWT plus frontend analyzes projects and generates docs. Uses Clean Architecture.

summary: One phone photo becomes a ready-to-sell online product listing
readme_summary: Segments product with SAM 3.1, generates studio photos with Muse Image, writes titles and pricing with Muse Spark. Next.js 16 + TypeScript + Tailwind, Prisma Postgres on Neon. All Meta Model API calls run server-side via OpenAI SDK.

summary: Detects building and vegetation change between two site images with evidence report
readme_summary: Validates image pairs, segments with Meta SAM 3.1, self-checks masks with Muse Spark vision, computes pixel change in code and writes PDF with inspection task. Backend plus frontend with Supabase. Uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark vision.

summary: Deterministic safety gate that blocks or holds risky agent sends.
readme_summary: ProofPowers gates irreversible agent actions with 8 fixed rules returning PASS/BLOCK/HELD. Muse models only draft and review; rules decide on exact payload. Includes replayable cases and live receipts via npm scripts.

summary: Automated studio generating vertical short videos and publishing to social platforms
readme_summary: Takes a topic to storyboard, then parallel image/video and voice generation, then FFmpeg assembly with subtitles, music, and logo to MP4. Python backend with web dashboard for creation, progress, history, scheduling, and logs. Uses Muse Spark, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Imagen, Veo for text, voice, visuals.

summary: WhatsApp AI team handling books, pricing, flyers and paperwork with approval
readme_summary: Small sellers chat on WhatsApp while agents draft accounting, pricing, marketing and documents, waiting for approval. Built with Next.js, Supabase, Twilio Sandbox. Uses Meta Muse models for multi-agent team orchestration and WhatsApp replies.

summary: Multi-agent system automates group buying for apartment communities.
readme_summary: Autonomous procurement platform for housing societies with multi-agent demand aggregation and ordering. Built with Next.js 14.2, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM; model reasons while deterministic code governs actions.

summary: Verifies AI vulnerability claims against source code with evidence verdicts
readme_summary: Breaks security reports into atomic claims and checks each against versioned source code. Uses Python pipeline with static code checks plus optional sandboxed reproduction tests. Leverages Meta AI models to parse claims and produce evidenced verdicts without applying fixes.

summary: Robot arm that finds and picks microbial colonies on its own
readme_summary: Autonomous colony picker where overhead camera guides a needle arm through pick, sample, disinfect and rinse steps. Browser UI shows live steps with offline demo mode. Uses SAM 3.1 for colony detection and Muse Spark as critic via Meta models only.

summary: Self-hosted film studio on your GPU built on top of ComfyUI
readme_summary: NovaField is a local-or-cloud film generation studio running on ComfyUI. Provides multilingual UI, Node.js 22 stack, and agent integrations. Licensed AGPL-3.0 with docs and e2e tests.

summary: Turns room photos into priced selling plans before student move-out dates
readme_summary: Move-Out Agent identifies sellable items from room photos and outputs structured listings with deadline-aware pricing. Built during hackathon separate from Feicai codebase. Demo at move-out-agent.vercel.app uses Muse models.

summary: Per-tenant memory and LoRA hatching loop that keeps fine-tunes only if tests pass
readme_summary: Provides persistent per-tenant memory, headless worker orchestrator and fine-tuning loop on tenant work. Base model Muse Glimmer 30B in bf16 with pre-registered paired bench for promote or rollback. Includes security checks, pytest suite and demo video.

summary: Rust single-binary harness for orchestrating complex autonomous coding workflows.
readme_summary: Rust-based harness for structuring autonomous multi-agent coding workflows as a single executable. Includes web PWA frontend and test suite. Orchestrates 23 coding agents and APIs with cultivated scaffolding.

summary: Previews salon cuts and car wraps on your photo, then books the service.
readme_summary: AI transformation previews for salons and auto shops. Upload selfie or car photo, view style or wrap on own image with before/after slider, then book. Built with Meta Model API using SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Spark with Next.js and Docker.

summary: Converts reports and photos into animated time-series maps
readme_summary: AIGIS ingests PDFs, Word, CSV, XLSX and photos with EXIF; Muse Spark extracts structured events with place, time and quotes, geocodes and detects anomalies. Next.js frontend at aigis.studio with time-scrubbable globe and chat.

summary: Voice-driven browser agent that saves repeat jobs as reusable one-step flows.
readme_summary: VoiceFlow is an Edge/Chrome extension turning repeatable browser jobs into shareable flows via a Cloudflare Worker library. Built with JS extension plus MCP server. Uses voice input and exposes flows as MCP tools for Claude Code and other agents.

summary: Two-person agreement workspace to negotiate terms, check understanding and verify delivery
readme_summary: FastAPI backend with web UI where two users create, accept, counter and amend agreements. A checklist verifies delivery against terms. Meta Muse Spark interprets conversation changes and checks mutual understanding of terms.

summary: Voice-narrated CLI agent that detects, patches and verifies UI overlap bugs
readme_summary: Records simulator video with narration transcribed by Muse Voice, extracts concepts with Muse Spark 1.3. Segments with SAM 3.1 to measure overlap, patches in a git worktree and re-verifies 0% overlap.

summary: Turns a one-line premise into a 30-second trailer starring you via webcam.
readme_summary: Live AI film director that writes a 4-shot script, generates sets, directs webcam takes, and composites the user into scenes. FastAPI/uvicorn backend with Node frontend and ffmpeg assembly. Uses Meta Model API with offline mock mode fallback.

summary: Network of personal AI twins that chat with each other to coordinate tasks.
readme_summary: Each twin holds profile, skills and per-field sharing rules and coordinates with other twins. Built in Python with approval-gated memory and owner-controlled activation. Opportunity matching is the first demo use case.

summary: Enterprise workspace where policy engine authorizes agent tool calls before execution.
readme_summary: OpenDesk is an agentic workspace where Muse Spark proposes plans but server-owned policy engine verdicts allow/deny/require_approval. Restricted writes need human approval with redacted audit trace. Next.js frontend with deterministic authorization backend on synthetic CRM data.

summary: Verified multi-agent runtime with 100 agents across 13 executable worlds.
readme_summary: LEGION-100 focuses on causal obligations, verifiable authority, state changes and receipts with independent Judge and VCC. Documents GAIA2 and OpenTelemetry-derived worlds. Source-available research snapshot with compliance docs.

summary: Turns text or links into sourced verification dossiers without absolute verdicts
readme_summary: TRAUNES/VERA agent extracts claims from text or URLs and returns reviewed sources and limits. Stack is FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker with Expo TypeScript frontend. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta API for claim analysis and verification reasoning.

summary: Analyzes multi-source logs, diagnoses issues and guides guided remediation.
readme_summary: AI assistant for log analysis and fix proposals across file, journald, docker, kafka, loki and k8s. Python 3.12 + NiceGUI desktop, web and REST API with OQL filters. Variant B uses Meta Model API for diagnosis and repair steps.

summary: Recovers editable CAD programs with parts and steps from one car photo.
readme_summary: Planner writes CAD operations from image while language world model predicts next solid state and failures. Kernel executes program for verification with overlay comparison. Python project with scripts, figures and results folders.

summary: Agentic operations workspace for event planning with approvals.
readme_summary: OpsPilot creates project workspaces, generates structured plans, and executes tasks via approval state machine and budget validator. Stack is Next.js with server API route. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for JSON plans.

summary: AI salesperson that turns social comments and DMs into tracked sales.
readme_summary: Salesie connects Meta accounts to an AI-native CRM linking comments and DMs to posts and products. A Muse Spark sales agent follows up, answers from catalog and sends payment links. Demoed live on Bloom and Thread Facebook Page.

summary: Local sales workspace that automates routine orders and escalates exceptions
readme_summary: OrderGuard is a Dockerized customer chat plus seller workspace demo with conversational setup and Scenario Lab. Meta Muse interprets language and selects validation and order actions from configured versions.

summary: Gamified plant-pet app with HP, streaks and real plant-care models
readme_summary: PeteyPlant turns houseplants into expressive cartoon pets with HP, XP, streaks and a ReAct explainer. Backend computes VPD, soil moisture decay and light forecasting; provider layer is configurable but no live Muse call in this build.

summary: Voice-driven agent that controls your real Android phone via ADB taps
readme_summary: Computer-use agent driving a real Android phone instead of a sandbox, with push-to-talk and locate commands. Muse Voice Transcribe hears, Muse Spark/Wonder plans, SAM 3.1 grounds UI elements to ADB taps.

summary: Audits factory video against work instructions with evidence links
readme_summary: Compares manufacturing procedures to process video, producing typed discrepancies for human review. FastAPI + SQLite with versioned schema and append-only ledger. Models perceive, deterministic code decides verdicts including UNVERIFIABLE.

summary: Verifies investment claims against Korean DART filings with deterministic math
readme_summary: Agent checks pasted claims or screenshots against OpenDART annual reports. Muse vision reads claims, MusePlanner parses via Meta Model API, numbers recomputed in Python Decimal. Streamlit UI plus CLI with 11 tests.

summary: Arabic-native sales brain unifying WhatsApp and social chats with verified answers.
readme_summary: Centralizes Arabic customer messages from all channels into one memory and judgment layer. Uses draft plus deterministic verification on Meta Muse Spark to prevent invented prices. Includes offline demo and architecture docs.

summary: Conversational shopping agent for local Egyptian fashion brands
readme_summary: Agentic commerce assistant for Egyptian brands that searches by meaning, inspects photos, remembers taste and guides to order with confirmation. Supports outfit photo matching and color search. Uses Meta models with demo catalog and Muse Image photos.

summary: Offline-first crop doctor that diagnoses leaf disease in English or Hindi.
readme_summary: FieldKit estimates crop damage on-device, guides photo capture, and gives treatment steps with audio. When signal returns, it sends ~40KB photo to SAM 3.1 for lesion segmentation and Muse Spark for confirmation. Stack is Node server, shared logic, and web client with offline storage.

summary: Turns photos, topics, and text into Kurdish flashcards in seconds.
readme_summary: Cardo by Kurdolingo generates Kurdish vocabulary cards from learner photos or text. It uses Muse Wonder for card text, SAM 3.1 to cut objects from photos, and Muse Image for abstract words. Built as Next.js + Supabase app deployed on Vercel during Nov 3-4 hackathon.

summary: Freelancer operating system with client portal and marketplace
readme_summary: SynapseX platform for freelancers with collaboration portal and marketplace. Stack is React 18 + Vite frontend and Render backend API, deployed on Vercel with production release status.

summary: Generates job-specific training scenarios with timed decisions and grading
readme_summary: Takes plain job description and builds framework-grounded scenarios with documents, clock, and action classifier. Deterministic code enforces rolls and grading while model narrates. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for scenario and feedback and muse-image-1.0 for scenes.

summary: Low-cost farm robot that spots weeds and sprays only weeds with wiper arm
readme_summary: Small Pi car looks down at crop rows, segments plants with SAM 3.1 and classifies weeds with Muse Spark to aim spray. Teaches new crops from ~10 photos then distills to offline YOLO11n. Stack is Python 3.11 + Flask on Raspberry Pi 4.

summary: Trilingual wedding-hall finder with AI recommendations and 360 tours
readme_summary: Responsive web app for Algerian wedding venues in FR/AR/EN with zero required dependencies. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 grounded in catalogue records for recommendations, plus 360 tours and owner dashboard.

summary: Math solver that verifies answers by two independent code executions
readme_summary: Requires two independent methods as real code with matching results, unit and sanity checks for integrals, roots and physics work. Includes scalar comparator, independence guard, local execution backend and Meta Model API client. Indie Push the Frontier entry.

summary: Virtual try-on that shows any store outfit on your own photo
readme_summary: Next.js web and iOS app where users upload one photo and paste product links to render full outfits. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for page parsing and Muse Image for try-on generation in ~20 seconds.

summary: Desktop ghost that translates English to Spanish and reads aloud
readme_summary: Desktop companion where users drop English text, PDF or photo to get Spanish translation, TTS audio, and tutor explanations. Python desktop app with floating mascot and local-first translation. Uses TTS/STT with planned Meta model tutoring loop.

summary: Turns trusted how-to videos into private offline step-by-step job lessons
readme_summary: USTAAD converts a filmed household or vehicle job into step-by-step procedures and compares learner attempts side-by-side. It runs offline on one GPU with quantized Muse Glimmer 30B via llama.cpp and SAM 3.1 for text-prompted video segmentation and privacy masking.

summary: Nepali-first checker that verifies forwarded messages with evidence receipts
readme_summary: Extracts claims from screenshots/text, searches Nepalese official sources, and returns Evidence Receipt in Nepali/English. Next.js app with web_search grounding. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API.

summary: Benchmarks bimanual robots on 10 data-center maintenance tasks
readme_summary: Ten fixed-setup board tasks with rubrics, 3 trials per model scoring 0/0.5/1, built on Inspect Robots and listed in WorldEvals. Includes install, mock policy runs, and published scoring pipeline.

summary: Local controller for budgeted coding search with offline evaluation
readme_summary: BranchPilot is a TypeScript CLI controller owning snapshots, external evaluation, accounting and checkpoints. The MVP runs offline with a fixture backend, no live coding model calls. Includes untested Muse adapter pinned to @muse-code/sdk 1.4.14.

summary: Android keyboard AI tools plus library for all your AI prompts
readme_summary: Unicorn is an Android companion with system-wide writing tools above the keyboard for grammar, tone, translate and Ask Unicorn. Includes Curiosity rings, Insights, Library and privacy controls. All writing tools run on muse-wonder-1.0 via Meta Model API.

summary: Plant photo investigator with evidence overlays and measurements
readme_summary: Nature Explorer turns plant photos into Discover to Test investigations. Pipeline is Muse Spark observation, SAM 3.1 segmentation, evidence overlay and deterministic measurement. Built as Next.js app with landing page, no speculation as diagnosis.

summary: Matches surplus items to community needs and coordinates pickups
readme_summary: Map-based surplus listings with Leaflet/OpenStreetMap and validated donor flows. Backend assistant matches needs by distance and constraints. Uses live Meta inference with labeled Demo Mode fallback.

summary: Evidence-gated ad approval that holds promos when source facts change
readme_summary: Proof to Publish is a local prototype for evidence-dependent creative approval. A source price change holds the promo ad while Muse Spark proposes a targeted repair requiring separate review. Uses Meta Muse Spark and Muse Image, no Meta Ads connection.

summary: Multifaith voice companion for end-of-life care in four languages
readme_summary: Voice-enabled spiritual companion covering nine traditions in English, Mandarin, Cantonese and Hokkien. Pipeline uses Muse Glimmer, Spark Open, Wonder and Voice Transcribe plus SeamlessM4T v2 with PII and crisis gates.

summary: Reusable agent skills pack for building on Meta AI developer stack
readme_summary: Public pack of modular SKILL.md instructions for Meta Model API, Muse models, open weights, Muse Code and Ray-Ban Meta wearables. Grounds coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Muse Code with workflows and constraints.

summary: Plays web games from screenshots and verifies bug reports by replay
readme_summary: Automated playtesting agent that plays web games via screenshot-to-action function tools. Records expectations, replays reports twice on fresh copies, and judges with evidence-quoting model. Outputs HTML report page with filmstrips, verdicts, and cost.

summary: Parses complex PDFs like 10-Ks and papers into structured multimodal answers
readme_summary: Parses financial filings, research papers, and clinical reports beyond flat OCR. Vite + React + Tailwind frontend with Modal/Fireworks/Baseten inference. Uses SAM 3.1 for layout vision, Muse Spark for reasoning, and Muse Wonder.

summary: Privacy gateway that keeps PII on-device and sends only hard queries to the cloud.
readme_summary: LLM routing gateway plus Android SDK running on Mac. Uses regex plus local Muse Glimmer NER via llama.cpp for PII detection, Muse Spark for hard queries with placeholder masking and streaming restore.

summary: Isolates invoice AI extraction from deterministic policy checks and owner approval
readme_summary: Airlock extracts facts from invoices, delivery evidence and voice notes with untrusted multimodal AI, then evaluates R1-R10 policy against vendor/bank/PO records. Only authenticated owner can approve mock payment with audit trail. Includes prompt-injection safeguards and adversarial evals.

summary: Face-to-face two-language conversation with live translation on phone and glasses
readme_summary: iPhone app for two-person spoken dialogue with transcripts, translations and reply coaching. Supports Meta Ray-Ban Display and Even G2 glasses plus offline demo mode. Uses Meta AI for speech translation and language generation.

summary: Single-pass vision decision model outputting calibrated probabilities for inspection.
readme_summary: Takes image plus typed noul/choice/score questions and returns calibrated probability per question in one forward pass. Built on Muse Glimmer 30B to cut latency vs text reasoning. Open heads on Hugging Face with Modal live demo.

summary: V2V/V2X fog-driving simulator with Muse advisory and ESP32 tools
readme_summary: Deterministic Python simulation for mine-vehicle safety in fog with channel, kinematics and risk models. Adds reproducible experiments, Meta Muse advisory layer, and ESP32 diagnostics. From Smart India Hackathon SIH26007.

summary: Rover companion with persistent memory and bounded physical actions
readme_summary: Connects RaspRover PT Pi5 to Meta reasoning, visual observation and object memory for 3-min discovery missions. Dashboard shows observations, requests and telemetry. Snapshot install, not turnkey navigation.

summary: Photograph diagrams or machines to get interactive 3D explanations in the browser.
readme_summary: React + Three.js frontend with Python FastAPI scene planner using Muse Spark 1.3. Three modes overlay stylized tiger, explain textbook heart diagrams, and explore 3D motor parts from photos. Procedural placeholders, screen-aligned video, optional USDZ Quick Look.

summary: Multi-robot survival sim where models vote and engine verifies actions
readme_summary: NULL SOCIETY Genesis Trial simulates 6 robots with 32 charge voting, sharing and building power over 7 days; model proposes, engine validates. Supports mock mode and live spark mode via MODEL_API_KEY. Uses Muse Image for portraits and SAM 3.1 for cutouts, with Python sim and web replay.

summary: Browser workspace for exploring 3D building concepts and chatting on docs.
readme_summary: Early React+Vite prototype with Three.js navigable building model and document chat. Extracts PDF/DOCX/text and images in browser. Server-side Meta Model API proxy with META_API_KEY, Vercel deploy.

summary: Checking layer that validates AI 2D animation consistency and guides repairs
readme_summary: Framebound is the checking and evidence layer for an external animation agent. It measures shape, motion and appearance against bounds via MCP tools and returns repair instructions. Built with Python, MCP server, schemas and export pipelines using Muse models.

summary: Browser papercraft adventure wandering District 1 Saigon helping neighbors
readme_summary: Playable web game set in a papercraft District 1 Saigon with English and Vietnamese support. Player explores, meets characters, runs errands and collects city pieces. Static browser game for desktop and mobile with no install.

summary: From-scratch x86 kernel where AI proposes actions and kernel enforces them
readme_summary: Custom x86 kernel in C with ring-3 agentsh shell taking plain-English requests. Host bridge passes fixed 16-byte checksummed actions, kernel allows, denies or asks user. Uses Muse Spark off-device to propose steps, never parsing model text in kernel.

summary: Investigates street issues from photos, permits and sensors with evidence map
readme_summary: Runs full investigation for 9 street-problem types, streaming steps in web UI with every claim linked to map and timeline evidence. Python backend combines city records, permits and flood sensors with checker validation. Uses Muse Spark explanations and SAM 3.1 re-checks.

summary: Infrastructure console predicting failure spread across power and water
readme_summary: Operations console detecting threats and coordinating interventions across power, water and comms. Node 22 + runtime/scripts stack; uses Meta Muse as reasoning brain for prediction and coordination.

summary: Governance floor that only allows admissible agent tool calls with receipts
readme_summary: HOLD separates intelligence, authority and evidence for autonomous agents. Every tool call passes an admissibility floor with uncertainty recovery. Integrates Meta Llama 3.2 3B with frozen protocol and replayable evidence journal.

summary: Lab session tracker with video action hints and timestamped notes
readme_summary: LabSpotter is a web app for logging lab sessions with guides, editable notes and exportable sessions. It uses Meta V-JEPA 2 for short-video action suggestions with optional speech transcription and recaps.

summary: Desktop focus island for task plans and distraction reminders
readme_summary: Fudge is a Windows always-on-top island for setting tasks and running opt-in focus sessions. It structures plans and surfaces gentle reminders on detected distraction.

summary: Local-first Rust agent harness with self-improving memory and hybrid RAG
readme_summary: Lumina is a local-first coding and open-world agent harness with daemon, CLI, TUI and embedded React SPA. Built in Rust with hybrid local RAG and plugin memory. Supports BYO-LLM via OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama and Copilot protocols.

summary: Builds bedtime briefings and stories only from parent-confirmed facts
readme_summary: PWA bedtime handoff where parent memo plus optional photo/voice yields briefing, recall question and reading page. Only parent-selected details used; child answers saved as testimony, never fact. Vanilla JS, zero runtime deps, Playwright tested.

summary: 3D puzzle game where gravity follows foldable space regions you carry and place
readme_summary: Single-room Godot 4.7 puzzle built around FoldScope.applied_gravity. Player picks up inert folds and places them live to redirect falling. Uses online AI for airlock narration with local log fallback.

summary: Maps potholes and cracks from dashcam video into ranked repair work orders
readme_summary: MEND segments road defects with SAM 3.1, measures area via camera projection and ranks by risk. Frontend plus Python engine with OpenStreetMap context. Uses Muse Spark for planning and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Fine-tuned technical-writing model that turns engineering context into clear design docs.
readme_summary: Technical-writing specialist built on Muse Glimmer 30B to produce complete documents with mechanisms and tradeoffs. Cleaned 1,916 human technical documents and fine-tuned with LoRA SFT plus data and benchmark pipelines. Includes chatbot, classifier, doc pipeline and model benchmark tooling.

summary: Builds reviewed Reels and ad kits for local shops from one link
readme_summary: Tickr researches a business from one link, analyzes photos and renders Reels and channel kits for approval. Tickr code with inference on api.meta.ai. Uses Muse Spark for image study and SAM 3.1 for product cutouts.

summary: AI repair assistant that diagnoses broken devices and guides step-by-step fixes
readme_summary: RepairLens helps users repair small appliances to reduce e-waste via photo, audio and guided instructions. Stack is FastAPI backend with React frontend and inspection history. Uses Meta Muse models for vision diagnosis and voice-guided repair.

summary: Turns phone photos of broken furniture into verified 3D-printable repair parts.
readme_summary: Guided photo capture with Muse Spark checks, SAM 3.1 segmentation of damage, and Muse Spark diagnosis for measurements. Muse Spark Open on Baseten generates CadQuery code for 3D printing. Frontend plus backend with samples and scripts.

summary: Verifies indoor routes by matching live photos to learned landmarks
readme_summary: Turns operator-recorded observations into an evidence-linked topological graph with deterministic verifier. Zero-dependency Python server.py + static frontend. Uses muse-spark-open via Fireworks to read signage and compare new observations to references.

summary: Daily outfits from your closet photos, weather and plans
readme_summary: Photos your closet to suggest daily outfits for weather, mood and plans with dress-step camera checks. Next.js app with segment, outfits, transcribe APIs. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, muse-spark-1.3 for tagging and outfits, muse-voice-transcribe-1.0.

summary: Learning-support agent that tests interventions and checks if they worked
readme_summary: Investigates why a learner struggles, tries a support strategy and measures outcome. Non-medical educational tool with PRD, architecture and child-safeguarding specs driving agent design.

summary: Early teaching-record experiments moved to teacherdox-core
readme_summary: Withdrawn early experiments for TeacherDox, not the final submission. Points to teacherdox-core for open .tdx 2.0 record engine. Intended stack was SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark and Spark Open for board detection.

summary: Robot data platform for labeling multi-camera episodes and actions
readme_summary: LabelVLA manages LeRobot v2/v3 datasets with multi-camera playback, action segmentation and review workflows. Dockerized frontend/backend integrates SAM service for assisted mask tracking.

summary: Lecturer-approved rubric tool that drafts marks with quoted student evidence.
readme_summary: Lecturers create assignments, students submit typed or PDF scripts transcribed with [illegible] marks. Model drafts rubric for approval then marks only against it. Stack spans web frontend plus worker and evals.

summary: Vietnamese IDC on-call agents for SOP lookup, shift reports and alert triage
readme_summary: Team of specialized agents for cited SOP QA, shift handover synthesis and warning duty over a swappable LLM Gateway. Knowledge in Markdown wiki vault with FTS5 RAG and PII redaction, interaction via Telegram owner bot. Human approval required for external actions.

summary: Decentralized small-model voters clean training data via consensus
readme_summary: Decentralized coordinator, crawler and node network where Llama 3.1/3.2 voters and Muse Glimmer judge label data. Includes agentic search and live dashboard. Uses Llama 3.3 70B agent and Muse fine-tune validation.

summary: Mobile camera guide that overlays troubleshooting targets on product photos
readme_summary: Mobile browser PoC where users input model code and issue, then get overlay targets on camera images. Uses hybrid registered/unregistered product flow with evidence validation. Backend on Azure Container Apps with authenticated adapters.

summary: Nine-check audit that verifies AI research claims with receipts
readme_summary: Post-research audit extracts every checkable claim from drafts and runs nine verification checks to return Verified/Corrected/Held verdicts. Python processor program with staged pipeline and tests. Positions as top-layer truth constraint, not detector or guardrail.

summary: AI copilot explains delivery delays and prioritizes actions for Indian distributors
readme_summary: Decision-support app for Indian distributors and MSMEs to track delays, shortages and costs. Built with React dashboard plus Python FastAPI backend integrated with Meta Model API. Uses Meta AI assistant to interpret logistics data and suggest next steps.

summary: Phone assistant that describes surroundings aloud and guides blind users camera.
readme_summary: Expo Android app with on-device detector and session memory for tap-to-ask, read text and recap. Muse Spark 1.3 handles seeing and answering; speech recognition and TTS run on phone. Offline commands without token use.

summary: Bangla-English style coach with 30-day plan, wardrobe and 3D looks
readme_summary: AinA offers skin, hair, fitness, food and fashion plans tuned for Bangladesh climate with bilingual chat. Next.js plus Three.js 3D lookbook, wardrobe cutouts, and local shop. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for roadmaps and muse-image for vision guidance.

summary: Simulated robot workcell bench to inspect, challenge, and replay repair plans.
readme_summary: BREAKSHIFT is a simulated robotic repair workbench for inspecting components and replaying recorded Meta-model proposals. Users change conditions to challenge plans and export replayable evidence. Hosted on Cloudflare Workers; passing sim does not authorize real repair.

summary: Mobile construction walkthroughs turn site photos into verified punch-list reports
readme_summary: Mobile-first construction QA demo for capturing walkthroughs, photos, and observations. Optional Muse Spark photo analysis via POST /api/analyze, local verification, and offline HTML/PDF reports.

summary: Private coincidence journal that matches shared anomalies only on mutual consent
readme_summary: Privacy-first platform to document unexplainable coincidences with deterministic trigram matching. Next.js + PostgreSQL on AWS Amplify. Uses open-weights Muse Spark Open muse-spark-open-1026 to discover matches without exposing content.

summary: Offline demo for searching event video moments and building cited storylines
readme_summary: Brisky event component with Node.js demo on port 3100 requiring no login or keys. Scripted offline walkthrough for moment search, source selection and brief creation. Uses mock data with synthetic citations.

summary: Operator desk giving Muse models shell and browser control of NVIDIA Jetson fleet
readme_summary: Embodied AI control plane for Jetson boards with operator desk, fleet jobs and relay. Apps monorepo with Cloudflare relay and Vercel frontend. Uses Muse Spark and Wonder for shell, files and browser ops.

summary: CLI gate that detects MCP tool poisoning and rug pulls before use
readme_summary: mcp-trust-check baselines MCP server tools and diffs changes with LLM review to approve or block trust in CI. Node TypeScript CLI with tests and eval-results. Uses Muse Spark via Baseten for new or changed tool review.

summary: Turns messy kitchen food photos into catalog photos with cost and caption
readme_summary: Uploads dish photo, SAM 3.1 segments plated food with parallel prompts, generates clean catalog image plus ingredient cost estimate and sales caption. End-to-end flow for small sellers with human review before save.

summary: Consented interview assistant that speaks only verified experience.
readme_summary: Planned flow: approved sources, speech transcription, retrieval, grounded draft, verification, candidate review, synthetic voice. Repo is bootstrap with AGENTS.md only, no implementation. Meta AI integration not yet implemented.

summary: Dual-auditor AST code review with on-chain attestation for AI-generated smart contracts
readme_summary: Trust and attestation layer for AI agents on Monad Testnet and Base Sepolia that performs autonomous AST static analysis and dual-auditor review. Issues cryptographic on-chain attestation for protocol trust. Backend API with Swagger, contracts, frontend and agent workbench.

summary: Bilingual AI voice agent that makes compliant collections calls for car dealers
readme_summary: Cloudflare Workers app using Twilio ConversationRelay for bilingual collections calls with identity verification. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder 1.0 and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 via Meta Model API. Adds KV, Durable Objects and Stripe test mode.

summary: Coaches networking lab students from terminal output without giving answers
readme_summary: Side panel beside hosted router lab reads terminal tail and lab check results. Gateway FastAPI app polls lab broker and streams coaching via Muse Spark with graded hint ladder. Never prints the fix, only nudges and concepts.

summary: Four-agent pipeline that audits Solidity and signs tamper-evident reports
readme_summary: Paste Solidity and Scout, Hunter, Forge and Arbiter map surface, reason exploits, generate PoCs and synthesize signed report in 90s. Every handoff is HMAC-SHA256 signed via Loom-Protocol. Uses Llama via Groq.

summary: Explains research papers at your level with adaptive depth and quizzes.
readme_summary: CLI agentic system that ingests a paper, extracts concepts, compares required knowledge to user profile, and writes adaptive HTML explanation. Planner builds learning path with adaptive quiz. Uses Meta models for analysis.

summary: AI persona panel debates forecasting questions into calibrated probability report
readme_summary: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript app where AI personas debate forecasting questions live. Returns pros/cons and calibrated estimate. Supports 6 model providers, packaged as web and Electron desktop with v1.1.0 release.

summary: F1 strategy engine that predicts rival stops and recommends pit timing to engineers
readme_summary: Tracks one car vs rival from public timing, forecasts stop laps, Monte Carlo simulates options to flag for stable call and radio phrasing. Python package with fixtures and docs. Uses Muse Spark grounded only on Pitwall numbers for Q&A.

summary: Tests vision AI on degraded labels to catch confident misreads for blind users.
readme_summary: Crash-test lab that renders labels with known text, degrades them, and measures vision model failures. Tracks legibility boundary and confidently-wrong answers. Built on Meta Model API to evaluate safe assistive reading.

summary: Audits Google Play listings and generates localized copy, posters, and bundles.
readme_summary: End-to-end ASO agent that audits Play listings, scores health, and builds localized copy and graphics. Uses google-play-scraper and recharts with SAM 3.1 visual analysis. Uses Muse Spark for copy and Muse Image for backgrounds.

summary: Python repair agent that proves fixes with frozen tests and evidence
readme_summary: Generates regression test before patching, freezes with SHA-256, reproduces failure and validates via subprocess pytest. Blocks test editing as fix. Uses deterministic mock models with real test runs for offline demo.

summary: Generates in-ear spoken cues to keep lecturers on track and on time.
readme_summary: Turns speaker notes into a timed cue plan with opening, wrap-up, and time warnings. Model restructures notes and estimates duration at ~130 wpm; runner plays cues via earpiece. Uses Meta Model API with local stand-in, web app frontend.

summary: Pre-trip briefing app where a pixel goose explains weather, budget, food and news
readme_summary: Pre-trip briefing app where users enter a destination and get one calm brief covering weather, UV, budget, sights, food and news. Frontend in src with Node server in server. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for live city briefs.

summary: Reproducible port of Muse Glimmer 30B on dual Intel Arc Pro B70 GPUs
readme_summary: Cookbook porting Muse Glimmer 30B BF16 with draft model to 2x Intel Arc Pro B70 using Intel llm-scaler vLLM image. Uses FP8 quantization, tensor parallelism and dflash speculative decoding. Includes BetterBench reports and scripts.

summary: Persona-driven AI shoppers test live beauty stores and measure behavior fidelity
readme_summary: Sends researched locked personas to shop Sephora and Olive Young US live. Built with TypeScript server/web stack during hackathon. Uses Muse Spark computer use for browsing and evaluating persona-faithful shopping.

summary: Voice dating app scores shared tastes and suggests date ideas via Qloo.
readme_summary: Voice-first companion builds taste profiles from conversation across ten domains. Uses Qloo Taste/Insights API for shared-taste score, common descriptors and joint recommendations. Subset extracted for Qloo hackathon.

summary: Teaching agent generating CBC schemes, lesson plans and exams with citations
readme_summary: Teaching agent for Kenya CBC plans term coverage from curriculum packs. It quotes KICD outcomes exactly and files documents for teacher sign-off. Uses Muse Spark and Code with audit trail.

summary: Desktop serial gateway that decodes industrial devices and gates writes.
readme_summary: Tauri 2 + Svelte 5 + Rust app to discover ports, decode proprietary serial frames and stream structured data. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API to propose parsers with Rust commit gate and Safe Mode. No hardware needed for demo.

summary: Answers shop chats across four channels and links orders to ad revenue.
readme_summary: One inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok and email remembers customers, quotes price-list prices, follows up and confirms bank-alert payments. Owner uses morning brief and order board. Muse Spark powers chat, receipt and voice-note understanding.

summary: Language-guided pixel-level video tracking at real-time speed.
readme_summary: VLM_Follower uses WeVisOne-VL-4B on keyframes to ground language queries to boxes and masks, then SAM 2.1 propagates masks at 30+ FPS. Python streaming pipeline supports live cameras with optional SAM 3.1 backend.

summary: Chat-first Kannada marketplace letting home sellers manage shops by voice and photos
readme_summary: Lets women home businesses and farmers in Karnataka create shops and manage orders via chat, voice, photos and video. Stack is Node.js with web storefront and chat interface. Uses Meta Model API for Kannada language understanding and multimodal listing.

summary: Plain-English data analyst that writes read-only SQL with traceable numbers.
readme_summary: Plans work, writes and runs read-only SQL, checks numbers against query results, asks when revenue/top/dates are ambiguous. Rule is no silent choices that change numbers. Muse Spark via Meta API with Python agent and tests.

summary: Piping integrity workbench with corrosion math and visual inspection
readme_summary: Integrity Copilot combines PI samples, UT readings and asset history into an evidence-linked inspection proposal. Deterministic Python computes corrosion rates and life; Muse Glimmer via Ollama writes narratives and SAM 3.1 marks images.

summary: Turns narrated plant walkthrough videos into ranked shift handoff briefs.
readme_summary: Operator films narrated walkthrough; pipeline transcribes, segments issues and fuses context into ranked brief with before/after comparison. Python app with Muse Voice, Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 adapters plus CHP fusion and HDBSCAN threading.

summary: Scout-Fixer-Adjudicator agent trio that fact-gates thousands of live pages
readme_summary: Production publishing fleet of 6 sites run on Meta Muse with Scout, Fixer and Adjudicator separation plus Hopper intake routers. Produces adjudicated fixes and work orders with counted spend. Uses Meta Muse models with verbatim-grounded adjudication.

summary: Transcribes WhatsApp business calls into searchable speaker transcripts
readme_summary: Meeting Pro converts WhatsApp Business calls to speaker-separated transcripts via Meta server-side transcription. Built with Expo SDK 58, React Native and Supabase. Notes phones cannot record WhatsApp calls directly.

summary: Agentic AML investigator that checks transactions without hallucinating
readme_summary: Autonomous Nigeria CBN AML/CFT agent using Plan-Act-Critique-Refine-Synthesize over rules, histories and sanctions lists. Escalates on ambiguous evidence with invariant routing. Python/FastAPI stack. Uses Muse models for planning and synthesis.

summary: Uploads site photos or video to detect workers and queue PPE concerns for human review
readme_summary: SOPProof uploads images or MP4s, runs SAM 3.1 to segment workers and hard hats, then Muse Spark reviews evidence worker by worker. Flags are queued for human decision, never auto-confirmed. Built with Python backend and frontend for review workflow.

summary: Network where agents and glasses wearers delegate tasks with verified on-chain payment.
readme_summary: Routes requests from Meta glasses or MCP agents to personal or hired specialist agents. Web, API, SDKs and verifier service check deliverables before on-chain payment. Uses Muse Spark for vision, web search and sourced answers with shared memory.

summary: Blender add-on for AI textures, agents, splats and cloud render
readme_summary: Blender Python add-on connecting Meta Model API for textures, chat, and splat segmentation plus Modal for cloud render. Builds product sites from Blender. Uses Muse Image generation and SAM 3.1 for Gaussian splat segmentation.

summary: Mobile web app guiding physical artists with composition tools and AI critique.
readme_summary: Photographs paintings, rectifies corners, offers guides, palette studies and voice critique. Uses Meta AI models for critique, art direction and positioned suggestions without altering original. Node mobile-first prototype.

summary: Verifiable AI engineer that investigates synthetic K8s incidents with audit logs
readme_summary: Investigates synthetic Kubernetes incidents, gathers evidence, requests operator approval, and verifies simulated remediation. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 with hash-chained audit log; sandboxed, no real K8s or shell access.

summary: Workout coach that builds plans and compares squat videos to your best rep
readme_summary: Next.js frontend with FastAPI backend for training plans, logging and evidence-grounded coaching. Uses Muse Spark for plans and coaching, SAM 3.1 for athlete outlines, MediaPipe for rep detection. Validates outputs before display.

summary: Local app that scores text as AI or human with sentence-level highlighting.
readme_summary: Paste text or upload PDF/DOCX/TXT for AI-likelihood score, verdict, and per-sentence highlighting plus AI-to-human rewriting. Built with FastAPI backend and React frontend with local ONNX model, running fully offline with no API keys.

summary: Django learning platform with AI tutor, quizzes, voice questions, and study planner.
readme_summary: Django 5 + Bootstrap 5 platform with AI tutor, textbook image reader, voice Q&A, quiz generator, and dashboards. Uses SQLite locally with PostgreSQL/Gunicorn for production and integrates Meta AI models for tutoring and generation.

summary: Muse Spark agent where every action is gated by an OS and kill switch in model weights.
readme_summary: Embeds CPU/NPU/GPU circuits, Secure OS, and kill switch into Muse Glimmer 30B weights with live Agent Guard demo. Every Muse Spark agent action passes ViKernel policy checks via gate service and UI.

summary: Brain MRI viewer with segmentation overlays and grounded chat explanations.
readme_summary: D-SCAN AI uploads PNG/JPG/NIfTI scans, runs ML segmentation, and renders real model masks with PDF reports. Backend pairs React TypeScript frontend with Python ML and Docker. Meta Muse Spark explains findings and powers case-grounded chat with template fallback.

summary: AI personas run missions in your live app to find friction then compare fixes
readme_summary: Sends goal-driven personas through browser missions, records actions and reactions, proposes fixes and reruns. Node.js engine, workspace UI, demo-data. Uses Meta Muse models for persona reasoning.

summary: Autonomous visual inspection agent for industrial defect detection
readme_summary: TypeScript React 19 + Vite app for industrial visual inspection and problem-solving. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning with Firebase Firestore storage. Server via server.ts with inspection workflows.

summary: Phone app guides blind users to operate flat appliance touch panels
readme_summary: iOS + backend app that reads appliance panels from voice and camera, plans button presses and guides the finger. Built during hackathon to replace stick-on bumps and sighted help with guided vision assistance.

summary: Filters overnight coding-agent requests to show only decisions needing a human.
readme_summary: Nightgate standardizes agent reports and judges each ask against six human-decision types with a Meta Muse Glimmer model. Claims like tests passing are re-verified, and the morning web UI keeps only yours. User feedback becomes training data for the local judge on DGX Spark.

summary: Audits AI-text detectors on civic and legal writing for false positives
readme_summary: Benchmarks AI detectors on legislation, filings, public comments and historical texts to expose false human-as-AI flags. Cloudflare Worker + TypeScript stack with data, migrations and docs. Configurable to run live with API keys.

summary: Autonomous grocery restocking app that predicts household needs
readme_summary: RepeatLess AI is a Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind app with MongoDB Atlas for household restocking intelligence. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 per badges. Includes scripts and tests for autonomous grocery workflows.

summary: Deterministic oracle that verifies agent claims on stripped binaries without LLM judging.
readme_summary: Agent proposes hypotheses on x86-64 ELF binaries; verdicts come from pure functions over independent evidence with INCONCLUSIVE fallback. Includes Python verifiers, notebooks, and Streamlit demo. Uses Meta models for reasoning, not verdicts.

summary: AP agent that extracts invoices and audits them in sandbox for approval
readme_summary: Reads text, PDF and photo invoices natively with Muse models to structured fields without OCR. Model-written audit code runs in no-network sandbox to check totals, duplicates and fraud. Human approves queued payments, contained on Vultr.

summary: Recaps your Facebook, Instagram and Threads posts for later listening
readme_summary: PWA in plain PHP 8.1 with SQLite that organizes signed-in user's own posts, reels, stories and threads. Respects Meta API limits, no viewing history access. Dark-mode UI with save-for-listening and installable offline flow.

summary: Turns prison register photos into verified BNSS release lists
readme_summary: Streamlit app where Muse Spark double-reads register pages, checks sections against law table, and deterministic Rihai engine computes 479 BNSS eligibility. Lawyer-in-loop correction and confirmation.

summary: Offline-first agritech app supporting Tamil Nadu smallholder farmers with AI vision.
readme_summary: AI-augmented offline-first farming platform for Tamil Nadu smallholders. FastAPI backend with Flutter mobile pairs on-device edge vision with cloud Meta AI models. Provides crop diagnostics and advisory with offline sync.

summary: Finds objects that vanish or appear in AI videos without cause
readme_summary: Lost & Frame scans AI-generated video frames to find continuity errors where objects vanish or appear. It runs locally in Node.js and sends only still frames to the model with user key. Each event returns frame pairs with a one-sentence reason.

summary: Compares product photos across views to flag weak evidence or inconsistency
readme_summary: Explores evidence-aware multimodal reasoning: compares markings across product photos and asks for more views or holds for human review. Powered by Meta Muse Spark 1.3 with replayable Gate 8.2 interface and policy controller.

summary: Verifies college admission cutoffs across sources to flag rank discrepancies
readme_summary: Admission Data Truth Engine cross-checks JoSAA, CSAB, MCC and third-party sources for institute, program and category mismatches. Python Flask app with SQLite, pytest suite and services layer. Uses Muse Spark Open for evidence extraction and verdicts.

summary: Runs Muse Spark and Wonder in pi agent via Muse Code subscription auth
readme_summary: Pi provider that routes Muse Spark/Wonder requests through local muse serve host instead of direct Model API. Built in TypeScript for pi >=1.0 and Node 20, using Muse Code SDK as authenticated model transport.

summary: Simulated eye-surgery robot lab with synthetic OCT, safety checks and approval.
readme_summary: Closed-loop simulation: synthetic OCT to Muse reasoning to RCM trajectory to safety validation to human approval to 6-DOF robot execution. FastAPI plus WebSocket backend serves built UI and 3D microscope view. Research only, no hardware.

summary: Ad creative studio that tests backgrounds and copy in controlled variants
readme_summary: Creative experiment studio comparing three variants while holding other elements fixed. Includes four modes, placement previews and campaign export. Uses SAM segmentation, Muse Image backgrounds and Muse Spark copy via Meta API.

summary: PR security engine that only reports vulnerabilities proven by sandbox exploit tests
readme_summary: Python security-verification engine for pull requests. Runs baseline, suspect, exploit and fix checks in isolated resource-limited containers. Uses adversary and test-writer workflow to prove findings before reporting, with nothing auto-merging.

summary: NES-style RPG where Greek gods in modern England are won over by talk
readme_summary: Primordial Paradox is an 8-bit GameMaker RPG set in storm-hit Southampton with dialogue plus combat. Hackathon repo adds content built by directing AI agents. Pre-existing engine with 292 commits plus new game logic.

summary: Voice-and-vision warehouse system where spoken scans and photo scans cross-check loads
readme_summary: Browser-based WMS console plus glasses UI for hands-free receiving. Workers talk to Meta AI, every load gets spoken and photo reads cross-checked into OS&D reports. Static HTML/CSS/JS with dynamic ontology learning.

summary: Records legacy desktop apps to generate React replacements with parity evidence.
readme_summary: Captures screen recording with FFmpeg and faster-whisper, builds an AppSpec, then generates a React app. Uses Muse-compatible chat API for observation and repair, verifies with Playwright replay and weighted parity report.

summary: Campus discovery graph and autonomous studio for verified grant synthesis
readme_summary: Collaborative research platform linking campus researchers for interdisciplinary grants with multimodal literature analysis. Next.js frontend, Python services, monorepo packages. Uses Muse Wonder 1.0 for synthesis and SAM 3.1 for pixel-verified outputs.

summary: iPhone VR practice app for situational skills starting with public speaking
readme_summary: Native iOS VR practice with voice intake and pairing to a local backend for scene generation. Backend validates Spark author-editor output into playable experiences. Uses Meta Spark models for authoring, editing, and Wonder building.

summary: Turns emails, screenshots and maps into shareable travel boards and magazines
readme_summary: Travel workspace that consolidates flights, hotels and saved places into trips you shape and share. Web app on Firebase Hosting with local data and magazine composition. Uses Muse AI for reasoning with bring-your-own agent.

summary: Voice modules to talk to a virtual employee on Windows
readme_summary: Provides reusable voice modules with synthetic demo and embeddable Windows host. Real gateway routes voice through Muse Spark for Q&A with speech output. Monorepo with apps, packages, docs and examples.

summary: Cozy 3D meadow adventure with word-spells and star-apple quests

summary: Finds CubeSat multi-fault failures with replayable counterexamples
readme_summary: FaultForge uses Muse Spark to search Basilisk CubeSat simulation for fault combos breaking FDIR safe-mode policy. Minimizes violations to one-command replays with diagnosis and whitelisted repairs. Keyless replay plus live mode.

summary: Marketplace turning sorted home waste into verified donations for compost makers.
readme_summary: Mobile-first Next.js + Firebase app connects households, collection partners and manure makers. Photo-verified waste listings with AI matching for local pickup. Built for circular economy with Firestore and Vercel deploy.

summary: Voice-first STEM tutor that draws with students on shared board
readme_summary: Texa is an AI tutor for Maths, Physics, Chemistry for middle and high school. Students draw and talk on shared board while Texa explains by speaking and sketching back. Ships on Android, iOS, macOS and Web.

summary: Election guide showing upcoming races, deadlines, polling places and reminders.
readme_summary: PollPal is a location-based election information site with timelines, official registration links, polling place maps, and email reminders. Built with Vite frontend, backend API, and Supabase. Uses Meta Muse models for source-backed ballot Q&A.

summary: Private on-device AI workstation for iPad Pro and iPhone running GGUF models
readme_summary: Local-first Swift/SwiftUI workstation that runs open-weight GGUF models fully offline via Metal. Inference via llama.cpp XCFramework with no cloud or telemetry. Supports model catalog, widgets, and TestFlight builds.

summary: Social PWA that matches San Diego people by events and forms small meetup groups
readme_summary: Dyad recommends real San Diego events from onboarding preferences and helps attendees form groups via Find Company matching. It includes auth, catalog, Discovery filters, invites and Supabase Realtime chat. It uses Muse for interest matching and event enrichment.

summary: Fuses selected repos into tested apps via pinned ingest and review
readme_summary: Takes repos through pinned ingest, static analysis, license check and isolated tests to synthesized app. Demo fuses itsdangerous + MarkupSafe. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for synthesis.

summary: AI sales crew that finds leads, sends outreach, answers DMs and books meetings
readme_summary: Multi-tenant Next.js app for small businesses with Inbox, Leads, Engage, Bookings and Website Builder. Connects WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram plus Meta CAPI. Uses Meta AI for prospecting, outreach writing, voice calls and DM automation.

summary: Quest mixed-reality physics lab where trials start when predictions are wrong
readme_summary: Mixed-reality physics on Quest built fully during hackathon. Unity 6 client handles room scan, passthrough and hand tracking while local simulation is source of truth. Instructor configures trials via tool schema in schema/.

summary: Generates software from sealed contracts using isolated LLM workers and deterministic orchestration
