readme_summary: CIDD validates a structured app Genome and expands it into a sealed contract graph. Python engine handles staging, assembly, and validation while isolated LLM workers generate per-contract code. Supports configurable providers including Ollama and Muse models with token and manifest tracking.

summary: Voice-first mock interview coach with live scoring and action plan
readme_summary: Tytho voice interview coach with duplex WebSocket, 3s-silence turn policy and streaming replies. Bun React Express frontend and backend. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for dialogue, Muse Voice Transcribe for STT and Deepgram Flux for TTS.

summary: Pantry photo scanner for West and East African dishes, swaps and shops
readme_summary: Kitchen Concierge that scans pantry photos to rank dishes from African food traditions and suggest swaps, stores and Instacart carts. Vite React TypeScript with Vercel functions. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for vision and tool calling.

summary: Multi-agent workspace for autonomous collaboration and live task execution
readme_summary: Dockerized multi-agent workspace for collaborative task execution with live updates. Repo includes app UI, components, db and docker-compose orchestration. Limited README, positioned as autonomous agent collaboration platform.

summary: Writing coach for vernacular-medium students practicing English academic paragraphs.
readme_summary: Structured write-feedback-revise loop for topic sentences, tone and citation, not essay writing. Python backend with learner store, knowledge base and frontend. Uses Muse models with speech and photo input.

summary: Browser harness auditing Spree releases for semantic regressions
readme_summary: Glue connecting Spree e-commerce store to the Semantic Release Auditor for side-by-side release testing. Spins up isolated stores, drives storefront and admin with browser automation in adapter.py, and lets Muse models judge pages and emails against stored orders.

summary: Windows desktop agent that investigates, fixes, and verifies PC problems
readme_summary: A Windows 11 Electron desktop repair agent powered by Meta Muse Spark. Investigates OS/app issues, researches version-specific fixes, and applies supported operations with verification. Distributed as installer and portable build.

summary: Multi-tenant gateway to register, discover and route AI agents and MCP servers
readme_summary: Multi-tenant gateway and service discovery registry for AI agents, APIs and MCP servers. Single entrypoint handles load balancing, health checks and routing. Go-based gateway with Docker support, built for Meta AI Hackathon.

summary: Diagnoses why prefix cache misses in self-hosted vLLM serving
readme_summary: Probes synthetic agent workload to find what breaks byte-identical prefixes and replays candidate fix. Verified on Muse Glimmer 30B open-weights served with vLLM on single GPU. Python CLI with measurement docs and evidence.

summary: Camera-first crop disease assistant answering farmers in Hindi, Odia or English
readme_summary: Photo pipeline segments disease with SAM 3.1, computes severity as spot share of leaf, then Muse Spark describes symptoms with RAG over official advisories. Backend enforces citations and escalates to KVK on low confidence. Frontend plus backend with Render deploy.

summary: Validates project ideas by finding matching GitHub repos with gap analysis
readme_summary: MissedBuild finds closest public GitHub repos for a plain-language idea and sorts them. Uses Meta Muse Spark to list what each repo does, gaps, and buildable extensions. Every claim ties to README, issues or source evidence.

summary: PPO fine-tunes Muse Glimmer 30B into a LIBERO robot manipulation policy
readme_summary: Fine-tunes Muse Glimmer 30B with PPO LoRA adapters plus value head for LIBERO-10 task 0. Implements LLM-LIBERO tool-call protocol with move_to/done actions and held-out evaluation. Includes CaPtain baseline and viewer tooling.

summary: Local-first job search OS that ranks postings and tailors resumes and prep
readme_summary: Ingests postings from seven sources, ranks them, and drives resume tailoring, ATS-checked PDF, cover letters and interview prep. Stack is Next.js 16, Prisma + Neon Postgres, Typst WASM, Zod. Uses local OpenCode or OpenAI-compatible LLM.

summary: Spanish-first app that photos a plant and replies as the plant with a voice note
readme_summary: Spanish-first web app where users name a plant and send photos for health checks. Uses SAM 3.1 for streaming leaf/spot segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 to answer as the plant, with ElevenLabs TTS and SQLite journal.

summary: Turns WhatsApp field photos and voice notes into verified donor reports.
readme_summary: Node webhook ingests WhatsApp media, hashes evidence and transcribes voice with muse-voice-transcribe-1.0. Meta Muse drafts source-linked delivery cases for nonprofit review. Donor report shows confirmed vs unproven claims.

summary: Converts photos of broken parts into measured editable printable CAD models
readme_summary: Takes top/side/front photos on a calibration card through segmentation, deterministic OpenCV measurement and parametric CAD to STL/STEP. Plans SAM 3.1 for segmentation. Python app with partforge package and scripts.

summary: Agentic wildfire sensor mesh where tuned Muse interrogates and reprograms ESP32 nodes
readme_summary: XIAO ESP32-S3 camera-mic nodes detect fire on-device and send 30-byte packets over Meshtastic-class LoRa mesh. Fine-tuned Muse Glimmer runs ALERT/WATCH/DISMISS loop, re-samples nodes and rewrites detectors plus reports.

summary: Turns one prompt into a multi-page brand site with domains and hosting
readme_summary: One prompt generates HTML pages, brand kit and domain keywords via Meta Model API with muse-wonder-1.0. The app adds name.com domain verification, SerpApi conflict checks and Vercel launch with DNS.

summary: Python tracing toolkit that exposes failures to AI assistants via MCP
readme_summary: vibe-debug traces Python functions as OpenTelemetry spans, captures exceptions and silent empty returns, and exports to Arize Phoenix. Evidence is exposed via CLI and MCP tools for coding assistants. Optional Muse Spark integration explains failures in English or Swahili.

summary: Personal memory layer that answers questions using your own past history with citations
readme_summary: Stores user history as memories across life angles and retrieves relevant ones per query with citations. Built with Python FastAPI backend, static frontend, and Uvicorn. Uses Muse Spark for photo description and Muse models via Meta API for retrieval and answering.

summary: Shelf walkthrough scanner producing numbered master image and item log
readme_summary: Takes a photo or walk-past video and returns numbered master, per-item crops, and editable log. Python pipeline with FastAPI app and ffmpeg stitching. Uses SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API.

summary: On-device 808-param learning brain living in a 3D terrarium with failure memory
readme_summary: Android app runs 24-16-16-8 neural net sensing gravity and prediction error in 3D terrarium. Failures sealed locally as FNV-1a Ghosts with fire-and-forget judging. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for verdicts and blame.

summary: Turns screen recordings and intent into executable Playwright behavioral contracts
readme_summary: Converts recording plus plain-English intent to human-reviewed contract, then runs fixed Playwright checks against demo checkout including double-charge bug. API + apps with SQLite persistence. Uses Meta AI for intent parsing and rule generation.

summary: Community field notes plus token cost tracking and API key guard tools
readme_summary: Unofficial community field notes documenting Meta AI API experiments and gaps. Includes Cost Center dashboard for token spend and Keyguard for key management. Chrome extension plus CLI tooling around dev.meta.ai usage.

summary: Turns natural language into validated MCP tools for running Windows apps
readme_summary: Agent on Muse Spark finds internal functions via REA/Ghidra and writes Frida and DevTools adapters. Validated tools are served by an MCP server with no LLM in loop, callable via mcp_server.muse_chat.

summary: Authors visual SOPs linking each instruction to video frames and object evidence.
readme_summary: StepProof Studio is an evidence-aware workspace where instructions link to source clips, frames, and object observations. Authors correct wording and evidence then export visual guides. Built with Muse Spark and SAM 3.1, Next.js, with saved demo film and review workflow.

summary: Browser video editor that applies natural-language edits to clips
readme_summary: Agentic in-browser editor for blur, background swap, captions and graphics via chat. Cloudflare/TS stack with browser rendering. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Voice transcription.

summary: Turns morning dream memories into structured coded data and storyboard images.
readme_summary: Streamlit app captures dream reports, mood and vividness into validated Pydantic scenes. Muse Spark assigns Hall/Van de Castle codes with quotes; Muse Image generates per-scene storyboards. Local-first storage under git-ignored data folders.

summary: AI football video analysis linking coaching feedback to player development records
readme_summary: Touchline analyzes training footage to identify key moments and attach player observations. Built with Python notebooks and src pipeline for video intelligence. Uses Meta AI models for moment detection and development tracking across sessions.

summary: Freezes browser bug repros behind human approval before allowing source-only fix
readme_summary: Compiles model plans into data-driven Playwright tests run in real Chromium, binds human approval to test SHA-256. Controller allows source-only patches via git apply. Built as hackathon MVP for Indie track with mock mode and evals.

summary: Engine that turns breaking OpenAPI changes into verified cross-repo pull requests.
readme_summary: SynchroAPI detects breaking OpenAPI edits with oasdiff, maps blast radius via Tree-sitter/NetworkX GraphRAG, then generates fixes in Modal sandboxes. Uses Muse Spark Open on Baseten and Muse Code on Fireworks. Python engine with pytest and cross-repo PR output.

summary: Catches invoice vs packing list mismatches before dispatch with visual evidence.
readme_summary: Compares shipment documents to flag quantity and packing discrepancies with rules and supplier message. Built with Next.js 15 + TypeScript on Netlify. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for document parsing and matching.

summary: Voice and shelf-photo back-office agent for small retail stock and reorder
readme_summary: Owner sends voice note plus shelf photo/video or invoice, agent returns verified stock check and supplier reorder. Built with Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe, frontend plus backend.

summary: Simplifies government notices into clear Nigerian-language explanations.
readme_summary: Information accessibility platform transforming complex public documents into actionable explanations. Next.js app using Meta Muse Spark for simplification and multilingual support for local languages.

summary: Explorable idea landscape showing how a book's meaning evolves.
readme_summary: MORe engine processes books passage-by-passage to map how ideas connect with evidence links. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API with saved runs for three texts. Backend plus frontend for Journey of Ideas exploration.

summary: Desktop pet that appears in live video while doing your computer tasks
readme_summary: Furiday turns one pet photo into a macOS live wallpaper that acts out tasks while Muse Wonder executes them with tools. Electron app handles wallpaper video, input bar and previews, with local file tools in main process. Uses Meta Muse API for research, documents and file work.

summary: Manager to run and swap multiple local llama.cpp servers and models
readme_summary: Rust tooling to run multiple llama-server instances with per-model ports and flags. Provides CLI ctl, systemd template units, egui indicator and Waybar module. Ships Muse-Glimmer and Qwen templates.

summary: Send one prompt to many AI models and compare answers side by side
readme_summary: Small Node web app with a unified prompt box fanning out to OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Meta and others. Defaults to muse-spark-1.3 for Meta via META_API_KEY and renders parallel responses.

summary: Travel app that identifies Nepal landmarks and teaches culture and Nepali phrases
readme_summary: BINDU turns photos of Nepal temples, signs, and landmarks into cultural analysis, follow-ups, and shareable postcards. Features Explore with AI, My Journey saves, and language learning. Uses Meta AI vision and language models for landmark recognition and Nepali tutoring.

summary: Phone-first AI apprentice that captures expert why into evidence-linked skill data.
readme_summary: Observes skilled industrial work, asks targeted questions in expert language and turns approvals into transferable data for workers, AI and robotics. Phone- and screen-first platform with contributor-controlled dataset exchange. Repo is spec-heavy with PRD, TRD and verification docs.

summary: Local-first think space that turns saved links into citable AI brainstorming
readme_summary: Save pages, images and chats with a why-note; app auto-files and chats over collection. Local-first SQLite monorepo with apps/packages and Vercel landing, offline fixtures included. Uses Meta Model API for filing, search and cited answers.

summary: Verifies gig workers' evidence photos and drafts ready-to-submit dispute appeals
readme_summary: Next.js app for penalized gig workers to contest pay cuts and strikes. Uses SAM 3.1 to verify evidence photos, Muse Spark to draft appeals, and Muse Voice Transcribe for input.

summary: Turns raw payment events into verified weekly revenue digests with deterministic KPIs
readme_summary: Ingests charge/refund/dispute events into D1, computes revenue deterministically in TypeScript. Muse Spark 1.2 via Meta Model API writes weekly digest, with every figure checked before display. Stack: Cloudflare Workers, D1, TypeScript.

summary: Ranks drone photo candidates against a case brief for human review.
readme_summary: ARGUS finds objects with SAM 3.1, checks them against a brief with Muse Spark, and ranks them on a map for verification. Stack is Python plus web UI for review. Uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark via Meta Model API with human-in-loop.

summary: Turns grandparents voice stories into bilingual side-by-side storybooks
readme_summary: Next.js app where grandparents speak or write in Tamil, Hindi and 18 other languages to create translated storybooks preserving idioms. Built Nov 3 2026 for hackathon indie track; uses Muse models for translation and explanation.

summary: Trust and safety review queue with cited evidence, image and audio inspection.
readme_summary: Reproduces social review workflow with reports, timelines, case JSON export and uploads. Next.js + Cloudflare + Drizzle architecture. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for recommendations, SAM 3.1 for frames, Muse Voice for transcription.

summary: Rebuilds working web apps from a screen-recording video with a fidelity score
readme_summary: Reads video of legacy app use into a JSON spec, regenerates modern HTML/CSS/JS and redraws assets. Uses Muse Wonder for spec, Muse Code for rebuild, Muse Image for visuals, with bench and tests.

summary: Auto-labels driving video into vectorized 3D lane splines without LiDAR
readme_summary: Multi-foundation-model teacher auto-labels monocular driving video into 3D camera-frame lane splines. Pipeline combines SAM 3.1 Video, DINOv3 and Llama 3.2 Vision with distillation configs and scripts. Built for cheap mono-camera 3D lane perception.

summary: AI IELTS examiner grading Writing and Speaking in 30 seconds
readme_summary: Provides IELTS Writing/Speaking grading on four official criteria, study planner, and coach agent. Built with Python, Docker, Cloud Run and structured output. Uses Muse Spark for planning/grading and Muse models for examiner reports.

summary: Agent-to-agent shopping protocol that enforces age and compliance checks before payment
readme_summary: ClearCart connects buyer and merchant agents with a ClearCart Gate for verification and limits. Architecture includes agents, providers, payments and services with demo data and specs. Uses Meta AI models for agent shopping with enforceable compliance before money moves.

summary: Matches WhatsApp help requests to volunteers with AI brokering
readme_summary: Ingests WhatsApp messages via Meta Cloud API, dedupes and redacts PII, parses screenshots and PDFs. Llama tool-calling agent with budgets proposes matches; policy code and humans approve. Full trace logged.

summary: Scores startup ideas and builds coaching, research and landing pages
readme_summary: Static web app that scores ideas consistently, then generates coaching, live-web competition research, and published landing pages. Built on Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0 for tool calls, web search and reasoning.

summary: Converts handwritten weather ledgers into arithmetically checked climate data
readme_summary: Quill digitizes scanned handwritten climate tables using Muse Spark 1.3 for reading and column grounding with zoomed re-reads. Muse Wonder 1.0 adjudicates disagreements; yearly totals must match monthly sums. Python package with web viewer and held-out benchmark.

summary: MCP copilot acting as 3D technical artist inside Unity and Unreal
readme_summary: ForgeArtisan connects to live game engines via Model Context Protocol to generate editable modular assets instead of blob meshes. Python agent with CLI, MCP server, and web UI targeting Unity Editor prototype. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API.

summary: Verifies claims against supplied evidence with cited sources and methods
readme_summary: PruvChat checks requirements, disputes, custom reviews and visa cases against pasted files or fetched pages. Streamlit app with modular pruvcore, providers and SSRF-guarded fetch. Live runs use paid Meta Muse API with explicit confirmation.

summary: Creates shareable AI personas for Muse Glimmer steered by trait vectors.
readme_summary: Designs personas from five questions via Muse Wonder, extracts direction from Glimmer hidden state. Applies h+av steering without prompts and paints avatar with Muse Image. Outputs portable .persona files with slider tuning.

summary: TPU serving recipes and benchmarks for Muse models with SGLang-TorchTPU
readme_summary: End-to-end serving configs and benchmarks for Muse-Spark-Open-816B and Muse-Glimmer-30B on TPU v7x and v5p-32 using SGLang-TorchTPU. Includes Pallas kernels, speculative decoding, and gateways. Uses Meta Muse open models on Cloud TPU.

summary: Fashion storefront that finds Shopify products and shows personalized AI previews.
readme_summary: FashionMirror AI is a Next.js + FastAPI storefront that searches real Shopify products via Shopify MCP and displays personalized previews beside originals. Backend uses Muse Spark 1.3 for matching and Muse Image for generation. Frontend is Next.js TypeScript with Tailwind.

summary: AI copilot for inspecting electronics photos and troubleshooting hardware issues
readme_summary: FastAPI backend for SpatialSparks providing auth, image uploads, and inspection chat. Uses Muse Spark via Baseten for conversations and SAM 3 via Hugging Face Space for segmentation, with Supabase Auth, Storage and Postgres.

summary: Chat interface that turns plain questions into validated OpenSearch queries
readme_summary: Admins register OpenSearch clusters for LLM discovery of indexes and relations, users ask questions in chat. Built with LangGraph agents, LiteLLM, Gradio portals, PostgreSQL and ParadeDB. It uses Meta Muse Wonder and Muse Spark via ChatLiteLLM for planning and queries.

summary: Single-screen film workspace for screenplay, 3D set, shots, and production export
readme_summary: FramePilot AI v0.13.5 provides screenplay OCR, 3D environment/camera/lighting, drawing, Art Studio, Director AI and audio export. Desktop/web app with Docker and Windows scripts. Uses Muse planning and SAM selection for actor/object editing.

summary: Restaurant ordering demo with memory-based recommendations, rewards and safety checks
readme_summary: Standalone Pulse, Rewards, Guardian demo isolated from Bolivian SaaS. Synthetic adapters, consent memory with forget controls, coupon logic. Next.js stack with Muse Spark integration for personalization.

summary: Stress-tests business decisions with Muse risks plus deterministic math
readme_summary: Eight decision modes like quote, hiring, and ad spend with JS-computed profit and break-even. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 to generate risk hypotheses for simulation. Node.js frontend with deterministic simulation scripts and docs.

summary: Tests whether executed tests and evidence justify confidence in software
readme_summary: Turns requirements into checkable claims via Meta Model API, generates and executes small tests, then two different Meta models rate persuasiveness. Fixed rule engine with no AI computes final confidence. Includes failures and synthetic data only.

summary: Phone scan builds live 3D object memory map for warehouse shelves
readme_summary: Streams phone camera, pose and depth over WebSocket at ~3fps to Node+Express server. SAM 3.1 detects boxes/masks, lifted to 3D via depth+pose and matched against persistent object memory. Browser 3D viewer shows remembered objects across occlusion.

summary: Newsroom tool that links drafts to sources with provenance and review flags.
readme_summary: Python FastAPI/Uvicorn app for source-linked editorial review and Evidence Passport records. Provides draft prep, social previews, Word export and heuristic review flags. Demo runs offline without API keys with synthetic examples.

summary: Opt-in visual memory for Ray-Ban glasses to recall last key sighting
readme_summary: ENKI Second Memory adds bounded observation policy, opt-in single-image analysis and saved visual evidence to iOS host. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 Standard via Mac CLI with Swift core and backend for deterministic queries.

summary: Checks product photos against spatial rules with segmented visual evidence.
readme_summary: Streamlit app app.py uses Muse Spark 1.3 to parse natural language into 4-relation JSON rules, SAM 3.1 to segment objects, and deterministic mask-centroid geometry for PASS/FAIL. 116 offline tests pass; live SAM/Spark unverified.

summary: Campus tray photos matched to official menus for nutrition and waste coaching
readme_summary: App with frontend plus Python backend matching tray photos to official dining data. Scores leftovers and coaches toward dietary goals. Built solo for Indie Dev track for inclusive dining.

summary: Explores gene-knockdown effects from public single-cell CRISPR screen data
readme_summary: Frontend plus backend pipeline over ~310k cells x 8563 genes Perturb-seq matrix for lookup of experimental effects. Shows only measurements, no biological predictions. Muse assistant to explain results is planned but not yet built.

summary: Invoice intake demo where Muse proposals are gated by strict rules
readme_summary: OmNi-Ledger demonstrates invoice intake with Meta Muse Spark 1.3 proposing fields from text/image. Deterministic schema, supplier/SKU and domain rules decide accept or block. Runs via Node mock tests with evidence in HACKATHON.md.

summary: Merchant support operator linking reports, sources, and next actions locally
readme_summary: Local-first Python prototype with web operator UI keeping report and evidence separate. Optional Muse Spark creates structured readings with validation. Defaults to credential-free scripted reader demo.

summary: Turns rough ideas into clear tickets and demos agent-built results for review
readme_summary: Yarrow shapes ideas into structured tickets then guides review with live demos and Q&A. Web app harness for product teams managing coding agents. Uses Meta AI / Muse models to draft specs and explain shipped changes.

summary: Dashcam system that detects deer, moose and bear to warn drivers
readme_summary: Watches dashcam video for deer, moose, elk, bear and bison. Uses SAM 3.1 to segment animals and road, geometry for risk levels, and Muse Spark to verify red alerts. Confirmed sightings are shared on a network map to warn following vehicles.

summary: Agent that investigates scam videos and voice notes with cited evidence report
readme_summary: Muse Spark 1.3 orchestrator runs parallel tools over sampled frames and audio: OCR, SAM 3.1 regions, deepfake detector and fact-checks. Audits its own report and drafts warnings and bank reports without auto-sending.

summary: Relays Python failures between Meta models with verified fixes
readme_summary: Local workbench for creating Python tasks and testing AI repairs with executed checks. Node + browser UI with reproducible runs. Uses Muse Spark to build/fix and Muse Wonder as fallback when checks fail.

summary: Curated list of free BYOK LLM APIs rated for coding and chat use
readme_summary: Maintains an Awesome-style catalog of free self-replenishing text LLM APIs for BYOK coding tools and apps. Includes coding ratings, quotas notes, and switch-on-limit guidance. Markdown docs with scripts and media, no runtime code.

summary: Local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI coding teammates
readme_summary: OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace giving each AI agent its own workspace, conversation, queues and browser. It supports Codex App Server, Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Copilot CLI and others via ACP. Fork adds Linux server builds for self-hosted VPS deployment.

summary: Local-first desktop AI that turns prompts into documents, code and app actions.
readme_summary: Windows Python desktop app that converts natural language into reviewable computer work across docs, sheets, 3D, code and browser. Local-first architecture for privacy. Uses Meta models for intent-to-action orchestration.

summary: Local-first desktop workspace giving each AI coding agent its own chat and tools
readme_summary: OpenBot is a local-first desktop app for persistent AI teammates with per-agent workspaces, queues, file transfer and messaging. Supports Codex App Server, Claude Code, Grok, OpenCode and others via ACP. Uses Meta AI models for orchestration inside the desktop workflow.

summary: Local-first desktop workspace for persistent multi-agent coding teammates.
readme_summary: Local-first desktop workspace giving each agent workspace, queues, file transfer and messaging. Supports Codex App Server, Claude Code, Gemini and others via ACP. Fix for WebRTC chunk order.

summary: Local fork of OpenBot adding model failover and orchestration for agent teams
readme_summary: Personal noncommercial fork of OpenBot focused on model seats, failover rungs and workflow orchestration. Provides local queues and workspaces for agent teams. Independently maintained and not affiliated with upstream.

summary: Native iOS group chat that catches you up on 300 missed messages in seconds.
readme_summary: Cetchup is a native iOS group chat with integrated summarization via Muse Spark. Tap Catch me up to get plans, money, open questions and mentions with links to source messages. Built with Swift, Supabase backend and Meta Muse Spark.

summary: Chat to build and publish 2D web games in a two-pane editor
readme_summary: Forja is a Next.js monorepo for creating 2D web games via chat with auth, Drizzle persistence and S3 storage. Chat triggers runs streamed over SSE with preview and verified static publishing. Uses Meta models via gateway for game code generation.

summary: AI workspace to research, brand, list and market local businesses
readme_summary: Yourlocalbusiness is a workspace where shared Project Context feeds onboarding, dashboard, and strategy modules. It generates product ideas, brand identity, and marketing posts with AI skills. Web app with Node server and shared context.

summary: Read-only AI auditor that checks analytics setups and proposes safe fixes
readme_summary: Cockpit audits synthetic GA4, GTM and tool-call traces for schema breaks, leaks and PII without auto-applying fixes. Python agent loop drives its own audit tools with holdout grading scripts. Uses Muse Spark 1.1 via Meta Model API for reasoning.

summary: Top-down browser game that generates new systems live from wishes
readme_summary: 2D Canvas game where planner AI splits player wishes into systems and designer AI writes manifests plus AssemblyScript modules. Vite TypeScript with Vitest pipeline and sandbox. Uses Muse API for planner and designer.

summary: Browser watcher that monitors camera or screen and speaks when it spots your ask
readme_summary: Public watch-for-me prototype that buffers 2s camera/screen clips and stays quiet until it has an answer. Browser frontend sends clips plus text question to Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API, with spoken questions transcribed by Meta voice model.

summary: User-mode runtimes to run foreign Linux guests natively on AArch64 hosts
readme_summary: Collection of user-mode runtimes and translators for running AArch32 and other Linux guests on AArch64 including Apple Silicon. Nix-based build with specs and docs, Class A/B address-space model. No Meta AI integration evident; low-level systems infra.

summary: Career insurance agent giving an AI-proof score and upskilling roadmap
readme_summary: Web product scores professions 0-100 from BLS labor data and job posts plus AI exposure. Weekly watchdog agent tracks AI tools, layoffs and rules and assigns next upskilling task.

summary: Protocol letting shopping agents trustlessly barter prices with retail vendors
readme_summary: barter.computer is a protocol for personal agents to negotiate prices with vendor agents. Agents with search and browsing can find best prices through the live site. It was designed and implemented during the hackathon using Muse Spark API for personal and vendor agents.

summary: Natural-language engineering studio with beam solver verification
readme_summary: Neodustria interprets written specs with Meta Muse to propose experiments and constraints. Separate nonlinear beam solver validates geometry with mesh refinement. Next.js studio with live runs and saved evidence.

summary: Voice-powered bookkeeping for market vendors to track sales and debts
readme_summary: Nawa records sales by voice or text, then tracks debts, stock and customer reminders for Namibian traders. Client-server app with Supabase. Uses Meta AI speech-to-text and Muse models to parse sales into records.

summary: Trust-gated verification protocol so no agent claim becomes fact without measurement.
readme_summary: Reference implementation of Environment Protocol v0 with principal, mandate and typed claims. Enforces measurement-backed verification between agents and world. Team Pistis Sophia shopping agent demo SOPH-E.

summary: Keeps Ollama loaded when idle and frees the GPU automatically when gaming
readme_summary: gpu-yield is a single-file Python daemon for Bazzite Linux that keeps Ollama serving on LAN when idle. It detects game start via Steam, stops Ollama in seconds to free VRAM, serves 503 during play, and reloads after cooldown.

summary: Text-to-sound synth plugin that generates and hot-swaps DSP code live
readme_summary: AI-native VST3 synth that turns English prompts into per-sample DSP code, compiles to native instructions and hot-swaps it. Built in C++ with JUCE/CMake for Windows/macOS/Linux. Uses Meta API for code generation with offline safety and stress testing.

summary: Local organizer that cures AI chat amnesia without traditional RAG
readme_summary: ExtBrain organizes tens of thousands of chats across AIs to recover decisions and insights. Web app with Docker and Cloud Run, takeout importer. Built with Meta Muse Code, local-first anti-RAG approach.

summary: Disaster-relief app connecting citizens, aid points, and coordinators
readme_summary: Afet Destek is a Flutter prototype for disaster response with citizen reports, aid-location maps, shipment tracking and role-based workflows. Uses Firebase/Firestore, maps/directions, SOS features and AI-assisted categorization. AI output is advisory only, not for emergencies.

summary: Shopify analyst tracing AI-assistant sales and fixing catalog contradictions
readme_summary: AI commerce analyst for Shopify brands. Deterministically attributes orders to ChatGPT, Perplexity, Meta AI etc, detects catalog contradictions, and tests AI-agent checkout. Ask Centurion chat on Muse Spark answers from store data with charts and actions.

summary: Go library running Muse Code under hard live-enforced budget limits
readme_summary: Go library driving Muse Code via MSP session protocol with live cost tracking, reservations and mid-turn stops. Powers agnts self-hosted engineer. Uses Meta Muse Code models with budget-aware executor and guards.

summary: Trial planning tool that benchmarks protocols against past registry data
readme_summary: Reads protocol PDF text and images, searches 56k ClinicalTrials.gov trials via SQL tools, computes context and registry-only enrollment risk score. Agentic Python app with backtests, docs and tests, no patient data.

summary: Red-teams chatbots and MCP servers with 30+ attacks, scoring and auto-hardening prompts
readme_summary: Python tool that mutates jailbreaks via attacker model, judges with canary detector plus LLM judge, then outputs hardened prompt diff and re-test scores. Supports chatbots, HTTP endpoints and MCP servers. Powered by Muse Glimmer on NVIDIA NIM or Llama 3.3 70B on Groq.

summary: Detects scam texts and fake checks to protect older parents and alerts family
readme_summary: Scam Shield reads screenshots and transcribes voicemails, checks links safely and scores scam risk in Korean and English. Check verification compares images to history. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe, with Android app and Python backend.

summary: Visual canvas for multi-agent research and document investigation work
readme_summary: Interactive investigation workbench combining visual canvas with automated multi-agent pipelines and deterministic Python engines. Users drop documents, run workflows and collaborate with AI assistant. FastAPI agent server plus frontend.

summary: Turns HAR captures into shareable mock capsules with synthetic data replacing PII
readme_summary: FastAPI backend plus frontend that ingests HAR files, strips auth locally and substitutes consistent synthetic data. Verifies reproduction of API failures against a local mock server. Built for debugging without production accounts or AI keys.

summary: Maps data flows across repos and shows attacker reach from vulnerable services
readme_summary: Discovers cross-repo data flows with Meta Muse Spark with code evidence, scans images with Grype, and renders an interactive map with AI impact assessments. Stack is Python-based analyzer with YAML config and container scanning pipeline.

summary: Guided homework resilience prototype with safety stops and provenance labels.
readme_summary: Childhood Confidence Learning Lab runs locally via Node server with no live API calls. Web prototype with recorded Muse Spark 1.3 responses and mocked tests. Enforces provenance labels, fallback presets and parent override.

summary: Decision-practice studio to rehearse conversations and compare alternate outcomes
readme_summary: Text-first studio with fictional customer Priya, PostgreSQL sessions, transactional turns, and fork from saved snapshots. Side-by-side transcripts with light/dark Next.js UI. Supports insurance training workflows.

summary: Chat-first English, Pashto, and Dari interpreter co-pilot for mobile
readme_summary: Mobile chat interpreter with compact composer, attachment cards, and looping video profile. Local web stack served on port 3002 via launcher script. Uses Meta API for translation and interpretation with credential-preserving launcher.

summary: Turns messy concrete plant Excel into low-CO2 mix predictions
readme_summary: MixPilot agent on Meta Muse Spark cleans plant spreadsheets into Meta BOxCrete format and tests extra variables. Aims to predict 28-day strength and propose lower-cement mixes to cut CO2 with plant-specific data.

summary: Audits AI-written forecast questions for resolvability and flaws.
readme_summary: Muse Spark generates prediction-market questions from trending topics. Independent agent checks deadlines, settlement sources and verifiability with cases and runs. Python agent plus verification pipeline for audit reports.

summary: Turns hand-drawn truss sketches into validated structural analysis models
readme_summary: Sketch2Solve converts hand-drawn truss sketches into interactive CAD models and runs deterministic static equilibrium solvers. Stack is Python backend, Vue 3 + Vite frontend, MCP servers and evaluation harness. Uses Meta muse-spark-1.3 for perception and reasoning.

summary: Logs disassembly photos and notes to guide reverse reassembly later
readme_summary: Unscrewed records step photos and notes for furniture disassembly and returns steps in reverse. Node server.mjs + lib/public frontend. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Wonder to draft bag contents, user must confirm counts.

summary: Upload messy CSVs to clean data, detect anomalies, and get verified answers
readme_summary: Streamlit app that cleans CSVs, scans anomalies, answers questions with recomputed numbers, and exports PDF reports. Built with Python, Pandas and Streamlit. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API for Q&A, charting and report generation, with demo mode without key.

summary: Topic-based AI reading UI that keeps passages linked to explanations
readme_summary: Metafor lets users ask about selected passages, splits or synthesizes topics, and preserves reading position and sources with map navigation. Next.js + TypeScript with side-by-side focused replies. Uses Meta AI models for topic splitting and synthesis.

summary: Local workbench for multi-stage inference and proof workflow replay
readme_summary: Research workbench running strategy exploration, decomposition, solving and verification against Meta models with Baseten fallback. FastAPI + SQLite backend with Electron and web UI.

summary: Maps building facades from a photo to plan projection shows that fit architecture
readme_summary: Standalone Python service that segments facade elements with SAM 3.1, plans readable shows with Muse Spark, and generates per-element visuals with Muse Image. Custom code animates content along outlines; served via FastAPI on Render.

summary: AI design co-pilot that turns any inspiration into design systems
readme_summary: Synesthetic Palette is a personal design co-pilot delivering weekly palettes, typography and visual direction from reference images and web insights. Reasoned by Muse Wonder via Meta Model API with verification. Stack is backend plus frontend built during Oct 26-Nov 4 hackathon.

summary: Learns physical procedure from demo video then verifies new attempts frame by frame
readme_summary: Meta models propose procedures and track steps through video, human reviews, deterministic code decides verdicts. Built as overlay scripts on pinned vision-test-bench dependency. Uses Meta models for procedure extraction and video following.

summary: Unitree Go2 robot dog inspects walking routes for wheelchair access barriers
readme_summary: BenBen runs Unitree Go2 autonomy with capture and spatial-temporal reasoning for accessibility diagnostics. Stack in app/autonomy/capture modules. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for visual barrier detection.

summary: Restaurant order versioning that keeps guest requests, decisions and kitchen handoffs aligned
readme_summary: Action Shift prototypes a restaurant front-desk workflow where Muse checks meal requests against dated facts. Code validates counts and pricing, human review approves drafts, kitchen simulator acknowledges. Built with Meta Muse Spark with versioned proposals and audit.

summary: Audit showing organoid cancer gene effects follow culture medium, with pipeline and site.
readme_summary: Independent audit of two 2026 Nature organoid studies using public DepMap controls to separate 3D shape vs medium effects. Includes reproducible pipeline, static site at itsthemedium.com, and Muse AI agent for queries. Stack is data pipeline plus web frontend.

summary: Uploads damage photo to reconstruct cause with physics animation overlay
readme_summary: 5-stage pipeline streams forensic reconstruction from a damage photo. SAM 3.1 segments damage, Muse Spark analyzes physics, Muse Wonder reasons causality, then physics engine animates it. Flask app with real-time UI.

summary: Weekly model router that picks the best lab model for 35 coding and agent jobs.
readme_summary: Thalamus re-ranks models from every lab each Monday using public leaderboards for 35 routes. Python CLI integrates with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor with self-check brain and council review. Learns user taste from verdicts and remembers past weeks.

summary: Self-correcting image generator that verifies counts and layout with code.
readme_summary: Extracts JSON constraints with Muse Spark, generates with Muse Image, verifies with SAM 3.1 segmentation and Python checks. Loops to self-correct and compares verifier decisions against blinded human counts.

summary: PDF plugin turning NCTB textbook highlights into summaries and simulations.
readme_summary: Simuplug is a learning plugin for NCTB textbooks that explains highlighted PDF text. It retrieves matching sections and generates summaries plus interactive visuals. Uses OpenUI Lang with RAG over OCR-converted HTML and Muse Wonder 1.0 for content.

summary: Local browser workspace to manage Muse Code chats and approvals
readme_summary: Drives installed Muse Code via muse serve and @muse-code/sdk with shared sign-in and history. Provides project folders, action approvals, tool and subagent activity view, and token tracking. Runs locally as Node.js web app.

summary: Converts health insurance denial letters into facts and draft appeals.
readme_summary: Parses photo or PDF denial letters to extract payer, claim, denial code and appeal deadline with quotes. Explains denial in plain language and drafts an appeal letter. Uses fine-tuned Llama-3.2-1B with no-guess extraction.

summary: Converts open-cry auction audio into verified ledger with proof clips
readme_summary: Turns phone recordings of produce auctions into verified sales ledgers with audio proof and slip comparison. Pipeline uses Muse Voice diarized transcription and Muse Spark 1.3 clerk plus ffmpeg clipping. Protects farmers from under-reported slips.

summary: Watches hackathons and jobs, matches them to your resume with cited evidence
readme_summary: Agent that parses resume PDFs into profiles, checks opportunities for eligibility and scam risk, and emails digests. Built with Next.js, Drizzle and Docker, Pro billing via Razorpay, AI runs on OpenAI models.

summary: Photographs heirlooms and records family voice stories into linked living pages
readme_summary: Family storytelling app where an object photo plus relative voice creates an explorable page with sentence-level attribution. Frontend plus backend with Supabase, built for Bringing People Closer Together track.

summary: Supervised Pi robot that finds a visual target, approaches it, and reports via Muse.
readme_summary: iRobot Create + Raspberry Pi with camera, pose graph and safety-validated controller. Stationary inspection and Muse reporting via Gadget SDK. Uses Muse Wonder for image interpretation, memory and navigation decisions.

summary: Verifies spoken work claims against video with dual evidence channels
readme_summary: Transcribes Tamil/English narration to claims, then checks via video reasoning and SAM 3.1 tracks to output SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED/UNVERIFIABLE. Python CLI with mocks and 18 tests. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark 1.3.

summary: Compares pharmacy NDCs to find best expected reimbursement margin per payer.
readme_summary: Analyzes generic-drug NDCs across Medicaid, MAC and AWP payers using FDA and CMS data. Built on Meta Model API Muse Spark with tool calling and deterministic verifier. Python package with demo and synthetic sample data.

summary: Forest-fire video detection with visual proof and Telegram alerts with evidence.
readme_summary: Extends FireNetCNN MobileNetV2 classifier with Grad-CAM, OpenCV pipeline for upload and webcam. Adds SAM segmentation and Muse Spark reasoning to verify alerts. Sends Telegram alerts with evidence, runs on stdlib fallback without heavy deps.

summary: Security testing harness that finds prompt injection and unsafe tool use in AI agents
readme_summary: AgentGuard evaluates observable agent behavior for prompt injection, tool misuse, and exfiltration. Built with FastAPI orchestration API, deterministic mock tools, and frontend. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 via Responses API with validated function_call parsing.

summary: Desktop AI environment to plan, edit, test and ship software projects
readme_summary: Electron desktop app with React, TypeScript, Vite frontend and Python backend for project understanding and code workflows. Supports editing, tool running, testing and Git shipping. Built for indie track as idea-to-software IDE.

summary: Links video motion to an interactive equation-driven slider-crank model
readme_summary: Local engineering studio with React/Three.js frontend and FastAPI backend. Uses manual annotation, OpenCV tracking baseline and numerical fitting with held-out frames. Meta API adapters exist but are disabled by default; demo uses original synthetic clip.

summary: VR chemistry lab where AI designs and marks IGCSE practicals
readme_summary: Extract of Unity Meta Quest VR chemistry lab for Cambridge IGCSE Paper 6. C# modules include AI Practical Architect, ProposalChecker and marking of spoken observations. Uses Meta Model API to generate practicals from teacher specs and mistakes.

summary: Grades produce from images and routes freight to nearby cold storage
readme_summary: Combines zero-shot grading, manifest decoding, and crate segmentation with spatial KNN routing. Stack is Go plus PostgreSQL/PostGIS API, Docker Compose, and web UI. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for grading, SAM 3.1 for cropping, and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Evolutionary framework that breeds LLM trading agents step by step
readme_summary: Apex evolves a population of LLM agents via Eval, Mutation and operator orchestration, one step at a time. Task logic is isolated in env_connector with 2025 price data for 13 assets. All roles run on muse-spark-1.3-contributor via Meta API with OpenAI SDK.

summary: Ranks SF room listings and checks if desk, sleep and kitchen fit
readme_summary: One-page critic that searches Craigslist, ranks descriptions with muse-spark-1.3 and measures room photos. Edits missing furniture into winning photo for fit verdict. All runtime calls go to api.meta.ai, no other models.

summary: Turns one product photo into cutout, staged scenes and SEO listing
readme_summary: Vite React TypeScript app at cutcopy.pages.dev that turns a phone photo into cutout, scene variants, title and description. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, muse-image-1.0 for scenes, muse-spark-1.3 for copy via Meta Model API.

summary: Agentic pipeline to find programmable gene-insertion enzymes from proteins
readme_summary: Phase 1 dry-lab scaffold that queries MGnify Proteins 2026_07 via API and DuckDB Parquet. Filters and ranks recombinase/transposase candidates with tie-break logic. Optional Muse Wonder review in run_wonder_demo.py.

summary: Deterministic verifier that accepts multi-agent answers only with quoted source evidence.
readme_summary: Arbitre replaces LLM voting with plain-code verification for Hermes Agent swarms. Workers must quote real source lines; unanimity or independent proof establishes a value. Uses Meta Model API workers with rule-based verifier, plus bench and budget tooling in Python.

summary: Fog-of-war learning map with daily AI briefings and spoken Q&A to unlock topics
readme_summary: Next.js app with 25-topic map where muse-spark-1.3 with web_search writes cited daily briefings via Responses API. Users answer three questions aloud; voice evaluation clears fog, with Postgres and Vercel hosting.

summary: VS Code sidebar panel that runs Muse coding agent via local CLI
readme_summary: Unofficial VS Code extension adding Muse chat to secondary sidebar with streaming and auto mode. TypeScript extension talks to local muse CLI via muse exec --json. Requires own Muse Code subscription, no separate server needed.

summary: Personal agent foundation with profile, memory and dashboard
readme_summary: Phase 1 foundation for a proactive personal agent with user profile, persistent memory and suggestions. Stack is FastAPI plus Neon PostgreSQL with React dashboard. Proactive behavior is not yet implemented per roadmap.

summary: Turns hands-free Ray-Ban site walks into priced customer quotes
readme_summary: iPhone app plus reference server for Meta Ray-Ban Display contractor walks. Captures photos, transcribes speech, names rooms, and builds scoped quotes. Pipeline runs entirely on Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark, and SAM 3.1.

summary: Medical interview simulator with AI patient, voice, and Unreal integration.
readme_summary: MedSim simulates doctor-patient interviews with bidirectional audio and Unreal Engine avatar. Stack is FastAPI plus React plus MongoDB deployed as single Docker image behind Nginx. Uses Meta AI models for patient dialogue and speech interaction.

summary: Voice-first daily companion for older adults with reminders and letters.
readme_summary: Daylight offers web and native Android apps sharing a local backend and SQLite reminder store. It talks through the day, reads appointment letters, and saves reminders after review. Uses Meta Model API on server with Node backend.

summary: Runs AI agents in layered sandboxes with unreachable observer for audits
readme_summary: Puts Muse Glimmer 30B agent in synthetic world with layered sandboxes and independent observer logging. Checks agent self-report against ground truth for overreach. Zero-dependency Node.js with dashboard and threat model.

summary: Turns text ideas into printable talking robots linked to AI agents via MCP
readme_summary: 8-step agent uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API to pick parts, design 3D body, wiring and firmware. Connects ESP32 and LicheeRV builds to PICOCEO agents over MCP for speech. Firebase, web UI and printable files.

summary: One sentence to live web game plus LiveOps economy agent
readme_summary: Game builder flow from wish to instant play, taste swipe, slices, sandboxed team build and live hosting with chat edits. Go + agents architecture. Built on Muse Spark for code and Muse Wonder for LiveOps.

summary: Spatial workspace that plans from images and runs only approved safe actions.
readme_summary: Accepts workspace image and objective, structures scene with vision model and links observations to evidence. Simulates prioritized plan, then executes single allowlisted software action after human approval. FastAPI plus React Vite with Meta Model API.

summary: Permissioned API layer letting sites control what AI agents can read and do.
readme_summary: Publishes an AI surface via aurif.json and /ai/* routes instead of HTML scraping. Node 22 + Python 3.11 stack with Aurif-UI dashboard, Demo-client shop, and server. Uses Muse chat for demo browsing, handshake, and CAPTCHA vision with offline fallback.

summary: Turns desk photos into playable browser action-adventure games
readme_summary: SnapQuest is a local photo-to-game studio: upload JPEG/PNG/WebP, track generation via polling/SSE, then play the adventure in browser. Includes System Override where desk objects become mechanics. Monorepo with apps, persistent arcade and offline export; no stated Muse dependency.

summary: Auditable vision for industrial safety with deterministic rules and review
readme_summary: Decision-support prototype where AI observes and deterministic rules decide with provenance and uncertainty. Not certified safety system. Fullstack with backend, frontend, e2e, docs, release archive r32 with independent technical verdicts.

summary: Semantic patch layer for Git so agents describe intent instead of huge line diffs.
readme_summary: Git extension that replaces large line diffs with Semantic Patch Language intent specs. Rust workspace translates semantic patches to native git patches for compatibility. Built for agentic code refactoring and review.

summary: Rust port of SAM 3.1 to track sperm cells in microscope video for fertility.
readme_summary: SpikeTrack runs SAM 3.1 Object Multiplex video tracker as a single Rust binary with no Python runtime. Tuned for VISEM-Tracking, it reports HOTA 0.570 vs 0.155 zero-shot on Apple Silicon.

summary: Registers Muse web app as a chat provider with local tools and MCP
readme_summary: Connector exposes Muse (muse.ai) as a BB provider via ACP. It drives signed-in Chrome profiles, routes prompts to Muse side chats, runs local tools and MCP servers, and streams replies back. Requires Node 22+ and Chrome.

summary: Local ComfyUI VFX studio for masks, 3D blocking, generation, and dubbing
readme_summary: KESHIKI runs fully local on open-weights LTX-2.5 and FLUX.3 Klein for backgrounds, characters, and compositing. Provides SAM 3.1 masks, depth/pose tracking, and AI director in ComfyUI nodes for 24GB VRAM.

summary: Always-on Meta ads team demo for small businesses with recorded live runs
readme_summary: Repository hosts homepage and replay-mode web demo of Agent Beans for Meta ads management. Static site on GitHub Pages with recorded runs for two advertisers. Uses Meta Muse models for the underlying growth-team agents.

summary: Hermes Agent plugin tracking NVIDIA NIM model health and latency
readme_summary: Slash-command plugin for Hermes Agent that probes NVIDIA NIM models for liveness, latency and throughput. Reports alive, stalled, retired or new models and picks best chat model with fallbacks.

summary: Product photo turned into studio listing card for global sellers
readme_summary: Brainstorm repo for worldwide seller tool. Pipeline cuts out product with SAM 3.1, creates studio shot with Muse Image, writes copy with Muse Spark. Targets Shopee, Etsy, eBay and Shopify.

summary: Browser extension that teaches languages as you browse the web
readme_summary: VISUS is a local-first extension that highlights words by knowledge level and shows definitions and pronunciation on click. Persists vocabulary across sites, books and videos with no server. Built with JS, Vitest and Playwright for Chrome/Firefox/Edge.

summary: Bridge letting Pi agent run inside T3 Code with skills and routing
readme_summary: pi-t3-bridge is a Pi package to run Pi as an agent inside T3 Code threads. TypeScript bridge exposes T3 tools via MCP, with pstack/tstack skills and amplike command adaptation.

summary: Designs origami fold patterns that snap and collapse in a planned order
readme_summary: Pipeline turns plain-English behavior goals into fold patterns for bistable structures. Muse Spark generates scoring recipes and seeds; graph-encoder RSSM world model trained on sim runs scores candidates. Verified in physics simulator and tested on real paper.

summary: Filters disliked ASMR triggers from videos and plays a personalized version.
readme_summary: TriggerSift analyzes ASMR videos across 15 sound types to let users keep loved sounds and skip or remove avoided ones. It shows detections on a timeline graph during playback. Built with Python using SAM Audio and Muse Wonder for audio understanding.

summary: Broadcast-grade sports analytics from ordinary match footage
readme_summary: Three-stage pipeline: SAM 3.1 tracks players and ball, Muse Spark writes sport-specific analysis code, sandbox executes to KPIs and report cards. Upload video or link via web frontend. Every fallback explicitly labeled.

summary: Surgical simulator teaching residents when to trust or override AI
readme_summary: Simulation measuring how surgical residents rely on AI across cases, with faculty compare view for calibrated trust training. Python app with cases, docs and tests. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for clinical decision-support simulation.

summary: Agentic tool that turns natural language into verified PCB designs with fab export
readme_summary: Web app where users describe a PCB in natural language and an agent designs, verifies and corrects it with live PCB/schematic/3D preview. Built on tscircuit plus Vercel AI SDK with Meta Model API/OpenAI for 2-layer ESP32/RP2040 boards.

summary: Voice-first sales ledger for market traders in Pidgin and English
readme_summary: Phone-first PWA where spoken sales, debts and stock updates become structured ledger entries with one-tap confirm. Static HTML/JS front-end with Python brain service. Uses Meta Muse Spark to parse Pidgin/English speech and product photos.

summary: Saves browser tabs as checkpoints to resume interrupted work with grounded recaps.
readme_summary: Backtrack is a browser extension with toolbar save, Resume/Notes/History tabs, search and quality filters. It stores local checkpoints and calls Muse for grounded observations, next actions, and uncertainty labels. Built for Build for Your World track.

summary: WhatsApp company memory answering only from uploaded documents
readme_summary: WhatsApp-based knowledge system where employees ask questions and get answers grounded in company PDFs and docs. Python engine with Postgres knowledge graph, role checks, and source-cited answers. Uses Meta AI for retrieval and response with ingestion via WhatsApp or API.

summary: Deterministically replays webhook failure schedules and verifies repairs against golden state
readme_summary: Python engine runs 27 real-SQL schedules covering reorder, duplicate bursts, and crashes. Meta Muse Wonder synthesizes repair candidates while Muse Spark 1.3 explains divergences with diagrams. Independent verification evaluates candidates without model calls.

summary: Gadget framework that turns Seeed screens into Muse voice devices
readme_summary: This repo provides SDK, protocols and firmware to run Muse gadgets on Seeed Studio ESP32, Android, iOS and Linux. It uses Muse Gadget SDK for on-device display, voice and interaction.

summary: Open-source video tool that swaps characters, objects and scenes while keeping camera motion
readme_summary: Openjutsu is a lightweight Next.js frontend over ComfyUI workflows for character and object replacement in video. It uses MiniMax H3 for generation, SAM 3.1 for person tracking, and Qwen3-VL for image and shot description on local GPU.

summary: Verifies coding tutorials by extracting steps and replaying them in Docker
readme_summary: Local prototype links terminal videos to Muse Spark extraction, allowlisted Docker replay, and independent verifier. Intake takes MP4 plus starter ZIP, supports one Python command, with offline checks and measured evals.

summary: Evaluates SEC filings for signal while grading models against locked answers
readme_summary: ATLAS-7 grades filings for material signal and benchmarks model readers against a frozen key. Built as an eval harness with demo-set, freeze commit and grading cards. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 as reference grading arm.

summary: Voice-first AI helpline on ordinary phone calls in Hindi or English with spoken answers
readme_summary: Call-in voice assistant with no app needed, Hindi/English IVR, barge-in and live dashboard. Python app with Exotel telephony stack. Uses Meta Voice Transcribe for STT and Muse Spark 1.3 for answers with TTS.

summary: Local deterministic guardrails that review coding-agent and Git changes
readme_summary: Checks risky patterns in coding-agent actions and Git diffs locally without runtime dependencies. Explains findings in plain language with deterministic rules. Optional Meta AI explanation layer, runs offline by default.

summary: macOS chat UI that drives Muse Code CLI and tracks usage windows
readme_summary: Single-file Python 3 stdlib-only macOS chat client for Meta muse CLI. Lets users pick model, reasoning effort and context, chat and queue prompts. Tracks 5-hour usage window and parses JSONL for readable output.

summary: macOS desktop agent for voice control, vision and physical mouse-screen automation
readme_summary: Unifies conversational AI, computer vision, CoreGraphics automation and Ubuntu VM into macOS companion. Built with Swift, Go and Python across Mac app and agent layers. Uses Meta Muse models for conversation, vision and desktop task execution.

summary: Continuous auth layer that binds sessions to browsers to block cookie replay.
readme_summary: Risk engine scores every request, binds sessions to originating browser and triggers Passkey step-up on anomaly. Provides plain-English rationale per decision. Includes demo app, attack harness and browser tests.

summary: AI companion for Nepali elders with fall detection and family updates
readme_summary: Thulo Bhai AI acts as son/grandson for elders at BSRP Old Age Home, Biratnagar, with fall detection, loneliness support and family alerts. Built with Python app.py agent plus web demo deployed on Vercel. Uses Meta AI models for conversational care and vision-based fall detection.

summary: Bayesian quantum calibration planner with guarded circuit placement dashboard
readme_summary: Q-Bridge directs limited calibration budget to high-value measurements and recommends guarded quantum circuit placement. Python engine + FastAPI backend + React dashboard with simulation prototype. Uses hosted Muse Spark function-calling to explain evidence.

summary: Peer-to-peer logistics network booking travelers bag space with escrow
readme_summary: Senders book kilo-priced space, multi-leg routing, escrow until delivery confirmation. Turborepo monorepo with apps/packages, Docker Compose, TypeScript. No explicit Meta Muse integration in excerpt.

summary: Interactive Art of War book with tactics library and AI advice plans
readme_summary: Static Astro site presents 383 verses in English and Chinese with 52 tactics and community board. Field Challenge uses grounded AI citations and Kokoro TTS to create a 30-second podcast MP3.

summary: Turns experiment videos into physical models and designs next tests
readme_summary: AI scientific experimentalist that converts visual observations into physical understanding and testable predictions. FastAPI + NumPy/SciPy stack with ODE solvers and web UI. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for vision and Muse Spark for reasoning.

summary: Provider adapters wiring Muse Image and SAM into video-ad platform
readme_summary: Extraction from Menivor video-ad platform adding Meta Model API routing for script-to-publish pipeline. Python adapters for Muse Image generations/edits and SAM 3.1 segmentation. Uses Muse Image $0.01/image with real test suite.

summary: Local-first AI gateway routing across 352 providers with free-tier tracking.
readme_summary: Termux installer for OmniRoute gateway with dashboard, free-token accounting and auto-update. Emphasizes local-first routing across provider catalog with pooled free-tier catalog. Docker/Bun/Termux install with docs and diagrams.

summary: Onboard per-command rover safety checker validated against PRISM model checker
readme_summary: C dependency-free probabilistic checker computes stuck/crash odds over 8 range bands for each drive arc on 10x11 grid. Terrain from AI4Mars Navcam via Meta SAM 2.1 encoder plus linear probe. All outputs validated against PRISM.

summary: Bengali single-page hangout where human and AI Muses leave notes.
readme_summary: Static site in Bengali with index, for-muses guide and guestbook, no build step. Resident Muses respond only to real words; visiting human Muses or AI agents can sign. Hosted as static pages on Vercel.

summary: Daily web search for fresh promos with dashboard and Telegram alerts.
readme_summary: Runs daily at 06:00 WIB on GitHub Actions, uses Meta Model API web_search to find promos, filters expired entries and updates static dashboard. Sends summary to Telegram. Key stored in GitHub Secrets.

summary: Event video system tracking every guest and building opt-out recaps
readme_summary: SAM 3.1 tracks every person across clips, Muse Spark selects moments and proposes roster matches for human confirm. Consent engine re-cuts recaps around opt-outs. Web app plus GhostCut pipeline for beat-sync cutting and FCPXML export.

summary: Diagnoses why cold emails hit spam with live DNS checks and fix steps.
readme_summary: Landed diagnoses cold-email deliverability from sender domain, headers and bounces. It runs real DNS, authentication and blocklist lookups with a Node/Express backend. Muse Spark on Meta Model API acts as investigator to order causes and fixes, with re-check.

summary: Turn physics problems into narrated 3D lessons in three languages
readme_summary: Converts typed or photo physics problems into 3D simulated lessons with voice and step solutions. Next.js + Drizzle stack. Uses Muse models for tutoring, SAM 3.1 for vision and MMS for Quechua speech.

summary: Diagnoses robot policy failures using attention and vision evidence
readme_summary: GlassBox diagnoses LeRobot SO-101 ACT pick-place failures using decoder attention hooks and local SAM 3 perception maps. Muse Wonder reasons over evidence and tests hypotheses, with Muse Image support. Built from scratch for hackathon.

summary: Browser 2D animation studio that generates layered looping lofi scenes
readme_summary: Anim Studio provides Krita-style drawing, playback, AI scene planning and MP4 export. TypeScript monorepo engine with deterministic renderer and Ollama local generation. Cloud fallback optional, ComfyUI painter.

summary: Tray app that pre-starts AI usage windows so limits reset before work.
readme_summary: Schedules warm-ups for Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, Muse and Kimi on macOS and Windows. Tauri tray app with install scripts and docs. No Meta model integration; manages subscription timing for developer workflows.

summary: Cuts out shirt graphics and writes listings in sellers voice
readme_summary: Print-on-demand assistant with SQLite seller memory injected into Responses API instructions and chained with previous_response_id. Uses SAM 3.1 to segment printed graphic into transparent PNG, then writes and grades listings.

summary: Detects warehouse walkway hazards from photos with boxed reports
readme_summary: SceneGuard AI uploads workplace photos; Python backend prompts Muse Spark for hazards and SAM 3.1 localizes them, returning JSON plus annotated image. Frontend in Node 20, backend Python 3.11; findings flagged as possible only.

summary: Mac menu app that splits one idea into parallel tasks for three coding AIs.
readme_summary: Takes one idea and creates coordinated prompts for Claude, Codex and Gemini to run in parallel locally. Mac menu bar app using own subscriptions. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for task splitting and routing.

summary: Community parcel marketplace where travelers carry packages with AI ranking.
readme_summary: Self-contained model client, ranking service, demo API and tests for Communal marketplace with no DB needed. Calls Meta Model API via OpenAI SDK with muse-spark-1.3 for taker and parcel ranking. Deployed on Cloudflare Workers with live demo endpoint.

summary: Turns brand PDFs and voice briefs into quoted, human-approved IG carousels
readme_summary: Read-plan-write-visuals-render pipeline where every sentence is source-quoted. Muse Spark reviews slide renders for cutoff before human sign-off. Python agent with config.yaml, replay and mocked publish.

summary: Team of AI agents that builds and runs small-business websites and bookings
readme_summary: Sumora creates a small-business team from one conversation to run website, bookings, WhatsApp and payments. Python agent stack with owner approval for risky actions. Every agent reasons with Meta Muse Spark, plus SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

summary: Tracks Muse Code coding time and token usage in WakaTime
readme_summary: Community plugin for Meta Muse Code that sends WakaTime heartbeats for prompts, edits and LLM usage. Node.js hooks install wakatime-cli and compute line changes and token counts. Built for muse TUI and muse exec workflows, unofficial.

summary: AI options research agent turning dealer positioning into tested swing trade setups.
readme_summary: Analyzes options market structure into hypotheses, held-out stats, and risk-managed setups. Stack is FastAPI backend + Next.js frontend with Tradier market data. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and explanations.

summary: Governed undercover persona that monitors closed groups for violent threats
readme_summary: Prevention system where a Muse-written research persona observes closed violent-extremism communities under a hard-rule Safety Governor and separate judge. Backend plus frontend demo. Uses Meta Muse for persona, governance, and text-image analysis.

summary: Local finance dashboard with budgeting, charts, and AI assistant.
readme_summary: Financial OS is a Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind + Prisma/SQLite prototype for tracking finances with Recharts. It includes demo mode and Windows/macOS setup scripts. Live assistant uses Meta Muse Spark via OpenAI-compatible Model API chat completions.

summary: Gaze-triggered assistant for Ray-Ban Display glasses with specialist cards.
readme_summary: Mr. Jeff Glasses is a context-aware assistant for Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses that triggers on 2.5s gaze to classify context and identify objects. Includes manufacturing, retail and wandering specialists with a 600x600 lens simulator. Runs in Python with cached vision results and demo clips.

summary: Java Spring Boot suite integrating Meta Model API with tool calling
readme_summary: Java 21 Spring Boot integration suite for Meta Model API with provider-neutral contracts and Meta adapter. Includes commerce demo where Muse Spark calls search_products and check_inventory. Key stays server-side with trace UI for tool calls.

summary: Turns pasted text, PDFs, images, or links into guided spoken explanations.
readme_summary: Next.js web app that reorders any text into situation-problem-answer-limits narrative with everyday examples. Keeps source open and highlights sentences as spoken, with prepared samples. Processing uses user API keys for language and voice models.

summary: Generates career briefs and peer matches linked to chat evidence
readme_summary: Local Node.js prototype that turns shared conversations into career briefs and cross-room intellectual connections. Uses a real Meta Model API call with fictional demo data and recorded replay viewer. No accounts, outreach, or training, evidence-linked UI only.

summary: Korean multiple-choice VQA that reads text in photos of signs and menus.
readme_summary: SSAFY AI challenge solution ranking 3rd of 217 for photo plus Korean question with 4 options. Includes src, configs, notebooks, scripts and reproduce code for byte-exact outputs. No Meta Muse integration stated; standard vision-language VQA stack.

summary: Turns phone video of motion into verified physics simulation data
readme_summary: Phone clip in, metric trajectory out checked against gravity. Pipeline uses SAM 3.1 ball tracking plus A4 homography for metres, outputting trajectory.json for theory agent, with 14 tests.

summary: Renders architecture decision records as swappable bento-grid canvases
readme_summary: Two-file vanilla JS/CSS library with no dependencies or build step. Renders MADR records as template layouts with swappable compartment components. No Meta AI / Muse model integration evident in README or file tree.

summary: Consent-based research platform with deterministic protocol and audit trail
readme_summary: TypeScript monorepo for creator/respondent property-buyer studies with explicit consent, immutable submissions, and deterministic controller. Uses muse-spark-1.3 Responses API with SQLite, 1779 tests, and infra checks.

summary: Phone scans verify bike service changes with evidence in Tamil, Hindi, English
readme_summary: BikeSense compares before and after photos and video to measure service changes against owner manual specs. Uses SAM 3.1 for part segmentation, Muse Spark 1.3 for vision judgments and reports, and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0.

summary: VS Code and Cursor sidebar chat UI that drives Meta Muse Code CLI agent.
readme_summary: Unofficial VS Code/Cursor extension providing sidebar chat for Meta Muse Code CLI. It shells out to muse exec --json while the Muse agent harness does the work. Requires macOS/Linux, Muse install and login or META_API_KEY.

summary: AI local guide for any place with 360 tours in 14 languages
readme_summary: Next.js tourism app with streamed Muse Spark 1.3 guide chat, translation and trip toolkit with fallback to 1.2/1.1. Optional Muse Image panoramas and SAM 3.1 segmentation, health-check endpoint.

summary: Glasses-based assistant that sees, remembers, and operates a computer
readme_summary: Jarvis runs through Meta Ray-Ban glasses with iPhone companion for live computer control. Backend routes requests, manages memory and background tasks using Meta models alongside OpenAI and Google vision. Supports video capture, browsing, booking, and guided editing.

summary: Autonomously discovers faster speculative-decoding draft strategies for LLMs
readme_summary: Research system for autonomous discovery and optimization of speculative decoding algorithms. Uses Python research codebase with overlays, scripts and analysis assets. Leverages Meta Muse models to propose and evaluate decoding strategies for inference speedup.

summary: AI practice-date simulator for a dating app with Meta model provider
readme_summary: Hackathon subset of Ayma with two deliverables. Adds a Meta Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe provider behind a per-surface flag with Gemini fallback. Implements Practice Date conversational simulator; Flutter plus backend.

summary: Finds the first divergence frame when a physical assembly goes wrong
readme_summary: Debugger for physical tasks that aligns a user attempt with correct runs to find first meaningful divergence. Samples frames, detects objects with SAM 3 on Kaggle T4 GPU via transformers, reasons with Muse Glimmer 30B. Outputs frames, objects, and explanation.

summary: Phone reader that detects waning attention and rewrites text plus visuals
readme_summary: Thalamuse is an attention-aware mobile reader using scroll and touch signals to infer focus loss per paragraph. Node backend calls Muse Spark to explain and rewrite text and Muse Image for visual summaries. No camera, mic or headset required.

summary: Turns Instagram shop posts into citable SEO pages for AI answer engines
readme_summary: Visto en ingests creator posts where shops are tagged, transcribes reels and enriches with summaries and FAQs. Uses Muse Spark for text, Muse Image for previews and Muse Voice Transcribe for audio, publishing schema.org pages after approval. Node and Make pipeline with fixtures.

summary: Multi-tenant SaaS to manage Quranic schools, attendance, fees and timetables.
readme_summary: Platform for Quranic, private and kindergarten schools with students, teachers, attendance, payments, timetables and messaging. Stack is Node.js TypeScript Express with React Vite frontend, MySQL and optional Redis. Includes AI-powered features and audit/security docs.

summary: Local triage queue that ranks image folders with evidence receipts
readme_summary: Desk tool where folder goes in and ranked uncertain/auto_decided queue with per-image receipt comes out. Fully local open-source Python CLI with ladder logic and detector scores, no Meta affiliation.

summary: Motorized classroom microscope that names pond creatures and tells their stories.
readme_summary: 3D-printed OpenFlexure microscope on Raspberry Pi 4 with FastAPI backend and kids web UI. Tap-to-track stage drive, refocus, SAM outlining, and checked-list naming to story cards. Built for SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark via Meta Model API, demo fallback to Gemini.

summary: Turns any topic into a short explanation with interactive sliders simulation
readme_summary: Generates a four-sentence explainer plus a full-screen simulation with sliders, presets and live chat rewrites. Built with Muse Wonder muse-wonder-1.0 for reasoning/code and Muse Image muse-image-1.0. Frontend/backend split with unified simulation layout.

summary: Reproducible workspace that screens data pairs and writes testable hypotheses
readme_summary: AFTERHUMAN screens numeric feature pairs, ranks dependencies, and validates them with permutation and shuffled controls. FastAPI backend serves linear vs quadratic comparisons and hypothesis dossiers. Optional Meta Model API critiques aggregate stats only, with no row-level data sent.

summary: Causal factor-research platform to test stock predictors beyond correlation
readme_summary: Causal Zookeeper is a quantitative research platform moving strategies from thesis through ingestion, causal discovery, identification, and validation. Python stack with DoWhy, Double ML, frontend and harness. Uses LLM priors for causal graphs.

summary: Live talks with subscribable AI tracks for captions, translation and recaps
readme_summary: Speaker broadcasts from browser, viewers watch in a player with AI publishers for captions, translations, slide descriptions and chapters. Built on Media over QUIC with WebSocket fallback, agents run only when watched. Same tracks power rewind and recordings.

summary: Mobile Godot app that renders any map location as on-device 3D 360 view.
readme_summary: Godot 4.7.2 mobile-first app that builds a true-metre 360-degree 3D scene from map tap, search or coordinates. Uses AWS Terrain, Esri imagery, OSM Overpass, CHELSA, Open-Meteo unified via LocationData. Meta AI usage not shown in excerpt.

summary: Camera-controlled VST3/CLAP plugin turning gestures and face into MIDI automation
readme_summary: Audio plugin for FL Studio on Apple Silicon that maps hands, fingers, face and head to automation and MIDI. Standalone window with plugin picker, presets and profiles. Uses computer vision pose and face tracking to control producers existing plugins.

summary: Git-backed pipeline for anime characters, comics and storyboard generation
readme_summary: Production system for reusable anime characters, environments, illustrations and comic pages via GitHub Actions workflows. Adds visual-reference conditioning and CPU LoRA training integration. Uses Meta image models with Python scripts and schemas.

summary: Prospecting agent that ranks leads with evidence and drafts outreach for approval
readme_summary: Agent takes business profile, plans searches, investigates public pages and drafts outreach held for human approval. Stack is Cloudflare Worker + D1 + Workflows. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for planning, research and drafting.

summary: Warehouse bin counter using SAM 3.1 to reconcile counts with ledger records
readme_summary: Argus photographs warehouse bins on terminal, counts boxes with SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API, reconciles with ledger and reports variances. Pi 5 target, web console, mock adapters for dev.

summary: Browser life sim grounded on real Manhattan building data from NYC Open Data.
