readme_summary: Life Itself Manhattan streams 45k+ NYC building footprints and attributes into a browser simulation. Built with web 3D Cesium plus data pipelines on Firebase. Uses Meta models to reason and act on the real grounded place.

summary: Hands-free cooking coach that watches via Ray-Ban Meta glasses
readme_summary: iOS app + worker backend watches camera stream from glasses/phone to guide cooking steps. Answers questions from observed video history, with recipe box and hands-free voice interaction.

summary: Generates mock voice interviews and question banks from job posting URLs
readme_summary: Recruiter pastes offer URL, agents extract role, build question bank, and curate spoken interview plan. Angular frontend with .NET Lambda API, Cognito, S3 and DynamoDB on AWS. Uses Meta AI agents plus ElevenLabs voice agent.

summary: Runs Power64 Linux binaries on ARM64 via user-mode binary translation
readme_summary: Zero-dependency static-PIE translator for ppc64le ELFv2 POWER9/Power10 on AArch64 Linux and Apple Silicon. Dual engines: C11 interpreter oracle and direct-mapped AArch64 DBT with 128TiB user space. No explicit Meta model use in excerpt.

summary: Rehearses risky agent scripts on disposable server twins before production.
readme_summary: Creates a disposable Vultr twin from golden snapshot to run risky scripts safely. Records every side-effect in an approvable ledger and blocks prod writes. Built for Vultr Agent Rush Blast Radius Zero with Python CLI, API, and web review UI.

summary: Turns one video into optimized posts for all social platforms
readme_summary: ReelDone is a publishing agent where creators upload one video plus topic to get platform-specific captions, tags and posting times. Enables Facebook publishing from a single workflow with AI content generation.

summary: Voice-based civic reporting that verifies photos before routing to officials
readme_summary: Android plus Firebase platform where citizens dictate 30s reports of urban issues. Muse Spark cleans transcripts and verifies photos match text, then neighbors ratify. Photos and cases route to officials after validation.

summary: Turns product photo plus typed goal into reviewable structured assistance
readme_summary: Camera-consent still or upload plus typed objective produces structured reviewable fields. Human must approve; no auto submit or purchase. Mock-mode FastAPI backend with Next.js Studio frontend.

summary: iOS app for visual inventory checks and scrap investigation in factories
readme_summary: Native iOS app for manufacturers to spot inventory discrepancies and recommend actions. Combines computer vision, OCR, ERP data and voice-guided investigation. Uses Meta Muse and autonomous agents for analysis.

summary: Turns tough decisions into testable small experiments with grounded briefs.
readme_summary: Extracts facts, assumptions and trade-offs from a decision description with exact source quotes, then proposes reversible experiments. Next.js prototype with editable review flow. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API as Extractor and Challenger.

summary: Mobile photo editor for AI cutouts, stickers, retouch, and 3D pop-out scenes.
readme_summary: Reel Talk is a mobile editor for lifting subjects, layering cutouts, generating stickers, and text or voice retouch. Supports 1:1, 4:5, 9:16 canvases with reusable asset library. Built with React Native/Expo using Meta AI vision models.

summary: Plans solar-battery-generator power hourly to cut fuel and outages
readme_summary: Offline-first operator for small solar sites that plans next 24h hourly to minimize generator fuel while protecting critical load. Runs in browser and phone for clinics, shops and homes with unreliable grid.

summary: Self-hosted Jetson Kubernetes cluster running agents and local inference via GitOps
readme_summary: 3-node NVIDIA Jetson ARM64 Kubernetes cluster running FastAPI microservices, LangGraph agents and UIs with ArgoCD GitOps. Managed by Solomon Claude Code skill; LLM inference and runners pinned to AGX Orin GPU node.

summary: Fashion discovery platform with AI photo tagging and Indonesian AI stylist chat
readme_summary: Creator fashion platform for sharing outfits with product links, 3D mannequin and closet. Go API with web frontend. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for Magic Tag photo analysis and AI Stylist chat.

summary: Local video checker that flags floating objects and physics breaks
readme_summary: Analyzes AI-generated clips on-device to find unsupported objects and count mismatches. Muse Glimmer 30B via Ollama names suspects, SAM 3.1 via ComfyUI segments hands and objects. Geometry tests support and motion, outputs fix prompt.

summary: Map-first public transit companion with boarding, routing and connection guidance.
readme_summary: Covers timetables, stops, live updates, route geometry and multilingual notices. Hackathon repo adds contributions, tests and integration procedure atop original Skopje app. Provides live demo, scope docs and reproducible setup.

summary: Desktop pet that narrates coding agents and gives VS Code tours.
readme_summary: Tauri + Rust Windows pet that reports what AI coding agents are doing and speaks status aloud. Provides codebase Q&A and guided file-by-file VS Code tours. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for reasoning and local Phonon TTS for voice.

summary: Audits Cameroon land records to detect fake areas and boundary fraud in two languages.
readme_summary: Cadastra performs cadastral forensics via document analysis and geospatial computation, detecting inflated surfaces and UTM errors. It generates bilingual PDF audits and WhatsApp verification. Same Meta AI backend and frontend architecture as CADASTRA CM.

summary: Splits household chores by free time and verifies completion with before/after photos.
readme_summary: MoLakaz is an Expo SDK 58 app with Python FastAPI backend on Modal that allocates chores by share of free time. Before/after photos are segmented by SAM 3.1 to verify cleaning, voice input transcribed by Whisper. Uses SAM 3.1 for verification on L4 GPU.

summary: Fits FLAME 3D head model to photos locally inside ComfyUI
readme_summary: FaceMesh builds a faithful 3D head mesh from 1-10 photos by jointly fitting FLAME 2023. Pipeline combines SAM 3.1 masks, MoGe-2 normals, and FAN landmarks in ComfyUI nodes. Outputs neutral GLB mesh, cameras, and overlays locally.

summary: Generates validated loop running routes matched to distance and vibe
readme_summary: Runova creates loop routes starting and ending at GPS location matched to distance and vibe like nature or historic. Uses OpenStreetMap path validation, Node backend with draggable map UI, and live tracking with $0 map stack and no API keys.

summary: Sorts synthetic recruiter inbox and drafts replies with safety gate
readme_summary: Labels synthetic job-search mail into 8 categories and drafts replies without auto-sending. Built with TypeScript using rules plus safety screen and LLM gate pipeline. Demonstrates privacy-first triage where interviews and offers surface above promos.

summary: Predicts object motion in latent space to answer what-if physics questions on video.

summary: Turns class WhatsApp chats into verified source-linked calendar

summary: Chrome extension that cleans articles into focus text, cards and speech.
readme_summary: Bandwidth is a Chrome extension with local backend that extracts article text for Clean, Cards, Listen and Simplify views. Simple unpacked install with paragraph navigation. Uses Meta model backend for cleaning, simplification and summarization.

summary: Fuses cameras, files, and sensors into charts, alerts, and data products.
readme_summary: Multimodal intelligence engine where everything becomes an Observation for fusion and reasoning. Bun/TypeScript stack with Drizzle, docs, and components. Powered by Meta AI models for vision and analysis.

summary: Quest letter app where 3D companions read and translate letters
readme_summary: Courio is a friends-only letter app for Meta Quest where 3D companions deliver letters in-room. Hackathon work adds Meta-model voice reading, translation, and voice reply with in-room keyboard. Headset web app uses Supabase backend and Netlify hosting.

summary: AI coach giving visual feedback on nail work for students and technicians
readme_summary: Prototype by IND Academy combining Meta SAM 3.1 for fingernail segmentation with Muse Spark multimodal analysis. Provides structured educational feedback on nail-work images via Python app.py and sam_module.py.

summary: WhatsApp copilot that drafts salon replies in owner tone for approval.
readme_summary: WhatsApp business partner for Nigerian salons and vendors. Drafts replies with meta-models/muse-spark-open on Baseten, enforces price floors and discounts in code, and requires owner approval via mobile page before sending.

summary: Local-first companion that plans safe cabinet cuts for Shark HD520 CNC router
readme_summary: UI talks to REST and MCP servers sharing one deterministic engine for geometry, nesting and preflight outside VCarve Pro 11. Python stack produces DXF packages and preflight reports with no autonomous cutting.

summary: Diagnoses failing dbt/Airflow jobs, verifies fix in sandbox, opens PR
readme_summary: Collects Airflow task, dbt SQL, errors and stats, sends to Muse Spark via Meta Model API for diagnosis and diff patch. Verifies with dbt build in sandbox and re-runs DAG before proposing PR.

summary: Offline benchmark measuring stale-fact use when agent memory has newer replacements
readme_summary: Generates synthetic entities with fact lifecycles and ground-truth current values, then probes actions requiring current values. Reports Zombie Rate share using superseded values. No Meta model in offline core; designed to evaluate agent memory systems.

summary: Turns Bee transcripts into evidence-backed follow-ups with review queue to Notion
readme_summary: Connects meeting transcripts to project memory using exact source evidence and editable review queue. Prepares daily background digests or single-meeting follow-ups. Python 3.11+ package with tests, Muse for drafting and Notion storage.

summary: Evidence-grounded assistant to investigate public procurement tenders
readme_summary: TenderLens is a public procurement investigation assistant that grounds answers in tender evidence. Built with FastAPI, Streamlit and LangGraph orchestration, it uses Meta Llama 3.3 70B for analysis over tender documents.

summary: Drafts HR-approved rejection feedback emails from ATS records for applicants
readme_summary: Junior Wings MVP generates feedback email drafts for rejected applications based on ATS records using Meta Muse. It holds incomplete or unapproved cases for HR review without changing decisions. Stack is FastAPI, SQLite, single-page HTML+Tailwind and muse-spark-1.3.

summary: AI shop employee on Messenger that sells, takes orders and updates via Telegram.
readme_summary: AI Commerce Agent chats in English, Bangla and Banglish, searches real catalog and sends product photos. It takes oversell-proof orders and lets sellers manage business from Telegram. Built with Python on Vercel using Meta Model API and Messenger Platform.

summary: Scripts to run LLMs, images, video and voice on one RTX 4090 via llama-swap.
readme_summary: Bash scripts and configs for single-GPU home server on RTX 4090 with Ubuntu. Routes OpenAI-compatible requests through keygate to llama-swap, llama.cpp, ComfyUI and Chatterbox. Uses local open models like FLUX.2 and Wan 2.2, no Muse API.

summary: Voice-first app describing photos aloud for blind and low-vision users
readme_summary: Accessible web app that captures or uploads images and answers spoken or typed questions. Uses Meta Model API muse-spark-1.3 for plain-English visual descriptions. Delivers results via browser text-to-speech for visual understanding.

summary: Exposes logged-in muse.ai via OpenAI-compatible local API bridge
readme_summary: Local bridge that reuses a logged-in Chrome via CDP to expose muse.ai as OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions with SSE. Python package with Noise WebSocket transport handling and no registration flow. Routes prompts to Meta Hatch muse.ai session.

summary: Guides small businesses through website troubleshooting with AI help.
readme_summary: Structured troubleshooting companion that explains issues, suggests safe next steps, and packages info for developers. Vite/JS frontend with Node server.js backend. Uses Meta Muse Wonder for optional AI assistance and session history.

summary: Turns one sentence into live software; built desktop video editor Framevik
readme_summary: CODREN at codren.ai is an AI creation platform powered by Meta AI that plans work and generates UI, logic, database and integrations live. Built during hackathon window, it produced Framevik, an installable Premiere-class desktop video editor.

summary: Converts prescription photos or voice notes into Hindi care plans.
readme_summary: CareLoop photographs a prescription or records speech, then returns dose schedule in Hindi or English. Next.js app shrinks images in-browser, transcribes via Web Speech API, and calls Muse Spark on Baseten via /api/extract.

summary: Turns silent video clips into synced foley, stems and cue sheet
readme_summary: Upload a silent clip, Muse Spark detects sound-making events, SAM tracks them frame-by-frame, AudioGen synthesizes motion-synced takes mixed with ffmpeg. Python app with CLI, modal deploy and QC report. Uses Muse Spark, SAM and AudioGen.

summary: Human-supervised document review that checks extractions against explicit Python rules.
readme_summary: AXIOM Governed Hive reviews fictional quote, invoice, and install report with extraction then issue-search passes. Deterministic Python controls verify evidence and contradictions; business decision stays PENDING until human approval. Python hive CLI with offline fixture mode and HTML report.

summary: PCB reviewer that checks KiCad designs and explains manufacturing risks
readme_summary: Reads KiCad project/ZIP, compares schematic vs PCB, runs ERC/DRC with KiCad 9. Built in Python stdlib plus pypdf. Uses Meta Muse Spark to investigate structured evidence and cite findings for handoff.

summary: Activates inactive FMCG retailers with evidence-linked manager briefs
readme_summary: Local FastAPI app with synthetic SQLite data for retailer reactivation workflows. Numbered-menu session links to evidence brief, human approval, guardrails, and simulated rewards. Uses offline-tested Meta HTTP adapter with mock injection.

summary: Two-way Indian Sign Language to speech translator for 11 Indian languages.
readme_summary: Hastaak translates ISL signing to spoken sentences and speech to captions plus sign videos. Browser app with FastAPI backend keeps keys and calls Meta models. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and MMS-TTS with ONNX tracking.

summary: Muse agents tell carmakers which variants to cut using only public EU data
readme_summary: Multi-agent system analyzes public EU data to recommend which car versions to discontinue and writes a board memo. Built with Muse Spark agents, Python database pipeline, backtests, and GitHub Pages demo.

summary: Local-first hooks that shunt bulk work to cheap models with honest savings meter
readme_summary: Provider-agnostic token saver for Claude Code, Codex and Muse Code enforced by hooks with no platform or telemetry. Includes adapters, benchmarks and measured phase reports. Uses cheap worker models for bulk reads; provider-agnostic, no Meta Muse required.

summary: Wealth planner with backtests, pathways, AI copilot and note workbench
readme_summary: Flask web app with WealthTest backtesting, WealthPath pathways, chat copilot with memory and structured-note tools. Uses Meta Muse Wonder and Spark for reasoning with deterministic fallbacks without keys.

summary: Bilingual voice receptionist that logs immigration calls to Sheets
readme_summary: Answers Spanish/English calls via Retell, then sends transcripts to Muse Spark 1.3 for 18-field structured extraction, summary and urgency. Python server on Render writes one validated row per call to Google Sheets.

summary: Business OS for customers, quotes and tasks with governed Meta AI assistance.
readme_summary: React, Vite, TypeScript and Supabase app with org-scoped dashboard, inquiry inbox, quotations, opportunities and reports. Analyze with Meta AI extracts intent and previews quotes, requiring manager approval before writes. Includes audit logs, role-based access and scripts.

summary: Interactive report comparing AI coding subscriptions by agentic work per dollar.
readme_summary: Static site plots cost per task versus benchmark score and time for models at effort levels on top subscription plans. Sliders filter by score, cost and time with frontier highlighting unbeatable options. Built from public benchmark and capacity data with data folder and hosted report.

summary: Agent that interviews you, then plans and runs multi-model gated tasks
readme_summary: Zuck clarifies goals then plans goals, tasks, gates and parallel groups. It routes work to Muse Spark, Wonder, Image and SAM 3.1 using the visitor's own API key, running asynchronously without storing it.

summary: LoRA fine-tune of small model to automate finance back-office tasks
readme_summary: Distills verified teacher trajectories to LoRA fine-tune muse-glimmer-30b for finance workflows. Evaluated on Zapier AutomationBench finance domain on final SaaS state. Reaches 31.0% pass@1 vs 15.3% base and 50.0% teacher.

summary: Homebuyer tool that calculates true ownership costs and compares two properties side by side.
readme_summary: Next.js app pairing tested deterministic financial calculations for taxes, insurance, HOA and upfront cash with optional Muse Spark 1.3 explanations. AI explains results but never performs the math, to avoid miscalculation.

summary: Tier-0 rules gate that drops noisy alerts before LLM triage
readme_summary: Webhook normalize and deterministic gate drops provable noise at zero tokens, escalating only signal to muse-spark-1.3 triage. Includes bench harness, frozen SHA256 evidence and tests for verifiable SRE triage.

summary: Source-backed property research with editable plans, models and walkthroughs.
readme_summary: Connects housing research to editable architectural plans, building models, and interactive walkthroughs for additions and ADUs. Full-stack site + API, research service, Blender worker, MCP. Uses Meta models for research and planning.

summary: Public receipted record mirror documenting ManyMoats and ICEBLOCK evidence
readme_summary: Repository provides a reading-rules README for critical evidence review with observed/derived/claimed labels. Contains only docs under hackathon folder, no runnable app described. No Meta AI integration evident from files.

summary: Mood-based travel muse that suggests places as painted postcards
readme_summary: Wander takes vague mood text and proposes distinct places with postcard images. Python app uses Meta Muse models via Meta Model API for text and image generation. Includes offline tests and smoke scripts for API verification.

summary: Investigates software failures from logs and verifies fixes in Docker
readme_summary: React + Vite frontend uploads logs and shows hypotheses, timelines and reports. FastAPI backend validates, redacts credentials and calls Muse Spark 1.3 via backend-only Meta Model API. Two Docker fixtures reproduce failures with offline demo mode.

summary: Captures incident calls into searchable postmortems with exact error recall
readme_summary: Incident Memory transcribes recorded calls and drafts structured cause, fix, and owner records. Combines vector search with exact code matching and access filtering. Uses Muse Spark for postmortems to avoid stale or invented runbook answers.

summary: Simulates downhill lava paths on synthetic terrain with AI interpretation
readme_summary: Generates synthetic volcanic terrain, computes geometric downhill flow paths with 2D/3D visualization. Streamlit + Python app calls Meta Model API to explain results. Not a real hazard forecast, demo only and unverified live.

summary: Phone-photo home screening that finds cracks and damp and rates severity
readme_summary: Plans photo upload with A4 scale reference, SAM 3.1 segmentation for cracks/damp, OpenCV measurement, and Muse Spark classification to JSON defect report. Stack is Python, SAM 3.1, Meta Model API, OpenCV, NumPy, Gradio. Early planned status, screening aid only.

summary: Travel itinerary checker that scores tour plans against Google Maps.
readme_summary: ItinAI extracts travel plans from text, PDF or photos and validates them against Google Maps Routes, Places, prices and exchange rates. A Muse Spark auditor scores 10 feasibility categories with fixes. Built on Laravel PHP, MySQL and Tailwind Vite.

summary: Turns egocentric video and gaze into object-grounded evidence for elder support
readme_summary: Pipeline maps gaze samples to objects with SAM 3 to produce time-stamped evidence and dwell metrics. Muse Spark interprets evidence with key frames into linked findings. Built for retrospective research on daily activities.

summary: Wealth planning workspace with Muse copilot over staged CRM household records
readme_summary: Preserves KentIQ workspace and adds server-side copilot retrieving selected household holdings and cashflows. Vanilla JS with case-model engine. Uses Muse models for grounded answers with separate deterministic calculations.

summary: Containerized business operator agent that acts with verifiable receipts
readme_summary: 3tched-in-Schema packages a business identity that turns goals into deployed infrastructure. Actions are capability-authorized, compliance-bounded, and logged as tamper-evident blockchain-anchored receipts. Built on Meta Muse Spark with verifiable demo at 3tched.com/demo.

summary: On-device contextual ad engine that infers intent without personal data
readme_summary: Llama-Persona analyzes active desktop app usage locally to infer commercial intent and match a local campaign catalog. Python and Streamlit dashboard uses Meta model for confidence-scored intent and guard-checked copy. 66 tests cover pipeline and privacy logic.

summary: Interactive painting studio that generates replayable technique demos
readme_summary: Learn-by-doing painting studio that turns technique requests into replayable demonstrations with practice feedback. Uses Meta Muse muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for lesson generation. Node.js frontend and server.

summary: 3D readiness twin showing supply delays impact on data center go-live
readme_summary: 3D twin for AI data center delivery that links supply changes to readiness date. Muse Wonder agents investigation, Muse Spark 1.3 extracts docs/photos, SAM 3.1 segments images, Muse Voice transcribes notes.

summary: Pre-checks Meta ads against 45 policies and visually fixes violations.
readme_summary: Next.js app that reviews ad image, copy and landing page against Meta Advertising Standards. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for structured policy verdicts and SAM 3.1 for pixel masks. Uses Muse Image to rewrite compliant copy and creatives.

summary: Benchmark that renders HTML animations from video and scores fidelity
readme_summary: Generates HTML animations from reference videos, renders to MP4, scores visual similarity, spatio-temporal IoU, retention. Docker + CUDA Python eval harness. Uses V-JEPA 2.1 features, SAM 3.1 tracking, GPT judge.

summary: Places brand posters into filmed video with tracking
readme_summary: Pipeline that scores placeability, finds flat surfaces, generates posters and composites them with camera tracking and occlusion. Python + ffmpeg cached jobs. Uses Muse Spark for planning, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

summary: Turns one expert video into steps, then coaches learners via webcam.
readme_summary: Films an expert once and uses Muse Spark 1.3 video to write structured procedures with key objects and done states. Uses SAM 3.1 to localize parts and point at errors in learner attempts live or recorded. Built for Push the Frontier on Meta Model API.

summary: Locates gunshots with 3 cameras using audio TDOA and AI labels
readme_summary: Uses Tapo C121/C120 mics with DSP impulse detection, chirp clock sync, and TDOA localization on satellite map. Meta Spark describes sounds on local dashboard with 1fps previews. Python with privacy docs.

summary: Scan toys, design printable upgrades in browser, then play in AR and games
readme_summary: ToyVentor guides Snap-Motion-Pro toy invention from scan to printable parts to AR play. Web app with containers and STEM-aligned modules. Uses self-hosted Muse Glimmer for text-to-part plus Meta hosted APIs for scan, art, and voice.

summary: Desktop agent that turns code and app recordings into launch videos.
readme_summary: PostOrca is a desktop app where Orca agent reads code and commits, plans shot-by-shot scripts, then records the running app. It edits captioned videos with voiceover for social platforms. Uses project workspaces, routines and brand profiles.

summary: Anime-based Japanese speaking practice with pause-and-repeat lines
readme_summary: Ttaku is a browser extension that pauses anime lines, shows romaji prompts and listens for speech before resuming. It collects practiced phrases into a word bank for review.

summary: 3D globe copilot with voice control for maps, alerts and schedules
readme_summary: Spatial discovery app with interactive 3D particle globe and orbital navigation. Coordinates phone, tablet and TV views with tool-calling. Uses Meta Muse for actions and local Kokoro pipeline for voice.

summary: Parody pledge site to mail old RAM to Sam Altman
readme_summary: samneedsram.com is a parody viral site where visitors pledge old RAM and generate a snail-mail kit. Currently scaffold with plan in docs/da_plan.md. No real Meta AI integration yet; landing, PDF generator and leaderboard planned.

summary: Turns floor-plan images into interactive 3D homes you can walk and remodel
readme_summary: BlueprintTo3D extracts walls, doors, rooms and roof as strict JSON with Muse Spark 1.3 and rebuilds in Three.js. Supports editing, first-person walk, SAM 3.1 symbol check, restyle and GLB/DXF export.

summary: Hands-free voice agent that controls keyboard and mouse for desktop tasks
readme_summary: Project Saiga listens for voice commands and performs sequential desktop actions like opening tabs and writing emails. Built with Meta Muse models for voice streaming, vision and orchestration to assist seniors and users with disabilities.

summary: Vehicle carbon and lifecycle analytics dashboard for sustainability
readme_summary: Next.js sustainability platform that audits vintage vehicle restoration carbon footprint and energy metrics. Frontend is Next.js with Tailwind and Vercel serverless APIs. Integrates Meta Muse Model API for diagnostics.

summary: High-throughput LLM inference engine with AMD ROCm and hybrid attention support
readme_summary: Extends Tokasaurus inference engine with AMD ROCm AITER backend and hybrid GDN/SWA attention. Supports GLM, Qwen, Gemma, OLMo, Muse, gpt-oss with Cartridges and attention matching. Benchmarked against vLLM and Transformers.

summary: Tests if AI-fixed web widgets work with Tab and Enter in headless Chrome
readme_summary: Tests 7 hand-built broken web widgets in real headless Chrome for Tab focus, visible focus ring, and Enter behavior. Python checker with replay and video proof; compares broken, hand fixes, Llama 3.2 1B and Muse Glimmer 30B repairs.

summary: Multi-agent system that renders CS concepts as Manim vertical reels
readme_summary: Concept2Motion runs algorithms in sandboxes to capture true runtime states, then compiles them to deterministic Manim animations. Multi-agent pipeline handles script, code, render, and narration for 1080x1920 60FPS reels. Powered by muse-spark-1.3 with Llama Guard 3 checks.

summary: Terminal research agent with STEM loadouts and 29+ science APIs
readme_summary: STEM-Claw is a terminal IDE agent with 5 STEM loadouts, PRISMA workflows and multi-epoch discovery. Python package queries PubMed, arXiv and ChEMBL, reasoning via Meta Model API Muse Wonder.

summary: Offline-first Android literacy app teaching reading by voice, image and gesture
readme_summary: Capacitor Android app where app/www HTML/CSS/JS teaches reading without prior literacy via lesson data packs. Small dependency-free Node server holds Meta key to generate lessons and evaluate spoken answers. Supports French, Swahili and Lingala packs.

summary: Compares ACA plan total costs by household, ZIP and care scenario
readme_summary: Educational ACA cost comparison tool starting with Colorado 2026 QHP data, ZIP-to-rating-area lookup and scenario ranking engine. Next.js TypeScript app with tested ranking logic. No direct Meta model inference described; built for hackathon as data + calculation app.

summary: Turns any physical object into a touch button using SAM-tracked masks.
readme_summary: Drag a box and SAM 3.1 traces the object boundary for review, then bind keys 1-5 to touch. Python live_demo with perception, camera and voice modules; hover never fires. Session-only or persisted profiles.

summary: On-device cartoon axolotl companion that hears, talks, and remembers locally
readme_summary: Fine-tuned Llama 3.2 3B Instruct (Salty-v7a) running on Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 Hexagon NPU via llama.cpp. 3D aquarium app with voice I/O, body reactions, and local memory. Built with Muse Code on Muse Wonder 1.0, no cloud.

summary: First-person hazard warnings with spoken clock-face directions for blind navigation.
readme_summary: Locus converts first-person video to stereo-panned audio and spoken time-to-collision warnings. Pipeline: SAM 3.1 segmentation to persistent 3D scene graph to collision logic. Evaluated on SANPO and AEA datasets.

summary: Native Windows x64 port of NeverDead via static PowerPC-to-C++ recompilation
readme_summary: AI-assisted EmuComp combining static PowerPC-to-C++20 recompilation with Xbox 360 runtime. CMake C++ stack with Direct3D 12 translation layer. Uses AI assistance for recompilation analysis; requires own retail disc.

summary: Local frontend that renders Muse agent edits for visual approve-or-revert review
readme_summary: Muse Maker is a local frontend for Muse coding agents. It renders the project in the center window with Before/After states and change explanations for approve, edit, or revert. Built with Node server.mjs and web frontend, it uses Muse models for agentic code changes.

summary: Go plugin proxying pay-as-you-go models into OpenCode with rotation
readme_summary: Native CLIProxyAPI plugin for OpenCode with model discovery, four-protocol support and shared API-key rotation. Handles streaming, reasoning output and quota queries for pay-as-you-go use. Implemented in Go with YAML config, internal proxy logic and tests.

summary: Reproduces Python bugs, proposes patches and verifies fixes with tests.
readme_summary: ProofPatch AI reproduces Python failures with pytest, requests a minimal unified-diff patch from a model and re-runs tests. FastAPI backend plus Next.js UI with mock-model mode, 71 backend tests and full-journey check.

summary: Real-time zero-G station sim with AI flight director for astronaut training
readme_summary: Unreal Engine 5.7 C++ 6-DOF physics sim where Meta AI acts as Flight Director perceiving telemetry and computing risk. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for cyber-physical control.

summary: Fine-tuned open model that reads hieroglyph photos into sign codes and transliteration.
readme_summary: Fine-tunes Muse Glimmer 30B with LoRA on Fireworks for two-step photo-to-Gardiner codes with boxes, then codes-to-transliteration. Includes bench, baseline and dedupe scripts with results and runs folders. Compares fine-tuned open model against frontier model baselines.

summary: Grades road defects from phone photos and dashcam clips with mapped tracking.
readme_summary: RoadPulse converts phone photos or dashcam clips into graded, mapped road defect reports via React PWA and Fastify API. Uses Meta AI models for detection and grading with in-memory store and Swagger docs. Deployed split-origin with HTTPS camera and GPS.

summary: Webcam-driven assistive finger simulation with AI-selected calibration
readme_summary: SyncDigit is a webcam-controlled simulation of an assistive finger for limited finger function. It mirrors a chosen finger using Spark-selected calibration profiles locally. Prototype in Python explores assistance for congenital hand differences.

summary: Replays API requests on old and new versions to catch unintended behavior changes
readme_summary: Autonomous loop replays test cases against reference and new APIs, triages diffs against changelog, fixes allowed rules and re-verifies. Guardrailed edits with backups. Full-stack with backend agent, frontend tester and AI verdicts.

summary: WhatsApp pipeline that reads fleet documents and replies in driver language
readme_summary: Drivers send photos/PDFs via WhatsApp webhook with signature check and SHA-256. Media is stored encrypted, read by Meta Muse via Model API, and checked by deterministic rules to update cab records. Stack is Python app with intake/bridge modules, dashboard and tests.

summary: Ask who built code in plain English and get contributors with Git evidence links
readme_summary: Points at any Git repo, runs local deterministic Git history analysis, streams investigation timeline to contributor cards. Optional model for NL queries and email drafts. Stack is backend + frontend with repo map tree and blame/commit evidence inspector.

summary: Local AI maintainer that verifies dependency updates in a sandbox
readme_summary: Watches drift, issues and PRs then triages, reproduces, fixes and verifies in Mac sandbox for human merge. Python CLI plus web dashboard. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Muse Code subscription, no direct API.

summary: Agent-directed pipeline that turns a song into a frame-accurate lyric video
readme_summary: Takes a song through transcription, Muse Wonder director JSON plans, and a builder to render designed lyric video. Python stack with director.py, sam_api.py and builder configs. Uses Muse Wonder for design and SAM 3.1 for visual segmentation.

summary: Turns dated field photo scans into reviewable farm action plans
readme_summary: Web core organizes parcels into dated scan folders with up to four images. Server routes call Meta Model API to draft plans, separating observations from estimates. Node pnpm monorepo, Vercel-deployable.

summary: Static Vietnamese web app for learning Chinese with flashcards and HSK quizzes.
readme_summary: Static HTML/JS site with dictionary, flashcards, writing, pinyin and quiz tabs. Progress stored in browser localStorage with no backend. No Meta AI / Muse integration evident in README or file tree.

summary: Isolated verification layer that proves AI code patches by before-after test runs
readme_summary: Uploads original code and patch, runs baseline tests then patched tests in network-disabled Docker containers. Compares results and issues a Repair Passport with evidence and review decision.

summary: Graph studio to design APIs, ERDs, and integrations on canvas.
readme_summary: GRAVENX lets architects explore Salesforce metadata, design topologies, and decompose Apex logs. Stack is Next.js on Cloudflare Workers with MCP server and WebSocket bridge. Uses headless control for terminal coding agents.

summary: Badminton video editor that tracks players and overlays scoreboard and focus inset.
readme_summary: Python tool calls Meta SAM 3.1 to segment and track four players P1-P4 through rallies, filling masks and blurring others. Static web editor adds title banner, rally clock, scoreboard and zoomed player inset. Runs locally with examples, docs and tools folders.

summary: Swarm robotics command system for disaster search and rescue operations
readme_summary: KirkinX is a distributed C2 platform for humanitarian search and rescue swarm robotics. Central tactical reasoning uses Meta Llama 3, while YOLOv8 runs on edge hardware for casualty detection. Dispatches JSON directives from telemetry evaluation.

summary: Payments agent that drafts PayPal invoices and waits for approval.
readme_summary: Reads money requests from email/chat, drafts PayPal invoices/payouts and executes after one approval. Includes policy caps, risk checks, idempotency and audit trail; deployed via Docker Compose, Postgres, Caddy on Vultr.

summary: Connects parents and therapists for child speech therapy follow-up
readme_summary: React Native Expo plus Supabase platform where parents share text, photos, video and voice notes and specialists publish reviewed session reports. AI drafts behavioral summaries requiring explicit save; no auto-diagnosis.

summary: Phone photos and voice notes become nurse-approved fluid-balance charts
readme_summary: Meniscus captures QR-linked container photos or voice notes at the bedside. SAM 3.1 finds liquid levels and Muse Spark drafts volume entries for one-tap nurse approval with rule-based review prompts.

summary: Desktop agent with persistent memory and verifiable tool execution
readme_summary: Desktop agent built in 10 days with Skuld V4 persistent subject runtime and world state in a terminal. Connects decisions to Pi execution harness returning tool results as evidence. Validated with self-hosted Muse Glimmer 30B with inspectable calls and receipts.

summary: Turns one product photo into an editable Blender 3D model in browser
readme_summary: Reads a photo via Meta Model API to get product priors, segments with SAM 3.1, restyles with Muse Image, then builds a Blender mesh (.blend/.glb) for browser viewing. Backend drives segmentation, depth priors and mesh generation.

summary: Idea-to-build planner with scope checks and project map review
readme_summary: LaunchBase guides idea analysis, scope confirmation, foundation filtering and build-plan review with an interactive project map. Built with Next.js, pnpm and Node 22; Meta integration is validated separately. App generation and ZIP export are planned.

summary: Maps logging schemas to OCSF and exports Databricks-ready pipelines
readme_summary: FastAPI backend plus React+Vite frontend maps existing logs to all 61 OCSF 1.9.0 classes and validates them. Exports PySpark, Spark SQL, data-quality tests and Asset Bundles after approval. Uses Meta API for mapping suggestions, hydration and code generation.

summary: Turns messages, documents and voice into approved action plans
readme_summary: Productivity agent that summarizes PDFs/DOCX/TXT, transcribes voice and builds structured plans with human-approved execution. Python backend with frontend UI. Uses Meta Model API for multimodal understanding, planning and Q&A.

summary: Recommender that answers from people you follow with cited sources
readme_summary: Drop-in retrieval and re-rank service on Meta Model API. Exposes candidates, rerank and clips endpoints using Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 for credited plans and feeds.

summary: Crop doctor measuring leaf damage and checking pesticide labels for Indian farmers.
readme_summary: Farmer sends leaf photo with scale card plus Hindi/Tamil/Telugu/Marathi voice note. SAM 3.1 masks lesions to measure affected area; Muse Spark reads pesticide label dose and interval to flag overdosing. Re-measures same leaves on day 3-5 to advise respray.

summary: Chrome extension plus MCP server letting personal agents collaborate with other AI apps.
readme_summary: Connects isolated AI apps via Chrome MV3 extension and MCP stdio server in strict TypeScript. Your coding agent delegates context-aware subtasks to ChatGPT/Gemini/Muse and iterates until correct. Built as multi-LLM interoperable agent tooling for the hackathon.

summary: Multi-agent fleet team that turns ship cases into engineering and commercial briefs
readme_summary: Prototype with Fleet Manager, Engineering and Marine Superintendent agents. Manager delegates, specialists assess technical and voyage impact, then briefs. Uses Muse Wonder 1.0 and Spark 1.3 with JSON Schema outputs, capped calls.

summary: Four-agent farming helper for Nigerian farmers via text, voice and photo
readme_summary: Orchestrator routes to Knowledge, Crop Doctor, Weather and Market agents with RAG, Open-Meteo and NBS prices. Web app with voice/photo/video input. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

summary: Personal grocery agent that learns receipts and tracks prices to plan cheapest buys.
readme_summary: Python package smartpantry implements A.G.E.N.T pipeline: acquire receipts with PII redaction, gather prices via API/flyer/browser, evaluate unit prices, navigate buy/wait plan, take action behind approval. Uses Meta Muse models for receipt parsing, product matching and planning.

summary: Instant lawn quotes from satellite imagery with canopy-based pricing.
readme_summary: Node.js app segments satellite tile into lawn/evergreen/hardscape, computes serviceable area and canopy score to drive Iron & Pine pricing engine. Returns instant quote with reasoning and customer-ready copy.

summary: Live call listener that updates a deal card and writes the investment memo
readme_summary: Single HTML file plus dependency-free Python server with no database. Transcribes 10s chunks and extracts structured deal data with contradiction flags. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 and Muse Spark 1.3.

summary: Self-hosted ComfyUI studio to prompt, edit, animate, and score media
readme_summary: Open-source creative studio on self-hosted ComfyUI with 135 tools and 82 app templates. Each tool is an editable ComfyUI workflow for image, video, voice, and music on local GPU. MIT licensed, runs on 24GB GPU or Apple Silicon.

summary: Checks RPKI paperwork for announced IP blocks and explains fixes in plain language.
readme_summary: Validates single prefix-ASN pairs or all prefixes for an ASN and explains results in English and Spanish. Zero-dependency Python server serving a static frontend locally. Uses Muse Spark to generate plain-language explanations.

summary: Turns a photo or sketch into a running data-backed InSpatial app.
readme_summary: Agent pipeline: Muse Spark classifies image, SAM 3.1 segments objects for seed data, Muse Spark emits App Intent JSON, then generates InSpatial project and preview app. Uses Meta Model API with strict json_schema and build checks.

summary: Conversational builder that creates 24/7 WhatsApp agents for Latin American businesses
readme_summary: Amanece lets owners chat to build WhatsApp customer agents with rules, sections and metrics. Stack is Next.js + Drizzle + Neon with Kapso WhatsApp integration. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Models API as owner and customer agents.

summary: AI librarian that reads scores, cuts parts for iPads and syncs conductor marks live
readme_summary: Import scan or digital score, bar-numbering and per-stand part generation with live mark propagation and spoken rehearsal notes. Stack is web + iPad/TestFlight with Supabase. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0.

summary: Local bridge that turns network change webhooks into prioritized review briefings
readme_summary: Go service with embedded dashboard, SQLite storage and signed webhooks. Groups events by deterministic rules into a review inbox. Uses Muse AI for explanations of changes and next checks.

summary: Gives rural micro-entrepreneurs plain-language business health and loan guidance
readme_summary: Provides profit, risk, schemes and registration advice in 8 languages with printable report. All figures from hand-written Python rules. Meta models only parse input and draft plan text for user review.

summary: Browser WebXR space where you talk in emoji with AI fairy and avatar
readme_summary: Safe-by-design VR/AR demo that replaces open-mic voice with universal emoji, AI Q&A, and a child avatar. Runs in browser/WebXR on Meta Quest with no setup. Uses Muse Spark for dialogue and Muse Voice Transcribe.

summary: Pixel-art graveyard where you resurrect 40 dead apps in rituals
readme_summary: A browser pixel-art game where a wizard visits 40 tombstones and revives dead apps in an overlay. Built with HTML/JS on Cloudflare Pages with Kiro CLI specs. Uses Muse Spark streamed chat for Clicky and generative playables for unmarked graves.

summary: Turns live seismic telemetry into mapped areas of interest with AI briefings
readme_summary: Takes live seismic telemetry, derives areas of interest polygons, visualizes with SAM, and generates Muse Spark briefings. Separates measured, calculated, and inferred values with sources. Viewer plus GIS pipeline built for testable geophysical analysis.

summary: Waste tracking app with Flutter frontend and Python backend for reporting
readme_summary: GarbageTrack is a waste-management tracker with Flutter mobile/web client and FastAPI backend. Uses Python, MongoDB and Uvicorn stack for logging, tracking and viewing waste reports.

summary: Playable browser fab simulation with story site and video script
readme_summary: Static submission site for Fab Gym game with story, images and video script. Embeds playable browser build simulating 1,043 machines. Story text by Muse Spark and pictures by Muse Image.

summary: Neuro-symbolic math tutor with step verification and WAEC red-pen grading.
readme_summary: SolvAm is a Next.js Turborepo math tutor combining Muse Spark with FastAPI/SymPy symbolic engine for zero-hallucination steps. Uses SAM, voice and image input to diagnose WAEC answers with red-pen feedback.

summary: Custom NVFP4 MoE CUDA kernel beating SGLang Marlin top-8 routing on H200.
readme_summary: Implements a custom W4A16 routed-experts kernel for Muse MoE versus SGLang Marlin baseline. Iterates via PRs with TMA, split-K and fused SiLU optimizations, reaching 1.6x speedup on H200.

summary: Local macOS app to track jobs, resumes and applications
readme_summary: Go desktop app with local workspace and browser-mode server on port 3019. Keeps opportunities, resumes, and submission records on-device in Apple Silicon bundle. Applicant reviews and submits manually.

summary: Muse agents write and verify solvers to break open math packing records
readme_summary: Uncharted is an AI research lab where Muse Spark workers write sandboxed solver programs scored by exact verifiers. Workers review rendered solution images, while Muse Wonder acts as PI to diagnose stalls and assign directions. Achieved new verified spherical-code records.

summary: Reviews LiDAR-to-CAD drafts from renders and photos with SEND/HOLD verdicts.
readme_summary: Agent reviews station plan renders and street photos, requests extra evidence when unsure. Uses Meta Muse Spark for vision QA and returns SEND/CAVEAT/HOLD with client note. Python loop with scorer, spend guard and replay.

summary: Turns plain words into CAD parts with real geometry checks
readme_summary: Agentic CAD that drafts parametric specs with muse-spark-1.3, builds geometry in isometric viewport, then verifies collision, stability, assembly order and clearance with real math, iterating on failure.

summary: Explains ERP vs WMS inventory gaps and queues fixes for approval
readme_summary: Long-running agent for food manufacturing that reconciles synthetic ERP and WMS records, investigates drift causes, proposes fixes, and holds them in human approval queue. Dashboard demo with Python backend.

summary: Phone video of a mechanism turned into a verified MuJoCo simulation twin
readme_summary: Films a mechanism on ChArUco board, proposes parts with Muse Wonder, segments with SAM 3.1, fits joints and dynamics. Issues trust certificate for MuJoCo model with agent repair. Python CLI with uv.

summary: Self-hosted personal agent with durable event log and approval-gated actions
readme_summary: Personal AI agent with append-only event log, multi-client sync and DBOS durable execution. Model gateway with fallback and cost tracking. Uses Composio SDK and MCP for Gmail and Calendar, Muse models via gateway.

summary: Visual memory app to save photos of spaces and ask questions about them
readme_summary: Capture photos or video into rooms, gardens or garages then ask natural-language questions about objects and locations. Flutter frontend for Android, iOS and web with FastAPI backend for auth, workspaces, storage and processing.

summary: Curated gallery of 193 AI-coded motion graphics, 3D worlds and games with prompts.
readme_summary: Collection of three.js, canvas, SVG, Remotion videos generated by coding models, credited from X with prompts. Static site built via scripts/build.mjs from data/videos.json. No Meta model integration; curation resource.

summary: Voice-first Head Start family engagement with home-language audio and records
readme_summary: SproutComm connects advocates and families via per-family links with multilingual messaging and voice replies. Node HTTP server with SQLite store and Meta proxy, no-framework client. Uses Meta API for translation, TTS/STT, and documentation.

summary: Turns litter photo and location into a safety-bounded youth action plan
readme_summary: Local climate action planner that converts photo, city and text into a pack-approved measurable plan. Monorepo with apps, packages/action-packs and Supabase. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark for tool-loop, Wonder for synthesis, Image and Voice Transcribe.

summary: Benchmarks VLM robot-arm policies on 5 held-out Meta-World tasks
readme_summary: ML45 held-out benchmark asking if VLMs can drive a simulated Sawyer arm on unseen tasks. Uses corner2 camera JPEG plus end-effector state for low-level actions. Training/inference on Fireworks, simulation locally via spec and manifest.

summary: Daily tracker comparing frontier models across LMArena, Epoch AI and OpenRouter.
readme_summary: GitHub Action runs pulse.py daily to pull LMArena rankings, Epoch AI capability scores and OpenRouter serving data. It generates SVG charts and a markdown snapshot tracking rank, price and precision changes. It monitors Meta models alongside others but does not call Muse models.

summary: Debugger that records, rewinds and branches AI agent runs to verify fixes
readme_summary: Agent Time Machine records AI coding-agent tool actions and checkpoints for rewind and branching. It compares code diffs and test results across branches to catch regressions. Python backend with Node frontend, Playwright and fixture-based validation.

summary: Llama-guided thermal offload and relay across mesh of personal devices
readme_summary: On-device Rust mesh that shifts work to cool devices and piggybacks propagation. Uses thermal rules with Llama 3.2 advice, ML-KEM and ML-DSA crypto. No cloud inference with device tests and dashboard demo.

summary: Grant-call reader that answers only with quotable clauses and verified citations
readme_summary: CallReader fetches pages and attachments, sniffs bytes to avoid silent unread-as-absent errors. Uses Muse Spark vision transcription and extraction with a citation verifier that abstains without quotes. Enforces invariants for AI rules and eligibility.

summary: Replicates social deduction arena to benchmark LLM agents on strategy and calibration
readme_summary: Runs 4-agent Mafia games to compare dmn_tpn vs CoT, ReAct and constitution agents. Python eval pipeline logs to parquet and reports win-rate, ECE, Brier and say-do gap. Uses meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor via AiCredits for agents plus OpenRouter Jev.

summary: Mario agent that plays like you and predicts your brain activity
readme_summary: Muse Glimmer 30B agent learns to play Super Mario like a specific person with spoken reasoning. Encoder maps internal state to fMRI. PyTorch pipeline for virtual-participant neuroscience experiments.

summary: Agent that uses your product and auto-cuts a launch video ad.
readme_summary: Pastes product URL, agent explores via computer use, films moments and renders motion-graphics ad with original soundtrack. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 computer use on Next.js. Exports landscape, vertical and square cuts.

summary: Mobile defensive scanner that detects and quarantines AI prompt attacks
readme_summary: Client-side index.html app detects hidden prompts, homoglyphs and jailbreaks before model execution. Creates sandboxed twin fingerprint and intel report; defensive-only with no offensive actions.

summary: Ask Earth and Moon imagery questions, get masks and real-unit measurements.
readme_summary: Orbital intelligence agent for solar change and lunar landing analysis. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B for planning and vision on Modal H100 with vLLM, and SAM 3.1 on L40S for text-prompted segmentation.

summary: AI export research assistant simplifying India to US shipping for sellers
readme_summary: EaseShipping provides export research assistance for small exporters, not carrier or legal advice. Node server with client web app and MongoDB auth. Uses Meta Model API muse-spark by default when key set.

summary: Matches your challenge to past experiences with cited, evidence-grounded transfer advice
readme_summary: KIVO compares a structured situation draft against local fictional records to show what matches and transfers. Next.js + TypeScript app with Discover flow, DNA profile and Transferability Lens. Uses Muse models for clarification and server-validated grounded matching.

summary: Private Spanish personal assistant that organizes tasks with GTD and life roles.
readme_summary: Captures text and voice via Telegram, Claude or web app, clarifies with GTD and schedules by Trabajo, Artistico, Iglesia and Personal hats. Cloudflare Worker with D1, password auth and Muse Spark or Claude sorting. Deploys to agenda.juancitoads.com via browser steps.

summary: Indonesian live-chat seller agent with real order tools and transfer checks
readme_summary: Answers stock, price and order status in Indonesian via real SQLite tools. Verifies transfer screenshots, transcribes buyer voice notes, and escalates low-confidence cases for human approval.

summary: Chrome extension that poisons trackers with rotating fictional personas
readme_summary: Chrome extension that runs decoy browsing and searches as seven fictional adults to corrupt ad profiles. Built from scratch in JS with persona rotation and scheduling, designed during Meta hackathon.

summary: Shared Atlas and playbooks for consistent work across VS Code AI agents
readme_summary: VS Code folder giving Claude Code, Roo Code and opencode a shared chief-of-staff workflow with browser Atlas, digests and Jira integration. Includes MCP servers, skills, templates and toolbox scripts. Model-agnostic and works with Claude, GPT, Qwen and Muse Glimmer.

summary: Open test harness measuring if language models can act as reliable decoys.
readme_summary: Measures usable replies, latency against deadlines, fallback and failure with deterministic baseline. Reference R6 Python implementation with examples and tests. Alt variants assisted by Muse / Meta Spark 1.3.

summary: Interactive anatomy atlas with AI assistant explaining models and code.
readme_summary: Pairs particle-built anatomy and engineering models with viewer and gesture controls. Adds Explain/Engineer/Code assistant via server-side Meta Model API adapter. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 Standard via secure server proxy.

summary: Private in-browser tool that compares Instagram follower exports and explains changes
readme_summary: Unfollowly diffs two Instagram exports locally to show unfollows, new and mutual followers with search and CSV. Vite + TypeScript frontend with Node API and Instagram API counts. Sends only changed usernames to Muse Spark for pattern and spam analysis.

summary: Local AI workspace for grounded legal research and document review
readme_summary: Local Python workspace keeping chat, findings, editable review and sources together with evidence inspection. Runs on Python 3.11 local console at 127.0.0.1:8765, model investigation starts only with user key.

summary: Streamlit app extracting cosmetic labels into evidence-grounded ingredient insights.
readme_summary: Streamlit app that extracts cosmetic labels to 69-entry curated knowledge base with PubMed and PubChem evidence. API-only inference architecture with offline unit tests and modular core/UI codebase.

summary: Bangla-first AI study companion for SSC/HSC students
readme_summary: Poralekha Bondhu is a static index.html app offering Bangla tutor, question maker, study planner and photo-based explanations. Supports 16 languages with RTL. Powered by Meta AI models for curriculum Q&A and study planning.

summary: Profit investigation demo that shows fictional evidence before making inferences.
readme_summary: Public extension demoing evidence-backed profit briefings on fixed fictional data. Node client/server app offers five-scenario briefing and seven-scenario investigation with citation checks. Defaults to deterministic fixture mode with optional Meta model inference.

summary: Finds Fresno rooftop solar in aerial images and simulates output
readme_summary: Detects rooftop solar arrays in Fresno aerial imagery with zero-shot SAM 3.1 prompting, simulates hourly production with pvlib, and visualizes city-wide output in a 3D map with film mode. No training data.

summary: Plan-Act-Observe agent with guardrails and console for prescription sourcing
readme_summary: Autonomous Plan-Act-Observe loop with 25-turn budget, tool calling and JSONL persistence. FastAPI supervision console with pharmacist sign-off gate. Uses Meta Llama via OpenAI-compatible client for medical prescription reconciliation.

summary: Turns scattered construction documents into hash-chained trusted project record.
readme_summary: Demo extracts four synthetic site documents into structured verified fields for off-plan buyers. Node server plus src UI with hash-chaining, permissioning and source citations. Uses Muse Spark via NanoGPT or Meta Model API for extraction.

summary: Compares before-and-after photos to list what you packed and what is missing.
readme_summary: WorldLens turns two photos into a verified pack and return checklist with evidence and confidence. Built with Streamlit and Python, it uses Muse Spark via Baseten for item detection and comparison.

summary: Infinite spatial canvas with AI Q&A and voice pipeline
readme_summary: Single-user visual workspace with spatial board, cards, checklists and audio understanding. Express + Vite + React with Postgres. Uses muse-wonder-1.0, muse-image-1.0 and voice-transcribe with Gemini fallback.

summary: Voice orders turn product photos into promo visuals on shop TVs
readme_summary: Baba Time lets shop owners speak a promo and show it on store screens. Next.js app uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech, Muse Spark agent with tools, SAM 3.1 for cutout and Muse Image for backgrounds.

summary: Floating cat pet that flags scams, calls and risky apps offline
readme_summary: Android guardian pet with floating cat UI that scans permissions, SMS, calls and links fully offline. Kotlin app with on-device ML scoring. Uses opt-in Muse Spark only to explain alerts in plain language.

summary: Meta API layer explaining paper trades in plain words
readme_summary: Integration layer connecting InsideTraders paper-trading education product to Meta hosted models API. Product runs four $30k paper lanes with fixed rules and plain-language explanations. Repo contains only the Meta Model API client, not trading engine.

summary: Turns course note photos into courses, flashcards and daily revision plans
readme_summary: Tempo revision app: snaps course notes, adds exam dates, generates courses, flashcards and quizzes. Plans 15 minutes revision daily and rebuilds on missed days. Next.js frontend powered by Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API.

summary: Homework helper turning photos of questions into visual play
readme_summary: Local web app for Grade 8-12 that solves photographed or typed questions with worked steps and interactive visuals. Python backend. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta API for real photos and unfamiliar questions.

summary: AR guide that sees your workspace and highlights parts step by step as you build.
readme_summary: Holo uses Muse Spark Open in server.py for planning, step tracking and web search from camera frames. SAM 3.1 does text-prompted segmentation and tracking, DINOv3 pools features for part identity. Unity client renders highlights and 3D STL models.

summary: Local study library turning recordings and docs into source-linked lessons.
readme_summary: Local open-source study workspace that creates chapters, subtitles, practice and concepts from user files. Web client with Node server and shared code. Uses Meta Model API with BYO key plus optional tutor web search.

summary: Open-world macOS dragon simulator where you guard a hoard from thieves
readme_summary: Playable Unreal editor build with rigged dragon, flight, fire breath, scent system and thief AI in a mountain lair. Built with Unreal Engine, Niagara, Meshy assets for Apple Silicon. Indie game entry with data-driven gameplay tuning.

summary: Demo dental CRM with tooth chart, billing and X-ray segmentation viewer
readme_summary: Next.js clinic CRM demo with appointments, patients, treatments, invoices and recall lists. X-ray upload runs SAM 3.1 segmentation to overlay tooth masks for planning.

summary: Turns creator video uploads into SEO articles with embeds and forum discussion
readme_summary: SABA converts direct video uploads into SEO-ready articles with JSON-LD schema and official embeds. Stack is Flutter forum app, Next.js SSR/ISR web site, and workers for transcoding. Uses Meta AI models for transcription and article generation.

summary: iPad pencil notebook where handwritten questions and boxes get AI answers and diagrams.
readme_summary: Native iPadOS notebook for Apple Pencil thinkers that answers handwritten ? prompts and fills drawn boxes with diagrams. Built with XcodeGen SwiftUI app plus validation tools. Uses Meta Muse models for handwriting understanding and sketch generation.

summary: Local-first desktop harness for running multi-agent coding workflows
readme_summary: Electron + SolidJS desktop app with Bun and TypeScript monorepo, SQLite ledger for agent runs. Local-first multi-agent coding harness built during hackathon with docs in English and Spanish.

summary: Personal super-intelligence companion app built on Next.js and Supabase.
readme_summary: Tomo is a personal AI companion web app carrying super intelligence with the user. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase and Playwright e2e tests, deployed on Vercel. Uses Meta AI models for conversational assistance.

summary: Voice-first marketplace for buying and selling without typing
readme_summary: Salmart Intelligence adds a voice layer to an existing marketplace app. Users register, search products, manage cart and checkout, and chat sellers by voice, using Llama voice agent backend on Render with a mobile client and live Play Store build.

summary: User-mode SPARC V9 binary translator running big-endian ELF on AArch64 Linux
readme_summary: Static-PIE translator for SPARC V9 Linux ELFs on AArch64. Provides a C11 reference interpreter and a default AArch64 DBT engine with direct mapping. Targets Oracle M8 and Fujitsu CPUs with no external dependencies.

summary: Shared canvas where people and AI agents explore and revise ideas together
readme_summary: Real-time shared canvas for collaborative ideation with people and AI agents. Stack is Vite client with Cloudflare Worker backend and shared types. Uses Meta AI developer API via MODEL_API_KEY for agent assistance.

summary: Five-agent team that researches, plans, writes, and reviews brand content
readme_summary: Ripple_handoff runs five specialized agents to do small-agency product communication. Node monorepo with packages. Uses Meta Model API Responses for field watch, numbers analysis, proposals, writing, and review.

summary: Intent-driven browser that organizes tabs into recoverable activity workspaces
readme_summary: Lightweight Electron browser that organizes activities not tabs. AI agent groups tabs by goal, restores workspaces, and keeps checkpoints in Memory. Built with Electron Vite, TypeScript renderer, and local agent in agent/core.

summary: Verifies water-hyacinth coverage in Endho Reservoir from satellites
readme_summary: Deterministic Sentinel-2 pipeline with two-stage GMM, quality traffic light and hydrology correction for reproducible coverage figures. Python uv CLI built with Muse Code, Frontier verification planned.

summary: Multi-signal checker for trading-card authenticity that can answer inconclusive.
readme_summary: Combines identity lookup, front/back pixel tells, set-symbol check and model reads in agent loop. Demo is SAMPLE-labelled after Oct 28 calibration gate fail. Uses Muse Spark/Wonder reads for verification with evidence ledgers.

summary: cBioPortal copilot answering cancer variant questions with cited evidence
readme_summary: Adds Ask Muse copilot to cBioPortal patient view with PubMed evidence and tissue mapping. Includes AlphaGenome variant-effect pipeline with liftover for Genome Nexus. Uses Muse Wonder for Q&A and notebook generation.

summary: TypeScript monorepo web app, API and worker with pluggable Meta AI provider
readme_summary: Next.js web app with Express API and background worker backed by MongoDB transactions. pnpm monorepo with mock provider for local dev. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Wonder models when EVIANTA_AI_PROVIDER=muse with enforced usage limits.

summary: Helps robots learn and navigate unseen spaces from one walkthrough
readme_summary: Builds spatial intelligence from a single camera walkthrough for robot navigation in unseen environments. Next.js/TypeScript app with cloud components focused on efficient physical AI.

summary: 10-turn branching game where you play an AI agent surviving security audits
readme_summary: Browser choose-your-own-adventure simulation roleplaying as CHAD, an autonomous coding agent shipping code under compliance pressure. Static web app with branching narrative and cybersecurity lessons. Deployed to GitHub Pages.

summary: Registers pets, identifies them by photo scan, and hosts lost-found alerts
readme_summary: React + Vite frontend with Express + Sequelize/MySQL backend for pet registration and lost-found subscriptions. Uses Meta AI SAM 3.1 via POST /api/animals/scan to match uploaded photos with stored uploads.

summary: Visual manga planner for tension curves and text storyboard briefs
readme_summary: StoryDAW Mini is a DAW-style single-screen app for Ki-Sho-Ten-Ketsu plotting with tension sliders and World Lock. It uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Cloudflare Workers to generate text-only panel briefs with camera and dialogue. Stack is Vite + TypeScript.

summary: Objective-aware guard that blocks agents evading denials via tool switching.
readme_summary: IntentFence cybersecurity copilot compares stateless policy vs objective-aware guard for denied sensitive ops. Detects replanning across tools, views or delegation. Prototype hosted as Vercel demo with docs and API.

summary: Privacy-preserving election research prototype with fictional voters and votes
readme_summary: Monorepo with Express Mongoose API with in-memory fallback and React Vite Tailwind Mantine frontend. Demonstrates private digital voting flows for hackathon research only. Uses Meta AI for architecture assistance; not production election software.

summary: Triages customer enquiries and drafts ready-to-send follow-up replies
readme_summary: Helps small service businesses triage enquiries with next action and draft response. Node/Express backend with web UI and /api/analyze-enquiry returning structured JSON. Uses Meta AI for missing-info detection and human-review flagging.

summary: Kiswahili-first offline motorcycle and workplace safety lessons
readme_summary: Free bilingual safety lessons with pictures, TTS audio, quizzes and voice grading. Static site with offline support plus ERP API. Uses Meta AI for Kiswahili voice Q&A grading, built with Muse Code.

summary: Zero-dependency panel showing token cost and runtime stats for DSH sessions
readme_summary: Adds a sidebar usage dashboard for DSH Web with token usage, cost estimates, session counts, and runtime sampling. Built with vanilla JS and hand-written SVG/CSS, no third-party deps. No Meta model use; it is local developer infra for monitoring model sessions.

summary: Linux desktop where voice assistant sees screen and acts across apps
readme_summary: Embeds assistant Muse into Linux OS with push-to-talk, screen overlays, and cross-app actions via accessibility APIs. Custom desktop code connects to models with local voice output. Uses Meta Muse models via Meta Model API for reasoning and voice transcription.

summary: Predicts scene-by-scene audience reaction before release.
readme_summary: ViChitra scores film cuts to surface weak scenes without test screenings. Python pipeline cuts clips, collects ratings and predicts reaction via Muse API, with app.py, score_clips.py and evaluation scripts.

summary: Governed desktop agent bridge with approval queue and audit log
readme_summary: Lets an AI agent work on user PC via Muse Spark JSON plans with read-auto and sensitive-approval classification. Executor runs only allowed actions, records hash-chained audit log with viewer. Synthetic demo data and installer included.

summary: Verifier that locates first wrong step and faulty sublayer in weight-compiled computers
readme_summary: Targets silent corruption in Neural Computers compiled into transformer weights. Compares execution against expected steps to find first error and layer. Built with Muse Spark 1.3, Python referee package, demos and experiments.

summary: Reasoning API combining symbolic logic and neural model with inspectable proofs

summary: Monthly hearing self-test that tracks per-ear thresholds against your history
readme_summary: Single-file hearing self-test for adults 20-80 that measures per-pitch per-ear thresholds and overlays history to show drift. Runs as static hearing_history_lab.html in Chrome. No Meta AI integration described; relative self-tracking, non-clinical.

summary: Turns restaurant menu photos into finished Instagram Reels via WhatsApp

summary: Android app that scores website accessibility and suggests code fixes
readme_summary: Native Android app that audits URLs for missing alt text, contrast and form labels, scoring 0-100 with marked-up preview. Built in Kotlin/Gradle during hackathon. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for plain-words verdicts and per-issue fixes.

summary: Web app that matches users to the best vehicle to purchase
readme_summary: DriveMatch is a Node.js + SQLite web app with planner, vision, and marketplace modules. Frontend in HTML/CSS/JS, backend in server.js. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for personalized recommendations and vision-based vehicle analysis.

summary: Investigates image provenance across real, generated, and inpainted edits
readme_summary: Analyzes images for camera authenticity versus diffusion, GAN and inpainting traces. Full-stack app with backend, frontend, scripts and sample images. Uses Meta vision models and Muse reasoning for forensic explanation.

summary: Voice-driven tutor that detects misconceptions and shows manipulable counter-proofs.

summary: Turns runtime failures into explainable, verified fixes with tests

summary: Playable 3D Godot office sandbox with routines and physics chaos

summary: Multimodal repair assistant that diagnoses phones and PCs from photos and video.

summary: Co-parenting AI coach that drafts calm messages grounded in your parenting plan.

readme_summary: NextStep helps students discover opportunities and prepare applications. Stack is React TypeScript Tailwind frontend, ASP.NET Core backend with MySQL, plus an ai/dotnet client. Uses Meta AI for eligibility checks, evaluation and preparation orchestration.

summary: VS Code chat companion that remembers you and resumes Muse coding sessions.

summary: Voice-driven kitchen HUD that watches pans for portions, prep and waste

summary: Double-blind introductions through shared questions, not profiles.

summary: Turns lecture PDFs, whiteboards and voice memos into study notes

summary: Mixed-reality Quest places to focus and unwind with talking AI companions.

summary: Photos a non-booting machine screen and returns what failed and what to run next.

summary: Bilingual multi-agent debate tool for mining, farming and climate decisions

summary: Llama proposes game plans while a deterministic simulator verifies every step.

summary: Market app linking trader stock logging to nearby buyer search
readme_summary: Next.js frontend and backend with PostgreSQL inventory for shops and location search, demoed on Kubwa shops. Uses Meta models for assisted stock logging and product discovery.

summary: Data-backed SEO niche finder that proves winnable website ideas
readme_summary: Niche Scout AI is a research agent that finds low-competition SEO niches with hard data and verdicts. Node.js ESM agent pipeline with caching and provenance, using Muse Spark to explain the call and plan the build.

summary: AI film production platform for college creators covering full workflow
readme_summary: Static HTML showcase for Jintai AI film platform aimed at Hebei Communication College teachers and students. Describes local GPU cluster, Jintai 1-3 model routing, 812 directing skills, asset library and MCP/CLI automation pipeline.

summary: Static site comparing 32 open-weight LLMs at config and training depth.
readme_summary: Documents layer layout, attention, MoE routing, token budgets, data mixes, RL and benchmarks. Includes Muse Spark Open and Glimmer 30B among 32 models. Standalone static site with no backend, built from data files and scripts.

summary: Live meeting companion that transcribes and surfaces insight cards unprompted
readme_summary: ProActive Assistant transcribes meetings live with Muse Voice Transcribe and diarization. Muse Wonder watches transcripts to explain jargon, flag claims and capture decisions. Exports summaries and action items as Markdown, built for web with demo mode.

summary: Autonomous coding workflow that plans, builds and reviews code.
readme_summary: Portable T3 Code skill where a lead coordinates planning, implementation and adversarial review. Discovers test instructions and picks models per role from live catalog. No fixed provider IDs, includes tests.

summary: Shared consented memory trees for humans and Muse agents.
readme_summary: Bilateral Human Tree and Agent Tree with Consent Grove lighting only on mutual accept. Live Muse Spark 1.3 chat with voice input/output. Append-only hash-chained events persisted in Cloudflare D1.

summary: Turns photos of handwritten trader credit notebooks into reviewable ledger entries
readme_summary: Ledger app for Ghanaian cereal traders tracks cash advances, maize repayments and buyer credit. Muse Spark reads notebook page photos, matches names to open advances and proposes entries for trader approval. Client/server app with demo photos and screenshots.

summary: Checks share-comment claims against cited sources before Facebook sharing.
readme_summary: Reader reviews Muse Spark findings, edits wording, then shares story. Defines findings contract and Model API transport with stubbed tests. Supabase project, verified only READY via Muse Wonder CLI, no live verdict claimed.

summary: WhatsApp voice sous-chef that saves family recipes and cooks along hands-free
readme_summary: WhatsApp voice notes transcribed then structured by Meta Llama into recipes with folk-to-metric measures. Docker setup with Asterisk gateway plus worker; calls back to guide cooking step-by-step by voice.

summary: Dashboard tracking coding agents across machines showing stuck or waiting states
readme_summary: Control board listing coding agent windows across computers and projects with working, stuck, or needs-you status. Built in Rust with mobile client, Docker, and Baseten/Modal backends. Built with Muse Meta models for agent state reasoning and summaries.

summary: Paper-trading council that deliberates live with verification and risk gates.
readme_summary: Single-page app with Python stdlib server running council sessions and gate checks live. Risk and portfolio views render timestamped read-only snapshots. No external dependencies, localhost-only demo.

summary: Pixel MMORPG where restaurants own dungeons and food boosts power
readme_summary: Top-down Phaser 3 MMORPG fused with restaurant partner platform and per-restaurant AI agents. Uses Node.js + Socket.IO realtime, MongoDB Atlas, with Meta Muse powering AI hosts and quests.

summary: macOS timeline editor to schedule and approve multi-agent coding tasks
readme_summary: Each AI agent gets a timeline track to view progress, queue instructions after current turn and cut them. Approval gate for operations like git push. Built with Rust crates, Electron frontend and services layer.

summary: Generates rule-checked house concepts from real Hesse parcel geodata and text.

summary: Product list to shareable storefront with WhatsApp checkout

summary: Phone video of pendulum experiment becomes verified gravity measurement with uncertainty.

readme_summary: App accepts pasted text or screenshots and returns Likely Scam, Be Careful or Looks OK with red flags and next steps. Built with Python FastAPI and rules.py plus muse-spark via Meta API, with demo mode and AARP helpline info.

summary: AI marking, feedback, practice and exam import for EduPath school platform
readme_summary: Hackathon-only repo adding Muse Spark Standard features via Cloudflare Worker proxy. Implements AI theory marking drafts, feedback comments, practice generation and bulk exam import; pre-existing app excluded.

summary: WhatsApp sales assistant for Indonesian shops with QRIS checkout
readme_summary: AI sales assistant over WhatsApp for Indonesian UMKM. Reads live catalog, answers in everyday language, compares products and builds structured orders with QRIS payment links. Python src with demo script.

summary: Read-only pipeline fixer that proposes repairs for human approval
readme_summary: Self-healing data pipeline agent for failed loads. All tool calls go through a read-only gateway enforcing propose-only access against prompt injection. Currently design docs; code lands during build period.

summary: Stress-test harness that probes AI science verifiers with physics variants
readme_summary: Harness that preserves physical predictions while changing representation to measure missed errors and false alarms. Python package with run.py, spectral-gap case study, and reproducibility docs. Tests Muse Spark and Wonder verifiers with checkpoints.

summary: Uncertainty-aware navigation agent that recovers from failures
readme_summary: Autonomous navigation and recovery agent that diagnoses failures, scores actions and verifies outcomes. Python with PyBullet and A* pathfinding. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API for reasoning with visual evidence.

summary: Reproduces Python bugs, requests a Muse fix, and re-runs the same tests.

summary: Tamil voice helper that ranks crops by profit range, risk, and water need.
