summary: Zig agent gathering news and SEC filings into evidence-linked market posts
readme_summary: Research and publishing service polling TradingView News Flow and SEC filings for ticker context. Uses muse-spark-1.3-contributor via Meta API for drafting and Baseten muse-spark-open for review. Zig service with Python extraction.

summary: Highly configurable cross-platform clipboard manager
readme_summary: Highly configurable cross-platform clipboard manager

readme_summary: Maps modules to islands and files to buildings, imports to bridges, with CRUD agent quests and plain-English reports. Client + server prototype architecture. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for agent orchestration.

readme_summary: ClaimWatch research agent built for Indie track to verify claims with sources. Repo shows automation, eval and agent orchestration scaffolding. Uses Muse models for research and self-verification workflow.

readme_summary: User-mode static-PIE binary translator for PowerPC 750/RAD750 and e500v2 SPE ELFs on AArch64 Linux and macOS. Provides C11 interpreter oracle and DBT engine with 4GiB window and profile auto-detection.

readme_summary: User-mode static-PIE translator for MIPS64r2 little/big-endian N64 and N32 ELFs on AArch64 Linux and macOS. Includes portable C11 reference interpreter and DBT engine with 1TiB/2GiB address space handling.

summary: Zero-dependency SPARC V8 Linux binary translator for AArch64
readme_summary: User-mode static-PIE translator for SPARC V8 LEON3/LEON4 ELFs on AArch64 Linux and macOS. Offers C11 interpreter oracle and direct-mapped DBT with strict EM_SPARC admission and 4GiB window.

summary: CPU-first modular learner testing skill reuse and continual learning
readme_summary: Compact research system explores learning, retention, and transfer on unseen task combinations with Meta-designed curriculum. CPU-first Python experiments with runs, prereg, and logs. Concept demos for robotics and inspection.

summary: Zero-dependency MIPS32r2 binary translator for AArch64 Linux
readme_summary: Static-PIE user-mode translator for MIPS32 LE/BE O32 ELF on AArch64 Linux and macOS via hyper-linux. Dual engines with C11 interpreter oracle and JIT, Nix and Make builds. No Meta AI integration evident.

summary: Zero-dependency LoongArch64 Linux binary translator for AArch64 hosts
readme_summary: loongarch64rt runs LoongArch LP64D ELF binaries on AArch64 Linux and macOS via interpreter and DBT engines. Written in portable C11 with static-PIE musl build, Make/Nix flake and differential tests. No Meta AI integration in tree.

summary: Receipt photo updates shopping lists, prices, budgets and weekly plans
readme_summary: Firebase Cloud Function proxy validates Firebase token, quota and forwards to Meta Model API, logging only calls. Client library handles receipt reading, auto-filing and list planning. Built on Meta Muse models.

summary: Unity story game where an AI drone companion talks, sees, and remembers
readme_summary: The Last Light is a third-person Unity game set in Shelter 7 where Spark, a caretaker drone, is played by Muse Spark. It supports voice/text dialogue, vision of the scene, memory, physics tasks and holograms. Built with Unity + Meta Muse Spark integration.

summary: Private Mac studio to generate and organize AI images in full quality
readme_summary: Private local image studio that runs on Mac with searchable library. Generates via WaveSpeed or Atlas Cloud using Nano Banana Pro, Seedream and Wan models. Installed via script with PostgreSQL backend.

summary: Empty static starter for community feed, briefing and archive with no preset data.
readme_summary: Six-tab static app with Live Feed, Submit, Weekly Briefing and replay views that fill only through use. Runs directly from file:// with localStorage persistence. Demo is the submission; this 1.0 has no users or AI data.

summary: Chat-driven home design workspace with traceable 3D model and review exports
readme_summary: Homeowner workspace built around an authoritative Python building model with studio, walls, stairs and dimensioned plans. FastAPI + Next.js with SQLite/Postgres and Docker Compose deploy. Uses Meta AI for conversational edits and revision-specific review drafts.

summary: Phenotype-first workbench linking traits to evidence and study outlines
readme_summary: Biological research workbench organizing traits, evidence packs and study briefs. Local demo-first website with saved replies, provenance and cost tracking. Planned inference via Meta Muse Model API.

summary: Checks if proposed agent handoffs fit explicitly declared permission scopes
readme_summary: Browser prototype with synthetic invoice scenarios and deterministic scope checks. Uses server-side Cloudflare Workers AI Llama binding for proposals, with mock D1, hashed sessions and tests.

summary: WhatsApp voice-note to professional PDF quote assistant for artisans.
readme_summary: DevisVocal converts artisan voice notes into priced PDF quotes via WhatsApp. Built with Next.js, Supabase and TypeScript. Uses Meta Muse models for transcription and quote generation.

summary: Goal-based macOS browser gives AI agents a permission-controlled workspace.
readme_summary: macOS Tauri browser organized around goals where AIP allows, approves or blocks agent actions and Guard logs risks. Built with TypeScript, Rust, Python 3.12 and Playwright Chromium; active prototype with real and experimental fixtures.

summary: Sound-and-touch math tutor that reads whiteboards and checks work for blind students
readme_summary: FollowMath AI helps visually impaired students follow whiteboard equations and verify work via audio and touch. Built with a custom real-time WebSocket backend and dual-device architecture, it uses SAM 3.1 for board capture, Muse Spark for reasoning, and Muse Transcribe for voice.

summary: Pocket voice gadget that answers aloud with cards and images on display
readme_summary: Pocket Muse is a round-display device: press button, speak, get voice plus visuals. Brain service handles weather, gold prices and image generation. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for Indie Build for Your World entry.

summary: Turns support FAQs into tested voice menus that staff can review and repair
readme_summary: FrontierBase ARS converts spreadsheets and policy FAQs into voice menus, checks routes and repairs drafts before staff review. Stack is Vue 3 console, Vite widget, Node.js 22 and Firebase, using Meta Muse Spark 1.3 and ElevenLabs for voice.

summary: Static marketing landing page for ConsensFlow AI coding-agent factory app
readme_summary: Marketing site for ConsensFlow desktop app where a Chief of Staff plans work for AI coding agents. Zero-build stack: single self-contained index.html with inline CSS and vanilla JS, no framework or CDN. No direct Muse model integration; promotes use with Claude Code, Codex, Muse Code.

summary: Personal portfolio chatbot site backed by Muse Wonder serverless API
readme_summary: Public index.html chat site calling POST /api/chat with fallback answers. Vercel Node function calls Meta API muse-wonder-1.0 with system prompt rules, spend cap and environment-key configuration.

summary: Turns leader exit interviews into cited day-one playbooks successors can query
readme_summary: Handoff converts voice/text exit interviews into a claim-cited playbook using transcript turns. Built with Next.js with sample Northline Labs fixtures and no API call for demo load. Uses Meta API to generate playbook and abstain on uncovered topics.

summary: Offline demo that links changing trade documents to revised decisions
readme_summary: Deterministic evidence engine verifies synthetic sources, tracks obligations and reranks missing evidence. Static docs site with Python offline tests, WebCrypto verification. Muse Spark 1.3 used only for prior authorized text extraction.

summary: Turns Thai-English slides into summaries, quizzes and flashcards
readme_summary: Uploads PDF slides to produce bilingual Thai-English summaries, glossaries, 10-question quizzes and flashcards linked to source slides. Python app with static frontend. Uses Muse Spark on Meta Model API to read pages including tables and diagrams.

summary: Serves Muse Glimmer 30B locally on Apple Silicon via Metal
readme_summary: Local OpenAI-compatible server for Muse-Glimmer-30B ExecuTorch PTE on macOS Apple Silicon. Install via pip, pull model, serve on 127.0.0.1:8000 with Rust crates and Python backend. Supports launching Muse agent without API key.

summary: Converts supplier invoices and statements into validated accounting ledgers
readme_summary: Ingests PDF/photo invoices and extracts vendor, line items, VAT and totals using SAM 3.1 for regions and Muse for handwriting. Python validator checks arithmetic like discounts and advances before ledger export.

summary: Phone copilot that predicts what a physical structure will do before change
readme_summary: ForeSight prototype in laplace-mvp combines live camera, SAM 3.1 vision, Muse transcription and QA, operator-confirmed block model and static calculation with 3D replay. Predictions lock before trials for comparison.

summary: Zoning and home design tool with editable plans and walkthrough
readme_summary: Extracts housing research with SAM 3.1 photo selection, Muse Image illustration with provenance, editable floor-plan viewers and first-person walkthrough. Includes NYC address resolution and IFC intake. Live calls need MODEL_API_KEY, tests use stubs.

summary: Camera and voice meal companion helping kidney patients document dishes.
readme_summary: Next.js PWA that segments dishes with SAM 3.1 and identifies foods with Muse Spark. Provides cited nutrient literacy, documentation-only with no medical advice enforced. Focused on Southeast Asian diets for CKD patients.

summary: Interactive 3D landscape to explore clients, operations and growth flows
readme_summary: Full-screen Three.js scene where business entities are vessels and platforms with orbit, pan and route-follow interactions. Vite + TypeScript frontend with worker backend. Meta Muse Spark assisted development; optional server Meta endpoint.

summary: Cited retail assistant answering inventory questions from store documents
readme_summary: FastAPI app with POST /ask that answers retail ops questions with verbatim citations. Hybrid BM25 plus TF-IDF retrieval with reranking in pure Python, simple web UI. Uses Muse models via meta_client for grounded answering.

summary: Local-first Android life tracker with voice agent that logs habits, meals, workouts and expenses.
readme_summary: Local-first Android app built with Expo/React Native and SQLite via Drizzle. Ally voice agent uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech-to-text and Muse Spark 1.3/1.2 with parallel tool calls to write to the local DB, plus Spark vision to log receipts.

summary: Audits ad diversity like Andromeda and generates new ad variants
readme_summary: Agent reads ads with Muse Spark 1.3 vision to group concepts, score diversity and map angle x format gaps. Segments product with SAM 3.1 then evolves 12 candidates with Muse Image edits. Muse Spark re-scores for reach.

summary: Milestone life planner that projects savings timelines with AI explanations
readme_summary: Households set milestones like wedding or home payment; deterministic engine projects dates from savings rate. Muse Spark via Meta Model API only explains numbers. Nuxt 4 + Drizzle standalone repo.

summary: Turns real food photos into 3D previews with TruthScore for ordering
readme_summary: Creates rotatable true-scale 3D dishes from customer photos with evidence strip and TruthScore. Next.js frontend with Modal 3D backend, cached instant models and conversational spatial Q&A.

summary: Appliance repair copilot that diagnoses photos and guides the fix
readme_summary: SnapFix diagnoses appliance photos or video with Muse Spark, highlights the faulty part with verified SAM 3.1 masks. Python app builds verdict, parts buy card and step-by-step illustrated guidance.

summary: Browser yoga coach that guides poses hands-free with skeleton view and voice
readme_summary: Muse Yoga creates asana step sequences and checks poses via in-browser MediaPipe skeleton view with spoken guidance. Privacy-first design blurs photos on-device and never shows camera feed. Uses Meta AI for asana generation with Web Speech for hands-free control.

summary: Scoped pentest agent that only reports vulnerabilities with proven exploits
readme_summary: Autonomous agent driven by muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API that hypothesizes and tests HTTP exploits. Deny-by-default scope.yaml allowlist enforced in code, findings require reproducible request/response. Python agent with core, demo and docs.

summary: Offline document Q&A that loads 200 pages into local Muse Glimmer with verified quotes.
readme_summary: Loads up to 100K tokens into Meta Muse Glimmer 30B on a single 16GB GPU with no RAG or uploads. Answers with word-for-word verified quotes, page references, and honest abstention when info is missing.

summary: Simulated 60-second AI text-back and booking flow for missed contractor calls
readme_summary: Python stdlib http.server demo with no dependencies or API key required. Simulates missed-call detection, AI qualification chat, appointment booking and timestamped customer record via local outbox and web view.

summary: Marketplace where Muse scores ideas and creates previews that hide details
readme_summary: Marketplace for selling documented ideas others won't build. Uses Next.js + Supabase with a 3-pass Muse Spark 1.3 pipeline: grounded web-search originality research, schema-enforced scoring and preview generation, then heading creation.

summary: Serves and fine-tunes Gemma, Qwen and Muse Glimmer models on Modal GPUs
readme_summary: Four self-contained projects for serving Gemma 4, Qwen and Muse Glimmer with SGLang and vLLM. Runs on Modal for solo and concurrent agentic-coding workloads with BYO-cloud support. Includes fine-tuning and speculative decoding setups.

summary: Read-only MCP server linking Nicaraguan shop data to AI assistants
readme_summary: TypeScript MCP server exposing 10 read-only tools for Nortex SaaS invoicing, inventory and payroll. Per-business revocable tokens, Spanish voseo voice-ready answers. Connects assistants to Nortex over HTTP; platform itself is proprietary.

summary: Stations-first marketplace to discover, book, and commission live broadcast feeds
readme_summary: Stations-first marketplace where stations discover and book live feeds, tower cams, and event production. Built with Python standard library only plus static public frontend, with server.py routing roles, bookings, and expenses. No explicit Meta AI integration described in README.

summary: Simulated nested sandbox where attackers and defenders train a fleet playbook
readme_summary: Fully simulated red-team vs blue-team sandbox where outer monitor hardens and shares lessons globally. Fleet clones deploy on-demand defenders paid per hold. Python agent loop with marketplace and dashboard, Meta hackathon Push the Frontier entry.

summary: Explains failed debugging attempts in a practice app with coach-style AI feedback
readme_summary: Muse Fix Review extension for BugGym with 74 server-graded problems in 4 languages. When hidden tests fail, Muse Spark Open on Baseten reviews the attempt via POST /api/review. Next.js UI shows explanation in FixReview component.

summary: Contract-first multi-agent squad that turns epics into tested production code
readme_summary: Enforces contract-first development where Muse Wonder locks interfaces in contracts.py and schedules a DAG. Muse Spark workers implement code and pytest suites concurrently. Modal micro-VMs verify builds with self-repair loops.

summary: AI exam prep platform for TYT, AYT, SAT and ACT with adaptive practice
readme_summary: PHP platform with student-teacher roles, adaptive levels, AI question generation, wrong-notebook and spaced repetition. Provides AI teacher, coach, study plans and XP classrooms. Supports Turkish and English UI.

summary: Benchmarks 16 LLMs on 55 TIS-100 puzzles with 3,714 frontier programs
readme_summary: Evaluation release where 16 LLMs played 47 TIS-100 puzzles plus 8 community puzzles, finding 133 new Pareto points. Dataset of programs and scores in CSV plus Hugging Face version. LLM benchmark study, no Meta Muse model construction.

summary: Tests Muse-proposed algorithms in isolation and stores proof with evidence
readme_summary: Local lab that preserves Muse Spark proposals, executes them under OS isolation and scores against Python references. Includes DAG scheduler verifier with rational arithmetic. Stores passes, failures and counterexamples reproducibly.

summary: Checks lab videos against protocols and writes evidence-linked notebooks.
readme_summary: Watches lab experiment video and measures color/motion with OpenCV to detect additions, stirring and color changes. Compares events to the written protocol, then uses Muse Glimmer vision to draft a cited HTML notebook. Citation checker drops unsupported claims.

summary: Ranks creator photos and generates AI head-and-shoulders avatars for ads.
readme_summary: Runnable slice of Amplify brand-creator marketplace covering avatar generation only. Two-step Meta pipeline ranks 1-8 training photos with Muse Spark then generates avatar. Marketplace, payments and Instagram integration remain private.

summary: Interactive brain MRI annotation with prompt-guided segmentation
readme_summary: React workspace with FastAPI proxy to Meta SAM 3.1. Upload MRI slice, prompt with text, points or box, inspect mask. Research prototype only, not clinically validated.

summary: Travel research board that saves venues as map pins and pocket guide pages
readme_summary: Atlas keeps map pins, sources and itinerary together around Venice venues. Self-contained Node 24 demo with Explore board and walkthrough video. Uses Meta models to research places and build savable guides.

summary: AI hiring shortlist assistant that replays a Muse recommendation
readme_summary: Demo package extracted from SunuTalent for recruiting workflows. Replays recorded muse-spark-1.3 shortlist decisions via Node runner and web UI. Production agent remains closed, no live API call by default.

summary: Upload piano video to get scored fixes, demos, and practice plan
readme_summary: Museverse Teacher analyzes uploaded piano performance against the score to name errors and show corrections. Web frontend calls server API that invokes Meta models for lesson generation. Measuring pipeline runs server-side; demo GIF and live Vercel site included.

summary: Muse plans phase scans while SAM validates droplet images in loop
readme_summary: PhasePilot closes the loop on PhaseScan microfluidics by selecting next conditions with Muse. Segment Anything checks every droplet image before results count, with Bayesian planner updating phase map. Includes dashboard, live loop, and demo video.

summary: Sixteen ESP32 display nodes form a swarm testbed for distributed agent experiments.
readme_summary: Sixteen ESP32-S3 RGB panels act as independent swarm bodies with local or remote brains. ESP32 Korvo controller hosts web controls, planner and experiment lab. Built with Meta Muse Spark/Wonder models for direction and learning experiments.

summary: One-click LAN hub controlling studio lights, OBS scenes and backdrop screens
readme_summary: TWOC Studio Hub drives zone power, DMX/BLE/IR lights, OBS scenes and backdrop screens from one web UI on Raspberry Pi or Windows host. It adds AI lighting director with voice prompts, undo log and health watchdog. Uses AI models for lighting look generation.

summary: Covers sports betting markets with models and a public win-loss ledger
readme_summary: Sports betting journalism desk reporting model vs market disagreement with complete graded record. Repo holds analyst models, sims, podcasts, runbooks and mirror. Focus on line movement coverage and transparent tracking over picks selling.

summary: Checks Bitbucket PRs to decide if they can skip full code review
readme_summary: Reads Bitbucket Cloud PRs via API and applies five size and risk rules. Prints PASS/FAIL per rule and exits with pipeline-actionable code. Node.js TypeScript CLI with tests and docs.

summary: Wearable finger clips for typing on any surface with one hand
readme_summary: One-hand wearable text input prototype with finger-clip firmware and host software. Validates clicky wearable typing for glasses-era computing; includes firmware, host code, and feasibility worklog.

summary: Local map lab that reproduces papers and grades how far results can be trusted
readme_summary: Local web app in apps/lab with satellite maps, SAM 3.1 segmentation, CHMv2 canopy analysis and paper knowledge base. Muse via Meta Model API controls map and supports reproduction workflow.

summary: Personal agent fleet for mail, leads and notes with cost tracking
readme_summary: Working fleet on one server triaging mail, scoring leads and checking notes under approval gates. Hackathon rebuild swaps model layer to Meta models to measure cost, latency and verdicts with public dashboard.

summary: Staged FastAPI Teamboard demo for testing the Unbidden AI scanner
readme_summary: Plain full-stack-fastapi-template copy with real missing index, planted crash, staged seed data and Locust traffic. Backend/frontend plus compose demo setup. Built as evaluation target for Unbidden during Meta hackathon.

summary: Enter a Calgary address to see a livability score explained plus listing photo checks.
readme_summary: Calgary home-buyer flow showing a read-only residential livability and investment score. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for plain-language explanations and Python plus SAM 3.1 for listing photo triage and segmentation.

summary: Warehouse copilot that forecasts shipping and recommends staffing moves.
readme_summary: Copilot on warehouse data projecting on-time shipping and detecting stoppages from scan gaps. Deterministic Python engine computes numbers, recommends moves and drafts staffing posts. Built with Muse, web UI plus approval workflow.

summary: Offline-first POS for small shops with local Llama voice commands
readme_summary: Offline-first retail POS for Mozambique with sales, stock, cashier shifts, and local storage. Built with React Vite, TypeScript, Tauri, SQLite, and Supabase sync. Uses Llama 3.2 1B via Ollama locally for natural-language store commands.

summary: Rehearses a purchasing case so successors learn the missing expert condition
readme_summary: Missing Monday demo runs a synthetic purchasing case where a successor rehearses and an expert adds the missing condition. Built with Python stdlib server on port 8766 with no dependencies. Uses muse-spark-open-1026 via BASETEN_API_KEY when present, otherwise runs offline.

summary: ESP32-S3 sensor nodes and gateway giving a home assistant live light perception
readme_summary: Physical sensing foundation with DFRobot ESP32-S3 node posting light observations every 10s. Includes LAN status page, gateway listener and systemd unit. MicroPython firmware plus gateway built during hackathon for embodied home perception.

summary: Converts LaTeX to venue-template Word docs with preservation checks.
readme_summary: Uploads .tex or .zip and builds .docx on IEEE and Springer LNCS Word templates with correction logs. Local Python pipeline. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for parsing LaTeX structure and verifying fidelity.

summary: AI corrosion inspection platform for infrastructure maintenance
readme_summary: CorroSense is an AI corrosion inspection and maintenance assistant built with Next.js. It uses Meta Model API with Muse models for analysis and image segmentation. API key is configured server-side via MODEL_API_KEY in .env.local.

summary: Unity neighbourhood life sim where autonomous residents live, work and talk
readme_summary: Blockparty is a Unity life simulation of eight residents with needs, traits, jobs and relationships. Players watch, guide or speak to residents with pause and time controls. It uses Muse Voice for commands, Muse Spark for behavior, SAM for vision and Muse Image.

summary: Triage system that flags grooming risk and resists text obfuscation attacks
readme_summary: Self-learning triage layer detects grooming and solicitation patterns and normalizes leetspeak and hidden characters. Uses Python src plus eval harness with SQLite reviewer queue. Uses Muse Spark concepts for structured audit explanations with human moderator feedback.

summary: Agentic assistant turning street-damage reports into audited work orders
readme_summary: StreetOps AI converts unstructured pothole and streetlight reports into verified maintenance work orders. Stack is React Vite plus Node Express with a Muse Spark agent loop for extraction, deduplication and auditable history.

summary: Linux terminal adventure game with AI-generated storybooks
readme_summary: The Cyber Crew is a web game for learning Linux terminal via adventures. Built with Vite and TypeScript, it calls Meta Model API muse-spark-1.2 for book generation with fallback to a built-in procedural generator.

summary: Autopilot for chemistry labs with safety and optimization
readme_summary: Experiment Autopilot v4 is a Python lab automation system with SPC, DOE, kill-switch and cost tracking. It uses Llama-4-Maverick for reasoning and Llama-Guard-3-8B for safety, with dashboard, optimizer and report generator.

summary: Static site mapping Turkish Official Gazette regulations since 2000
readme_summary: Parses 10,608 Official Gazette issues into 99k regulations by type, year and amended law. Python scripts generate a static interactive site served locally. No Meta AI integration described; analysis is deterministic parsing and comparison.

summary: Local-first camera pipeline detecting events with graded alerts and evidence custody
readme_summary: Safe House turns existing cameras into detection to graded alert to tamper-evident evidence. Local detection filters video and only candidates go to Muse Spark Open via Baseten for verification. Verified alerts are sent to human via WhatsApp with measured egress and hashes.

summary: Action-path supervisor that gates risky agent steps with deterministic rules
readme_summary: Sits in agent action path wrapping tool calls via SDK. Engine gates steps with rules, escalates flagged steps to judge contract and learns new rules. Monorepo with pnpm-turbo, packages/sdk, engine, registry and demo app.

summary: Local API relay with client portal, admin center and Muse connector
readme_summary: Node.js relay with client experience site, admin server, SQLite usage and simulated billing. Local Python connector bridges Muse web sessions. Tagged muse-spark compatible, upstream model decided.

summary: Bangla chat assistant answering local service questions from a real Kurigram directory
readme_summary: Single-file Cloudflare Worker exposes /api/ai-chat for Bangla text or voice queries. Muse Spark 1.3 calls 12 tools over Supabase tables for doctors, buses, blood donors and shops. Returns grounded Bangla answers with no invented data.

summary: Personal digital twin with multi-agent help, RAG knowledge hub and memory
readme_summary: LifeOS AI is a personal assistant with multi-agent orchestration, RAG knowledge hub and persistent memory. Stack is FastAPI backend, React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind frontend, and MongoDB Atlas. It uses Meta Llama API for chat, planning and memory tasks.

summary: Verified waste ledger tracking weights and payments for Lagos households and collectors.
readme_summary: EcoCycle is Laravel 13 + Livewire 4 + MySQL platform where every screen figure is a DB query for waste movement and payouts. Provides household verification, collector proof and processor purchases for Lagos waste economy.

summary: Simplifies Indonesian employment documents into verified plain language
readme_summary: Go backend with Flutter frontend focused on privacy with no document retention. Uploads employment docs for clarity and verification workflow. Uses Meta Muse Spark for simplification.

summary: Browser video editing copilot that turns prompts into VFX edits
readme_summary: Browser-based multimodal video editing copilot for natural-language rotoscoping and composition. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark Open for scene understanding, with serverless inference on Modal, Baseten and Fireworks.

summary: Offline-first Android AI tutor that works without network in airplane mode
readme_summary: Android Maya tutor app where Llama 3.2 1B runs on-device for offline lessons and quizzes. Backend uses Muse Wonder for micro-lessons and Muse Image for illustrations. Native Android with Gradle build.

summary: Reusable state and traceable-change toolkit portfolio called manymoats
readme_summary: Manymoats is a pre-revenue software and IP portfolio around reusable state and traceable changes. Repo contains overview docs and hackathon folder with evidence-focused reading rules. No clear Muse model integration is documented in the excerpt.

summary: Chrome extension that rates YouTube video credibility from transcripts.
readme_summary: Chrome extension that fetches video transcripts and returns Credible/Mixed/Red-flags verdict with reasons and confidence. Bring-your-own-key client-side design with token cost display. Supports Claude Haiku plus other providers, no server needed.

summary: Triages e-waste photos into parts, sorting tips, and safety notes
readme_summary: Upload e-waste photo to get component list, bounding-box overlay, sorting suggestions and JSON report. Live mode uses vision chat-completions endpoint; demo mode is UI-only. Flask backend with HTML templates.

summary: Sorts unreplied support email by urgency and drafts replies for review.
readme_summary: Python scripts filter sample_inbox.json to unreplied mail, classify topic and urgency, and save sorted queue. Draft generator creates short NOT SENT replies for human review. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API, never sends email.

summary: Hand-tuned CUDA kernels speeding up Muse Spark serving on H200 GPUs
readme_summary: Open Kernel Challenge entry with custom CUDA kernels for Muse attention decode, MoE, decode and prefill layers. Each problem directory holds submission.py measured as speedup over SGLang baseline. Optimizes Muse Spark Open 8xH200 inference, no Muse API use.

summary: Visual DIY guide for Ray-Ban Display with voice and illustrated steps
readme_summary: Native SwiftUI iOS 17.2+ app turning repair photos and descriptions into visual checklists. Supports voice, glasses gesture, and touch for steps and close-ups. Built for Meta Ray-Ban Display with docs for architecture and builds.

summary: Shared file mailbox and MCP server for messaging between agent sessions
readme_summary: Agent-mail provides a shared ~/Mailbox directory synced via Syncthing with MCP server for agent-to-agent messages by topic. Python utility installed via nix across hosts. No direct Meta model use; infrastructure for multi-agent harnesses.

summary: Codes AI harm cases by who actually bore the consequence
readme_summary: Python-coded tracker of 46 AI Incident Database agent cases from primary sources, using frozen v24 scheme. Classifies liability to user, employer, deployer, vendor, or harmed party; made by errata AI agent.

summary: Three-gate continuity checker for AI-generated frame sequences
readme_summary: Spike testing static validity, transition and spec compliance across frame pairs using named pixel sets. CPU-only Python with numpy, scipy, PIL on synthetic and real cases. Validates consistency across images, not inside one.

summary: Hackathon harness with contracts, fixtures and launcher for judging runs
readme_summary: No README content provided. File tree shows launcher, candidate backend, deploy configs and JSON contracts for judge actions, clock, beats and notices. Appears to be evaluation tooling for reproducible hackathon judging.

summary: Map-first planning workspace linking parcels, satellite change and field evidence in Kilimani.
readme_summary: Kili-Vault is a planner workspace for Kilimani Ward connecting GIS parcels, satellite detections, geotagged evidence, and case records. Frontend map plus backend evidence chain generates descriptive briefs. Uses Meta AI models for factual verification summaries without autonomous compliance decisions.

summary: Shared due-date board with Tibo AI friend that edits, remembers, and checks in
readme_summary: Central board for tasks, habits, goals, notes, and focus sessions shared via Live and profiles. TiboAgent edits the board, keeps long-term memory, and handles check-ins on Meta Muse Spark via AI Gateway. Built with TanStack Start, Effect RPC, Drizzle, Neon Postgres, Cloudflare.

summary: Watch serial shorts or generate branching illustrated narrated stories.
readme_summary: Expo mobile/web app for live-action and stop-motion series with AI story branching. Cloudflare Worker API with Supabase Postgres handles workflows and hosting. Uses Meta models to turn prompts into illustrated, narrated story branches.

summary: Automates pool filter backwashing with pressure sensing, valves and pump control.
readme_summary: ESP32-based controller reads filter pressure gauge, drives pump and backwash valve with HTTP server and Home Assistant integration. Includes mDNS, config manager and relay control. Plans physical hardware build with power and RS485 wiring.

summary: Local-first assistant that turns plain-language file requests into reviewable plans executed on-device
readme_summary: Users describe file tasks, review an AI-generated step plan, then a desktop agent executes locally. Turborepo with web app, API server, PostgreSQL and secure local executor; sensitive files stay on device.

summary: Investigation game where players check AI claims against case evidence.
readme_summary: Players review briefings and three evidence cards, question an AI partner and submit verdicts with reasoning. Frontend and backend present timestamps and feedback. Uses Muse Spark for the investigation dialogue and claim evaluation.

summary: OpenCode V2 config adding ClinePass models as a provider
readme_summary: Drop-in OpenCode V2 body that adds ClinePass as provider via Cline OpenAI-compatible API. Merges subscription catalog and free-tier models including Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor, with JSONC config and plugins.

summary: Photographs medical bills and explains charges in plain language
readme_summary: Elderly-first PWA built with HTML, CSS and JS, installable with offline app shell. Scans bills/EOBs, explains line items, flags suspicious charges and drafts dispute letters. Uses Meta AI models for multilingual text and voice explanations and Q&A.

summary: Offline synthetic demo of a short-video studio with gated Meta API adapters.
readme_summary: Isolated Python + HTML prototype with demo.py, server.py and studio.py using synthetic images and plans. Default run is offline with Pillow and FFmpeg; live Meta API is gated and disabled. Explicitly not a submitted entry or proof of integration.

summary: Ranks GitHub issues by newcomer-friendliness and drafts grounded fix plans.
readme_summary: Enter owner/name to fetch open issues via GitHub REST API. Muse Spark scores newcomer-friendliness 0-10, picks top 3, then tool-calls get_repo_tree/readme/read_file to write file-level fix plans. Stack is Python app.py + Cloudflare Worker with live demo.

summary: Turns phone browser into mouse, keyboard, and macro pad for PC
readme_summary: Local Wi-Fi controller that turns any phone browser into trackpad, keyboard, shortcuts, and screen viewer for Windows. Python server + web client with JSON macro bank and gesture lab. No cloud or Meta AI dependency.

summary: Self-evolving agent harness first applied to Waldorf education in Vietnam
readme_summary: Self-improving system that researches, updates specs, generates harness and plugins, then measures via benchmark. Immutable DAO.md governs decisions. First loop is waldorf plugin for Waldorf-inspired education.

summary: Rust platform to run agents with traces, secrets, and feedback loop
readme_summary: Rust-native AgentHub with axum HTTP API, terminal client, run loop, transcript persistence, and per-run traceability. Workspace crates for API, runtime, and control with feedback/improve loop. Model-agnostic infra ready for Muse integration.

summary: Agent API for HELM POS and inventory management system
readme_summary: Next.js POS/inventory system with a dedicated agent API layer. TypeScript API with Vercel deployment exposing inventory operations to AI agents for the hackathon demo.

summary: Simulates oral biofilm diffusion to explore mouth-to-bloodstream dynamics
readme_summary: Python dynamical simulation of oral biofilm diffusion on an abstracted SpatialGrid, designed 1D now and 4D-ready. Stack includes Python sim engine, configs and web-based Journey demo. Uses a live Meta guide and bounded Meta research agent for interpretation, inference only.

summary: Lets Pi harness run on Muse subscription credentials with native loop
readme_summary: Pi extension that routes Pi agent requests through Muse subscription auth from ~/.config/muse/auth.json. Preserves Pi's native agent loop and namespaced tools with no billing fallback. Supports model selection, usage reporting, and env overrides for key and user-agent.

summary: Termux-built Android app using Muse Spark, SAM vision and Xhosa voice features
readme_summary: Collection of 5 lightweight APKs built with javac, d8 and aapt2 in Termux, no Android Studio. Uses muse-spark-1.3, muse-wonder, sam-3.1 and muse-voice for Xhosa/English speech. Java source and build proofs included.

summary: Automates 3-way invoice-PO-receipt matching with explainable audit notes
readme_summary: Autonomous CFO compares vendor invoices, purchase orders, and receipts to flag quantity, price, and bank-detail mismatches. Python app generates AI-written audit workpapers while keeping human approval for payments. Uses Meta AI models for extraction and exception explanation.

summary: SMS chatbot bringing AI Q&A to basic feature phones without internet.
readme_summary: Brings AI to ordinary mobile phones via SMS for users without smartphones or data. Node.js backend handles text questions and conversational answers. Uses Meta Muse Spark for multilingual understanding and response generation.

summary: Benchmarks 24 AI models on real Israeli rabbinic ordination exam questions
readme_summary: Evaluation results bundle testing models on 60 closed-book Hebrew questions from five Cheshvan 5787 semicha papers. Each model answered three times with shared rubrics and judge scoring. Provisional report compares GPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude and others, not a Muse-powered app.

summary: Offline iPhone assistant with on-device AI, maps, compass and BT sharing
readme_summary: Native iOS prototype runs Meta Llama 3.2 1B Instruct on-device for text answers with no cloud or API key. Includes bundled OpenStreetMap area, saved places, compass and encrypted Bluetooth location sharing.

summary: WhatsApp-supervised AI coding that turns chat bug reports into approved GitHub issues
readme_summary: Zero-build static bakery site serving as live target repo for Relais demo. Relais converts WhatsApp conversation with owner Sarah into reviewed GitHub issues, shown with intentional booking spinner bug. Showcases human-supervised engineering with Muse models.

summary: Explains Android health-app permissions and tracker risks in plain terms
readme_summary: Python tool parses MobSF output, permissions and trackers with deterministic analyzers and Streamlit UI. Presents structured findings with risk levels. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 to generate plain-English explanations of findings.

summary: Web platform for AI-powered code security audits and business plan evaluations.
readme_summary: Provides Code Auditor and Business Evaluator workflows powered server-side by Meta Model API. Built with Node.js, TypeScript, and server.ts backend requiring MODEL_API_KEY with no frontend key exposure.

summary: Analyzes 32k winning Meta ads to suggest what brands should test next
readme_summary: Admode mines Meta Ad Library data to find durable winning patterns. Muse Spark watched 32,051 video ads to recommend ideas, success likelihood, and next tests for brands. Demo is a static site with video walkthrough.

summary: No-code studio that fine-tunes private LoRAs to keep brand mascots consistent.
readme_summary: WREN Story Engine turns a few mascot reference photos into a private reusable model for new scenes and story art. It handles dataset curation, paid GPU fine-tuning, versioned adapters, and t-shirt and storyboard outputs. Built with frontend + backend for designers with no code or GPU.

summary: Turns any phone browser on Wi-Fi into PC mouse, keyboard and screen viewer
readme_summary: Prototype exposes one local address to provide trackpad, typing, shortcuts, JSON macro bank, and gesture pad. Python backend streams optional live PC screen with cursor overlay. No app, account, or cloud; includes gesture lab and config-driven profiles.

summary: Floating on-screen subtitles that transcribe mic and system audio with live translation
readme_summary: Listens to mic, system audio or files and shows streaming transcripts plus translations in an always-on-top window. Speech recognition and translation run on Meta Model API with second-pass check. Exports SRT, VTT and JSONL with spending limits.

summary: Parses credit reports, flags issues, and drafts letters for user review
readme_summary: Python scaffold parsing JSON, labelled-text, and PDF via local pdftotext. Flags inconsistencies and drafts dispute letters from synthetic data. Demo prototype with no cloud or bureau integration.

summary: Rules-first symptom triage assistant that routes Zambian telehealth patients to right care level
readme_summary: Live at Doc'O Clock /triage, it takes symptom chips, free text, severity and risk factors through TriageAssistant.tsx. Rules engine gates urgency with a Meta Model API step for refinement and booking. Built with React frontend and Supabase backend on a live telehealth platform.

summary: Encrypted container format with forensic validation and IPFS Filecoin ledger
readme_summary: Implements HLK v2 wire protocol with canonical CBOR, Zstandard compress-then-encrypt and AEAD ciphers. Uses Argon2id KDF and BLAKE3 with Python CLI plus Windows support. Provides forensic integrity validator and decentralized storage ledger, no Meta model dependency.

summary: Reproducible evolution loop to optimize gripper designs in simulation
readme_summary: Takes gripper objective, bounds and simulator budget to compare random search vs evolution vs evolution+adversary. Planner proposes regions, deterministic surrogate scores, results versioned with seeds and holdout fingerprint.

summary: Photo tool that segments thrift piles and prices each item from sold listings.
readme_summary: Segments a thrift pile photo into individual items and returns pass or price verdicts from verified sold prices. Python script calls SAM 3.1 for text-prompted segmentation then Muse Spark 1.3 for item identification and valuation.

summary: Phone-scanned living 3D semantic maps for indoor voice navigation
readme_summary: Unity + AR Foundation app scans rooms into persistent 3D wireframe maps. SAM 3.1 does zero-shot segmentation, Muse Spark reasons over topology for navigation. Built with Muse Code and Unity MCP with regression tests.

summary: Evidence-first lab to stress-test document AI with verified reports
readme_summary: Generates fictional receipts/invoices with deterministic facts for paired controls and replay. Muse Wonder/Image/Spark chain designs, renders, extracts and coaches prompts with gated scoring. TypeScript + Vite workbench.

summary: Browser camera counter with Muse Spark scene interpretation and event log
readme_summary: Real-time audience counting from camera, upload, or synthetic scene using browser blob counting. Sends count, clusters and spread to Muse Spark via Meta Model API for crowd interpretation. Stack is Python server.py plus static web UI with timestamped event log.

summary: Open content dataset of animals, places and translations for Animundo game
readme_summary: This repo is Animundo game content, not the hackathon entry: data files for lands, animals, foods and locales. The separate Animundo Builder built with Muse Code reads this checkout and uses Meta models to research new species. First commit predates event.

summary: Family organizer for chores, homework, points, rewards and shared calendar
readme_summary: HomeSync is a family organization app for chores, homework tracking, points and shared calendar. Backend runs in Docker with API docs, frontend is Flutter. Simple full-stack structure with minimal AI integration described in README.

summary: Planned iPad-first Socratic math app where mascots act out story consequences.
readme_summary: Planning-only repo for an open-source grade-2 math app with hint ladder and on-device progress, no backend. Defines web-first then native SwiftUI iPad build covering NCDPI curriculum. No implementation or Meta model integration yet.

summary: Open-rules safety gate that scores and blocks risky lethal agent tool combos.

summary: Evidence-driven multimodal agent that diagnoses tech issues via observe-verify loop
readme_summary: Multimodal troubleshooting agent built around Observe-Hypothesize-Ask-Verify-Recommend loop. Collects symptoms, images and evidence to test hypotheses before recommending fixes. Python diagnostic_core with docs, examples and tests.

summary: Polls Design Arena registry and posts stealth model alerts to Discord.

summary: Hex-grid steppe adventure in Godot 4 with AI-proposed explorable worlds

summary: 3D oil-spill response console for detection, drift forecast, and cleanup planning.

summary: Turns photos of old parish records into transcription and translation

Uses SAM 3.1 for segment and track and Muse Spark for multimodal reasoning and reports. Human-in-loop review assistant with frontend/backend.

readme_summary: Toolbox catalogs tools seen in forwards and reels, verified against real GitHub repos via daily cron. Static markdown plus Python verify script using GitHub API snapshots. No Meta AI integration evident; utility inventory for CPU-only Linux box.
